job.description:
Job Description

Principal Program Manager, OCI Transitions and Migrations

Are you a creative problem-solver who thrives on complex challenges? Do you enjoy bringing structure to ambiguity, aligning diverse stakeholders, and driving large-scale programs to successful outcomes? If so, you may be the perfect fit for our team as a Principal Program Manager.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is transforming how organizations run their most important applications and workloads. The OCI Transitions and Migrations team helps customers plan and execute complex transitions to Oracle Cloud, coordinating activities across customer teams, engineering, operations, product management, support, sales, and other Oracle organizations.

As a Principal Program Manager for OCI Transitions and Migrations, you will lead high-impact migration and transition programs, establish clear execution plans, manage cross-functional dependencies, and ensure successful delivery. You will act as a central point of accountability, communicate program status to senior leadership, and drive resolution of issues that span teams and organizations.

Job Requirements

8+ Years of Related Experience:

Eight or more years of experience in program management, project management, cloud migrations, enterprise technology delivery, consulting, operations, or a related field.

Program Leadership and Execution:

Demonstrated experience leading large, complex programs across multiple teams, workstreams, and organizational boundaries. Proven ability to develop integrated plans, roadmaps, milestones, governance models, and success measures.

Cloud and Migration Experience:

Experience supporting cloud transitions, enterprise migrations, infrastructure programs, application migrations, data migrations, or technology transformation initiatives. Experience with OCI, AWS, Azure, or other enterprise cloud platforms is preferred.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

Ability to build strong relationships, align stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and drive shared outcomes across engineering, operations, product, support, sales, customer, and leadership teams.

Risk, Dependency, and Change Management:

Experience identifying risks, managing complex dependencies, developing mitigation and recovery plans, and maintaining progress through changing priorities or ambiguous conditions.

Communication and Influence:

Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex information clearly, influence without direct authority, and represent programs effectively with senior leaders.

Strategic and Analytical Thinking:

Ability to connect program execution to broader customer and business objectives, work with large amounts of qualitative and quantitative information, assess program health, and make sound recommendations.

Educational Background:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Responsibilities

Lead Program Delivery:

Lead complex OCI transition and migration programs from planning through execution, stabilization, and completion, ensuring delivery aligns with scope, schedule, customer commitments, and business objectives.

Manage Roadmaps, Dependencies, and Resources:

Develop and maintain integrated program roadmaps, milestones, ownership models, dependencies, resource requirements, and success criteria across cross-functional teams.

Drive Stakeholder Alignment and Execution:

Establish alignment and accountability across customer teams, engineering, operations, product management, support, sales, and partner organizations. Remove barriers and drive timely decisions and actions.

Manage Risks and Resolve Issues:

Identify risks, issues, and dependencies early; develop mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans; and independently drive resolution of cross-team and division-level challenges.

Establish Program Governance:

Create and maintain effective governance, including decision-making processes, escalation paths, status reporting, operating cadences, metrics, and executive review mechanisms.

Communicate Program Status and Recommendations:

Provide clear written and verbal updates on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and customer impact. Present complex issues with relevant data, tradeoffs, options, and recommendations.

Represent the Program With Senior Leadership:

Represent the program and organization independently in discussions through the VP level and support higher-level executive engagements as appropriate.

Maintain Customer and Operational Excellence:

Ensure a consistent Oracle customer experience throughout the transition and migration lifecycle while maintaining high standards for quality, readiness, and execution.

Improve Program Practices:

Identify and implement improvements to planning, governance, reporting, risk management, communications, and execution. Develop reusable templates, dashboards, metrics, and best practices that improve consistency and predictability.

Build Relationships and Mentor Others:

Build trusted partnerships across teams, organizations, cultures, and geographies, while providing guidance and mentorship to other program managers.

Join Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and help customers successfully transition their most important workloads to the cloud. Your leadership, judgment, and ability to drive complex programs will play a critical role in delivering successful migration outcomes and improving how OCI executes transitions at scale.

Responsibilities

Identifies, prioritizes, and successfully executes a broad portfolio of functional initiatives and programs. Plans and directs schedules for multiple programs running simultaneously.  Partners closely with global cross-functional teams to understand and capture requirements for programs. Navigates complex dependencies between cross-functional teams and organizational priorities to optimize the critical path and addresses & mitigates risks.  Effectively influences internal and external teams to prioritize; Drives mitigation plans and ensures ownership for each item and regular follow up through to program closure while ensuring resolution of risk and issues, escalating, as necessary. Provides rigorous management and analysis of overall portfolio budget (including spend and forecasted spend vs. budget, spend per program and historical trends, etc.). Establishes scalable frameworks (process, tools, etc.) for the end-to-end project and manages stakeholders applying project management standards and documentation best practices. Runs standups and sprint planning exercises for programs owned.  Builds and maintains consistent reporting across numerous programs. Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel. Performs other duties as assigned.

job.title: Senior Principal Energy Manager APAC
job.description:
Job Description

Oracle is seeking a Singapore-based Senior Principal Energy Program Manager, reporting to the Vice President of APAC site and energy acquisition. As an energy procurement leader, you will have day-to-day responsibility for shaping and driving Oracle’s approach to energy procurement, as well as supporting broader team efforts around energy innovation, hedging strategies, renewable energy and sustainability. Sustainable and scalable energy procurement is growing in focus across our business and this role will provide critical expertise and execution across Oracle Cloud data centers. At Oracle, we are committed to maintaining 100% carbon-free electricity for our offices and public cloud offerings. Additionally, we are setting a new goal to achieve 100% carbon-free electricity for Oracle Custom AI Data Centers by 2035, including our large, custom AI clusters built for a single customer.

Oversees Data Center Operations across multiple data centers, managing and integrating team performance, operations metrics, and capacity analysis into the broader business line strategy. Directs multiple teams in supporting escalated technical issues, crisis management, and root cause analysis, while standardizing processes and maintaining an accurate knowledge base. Leads new region builds and expansion activities, acting as a senior liaison with project and engineering teams to manage timelines, capacity, and ensure adherence to world-class standards. Guides teams responsible for installations, repairs, inventory, and logistics, enforces standards for component replacements and upgrades, recommends significant purchases, and implements advanced maintenance strategies to optimize data center efficiency and stability.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Data Center Site Portfolio Management:

-Oversees Data Center Operations team across multiple data centers.

Performance Monitoring and Analysis:

-Oversees multiple teams, integrates operations metrics into broader business line strategy.

  • Directs performance evaluations for multiple teams, integrates findings into broader business line strategy.
  • Supervises analysis of physical, power, and cooling capacity for multiple teams, integrates findings into broader business line strategy.
  • Leads Guides collaboration across functions to support continuous improvement efforts in alignment with industry best practices, and mentors team members.

Issue Management and Automation:

-Directs multiple teams providing support for escalated complex technical issues.

  • Proposes and implements advanced strategies for issue triage and leverages automation, scheduling, and monitoring tools to prevent and resolve potential problems.
  • Identifies, documents, and standardizes issues, processes, and solutions, ensuring consistency and accuracy in the data center knowledge base, tailored to departmental requirements.
  • Guides team members to implement strategy for incident or crisis management protocols in alignment with business continuity plans.
  • Leads team members in performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA) following crises or incidents, and updates documentation to capture process improvements.

Data Center Expansion Support:

-Oversees the management of new region builds and expansion activities, both onsite and remotely.

  • Acts as a senior liaison with project teams and data center engineering, ensuring comprehensive timelines and capacity needs are strategically managed for a broad array of expansion projects and site builds.
  • Collaborates with and directs project teams to maintain world-class standards in all expansion projects and site builds.

Installation and Maintenance:

-Leads multiple teams in installations, repairs, inventory management, and logistics tasks for data centers.

  • Creates and enforces standards for component replacements and upgrades.
  • Recommends and oversees significant purchases or upgrades for data centers.
  • Directs high-level planning and coordination of rack deployments, installations, and network infrastructure upgrades/changes.
  • Implements advanced maintenance strategies of the Data Center facilities with regard to efficiency and stability (e.g. containment, air flow & pressure, power trains).

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

-Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

-Drives cross-functional partnerships to align on expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

Problem Solving:

-Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions.

Continuous Learning:

-Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization.

Continuous Improvement:

-Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement.

Performance and Development:

-Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources.

job.title: Lead Principal Systems Software Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Systems Software Development:

  • Contribute to architectural direction for system software and management paradigms across server, storage, networking, and GPU subsystems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Drive the definition and evolution of hardware provisioning solutions for next-generation hardware platforms, leading cross-functional efforts spanning engineering, operations, and global data centers.
  • Lead the integration of system firmware with emerging hardware, collaborating with silicon, board, and firmware teams to ensure seamless bring-up and sustained operability.
  • Partner with internal and external engineering, security, and vendor teams to deliver continuous improvements in performance, security, and diagnosability of system platforms and provisioning workflows.
  • Lead or oversee the analysis of high-impact hardware provisioning and systems software failures, developing systemic engineering and process improvements for large-scale cloud fleets.
  • Mentor engineers across teams, championing best practices in systems integration, reliability, and operational excellence.

Software Development and Coding:

  • Leads project initiatives to design software solutions and identify and analyze requirements. Writes and defines foundational code for new projects or prototypes.
  • Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; coaches engineers across teams or units to drive improvements.
  • Acts as a subject matter expert within the organization to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code.
  • Leads process, architecture, and code reviews across projects and/or products/services to drive improvements.
  • Utilizes modern/emerging technologies to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix highly complex software issues.
  • Leads strategic initiatives to optimize software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
  • Encourages innovation, research, and relevant industry practices to optimize performance across products and domains.
  • Resolves and may troubleshoot highly complex and systematic issues requiring innovation related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
  • Implements innovative API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

  • Leads task and project initiatives for the design and development of software, systems, and services. Defines project or design scope; reviews, influences, and approves scope and design recommendations.
  • Provides technical guidance, domain expertise, and coaching in software architecture decisions and best practices that drive key organizational decisions, including industry standards and competitive considerations, providing mentorship and coaching for small teams and peers and contributing to both individual and team development across line of business/function.
  • Utilizes innovative methods to conduct highly complex periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders across lines of business and externally, to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities.
  • Implements innovative performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
  • Conducts regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements and translates into decisions and plans that can have a major impact on the organization.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

  • Collaborates with stakeholders internally and externally to lead efforts to understand customer issues, root causes, and mitigation to align and explain rationale behind solutions.
  • Must provide expert technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues to mitigate recurrence.
  • Acts as an advisor to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements and solutions based on feedback.
  • Networks across lines of business to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
  • Guides implementation of strategic solutions for customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes.
  • Investigates and troubleshoots the most complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:

  • Collaborates with the security team and leadership teams to establish, follow, and improve upon development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members.
  • Participates in peer review processes and provides technical leadership with initiatives to ensure quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.
  • Demonstrates, contributes to, and shares deep expertise of industry best practices and their application to software development processes.
  • Implements highly complex secure software development practices/solutions requiring modern/emerging innovation to prevent security vulnerabilities, leveraging automated solutions to augment the manual review process.

Development Operations - System Maintenance:

  • Leads project initiatives for periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
  • Acts as subject matter expert to drive improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

  • Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements.
  • Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

  • Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives.
  • Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success.
  • Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

  • Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues.
  • Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

  • Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization.
  • Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions).
  • Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices.
  • Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams.
  • Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization.
  • Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.
  • Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

Performance and Development:

  • Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy.
  • Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

job.title: Lead Data Center Support Services Technician
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, test, deploy, maintain, upgrade, and decommission data centre equipment and infrastructure.
  • Perform safe and efficient rack and stack activities, server deployments, hardware installations, equipment replacements, upgrades, and decommissioning.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve server, hardware, cabling, network, power, and supporting infrastructure issues, escalating appropriately when additional expertise or support is required.
  • Triage, prioritise, and respond to incoming incidents, service requests, and operational issues in a timely manner.
  • Perform preventative and corrective maintenance, including diagnosing hardware failures, replacing failed components, and applying firmware updates.
  • Monitor and support the reliability and performance of production server hardware and supporting data centre infrastructure.
  • Maintain accurate asset, hardware, and spare-parts inventory using internal systems and support tools.
  • Follow established SOPs, change-management processes, operational procedures, security requirements, and safety standards.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and improved service quality.
  • Plan and organise work effectively, balancing competing priorities and high work demands while maintaining attention to detail and delivery quality.
  • Monitor progress against assigned work, proactively communicate priorities, dependencies, blockers, and risks, and take appropriate action when delivery may be impacted.
  • Demonstrate initiative, accountability, and resourcefulness, independently using available documentation, tools, systems, and technical resources to investigate and resolve problems.
  • Recognise personal capacity and technical limitations and escalate workload, risk, or complexity appropriately before service quality, safety, wellbeing, or delivery is adversely affected.
  • Build collaborative working relationships with engineering teams, vendors, customers, internal stakeholders, and other technical and non-technical teams.
  • Communicate technical information clearly and professionally, adapting communication to the audience and proactively keeping relevant stakeholders informed.
  • Work effectively within a global matrix organisation, collaborating and influencing across functions, regions, teams, and reporting lines without relying on direct authority.
  • Balance customer, commercial, operational, and organisational requirements when prioritising work and making decisions.
  • Maintain professionalism, resilience, and sound judgement when working under pressure or responding to changing operational priorities.
  • Contribute to a psychologically safe, respectful, ethical, and inclusive workplace through constructive communication and behaviour consistent with organisational values and policies.
  • Remain open to feedback, resolve disagreements constructively, and demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and development.
  • Adopt new technologies, processes, tools, and ways of working that improve team and operational performance.
  • Deliver timely, accurate, customer-focused, and high-quality technical support within a mission-critical data centre environment.
  • Participate in a rotating 24x7 shift roster, including on-call responsibilities.

Technical Knowledge and Experience

The successful candidate will bring:

  • Previous hands-on experience working in a Data Centre or comparable mission-critical infrastructure environment.
  • Practical experience across the hardware lifecycle, including rack and stack, deployment, configuration, testing, maintenance, upgrades, break/fix activities, component replacement, and decommissioning.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify root causes and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Experience following documented operational procedures while exercising sound judgement when situations require investigation or escalation.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when performing physical infrastructure changes, maintaining records, handling assets, and working on production systems.
  • Background in Linux.
  • Knowledge of Data Centre Ecosystem (cooling, electrical, networking, and structured cabling).

Professional Capabilities

Communication and Stakeholder Management

Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build collaborative relationships across technical and non-technical teams. Able to influence stakeholders, communicate priorities, risks, dependencies, and technical issues proactively, and balance customer, commercial, operational, and organisational needs.

Respectful and Inclusive Behaviour

A demonstrated commitment to fostering a psychologically safe, respectful, ethical, and inclusive workplace. Maintains professional behaviour, communicates constructively, makes responsible decisions, and works consistently with organisational values, policies, and expected standards of conduct.

Resilience, Adaptability and Customer Focus

Able to operate effectively in a dynamic, mission-critical environment, navigate ambiguity, embrace change, and remain resilient under pressure. Demonstrates emotional intelligence and maintains a strong customer focus while delivering required technical and business outcomes.

Planning and Delivery

Strong planning, organisation, prioritisation, and time-management skills. Able to manage competing priorities and high work demands, monitor progress, adjust plans as circumstances change, and consistently deliver safe, accurate, and high-quality outcomes.

Initiative and Accountability

Demonstrates a proactive, self-service mindset with strong initiative, ownership, accountability, and resourcefulness. Independently investigates and solves problems using available tools, documentation, systems, and resources while understanding when escalation or additional support is appropriate.

Recognises personal capacity, workload constraints, and technical complexity and proactively seeks support before quality, safety, wellbeing, customer outcomes, or delivery are adversely affected.

Collaboration in a Matrix Environment

Experience working effectively within a global matrix organisation, collaborating across multiple functions, regions, teams, and reporting structures. Able to build alignment and influence outcomes through credibility, communication, and collaboration rather than direct authority.

Continuous Learning and Improvement

Demonstrates openness to feedback, coaching, continuous learning, and constructive conflict resolution. Willingly adopts new processes, tools, technologies, and ways of working and actively contributes ideas that improve operational effectiveness and support a high-performing team culture.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, position, and move IT equipment weighing 15 kg or more.
  • Comfortable working within data centre environments, including standing for extended periods, bending, reaching, and working in confined or restricted spaces.
  • Able to safely and efficiently perform rack and stack, hardware installation, cabling, component replacement, and equipment decommissioning activities.
  • Commitment to following relevant workplace health, safety, and operational procedures.
  • Valid drivers license and access to a car.

Security Requirements

Applicants must be Australian citizens and either:

  • Hold a current NV1 Security Clearance, or
  • Be eligible and willing to obtain NV1 clearance through the Australian Government security vetting process.

Why ORACLE?

Join a global technology leader operating some of the world's most advanced cloud infrastructure. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies, solve challenging infrastructure problems, collaborate with talented professionals across a global organisation, and contribute directly to the reliability, availability, and performance of critical cloud services used by customers around the world.

You'll join an environment that values technical excellence, customer focus, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, continuous learning, safety, and continuous improvement.

If you're looking for your next challenge and want to develop your career in large-scale, mission-critical data centre and cloud infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of the team powering ORACLE Cloud Infrastructure.

job.title: Principal Performance Test Engineer (Fusion Load Testing)
job.description:
Job Description

As a member of the Support organization, your focus is to deliver post-sales support and solutions to the Oracle customer base while serving as an advocate for customer needs. This involves resolving post-sales non-technical customer inquiries via phone and electronic means, as well as, technical questions regarding the use of and troubleshooting for our Electronic Support Services. A primary point of contact for customers, you are responsible for facilitating customer relationships with Support and providing advice and assistance to internal Oracle employees on diverse customer situations and escalated issues.

Responsibilities

As a Principal Support Engineer, you will offer strategic technical support to assure the highest level of customer satisfaction. A primary focus is to create/utilize automated technology and instrumentation to diagnose, document, and resolve/avoid customer issues. You are expected to be an expert member of the technical problem solving/problem avoidance team, routinely sought after to address extremely complex, critical customer issues. Services may be frequently provided by on-site customer visits.

Experience Level: 8 to10+ years relevant working experience

Qualification: BE, BTech, MCA or equivalent preferred. Other qualifications with adequate experience may be considered.

  • Take Senior role and the responsibility includes understanding & perform various components Load/performance testing, system testing and non-functional testing.
  • Gather Performance Non Functional Requirements
  • Create and review Performance Test Plan
  • Develop performance Test Script as per Transaction flow document using OATS
  • Automate load testing using any of the lead testing tools like OATS, Load runner etc.,
  • Should have good debugging skills.
  • Creating Load Test Cases, designing the orchestration, executing them.
  • Experience of OATS load testing protocols
  • Application Knowledge in Oracle Fusion (All modules), Web-Based application & expertise in Oracle applications
  • Hands on debugging skills.
  • 8 to 10+ years of relevant experience
  • Good experience in  OLT /Open Script - Test Management Tools
  • Developing a Web Based Application Test Plan, Test Strategy, Test Scenarios, Test Cases, and Traceability Matrix.
  • Ability to work with the functional team to coordinate all testing efforts.
  • Adopt innovative technologies and best practices to solve complicated challenges.
  • Ability to learn new technologies, improve skills and develop yourself.
  • Take responsibility of training and mentoring team members.

Primary Skills:

  • Experienced as Testing Tech Lead of Oracle Fusion SaaS Applications. Performance Testing Experience is must (OATS/ Load Runner)
  • Helps Formulate & develop effective Test Architecture (Manual/ Automated/ Load) per organizational needs
  • Responsible for Test Strategy formulation
  • Extensive Technical skills covering Product, Technologies and Competitive
  • Software Analysis & Design knowledge/experience
  • Solid background in Software Quality & Testing with wide expertise in Oracle Application Testing Suite (OATS), QTP, Winrunner etc.
  • Hands-on experience to perform and review both functional and non-functional testing and its outputs
  • Technically responsible for all the Testing performed by the Team
  • Technical Leadership and Strategic Direction to the Testing Team.
  • Take responsibility of training and mentoring team members.

Secondary & Automation Skills:

  • Basic knowledge in any one software programming like Python, Shell scripting, PERL
  • Basic knowledge on any one Web development, languages like HTML, CSS, Jscript, REST framework etc., will be an added advantage
  • Specialist in any one area or technology such as Saas Fusion Apps, EBSO, PeopleSoft, Hyperion, JD Edwards etc,
  • Knowledge of current industry wide Quality & Test processes and practices, Tools and techniques
  • Solution-oriented and creative thinker.

Other Details:

  • Excellent team player
  • Effective negotiation skills
  • Strong communication skills
  • Strong customer management skills
  • Willing to learn new applications
  • Quick learner who adapts to new technology.
  • Committed to studying and meeting the needs of business users.

Location:

Bangalore

Qualifications

Career Level - IC4

Required Skills

  • Load Testing Tools
  • Performance Testing

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing [accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com](mailto:accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com) or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

job.title: Oracle PaaS Solution Architect
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership:

-Serves as a trusted advisor to customers and a technical expert on technologies across the marketplace (e.g., technical speaking engagements, publications) to shape guidance provided to customers.

  • Recognized as a technical expert with highly specialized knowledge across Oracle and non-Oracle technologies, products, services, and market trends, serving as a go-to expert for complex or high-impact scenarios.
  • Defines or adjusts strategy for highly complex pre-sales activities, contributing to long-term account growth and solution fit.
  • Leads organization-wide and customer fleet-wide optimizations or efficiency efforts (e.g., automation, streamlined processes, elimination of redundant effort), coordinating with the TAM, ASE engineers and others on the Oracle customer team.
  • Works with external partners to ensure appropriate design and implementation of solutions and promote best practices for technology deployment and workloads, and their stability, maintainability, upgradeability, and performance.

Service Delivery:

-Acts as internal and/or external expert point of contact and escalation point for critical technical and process issues encountered in the customer's supported environment.

  • Provides proactive and reactive remote or onsite technical assistance in close cooperation with Support and Product Development teams, for problem analysis and investigation and providing and verifying workarounds and acting as a field point of contact for various LOBs.
  • Assists customers with highly complex software updates, upgrades, change management, and incident remediation, identifying key risks and mitigation strategies that may impact project success.
  • Analyzes new and highly complex issues encountered by customers by performing thorough technical root cause investigations.
  • Reviews themes across lessons learned post-project and leads changes to improve technology implementation.

Global Customer Engagement & Education:

-Acts as expert technical lead for customers and partners with customer leadership to, ensuring solutions address business needs and drive long-term business transformation.

  • Educates and mentors junior engineers to educate customers on product features, upgrades, and patches, and drives and shapes adoption of best practices for technology deployment and workloads, and their stability, maintainability, upgradeability, and performance.
  • Provides executive presence for junior team members during customer meetings where technical expertise is required for critical or escalated issues or where expert technical direction is needed for key decisions.
  • Uses holistic view of solutions and contextual understanding of customer solutions to influence customer direction.

Technical Design & Documentation:

-Leads the scoping, creation, and maintenance of customer deliverables, SOPs, and documentation to help customers implement solutions.

  • Leads highly complex problem analysis and investigation, providing documented technical solutions ready for customers to implement, test and maintain.
  • Oversees how solution designs are developed across programs, ensuring the use of appropriate methodologies and adherence to Oracle and enterprise architectural standards.
  • Scopes potential customer requests and clarify value-add for a service during pre-sales.
  • Defines best practices and provides mentorship to engineers across multiple teams.
  • Ensures technical designs are forward-looking, scalable, and aligned with broader strategic direction.
  • Translates market trends into design strategies that prepare the business for future growth.

Influence & Collaboration:

-Drives cross-functional alignment of internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with technology strategy and business goals, facilitating collaboration across multiple programs and senior stakeholders.

  • Identifies opportunities for expanding partnerships and with key contacts across functions and creates opportunities to facilitate networking for lower levels.
  • Works with customer senior leadership to influences priorities based on technical vision to support customer's technical roadmap.

Innovation & Business Development:

-Leverages customer insights and partners with product management to ensure alignment with technical ecosystem when driving new service offerings and engagement methods.

  • Leverages customer insights to shape new service offerings and engagement methods.
  • Leads technical scoping in strategic deals, partnering with sales teams to define the solution approach and ensure business needs are translated into viable technical deliverables.
  • Shapes growth opportunities by aligning Oracle solutions with customer roadmaps and business drivers.
  • Delivers presentations and acts as a technical expert and executive presence during presentations for junior team members and communicates details on integrated solutions that drive strategy.
  • Uses deep technical, functional, and service delivery expertise across technologies to strategically influence customer perception of value.

Additional Responsibilities (as needed)

Technical Solution Design:

-Drives technical strategy and architecture across the organization, mentoring technical leaders and ensuring alignment with business goals using broad knowledge across multiple technologies/ services.

  • Oversees architectural and solution design reviews across programs, ensuring technical excellence and mentoring senior engineers across technologies and services in scalable design principles.
  • Guides teams in applying consistent design practices aligned to current and emerging business needs using expertise across multiple technologies/services.
  • Shapes and maintains architectural principles, introducing innovative approaches and evolving design practices to remain competitive in a rapidly changing market.
  • Drives high-level design (HLD) development by introducing new methods across technologies/services, promoting creativity, and ensuring solutions reflect a deep understanding of organizational technical operations.
  • Creates and establishes internal policies, processes, and standards for security, scalability, and other product/service fundamentals related to solution delivery across a family of technologies or services at the organization or cross-organization level.

Delivery Program Management:

-Owns the planning, execution, and service value creation of delivery engineering projects across multiple customer accounts within a technical domain.

  • Leverages deep project management knowledge to scope delivery engineering projects, design project schedules, and document resource requirements.
  • Manages technical delivery along with Technical Leader, coordinating resources and managing projects to drive results and maximize value to customers.
  • Proactively partners with customers and other account team members (e.g., TAM, Technical Leader) to understand customers' technical projects, goals, and KPIs, and provide required technical guidance to delivery engineering team.
  • Leverages domain expertise to lead escalation calls and assist in managing all aspects of escalations, including situation management and executive communication.
  • Oversees the quality and completeness of deliverables across customers.
  • Acts as a domain technical expert to represent delivery engineering in sales opportunities with customers.

Core Responsibilities

Collaboration & Partnership:

-Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives. Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success. Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Continuous Improvement:

-Drives implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department. Seeks and integrates diverse feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.

Planning & Execution:

-Manages and provides direction on timelines and budgets for critical high-impact projects, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements. Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Problem Solving:

-Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for highly complex issues. Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

-Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise within a specialty area to serve as a thought leader within the organization. Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve server, hardware, cabling, network, power, and supporting infrastructure issues, escalating appropriately when additional expertise or support is required.
  • Triage, prioritise, and respond to incoming incidents, service requests, and operational issues in a timely manner.
  • Perform preventative and corrective maintenance, including diagnosing hardware failures, replacing failed components, and applying firmware updates.
  • Monitor and support the reliability and performance of production server hardware and supporting data centre infrastructure.
  • Maintain accurate asset, hardware, and spare-parts inventory using internal systems and support tools.
  • Follow established SOPs, change-management processes, operational procedures, security requirements, and safety standards.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and improved service quality.
  • Plan and organise work effectively, balancing competing priorities and high work demands while maintaining attention to detail and delivery quality.
  • Monitor progress against assigned work, proactively communicate priorities, dependencies, blockers, and risks, and take appropriate action when delivery may be impacted.
  • Demonstrate initiative, accountability, and resourcefulness, independently using available documentation, tools, systems, and technical resources to investigate and resolve problems.
  • Recognise personal capacity and technical limitations and escalate workload, risk, or complexity appropriately before service quality, safety, wellbeing, or delivery is adversely affected.
  • Build collaborative working relationships with engineering teams, vendors, customers, internal stakeholders, and other technical and non-technical teams.
  • Communicate technical information clearly and professionally, adapting communication to the audience and proactively keeping relevant stakeholders informed.
  • Work effectively within a global matrix organisation, collaborating and influencing across functions, regions, teams, and reporting lines without relying on direct authority.
  • Balance customer, commercial, operational, and organisational requirements when prioritising work and making decisions.
  • Maintain professionalism, resilience, and sound judgement when working under pressure or responding to changing operational priorities.
  • Contribute to a psychologically safe, respectful, ethical, and inclusive workplace through constructive communication and behaviour consistent with organisational values and policies.
  • Remain open to feedback, resolve disagreements constructively, and demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and development.
  • Adopt new technologies, processes, tools, and ways of working that improve team and operational performance.
  • Deliver timely, accurate, customer-focused, and high-quality technical support within a mission-critical data centre environment.
  • Participate in a rotating 24x7 shift roster, including on-call responsibilities.

Technical Knowledge and Experience

The successful candidate will bring:

  • Previous hands-on experience working in a Data Centre or comparable mission-critical infrastructure environment.
  • Practical experience across the hardware lifecycle, including rack and stack, deployment, configuration, testing, maintenance, upgrades, break/fix activities, component replacement, and decommissioning.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify root causes and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Experience following documented operational procedures while exercising sound judgement when situations require investigation or escalation.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when performing physical infrastructure changes, maintaining records, handling assets, and working on production systems.
  • Background in Linux.
  • Knowledge of Data Centre Ecosystem (cooling, electrical, networking, and structured cabling).

Professional Capabilities

Communication and Stakeholder Management

Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build collaborative relationships across technical and non-technical teams. Able to influence stakeholders, communicate priorities, risks, dependencies, and technical issues proactively, and balance customer, commercial, operational, and organisational needs.

Respectful and Inclusive Behaviour

A demonstrated commitment to fostering a psychologically safe, respectful, ethical, and inclusive workplace. Maintains professional behaviour, communicates constructively, makes responsible decisions, and works consistently with organisational values, policies, and expected standards of conduct.

Resilience, Adaptability and Customer Focus

Able to operate effectively in a dynamic, mission-critical environment, navigate ambiguity, embrace change, and remain resilient under pressure. Demonstrates emotional intelligence and maintains a strong customer focus while delivering required technical and business outcomes.

Planning and Delivery

Strong planning, organisation, prioritisation, and time-management skills. Able to manage competing priorities and high work demands, monitor progress, adjust plans as circumstances change, and consistently deliver safe, accurate, and high-quality outcomes.

Initiative and Accountability

Demonstrates a proactive, self-service mindset with strong initiative, ownership, accountability, and resourcefulness. Independently investigates and solves problems using available tools, documentation, systems, and resources while understanding when escalation or additional support is appropriate.

Recognises personal capacity, workload constraints, and technical complexity and proactively seeks support before quality, safety, wellbeing, customer outcomes, or delivery are adversely affected.

Collaboration in a Matrix Environment

Experience working effectively within a global matrix organisation, collaborating across multiple functions, regions, teams, and reporting structures. Able to build alignment and influence outcomes through credibility, communication, and collaboration rather than direct authority.

Continuous Learning and Improvement

Demonstrates openness to feedback, coaching, continuous learning, and constructive conflict resolution. Willingly adopts new processes, tools, technologies, and ways of working and actively contributes ideas that improve operational effectiveness and support a high-performing team culture.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, position, and move IT equipment weighing 15 kg or more.
  • Comfortable working within data centre environments, including standing for extended periods, bending, reaching, and working in confined or restricted spaces.
  • Able to safely and efficiently perform rack and stack, hardware installation, cabling, component replacement, and equipment decommissioning activities.
  • Commitment to following relevant workplace health, safety, and operational procedures.
  • Valid driver’s license and access to a car.

Security Requirements

Applicants must be Australian citizens and either:

  • Hold a current NV1 Security Clearance, or
  • Be eligible and willing to obtain NV1 clearance through the Australian Government security vetting process.

Why ORACLE?

Join a global technology leader operating some of the world's most advanced cloud infrastructure. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies, solve challenging infrastructure problems, collaborate with talented professionals across a global organisation, and contribute directly to the reliability, availability, and performance of critical cloud services used by customers around the world.

You'll join an environment that values technical excellence, customer focus, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, continuous learning, safety, and continuous improvement.

If you're looking for your next challenge and want to develop your career in large-scale, mission-critical data centre and cloud infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of the team powering ORACLE Cloud Infrastructure.

job.title: Front End Planning Manager, Construction - JAPAC
job.description:
Job Description

The FEP Manager is responsible for developing robust project plans from early concept through construction readiness. The role partners with design, engineering, procurement, commercial, operations, and construction teams to establish project scope, budget, schedule, delivery strategy, risk profile, and governance requirements.

The successful candidate will bring a minimum of 10 years’ construction experience, including at least 5 years in pre-construction or front-end planning. They will have strong knowledge of construction delivery, estimating, scheduling, design coordination, procurement, and risk management. Travel within Australia and the APAC region is required up to 20% of the time.

Responsibilities

  • Lead front-end planning and pre-construction activities for projects across APAC.
  • Define and validate project scope, delivery strategy, budget, schedule, milestones, and resourcing requirements.
  • Lead feasibility studies, site due diligence, constructability reviews, and project-readiness assessments.
  • Identify risks, constraints, dependencies, and opportunities early, and develop appropriate mitigation plans.
  • Partner with design, engineering, procurement, commercial, operations, and construction stakeholders to align project plans and requirements.
  • Coordinate contractor and consultant engagement, including tender strategy, bid evaluation, scope clarification, and pre-construction activities.
  • Establish and maintain project governance, stage-gate deliverables, risk registers, decision logs, and executive reporting.
  • Review design and construction documentation to confirm alignment with safety, quality, cost, schedule, and constructability objectives.
  • Apply knowledge of Australian and APAC construction markets, local regulatory requirements, permitting processes, and supply-chain conditions.
  • Present project recommendations, status updates, risks, and key decisions to senior stakeholders.
  • Promote consistent planning standards, continuous improvement, and a strong culture of safety, quality, and accountability across the regional portfolio.

Qualifications

job.title: Data Centre Technician - Trainee Program (Australia)
job.description:
Anticipated Start Date (subject to change):November 2, 2026

At OCI, we design, build, deliver, and operate Oracle’s global cloud infrastructure. Our teams support the servers, storage, networking, power, cooling, and critical infrastructure that enable customers worldwide to run their most important workloads. We operate in a fast-paced environment where safety, operational excellence, innovation, and customer focus are at the center of everything we do.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is expanding rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technicians to join our Infrastructure Operations team through our Trainee Program. This structured 12 week onboarding and development program is designed to accelerate the growth of early-career technicians by combining hands-on operational experience, technical training, mentorship, and career development. The trainee program involves 2 weeks of classroom-based training plus 10 weeks of on-the-job training at our data centres. This is a paid 12 week trainee program and successful candidates will be considered for full time permanent opportunities at the conclusion of the program.

We are looking for candidates from all backgrounds to join our mission—whether you are a recent high school graduate, have experience in retail, hospitality, construction, sales, or any other field, we welcome you to apply!

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum Education: Completion of High School (HSC)
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Must be an Australiancitizen for security clearance purposes

Essential Capabilities and Requirements

  • Basic understanding of computer hardware and technology concepts.
  • Basic understanding of mathematical and computational concepts.
  • Interest in technology and a desire to build a career in data center operations.
  • Ability to learn technical concepts and follow documented procedures with precision.
  • Ability to lift up to 20 kg, climb ladders, and work in confined spaces as required.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including weekends, night shifts, public holidays, and rotating shift schedules as required.
  • Access to own transportation for travel to data centres.

job.description:

job.title: Senior Security Engineer, Trust and Safety Workspace
job.description:
About the job

The Trust and Safety Workspace Account Security and Integrity (AIS) team is dedicated to protecting Google Workspace and Cloud customers from account-based threats. The mission is to safeguard the integrity of Workspace accounts by delivering a unified, scalable defense against account hijacking, takeover (ATO), and malicious automation. We operate at the critical intersection of product security and abuse prevention, balancing robust security controls with a frictionless experience for both individual users and enterprise organizations. By studying adversarial behavior and building state-of-the-art telemetry and agentic defense systems, we ensure a secure, trusted, and resilient ecosystem that protects our customers' businesses, data, and users.

As a Senior Security Engineer, you will drive the technical strategy to defend Workspace accounts and protect the Google Workspace and Cloud customers against advanced and evolving threats. Operating at the frontier of account security, adversarial analysis, and agentic AI, you will lead research into account vulnerabilities and pioneer the next generation of automated defense tools. In this role, you will not only identify and patch critical vulnerabilities but also architect novel, customer-facing agentic systems that empower Google Workspace and Cloud customers to defend their own environments. You will provide strong technical leadership, collaborate closely with product engineering and threat intelligence teams, and mentor junior engineers to scale our defensive capabilities.

**

Responsibilities

  • Drive the technical strategy and threat modeling for Workspace account security, identifying systemic weaknesses in authentication, recovery, and API integration paths.
  • Lead vulnerability research and adversarial simulation to expose novel account takeover (ATO) and "Made for Abuse" (MFA) techniques.
  • Design and build advanced agentic systems, debugging tools, and simulators to autonomously detect, analyze, and mitigate complex account security threats.
  • Architect and deploy customer-facing agentic tools that empower Workspace and Google Cloud customers to proactively monitor and secure their own environments.
  • Lead the investigation of high-severity account security incidents, developing robust, long-term mitigations and patches in collaboration with Product Engineering teams.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Google Pay, Growth and Communications
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our mission at Google Pay is to make digital finance simple, safe, and universally accessible.

Operating at an unprecedented scale, our Singapore-based team is the engine behind the growth and communications (comms) platforms. Our Comms infrastructure powers the high-throughput messaging systems required to reliably engage hundreds of millions of users. Simultaneously, under Growth, we own high-volume user acquisition channels including our core referral and reward engines that drive massive-scale traffic and generate multi-million dollar business streams.

In this role, you will lead the technical execution of growth initiatives to scale our user base. You will have true ownership of the full feature lifecycle, building solutions that span entirely from robust backend systems to seamless frontend UI components, leveraging agentic workflows and DevAI tools to accelerate delivery and productivity.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end ownership of feature design and deployment, operating seamlessly across the stack from backend infrastructure to frontend mobile and web ecosystems.
  • Mentor junior engineers on reliable, scalable, and secure designs.
  • Lead technical designs for robust backend services and data processing pipelines that support massive-scale growth experiments.
  • Ensure long-term feature reliability by building comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and automated performance tracking.
  • Contribute to engineering excellence by participating in design reviews, improving code quality, and leveraging DevAI and agentic coding workflows to accelerate end-to-end development.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
job.description:
About the job

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

Google’s software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team combines software engineering and systems administration to build and operate some of the world's most complex distributed systems. As an SRE Manager, you will lead a team of engineers tasked with ensuring our services are fast, reliable, and available. You will balance the development of new features with the long-term health and stability of the production environment.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a team of SREs, providing technical guidance, career development, and performance management.
  • Partner with Software Development teams to design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable services.
  • Drive the evolution of monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks to ensure rapid detection and resolution of production issues.
  • Implement software solutions and automation to eliminate manual tasks and improve the efficiency of systems operations. Manage Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets to balance innovation with system stability.
  • Participate in on-call rotations as a manager-escalation point and lead incident command during critical outages. Advocate a culture of engineering excellence, technical curiosity, and continuous improvement within the Sydney office.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: QA Lead (Automation & AI)
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

The QA Validation Architect provides technical leadership for validation and quality assurance for MineStar modernisation programs. This role owns the test strategy, validation execution, and quality governance for phase‑wise modernisation from legacy to modern platforms. The role requires strong technical depth, automation expertise, and leadership to ensure releases meet acceptance criteria, built‑in quality standards, and deployment readiness goals .

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership to all QA teams supporting MineStar modernisation initiatives
  • Define and own the test strategy and validation approach for phase‑wise modernisation, ensuring effective coexistence and transition between legacy and modern systems
  • Establish and govern built‑in quality standards and Definition of Done
  • Define modernisation test suites by refactoring and extending existing legacy test suites
  • Define and drive automation strategy, coverage, and standards across teams
  • Make strategic decisions on test automation versus manual validation based on risk, complexity, and return on investment
  • Review and approve test plans prepared by QA leads
  • Plan and ensure adequate test coverage across functional, integration, system, and non‑functional areas
  • Identify quality risks, dependencies, and challenges, and drive mitigation actions
  • Provide technical guidance for component‑level, service‑level, and API testing
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, Engineering, and QA teams to align validation with feature intent
  • Drive validation execution to ensure features meet defined acceptance criteria
  • Define, enforce, and make decisions on quality gates and deployment readiness
  • Act as the final authority on validation approach decisions where technical or quality trade‑offs are required
  • Track quality metrics, test effectiveness, and defect trends, driving continuous improvement

Required Skills & Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in Quality Assurance and automation testing
  • Experience working with multiple or large QA teams in enterprise or platform modernisation programs
  • Strong expertise in manual testing concepts and test design techniques
  • Experience with CI/CD and DevOps tools including Git, Maven, Jenkins, and DevOps pipelines.
  • Hands‑on experience with automation tools and frameworks, including Cucumber and Playwright
  • Strong understanding of SDLC and STLC in Agile and SAFe environments
  • Solid knowledge of non‑functional testing methodologies (performance, reliability, scalability, security)
  • Strong risk assessment and decision‑making capabilities related to quality and releases

job.description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. Role Definition:

Processes requisitions and provides support for purchasing, supply chain, sourcing, cost, price analyses and contract/purchase order generation.

Responsibilities

  • Developing improvement plans to support buyers & professionals related to Response Time, Lean Targets Quality, Cost, Logistics, Development, and Management (QCLDM) to enable optimal and efficient operations.
  • Performing analysis and maintenance of assigned processes that produce output excellence, builds expertise for the assign process area, and contributing to continuous improvement efforts.
  • Supporting customers and customer proposal efforts with pricing information and supplier selection.
  • Performing analytical and administrative tasks in support of purchasing strategic initiatives.

Degree Requirement: Bachelors from a Tier 1 University or college is preferred / Degree or equivalent experience desired

Skill Descriptors:

Data-driven Decision Making: Knowledge of the data-driven decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to gather and analyze data to make organizational decisions that align with strategic business objectives and goals.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes major considerations and issues in the use of data-driven decision making.
  • Differentiates Data-driven decision making from traditional decision making.
  • Explains characteristics and steps in an effective Data-driven Decision-Making process.
  • Identifies key objectives in gathering and analyzing data.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

  • Helps others research and learn more about business analytics tools and applications.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies project management tools and requirements within own function.
  • Describes the key objectives, phases and deliverables of a current project.
  • Explains the concepts of phase, activity, task, and deliverable.
  • Gives examples of critical paths in projects.

Procurement: Knowledge of buying and procurement; ability to work with organizational strategies and practices, and use tools for buying goods, supplies, equipment and services needed to conduct business.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies the major steps and critical paths in a purchasing cycle.
  • Explains the basic concepts and responsibilities of institutional purchasing.
  • Describes the major types of materials, products or services purchased by the organization.
  • Identifies the basic tools used for maintaining procurement information and records.

Knowledge of a Specific Procurement System: Knowledge of the features, functions and operations of a specific procurement system; ability to develop and use tools, techniques, and practices for a specific procurement application.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Summarizes major functions, features and capabilities of the procurement application.
  • Identifies key reports, their use, and frequency related to the specific procurement system.
  • Explains how to process purchases of basic materials and supplies.
  • Identifies key components of the specific system using relevant language.

Purchasing Tasks and Activities: Knowledge of policies, regulations and processes of purchasing; ability to use practices and procedures for procurement of materials, components, equipment and services.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies the basic tools used for maintaining procurement information.
  • Identifies major types of products or services purchased by the organization.
  • Explains the basic concepts and responsibilities of purchasing tasks and activities.
  • Describes established procurement processes and standards.

Logistics Management: Knowledge of the processes, tools and operational considerations for effective and efficient movement of goods and materials; ability to understand, predict and control the movement of goods, materials and supplies.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Documents internal and external informative sources or proprietary materials about logistics management.
  • Describes basic logistical processes and sub-processes.
  • Explains how improvements in logistics contribute to competitive advantage in the marketplace.
  • Identifies issues and considerations for inbound and outbound logistics.
