job.title: Senior Manager Manufacturing Operations
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Overseeing programs and practices for hiring, performance management and developing/training the personnel that perform and

support the plant operating functions to deliver the required operational performance.

  • Directing all aspects of manufacturing operations for the plant or facility to produce cost-effective, timely and high-quality products in a safe, secure and sanitary working environment.
  • Managing development, implementation and continual improvement of the operating methods, equipment, systems and other operating infrastructure used to realize operating goals and objectives.
  • Directing development of production work schedules to meet internal goals and customer expectations; monitoring process and personnel performance of scheduled work activities to remove operating impediments and achieve established operating goals.

What You Will Do

  • Safety is a core value; this role will lead the way in ensuring our Safety Commitments are met
  • Manage the production processes in line with Caterpillar production principles, establish and maintain appropriate governance to ensure quality and order delivery commitments are met, whilst leading the teams through changes with effective change management strategies.
  • Participation in the facility demand and orders process, capacity planning, execution of manufacturing run rates to required quality and velocity
  • Provide leadership to the Operations teams, with a focus on talent development and growth, taking a proactive and organized approach
  • Foster and grow existing positive relationships with the on-site trade unions, including leading collective bargaining processes and pay deal

Key Skills Required

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Collaborating: Knowledge of collaborative techniques; ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a

constructive and collaborative manner.

Quality Management: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques and ability to create and support

an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.

Performance Management: Knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's

performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational

performance.

Lean Manufacturing: Knowledge of the philosophy, principles and implementation approaches of lean manufacturing;

ability to integrate and implement lean manufacturing philosophy into existing production and management processes.

Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and

organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic time and resources and highly methodical way.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high

levels of precision.

September 10, 2026 - September 24, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. Caterpillar Inc is the world’s leading manufacturer of off-highway machinery and diesel and natural gas engines. The Caterpillar brand is recognised worldwide and is synonymous with quality and reliability.

The Industrial Power Systems Division currently has a new and exciting opportunity for a Manufacturing Engineer. This position works both independently and as part of a team to maintain and improve processes and systems used in manufacturing. In addition, Manufacturing Engineers function as a specialist and subject matter expert for technical planning throughout a manufacturing facility. As Manufacturing Engineer, you will have an opportunity to provide the technical expertise necessary to design, develop, and implement manufacturing systems, manufacturing operations and state of the art machines.

JOB PURPOSE

Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing processes by leveraging advanced technologies, AI-enabled solutions, digital dashboards, and lean manufacturing principles. The role focuses on improving safety, quality, productivity, and cost efficiency through data-driven decision making, low-cost automation, and smart manufacturing initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in developing, implementing, and improving manufacturing processes for engine assembly, testing, paint, and related operations.
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and Concurrent Process and Product Development (CPPD) activities.
  • Participate in process validation, manufacturing readiness reviews, and production launch activities.
  • Develop and update assembly procedures, process flows, work instructions, BOMs, PFMEAs, and standard work documentation.
  • Support implementation of AI-based manufacturing solutions for safety, quality, and productivity improvement.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and digital visual management tools for manufacturing performance monitoring.
  • Analyze manufacturing data to identify trends, bottlenecks, quality issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support MES, SAP, and shop-floor device integration initiatives to improve process traceability and operational visibility.
  • Participate in Industry 4.0 and digital transformation projects involving IoT, smart devices, and connected manufacturing systems.
  • Contribute to safety improvement initiatives through risk assessments, ergonomic studies, and implementation of safety controls.
  • Support deployment of digital safety technologies such as vision systems, interlocks, and process monitoring solutions.
  • Design and develop assembly fixtures, jigs, gauges, work-holding devices, poka-yoke solutions, and ergonomic tooling to support safe and efficient manufacturing operations.
  • Participate in prototype development, validation, and implementation of assembly tooling and fixtures.
  • Work closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders to procure, manufacture, install, and commission tooling solutions.
  • Ensure tooling designs comply with safety, ergonomics, quality, and Caterpillar manufacturing standards.
  • Participate in root cause analysis and corrective action activities to improve safety, quality, and process reliability.
  • Drive continuous improvement and waste reduction initiatives using Lean Manufacturing principles.
  • Assist in the design, procurement, installation, and commissioning of tooling, fixtures, gauges, and manufacturing equipment.
  • Support implementation of low-cost automation and mistake-proofing (Poka-Yoke) solutions.
  • Contribute to evaluation of new technologies and preparation of business cases for process improvements.
  • Monitor equipment performance and support troubleshooting activities.
  • Support factory layout modifications and workstation improvements to enhance safety, productivity, and material flow.
  • Assist in capacity analysis, line balancing, and space optimization initiatives.
  • Participate in manufacturing process improvement projects aimed at reducing cycle time and improving efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering.
  • 4 to 6 years of manufacturing engineering or production engineering experience.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes, assembly operations, and industrial engineering principles.
  • Experience with CAD tools such as CREO and AutoCAD.
  • Exposure to Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement methodologies.
  • Knowledge of data analysis, root cause analysis, and problem-solving techniques.
  • Familiarity with SAP ERP, MES, or manufacturing information systems.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and Power BI.
  • Strong communication, teamwork, and stakeholder engagement skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to AI-based manufacturing applications, machine vision systems, or digital manufacturing technologies.
  • Experience with IoT, Industry 4.0, automation, robotics, or smart factory initiatives.
  • Understanding of engine assembly, testing, leak testing, or torque-controlled assembly processes.
  • Exposure to APQP, PFMEA, and manufacturing process validation activities.
  • Knowledge of low-cost automation and productivity improvement projects.

Key Competencies:

  • Process Engineering
  • Digital Manufacturing
  • Tooling & Fixture design
  • AI & Industry 4.0
  • Safety First Mindset
  • Power BI & Dashboards
  • Data Analytics
  • Lean Manufacturing
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Problem Solving
  • Low-Cost Automation
  • Manufacturing Systems (MES/SAP)
  • NPI & Process Validation

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World

Whether it be groundbreaking products, best in class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do the work that matters at Caterpillar. With a 100-years legacy of quality and innovation and 150 locations in countries around the world, your impact spans the globe.

When you join Caterpillar, you are joining a team of makers, innovators, and doers. We are the people who roll up our sleeves and do the work to build a better world. And we are proud of that, because it helps our customers build and power the world, we live in – the roads, hospitals, homes, and infrastructure. Without a dedicated workforce, Caterpillar could not effectively meet our customers’ needs. Join us.

Job Summary

The Large Power Systems Division currently has an opening for a performance analyst who will utilize commercial and internal tools and analytical techniques (1-D and 3-D simulation tools) to provide simulation support for lubrication systems across various Caterpillar large engine platforms, with the opportunity to also work on engine water system simulations. This includes development of models to simulate oil pumps, engine oil galleries, valves, and heat exchangers in both steady-state and transient conditions (e.g., time to prime simulations), as well as 3-D simulations of piston cooling with oil jets. This position will also be a key player in the development of new methods and processes for 1-D and 3-D lubrication simulation, including investigations of the Lattice-Boltzmann vs. finite volume methods. The engineer will effectively collaborate with the various product development teams to deliver validated design solutions for our challenging program deliverables. The position includes strong collaboration with our design, system, and validation partners.

What will you do:

  • Analyze designs and concepts to achieve functional lubrication system requirements
  • Develop system layouts, component selection, sizing and optimizing lube systems using 1-D & 3-D simulation tools
  • Conduct lube component CFD to determine performance characteristics
  • Understand oil level dynamic change in various operating conditions, oil splashing, sloshing and oil flooding/starvation under different driving conditions, to assure lubrication requirements are met under all conditions
  • Conduct piston cooling and time to prime simulation (e.g., turbocharger lubrication)
  • Develop engine water circuit models to size pumps and other components
  • Collaborate with engine platform partners and customers to meet technical requirements
  • Communicate simulation results to engine teams, component teams and customers
  • Collaborate with test engineers and correlate simulation models
  • Perform simulation to assist in resolving lubrication system related field problems
  • Contribute to improvements in simulation methods and processes
  • Help to establish technical requirements and specifications for new products

What you must have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Agricultural, or Aerospace engineering or similar)
  • Relevant engineering experience:Bachelor’s degree: 5+ years
  • Master’s degree: 2+ years
  • Doctorate degree

Experience in CFD and/or 1-D engine, power systems, machine systems, or lubrication system simulationStrong background and interest in thermo-sciencesClear verbal and written communication skillsProject management skills allowing handling of multiple projects and priorities Top Candidates will also have:

  • Master or Doctorate degree in Mechanical, Agricultural or Aerospace engineering or similar
  • Strong technical knowledge with the ability to communicate technical information effectively with team members and others in the work group, and process partners
  • Working knowledge of engine, lubrication/ powertrain cooling and/or electrification systems
  • 2+ years of experience using Fluent, 1-D analysis tools (i.e., GT-Suite) and Creo

Additional Information:

  • This position may require up to 10% travel
  • This position is located in World Trade Center, Chennai, Tamil Nadu
  • Relocation assistance is available for this position

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar Trimble Control Technologies (CTCT) is a joint venture between Caterpillar Inc. and Trimble Inc. This division develops positioning, control and automation products for earthmoving and paving machines in the construction and mining industries, using technologies such as GNSS, optical total stations, lasers and sonics. The products are used in a range of applications where the operator of the machine benefits from having accurate horizontal and vertical guidance.

CTCT currently has a job opening for a Product Development Engineer Proactive Quality. This position will report to the CTCT Proactive Quality Manager. The team works in a dynamic global environment delivering the best in class quality product based on data backed analysis.

The Product Development Engineer – Proactive Quality works collaboratively with project and product teams to evaluate how new or sustaining development efforts impact the end user. This role guides the establishment of Critical to Quality (CTQ) measures in close partnership with Product and Engineering data SMEs, while owning the ongoing operational tracking of those metrics. By assessing whether a project or development effort contributes a net positive, neutral, or negative effect on overarching in-service quality measures, this role helps leadership balance the critical need for continuous value delivery with the mandate to protect long-term product health and reliability.

Success in this role is reflected in the accuracy, consistency, and clarity of the quality picture provided to decision-makers. Whether a trade-off results in a positive, neutral, or intentionally negative impact to product quality, ensuring that project decisions are deliberate, transparently communicated, and consistently tracked demonstrates a pragmatic, value-add approach to proactive quality.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute the CTCT Proactive Quality Strategy through engagement with product, project and engineering organization.
  • Lead collaborative efforts with key Product Team stakeholders to define new, or improve existing, Critical to Quality (CTQ) measures.
  • Work closely with CTCT analytics and engineering SMEs to own the creation, monitoring, and maintenance of quality dashboards, and actively disseminate key findings to relevant stakeholders.
  • Partner with Verification & Validation (V&V) team members to ensure risk-based testing strategies adequately evaluate system quality.
  • Work closely with Product Support and channel partners to lead Supportability Risk Assessment sessions and execute supportability strategy.
  • Actively participate in cross-functional project and product reviews by providing quality-related data, dashboards, and summaries when there are significant impacts or changes to quality measures.
  • Create standard processes or tools by working with SMEs for efficient project execution.
  • Concurrent work on multiple project teams and CTCT initiations and facilitate change management as necessary.

What You Have: - This section requires more refinement

  • 4 years Engineering degree.
  • System Integration
  • Cross functional collaboration
  • Information Capture: Knowledge of the methods, channels and processes to obtain needed information; ability to identify, capture and document relevant business information in an auditable, organized, understandable and easily retrievable manner.
  • Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
  • Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  • Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Conceptual Thinking: Knowledge of thinking and reasoning at a conceptual level; ability to identify the critical ideas and interdependencies among system elements that impact performance.

Additional Information

  • The primary location for this position is Christchurch, NZ

The role combines strong accounting expertise, analytical capability, and stakeholder collaboration to deliver reliable financial information that supports business decision-making.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

At Caterpillar, we work to help our customers build a better world. Without our team of talented, bright and driven individuals, we wouldn’t be the Caterpillar we are today. Now, this is your chance to join our team and do work that matters. We want you to help us enable customer success, make progress possible around the world and help our communities grow and thrive.

As a Condition Monitoring Advisor at Caterpillar, you will help our customers prevent downtime through condition monitoring techniques. This includes analysis of electronic, fluids, and and other equipment and fleet data. This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Growth Mindset: Demonstrates a strong desire to learn and understand new concepts, technologies, and methodologies. Continuously seeks out opportunities for growth and improvement, and is not afraid to ask questions or challenge the status quo.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.

Service Excellence: Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.

job.title: Sales Account Manager (Senior Connectivity Sales Specialist)
job.description:
Job Description

Job purpose

We are looking for a motivated Enterprise Connectivity Sales Specialist to drive revenue growth by selling both core infrastructure and advanced networking and connectivity solutions to C-level executives and IT leaders. You will own the full client sales lifecycle—from lead discovery and solution scoping to closing complex, multi-year service contracts.

Responsibilities

  • Account Acquisition & Expansion: Target and close mid-market and enterprise prospects through strategic prospecting, executive networking, and consultative selling.
  • Account Ownership and Supported : Own targeted key Enterprise Connectivity accounts and support rest of EBG base
  • Responsible for meeting and exceeding Orderbook, Revenue and Gross Margin targets
  • Solution Architecture & Scoping: Partner with Solutions Engineers to design tailored connectivity solutions addressing client needs around bandwidth, latency, redundancy, and security.
  • Pipeline & Deal Management: Build and manage a strong sales pipeline using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), providing accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Contract & Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations, service level agreement (SLA) terms, and pricing strategies for high-value enterprise accounts.
  • Market & Product Expertise: Maintain deep subject matter expertise in core enterprise connectivity solutions:
  • Network & Transit: Layer 1-3 services including but not limited to Dedicated Internet, Dark Fiber, Ethernet/MPLS
  • Cloud & Edge: Direct Cloud Connect (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute), SD-WAN, SASE
  • Platform and Managed Services: Managed CPE solution eg Managed Router, Managed Firewall

Qualifications

  • Diploma in IT/Engineering/ICT related field with at least 5 years of B2B sales experience within telecommunications, network service providers, or cloud connectivity vendors.
  • Advantageous to possess experience managing accounts in Healthcare, Education (Institutes of Higher Learning) and Hospitality
  • Proven understanding of WAN architectures, SD-WAN, multi-cloud interconnectivity, and enterprise networking hardware for both domestic and international connectivity.
  • Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding revenue and order book quotas with complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Demonstrated ability to pitch and build trust with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, and VP-level decision-makers.

job.title: Regional Capability Trainer - Western
job.description:
Completes troubleshooting, repairs and rebuilds on engine products in a service workshop independently while coaching and developing less experienced technicians

Key Responsibilities

1. Hands-On Workshop Coaching

  • Teach apprentices how to use hand tools, power tools, torque tools, and precision measurement gear correctly.
  • Show them how to dismantle, inspect, and reassemble components safely and cleanly.
  • Demonstrate how engines, fuel systems, air systems, and aftertreatment systems work—using real examples in the shop.
  • Walk apprentices through “what goes wrong” and how to identify faults, damage, wear, and failure modes.
  • Build foundational troubleshooting skills using real units, real jobs, and real failures.

2. Apprentice Readiness & Confidence Building

  • Help first-years get comfortable in the workshop—how to move safely, set up their workspace, and think like a technician.
  • Teach shop etiquette: teamwork, communication, keeping a tidy bay, and respecting the craft.
  • Support apprentices who may lack confidence or exposure by giving them structured, achievable tasks.

3. Capability Tracking & Individualised Support

  • Use the standardised capability tracker to guide development, set expectations, and maintain consistency across regions.
  • Adapt coaching approaches to each apprentice—ensuring flexibility to address gaps, strengths, and real-time needs.
  • Provide apprentices with targeted support in areas flagged through the tracker or identified in the workshop.

4. Branch Support & Integration

  • Work closely with Service Managers, Supervisors, and Technicians to ensure apprentices are developing the right skills.
  • Identify capability gaps at each branch and provide targeted hands-on coaching sessions.
  • Support the embedding of standard work practices and safe working methods in day-to-day workshop tasks.
  • Travel to nearby or regional sites when required —usually infrequent and planned (<10%), but may increase as program needs evolve.

5. Technical Demonstrations & Practical Learning

  • Run short, practical mini-sessions in the workshop (e.g., correct measuring techniques, wear pattern identification, torque procedures).
  • Set up hands-on problem‑solving activities using failed components or stripped-down engines.
  • Guide apprentices through real diagnostic processes using actual customer units when appropriate.

6. Apprentice Progression & Support

  • Provide input for apprentice capability reviews based on observed workshop performance.
  • Work with the Apprentice Program Manager to identify apprentices needing additional support.
  • Celebrate growth and milestones to keep apprentices engaged and motivated.

Competencies:

  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.
  • Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.
  • Situational adaptability - Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations.
  • Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  • Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.
  • Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.
  • Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.
  • Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.
  • Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Preferred)
  • Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution
  • Locally valid driving permit (Preferred)
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

  • Advanced level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products
  • Experience providing technical advice and coaching to more junior technicians (preferred)

1. Hands-On Workshop Coaching

  • Teach apprentices how to use hand tools, power tools, torque tools, and precision measurement gear correctly.
  • Show them how to dismantle, inspect, and reassemble components safely and cleanly.
  • Demonstrate how engines, fuel systems, air systems, and aftertreatment systems work—using real examples in the shop.
  • Walk apprentices through “what goes wrong” and how to identify faults, damage, wear, and failure modes.
  • Build foundational troubleshooting skills using real units, real jobs, and real failures.

2. Apprentice Readiness & Confidence Building

  • Help first-years get comfortable in the workshop—how to move safely, set up their workspace, and think like a technician.
  • Teach shop etiquette: teamwork, communication, keeping a tidy bay, and respecting the craft.
  • Support apprentices who may lack confidence or exposure by giving them structured, achievable tasks.

3. Capability Tracking & Individualised Support

  • Use the standardised capability tracker to guide development, set expectations, and maintain consistency across regions.
  • Adapt coaching approaches to each apprentice—ensuring flexibility to address gaps, strengths, and real-time needs.
  • Provide apprentices with targeted support in areas flagged through the tracker or identified in the workshop.

4. Branch Support & Integration

  • Work closely with Service Managers, Supervisors, and Technicians to ensure apprentices are developing the right skills.
  • Identify capability gaps at each branch and provide targeted hands-on coaching sessions.
  • Support the embedding of standard work practices and safe working methods in day-to-day workshop tasks.
  • Travel to nearby or regional sites when required —usually infrequent and planned (<10%), but may increase as program needs evolve.

5. Technical Demonstrations & Practical Learning

  • Run short, practical mini-sessions in the workshop (e.g., correct measuring techniques, wear pattern identification, torque procedures).
  • Set up hands-on problem‑solving activities using failed components or stripped-down engines.
  • Guide apprentices through real diagnostic processes using actual customer units when appropriate.

6. Apprentice Progression & Support

  • Provide input for apprentice capability reviews based on observed workshop performance.

job.title: Quality Testing Tool Engineer Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

The Quality Testing Tool Engineer – Senior is responsible for implementing, maintaining, and optimizing IT infrastructure and quality engineering solutions across on-premises and cloud environments. This role focuses on enabling reliable, scalable, and high-performing systems through automation, testing frameworks, and continuous improvement practices. The incumbent collaborates across engineering, operations, and product teams to ensure robust system performance, quality assurance, and adherence to enterprise standards.

Key Responsibilities Technical Execution & Delivery

  • Design, develop, and implement small to medium-scale automation solutions to improve operational efficiency, consistency, and accuracy.
  • Implement and maintain automated testing frameworks (functional, integration, API, regression) integrated with CI/CD pipelines.
  • Install, configure, and support infrastructure components across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.
  • Execute system monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting activities to ensure stability, availability, and performance.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, workflows, and procedures.
  • Contribute to functional and technical specifications for assigned systems and components.
  • Implement system security controls, backup procedures, and redundancy configurations aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Conduct system health checks, validate backup integrity, and support recovery operations.
  • Analyze performance trends, identify potential issues, and contribute to capacity planning and optimization.
  • Troubleshoot complex system, infrastructure, and pipeline issues using diagnostic tools and established processes.
  • Support performance, load, and resiliency testing to validate system behavior under stress conditions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support integration of infrastructure, applications, and testing solutions.

Managerial & Functional Contribution

  • Support adoption of quality engineering best practices, including shift-left testing, automation-first approach, and CI/CD quality gates.
  • Provide guidance and coaching to teams on effective use of testing tools and frameworks.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders (engineering, SRE, product, and architecture teams) to align testing strategies with business and technical goals.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues and driving corrective actions.
  • Influence quality standards, processes, and tooling adoption across teams.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders to ensure alignment, transparency, and timely delivery.
  • Demonstrate ownership and accountability in delivering high-quality, customer-focused solutions.

Skills & Competencies

  • Security & Compliance: Strong understanding of embedding security, privacy, and compliance across the SDLC.
  • Programming & Automation: Proficiency in automation frameworks, scripting, and programming concepts.
  • Quality Engineering & Testing: Expertise in automated testing (functional, API, integration, regression), performance, and security testing.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, OCI) and hybrid environments.
  • DevOps Practices: Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Containerization & Microservices: Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and microservices architectures.
  • Observability & Monitoring: Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools for performance validation and troubleshooting.
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across application, infrastructure, and pipelines.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders.
  • Customer Focus & Execution: Strong ownership mindset with focus on delivering reliable, value-driven solutions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

job.title: IT Technical Analyst - Senior (WMS)
job.description:
Job Summary

Provides application or infrastructure technical expertise, analysis and specifications for IT systems to meet business requirements in accordance with IT architecture policies and standards; translate requirements into technical specifications, create detailed solution design, coordinate construction, installation, configuration and testing of IT systems; and identifies, troubleshoots and resolves system technical issues.

Key Responsibilities

Assists in creating and managing the technical specifications from which programs and configurations will be applied to create the application, infrastructure or complete solution. Assists in technical analysis of potential solutions including evaluating the technical fit and viability of commercial-of-the-shelf products versus custom built solution. Delivers solution design, adhering to standards and leveraging re-use of components. Assists in creating high level and detail design of infrastructure OR applications, interfaces, conversions, extensions, reports, and workflows while meeting architecture, security, performance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. Assists technical and infrastructure groups in understanding the solution design and specifications. Works closely with IT technical service providers to ensure outsourced work packages are delivered to specifications, meeting key parameters of quality, schedule, cost, security, performance, and scalability. Participates in formal design reviews and code reviews (where applicable) to ensure the detailed design specifications have been understood and coding standards have been adhered to by the development team(s). Leverages re-usability of component designs to reduce costs and shorten time to deliver solution Ensures adherence to obtain efficiency in the build and deploy processes, leveraging automation where possible. Assists in the test strategy and execution of master test plan. Participates in the creation of standards, processes, procedures, and guidelines for the IT design and development community as well work instructions or ‘runbooks’ used for end-user support. Analyzes and revises existing systems and documentation to identify remediation or improvements in the application or infrastructure solution. Provides level 3 support for critical issues. Competencies:

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Data Modeling - Creates, writes and tests data models, test scripts and build scripts using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Performance Tuning - Conceptualizes, analyzes and solves application, database and hardware problems using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Solution Configuration - Configures, creates and tests a solution for commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) applications using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Solution Design - Creates and defines the solution design complete with instrumentation and measurement, using industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to synthesize diagrams, models and documentation in order to build a solution that meets buildability, business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Solution Functional Fit Analysis - Composes and decomposes a system into its component parts using procedures, tools and work aides for the purpose of studying how well the component parts were designed, purchased and configured to interact holistically to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Solution Modeling - Creates, designs and formulates models, diagrams and documentation using industry standards, tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Solution Validation Testing - Validates a configuration item change or solution using the Function's defined best practices, including the Systems Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards, tools and metrics, to ensure that it works as designed and meets customer requirements.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 3-5 years of experience.

Key Responsibilities

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

​Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

​Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Analysis and Troubleshooting - Extracts, transforms, models, interprets, and presents planning data with the goal of mining useful information, troubleshooting, suggesting conclusions, and supporting value creating decision making.

Inventory Management and Optimization - Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end-to-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.

Material Planning - Uses advanced tools (e.g. Advanced Planning Command Centre, Business Intelligence (BI) Dashboards etc.) to take a decision related to parts availability, inventory optimization and root cause analysis.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

job.title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
job.description:
Job Summary

This applied technology role is responsible for developing and delivering embedded software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins products. The role involves understanding stakeholder and system requirements, contributing to software specifications, and owning the design, integration, testing, release, and quality of AUTOSAR-based embedded software solutions. The position operates as a recognized technical specialist within the team, delivering independently while collaborating across global product, software, and architecture teams to ensure robust, high-quality software that meets Cummins’ product, platform, and compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform AUTOSAR BSW integration and support full end-to-end software build activities across product platforms.
  • Configure and integrate AUTOSAR stack and BSW modules (e.g., COM, DCM, DEM, NvM) using industry-standard tools such as DaVinci Configurator / Developer and EB Tresos , including SIP integration activities.
  • Analyze, debug, and resolve software integration issues , including build failures, RTE runtime errors, and system-level failures.
  • Perform stack analysis, timing analysis , and advanced debugging using Trace32 and related timing analysis tools.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain automation scripts using Python and Groovy to support build, integration, and test activities.
  • Support and improve continuous integration (CI) and automated build pipelines to enhance software quality and delivery efficiency.
  • Investigate product software problems, identify causal mechanisms, recommend corrective actions, and own problem resolution through closure with appropriate documentation.
  • Apply and continuously improve software development processes and tools , including coding, compiling, testing, static analysis, and integration workflows.
  • Collaborate closely with application software, BSW, architecture, project, and product teams across business units to deliver verified software builds and components.
  • Ensure compliance with project governance, quality standards, and process frameworks , including ASPICE and Cummins software development practices.
  • Review and provide technical guidance on work performed by less-experienced engineers or testers to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient software designs.
  • Provide technical leadership on complex components or smaller projects with moderate ambiguity, maintaining full accountability for deliverables.
  • Contribute to the improvement of work processes and systems within the function or across global business units.
  • Support knowledge transfer and mentoring of technicians, early-career engineers, and student employees.
  • Influence technical direction within project teams through systems thinking, requirements understanding, and design decision-making.
  • Operate as a recognized specialist within the immediate team or product area.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a relevant STEM discipline is required.
  • A post-graduate (Master’s) degree relevant to this discipline may be required for select roles.
  • This position may require compliance with export control or sanctions regulations , including applicable licensing.

Core Competencies

  • Product Software Design and Construction
  • Product Failure Mode Avoidance
  • Product Verification and Validation Management
  • System Requirements Engineering
  • Product Platform Planning and Architecting
  • Systems Thinking
  • Decision Quality
  • Managing Complexity
  • Drives Results
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Builds Networks
  • Resourcefulness
  • Values Differences

Skills

  • Strong knowledge of AUTOSAR architecture , including BSW and RTE concepts.
  • Proven expertise in AUTOSAR BSW module configuration (COM, DCM, DEM, NvM, etc.).
  • Advanced debugging and system analysis skills using Trace32 .
  • Proficiency in Python and Groovy scripting for automation and software integration support.
  • Experience with DaVinci tools (Configurator and Developer); exposure to EB Tresos .
  • Understanding of embedded C programming and embedded software development best practices.
  • Working knowledge of software build systems, CI/CD pipelines , and automated testing environments.
  • Familiarity with Vector DaVinci Teams is desirable.
  • Strong systems thinking and ability to analyze complex interactions across software, hardware, and product platforms.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills across cross-functional and global teams.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in AUTOSAR BSW integration and embedded software development.
  • Prior Senior or Lead Engineer–equivalent experience in a relevant technical discipline with a demonstrated track record of:
  • Technical problem-solving
  • Quality and data-driven decision making
  • Delivery of integrated software builds in complex environments
  • Experience working in environments governed by ASPICE or equivalent quality frameworks .
  • Practical exposure to tools such as code editors, compilers, static analysis tools, integration tools, and HIL test environments.
  • Working knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred.

job.title: Technician - Field Service
job.description:
Job Summary

Diagnoses and completes less complex repairs to engines at the customer’s site.

Key Responsibilities

Engages customers in a courteous and professional manner. Anticipates and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs. Applies the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete less complex repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools. Performs preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engine and related components in the field. Escalates unresolved issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or Supervisor. Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens. Identifies additional service opportunities with customer. Completes training in line with skill and business requirements. Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation. Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Preferred)

Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution

Locally valid driving permit

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Basic level field service work experience

Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products

Customer service experience

Good communication skills. Work well within a team environment , also need to work autonomously when required in the field. Good computer skills. Insite and QSOL experience preferred. Good attitude towards work and team.

Job Summary

The AI Software Engineer – Senior is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and high-performing AI-powered software solutions and platforms. This role focuses on building reusable agentic AI frameworks, enterprise integrations, orchestration capabilities, governance mechanisms, and development accelerators that enable the rapid delivery of enterprise AI solutions.

The position combines strong software engineering principles with modern AI platform development, ensuring solutions are built using industry best practices, enterprise architecture standards, and modern development methodologies. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, reliable, and compliant AI systems that drive business value while maintaining security, observability, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

AI Platform & Framework Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain reusable agentic AI frameworks, orchestration templates, and platform accelerators.
  • Build shared services and libraries for agent communication, workflow orchestration, memory management, tool integration, and evaluation pipelines.
  • Establish standardized engineering patterns and best practices for enterprise AI solutions.
  • Develop scalable, secure, and maintainable software solutions throughout the software development lifecycle.

Enterprise Integration & MCP Enablement

  • Develop and maintain MCP-compatible integrations and enterprise connectors.
  • Build reusable APIs, services, and integration frameworks for enterprise platforms and business applications.
  • Enable secure and scalable access to enterprise data sources, systems, and business tools.
  • Design and implement event-driven and cloud-native integration architectures.

Governance, Security & Compliance

  • Define and implement governance standards for enterprise AI systems.
  • Build mechanisms for traceability, auditability, monitoring, lifecycle management, and operational oversight.
  • Support Trust, Risk, Security, and Monitoring (TRiSM) requirements across AI solutions.
  • Ensure adherence to security, privacy, compliance, and regulatory requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Establish observability, evaluation, and monitoring practices to ensure responsible AI deployment.

Software Engineering & Solution Design

  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions and architectures.
  • Design application interfaces, define system interactions, and establish non-functional requirements.
  • Evaluate technical feasibility, define solution architectures, and recommend implementation approaches.
  • Develop software following coding standards, testing practices, and quality assurance processes.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and production support activities.
  • Document solutions, technical designs, workflows, and implementation standards.

Engineering Enablement & Operational Excellence

  • Create reusable templates, starter kits, deployment accelerators, and implementation guides.
  • Improve developer productivity through automation, tooling, and standardized development practices.
  • Support production readiness, monitoring, telemetry, guardrails, and fallback strategies.
  • Collaborate with solution teams to improve system reliability, scalability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and adoption of modern engineering practices.

Innovation & Technical Leadership

  • Stay current with emerging technologies, AI frameworks, and industry trends.
  • Recommend innovative approaches, tools, and technologies that improve business outcomes.
  • Support Agile, DevSecOps, and continuous delivery practices.
  • Mentor team members and contribute to the organization's technical excellence and learning culture.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience developing enterprise software applications using modern software engineering practices.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Proven experience delivering solutions through the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through production deployment.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and scalable system development.

  • Security & Compliance Principles
  • Programming Principles
  • Data Principles
  • Modern Development Practices
  • Solution Design
  • Strategic & Innovative Thinking
  • Technical Passion & Continuous Learning
  • Driving Effective Outcomes
  • Engaging with Impact
  • Customer Focus
  • Collaboration & Team Agility
  • Valuing Diverse Perspectives
  • Built-In Quality Mindset

Required Skills & Experience

Software Engineering & Architecture

  • Strong software architecture and platform engineering expertise.
  • Experience designing and building reusable platforms, frameworks, and shared services.
  • Strong backend development experience using Python and/or Node.js.
  • Experience with APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native systems.
  • Deep understanding of software development best practices including:
  • Coding standards
  • Code reviews
  • Source control management
  • Automated testing
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Production operations

  • Expertise with one or more of the following frameworks:
  • LangGraph
  • Semantic Kernel
  • AutoGen
  • CrewAI
  • Strong understanding of AI orchestration frameworks and AI system architecture.
  • Experience developing workflow automation, tool orchestration, and multi-agent systems.

job.title: Regional Branch Manager
job.description:
Regional Branch Manager - Tomago

We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what _\#LifeAtCummins_ is all about.

We are looking for a experienced Regional Branch Manager to join our team in Tomago, Newcastle NSW.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Manages the day-to-day operations for our 3 branches Tomago, Muswellbrook and Tamworth
  • Full accountability for creating and maintaining Right Work Environment,
  • Leading sustained growth through the provision of world-class sales and support for an enviable on-highway, off-highway, power generation, mining and marine customer base whilst ensuring best in class operational efficiency
  • Building and promoting a team environment that works collaboratively.
  • Responsible for all functions and financial metrics for the group of branches.
  • Identify improvements and encourage an innovative culture.
  • Ensures business growth by managing annual marketing and sales plan; develops and maintains business relationships with customers and develops new business partners and alliances for the business segment and geographical locations
  • Manages compliance with health, safety, and environmental standards and compliance; oversees health, safety, and environmental audits.
  • Drive growth in your area by having strong relationships with existing and potential customers
  • Ensure customer expectations are met and managed accordingly

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Previous experience / knowledge within diesel and alternative fuel engines and generators industry is ideal
  • A proven strong team leader with a business development mindset that can lead a diverse team to safely meet business objectives.
  • Committed to providing exceptional customer service to customers across a diverse region and customer base.
  • Dedicated to building the ‘Right Work Environment’, including a focus on Health, Safety and Environment

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive Salary Package – Base + Super + Car Allowance + Annual Variable Compensation Program (bonus)
  • Annual remuneration reviews
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • A range of personal and professional benefits
  • Paid Parental leave (Conditions apply)
  • Uniforms provided
  • Comprehensive Cummins product training provided
  • Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles
  • Onsite parking
  • Employee Assistance Program available to employees

Experience

Significant relevant experience required, including managerial and budgetary experience.

Qualifications for Internal Candidates:

This is a key leadership role responsible for Newcastle, Muswellbrook and Tamworth branches reporting to Central Region Area Director.

This region supports strategic global coal mining customers and OEM's in a highly competitive environment. This region accounts for over $100m in parts and service revenue annually.

The role will have oversight of large On Highway Truck Shop and HHP rebuild shop in Newcastle, 24/7 Field service operation in Muswellbrook and On Highway Truck Shop and large field service team in Tamworth.

The Regional Branch Manager will be required to manage complexity across multiple markets, identify and implement strategic initiatives that improve efficiency, productivity, profitability and customer and employee experience with eight direct reports.

Current knowledge of Mining, On Highway and Power Gen markets will be highly regarded and previous experience successfully leading large teams essential.

job.title: Service Supervisor - FIFO
job.description:
_Our culture believes in POWERING YOUR POTENTIAL._ We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what _\#LifeAtCummins_ is all about.

We are looking for a talented Service Supervisor to join our team supporting workshop and field operations within our Port Hedland workshop. This is an 8:6 FIFO temporary secondment opportunity from Perth, giving employees the chance to experience FIFO life, gain exposure to the Pilbara and broaden their leadership capability while maintaining their connection to their current Cummins branch.

The role will suit a safety-focused and customer-driven leader who enjoys coaching teams, managing priorities and ensuring service work is completed to a high standard. It is also a great opportunity for employees who are curious about FIFO, want to experience life in the Pilbara and are interested in developing new skills without committing to a permanent move away from their home branch or team.

Ever wondered what FIFO is really like? This temporary secondment offers the chance to step into a FIFO leadership role, experience the Port Hedland operation firsthand and return to your home branch at the completion of the assignment.

Why consider this temporary secondment?

  • Gain leadership experience in a FIFO environment while supporting a busy Port Hedland operation.
  • Experience life in the Pilbara and build exposure to a key Cummins regional operation.
  • Develop new skills, broaden your operational knowledge and strengthen your leadership capability while remaining within Cummins.
  • Return to your home branch at the completion of the secondment, with valuable FIFO and Pilbara experience to bring back to your team.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Supervise and coordinate daily service activities across workshop and/or field operations, ensuring work is planned, prioritised and completed safely and efficiently.
  • Provide leadership, coaching and technical support to technicians and apprentices, helping build capability and maintain high standards of workmanship.
  • Drive a strong safety culture by ensuring adherence to all relevant Health, Safety and Environmental policies, procedures and legislative requirements, while reporting and escalating any issues or incidents appropriately.
  • Support service delivery by reviewing work requirements, allocating resources, monitoring progress, resolving operational issues and ensuring quality documentation is completed accurately.
  • Build strong customer relationships by communicating effectively, responding to service priorities and supporting timely, customer-focused solutions.
  • Monitor service performance, technician utilisation and job progress to help maintain productivity, quality outcomes and customer satisfaction.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Mechanical trades qualification as a Heavy Vehicle Mechanic, Diesel Mechanic or equivalent trade background.
  • Previous supervisory, leading hand or team leadership experience within a workshop, field service, mining, heavy diesel or engine product environment.
  • Strong technical understanding of diesel engines, diagnostics, repairs, preventative maintenance and service operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and support technicians while managing competing priorities in a fast-paced service environment.
  • Strong communication, customer service, planning and problem-solving skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships with customers and internal teams.
  • Solid diagnostic and IT capability, including confidence using service systems, documentation tools and business system input screens.
  • Experience with Cummins engines and heavy diesel products is highly regarded.

_At Cummins, we are an equal opportunity employer dedicated to diversity in the workplace. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, colour, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity and/or expression, or other status protected by law._

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

job.description:
Job Summary

Servant leader and coach to cross-functional teams in their understanding of delivering valuable outcomes through modern delivery practices and product centric operating model. Coaches on frameworks and methodologies, enabling the teams and Product Managers to inspire innovation, high performance and to embrace continuous improvement. When opportunities arise, coaches in organizational change to help the teams embrace agility. Help form the teams, establish practices and norms, ensure focus, facilitate events, identify and manage risks, dependences and remove impediments.

Key Responsibilities

Establishes lean/agile leadership, supports the Product Manager, and promotes quality practices; Coaches team members on modern delivery practices & provides developmental feedback to team members using a servant leadership style and leading by example. Support Product Managers and teams' backlog refinement and release planning, and identifying tangible and measurable business outcomes across multiple teams. Fosters an environment of mutual respect and cooperation, transparency, and autonomy; Coaches the adoption of product centric operating model reducing the gap between theory and practice; facilitates continuous improvement process and creates the right environment. Monitors and reports key metrics that impact value driven delivery and indicate potential problems; facilitate the creation of definition of done to ensure organizational standards are met for the solution (Documentation, Compliance, Architectural and Governance constraints). Establishes and communicates team progress and goals to keep the teams work visible, celebrate wins, highlight roadblocks through various methods. Supports team rules and norms and protects the team from outside interference; removes impediments for the teams and/or finds the right personnel to remove impediments. Identify, track and manage cross team dependencies. Proactively identify risks and issues that could impact delivery, facilitate risk response planning, and escalate appropriately. Facilitate team collaboration events, as necessary including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Ensures results/impact are fully realized and completed within the agreed timeline and delivered successfully. job.title: IT Product Manager - Supply Chain EWM
job.description:
Job Summary

Defines the product vision, and roadmap, ensuring alignment with customer needs, business goals, and market trends; Leads the end-to-end lifecycle of a complex, high-impact product. Drives business outcomes and continuous improvement leveraging financial insights, team metrics, KPIs and inspiring teams to achieve excellence. Accountable for maximizing product value. Act as the voice of the customer in planning sessions and related events.

Key Responsibilities

Define and evolve the product vision and roadmap; lead the teams in delivering solutions oriented around business impact ensuring it supports business goals and representing the voice of the customer. Conducts market research, user interviews, and data analysis to inform product decisions, define personas and their pain points ensuring these insights inform product requirements and solution development. Technical understanding of the scope of enabler work; Collaborates with Enterprise and Solution Architect/Engineering to assist decisions and sequencing of technology enablers. Shape product backlog with clearly defined and prioritized user stories, defects, enablers and acceptance criteria, ensuring ongoing alignment with evolving business priorities and stakeholder expectations. Accepts user stories as done, including validation of the stories meeting acceptance criteria; has appropriate acceptance tests, and complies with the Definition of Done (DoD). Drive user acceptance testing and ensure features meet business and quality standards before release. Partner with the Scrum Master/s and Agile Coach/s to drive continuous improvement. In partnership with InfoSec / legal teams, ensure that systems meet company standards for security, compliance and data privacy. Participate in release planning, sprint planning and demos with stakeholders; Actively participate in PI Planning, System Demos, and Inspect & Adapt events as the voice of the customer. Define and track key team performance metrics, KPIs and objectives and key results (OKRs) to ensure alignment with strategic goals. Work closely with business owners and other stakeholders to define product goals, success metrics, roadmap and establish the products’ business value, support messaging, communication and customer outreach as necessary. Financially responsible for the product – ensures the product investments are successful throughout product lifecycle. Responsible for people management including work plan development, performance management, and people development. Responsible for team building and development including organization structure, recruiting, team management.
