job.title: Procurement Risk Analyst
job.description:
The Procurement Risk Analyst supports procurement and supply chain operations by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating supplier and supply chain risks to ensure business continuity and operational efficiency. This role executes procurement strategies aligned with material buying plans, with a focus on improving supplier performance, capacity readiness, and risk mitigation ahead of demand. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, supplier risk management expertise, data visualization skills, and stakeholder collaboration to provide actionable insights that support procurement decision-making and supply continuity. The analyst will also act as a data steward, ensuring data quality, governance, and consistency across procurement systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze supplier and supply chain data to identify risks, vulnerabilities, and potential business impacts, and provide actionable insights to procurement and business leaders.
  • Coordinate with sourcing managers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to assess risks and develop mitigation and business continuity plans.
  • Support supplier performance improvement initiatives while maintaining high-quality product and service delivery.
  • Monitor supplier capacity, continuity of supply, reputational risks, and margin-related risks, and proactively implement risk mitigation strategies.
  • Prepare and present recommendations for process improvements, risk reduction opportunities, and alternative courses of action to procurement leadership.
  • Support procurement operations related to supplier onboarding, qualification, contract management, payment issues, and order fulfillment.
  • Serve as the communication conduit between suppliers, sourcing teams, and manufacturing facilities during supplier issues or disruptions.
  • Provide delivery and expediting support to plants/sites during supplier constraints or operational challenges.
  • Support management and execution of engineering releases impacting suppliers.
  • Collect, validate, and maintain supplier scorecard data and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Act as a Data Steward by ensuring data integrity, governance, quality, and consistency across procurement systems.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and automations using tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Excel, and database systems to improve efficiency and visibility.
  • Proactively monitor procurement systems, identify issues, and drive corrective actions to ensure uninterrupted operations.
  • Document and share best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives across procurement teams.
  • Drive process automation and system enhancements to improve productivity and reduce manual effort.

Skills & Competencies

  • Supply Base Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate supplier risks related to supply continuity, reputation, and profitability.
  • Data Analytics & Visualization: Strong capability to analyze qualitative and quantitative data, identify trends, and present actionable insights using dashboards and reporting tools.
  • Procurement Systems Knowledge: Proficiency in ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, Ariba, and related purchasing, quality, and payment systems.
  • Advanced Technical Skills: Expertise in Advanced Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, Macros), Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, and reporting automation.
  • Supplier Performance Management: Ability to monitor supplier KPIs, manage corrective actions, and drive continuous supplier improvement.
  • Supplier Capacity Management: Understanding of supplier capacity planning, forecasting, and demand alignment.
  • Contract Management: Ability to assess contractual terms, monitor supplier compliance, and manage contract lifecycle activities.
  • Problem Solving: Strong root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving using data-driven methodologies.
  • Negotiation Excellence: Ability to support negotiations to achieve mutually beneficial business outcomes.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong collaboration and relationship-building with suppliers, sourcing teams, manufacturing, and internal stakeholders.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence and present insights effectively.
  • Escalation & Conflict Management: Ability to manage escalations calmly and resolve issues with minimal business disruption.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify inefficiencies, implement process improvements, and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Agility & Decision Making: Quick decision-making capability with strong business judgment in dynamic environments.

Experience

  • Minimum 5–6 years of experience in procurement, supply chain analytics, supplier management, or source-to-pay operations.
  • Hands-on experience in procurement data analysis, business intelligence, and visualization tools.
  • Experience in supplier risk management and business continuity planning.
  • Exposure to end-to-end Source-to-Pay processes including supplier qualification, onboarding, contract management, and payment cycles.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in global or matrix organizations.
  • Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments preferred.

Additional Information

  • Work Location: Cummins India Technical Center (IOC), Pune, India
  • Shift Timing: Afternoon / EMEA Shift (12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST)
  • Work Mode: Hybrid / On-site with flexibility

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred, with specialization in Supply Chain, Procurement, or Operations.
  • Additional certifications in Risk Management, Procurement, Project Management (PMP/Prince2), or Data Analytics are an advantage.

job.title: Apprentice - Mechanical
job.description:
Our culture believes in POWERING YOUR POTENTIAL. We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what #LifeAtCummins is all about.

Working under the supervision of a qualified Cummins Technician, you will learn everything that comes with the diagnosis and repair of Cummins engines and products.

What’s in it for you?

  • Earn while you learn, we pay above award rates.
  • Mechanical starter toolkit provided upon commencement.
  • Obtain a nationally recognized Certificate III trade qualification.
  • Complete off-the-job TAFE/Registered Training Organization study.
  • Receive structured on-the-job training, under the supervision of our Regional Capability Trainers, as well as the qualified technicians and supervisors in your workshop.
  • Gain your experience working on a range of our world class Cummins engine products.
  • Improve your technical expertise by completing a range of engine product training with Cummins Technical Trainers as you progress through your apprenticeship.

About you

Cummins are looking for applicants with the following attributes:

  • A positive attitude and eagerness to learn.
  • A passion for working on our products and in the industry.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well in a team.
  • Excellent level of language, literacy, and numeracy skills
  • A willingness to work across regional areas and rotate through different departments to gain experience on automotive, industrial, marine, and mining engine products as you progress through your apprenticeship.
  • Right to work in Australia
  • Preference to have completed year 12 or equivalent.
  • A strong focus on safety and wellbeing that will lead to a successful career at Cummins.
  • Willingness to embrace diversity and make Cummins a great place to work.

At Cummins, we are an equal opportunity employer dedicated to diversity in the workplace. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, colour, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity and/or expression, or other status protected by law.

Job Summary

Responsible for analyzing and gathering business and technical requirements to design and document fit-for-purpose solutions. Contributes to solution development, design, integration and testing, and configuration of technology solutions ensuring that delivered solutions adhere to defined architecture and security standards. Works closely with with cross-functional teams, vendors, and business partners to ensure smooth execution and continuous improvement in solution performance and quality. Ensure seamless solution implementation and effective issue resolution.

Supports the design of fit-for-purpose solutions by collaborating with stakeholders to identify integration points and ensure alignment with business processes and goals. job.title: Electrician - Level I
job.description:
Job Summary

As part of a formal skilled trades training program, assists site Electrician skilled trades to learn and develop electrical skills in a manufacturing environment under direct guidance. Apprentice will be required to successfully complete and document specified classes and a minimum quantity of on the job training hours. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards.
  • Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard.
  • Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment.
  • Promote interdependence by looking out for one another.
  • Correct hazards within your control and capabilities.
  • Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact.
  • Engage in HSE Training.

Quality

  • Learns and applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship.
  • Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis.
  • Performs supervised work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments.
  • Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system.
  • Follows all process documentation and quality procedures.
  • Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures.
  • Performs quality inspections.

Delivery

  • Attends required classes to build basic electrical skills and knowledge to qualify as an Electrician.
  • Completes all required on the job training hours.
  • Repairs and maintains manufacturing equipment and other miscellaneous duties within their capabilities .
  • Assists with preventive, emergency, corrective and predictive maintenance activities.
  • Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks.

Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork

  • Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams.
  • Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements.
  • Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Electrical System Troubleshooting - Analyzes an electrical control system to resolve and repair electrical issues to return the system to proper operating conditions.

Factory Automation and Control Systems - Implements changes to further automate manufacturing processes using available technology, programming techniques, and identifying needed material and resources for project completion to provide the optimum automation for the manufacturing environment.

Machine Programming - Creates factory floor machine programs by designing and implementing solutions to improve usage of machine and overall operation.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

job.title: Senior Project Engineer - Power Generation
job.description:
This role is based at our Wetherill Park, NSW office, where you will join our expanding Power Generation team providing technical leadership and application engineering support for projects across Data Centres, Energy Management, Healthcare, Commercial Buildings, Industrial Facilities, Utilities, Mining, and other critical infrastructure sectors.

Working closely with customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, project managers, and Cummins teams across the Asia Pacific region, you will develop reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective power generation solutions that meet both technical and commercial requirements.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Develop technical solutions for diesel and gas generator systems, power generation packages, and integrated power solutions.
  • Engage directly with customers, consulting engineers, EPC contractors, and internal stakeholders to understand technical and commercial requirements.
  • Prepare and review technical specifications, single line diagrams, system architecture, equipment schedules, and engineering documentation.
  • Evaluate customer specifications and provide technical compliance, deviations, and value engineering recommendations.
  • Support tender submissions by preparing technical proposals and ensuring solutions meet customer and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide on-site expertise during installation and commissioning of equipment, ensuring we provide a high quality and safe solution for our customers.
  • Review electrical and mechanical system designs to ensure compliance with Australian Standards, customer specifications, and Cummins engineering guidelines.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout project execution including design reviews, factory acceptance testing (FAT), site installation, commissioning, and project close-out.
  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Service, Project Management, Product Engineering, and Manufacturing teams to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers where required.
  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, project delivery, and customer outcomes.

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A Washington Accord recognised bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Mechanical engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in power generation, electrical infrastructure, critical power, or industrial power systems.
  • Experience delivering technical solutions for industries such as Data Centres, Healthcare, Mining, Commercial Buildings, Utilities, Manufacturing, or Infrastructure.
  • Experience creating and reviewing engineering drawings, electrical schematics, technical specifications, and project documentation.
  • Strong understanding of Australian Standards and relevant electrical codes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, consultants, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
  • Experience with commissioning or field support of generator systems or other electrical power, or large industrial equipment.
  • Strong knowledge of generator systems, synchronisation, switchgear, control systems, ATS, paralleling systems, and power distribution.

Desirable traits for the role include:

  • Knowledge of SCADA, PLCs, Building Management Systems (BMS), or Power Management Systems.
  • Experience with Cummins, CAT, MTU, Kohler, or other power generation equipment.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Flexible Lifestyle – Monday to Friday (Hybrid)
  • Competitive salary package
  • Further training provided on site.
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles.

We are proud to offer learning and development opportunities designed to promote individual performance and spark purpose and trust within our teams. We look to hire the best and then help you to become even better.

Technician- Mechanical

We are seeking experienced Technician- Mechanical to join our dynamic workshop team based in Perth.

Description

  • Deliver first-class service to our customers
  • Complete repairs and maintenance of heavy diesel products
  • Diagnose and repair Cummins engines
  • Engine rebuilding and reconditioning
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and report any issues / incidents to the Supervisor
  • Complete required documentation, such as service worksheets, warranty claims, quality forms or business system input screens.

Education, Licenses, Certifications

  • WA driver’s licence
  • Australian working rights
  • Mechanical trades qualified as Heavy Diesel Mechanic, Light vehicle mechanic or plant mechanic (light/heavy/engine reconditioning)
  • Experience as a technician in the service and maintenance of heavy diesel products
  • Ideally possess engine repair, rebuild or reconditioning experience.
  • Safety Focused and the ability to work effectively in a team environment

Additional Information:

  • Competitive hourly rate for applicants with proven experience
  • Overtime penalties
  • Further training and career development opportunities
  • Participation in an annual variable compensation (bonus) program
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • Discounts with select private health insurance
  • PC software/hardware, and a range of vehicles
  • Annual remuneration reviews
  • Safety equipment/PPE and uniforms provided and a range of personal and professional benefits

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electrical Knowledge - Demonstrates knowledge of Cummins and industry standards on working with low and/or high voltage by complying with all safe work procedures including Personal Protective Equipment to create a safe work environment; applies basic electrical theories and electronics components knowledge using appropriate tools and procedures to diagnose and repair products safely and efficiently.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Mechanical Knowledge - Demonstrates knowledge of Cummins and industry standards by complying with all safe work procedures including Personal Protective Equipment to create a safe work environment; applies mechanical principles and theories using appropriate tools and procedures to diagnose and repair products safely and efficiently.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Preferred)

Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution

Locally valid driving permit (Preferred)

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Minimal level of work shop experience required

job.title: Product Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Main focus will include working in business processes of Product Preceding Technology (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI) or Current Product Support (CPS) and executing technical processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) while using tools such as 7-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Competencies:

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.

Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems - Acquires and applies an in-depth understanding of mechanical systems through working knowledge that guides a designer’s ability to create innovative and sound design concepts to meet Cummins and customer expectations; designs for requirements of all lifecycle stages by considering the customer requirements in different operating environments to ensure a robust system.

Mechanical Design Specification - Creates complete specifications in the form of solid models, configured engineering bill of materials and detailed drawings that cross-functionally communicate the information required to manufacture and inspect a product per its design intent; considers national, international, industry, and Cummins’ standards that accurately and concisely define the part specification.

Product Configuration and Change Management - Establishes a baseline of identified product artifacts to be placed under configuration management; releases, tracks, controls and communicates changes from concept to obsolescence often through work requests; establishes and maintains the integrity of the product artifact baselines.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Interface Management and Integration - Identifies and analyzes the interfaces and interactions across system boundaries by specifying the requirements and limits to ensure that the product meets requirements; controls the interactions across the system element boundaries by making sure that they remain within specified limits; integrates system elements by creating an integration plan, including identification of method and timing for each activity to make it easier to find, isolate, diagnose, and correct.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

job.title: Production Associate - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

The Assembly Line Operator / Manufacturing Technician is responsible for operating production equipment and supporting assembly line operations to manufacture high-quality products in accordance with established production, quality, safety, and productivity standards. This role performs machine operation, product assembly, equipment setup, process verification, quality inspections, and basic troubleshooting while ensuring adherence to standard operating procedures, engineering specifications, and continuous improvement practices in a high-volume manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Production & Assembly Operations

  • Operate manual and automated production equipment safely and efficiently to achieve production targets while meeting quality and cycle time requirements.
  • Perform assembly line operations in accordance with standardized manufacturing processes, work instructions, engineering drawings, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Set up machines, perform changeovers, verify process parameters, and ensure production equipment is ready for operation.
  • Perform tool offset setting, adjustment, and validation to maintain product quality and process stability.
  • Load, unload, align, and validate fixtures to ensure proper product positioning during manufacturing.
  • Monitor machine performance and production output to ensure products meet engineering specifications and customer quality requirements.
  • Support production across different manufacturing lines or functions based on business requirements.

Quality & Process Control

  • Follow all applicable quality procedures, including Statistical Process Control (SPC), poka-yoke, visual management, and standardized work instructions.
  • Perform in-process and final quality inspections to identify defects and ensure product conformity.
  • Identify, segregate, and report non-conforming materials while supporting corrective and preventive actions.
  • Monitor First Time Right (FTR/RFT) performance and implement actions to reduce defects, rework, and process losses.
  • Participate in root cause analysis and continuous improvement activities to improve product quality and manufacturing efficiency.

Equipment Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Perform routine operator care, cleaning, inspection, and preventive maintenance activities on production equipment.
  • Participate in Preventive Maintenance (PM) and Process Maintenance activities to improve equipment reliability.
  • Identify and troubleshoot basic mechanical or operational issues and coordinate with maintenance teams for timely resolution.
  • Support Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvement initiatives by minimizing downtime and improving machine utilization.

Health, Safety & Continuous Improvement

  • Comply with Cummins Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and actively promote a safe working environment.
  • Maintain workplace cleanliness and organization through 5S practices and standard housekeeping activities.
  • Participate in Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Kaizen, and other continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Report safety hazards, quality concerns, equipment abnormalities, and production issues promptly.

Teamwork & Operational Excellence

  • Work collaboratively with production teams, maintenance personnel, quality engineers, and support functions to achieve manufacturing goals.
  • Communicate production status, issues, and improvement opportunities effectively with Team Leaders and Managers.
  • Follow production schedules, shift timings, break schedules, and attendance requirements to support uninterrupted operations.
  • Complete required training and actively participate in skill development initiatives.
  • Perform additional duties assigned by Team Leaders or Managers to support business objectives.

Qualifications

  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent may be considered where applicable.
  • Additional certifications in Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Quality Systems, or Manufacturing Operations are an advantage.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export control or regulatory requirements.

Skills

  • Strong understanding of assembly line operations and high-volume manufacturing processes.
  • Hands-on experience in machine operation, product assembly, and manufacturing equipment.
  • Knowledge of machine setup, changeover activities, process parameter verification, and tool offset adjustments.
  • Experience with fixture loading, unloading, alignment, and validation.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, control plans, work instructions, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC), poka-yoke, quality inspection methods, and defect prevention techniques.
  • Knowledge of Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Lean Manufacturing, 5S, and Kaizen methodologies.
  • Basic mechanical troubleshooting skills and equipment maintenance knowledge.
  • Strong awareness of safety procedures, PPE requirements, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) standards.
  • Ability to achieve production targets while maintaining quality and cycle time requirements.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional manufacturing environment.
  • Basic computer literacy and manufacturing system knowledge are preferred.
  • Flexibility to work in a rotating three-shift manufacturing environment.

Experience

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in the automobile or manufacturing industry.
  • Proven experience working on assembly lines in a high-volume production environment.
  • Experience operating manual and automated production equipment.
  • Hands-on experience with machine setup, process verification, fixture handling, and assembly operations.
  • Experience supporting preventive maintenance, process improvement, and equipment reliability initiatives.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing quality systems, defect identification, and root cause analysis.
  • Experience working with Lean Manufacturing, TPM, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Experience achieving production targets while maintaining quality, safety, and operational excellence.

job.description:
Job Summary

The Assembly Line Operator / Manufacturing Technician is responsible for operating production equipment and supporting assembly line operations to manufacture high-quality products in accordance with established production, quality, safety, and productivity standards. This role performs machine operation, product assembly, equipment setup, process verification, quality inspections, and basic troubleshooting while ensuring adherence to standard operating procedures, engineering specifications, and continuous improvement practices in a high-volume manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

Production & Assembly Operations

  • Operate manual and automated production equipment safely and efficiently to achieve production targets while meeting quality and cycle time requirements.
  • Perform assembly line operations in accordance with standardized manufacturing processes, work instructions, engineering drawings, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Set up machines, perform changeovers, verify process parameters, and ensure production equipment is ready for operation.
  • Perform tool offset setting, adjustment, and validation to maintain product quality and process stability.
  • Load, unload, align, and validate fixtures to ensure proper product positioning during manufacturing.
  • Monitor machine performance and production output to ensure products meet engineering specifications and customer quality requirements.
  • Support production across different manufacturing lines or functions based on business requirements.

Quality & Process Control

  • Follow all applicable quality procedures, including Statistical Process Control (SPC), poka-yoke, visual management, and standardized work instructions.
  • Perform in-process and final quality inspections to identify defects and ensure product conformity.
  • Identify, segregate, and report non-conforming materials while supporting corrective and preventive actions.
  • Monitor First Time Right (FTR/RFT) performance and implement actions to reduce defects, rework, and process losses.
  • Participate in root cause analysis and continuous improvement activities to improve product quality and manufacturing efficiency.

Equipment Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Perform routine operator care, cleaning, inspection, and preventive maintenance activities on production equipment.
  • Participate in Preventive Maintenance (PM) and Process Maintenance activities to improve equipment reliability.
  • Identify and troubleshoot basic mechanical or operational issues and coordinate with maintenance teams for timely resolution.
  • Support Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) improvement initiatives by minimizing downtime and improving machine utilization.

Health, Safety & Continuous Improvement

  • Comply with Cummins Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and actively promote a safe working environment.
  • Maintain workplace cleanliness and organization through 5S practices and standard housekeeping activities.
  • Participate in Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Kaizen, and other continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Report safety hazards, quality concerns, equipment abnormalities, and production issues promptly.

Teamwork & Operational Excellence

  • Work collaboratively with production teams, maintenance personnel, quality engineers, and support functions to achieve manufacturing goals.
  • Communicate production status, issues, and improvement opportunities effectively with Team Leaders and Managers.
  • Follow production schedules, shift timings, break schedules, and attendance requirements to support uninterrupted operations.
  • Complete required training and actively participate in skill development initiatives.
  • Perform additional duties assigned by Team Leaders or Managers to support business objectives.

Qualifications

  • Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent may be considered where applicable.
  • Additional certifications in Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Quality Systems, or Manufacturing Operations are an advantage.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export control or regulatory requirements.

Skills

  • Strong understanding of assembly line operations and high-volume manufacturing processes.
  • Hands-on experience in machine operation, product assembly, and manufacturing equipment.
  • Knowledge of machine setup, changeover activities, process parameter verification, and tool offset adjustments.
  • Experience with fixture loading, unloading, alignment, and validation.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, control plans, work instructions, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC), poka-yoke, quality inspection methods, and defect prevention techniques.
  • Knowledge of Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Lean Manufacturing, 5S, and Kaizen methodologies.
  • Basic mechanical troubleshooting skills and equipment maintenance knowledge.
  • Strong awareness of safety procedures, PPE requirements, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) standards.
  • Ability to achieve production targets while maintaining quality and cycle time requirements.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional manufacturing environment.
  • Basic computer literacy and manufacturing system knowledge are preferred.
  • Flexibility to work in a rotating three-shift manufacturing environment.

Experience

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in the automobile or manufacturing industry.
  • Proven experience working on assembly lines in a high-volume production environment.
  • Experience operating manual and automated production equipment.
  • Hands-on experience with machine setup, process verification, fixture handling, and assembly operations.
  • Experience supporting preventive maintenance, process improvement, and equipment reliability initiatives.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of manufacturing quality systems, defect identification, and root cause analysis.
  • Experience working with Lean Manufacturing, TPM, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Experience achieving production targets while maintaining quality, safety, and operational excellence.

job.title: Supplier Quality Engineer - Delhi Region (Faridabad)
job.description:
Job Summary

The Supplier Quality Engineer creates values by supporting supplier quality initiatives that enable the business or function to achieve its operational and strategic supplier quality goals

Key Responsibilities

Build relationships with all critical partners to improve quality and business outcomes, including: external suppliers, external customers, and internal customers and stakeholders, such as Purchasing, Manufacturing and Engineering. Learn and apply industry common Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) processes, Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) tools, and Cummins specialty tools to develop or improve an external supplier’s manufacturing process. Become an effective auditor by participating in external supplier audits; may lead low complexity and low risk audits after becoming a certified auditor. Participate in the resolution of external supplier related quality challenges; support root cause analysis, supporting development of corrective actions and support the verification of the effectiveness of corrective actions; may lead resolution of low complexity and lower risk quality challenges after gaining experience. Embrace continuous improvement in the external supply base by participating in and contributing to product and process focused projects that utilize industry proven methodologies, such as lean and six-sigma. Partcipate in the quality performance planning and improvement process for a specific product type or specific segment of the external supply base; may lead the quality planning and improvement process for low complexity and low risk product types or segments of the supply base. Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Auditing - Applying auditing skills and techniques and Quality Management Systems knowledge to effectively appraise a manufacturing process for quality and safety risks and non-conformances.

Interpreting Technical Requirements - Applying knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing principles and Engineering Standards to correctly interpret the technical requirements of an engineering drawing; Applying knowledge to improve a product’s design for manufacturability and measurability.

Manufacturing Process Design - Applying knowledge of manufacturing technology (methods, techniques, tools, equipment, etc) to design a Zero Defect manufacturing process that can consistently meet technical and customer requirements.

Manufacturing Process Validation - Applying core Automotive tools (i.e. DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, Source Release and PPAP) to validate that a manufacturing process can consistently meet technical and customer requirements.

Measurement Process Design - Applying knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing principles and knowledge of measurement technology (standards, techniques, equipment, etc) to design a measurement system that can consistently meet industry and customer requirements.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Quality Influence - Ability to recognize stakeholders, create a forum to professionally extract stakeholder perspectives, drive and engage in constructive conflict, and to influence outcomes in order to ensure Cummins makes a balanced decision inclusive of Quality priorities.

Quality Standards - Applying knowledge of quality standards, such as ISO9001:2015 and IATF16949, to develop procedures, processes, and external suppliers in a manner that aligns with regulatory requirements.

Statistical Foundations - Applies statistical tools and technique to influence decision making; leverages understanding of data collection methods, key statistics, graphical and analytical methods to describe process performance, gain insights and drive improvement action

Supplier Performance Improvement - Improving supplier performance by developing and executing an effective quality improvement strategy that consists of a project team, glidepath, reduction of manufacturing issues and improvement of systemic deficiencies.

Supplier Quality Project Planning and Execution - Applying Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) skills to develop and execute a quality plan that enables external suppliers to meet customer expectations; Requires facilitating communication and collaboration across cross-functional activities, when a program, initiative, or project concerns external suppliers.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Supplier Product Reliability - Ability to evaluate the supplier's product design, supplier's manufacturing process design and product validation process to ensure the supplier is capable to meet reliability expectations.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Engineering or a related technical or scientific subject required

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Minimal level of relevant work experience required.

Work Location New Delhi- NCR region in Central part of India - Station at Faridabad and catering North zone suppliers

Need 6 to 10+ year experience person with having good hold on Supplier Quality process with having good hold on development cycle with APQP methodology and able to conduct onsite PPAP and Inspection of parts by self .

Minimum local travel 85 % to visit at supplier plants near North India Region. – Regional SQE stationed at North India

Candidate well verse with Process/ product knowledge Bellows, Pipes, Hoses, Doser and sensors. Instrument in deep knowledge on molding process, pipe manufacturing etc.

Need to be flexible for attending local and Global meetings based on requirements.

job.title: Data Scientist - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Solves complex analytical problems using quantitative approaches through a combination of analytical, mathematical and technical skills. Researches, designs, implements and validates complex algorithms to analyze diverse sources of data to achieve targeted outcomes by leveraging complex statistical and predictive modeling concepts.

Key Responsibilities

Participates in projects to support key objectives and business goals through the use of data science methodology. Leverages data science methodology to solve complex business problems. Creates multiple algorithms using complex statistical methodologies through the use of statistical programming languages and tools. Partners with domain experts to verify model capabilities. Partners with Solution Architect to enable appropriate data flow/data model, development using appropriate tools/technology, rapid prototyping and informs the design of analytical products. Partners with less experienced employees on data science tools and methodologies. Clearly articulates results, methodologies and learnings to stakeholder and peer group. Continuous development and advancement of the team through knowledge sharing and collaboration.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Tech savvy - Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital and technology applications.

Data Mining - Extracts insights from data by identifying relationships and patterns through use of a suite of data exploration and data visualization techniques to understand the underlying structure of the data and enable sound conclusions upon model building.

Predictive Modeling - Develops analytical or machine learning models by using appropriate variable transformations, feature selection strategies, imputation strategies, class rebalancing, resampling strategies and quality control measures to generate predictive insights used in solving business questions.

Requirements Analysis - Evaluates relationships and interdependencies between requirements based upon their complexity and value to the business in order to determine feasibility and prioritization.

Statistical Modeling - Develops descriptive and explanatory statistical models, and simulations for regression, classification, outlier detection, anomaly detection, time series forecasting using knowledge of foundational statistics such as null hypotheses significance tests, regression models, generalized linear modeling, time series analysis, rank statistics, probability distribution fitting survival analysis, etc. to validate hypotheses for any given statistical or business question.

job.title: Industrial Engineer - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Designs, improves, and installs integrated manufacturing or administrative systems which use people, materials, information, equipment, and energy.

Key Responsibilities

Leads work studies for new and current production lines. Leads standard work methods for new and current production lines. Leads the work for specific projects to create and implement all aspects of a manufacturing processes to ensure safety requirements, manufacturing goals, business goals, and product specifications are met. Leads by applying the knowledge or use of manufacturing principles and practices to improve manufacturing equipment and processes. Maintains the application of Cummins standards and develops manufacturing standards. Leads the communications with and influences key external stakeholders, business leaders, and functional members. Works with internal and external resources on specific project assignments. Leads the advanced knowledge of manufacturing principles and practices as they are applied to Cummins. Maintains relationships and coaches key stakeholders. Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Ergonomic Fundamentals - Understands ergonomic concepts by applying Cummins ergonomic standards, guidelines, controls and tools to reduce ergonomic risk to employees while at work.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Line Balancing - Evaluates work activities performed by individuals or machines to identify opportunities to optimize operating time and distributing of the work content to meet the changes in customer demands while continuing to optimize manufacturing processes.

Manufacturing Analysis Led Design - Uses digital tools to model and simulate manufacturing processes, equipment and performance to make data driven decisions before changes are made and to drive continuous improvements.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Process Layout - Creates and/or modifies an optimized manufacturing process by incorporating knowledge of equipment, human interfaces, sequences of production steps, and facilities requirements in order to reduce process time and waste.

Work Measurement - Quantifies and evaluates the elements of work that make up a process by breaking it down into detailed steps to identify and reduce waste, and redistribute work content to optimize process flows.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Continuous Process Improvement - Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.

Drawing Interpretation - Integrates product design and manufacturing equipment engineering drawings to support the design and development of an optimal manufacturing process that meets product design specifications.

Industrial Engineering Knowledge - Integrates the pillars of industrial engineering techniques by applying a comprehensive and quantitative analysis to available data to be used as decision factors for the development or improvement of manufacturing processes to contribute to the most efficient process.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) or related field, or equivalent experience required.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level relevant work experience required.

Job Description: Industrial Engineer Senior

Role Summary: We are seeking an Industrial Engineering professional with strong expertise in discrete manufacturing, industrial engineering, and data analytics. This role will transform manufacturing data into actionable insights, drive continuous improvement, and support the deployment of AI and analytics solutions across plant operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze data from digital manufacturing systems such as CMES, Connected Factory, Maximo, Q-DAS, OEE platforms, and other plant applications to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to understand process challenges and convert them into data-driven improvement projects.
  • Develop dashboards, analytics models, and performance insights to improve productivity, equipment utilization, quality, cost, and operational efficiency.
  • Support AI and machine learning use cases by providing manufacturing domain expertise, validating data logic, and helping enterprise AI teams translate plant requirements into practical solutions.
  • Perform data validation, root-cause analysis, and performance investigations using SQL, Python, Power BI, and other analytics tools.
  • Identify bottlenecks, waste, process variation, and reliability issues, then recommend practical actions to drive measurable business improvements.
  • Facilitate Industry 4.0 analytics workshops, train plant teams on analytics tools, and build capability for data-driven decision making.
  • Design and support Operations Control Tower concepts by integrating data from manufacturing, maintenance, quality, and ERP systems to provide a consolidated view of operations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes, plant operations, lean manufacturing, industrial engineering methods, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Hands-on experience with manufacturing performance metrics such as OEE, throughput, downtime, cycle time, productivity, quality losses, and cost improvement.
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and methods, including SQL, Python, Power BI, statistical analysis, and data visualization.
  • Ability to work with large operational data sets, validate data quality, identify trends, and convert analysis into business actions.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional plant teams and translating shop-floor challenges into analytics or AI use cases.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and project execution skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, connected factory, MES, ERP, or digital manufacturing platforms.
  • Exposure to AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced operations analytics in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience leading value stream improvement, or data-driven productivity projects.
  • Ability to influence plant stakeholders and drive adoption of analytics-based improvement actions.

job.title: Solution Architect - Senior
job.description:
The Solution Architect - Senior is responsible for assessing, designing, and implementing scalable solution architectures aligned with Cummins enterprise architecture strategies, standards, and principles. This role defines application and solution designs for complex systems in partnership with product and project teams, ensuring technical solutions meet business, security, governance, and compliance requirements. The incumbent provides technical leadership in designing end-to-end analytics and AI architectures, including data pipelines, machine learning systems, and enterprise integrations. The role also drives innovation through proof-of-concepts (POCs), evaluates emerging technologies, and ensures architecture decisions create measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and own end-to-end scalable solution architectures for analytics, AI, cloud, and enterprise systems aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Define system component architecture, functional allocation, and interfaces between applications, platforms, and infrastructure components.
  • Develop multiple solution design options, perform cost-benefit analysis, and recommend optimized architectures based on business and technical requirements.
  • Create and maintain reference architectures, reusable design patterns, and architecture building blocks for global adoption.
  • Apply enterprise architecture standards, frameworks, styles, technology stacks, and patterns in solution development.
  • Drive architectural improvements and influence enterprise technical strategy through collaboration with Principal Solution Architects and engineering teams.
  • Architect scalable data pipelines, ML systems, and system integrations to support advanced analytics and AI use cases.
  • Analyze complex business processes, governance requirements, and technical constraints to create practical, scalable solutions.
  • Lead pilot programs and proof-of-concept initiatives to validate technology capabilities and support innovation.
  • Evaluate infrastructure capacity and recommend improvements to support current and future business needs.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to align technical solutions with strategic business goals.
  • Promote adoption of standard technologies and best practices through strong collaboration with customers, peers, and engineering teams.
  • Identify, assess, and manage architecture-related risks and issues while driving mitigation strategies.
  • Stay current on emerging technologies, software trends, architecture methodologies, and industry best practices.

Skills

  • Enterprise Architecture & Solution Design
  • Cloud Architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Data Architecture, Data Warehousing & ETL
  • Machine Learning Systems & MLOps
  • System Integration & API Architecture
  • Analytics and AI Platform Design
  • Architecture Frameworks & Reference Models
  • DevSecOps and Agile Delivery Practices
  • Risk and Issue Management
  • Stakeholder Management & Business Relationship Management
  • Cost Optimization and Performance Engineering
  • Technical Leadership and Strategic Thinking

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Experience with data modeling , ETL frameworks , and data pipeline design
  • Experience with machine learning lifecycle management (MLOps)
  • Knowledge of build automation, version control, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Understanding of security, governance, and compliance requirements in architecture design

Experience

  • Intermediate to advanced experience in solution architecture, enterprise systems, or a related technical discipline required.

  • Proven ability to architect complex technical solutions and translate business requirements into scalable technical designs.
  • Experience leading cross-functional technical teams and influencing architecture decisions across stakeholders.
  • Experience in:
  • Analyzing complex business systems and industry requirements
  • Designing scalable enterprise data and analytics solutions
  • Architecting integrations across enterprise applications and data platforms
  • Building AI/ML-enabled solution architectures
  • Preferred experience with:
  • IoT technologies and connected systems
  • Agile software development methodologies

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Databricks , Snowflake , and Neo4j

job.title: Supply Chain Planner
job.description:
The Supply Chain Planner is responsible for planning, coordinating, and maintaining daily supply chain operations across one or more functional areas, including material planning, production planning, inventory management, logistics, demand management, customer service, and order fulfillment. The role ensures alignment between supply and demand while meeting internal and external customer expectations. Working in a global supply chain environment, the Supply Chain Planner collaborates with suppliers, manufacturing sites, logistics providers, and cross-functional stakeholders to optimize inventory, improve supplier performance, mitigate supply risks, and drive continuous process improvements across regional and global operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, execute, and maintain supply and material plans that align with customer demand while balancing inventory, production capacity, and logistics requirements.
  • Plan and manage end-to-end material flow across global supply networks, including suppliers, manufacturing facilities, distribution centers, and regional operations.
  • Monitor and optimize planning parameters within ERP and planning systems to improve planning accuracy and ensure consistent supply chain signals.
  • Analyze supply chain performance using key performance indicators (KPIs), identify performance gaps, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
  • Identify and proactively mitigate supply risks related to supplier capacity, material shortages, logistics constraints, long lead times, geopolitical disruptions, and transportation delays.
  • Collaborate with suppliers to improve delivery performance, capacity commitments, order fulfillment, and On-Time-In-Full (OTIF) performance.
  • Coordinate with procurement, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, customer service, and regional planning teams to ensure effective execution of supply plans.
  • Manage inventory strategies across multiple supply chain nodes, including origin, in-transit, and destination inventory, while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.
  • Monitor shipment pipelines and logistics performance, ensuring accurate delivery tracking and timely escalation of potential delays.
  • Support engineering change implementation, part lifecycle management, and material planning activities while minimizing operational disruptions.
  • Apply Plan for Every Part (PFEP), Master Supply Scheduling, and Material Planning principles to improve planning efficiency and material availability.
  • Evaluate cost, service, and inventory trade-offs to support effective supply chain decision-making.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives through data analysis, process optimization, and participation in cross-functional improvement teams.
  • Maintain effective communication across global stakeholders while supporting supply continuity and operational excellence.

Skills and Experience

  • Significant experience in supply planning, material planning, inventory management, or broader supply chain operations within a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience working in global supply chain environments supporting multiple regions, with exposure to Asia-to-North America and/or EMEA supply networks preferred.
  • Strong understanding of supply planning processes, demand planning, inventory optimization, production planning, logistics, and supplier management.
  • Experience using ERP and Advanced Planning Systems such as Oracle R12, Oracle ASCP/APCC, or equivalent supply planning platforms.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, data analysis, business intelligence tools, and reporting platforms such as Power BI.
  • Knowledge of materials planning systems, Master Production Scheduling (MPS), PFEP methodology, engineering change management, and materials KPI management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data, assess risks, and make informed business decisions.
  • Experience conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions to improve supply chain performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced global environment while balancing cost, service, and inventory objectives.
  • Strong stakeholder management, supplier collaboration, communication, and cross-functional teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones.
  • High level of ownership, customer focus, adaptability, and commitment to continuous improvement.

Working Hours: This role supports global operations and requires working 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM IST to effectively collaborate with international stakeholders across multiple regions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • An advanced degree or professional supply chain certification is considered an advantage.
  • This position may require compliance with applicable export controls or sanctions regulations.

job.title: Principal Data Analyst
job.description:
Cummins is seeking a hands-on SAP Data professional who is equally comfortable analyzing data, resolving complex issues, engaging with business stakeholders, and executing migration activities. This is a critical role and requires a self-starter who takes ownership, delivers outcomes, has the credibility and experience to lead critical data activities and data quality across complex business and technical environments within a major S/4HANA transformation program.

Location – This role could be based in any major Australian city.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Analyze legacy data sources and SAP data structures.
  • Define and execute source-to-target mappings for master and transactional data.
  • Perform detailed data profiling, quality assessments, and root cause analysis of data issues.
  • Drive data cleansing, enrichment, standardization, and remediation activities across business functions.
  • Build, validate, and execute migration datasets for multiple migration cycles.
  • Support ETL development, data transformation, load execution, and reconciliation activities.
  • Perform hands-on data validation and resolve migration defects through to closure.
  • Develop migration rules, automation framework, establish reusable components to support factory model, data quality controls, and governance standards.
  • Lead data readiness assessments and provide clear reporting on migration progress and risks.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, SAP functional consultants, and technical teams to ensure successful migration outcomes.
  • Support mock conversions, dress rehearsals, cutover activities, and production deployment.
  • Take ownership of data issues, driving resolution and ensuring delivery against program milestones.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Proven experience delivering SAP data migration workstreams on large-scale transformation programs.
  • Strong SAP S/4HANA knowledge with a solid understanding of key business processes and data models.
  • Experience migrating both master and transactional data across Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Service Management domains.
  • Build, validate, and execute migration datasets using SAP BODS, BDC, and other migration tools.
  • Strong ETL, data quality, data governance, and data management expertise.
  • Hands-on experience with data extraction, transformation, cleansing, reconciliation, and migration execution.
  • Ability to work independently, challenge stakeholders, and drive delivery in complex environments.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA 2021 and higher implementations and upgrades is essential.
  • Exposure to SAP Business AI capabilities and SAP Joule within the S/4HANA ecosystem and leveraging AI-assisted tools for data analysis, data quality assessment, data mapping, and migration acceleration, is highly desirable and will be key differentiator for the candidate.
