job.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

The Supplier Quality Engineer supports supplier quality initiatives that enable the business to achieve its operational and strategic supplier quality objectives. This role partners with suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders to improve supplier performance, manufacturing processes, and product quality by applying quality engineering principles, industry standards, and continuous improvement methodologies. The Supplier Quality Engineer helps ensure suppliers consistently deliver products that meet customer, regulatory, and business requirements while driving operational excellence across the supply base.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with external suppliers, customers, and internal stakeholders including Purchasing, Manufacturing, Engineering, and Supply Chain to improve supplier quality and business outcomes.
  • Support supplier quality planning activities by applying Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) Core Tools, and Cummins quality methodologies.
  • Evaluate and improve supplier manufacturing processes to enhance process capability, product quality, manufacturability, and operational performance.
  • Participate in supplier quality audits and, when qualified, lead low-complexity supplier audits to assess compliance with quality management systems, manufacturing standards, and customer requirements.
  • Investigate supplier quality issues using structured problem-solving methodologies, support root cause analysis, implement corrective and preventive actions, and verify the effectiveness of solutions.
  • Monitor supplier quality performance and analyze quality metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Support supplier development initiatives focused on improving manufacturing capability, reducing defects, enhancing process stability, and achieving Zero Defect performance.
  • Apply AIAG Core Tools including PPAP, DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA, and Source Release to validate supplier manufacturing processes and production readiness.
  • Participate in quality planning and supplier performance improvement projects across assigned suppliers, commodities, or product segments.
  • Support new product introduction activities by ensuring supplier readiness, process validation, and compliance with engineering and customer requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives utilizing Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, statistical analysis, and data-driven decision-making.
  • Ensure supplier compliance with quality standards, regulatory requirements, and Cummins quality expectations.

Competencies

  • Supplier Quality Management
  • Supplier Performance Improvement
  • Supplier Quality Planning and Execution (APQP)
  • Supplier Auditing and Quality Management Systems
  • AIAG Core Tools (PPAP, DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, MSA)
  • Manufacturing Process Design and Validation
  • Product and Process Quality Assurance
  • Supplier Product Reliability
  • Root Cause Analysis and Corrective Action
  • Problem Solving and Continuous Improvement
  • Statistical Analysis and Process Capability
  • Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T)
  • Engineering Drawing and Technical Requirement Interpretation
  • Measurement System Design and Validation
  • Quality Standards (ISO 9001:2015, IATF 16949)
  • Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma Methodologies
  • Communication and Stakeholder Management
  • Customer Focus
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Quality Influence and Decision Making
  • Valuing Differences and Inclusive Collaboration

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical or scientific discipline is required.
  • Professional certifications in Quality, Lean, Six Sigma, or Supplier Quality are preferred.
  • Certification as a Quality Auditor or Lead Auditor is advantageous.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Skills & Experience

  • Relevant experience in Supplier Quality Engineering, Quality Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supplier Development, or a related technical discipline.
  • Working knowledge of supplier quality management principles and manufacturing processes.
  • Experience applying APQP and AIAG Core Tools including PPAP, DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and MSA.
  • Knowledge of quality management systems and standards, including ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949.
  • Experience participating in or conducting supplier quality audits.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience using structured root cause analysis methodologies.

  • Experience using statistical methods to evaluate process performance and support quality improvement initiatives.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and external suppliers.
  • Experience working in a manufacturing, automotive, industrial, or heavy equipment environment is preferred.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and contribute effectively in a fast-paced, global organization.

Preference will be given to candidates experienced in aftermarket services, remanufacturing, transformation projects, and managing supply chain quality across the value chain.

job.title: Supply Chain Planner
job.description:
The Supply Chain Planner is responsible for planning, coordinating, and maintaining daily supply chain operations across one or more functional areas, including materials planning, production planning, inventory management, logistics, demand management, customer service, and order fulfillment. The role ensures a reliable flow of materials and products to meet customer and business requirements while optimizing inventory, improving operational efficiency, and mitigating supply chain risks. The Supply Chain Planner collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to drive continuous improvement initiatives and leverage planning systems to enable effective end-to-end supply chain execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute daily supply chain planning activities across materials, production, inventory, logistics, demand planning, and order fulfillment.
  • Develop and maintain planning system strategies that improve planning signals and overall supply chain performance.
  • Monitor, maintain, and optimize planning parameters within enterprise planning systems.
  • Analyze supply chain data and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to identify performance gaps, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
  • Identify potential supply chain risks, shortages, or disruptions and develop mitigation plans to minimize business impact.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to implement short-term tactical improvements and support long-term planning objectives.
  • Utilize planning systems to drive consistent and accurate planning signals across the end-to-end supply chain.
  • Support Master Supply Scheduling activities by aligning procurement, production, and replenishment plans with manufacturing capacity and customer demand.
  • Manage engineering changes, part supersessions, new part introductions, and obsolescence activities while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.
  • Apply Plan for Every Part (PFEP) principles to optimize material flow, inventory management, warehouse operations, and transportation planning.
  • Leverage planning tools and business intelligence solutions to improve inventory optimization, parts availability, and supply chain decision-making.
  • Participate in cross-functional continuous improvement initiatives to enhance planning processes, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, quality standards, and applicable export control or regulatory requirements.

Skills & Experience

Required Skills

  • Knowledge of end-to-end supply chain planning processes.
  • Understanding of material planning, inventory management, production planning, demand planning, and order fulfillment.
  • Experience using ERP and supply chain planning systems such as SAP , Oracle , or similar enterprise planning platforms.
  • Knowledge of planning parameters, master scheduling, and supply chain optimization techniques.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret data and KPIs.
  • Experience using Microsoft Excel and business intelligence or reporting tools for planning analysis.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work, manage multiple tasks, and perform in a fast-paced environment.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with strong organizational and execution skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with advanced planning solutions such as Kinaxis RapidResponse or other Advanced Planning Systems (APS).
  • Knowledge of Business Intelligence dashboards, Advanced Planning Command Center (APCC), or similar analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with PFEP (Plan for Every Part), Master Production Scheduling (MPS), and engineering change management.
  • Experience in manufacturing, automotive, heavy equipment, or industrial environments.

Experience

job.description:
Job Summary

The Mechanical Design Engineer is responsible for developing innovative and optimized mechanical design solutions for Cummins products by applying engineering principles, design standards, and product development processes. This role supports new product development, engineering change management, and value engineering initiatives through 3D modeling, 2D drawing creation, design validation, and cross-functional collaboration. The engineer contributes to delivering high-quality, reliable, and manufacturable products while supporting continuous product improvement throughout the product lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop 3D models and detailed 2D manufacturing drawings for forged, cast, and sheet metal components using Creo .
  • Create concept models and perform design feasibility studies (DMU) to evaluate packaging, manufacturability, and product functionality.
  • Execute engineering changes (ECR/ECN) and manage product releases using Windchill PLM .
  • Perform basic engineering calculations, tolerance stack-up analysis, and support Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA).
  • Support Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) initiatives to improve product cost, quality, reliability, and manufacturability.
  • Participate in product development activities including Value Package Introduction (VPI), Product Preceding Technology (PPT), and Value Package Change Request (VPCR) programs.
  • Investigate design-related product issues, perform root cause analysis, recommend corrective actions, and document technical findings.
  • Prepare and present design review packages while communicating design intent to cross-functional teams.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, purchasing, simulation, validation, and customer teams to ensure robust product development and successful product launches.
  • Support concept selection, design optimization, product validation, and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Develop and maintain engineering documentation, specifications, engineering bills of materials (EBOM), drawings, and technical reports.
  • Ensure designs comply with Cummins engineering standards, GD&T practices, manufacturing requirements, customer expectations, and applicable industry standards.
  • Coordinate with internal cross-functional teams and customers to resolve technical issues and achieve project milestones.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or another relevant STEM discipline is required.

job.title: On Site Service Technician - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

Acts as the technical specialist and primary customer support contact to independently diagnose and complete repairs to products at a single customer site

Independently performs diagnostics and completes repairs on equipment at customer site Maintains productive customer relations and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs to minimize customer product downtime Coaches on preventative maintenance and/or repairs completed by more experienced technicians and/or customer technicians; may provide work direction to others; may review repair plans, parts and tool lists, etc Manages parts and spares inventory at the work site Escalates unresolved issues to product specialists / Supervisor Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens. Identifies additional sales and service opportunities with customer Completes training in line with skill and business requirements Maintains work area and tools for cleanliness and proper operation Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety &Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer - Senior
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Leads the work for specific projects to create and implement all aspects of a manufacturing processes to ensure safety requirements, manufacturing goals, business goals, and product specifications are met. Leads by applying the knowledge or use of manufacturing principles and practices to improve manufacturing equipment and processes. Impacts the work by utilizing continuous improvement tools, following the Cummins standards, and leading the development of manufacturing standards and working methods. Leads the communications with and influences key external stakeholders, business leaders, and functional members. Works with internal and external resources on specific project assignments. Leads the advanced knowledge of manufacturing principles and practices as they are applied to Cummins. Maintains relationships and coaches key stakeholders.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Drawing Interpretation - Integrates product design and manufacturing equipment engineering drawings to support the design and development of an optimal manufacturing process that meets product design specifications.

Equipment/Capital Procurement - Selects manufacturing equipment which meets the Cummins manufacturing specifications and meets the project or program needs.

Manufacturing Analysis Led Design - Uses digital tools to model and simulate manufacturing processes, equipment and performance to make data driven decisions before changes are made and to drive continuous improvements.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Process Documentation - Produces written manufacturing procedures in proper sequence which are followed correctly by all approved stakeholders to establish continuity in processes and standardization.

Tool and Fixture Design - Selects work-piece-holding devices capable of effectively holding parts and products during a manufacturing process to secure their position to meet functional requirements.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Continuous Process Improvement - Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.

Ergonomics Process and Workplace Design - Designs, creates or adapts processes and workstations by implementing ergonomic controls through the application of the Cummins ergonomic design guidelines to reduce risk and deliver ergonomically designed work.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Workstation Design - Designs operator work stations that are safe, healthy, and ergonomic while accounting for cost, quality, and delivery to contribute to an efficient work environment.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) or related field, or equivalent experience required.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required.

Structured Responsibility Buckets

1. CAPEX PLANNING & EQUIPMENT PROCUREMENT

Primary Responsibilities

  • Capex Budget Planning & Tracking: Develop, manage, and track annual and multi-year capital expenditure plans (AOP capex) for manufacturing equipment and infrastructure projects; monitor cash flow against planned vs. actual spend across quarters.
  • Equipment Sourcing & RFQ Management: Prepare detailed RFQs for production equipment (e.g., VPI plants, HRD machines, presses, ovens, conveyors, winding machines, balancing machines); coordinate site visits for vendors; manage techno-commercial bid evaluations.
  • Vendor Selection & Negotiation: Conduct techno-commercial comparisons across multiple vendors (L1/L2 analysis); negotiate pricing, delivery timelines, payment terms, and warranties; finalize vendor selection with procurement and leadership approval.
  • Purchase Order Execution: Issue POs for equipment, utilities, and construction packages; manage advances, milestone payments, NFA (Non-Financial Approval) submissions, and contractor invoicing aligned to project progress.
  • Equipment Delivery & Installation Oversight: Track equipment receipt against delivery schedules; coordinate dismantling (if refurbishing existing assets), transportation, installation, and commissioning activities; ensure adherence to DAP (Delivered at Place) timelines.
  • Factory & Site Acceptance Testing (FAT/SAT): Plan and execute FAT at vendor facilities and SAT at plant; document test results, snag lists, and ensure resolution of technical issues before handover to operations.
  • Cash Flow & Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly/quarterly capex spend reports; reconcile invoices, track payment milestones, and report variances to finance and plant leadership.

2. CIVIL & INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECT MANAGEMENT

Primary Responsibilities

  • Plant Layout Design & Optimization: Develop manufacturing facility layouts (including assembly lines, storage, utilities); collaborate with architects and civil consultants to finalize layouts in PREDCR format for MIDC submission.
  • Civil Tender Management: Prepare BOQ, technical specifications, and tender documents for civil construction (building footings, PEB structures, flooring, plaster, painting, waterproofing); evaluate civil contractor bids and finalize L1 vendor.
  • Building Expansion & Construction Supervision: Oversee new building construction, plant expansions (Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3), and infrastructure projects (dock, scrap yard, admin blocks); track progress against Gantt charts and milestone completion.
  • Contractor Coordination & Billing: Manage civil, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and interior contractors; verify work completion, approve RA (Running Account) bills, process mobilization advances, and manage retention payments.
  • Utility Installation Projects: Coordinate installation of plant utilities including transformers, DG sets, UPS, compressors, STP/ETP upgrades, hydrant systems, fire suppression, HVAC, earthing, IT infrastructure, and electrical cabling.
  • Excavation, Grading & Site Preparation: Oversee site grading, excavation, foundation work, and legal clearances for land use; coordinate with legal teams on royalty approvals and excavation permits.

3. STATUTORY COMPLIANCE & LEGAL APPROVALS

Primary Responsibilities

  • MIDC Building Plan Approval: Prepare and submit building plans to MIDC (Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation); obtain approvals for plinth-level construction, building completion certificates, and occupancy certificates (OC).
  • Fire NOC & Safety Clearances: Coordinate with fire consultants to obtain provisional Fire NOC, part-final Fire NOC, and final Fire NOC from Maharashtra Industrial Fire Department; ensure hydrant system installation and inspection readiness.
  • Environmental & Pollution Clearances:
  • CTE (Consent to Establish): Apply for and obtain CTE from MPCB before commencing manufacturing operations.
  • CTO (Consent to Operate): Submit CTO applications post-equipment installation (varnishing ovens, chemical processes); track approval timelines (60–90 days); implement mitigation plans for delays.
  • DISH Layout Approval: Obtain layout approval from Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH) for industrial equipment placement, factory layout, and worker safety compliance.
  • Electrical Load Enhancement Approvals: Coordinate with MSEDCL (Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd.) for load enhancement applications, WCR (Work Completion Report) approvals, demand notes, fixed deposits, and transformer charging permissions.
  • BOCW (Building and Other Construction Workers) Registration: Register construction projects under BOCW Act; ensure labor welfare cess payments and statutory contractor registrations are current.
  • Safety Standards & Compliance Documentation: Ensure compliance with NFPA (National Fire Protection Association) standards, LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) procedures, HSE (Health, Safety, Environment) protocols, and maintain MAITRI portal documentation for legal audits.

4. VENDOR & COMMERCIAL MANAGEMENT

Primary Responsibilities

  • Vendor Identification & Capability Assessment: Identify and assess vendors for equipment supply, civil construction, electrical works, HVAC, interior fit-outs, and specialty services; conduct technical and financial due diligence.
  • Techno-Commercial Evaluation: Prepare comparative techno-commercial matrices for initial offers, final offers, and revised bids; validate technical compliance, delivery schedules, warranty terms, and total cost of ownership.
  • Contract Negotiation & Finalization: Negotiate pricing, payment terms (advances, milestones, retentions), scope changes, and penalty clauses; finalize contracts with legal, procurement, and finance sign-offs.
  • Vendor Performance Management: Monitor vendor adherence to delivery timelines, quality standards, and safety compliance; escalate delays, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
  • Commercial Documentation & Payments: Process vendor invoices, verify work completion against milestones, approve RA certificates, manage advance adjustments, and ensure timely payment releases aligned to contract terms.
  • Supplier Development & Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with OEMs and contractors; facilitate supplier visits, audits, and capability showcases; maintain vendor databases and performance scorecards.
  • Legal & HR Compliance for Contractors: Ensure contractors maintain valid licenses (architect, plumber, structural engineer), provide labor welfare documentation, safety PPE, and comply with site safety regulations.

Additional Context & Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engg, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field
  • 12-15 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, plant projects, or capex execution
  • Proven track record in managing multi-crore capex projects (₹10–50 Cr range)
  • Strong knowledge of Indian industrial regulations (MIDC, MPCB, Factory Act, BOCW)
  • Experience with equipment procurement (machining centers, assembly lines, utilities)
  • Familiarity with EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) project lifecycles

Reporting Structure:

  • Reports to: Manufacturing Engineering Leader
  • Collaborates with: Procurement, Finance, Legal, HSE, SCM, Operations, Quality, and Facilities teams

job.title: Supply Chain Coordinator - Level II - OFFC
job.description:
Under general supervision, the Supply Chain Coordinator - Level II supports end-to-end supply chain planning and coordination by analyzing demand and supply data, maintaining planning parameters, and ensuring optimal inventory levels. The role collaborates with cross-functional teams to align supply plans with customer demand, improve material flow, resolve supply chain issues, and support continuous improvement initiatives. The position also contributes to reporting, planning accuracy, and operational excellence while maintaining compliance with quality, safety, and business standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support demand and supply planning activities by analyzing demand trends, inventory levels, and planning data to maintain a stable and efficient supply chain.
  • Monitor inventory performance and planning parameters, including reorder points, safety stock, lead times, and other planning settings, ensuring alignment with Plan for Every Part (PFEP) principles.
  • Perform supply and demand analysis, identify potential risks or shortages, and recommend corrective actions to improve supply chain performance.
  • Execute approved planning parameter and forecast adjustments within planning systems to optimize inventory and customer service levels.
  • Coordinate with planning, procurement, warehouse, transportation, and manufacturing teams to resolve material, transaction, and system-related issues.
  • Monitor shipment movement, transit performance, and logistics activities, escalating exceptions and supporting timely resolution of delivery issues.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, reporting, and records related to supply chain activities, inventory, shipments, and planning processes.
  • Prepare and maintain MIS reports, dashboards, and analytical reports to support operational decision-making and KPI tracking.
  • Support purchase order management, planning attributes, EDI/Kanban processes, and material flow coordination.
  • Participate in simulation and scenario analysis to evaluate the impact of planning changes on supply chain KPIs.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality, safety, material flow, inventory optimization, and process efficiency.
  • Follow Cummins Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) policies, quality standards, and standard operating procedures.
  • Complete required training and actively contribute to personal and professional development.

Skills & Experience

Experience

  • 1–4 years of experience in Supply Chain Planning, Supply Chain Coordination, Logistics, Global Logistics, Materials Planning, Procurement Operations, or related functions.
  • Experience with freight forwarding organizations or import/export logistics is preferred.
  • Exposure to inventory planning, transportation coordination, or warehouse operations is advantageous.

Technical Skills

  • Knowledge of supply chain planning principles, inventory management, and materials planning.
  • Experience with MIS reporting and data analysis.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills with the ability to analyze and interpret operational data.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems such as Oracle or SAP is preferred.
  • Understanding of transportation management systems (TMS) and shipment monitoring is desirable.
  • Familiarity with purchase orders, planning attributes, EDI, and Kanban processes.
  • Knowledge of lead time management, route mapping, transit issue resolution, and logistics coordination.
  • Understanding of inventory optimization, PFEP concepts, and supply chain KPIs.
  • Experience with Power BI or similar reporting and visualization tools is an advantage.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Attention to detail with strong documentation and record management skills.
  • Results-oriented with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across global cross-functional teams.
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and business processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complexity, interpret data, and make informed decisions.
  • Appreciation for diverse perspectives and the ability to work effectively in an inclusive environment.

Qualifications

  • Diploma, Bachelor's degree, or equivalent qualification in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.
  • High school diploma or equivalent may be considered where supported by relevant work experience and applicable regulations.
  • Export control or regulatory compliance requirements may apply for certain positions.

job.title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
job.description:
Job Summary

This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.

Competencies:

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred

  • Experience with the Vector diagnostic tool chain, including CANdelaStudio and DaVinci Configurator/Developer.
  • 6+ years of experience in AUTOSAR BSW integration including BSW and RTE concepts.
  • Proven expertise in AUTOSAR BSW module configuration (COM, DCM, DEM, NvM, etc.) and diagnostic architecture, particularly DCM, DEM, and FIM.
  • Advanced debugging and system analysis skills using Trace32. Understanding of embedded C programming and embedded software development best practices.
  • Experience configuring UDS diagnostic services, including DIDs, RIDs, Diagnostic Sessions, Security Access, Routine Control, ECU Reset, and Communication Contro and SAE J1939-73 diagnostics, including SPNs, DM messages, and DTC mapping
  • Experience configuring and maintaining Diagnostic Events, DTCs, Freeze Frames, Extended Data Records, and OBD-related diagnostic data.
  • Strong understanding of Diagnostics Protocol UDS (ISO 14229), OBD-II, WWH-OBD (ISO 27145), SAE J1939 -73-84, J1979-02, ISO 15765-2.
  • Experience analyzing diagnostic requirements and translating them into DEM/DEXT configurations.
  • Experience with Python or other scripting languages for automation.
  • Familiarity with Git/GitLab.
  • Understanding of FUSA and ASPICE processes.
  • Experience using work items and change management tools to track Change Requests (CRs), defects, and development activities.

Job Summary – JM2

Junior Collection Manager is responsible for managing accounts receivable, ensuring timely collection of outstanding invoices from business clients, performing account reconciliations, and resolving disputes. The role requires strong analytical skills, stakeholder communication, and attention to detail to maintain healthy cash flow and minimize aged receivables

Key Responsibilities

1. Collections

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring timely collection of outstanding balances and reducing delinquency
  • Handle outbound and inbound calls to customers for payment reminders
  • Conduct proactive outreach to customers via phone and email to resolve past-due invoices and secure payment commitments
  • Maintain detailed and accurate collection notes and account histories within the system to support transparency and continuity
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in collections processes
  • Collaborate with field representatives and internal stakeholders to resolve complex customer issues and support strategic initiatives
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of collections policies, procedures, and tools to enhance efficiency and scalability
  • Build strong relationships with customers to improve payment cycles

2. Account Reconciliation (Recon)

  • Perform periodic reconciliation of customer accounts
  • Identify discrepancies between internal records and customer statements
  • Investigate unapplied cash, short payments, or overpayments
  • Work with internal teams (billing, sales, finance) to resolve mismatches
  • Maintain accurate and updated account statements

3. Dispute Management

  • Identify, log, and track customer disputes related to invoices
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders (billing, operations, sales) for resolution
  • Ensure timely closure of disputes to avoid payment delays
  • Maintain dispute logs and provide root cause analysis
  • Work on preventing recurring issues through process improvements

4. Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports on collections, aging, disputes
  • Analyze aging reports to identify trends, highlight at-risk accounts, and provide actionable insights to leadership
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve collection efficiency
  • Perform monthly and quarterly responsibilities such as Allowance Analysis and journal entry, collection escalation for doubtful accounts and monthly reporting package for collections metrics.
  • Track KPIs such as DSO (Days Sales Outstanding), collection rate, dispute resolution TAT

5. Compliance & Process Adherence

  • Ensure adherence to company credit policies and collection procedures
  • Maintain proper documentation for audits and compliance requirements
  • Support internal and external audit queries related to receivables

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelors or Master’s degree in finance or equivalent
  • 7–8 years of experience in Global Collections, including U.S. customer portfolios
  • Experience managing large, high-volume AR portfolios with measurable impact on DSO
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem‑solving capabilities
  • Ability to negotiate and influence outcomes while remaining tactful and respectful.
  • Excellent time management with the ability to independently prioritize and manage portfolios
  • Proficiency in ERP Systems & Collection Tools – SAP, Oracle, High Radius
  • Demonstrated ownership of high-value, complex AR portfolios with material cash impact
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail
  • Willingness and ability to work U.S. Shifts

job.title: Procurement and Supply Continuity Analyst - Team Lead
job.description:
Job Summary

Executes buying strategies in accordance with agreed upon material buying plans, specifically focused on improving supplier overall performance and capacity ahead of demand.

Key Responsibilities

Collaborates with sourcing team for supplier process improvement while maintaining high quality product and/or service delivery. Analyzes Procurement initiatives and processes in support of the delivery of cost effective and high quality goods and services. Prepares and presents recommendations of improvement opportunities and alternative courses of action to senior Procurement leaders. Consistently applies sourcing policies, procedures and processes. Supports linkage between Procurement and manufacturing facilities and will serve as communication conduit between manufacturing and the suppliers. Interacts with suppliers with regard to payment issues and order fulfillment. Collects/validates relevant supplier score card data. Provides delivery/expediting support to the plant/site during supplier issues. Supports management and execution of engineering releases

Negotiations Excellence - Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Procurement Ethics - Avoids supplier engagement that may compromise supplier sourcing, selection, and management processes and seeks counsel to ensure compliance.

Procurement Policies, Procedures, Tools - Understands all of the relevant Procurement policies and procedures and complies with them in daily work; Masters all tools required to conduct procurement work. Knows how to access documents in the appropriate Document Management System (DMS) and/or who to ask if clarification or expansion of the information contained in each document is needed.

Procurement Systems - Recognizes linkage to multiple systems such as purchasing order, payment, engineering release, and quality systems; troubleshoots and corrects issues resulting from data issues; writes ad-hoc reports using tools within each application; identifies and documents work flows and system testing; actively participates in implementation process of new purchasing systems including requirements gathering, design, communication, and training.

Supplier Capacity Management - Leverages Cummins marketing forecast processes and data required from suppliers for capacity planning; negotiates capacity requirements in supplier contracts to deliver the lowest Total Cost of Ownership; links interrelationship between capacity management and product quality; assesses suppliers to ensure that they are capable of meeting Cummins total demand for both production and aftermarket.

Supplier Contract Management - Assesses and enforces contractual terms and conditions; monitors key performance indicators throughout the term of the contract to ensure Cummins reach the intended value of the contract; manages supplier delivery of product/services to Cummins requirements, and tracks the term of the contract (when it expires).

Supplier Performance Management - Leverages functional roles and responsibilities to appropriately manage supplier performance; negotiates defined metrics and supplier management processes to ensure robust management by all functional stakeholders; assimilates cross-functional, cross-site performance data across geographies; ensures suppliers awareness to performance deficiencies and communicates Cummins expectations relative to continuous improvement.

Supply Base Risk Management - Minimize supplier risk to Cummins by proactively mitigating risks through use of risk analysis tools and risk mitigation playbook to manage three key risk: 1) Continuity of Supply, 2) Reputational Risk, and 3) Risk to our Margins of parts. By minimize disruption and services throughout supply chain. Manage and leverage supplier selection and dual sourcing opportunities as a first line of defense against supplier risk.

job.title: Manufacturing Shop Operations Team Manager - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Manager / Manager – Camshaft Manufacturing Operations is responsible for leading day-to-day manufacturing operations for camshafts across QSK, KV, NT, ISX, and other engine platforms at Kothrud Engine Plant. The role focuses on ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production through effective management of machining processes, manpower, equipment performance, automation systems, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The incumbent will lead operations involving cam milling, grinding, induction hardening, straightening, superfinishing, washing, inspection, and packaging processes while ensuring achievement of safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets. The role also requires strong coordination with cross-functional teams including Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Maintenance, Planning, and Supply Chain.

Key Responsibilities

Production & Operations Management

  • Execute and monitor daily production plans to meet customer delivery schedules and operational targets.
  • Ensure smooth operation of manufacturing lines with focus on safety, quality, productivity, and cost optimization.
  • Manage manpower deployment, shift planning, absenteeism control, and resource utilization.
  • Coordinate with planning, quality, maintenance, and manufacturing engineering teams to minimize downtime and production losses.
  • Drive production stability across multiple camshaft variants and engine platforms.
  • Lead and manage daily operations of cylinder head machining lines.
  • Drive high-mix, high-volume production while maintaining flexibility and efficiency.
  • Optimize manpower utilization, line balancing, and throughput.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Supply Chain, Quality, Maintenance, and Engineering to ensure seamless operations.

Equipment & Process Management

  • Oversee end-to-end machining processes including:
  • Oversee operation and performance of critical manufacturing equipment including:
  • Cam Milling Machines
  • Journal & Cam Lobe Grinding Machines
  • Induction Hardening Systems
  • Straightening Machines
  • Superfinishing Machines
  • BHN Testing & Crack Detection Systems
  • Washing, Laser Marking & Final Inspection Machines
  • Ensure adherence to preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for improved equipment reliability.
  • Support machine trials, process validation, commissioning, and production ramp-up activities.
  • Monitor process capability and implement corrective actions to sustain process stability.

Automation & Manufacturing Systems

  • Support implementation and stabilization of automation systems such as robotic handling, gantry systems, and automated inspection systems.
  • Drive CMS (Cummins Manufacturing System) implementation and sustainment across the shop floor.
  • Participate in Industry 4.0 and digital manufacturing initiatives to improve operational visibility and machine utilization.
  • Promote data-based decision-making through operational reviews and KPI tracking.

Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure adherence to Cummins quality standards and customer requirements.
  • Lead root cause analysis and implementation of corrective/preventive actions for process and quality issues.
  • Drive reduction in scrap, rework, and customer complaints.
  • Ensure compliance with HSE, environmental, ergonomic, and statutory requirements.
  • Support audits, VPCR activities, layered process audits, and quality improvement initiatives.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead and develop supervisors, operators, technicians, and support staff.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, discipline, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct training, skill development, performance reviews, and competency enhancement initiatives.
  • Encourage employee involvement in Kaizen, safety, and productivity improvement activities.

Continuous Improvement & Cost Optimization

  • Improve OEE, productivity, cycle time, and process efficiency.
  • Drive Lean Manufacturing initiatives including 5S, TPM, Kaizen, SMED, and waste elimination.
  • Support cost reduction initiatives related to tooling, consumables, utilities, and manpower optimization.
  • Participate in CAPEX execution, operational budgeting, and resource planning activities.

Competencies:

Core Competencies

  • Operations Management
  • Manufacturing Excellence
  • Team Leadership
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Lean Manufacturing & TPM
  • Problem Solving & Root Cause Analysis
  • Decision Making
  • Collaboration & Cross-functional Coordination
  • Health, Safety & Environmental Awareness
  • Technical Expertise in Precision Machining

job.title: Buying Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary

The Strategic Sourcing / Procurement Specialist supports sourcing, localization, supplier management, commercial negotiations, and cost optimization activities for Cummins products. The role is responsible for analyzing supplier quotations, conducting should-cost and benchmarking analysis, developing sourcing strategies, managing supplier agreements, and identifying cost reduction opportunities while ensuring quality, delivery, compliance, and long-term supplier relationships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage supplier agreements, including Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), purchasing agreements, and other commercial contracts.
  • Lead sourcing and localization programs, ensuring timely execution and achievement of project milestones.
  • Develop and evaluate should-cost models for castings, forgings, machined components, sheet metal, brake components, and proprietary parts.
  • Prepare and evaluate tooling cost estimates for new product development and localization projects.
  • Conduct raw material cost trend analysis, RM indexing, price benchmarking, and commercial analysis to support supplier negotiations.
  • Lead commercial negotiations with suppliers and drive successful cost settlements while maintaining strong supplier relationships.
  • Prepare and issue RFQs and evaluate supplier quotations using Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and technical-commercial analysis.
  • Analyze and benchmark BOM costs for complete vehicles, aggregates, and sub-systems to identify cost optimization opportunities.
  • Identify and implement Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VA/VE) and cost reduction initiatives across commodities.
  • Develop sourcing strategies, assess supplier capabilities, and support supplier selection and development.
  • Monitor manufacturing technologies, cost drivers, market trends, and industry developments across commodities such as gears, castings, forgings, sheet metal, brake components, bearings, rubber, and seals.
  • Manage procurement transactions and reporting using ERP systems such as SAP MM, JD Edwards, or Oracle .
  • Ensure compliance with procurement policies, procedures, ethical sourcing practices, and applicable commercial requirements.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams to achieve sourcing and project objectives.
  • Analyze sourcing data and market intelligence to identify process improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
  • Maintain appropriate supplier, legal, and compliance documentation in applicable systems.
  • Support supplier onboarding, vendor management, and procurement process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • A degree or specialization in Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, or related discipline is preferred.
  • Additional qualifications in strategic sourcing, cost engineering, or supply chain management will be an advantage.

Skills & Experience

  • Relevant experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, commodity management, cost engineering, or supplier management .
  • Hands-on experience in should-cost analysis and cost estimation for manufacturing processes such as castings, forgings, machining, sheet metal, brake components, or proprietary parts.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling costs, raw material cost drivers, and supplier economics.
  • Experience in RFQ management, supplier quotation analysis, cost benchmarking, and commercial negotiations.
  • Knowledge of VA/VE, cost reduction, localization, and sourcing strategy development .
  • Working knowledge of SAP MM, JD Edwards, Oracle , or similar ERP/procurement systems.
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills with the ability to use cost and market data for business decisions.
  • Understanding of Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) principles and supplier evaluation methodologies.
  • Strong financial acumen and understanding of procurement cost structures.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, stakeholder management, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with suppliers and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong project/program management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against timelines.
  • High level of integrity and understanding of procurement ethics, policies, and compliance requirements.

Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment and adapt to changing business requirements.

job.title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
job.description:
Job Summary

This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.

Competencies:

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred

  • CDD Development & Integration

job.title: Sourcing Specialist - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

The Strategic Sourcing / Procurement Specialist supports sourcing, localization, supplier management, commercial negotiations, and cost optimization activities for Cummins products. The role is responsible for analyzing supplier quotations, conducting should-cost and benchmarking analysis, developing sourcing strategies, managing supplier agreements, and identifying cost reduction opportunities while ensuring quality, delivery, compliance, and long-term supplier relationships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage supplier agreements, including Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), purchasing agreements, and other commercial contracts.
  • Lead sourcing and localization programs, ensuring timely execution and achievement of project milestones.
  • Develop and evaluate should-cost models for castings, forgings, machined components, sheet metal, brake components, and proprietary parts.
  • Prepare and evaluate tooling cost estimates for new product development and localization projects.
  • Conduct raw material cost trend analysis, RM indexing, price benchmarking, and commercial analysis to support supplier negotiations.
  • Lead commercial negotiations with suppliers and drive successful cost settlements while maintaining strong supplier relationships.
  • Prepare and issue RFQs and evaluate supplier quotations using Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and technical-commercial analysis.
  • Analyze and benchmark BOM costs for complete vehicles, aggregates, and sub-systems to identify cost optimization opportunities.
  • Identify and implement Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VA/VE) and cost reduction initiatives across commodities.
  • Develop sourcing strategies, assess supplier capabilities, and support supplier selection and development.
  • Monitor manufacturing technologies, cost drivers, market trends, and industry developments across commodities such as gears, castings, forgings, sheet metal, brake components, bearings, rubber, and seals.
  • Manage procurement transactions and reporting using ERP systems such as SAP MM, JD Edwards, or Oracle .
  • Ensure compliance with procurement policies, procedures, ethical sourcing practices, and applicable commercial requirements.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Program Management teams to achieve sourcing and project objectives.
  • Analyze sourcing data and market intelligence to identify process improvement and cost reduction opportunities.
  • Maintain appropriate supplier, legal, and compliance documentation in applicable systems.
  • Support supplier onboarding, vendor management, and procurement process improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • A degree or specialization in Supply Chain, Procurement, Manufacturing, or related discipline is preferred.
  • Additional qualifications in strategic sourcing, cost engineering, or supply chain management will be an advantage.

Skills & Experience

  • Relevant experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, commodity management, cost engineering, or supplier management .
  • Hands-on experience in should-cost analysis and cost estimation for manufacturing processes such as castings, forgings, machining, sheet metal, brake components, or proprietary parts.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling costs, raw material cost drivers, and supplier economics.
  • Experience in RFQ management, supplier quotation analysis, cost benchmarking, and commercial negotiations.
  • Knowledge of VA/VE, cost reduction, localization, and sourcing strategy development .
  • Working knowledge of SAP MM, JD Edwards, Oracle , or similar ERP/procurement systems.
  • Strong analytical and data interpretation skills with the ability to use cost and market data for business decisions.
  • Understanding of Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) principles and supplier evaluation methodologies.
  • Strong financial acumen and understanding of procurement cost structures.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication, stakeholder management, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to build effective relationships with suppliers and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong project/program management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver against timelines.
  • High level of integrity and understanding of procurement ethics, policies, and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to work effectively in a global, cross-functional environment and adapt to changing business requirements.

job.title: Controls Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

The Controls Engineer is responsible for supporting and improving manufacturing automation systems to achieve safety, quality, delivery, and cost objectives. This role provides electrical maintenance and automation support through PLC programming, robotics integration, control system development, troubleshooting, commissioning, and process optimization. Working closely with cross-functional teams, the Controls Engineer ensures reliable and efficient operation of production equipment, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and maintains compliance with safety, quality, and operational standards. The position requires the ability to work independently with limited supervision and flexibility to support shift-based manufacturing operations as needed.

Key Responsibilities

Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with Cummins Health, Safety, Environmental (HSE), quality, and manufacturing standards.
  • Enforce Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), Permit to Work systems, machine safety requirements, PPE compliance, and safety PLC standards.
  • Conduct risk assessments, safety audits, and machine safety validations, including interlocks, emergency circuits, and guarding systems.
  • Promote 5S, housekeeping, and continuous improvement practices to maintain a safe and efficient work environment.

Controls Engineering & Automation

  • Develop, modify, troubleshoot, and optimize PLC programs, robot logic, HMI/SCADA applications, and automation control systems.
  • Design and implement end-to-end automation solutions, including control philosophy, sequence logic, and safety architecture for manufacturing equipment and production lines.
  • Program, configure, and support Siemens S7-1500 PLCs, ABB, FANUC, and Yaskawa robotic systems.
  • Integrate robots, vision systems, conveyors, manipulators, servo drives, VFDs, safety PLCs, sensors, and other automation devices.
  • Configure and maintain industrial communication networks such as Profinet, Ethernet/IP, Modbus.
  • Develop standardized control architectures, reusable software modules, and automation best practices.
  • Support Industry 4.0, machine connectivity, predictive maintenance, cybersecurity, and digital manufacturing initiatives.

Equipment Reliability & Manufacturing Support

  • Lead installation, commissioning, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and production ramp-up activities.
  • Troubleshoot complex automation, electrical, robotics, hydraulic, and pneumatic system issues to minimize downtime and improve equipment reliability.
  • Drive preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs using CMMS systems such as MAXIMO.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis using structured methodologies (5 Why, Fishbone, FTA) and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Monitor and improve equipment performance through OEE, MTBF, MTTR, cycle time, throughput, and reliability improvements.
  • Coordinate maintenance and automation activities with production, quality, suppliers, and OEMs to support manufacturing objectives.

Continuous Improvement & Project Management

  • Identify and implement process optimization opportunities to improve productivity, quality, safety, and cost performance.
  • Support capital projects through technical evaluation, cost estimation, appropriation requests, equipment specifications, and project execution.
  • Lead cost reduction initiatives focused on maintenance efficiency, energy conservation, spare optimization, and waste elimination.
  • Prepare technical documentation, engineering reports, control narratives, project plans, and operating procedures.

Team Leadership & Technical Development

  • Provide technical leadership and hands-on support to technicians, trainees, and junior engineers across shifts.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop team members to strengthen controls, automation, and troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Lead shift meetings and maintenance reviews to communicate safety requirements, production priorities, and operational targets.
  • Manage contractors and service providers to ensure work is completed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with company standards.

Planning & Resource Management

  • Plan and manage critical spare parts inventory to support automation system reliability and business continuity.
  • Track maintenance and automation performance metrics, ensuring achievement of uptime, reliability, quality, and cost objectives.
  • Support resource planning and budgeting activities while driving continuous improvement in maintenance and automation performance
  • Work in rotational shifts as per operational and business requirements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Automation, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, STEM-related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Intermediate level of relevant automation, controls engineering, or manufacturing experience. Equivalent engineering qualification with relevant Industry experience may also be considered.
