job.title: Product Design Technician - Level I - OFFC
job.description:
Job Summary

As part of a formal apprenticeship or regional training program, the Product Design Technician – Level I supports Cummins product development by creating and maintaining accurate 3D CAD models and detailed engineering drawings in accordance with Cummins standards. The role develops foundational capabilities in mechanical design, CAD modeling, Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T), configuration management, and engineering standards while working under the guidance of experienced technicians and engineers.

The position independently performs assigned tasks during work rotations, supports cross-functional engineering activities, and contributes to Right First Time (RFT) and On-Time Delivery (OTD) objectives while progressing toward applicable technician certification.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create, modify, and maintain 3D CAD models and 2D engineering drawings for product components and assemblies using Creo or equivalent CAD tools.
  • Support the development and maintenance of product specifications in accordance with Cummins CAD practices, procedures, and applicable engineering standards.
  • Apply foundational knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) to support manufacturability, inspection, interchangeability, and functional fit.
  • Develop and maintain mechanical models for components and assemblies, including sheet metal, castings, welded structures, and other product configurations as applicable.
  • Perform self-checks using established CAD checklists to verify model and drawing accuracy, completeness, and compliance before release.
  • Create and maintain engineering bills of materials and detailed product specifications as required.
  • Use CAD data management and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) systems to support configuration control, version management, release status, and product data security.
  • Support product configuration and change management activities throughout the product lifecycle, including engineering work requests and applicable change processes.
  • Apply company, industry, national, and international engineering standards to product models and drawings.
  • Collaborate with engineers, designers, technicians, manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to clarify requirements and resolve design-related issues.
  • Support Drawing Quality Reviews and participate in activities that improve product and documentation quality.
  • Contribute to RFT and OTD objectives by delivering accurate, error-free work within agreed timelines.
  • Participate in classroom training, on-the-job learning, work rotations, and apprenticeship activities while progressing toward required certification.
  • Support continuous improvement and other engineering activities as assigned.

Competency

Technical & Functional Competencies

  • Mechanical Design Modeling and Analysis: Develops CAD models in accordance with established standards and supports product-level design and engineering analysis requirements.
  • Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems: Applies fundamental mechanical design knowledge to develop practical and robust design concepts considering product requirements and operating environments.
  • Mechanical Design Specification: Creates and maintains accurate solid models, engineering bills of materials, and detailed drawings that communicate design intent for manufacturing and inspection.
  • Product Configuration and Change Management: Supports the release, tracking, control, and communication of product changes while maintaining the integrity of product data.
  • CAD & PLM Data Management: Uses CAD and PLM systems effectively to maintain product data, revisions, configuration, and security.
  • GD&T and Engineering Standards: Applies basic GD&T principles and relevant engineering standards to support product quality and manufacturability.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Instills Trust: Demonstrates honesty, integrity, accountability, and reliability.
  • Manages Complexity: Organizes and works effectively with technical information, requirements, and multiple priorities.
  • Self-Development: Actively develops technical knowledge and skills through training, feedback, and hands-on experience.
  • Values Differences: Works effectively with people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma, certificate of completion of secondary education, or equivalent experience in a relevant STEM field.

  • Registration in a regionally certified apprenticeship or learning/training program is required, where applicable.
  • Additional technical or vocational education in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design, CAD, Drafting, or a related discipline is preferred.

Skills

  • Basic understanding of mechanical design and engineering drawing principles.

  • Exposure to Creo or other industry-standard CAD software is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of GD&T and engineering drawing standards.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical requirements.
  • Familiarity with CAD data management, PLM, configuration control, and revision management concepts.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate engineering documentation.

job.title: Mechanical Maintenance - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

The Mechanical Maintenance Technician is responsible for supporting the installation, assembly, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of manufacturing equipment, automated machinery, robotic systems, and industrial automation. The role focuses on maximizing equipment availability, reliability, and productivity by performing preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance while ensuring compliance with Cummins' Health, Safety, Environmental (HSE), and quality standards. The technician will also support machine validation, precision measurement, pneumatic systems, robotics, and continuous improvement initiatives to drive operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance on manufacturing equipment to maximize machine uptime and reliability.
  • Assemble, install, align, level, and commission manufacturing equipment, machinery, and automation systems.
  • Diagnose and repair mechanical issues involving bearings, gearboxes, shafts, ball screws, linear guides, drive systems, and other machine components.
  • Interpret mechanical drawings, assembly drawings, pneumatic schematics, machine layouts, and technical documentation.
  • Read, assemble, install, troubleshoot, and optimize pneumatic systems including cylinders, valves, FRLs, regulators, sensors, tubing, and air preparation systems.
  • Support installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, calibration, teaching, and recovery of industrial robots and collaborative robots (Cobots).
  • Assist in End-of-Arm Tooling (EOAT) installation, setup, and optimization for robotic applications.
  • Perform precision measurement activities including runout, flatness, parallelism, concentricity, alignment, repeatability, and machine accuracy verification using precision measuring instruments.
  • Analyze machine performance and measurement data to identify improvement opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support machine upgrades, modifications, retrofits, and automation improvement projects.
  • Conduct root cause analysis for recurring equipment failures and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, equipment history, inspection reports, and technical documentation.
  • Coordinate maintenance activities to minimize production downtime and support manufacturing requirements.
  • Participate in TPM, Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve equipment reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Work closely with manufacturing, engineering, quality, automation, and maintenance teams to improve machine performance and process capability.
  • Follow all Health, Safety, Environmental (HSE), quality, and regulatory requirements while maintaining a safe and organized work environment.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, Certificate of Secondary Education, ITI, Diploma, or equivalent technical qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Maintenance, or a related discipline.
  • Additional technical certifications in mechanical maintenance, robotics, pneumatics, or automation are an advantage.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export control or sanctions regulations.

Key Competencies

  • Mechanical Maintenance & Equipment Reliability
  • Machine Assembly & Installation
  • Preventive & Predictive Maintenance
  • Pneumatic System Troubleshooting
  • Industrial Robotics & Cobots
  • Machine Alignment & Precision Measurement
  • Root Cause Analysis & Problem Solving
  • Manufacturing Knowledge
  • Continuous Improvement (Lean, TPM, 5S)
  • Safety & Environmental Compliance
  • Quality & Process Documentation
  • Decision Making
  • Collaboration & Cross-functional Teamwork
  • Communication Skills
  • Customer Focus
  • Attention to Detail
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Adaptability & Continuous Learning

Skills & Experience

Required Skills

  • Experience in mechanical maintenance within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • Machine assembly and installation
  • Preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance
  • Bearings, gearboxes, shafts, ball screws, and linear motion systems
  • Machine alignment and leveling
  • Ability to read and interpret:
  • Mechanical drawings

job.title: Product Systems Validation Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute component, subsystem, and system-level verification and validation plans based on technical requirements and stakeholder inputs.
  • Support creation and maintenance of Design Verification Plan & Report (DVP&R) documentation and ensure adequate test coverage.
  • Perform requirement analysis and derive test cases using techniques such as Boundary Value Analysis (BVA), Equivalence Class (EC) testing, and risk-based methodologies.
  • Conduct verification and validation activities using HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop), SIL (Software-in-the-Loop), and MIL (Model-in-the-Loop) environments.
  • Execute and support closed-loop testing activities to validate product functionality and system performance.
  • Analyze test results, identify failures, investigate root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Own resolution of moderately complex product, component, or system issues with guidance from senior engineers when required.
  • Evaluate analytical, simulation, and physical test data to validate product capability against requirements.
  • Utilize systems engineering principles to manage interfaces, requirements traceability, integration activities, and product risk.
  • Support product failure mode avoidance activities, including identification of potential failure modes and mitigation strategies.
  • Apply statistical methods and data-driven approaches to support engineering decisions and improve product quality.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, test reports, issue logs, and validation records.
  • Support change request (CR) management and verification of engineering changes.
  • Use engineering tools and processes including Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, DVP&R, Integrity, Power BI, and other validation systems.
  • Create and maintain test automation scripts using Python, CAPL, NI TestStand, ECU-Test, or similar tools.
  • Work with communication protocols such as CAN, J1939, UDS, and related diagnostics systems.
  • Coordinate testing activities with technicians, interns, or other supporting resources as needed.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for test methodologies, tools, and validation processes.
  • Collaborate effectively with global and cross-functional teams to meet project timelines, quality targets, and business objectives.

We are looking for someone with:

job.title: Product Functional Test Maintenance Tech - Level II - SHOP
job.description:
Job Summary

Supports laboratory and engine test cell operations through the maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, installation, and setup of facility mechanical systems, test equipment, and associated infrastructure. The role ensures safe, reliable, and effective operation of laboratory and engine test cell facilities while supporting testing activities, equipment readiness, data integrity, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The position works closely with engineering, testing, maintenance, and cross-functional teams to troubleshoot equipment and instrumentation issues, execute preventive and predictive maintenance, support engine test cell setups, and ensure compliance with applicable safety, quality, and environmental requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and installation of facility mechanical systems, including HVAC systems, heating and refrigeration equipment, air-conditioning and building ventilation systems, air compressors, heat exchangers, hydraulic equipment, and other laboratory infrastructure.
  • Install, maintain, and troubleshoot machine tools, test stands, dynamometer systems, and associated laboratory equipment.
  • Support engine test cell installation, rigging, instrumentation setup, and test cycle preparation in accordance with approved test plans, procedures, and safety requirements.
  • Perform test cell instrumentation setup, including measurement instruments, data logging systems, sensors, and associated equipment required for engine testing.
  • Support ECM test cell harness wiring, engine ECM software interfaces, and troubleshooting of ECM fault codes and sensor-related issues.
  • Configure and update test cell specifications and setup files in accordance with approved test plans and engine installation requirements.
  • Support engine test cell software platforms and tools such as PUMA, Cyflex, and Indicom, as applicable.
  • Support ECM-related activities using tools such as Calterm, ASAM, and License Configuration Tool, as applicable.
  • Troubleshoot breakdowns and performance issues involving test cell instruments and equipment such as smoke meters, flow meters, fuel conditioning systems, and other test infrastructure.
  • Perform preventive and predictive maintenance based on equipment condition, maintenance records, and operating data to improve equipment reliability and availability.
  • Demonstrate an understanding of test equipment functionality and its impact on the accuracy and validity of test results.
  • Prepare and configure test equipment and test setups in accordance with established test procedures, engineering standards, and laboratory requirements.
  • Support measurement and data acquisition activities while ensuring equipment readiness and data integrity following engine installation.
  • Perform mechanical rigging, system wiring, and installation activities required to prepare engines and test systems for testing.
  • Participate in engine test preparation, troubleshooting, breakdown recovery, and restoration of test equipment to operational condition.
  • Support Right First Time (RFT) practices and ensure engine and test cell setup activities meet defined quality requirements.
  • Participate in Kaizen, continuous improvement, and other operational excellence initiatives to improve laboratory and test cell reliability, safety, productivity, and efficiency.
  • Coordinate maintenance and facility programs, including planning, scheduling, ordering, tracking, and completion of required activities.
  • Maintain appropriate maintenance, test setup, and equipment documentation and records.
  • Participate in quality procedures, self-audits, corrective actions, and improvement projects.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) policies, procedures, standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with engineering, laboratory, maintenance, and other functional teams to resolve technical and operational issues.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as required to support laboratory and test cell operations.

Functional Competencies

Facility Mechanical Systems

  • Working knowledge of HVAC, refrigeration, ventilation, compressors, heat exchangers, hydraulic systems, and other facility mechanical equipment.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, repair, install, and maintain laboratory and facility equipment.

Test Cell Equipment and Systems

  • Understanding of engine test cell infrastructure, test stands, dynamometers, rigging, and associated mechanical systems.
  • Ability to interpret test requirements and prepare equipment and test setups accordingly.

Test Setup and Configuration

  • Ability to interpret test plans and determine appropriate equipment, instrumentation, installation requirements, and test configurations.
  • Ability to configure and prepare test systems while considering safety, environmental, and technical requirements.

Instrumentation and Data Acquisition

  • Working knowledge of measurement instruments, sensors, instrumentation systems, and data logging equipment.
  • Ability to verify equipment readiness and support reliable data acquisition and test results.

ECM and Controls Support

  • Knowledge of engine ECMs, test cell harness wiring, sensors, and control systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot ECM fault codes and sensor-related issues.
  • Familiarity with ECM software and diagnostic tools such as Calterm, ASAM, and License Configuration Tool is advantageous.

Preventive and Predictive Maintenance

  • Interprets maintenance records and equipment data to execute preventive and predictive maintenance activities.
  • Identifies potential equipment failures and takes appropriate action to improve reliability and minimize downtime.

Problem Solving

  • Uses structured troubleshooting and problem-solving techniques to identify root causes and implement effective corrective actions.
  • Ability to troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, and test equipment issues.

Health and Safety

  • Demonstrates proactive safety behaviors and follows established HSE procedures while working with laboratory equipment, test cells, machinery, mechanical systems, and instrumentation.

Behavioral Competencies

  • Action Oriented – Takes initiative and responds with urgency to maintenance, equipment, and operational requirements.
  • Communicates Effectively – Communicates technical information clearly with engineers, technicians, maintenance teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Decision Quality – Makes timely and appropriate decisions when troubleshooting equipment and resolving operational issues.
  • Drives Results – Delivers reliable maintenance and test cell support while meeting agreed timelines and quality requirements.
  • Manages Complexity – Effectively handles multiple technical issues and priorities in a laboratory/test cell environment.
  • Collaborates – Works effectively with cross-functional teams to achieve shared objectives.
  • Values Differences – Respects diverse perspectives and contributes to an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  • Health and Safety Fundamentals – Champions safe working practices and proactively identifies and addresses potential hazards.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset – Actively contributes to Kaizen, process improvements, and initiatives that improve equipment reliability and operational effectiveness.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma, certificate of completion of secondary education, or equivalent experience in an appropriate STEM/technical field is required.
  • Diploma, ITI, technical certification, or a two-year associate-level qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Automotive, or a related technical field is preferred.
  • Relevant technical certifications in maintenance, HVAC, instrumentation, or industrial systems will be an advantage.
  • Must be willing and able to work in an engine laboratory/test cell environment and comply with applicable safety requirements.
  • Any locally required licenses or certifications for operating relevant equipment may be required.

Skills and Experience Needed

  • Some relevant experience in facility maintenance, industrial maintenance, laboratory operations, engine testing, test cell support, or a related technical field.
  • Working knowledge of mechanical maintenance, troubleshooting, installation, and repair.
  • Experience with engine test cell equipment, test stands, dynamometers, or laboratory systems is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of engine test cell instrumentation systems and test parameter setup.
  • Experience with engine rigging and instrumentation installation is preferred.
  • Knowledge of mechanical rigging, system wiring, and test cycle preparation.
  • Experience using measurement instruments and data acquisition/data logging systems.
  • Knowledge of ECM test cell harness wiring, sensors, and engine control systems.
  • Familiarity with PUMA, Cyflex, or Indicom test cell software platforms is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with Calterm, ASAM, or License Configuration Tool for ECM-related activities is an advantage.
  • Ability to troubleshoot ECM fault codes, sensors, test instruments, and mechanical/electrical systems.
  • Experience maintaining and troubleshooting test cell equipment such as smoke meters, flow meters, fuel conditioning systems, and related instrumentation is preferred.
  • Ability to understand and interpret test plans and translate requirements into practical test cell setups.
  • Ability to maintain equipment and test systems while ensuring data integrity and Right First Time (RFT) execution.
  • Strong hands-on troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good documentation and reporting skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision while effectively collaborating with engineering and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong communication, multitasking, planning, and time-management skills.
  • Exposure to Kaizen, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, or similar operational excellence initiatives is preferred.

Job Summary

The Electronic Systems Engineer – Hardware is responsible for the design, development, validation, and continuous improvement of electronic hardware solutions that support Cummins products across a wide range of customer applications. The role contributes to the development of electronic sensors, actuators, control units, wiring harnesses, control systems, and associated analog and digital circuits to ensure reliable product performance, quality, and compliance with customer and business requirements. Working closely with cross-functional engineering teams, the incumbent supports product development, problem resolution, system integration, and continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring adherence to Cummins engineering standards and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, validate, and integrate electronic hardware components including sensors, actuators, electronic control modules (ECMs), control units, wiring harnesses, and associated analog and digital circuits.
  • Investigate electronic hardware issues, perform root cause analysis, recommend corrective actions, and support timely problem resolution.
  • Apply engineering principles, design methodologies, and analytical tools to develop reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality hardware solutions.
  • Support hardware development activities including requirements analysis, circuit simulation, worst-case analysis, DFMEA/PFMEA, Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), schematic capture, and design verification.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including software, systems, validation, manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and product engineering to ensure successful product integration.
  • Support verification and validation activities by reviewing test results, analyzing failures, and ensuring compliance with technical requirements and engineering standards.
  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation including design specifications, validation reports, engineering changes, and problem resolution records.
  • Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and product development activities throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Support continuous improvement of hardware development processes, engineering tools, and technical standards.
  • Coordinate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve technical issues and support component development activities.
  • Utilize engineering software and simulation tools to evaluate hardware designs and improve product performance and reliability.
  • Contribute to project planning, execution, and delivery while meeting quality, cost, and schedule objectives.
  • Support knowledge sharing, mentoring, and technical guidance within the engineering team.
  • Ensure compliance with Cummins engineering processes, safety standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Competencies

Technical Competencies

  • Electronic Hardware Design and Development
  • Analog and Digital Circuit Design
  • Requirements Analysis and System Integration
  • Design Verification and Validation
  • Product Problem Solving and Root Cause Analysis
  • DFMEA, PFMEA and Fault Tree Analysis (FTA)

  • Technical Documentation and Engineering Standards

job.title: Electronic Systems Technical Specialist - Software
job.description:
Job Summary

This applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and improves the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and negotiates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Responsible for review of less-experienced developers/testers’ work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.

Competencies:

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred

RESPOSIBILITIES:

  • Develop embedded fuel systems controls software per requirements
  • Follow all Cummins internal software processes while developing embedded fuel system controls software
  • Modify existing software implementation to support the software change
  • Verify and document evidence of the software change functioning correctly
  • Solve the software related problems by determining the root cause
  • Generate a solution to fix the problem identified and verify on test bench
  • Highlight software integration changes to peers in a timely manner
  • Support global software team to deliver software for global engine programs
  • Align with global software development functional excellence practices
  • The work will include development in both ‘C’ code as well as in Simulink models.Other tools used for development will include the use of a Cummins proprietary data dictionary and build tool, configuration management tools as well as test tools (oscilloscopes, frequency generators, debuggers, etc.…)

SKILLS

  • FUNCTIONAL/TECHNICAL:
  • MTech or BTech Electrical Engineering or computer science with embedded controls development focus preferred
  • 7 to 9 years industry experience or equivalent academic experience in development of automotive controls software
  • Experience with MATLAB and Simulink for model-based development.
  • Experience with programming in C or other imperative and procedural languages.
  • Understanding of diesel engines, mechanical systems, especially fuel systems and air handling systems is a plus
  • Good communication and presentation skills required for documenting software design, test results and observations
  • Experience or familiarity with microprocessor based embedded control system development
  • Understanding of AUTOSAR

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for general accounting work required to maintain the department’s general ledger. Performs financial analysis of the department’s chart of accounts and financial statements by identifying and analyzing variances.

Key Responsibilities

Analyzes, records and reports accounting transactions in a timely manner. Prepares general ledger entries and account reconciliations. Responds to inquiries received from management, internal and external auditors, Sarbanes-Oxley audit group and others regarding financial results, special reporting requests, etc. Protects organization's value by keeping information confidential.

Competencies:

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Financial Analysis - Interprets financial data by analyzing trends, variances, opportunities and risks to provide insight to stakeholders regarding financial impact to drive business improvement; evaluates financial results against targets to communicate conclusions to all stakeholders; ensures integrity of financial data by investigating variances and determining corrective actions to resolve identified issues.

Financial Internal Controls - Leverages internal control framework by assessing internal controls and developing remediation plans to mitigate financial reporting risks and respond to changing business needs.

Financial Regulations Acumen - Evaluates applicable regulations for the financial area of focus, such as tax, banking, pension, local accounting to ensure underlying transactions are recorded in compliance with applicable regulations; explains key requirements and purpose of regulations and implications to the business to inform and educate relevant stakeholders.

Designs and provide guidance on building reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Designs and implements physical data models to define the database structure. Optimizing database performance through efficient indexing and table relationships. Participates in optimizing, testing, and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Uses innovative and modern tools, techniques and architectures to partially or completely automate the most-common, repeatable and tedious data preparation and integration tasks in order to minimize manual and error-prone processes and improve productivity. job.title: Customer Order Management Representative - Level II - OFFC
job.description:
The Customer Order Management Representative – Level II acts as the single point of contact for assigned customer accounts and manages the end-to-end customer order lifecycle. The role is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely order processing, effective resolution of customer inquiries and exceptions, and coordination with customers, distribution centers, manufacturing locations, and cross-functional teams to ensure orders are fulfilled and shipped within agreed timelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage assigned customer accounts throughout the complete order lifecycle, including new customer setup, order entry and modification, order fulfilment, escalations, and, where applicable, logistics management.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers, parts distribution centers, manufacturing plants, and cross-functional teams to coordinate and fulfil customer orders.
  • Ensure customer orders are processed accurately and shipped within agreed deadlines and service-level requirements.
  • Provide accurate order-related documentation and maintain proactive and timely communication with customers throughout the order lifecycle.
  • Take ownership of complex customer inquiries and resolve them through detailed research and application of Cummins processes, systems, policies, and practices.
  • Provide timely and informative responses to customers in accordance with established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Identify and escalate complex issues to the appropriate level of customer support, ensuring complete and accurate documentation throughout the escalation process.
  • Maintain accurate records of internal and external customer interactions in the appropriate databases and systems.
  • Ensure customers comply with applicable export policies and that required export and shipping documentation is completed in accordance with relevant legislation and requirements.
  • Act as a liaison between customers and aftermarket and/or manufacturing locations to support resolution of quality-related issues.
  • Submit Material Non-Conformance and Process Non-Conformance claims through the applicable Quality Management System.
  • Apply knowledge of Quality Management Systems to support effective resolution of customer and quality issues.
  • Support the Supervisor in hosting customer visits at the local facility, as required.
  • Prepare and distribute standard and customized reports for internal and external customers.
  • Understand and apply Customer Order Management policies, procedures, and performance metrics.
  • Support Customer Order Management departmental goals and initiatives aimed at developing a more proactive and customer-focused support organization.
  • Participate in and/or lead process improvement projects to enhance order management processes and customer support.

Skills and Experience

  • Some relevant work experience with intermediate-level knowledge gained through training and/or on-the-job experience in Customer Order Management, Account Management, Supply Chain, or a related field .
  • Understanding of the end-to-end customer order lifecycle , including customer setup, order entry, order modification, exception identification and resolution, fulfilment, and shipment.
  • Knowledge of order processing systems and the ability to accurately process customer orders, order modifications, and customer inquiries.
  • Ability to research and resolve complex customer inquiries and order-related issues.
  • Knowledge of Customer Order Management policies, procedures, and metrics.
  • Knowledge of Quality Management Systems and ability to support quality-related customer issues.
  • Understanding of export policies and required export/shipping documentation.
  • Strong customer service and relationship management skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with different audiences.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively with customers and cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, resolve issues, and deliver results within agreed timelines.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
  • Ability to identify and contribute to process improvement opportunities.
  • Willingness to learn and develop through formal and informal development opportunities.
  • Ability to work effectively with diverse perspectives and cultures.

Key Competencies

  • Collaborates: Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to achieve shared objectives.

job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a talented Diesel Workshop Supervisor to join our high performing team in Carole Park, QLD.

You will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Independently perform diagnostics and complete complex repairs

  • Identify additional sales and service opportunities with customer
  • Maintain work area and tools for cleanliness and proper operation
  • Adheres to and ensures adherence of technicians to all relevant Health, Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to their supervisor

Additional Information:

  • Full Time / 38 hours per week
  • Rotational Shifts (day/afternoon)
  • Overtime as required – Penalty rates paid for all work above 38 hours
  • All your Safety equipment / PPE and uniforms are provided and laundered
  • Domestic Relocation may be offered for the right candidate
  • Local Valid Drivers License (Preferred)

Experience

  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Cert III)
  • Advanced level of workshop or field service experience required
  • Advanced level knowledge of and experience with engine products
  • HR License preferred
  • Experience providing technical advice and coaching to more junior technicians (preferred)

Critical Competencies:

  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  • Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  • Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.
  • Electrical Knowledge - Demonstrates knowledge of Cummins and industry standards on working with low and/or high voltage by complying with all safe work procedures including Personal Protective Equipment to create a safe work environment; applies basic electrical theories and electronics components knowledge using appropriate tools and procedures to diagnose and repair products safely and efficiently.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.
  • Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.
  • Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.
  • Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
The Data Engineer supports, develops, and maintains data and analytics platforms that enable reliable, scalable, and efficient access to data. This role partners with Business and IT teams to understand requirements and leverage modern data engineering technologies to deliver high-quality data solutions at scale. The Data Engineer will design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and data storage solutions, ensure data quality and integrity, and contribute to data governance, analytics, and cloud-based data platforms. The role works within Agile delivery environments and applies modern engineering practices to continuously improve data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain reliable, scalable, and efficient ETL/ELT data pipelines using technologies such as Azure Databricks, PySpark, Python/Scala, and SQL .
  • Design and implement data ingestion and transformation solutions for a variety of data sources, including relational, event-based, and unstructured data.
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Lake and Lakehouse solutions and optimize data processing and storage performance.
  • Develop physical data models and implement data storage architectures in accordance with established design and engineering guidelines.
  • Implement data quality checks, monitoring, alerting, and troubleshooting mechanisms to identify and resolve data quality and data integrity issues.
  • Analyze complex data elements, data flows, dependencies, and relationships to contribute to conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
  • Develop and operate large-scale data storage and processing solutions using distributed and cloud-based technologies.
  • Work with Azure services such as Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS), Event Hubs, and Azure Functions to support scalable data solutions.
  • Implement and support data governance practices, including metadata management, data access, retention, and availability.
  • Participate in testing, validation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of data pipelines and solutions.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, data scientists, and IT teams to understand requirements and deliver analytics and data solutions.
  • Apply Agile development practices, including Scrum, Kanban, DevOps, and continuous improvement , to deliver data-driven solutions.
  • Document technical solutions, processes, data flows, and system dependencies to support knowledge sharing and effective solution maintenance.
  • Apply appropriate engineering, security, governance, and compliance practices throughout the data development lifecycle.

Skills and Experience

  • Strong programming skills in Python/PySpark or Scala , with the ability to develop, test, and maintain production-quality code.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and experience working with data extraction, transformation, and loading processes.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and cloud-based data engineering solutions.
  • Experience with Azure data services, including ADLS, Event Hub, and Azure Functions .
  • Good understanding of Data Lake, Delta Lake, Lakehouse, ETL/ELT, data modeling, and distributed data processing concepts.
  • Exposure to or knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Spark, MapReduce, Hive, HBase, Kafka , or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience or exposure to clustered compute and cloud-based implementations.
  • Familiarity with designing solutions that support large-scale data movement and processing in cloud environments.
  • Understanding of data quality, data integrity, metadata, governance, and data management principles.
  • Exposure to analytical solutions, IoT technologies, and data-driven applications is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with Agile software development, DevOps, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify root causes and implement robust solutions.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to understand stakeholder needs and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Ability to document solutions clearly and communicate technical information to different audiences.
  • Strong focus on quality, solution validation, testing, security, governance, and continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in diverse teams and recognize the value of different perspectives.

Core Competencies

  • System Requirements Engineering
  • Data Extraction and ETL/ELT
  • Programming and Data Engineering
  • Data Quality and Data Governance
  • Solution Validation and Testing
  • Problem Solving and Decision Quality
  • Quality Assurance and Metrics
  • Solution Documentation
  • Customer Focus
  • Collaboration and Effective Communication
  • Continuous Improvement

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or another relevant technical discipline , or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 2–4 years of relevant Data Engineering experience preferred.
  • Relevant experience through internships, co-op programs, temporary student employment, academic projects, or extracurricular technical activities may be considered for early-career candidates.
  • Relevant certifications such as Databricks or Azure certifications are an advantage.
  • This position may require licensing or compliance with applicable export control or sanctions regulations.

job.title: Production Associate - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

Operates machines and production equipment safely and efficiently in a manufacturing environment to meet quality, productivity, delivery, and safety requirements. Works with limited guidance while following standard operating procedures, maintaining equipment, supporting continuous improvement initiatives, and contributing to a collaborative team environment.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Follow all Cummins Health, Safety, and Environmental policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Immediately stop work and report unsafe conditions, major injury hazards, incidents, illnesses, and near misses.
  • Use required personal protective equipment (PPE) and promote a culture of safety.
  • Identify and correct hazards within area of responsibility and capability.
  • Support environmental sustainability initiatives by minimizing the environmental impact of work activities.
  • Participate in required HSE training programs and safety improvement initiatives.
  • Demonstrate accountability for personal safety and the safety of team members.

Quality

  • Adhere to standard work instructions, process documentation, and quality procedures.
  • Apply quality tools and methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC), Poka-Yoke, and visual management standards.
  • Perform quality inspections and verify products meet specifications and customer requirements.
  • Identify, segregate, and control non-conforming materials.
  • Raise quality concerns promptly to minimize product defects, rework, scrap, and customer impact.
  • Support continuous improvement efforts to enhance product quality and process effectiveness.

Production & Delivery

  • Operate manual and automated manufacturing equipment to produce and assemble components according to specifications.
  • Achieve daily production targets, cycle time requirements, and established engineering standards.
  • Demonstrate competency in machine operation, manufacturing processes, and standard work practices.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment through routine housekeeping activities.
  • Perform basic operator care, preventive maintenance, and equipment cleaning activities.
  • Work collaboratively with maintenance technicians, skilled trades, and support teams to identify equipment issues and support repairs.
  • Remain flexible and perform additional duties as required to support production schedules and business needs.

Teamwork & Continuous Improvement

  • Communicate effectively with team members, supervisors, and cross-functional support teams.
  • Participate actively in team meetings, training programs, and development activities.
  • Contribute ideas and support initiatives focused on improving safety, quality, productivity, material flow, and operational efficiency.
  • Demonstrate teamwork, collaboration, and a commitment to Cummins values.
  • Continuously develop skills and knowledge to support business and operational requirements.

Competencies:

Minimum Education

  • High School Diploma, ITI, Vocational Certification, Diploma, or equivalent technical qualification required.

Preferred Education

  • Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Production Engineering, or a related technical field preferred.

Skills

  • Machine operation and equipment handling.
  • Manufacturing and assembly processes.
  • Understanding of quality systems and inspection methods.
  • Statistical Process Control (SPC) awareness.
  • Knowledge of Poka-Yoke and visual management practices.
  • Basic troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to read and follow work instructions and process documentation.
  • Strong attention to detail and quality focus.
  • Safety awareness and compliance.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills.
  • Time management and ability to meet production targets.
  • Continuous improvement mindset.
  • Basic equipment care and maintenance knowledge.

Experience

Required

  • Experience operating manufacturing equipment, machinery, or production systems in an industrial environment.
  • Experience following standard operating procedures, work instructions, and safety requirements.
  • Experience working within quality and productivity targets.

Preferred

  • Experience in a high-volume manufacturing or assembly environment.

job.title: Electronic Systems Product Advisor
job.description:
Job Summary

The Technical Project Leader – Electronics & Software Systems provides technical and project leadership for the development, integration, validation, and release of electronic and software systems for Cummins products. This role serves as the primary customer interface, leading cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software and electronics solutions while managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, and technical risks throughout the product lifecycle.

The incumbent translates customer and product requirements into robust hardware and software solutions, drives systems engineering activities, ensures compliance with Cummins VPI processes, and enables successful project execution. This position also provides technical leadership, mentors engineering teams, and drives continuous improvement across engineering processes, product quality, and project delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers and external business units (EBU) throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead the planning, execution, integration, validation, and release of electronic and software systems for Cummins products.
  • Translate customer and product requirements into hardware and software technical requirements.
  • Manage overall project scope, schedule, milestones, deliverables, and handoffs to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Plan and align engineering resources across cross-functional teams to meet project objectives.
  • Lead risk identification and mitigation activities related to architecture, design implementation, schedule, scope, and resource planning.
  • Manage project changes, resolve conflicts, and proactively remove execution barriers.
  • Support engineering teams in technical problem resolution and facilitate timely issue closure.
  • Manage project financials, including quotations, budgeting, forecasting, actual cost tracking, and recovery planning.
  • Investigate complex electronic application and system issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement robust corrective actions.
  • Develop, manage, and continuously improve systems engineering processes including system specification, modeling, simulation, calibration, validation, troubleshooting, and Design Verification Plan & Report (DVP&R).
  • Collaborate with customers, product engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality engineering solutions.
  • Review technical work of engineers to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient designs.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching, and mentoring to engineers while supporting development of future technical talent.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across engineering processes, project execution, and product quality.
  • Ensure compliance with Cummins engineering standards, VPI processes, and organizational quality requirements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related STEM discipline is required.
  • Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline is preferred for selected roles.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office applications is preferred.
  • This position may require compliance with export control and regulatory requirements.

Skills

Technical Skills

  • Electronic Controls Design, Development and Troubleshooting
  • Electronics and Software Systems Engineering
  • Technical Project Leadership
  • Product Development Lifecycle Management
  • Systems Engineering
  • System Requirements Engineering
  • Product Integration and Validation
  • Design Verification Planning & Reporting (DVP&R)
  • Calibration and System Testing
  • Product Function Modeling and Simulation
  • Design and Application of Mechatronics Systems
  • Open and Closed Loop Control Systems
  • Machine Integration and Optimization
  • Product Problem Solving and Root Cause Analysis
  • Technical Risk Assessment and Mitigation
  • Software and Electronics Release Management
  • Project Budget Management
  • Resource Planning
  • Scope and Schedule Management
  • Change Management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Cummins VPI Process
  • PPT Process
  • VPCR Process
  • SAFe Agile Methodology
  • CSAR Tools (Preferred)
  • MS Office Applications

Professional Competencies

  • Technical Leadership
  • Customer Focus
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Decision Quality
  • Systems Thinking
  • Project Planning and Execution
  • Communication Skills
  • Managing Ambiguity
  • Managing Complexity
  • Innovation
  • Conflict Resolution
  • Process Optimization
  • Relationship Building
  • Coaching and Mentoring
  • Continuous Improvement

Experience

  • Prior experience as a Technical Project Leader (TPL) , Technical Specialist , or equivalent engineering leadership role within a product, technology, or engineering services environment.
  • Proven success leading cross-functional engineering teams through multiple product development lifecycles.
  • Strong experience in electronic controls design, software development, integration, troubleshooting, and validation.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of electronics and software system architecture and development processes.
  • Experience managing project scope, schedules, resources, budgets, technical risks, and customer deliverables.
  • Experience working with Cummins engineering processes and tools, including VPI, PPT, VPCR, SAFe Agile , and CSAR (preferred).
  • Demonstrated ability to provide technical direction, mentor engineers, make quality technical decisions, and successfully deliver complex engineering projects.

job.title: Procurement and Supply Continuity Specialist - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Executes complex buying strategies in accordance with agreed upon material buying plans, specifically focused on improving supplier overall performance and capacity ahead of demand.

Key Responsibilities

Conducts complex analysis of sourcing information and presents findings to Procurement and Supply Chain leadership for process improvement while maintaining high quality product and service delivery. Supports linkage between procurement and manufacturing facilities and will serve as communication conduit between manufacturing and the suppliers. Prepares and presents recommendations of improvement opportunities and alternative courses of action to Senior Procurement/Sourcing leadership. Evaluates consistent application of sourcing procedures and processes. Supports Procurement/Sourcing management in activities such as vendor management, industry and market analysis, process analysis, and model building. Leads analysis projects/initiatives providing coaching to less experienced analysts. Develops effective relationships with vendors and suppliers favorable for company business. Manages capacity, delivery and issue resolution projects. Support of engineering releases and other change management processes.

Competencies:

Negotiations Excellence - Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Procurement Ethics - Avoids supplier engagement that may compromise supplier sourcing, selection, and management processes and seeks counsel to ensure compliance.

Procurement Policies, Procedures, Tools - Understands all of the relevant Procurement policies and procedures and complies with them in daily work; Masters all tools required to conduct procurement work. Knows how to access documents in the appropriate Document Management System (DMS) and/or who to ask if clarification or expansion of the information contained in each document is needed.

Supplier Capacity Management - Leverages Cummins marketing forecast processes and data required from suppliers for capacity planning; negotiates capacity requirements in supplier contracts to deliver the lowest Total Cost of Ownership; links interrelationship between capacity management and product quality; assesses suppliers to ensure that they are capable of meeting Cummins total demand for both production and aftermarket.

Supplier Performance Management - Leverages functional roles and responsibilities to appropriately manage supplier performance; negotiates defined metrics and supplier management processes to ensure robust management by all functional stakeholders; assimilates cross-functional, cross-site performance data across geographies; ensures suppliers awareness to performance deficiencies and communicates Cummins expectations relative to continuous improvement.

Supply Base Risk Management - Minimize supplier risk to Cummins by proactively mitigating risks through use of risk analysis tools and risk mitigation playbook to manage three key risk: 1) Continuity of Supply, 2) Reputational Risk, and 3) Risk to our Margins of parts. By minimize disruption and services throughout supply chain. Manage and leverage supplier selection and dual sourcing opportunities as a first line of defense against supplier risk.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Any engineering Graduate (Mechanical preferred)

Experience

8-10 years of relevant experience required.

Overall Objective:

Ensure uninterrupted supply, minimize operational risks, drive continuous improvement with suppliers, and deliver sustainable business results through strong collaboration, data-driven decisions, and disciplined execution.

  • Ensure Supply Continuity & Plant Operations : Proactively identify, manage, and resolve supply continuity risks impacting manufactured material commodities and plant operations.
  • Drive Effective Stakeholder Communication: Maintain timely, accurate, and professional communication with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring proper escalation and close-looping.
  • Build Strong Supplier Relationships: Develop and sustain strong partnerships with suppliers to enhance collaboration, responsiveness, and long-term business continuity.
  • Lead Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with key stakeholders, peers, business units, and suppliers to resolve issues and achieve organizational goals.
  • Implement Sustainable Problem Resolution: Drive root-cause analysis, A3 problem-solving, corrective actions, and permanent fixes for continuity-related challenges.
  • Manage Improvement Projects: Lead supplier-focused initiatives covering capacity enhancement, quality improvement, delivery performance, and overall supply chain efficiency.
  • Provide Data-Driven Business Insights: Perform spend analysis, identify cost avoidance opportunities, and present solutions using accurate data, facts, and structured reporting.
  • Drive Governance, Reviews, and Reporting: Lead supply continuity reviews, maintain real-time trackers, monitor action plans, and ensure compliance with Cummins policies and procedures.
  • Support Strategic Business Initiatives: Coordinate Technology Day events, special projects, new developments, and additional responsibilities with agility and business focus.
  • Demonstrate Business Excellence: Align all activities with Cummins Mission, Vision, and Values while fostering a “Space of Understanding,” promoting bottom-up escalation, and ensuring business-centric decision-making. Roles & Responsibilities - Manage Supply Chain Disruptions: Proactively identify and resolve supply chain disruptions by working closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Drive Supplier Collaboration: Develop strong supplier relationships and collaborate with suppliers to address supply, capacity, quality, delivery, and commercial challenges.
  • Demonstrate Strategic & Commercial Mindset: Apply strong strategic and commercial understanding while making supplier-related decisions and balancing business, cost, capacity, and continuity requirements.
  • Lead Supplier Negotiations: Drive commercial discussions and negotiations with suppliers to achieve competitive and sustainable business outcomes.
  • Drive Cost Reduction: Identify and execute cost reduction and cost avoidance projects in collaboration with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Drive Capacity Ramp-Up: Work with suppliers to plan and execute capacity ramp-up initiatives based on business and plant requirements.
  • Execute Supplier Agreements: Coordinate and support the execution of commercial and contractual agreements with suppliers, ensuring alignment with business requirements and Purchasing processes.
  • Collaborate with Strategic Sourcing: Partner closely with the Strategic Sourcing team to align sourcing strategies with supply continuity requirements and overall business objectives.
