job.title: Procurement and Supply Continuity Specialist - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Executes complex buying strategies in accordance with agreed upon material buying plans, specifically focused on improving supplier overall performance and capacity ahead of demand.

Key Responsibilities

Conducts complex analysis of sourcing information and presents findings to Procurement and Supply Chain leadership for process improvement while maintaining high quality product and service delivery. Supports linkage between procurement and manufacturing facilities and will serve as communication conduit between manufacturing and the suppliers. Prepares and presents recommendations of improvement opportunities and alternative courses of action to Senior Procurement/Sourcing leadership. Evaluates consistent application of sourcing procedures and processes. Supports Procurement/Sourcing management in activities such as vendor management, industry and market analysis, process analysis, and model building. Leads analysis projects/initiatives providing coaching to less experienced analysts. Develops effective relationships with vendors and suppliers favorable for company business. Manages capacity, delivery and issue resolution projects. Support of engineering releases and other change management processes.

Competencies:

Negotiations Excellence - Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Procurement Ethics - Avoids supplier engagement that may compromise supplier sourcing, selection, and management processes and seeks counsel to ensure compliance.

Procurement Policies, Procedures, Tools - Understands all of the relevant Procurement policies and procedures and complies with them in daily work; Masters all tools required to conduct procurement work. Knows how to access documents in the appropriate Document Management System (DMS) and/or who to ask if clarification or expansion of the information contained in each document is needed.

Supplier Capacity Management - Leverages Cummins marketing forecast processes and data required from suppliers for capacity planning; negotiates capacity requirements in supplier contracts to deliver the lowest Total Cost of Ownership; links interrelationship between capacity management and product quality; assesses suppliers to ensure that they are capable of meeting Cummins total demand for both production and aftermarket.

Supplier Performance Management - Leverages functional roles and responsibilities to appropriately manage supplier performance; negotiates defined metrics and supplier management processes to ensure robust management by all functional stakeholders; assimilates cross-functional, cross-site performance data across geographies; ensures suppliers awareness to performance deficiencies and communicates Cummins expectations relative to continuous improvement.

Supply Base Risk Management - Minimize supplier risk to Cummins by proactively mitigating risks through use of risk analysis tools and risk mitigation playbook to manage three key risk: 1) Continuity of Supply, 2) Reputational Risk, and 3) Risk to our Margins of parts. By minimize disruption and services throughout supply chain. Manage and leverage supplier selection and dual sourcing opportunities as a first line of defense against supplier risk.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Any engineering Graduate (Mechanical preferred)

Experience

8-10 years of relevant experience required.

Overall Objective:

Ensure uninterrupted supply, minimize operational risks, drive continuous improvement with suppliers, and deliver sustainable business results through strong collaboration, data-driven decisions, and disciplined execution.

  • Ensure Supply Continuity & Plant Operations : Proactively identify, manage, and resolve supply continuity risks impacting Casting commodities and plant operations.
  • Drive Effective Stakeholder Communication: Maintain timely, accurate, and professional communication with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring proper escalation and close-looping.
  • Build Strong Supplier Relationships: Develop and sustain strong partnerships with suppliers to enhance collaboration, responsiveness, and long-term business continuity.
  • Lead Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with key stakeholders, peers, business units, and suppliers to resolve issues and achieve organizational goals.
  • Implement Sustainable Problem Resolution: Drive root-cause analysis, A3 problem-solving, corrective actions, and permanent fixes for continuity-related challenges.
  • Manage Improvement Projects: Lead supplier-focused initiatives covering capacity enhancement, quality improvement, delivery performance, and overall supply chain efficiency.
  • Provide Data-Driven Business Insights: Perform spend analysis, identify cost avoidance opportunities, and present solutions using accurate data, facts, and structured reporting.
  • Drive Governance, Reviews, and Reporting: Lead supply continuity reviews, maintain real-time trackers, monitor action plans, and ensure compliance with Cummins policies and procedures.
  • Support Strategic Business Initiatives: Coordinate Technology Day events, special projects, new developments, and additional responsibilities with agility and business focus.

Demonstrate Business Excellence: Align all activities with Cummins Mission, Vision, and Values while fostering a “Space of Understanding,” promoting bottom-up escalation, and ensuring business-centric decision-making.

Roles & Responsibilities -

Manage Supply Chain Disruptions: Proactively identify and resolve supply chain disruptions by working closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Drive Supplier Collaboration: Develop strong supplier relationships and collaborate with suppliers to address supply, capacity, quality, delivery, and commercial challenges.

Demonstrate Strategic & Commercial Mindset: Apply strong strategic and commercial understanding while making supplier-related decisions and balancing business, cost, capacity, and continuity requirements.

Lead Supplier Negotiations: Drive commercial discussions and negotiations with suppliers to achieve competitive and sustainable business outcomes.

Drive Cost Reduction: Identify and execute cost reduction and cost avoidance projects in collaboration with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Drive Capacity Ramp-Up: Work with suppliers to plan and execute capacity ramp-up initiatives based on business and plant requirements.

Execute Supplier Agreements: Coordinate and support the execution of commercial and contractual agreements with suppliers, ensuring alignment with business requirements and Purchasing processes.

Collaborate with Strategic Sourcing: Partner closely with the Strategic Sourcing team to align sourcing strategies with supply continuity requirements and overall business objectives.

Job Purchasing

Role Category On-site with Flexibility

Job Type Exempt - Experienced

job.title: Production Associate - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

Operates machines and production equipment in accordance with quality and productivity requirements safely in a manufacturing environment with limited guidance.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards.
  • Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard.
  • Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment.
  • Promote interdependence by looking out for one another.
  • Correct hazards within your control and capabilities.
  • Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact.
  • Engage in HSE Training.

Quality

  • Follows all applicable standard work, process documentation and quality procedures such as Statistical Process Control (SPC), poka-yoke and visual standards.
  • Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures.
  • Performs quality inspections.
  • Identifies and controls non-conforming material.

Delivery

  • Operates manual and automated equipment to manufacture and assemble product in order to create the proper characteristics and dimensions necessary to meet customer expectations.
  • Demonstrates a high level of competency in core work skills.
  • Achieves production goals.
  • Works at the required cycle time or defined engineering standard.
  • Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping tasks and machine cleaning tasks and performs planned operator care and maintenance tasks.
  • Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet production goals.
  • Works with peers, skilled trades and support staff to maintain and identify equipment needing repair.

Teamwork

  • Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams.
  • Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements.
  • Participates actively in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Courage - Stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Requires some work experience or intermediate level knowledge obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Operate manual and automated CNC machines to manufacture and assemble products to meet customer specifications. Achieve production goals in line with defined cycle times and engineering standards. Maintain clean, safe, and orderly work area; perform routine housekeeping and planned operator care/maintenance tasks. Support troubleshooting of equipment issues and work with skilled trades for repairs. Remain flexible and perform miscellaneous duties to meet production targets. Communicate effectively with team members, skilled trades, and support functions. Actively contribute to quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development improvements. Manufacturing process knowledge of Cylinder block, Head & Connecting is preferred. Knowledge of Mazatrol, Fanuc & Siemens operating control is preferred. Knowledge of cutting tools, Engineering drawing, CMM report reading is preferred.

job.description:
Job Summary

Operate tool regrinding machines and tool pre-setting equipment safely in the Tool Crib area as per quality and production requirements. Manage shift activities and follow all safety rules while working with electrical and other energy sources. Learn safe working methods for industrial equipment and guide or coach others whenever required.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship. Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis. Performs work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments . Follows all process documentation and quality procedures. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Ability to run all tool room equipment including Computer Numerical Controlled (CNC) machines, lathes, grinders, milling machines, drill presses and shapers. Ability to use measuring devices, layout work and set up of tool room machines to build or fabricate details and assemble as needed. Repairs and maintains manufacturing equipment . Performs and documents preventive, emergency, corrective and predictive maintenance activities. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Schedule maintenance activities around production requirements Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Tool and Fixture Design - Selects work-piece-holding devices capable of effectively holding parts and products during a manufacturing process to secure their position to meet functional requirements.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Requires some work experience or intermediate level knowledge obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

  • Experience in operating CNC Tool & Cutter Grinding Machines and conventional tool grinding machines.
  • Knowledge of tool regrinding, basic troubleshooting, and improving tool life.
  • Experience in using Zoller Tool Pre-setter and setting milling cutters.
  • Experience with Oracle transactions for tool issue, return, stock control, and material tracking.
  • Ability to identify and solve problems related to cutting tools and machining operations.
  • Knowledge of cutting tools, tool holders, inserts, gauges, and tool crib activities.
  • Basic understanding of CNC machining processes such as turning, milling, drilling, and grinding.
  • Knowledge of inventory control, stock accuracy, and material management.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Good communication and coordination skills with Production, Quality, Maintenance, and Purchase teams.
  • Understanding of 5S, safety rules, and workplace housekeeping standards.
  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and willing to learn new tools and processes.
  • Work in rotational shifts.

job.title: Technician - Field Service
job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a talented Diesel Technician to join the high performing team at our Cairns branch in Far North Queensland. In this role you will diagnose and complete repairs to engines at the customer’s site.

You will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Engage customers in a courteous and professional manner. Anticipates and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs.
  • Apply the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools.
  • Perform preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engine and related components in the field.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or Supervisor.
  • Complete required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens.
  • Identify additional service opportunities with customer.
  • Complete training in line with skill and business requirements.
  • Maintain service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation.
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.
  • Complete in workshop repairs as required

Additional Information:

  • Full Time / 38 hours per week
  • On Call Roster
  • Overtime as required – Penalty rates paid for all work above 38 hours
  • All your Safety equipment / PPE and uniforms are provided and laundered
  • Domestic Relocation from across Australia _may_ be offered for the right candidate
  • _Local Valid Drivers License is required_
  • _Remote Area Travel Required_

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Cert III) or equivalent
  • Basic level of workshop or field service experience required
  • Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products

_Preferred but not essential:_

  • _Heavy Vehicle or Mobile Plant Experience_
  • _HR License_
  • _Cummins experience_
  • _Remote Work Experience_
  • _Power Generation (Mechanical) experience_

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Overtime & Loading penalties
  • Safety equipment / PPE provided
  • Uniforms provided
  • Income Protection continuance insurance
  • Discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles
  • Annual remuneration review
  • Participation in an annual variable compensation (bonus) program
  • A range of personal and professional benefits
  • Onsite parking
  • Employee Assistance Program available to employees
  • Paid Parental leave (Conditions apply)

_At Cummins, we are an equal opportunity employer dedicated to diversity in the workplace. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, colour, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity and/or expression, or other status protected by law._

Critical Competencies:

  • Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  • Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.
  • Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.
  • Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.
  • Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.
  • Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

job.title: Inventory Accountant - QR034
job.description:
Being part of Cummins means working alongside today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems. We are proud to offer learning and development opportunities designed to promote individual performance and spark purpose and trust within our teams. We look to hire the best and then help you to become even better.

Join Cummins’ Asia Pacific Finance team and play a key role in supporting inventory accounting, reporting and analysis across the region.

Working closely with Finance, Operations, Supply Chain and Pricing teams, you’ll provide insights that help drive better business decisions while gaining exposure to a global organisation.

This is also an exciting time to join Cummins, with Finance undergoing a major transformation as we transition to a global SAP platform. Alongside your core accounting responsibilities, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to process improvements, reporting enhancements and the SAP transformation program.

This is a 12-month Fixed Term contract – ideally starting in November.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Manage inventory accounting, including reconciliations, journals, schedules and financial reporting
  • Support month-end, quarter-end and year-end close activities
  • Analyse inventory costs, variances and trends, identifying risks and opportunities
  • Partner with Operations, Supply Chain and Pricing to provide financial insights and support business performance
  • Ensure compliance with accounting policies, internal controls and financial requirements
  • Support audits and respond to inventory-related enquiries
  • Identify and implement improvements to processes, controls and reporting
  • Contribute to the transition to SAP and broader Finance transformation initiatives

job.title: Product Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Main focus will include working in business processes of Product Preceding Technology (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI) or Current Product Support (CPS) and executing technical processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) while using tools such as 7-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

Competencies:

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.

Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems - Acquires and applies an in-depth understanding of mechanical systems through working knowledge that guides a designer’s ability to create innovative and sound design concepts to meet Cummins and customer expectations; designs for requirements of all lifecycle stages by considering the customer requirements in different operating environments to ensure a robust system.

Mechanical Design Specification - Creates complete specifications in the form of solid models, configured engineering bill of materials and detailed drawings that cross-functionally communicate the information required to manufacture and inspect a product per its design intent; considers national, international, industry, and Cummins’ standards that accurately and concisely define the part specification.

Product Configuration and Change Management - Establishes a baseline of identified product artifacts to be placed under configuration management; releases, tracks, controls and communicates changes from concept to obsolescence often through work requests; establishes and maintains the integrity of the product artifact baselines.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Interface Management and Integration - Identifies and analyzes the interfaces and interactions across system boundaries by specifying the requirements and limits to ensure that the product meets requirements; controls the interactions across the system element boundaries by making sure that they remain within specified limits; integrates system elements by creating an integration plan, including identification of method and timing for each activity to make it easier to find, isolate, diagnose, and correct.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred

Create common supply chain processes and procedures by establishing collaborative business partner relationships. job.title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

Technical specialist and primary customer support contact to diagnose and execute complex repairs to engine products at the customer’s site.

Key Responsibilities

Establishes and continually develops productive customer relations and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs. Applies the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete complex repairs at customer site. Performs preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engines and related components in the field. Escalates unresolved issues to product specialists or supervisor. Coaches and develops technicians and/or apprentices and transfers knowledge and experience to others; may provide work direction; may review repair plans, parts lists, etc. Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens. Identifies additional sales and service opportunities with customer. Completes training in line with skill and business requirements. Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation. Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

job.title: Pricing Analyst - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

The Pricing Analyst – Senior is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing pricing strategies that drive profitable growth while maintaining market competitiveness. This role leads pricing operations, pricing analytics, and cross-functional pricing initiatives by ensuring accurate pricing data, executing strategic price revisions, supporting customer pricing, and delivering actionable business insights. The position collaborates closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, and business leadership to align pricing decisions with organizational objectives, enhance pricing processes, and improve customer value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development, implementation, and execution of pricing strategies that support business growth, profitability, and competitive positioning.
  • Plan, analyze, obtain approvals for, and execute annual and mid-year pricing revisions across multiple product lines and market segments.
  • Maintain accurate pricing data across ERP, CRM, order management, rebate, and pricing systems, ensuring data integrity and first-time accuracy.
  • Manage multiple pricing structures and price lists while ensuring synchronization across enterprise systems.
  • Prepare customer quotations and pricing proposals in collaboration with Sales teams and support complex customer pricing negotiations.
  • Analyze pricing performance, market trends, customer behavior, competitive intelligence, and win/loss data to recommend pricing improvements and business actions.
  • Lead pricing governance forums and facilitate collaborative pricing decisions with Sales, Finance, and business leadership.
  • Design and continuously improve pricing methodologies, pricing policies, and pricing philosophies aligned with business objectives.
  • Lead pricing analytics initiatives by leveraging business intelligence, automation, AI, and digital tools to improve pricing effectiveness and decision-making.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, forecasts, and executive presentations that provide meaningful pricing insights and business recommendations.
  • Lead pricing improvement projects, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Ensure timely resolution of complex pricing issues while providing excellent support to internal and external customers.
  • Maintain confidentiality of pricing information and ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Monitor pricing operational KPIs including turnaround time, accuracy, and service levels, implementing corrective actions where required.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop pricing team members while fostering a collaborative, high-performance work environment.

Build strong partnerships across Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, Supply Chain, and other business functions to achieve shared business goals.

  • Customer Focus
  • Effective Communication

  • Managing Ambiguity

  • Valuing Diverse Perspectives

  • Position may require compliance with applicable export controls or sanctions regulations.

Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience in pricing, commercial finance, pricing analytics, sales operations, business analytics, or related commercial functions.
  • Experience developing and implementing pricing strategies within manufacturing, automotive, industrial, aftermarket, or B2B environments is preferred.

job.title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

The Engine Field Service Technician – Level II is responsible for diagnosing, maintaining, and completing less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites. The role requires a strong customer focus, sound technical knowledge, effective troubleshooting skills, and adherence to Cummins’ safety, quality, and service standards.

The role may be considered for both internal and external candidates , based on relevant qualifications, technical capability, experience, and business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Diagnose and complete less complex repairs on engines and related components at customer sites using approved procedures, service publications, specialized tools, and electronic service tools.
  • Engage with customers in a courteous and professional manner, understand their needs, and provide prompt and effective service solutions.
  • Translate customer complaints into structured troubleshooting plans and identify failed components through appropriate diagnostic methods.
  • Perform preventive maintenance activities in accordance with documented schedules, procedures, and technical standards.
  • Identify, prepare, and use the required parts, tools, equipment, and service information to complete repairs efficiently and accurately.
  • Apply knowledge of engine mechanical and electrical systems, including fuel, cooling, exhaust, aftertreatment, sensors, controls, and related systems, to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • Validate completed repairs by confirming that the reported issue has been resolved and the equipment is operating as required.
  • Escalate unresolved or complex technical issues to experienced Field Service Technicians, technical experts, or the Supervisor, as appropriate.
  • Accurately complete service documentation, including service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality records, and required information in business systems.
  • Maintain accurate customer, equipment, technical, and troubleshooting records to support service history and future diagnostics.
  • Identify additional service opportunities and communicate relevant customer needs to support service excellence.
  • Maintain service vehicles, tools, and equipment in a clean, safe, and operational condition.
  • Complete required technical and developmental training in line with individual skill requirements and business needs.
  • Comply with all applicable Health, Safety & Environmental policies, procedures, standards, and legislation, and promptly report incidents, hazards, or other concerns to site management and the Supervisor.
  • Promote a professional, customer-focused, and safety-oriented approach across all field service activities.

Key Competencies

  • Effective Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally across different audiences and situations.
  • Customer Focus: Builds positive customer relationships and delivers solutions aligned with customer needs.
  • Diagnostics & Troubleshooting: Uses structured troubleshooting approaches, technical information, service tools, and measurements to identify and resolve product issues.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application: Selects and effectively uses appropriate electronic hardware and software tools for diagnosis, maintenance, and repair.
  • Engine Systems Knowledge: Understands the interaction between mechanical and electrical engine systems and applies this knowledge to field diagnostics and repair.
  • Product Repair & Maintenance: Performs repairs, maintenance, component replacement, disassembly, and assembly in accordance with approved procedures and quality standards.
  • Service Documentation: Accurately records technical information, troubleshooting activities, repairs, and service outcomes in the required systems.
  • Technical Escalation: Recognizes issues requiring additional expertise and escalates them appropriately while ensuring complete documentation of troubleshooting performed.
  • Health & Safety: Demonstrates proactive safety behavior, identifies hazards, follows HSE requirements, and contributes to a safe working environment.
  • Manages Complexity: Analyzes technical information and applies sound judgment to resolve field service issues.
  • Self-Development: Demonstrates a willingness to learn, develop technical capability, and complete required training.
  • Develops Talent: Supports knowledge sharing and contributes to the development of colleagues where appropriate.
  • Values Differences: Works effectively with people from diverse backgrounds and values different perspectives.

Qualifications

  • Vocational diploma/certificate from a relevant technical institution.
  • Apprentice-trained Engine Technician qualification is preferred.
  • Locally valid driving permit/license.
  • Any additional technical certifications relevant to engine, mechanical, electrical, or field service activities would be advantageous.
  • The position may require applicable licensing or authorization to comply with export control and sanctions regulations.

Skills

  • Basic to intermediate troubleshooting and diagnostic skills for engines and related systems.
  • Ability to use mechanical and electronic service tools and diagnostic equipment.
  • Ability to interpret service manuals, technical publications, diagnostic results, and repair procedures.
  • Basic understanding of mechanical and electrical engine systems.
  • Ability to perform preventive maintenance and less complex repairs independently.
  • Good customer service and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to accurately complete service reports, warranty documentation, timesheets, and electronic service records.
  • Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work safely and effectively at customer sites.
  • Ability to identify when technical escalation is required.
  • Willingness to travel and work in field/customer-site environments as required.

Experience

  • Basic level field service experience is preferred.
  • Intermediate-level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products.
  • Experience in engine maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, or related technical service environments.
  • Customer service experience, preferably in a technical or field service environment.
  • Experience using diagnostic tools, service software, and technical documentation would be advantageous.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a technically capable and customer-focused professional who can independently handle routine field service activities and less complex engine repairs while recognizing when issues require escalation. The candidate should demonstrate strong safety awareness, willingness to learn, disciplined service documentation, and the ability to build effective customer relationships.

Key account manager service for HHP segment.

Adherence to Service Level Agreement (SLA), HSE guidelines and other business compliance.

  • Have clear understanding of contract scope and discuss with all the concerned at dealership on the commencement of any new contract.
  • Support dealership and solution team to prepare an accurate PM schedule.
  • Failure trend analysis especially under LHP CAMC and ensure stocking of parts as per FTA through DAMs.
  • Ensure the team reviews open SRN regularly and supporting dealership on PM and breakdown SLA compliance.
  • Ensure 100 % utilization of contract cap value. Have a monthly review of parts consumption to be tracked and ensure consumption of supplied parts are as per agreed cap value of individual contract. Prepare proactive maintenances and parts replacement in order to prevent breakdowns and share with the customer as per capped value yearly.
  • Ensure that vendor evaluation score should be above 95% for all the CAMC customers

Develop relationship with customer

職務描述

We are looking for a Sourcer to join our Procurement Team and support supplier sourcing, cost management, and supply capability development.

This role works closely with Engineering, Operations, Finance, Product Management, and suppliers to ensure sourcing activities support business growth, operational stability, and continuous improvement.

The ideal candidate enjoys solving business problems through structured analysis, supplier collaboration, and practical execution. You do not need to know everything from day one — but we value people who are curious, organized, and willing to take ownership beyond assigned tasks.

This position provides opportunities to gradually develop sourcing capability through supplier exposure, project participation, and cross-functional collaboration.

職責

ESSENTIAL  DUTIES  AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Cost Analysis & Sourcing Execution

  • Review and analyze component spend, sourcing opportunities, and cost structure then further to set up sourcing strategy.
  • Execute RFQ, quotation comparison, bidding activities, and commercial negotiations.
  • Support annual standard cost review and cost reduction initiatives.
  • Perform sourcing analysis including TCO (Total Cost of Ownership), cost comparison, and business case evaluation.
  • Maintain sourcing and procurement data in ERP systems (e.g. standard cost, MOQ, lead time, PIR, source list).
  • Execute risk mitigation, business continuity, cost management, and operation strategies

Supplier Development & Supplier Management

  • Develop and maintain relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Manage supplier onboarding, approval, and supplier master data maintenance.
  • Manage supplier agreements, payment terms, and Incoterms alignment.
  • Support supplier qualification, audits, supplier performance reviews, and supplier scorecard activities.
  • Maintain supplier records and support supplier-related compliance requirements.
  • Conduct regular business review with suppliers to ensure continuous improvement (ex: cost, capacity or operation excellence…)

Product Sourcing & Project Support

  • Work with Engineering to support sample sourcing and component qualification.
  • Participate in new projects, product launch, and pilot run activities.
  • Support product lifecycle management including EOL control, second source development, last-time-buy execution, and sourcing readiness.
  • Manage sourcing-related documentation and approval processes.

Supplier Performance & Operational Improvement

  • Coordinate supplier quality-related topics and commercial recovery activities when applicable.
  • Support KPI reporting, process documentation, and sourcing operational excellence initiatives.

Sustainability & Business Compliance

  • Manage ESG / CSR related activities of suppliers.
  • Support environmental and carbon-related data collection where required.
  • Assist with company compliance and supplier governance initiatives.

資格

REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Electronics, Business, Operations, or related disciplines.
  • 5-10 years of experience in Procurement, Sourcing, Supply Chain, Supplier Management, Engineering support, or related functions.
  • Familiar with Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP preferred).
  • Business-level English communication capability.
  • Experience with sourcing, supplier interaction, or manufacturing environment is preferred.

DESIRED KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS

We value people who demonstrate：

  • Ownership and accountability
  • Curiosity to understand how products and supply chains work
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management
  • Ability to organize information and drive follow-up actions
  • Structured thinking and problem-solving capability
  • Ability to balance execution quality and business speed
  • Continuous learning mindset and willingness to improve existing ways of working

Success in this role looks like：

  • Supplier activities move forward with clear ownership
  • Cost and sourcing opportunities are identified proactively
  • Cross-functional collaboration becomes more efficient
  • Operational issues are solved with sustainable improvements
  • Gradual growth toward independently managing sourcing activities

job.title: Team Lead - Embedded (UI)
job.description:
Job Description

Required Skills

  • Strong experience in Embedded C/C++ programming.
  • Hands-on experience with FreeRTOS development.
  • Strong experience in Embedded Linux system development.
  • Experience in Bare Metal firmware development.
  • BSP development and customization experience.
  • Experience in board bring-up and hardware debugging.
  • Device driver development for embedded peripherals.
  • Strong understanding of ARM Cortex-A/R/M or similar processor architectures.
  • Experience with IPC mechanisms: Message Queues, Shared Memory, Semaphores, Pipes, and Socket-based Communication.
  • Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, UDP, HTTP/HTTPS, MQTT, SNMP, and SSH/TLS.
  • Linux kernel fundamentals, Device Tree concepts, boot sequence, and startup architecture.
  • Strong debugging skills using GDB, JTAG Debuggers, Lauterbach/Trace32, Wireshark, Logic Analyzers, and Oscilloscopes.
  • Experience with Git and version control systems.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with FreeRtos BSP development.
  • Knowledge of AMP/SMP architectures.
  • Experience with secure boot and embedded security concepts.
  • Familiarity with IoT protocols such as BLE, Zigbee, Thread, Matter, and Wi-Fi.
  • Exposure to cloud-connected IoT devices and edge computing.
  • Experience with CI/CD and automated build systems.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity concepts for connected products.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain embedded software solutions on FreeRtos, Embedded Linux, and Bare Metal platforms.
  • Perform BSP development and customization for new hardware platforms.
  • Lead and support board bring-up activities, including bootloader, kernel, device drivers, and hardware validation.
  • Develop and integrate device drivers for UART, SPI, I2C, Ethernet, USB, GPIO, ADC, PWM, and PCIe peripherals.
  • Design and implement IPC mechanisms, message queues, shared memory, semaphores, sockets, and synchronization primitives.
  • Work on real-time applications with deterministic performance requirements.
  • Develop and optimize embedded applications using C/C++.
  • Configure and customize bootloaders (U-Boot or equivalent).
  • Debug hardware-software integration issues during platform bring-up and product development.
  • Analyze and optimize system performance, memory utilization, boot time, and CPU utilization.
  • Collaborate with hardware, firmware, validation, and system teams throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical design discussions.
  • Support product validation, deployment, and field issue analysis.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

Domain

IoT Devices / Smart Home Solutions / Building Automation / Connected Products / Embedded Systems

job.title: Applications Engineer II
job.description:
Job Description

At a Glance

Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a Aplications Engineer (Design) - APAC to join the Data, Power & Control - Starline Team in Tuas, Singapore (Remote). The Applications Engineer provides high-level engineering expertise, technical design and commercial support on the application of Starline high amperage busduct products to specific projects and customers. The Engineer has the task of overseeing the activities aimed at defining and consequently drafting the offers for the products. The role is also responsible for identifying and providing reliable solutions for all technical issues related to design and field install to assure complete customer satisfaction through all stages of the project. The role establishes and maintains strong relationships throughout the project life cycle.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

  • Maintain High-level expertise of product knowledge and application.
  • Complete System Layouts: design layouts of busduct systems based on site
  • Audit & Surveys, Customer drawings, Project tenders and Field input.
  • Utilize AutoDesk Suite to assess understand customer requirements
  • Experienced in 3D design such as AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor & BIM360
  • Create product technical system layouts from engineered drawings (catalog sheets, FAQ’s, Tech Briefs, Reports, instructions, etc.)
  • Provide technical and commercial support to sales and to customers onsite or remotely as required on topics including but not limited to product estimation, RFQ support, ratings, compliance with local regulations and Standards, safety, functionality, Product hands on training, customization, troubleshooting and pricing.
  • Attend customer facing meetings which may include providing customer presentations for product solutions and project updates.
  • Drafting offers related to bus duct products, verifies the technical aspects of the application (based on the technical needs expressed by the customer, drawings of the installation layout.)
  • Verifying the technical characteristics (operating temperature, power, installation, material, quantity, etc.)
  • Supports the management of the customer’s project through the entire project life cycle
  • Work with internal departments such as Purchasing, R&D, Test, Product Engineering, 3rd party assembly providers, for assembly designs, resolve customer & Field technical design issues.

Additional Duties

  • Onsite troubleshooting and rework.
  • Technical liaison to the sales team
  • Training on busduct products and design tools to Sales network
  • Provides Service Group through helping to project manage installations.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Aptitude for electrical product design and application in power distribution and busduct products.
  • Experienced user of AutoDESK programs – AutoCAD, Revit, Inventor
  • Experience using BIM360
  • Familiarity with the IEC standards and various IEC certifications
  • Persuasive and articulate, with an ability to communicate and influence people at all levels, verbally, in writing and by presentation.
  • Stable, loyal and reliable, with a customer focused personality.
  • Self-reliant, flexible and resourceful.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BS Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in the Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering field.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office.
  • Familiar with project management tools such as Prince2
  • Proficient in technical writing and communication.
  • Prior experience with Busduct products is preferred
  • Ability to travel up to 15% on a regular basis and 20% occasionally, mainly in APAC, other locations as required.

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • The performance of this position may occasionally require exposure to the manufacturing and construction areas where, under certain areas, the use of personal protective equipment such as safety glasses and mandatory hearing protection are required. Also exposed to certain high working areas like high ceiling or floor level.
  • Ability to sit for prolonged periods of time
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 23kg occasionally

Note: The above Job Description is representative of the responsibilities and qualifications necessary to be successful in this role. It does not encompass every job duty or responsibility; other tasks may be assigned as necessary. Further the job

description does not alter the at-will nature of employment with Legrand and does not create a contract of employment.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Mould Tool Development (MTDM)
job.description:
Job Description

The Deputy Manager will play a crucial role in developing, validating, and standardizing injection moulding processes for new and existing moulds. They will qualify moulds, support production commissioning, and establish robust parameters to maintain consistent quality and performance. This role is integral to the success of the Mould Tool Development (MTDM) department and the overall research and development efforts of the company.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct T1, T2, and follow-up mould trials at supplier sites to assess mould functionality and process capability.
  • Qualify new injection moulds at suppliers before dispatch, ensuring they meet quality standards.
  • Execute mould commissioning and validation at production plants, aiming for First Time Right (FTR) performance.
  • Optimize moulding process parameters for repeatability and efficiency.
  • Perform root cause analysis to identify and eliminate moulding defects, ensuring defect-free components.
  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive process documentation, including setting sheets, reports, and SOPs.
  • Coordinate with mould suppliers for trials, process optimization, and timely delivery of moulds.
  • Support cross-functional teams, including Production, Tool Room, Quality, and R&D, for successful mould commissioning.
  • Provide technical support and training to production and tool room teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Plastic, Polymer, or Tool & Die Engineering.
  • 8-12 years of experience in injection moulding process development, mould qualification, and production commissioning.
  • Scientific Injection Moulding certification is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience with injection moulding machines from leading manufacturers.
  • Strong knowledge of plastic material processing (PP, ABS, PC, etc.) and hot/cold runner systems.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and Creo for interpreting engineering drawings and GD&T.
  • Understanding of DFM principles and mould construction.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001/14001/45001 systems and documentation.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective communication and the ability to collaborate across functional teams.

job.title: Senior Manager
job.description:
Job Description

The Senior Manager - Corporate Finance & Controllership is responsible for leading the organization's finance operations, ensuring robust financial governance, regulatory compliance, effective cash management, and accurate financial reporting. The role oversees Accounting, Accounts Payable, Treasury, Direct Taxation, Statutory Audits, Internal Controls, and Internal Audit coordination while partnering closely with cross-functional teams to support business objectives and maintain strong compliance standards.

Responsibilities

Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Lead and oversee all accounting activities ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
  • Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing of books.
  • Review and validate financial statements, reconciliations, and accounting entries.
  • Drive continuous improvement in accounting processes and controls.

Accounts Payable Management

  • Ensure timely verification, approval, and processing of vendor payments.
  • Monitor payable cycles and maintain strong vendor relationships.
  • Ensure adherence to delegation of authority and payment control procedures.
  • Drive efficiencies and automation within the procure-to-pay process.

Treasury & Cash Flow Management

  • Manage working capital, cash flow planning, and liquidity requirements.
  • Monitor banking operations and maintain strong relation with bankers.
  • Ensure timely execution of payments and treasury transactions.
  • Validate EMDs & Bank Guarantee’s as per business requirement.
  • Support EXIM business for compliance and LC related activities where applicable.

Taxation & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee direct tax compliance.
  • Coordinate with external consultants for certifications, Form 15CA/CB.
  • Ensure compliance with all statutory, legal, and regulatory requirements with internal and external team.

Audit Management

  • Lead and coordinate statutory audit activities ensuring timely completion and closure of audit observations.
  • Manage internal audit engagements and facilitate implementation of corrective actions.
  • Act as the primary finance liaison with external auditors and internal audit teams.
  • Monitor audit findings and drive sustainable process improvements.

Internal Controls & Governance

  • Establish and maintain a robust internal control framework.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and financial governance requirements and strong adherence to DOA.
  • Drive a strong control environment with a zero-tolerance approach toward compliance violations.
  • Conduct periodic reviews to identify and address financial and operational risks.

SG&A Analysis & Business Performance Monitoring

  • Prepare and present monthly SG&A expense analysis.
  • Analyze cost variances, spending trends, and key financial performance indicators.
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to management for cost optimization.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Lead and develop finance teams including plant finance and accounting personnel.
  • Allocate responsibilities, monitor team performance, and support capability development.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor team members and strengthen succession planning within the finance function.

Business Partnering

  • Collaborate closely with operations, procurement, sales, HR, legal, and other functions to support business requirements.
  • Provide financial guidance to stakeholders for strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Participate in business initiatives and transformation projects.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and financial governance requirements.

Managing of Numeric Subsidiary and Gratuity trust account

  • Interacting with Bankers for closure of Lanka Technology along with filing of annual income tax returns.
  • Annual filing of Income Tax return for Numeric Trust accounts.

Qualifications

Chartered Accountant with 8 to 10 years of relevant Experience

job.title: Senior PCB Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

At NEDS, we are looking for a talented and experienced Senior PCB Engineer to join our L7 - IN - NUMERIC - PCB Technical department. As a key member of our team, you will play a vital role in designing, developing, and maintaining high-quality printed circuit boards (PCBs) for our advanced electrical and digital systems. Your expertise will be instrumental in ensuring the reliability and performance of our products, contributing to our reputation for innovation and excellence.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop PCBs for a variety of electrical and digital systems, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
  • Conduct thorough PCB layout and routing, considering factors such as signal integrity, power distribution, and thermal management.
  • Review and analyze PCB designs, providing constructive feedback and suggestions for improvement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including hardware and software engineers, to ensure seamless integration of PCBs into the overall system.
  • Stay updated with the latest technologies, industry trends, and best practices in PCB design and manufacturing.
  • Mentor and guide junior PCB engineers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose issues related to PCB functionality, identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions.
  • Conduct thorough testing and validation of PCBs, ensuring they meet specified requirements and industry standards.
  • Document and maintain accurate records of PCB designs, revisions, and test results for future reference and compliance.
  • Support the production team by providing technical expertise and guidance during PCB assembly and manufacturing processes.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in PCB design, repair, and soldering.
  • Diploma or ITI qualification in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • In-depth knowledge of PCB design principles, including schematic capture, layout, and routing.
  • Proficiency in using PCB design software such as Altium, Cadence, or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of electrical and electronic components, circuits, and their interactions.
  • Experience with PCB manufacturing processes, including fabrication, assembly, and testing.
  • Ability to read and interpret complex technical documentation and schematics.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with a methodical approach to troubleshooting.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Willingness to stay updated with industry advancements and a commitment to continuous learning.

job.title: AGM - Data Analytics
job.description:
Job Description

Legrand fosters an inclusive, innovative, and diverse environment where individuals can contribute meaningfully.

You will play a pivotal role in enabling Legrand India to become a data-driven, insight-led, and AI-enabled enterprise, shaping the future of our digital and business transformation

Responsibilities

1 . Data Strategy & Architecture

  • Understand the current landscape and framework of Legrand India’s systems and data.
  • Work with Digital Transformation Office in structuring the same and evolving the future frame work and system architecture.
  • Define and execute the enterprise-wide data & analytics strategy under Legrand’s digital transformation roadmap.
  • Build and govern a modern data architecture, including data lake on Fabric, data warehouse, ETL pipelines, and integration with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM).
  • Establish best practices in data modelling, data quality, master data management, and governance.

2\. Analytics Framework & Business Intelligence Solutions

  • Study the business needs and build data analytics solutions using the existing tools and technologies.
  • Deliver real-time and periodic insights using data analytics for business needs.
  • Understand the current solutions and evolve and enhance them to give deeper insights to business teams.
  • Implement advanced analytics solutions for forecasting, market intelligence, pricing, productivity, and channel insights.

3\. Business Partnering & Decision Support

  • Guide and train the key users from different functional domains in using data analytics.
  • Engage with Business Heads to translate business needs into actionable analytics.
  • Provide data-backed recommendations for GTM strategy, category growth, channel performance, NPI insights, customer segmentation, and revenue growth initiatives.
  • Build strong relationships with global and corporate teams to align tools, models, and standards with Legrand Group’s global analytics direction.

4\. Product & Innovation

  • Drive digitalization of processes with analytics embedded into workflows and decision systems
  • Work closely with Digital Transformation team to build analytics solutions using Fabric and Azure framework.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, or related fields; MBA preferred.

  • Experience: 5 - 10 years of experience in Data Analytics, BI, or Data Architecture roles.
  • Good understanding of manufacturing, supply chain, and sales analytics; electrical/industrial/FMCG

Experience preferred and will be added advantage :-

  • Hands-on expertise with:
  • Power BI / Tableau
  • SQL, Python/R
  • Cloud platform Azure – most preferred
  • Fabric framework – most preferred
  • Gen AI frameworks (MS/AWS/Google etc) and their use for data analytics and deep diving
