job.title: Plugs Assembler I
job.description:
Job Description

At a Glance

Starline – a company of Legrand has an exciting opportunity for an Assembler to join the Data, Power, Control Team in Singapore. The Assemblers manufactures and assembles a variety of configurations of mechanical and basic electrical assemblies used in electrical distribution systems.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

Essential Functions

  • Read shop drawings and wiring diagrams
  • Read Bills of Materials (BOMs) to determine component parts and assembly sequences of electromechanical units
  • Make electrical connections according to specifications
  • Assemble parts, and position, align, and fasten assemblies, subassemblies, using hand tools and power tools.
  • Modify parts by drilling, tapping, countersinking, etc. machine tools, power and pneumatic hand tools.
  • Position, align, and adjust parts for proper fit and assembly.
  • Measure parts to determine tolerances, using tape measures and precision measuring instruments such as micrometers and calipers.
  • Attach labels and mark identifying information on parts.
  • Adhere to all company policies, guidelines and practices including the SECRIT values.

Additional Duties

  • Cross training to work in other functional department of the plant
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Tool selection — determining the kind of tools and equipment needed to do a job.
  • Oral Comprehension – The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
  • Ability to operate cordless hand tools, power tools and pneumatic tools.
  • Ability to read shop drawings and wiring diagrams preferred.
  • Ability to read standard tape measure.
  • Ability to work in a cohesive team environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Level/A Level/ ITE or High School Diploma or equivalent
  • One year of experience in manufacturing preferred

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • Lifting:  Ability to lift and carry up to 75 lbs occasionally; ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs often.
  • Finger Dexterity: The ability to make precisely coordinated movements of the fingers of one or both hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble very small objects.
  • Manual Dexterity: The ability to quickly move hand, hand together with arm, or two hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble objects.
  • Arm-Hand Steadiness: The ability to keep hand and arm steady while moving arm or while holding arm and hand in one position.
  • Vision: The ability to see details at a close range and have the ability to tell the difference in the colors of wires.

job.title: Director User Exp Design
job.description:
Job Description

Honeywell User Experience (HUE) design studios lead the creation of next-generation experiences for the connected world. Leveraging well-established human-centered design principles, HUE ensures that Honeywell products and applications are the most useful, usable, and desirable in the marketplace. The studios operate globally across North America, Europe, China, and Australia, fostering a collegial,

ROLE OVERVIEW

The PA HUE Leader at HTCS is a senior design executive responsible for two interconnected capabilities: (1) leading the HUE Design Studio for the Process Automation (PA) business, driving the UX vision, strategy, and delivery aligned with the PA SBG and GBE leadership; and (2) overseeing the Technical Writer team, ensuring that product knowledge is translated into accurate, user-centered documentation that enhances the overall customer experience.

This dual mandate positions the PA HUE Leader as a key steward of both visual-interactive experience design and content-driven experience design — recognizing that great products must be equally well-designed and well-documented.

Responsibilities

SCOPE OF LEADERSHIP

A. HUE Design Studio — Process Automation

Lead a growing, multidisciplinary team of User Experience designers delivering next-generation, delightful solutions across the PA product portfolio. Key responsibilities include:

  • Developing design capability and infrastructure aligned with PA business strategy.
  • Recruiting, developing, and managing UX design talent; managing resources and operational plans.
  • Overseeing multidisciplinary competencies: design research, experience design, interaction design, visual design, and industrial design.
  • Driving 2–3 high-impact, innovative offerings based on a UX-led approach.
  • Delivering design projects on time to support business growth and enhance product value.
  • Collaborating with PA Global Experience Design teams to implement a design strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Contributing to HUE best practices for User Experience Design throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Participating as a decision-maker at project reviews; providing a clear, consistent UX perspective to teams and stakeholders.
  • Creating and executing human-centered designs that differentiate Honeywell brands globally.
  • Applying, building, and evolving the Honeywell Design Language System (DLS) and brand identity program.
  • Contributing to management updates, operational reviews, and leadership dialogue at HUE Global Leadership and HTS India Leadership.
  • Collaborating with all Honeywell functions that interact with customers to deliver end-to-end journey alignment.
  • Establishing a framework for regular usability testing with dedicated UX researchers embedded across studios.
  • Overseeing co-creation workshops with end users to inform new product and service development.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve data visualization and interpretability through design.
  • Promoting a holistic, end-to-end user experience strategy across all product touchpoints.
  • Championing system thinking and storytelling techniques to align product vision with user needs.

B. Technical Writer Team — Documentation & Content Experience

Provide leadership and strategic direction to the Technical Writer team, ensuring product documentation is accurate, structured, and user-centered. This team is integral to the customer experience and works at the intersection of product knowledge and communication design. Key responsibilities include:

  • Overseeing end-to-end documentation for products and programs, covering user guides, installation manuals, administrator guides, and troubleshooting references.
  • Directing the development of feature walkthroughs, process flow documentation, and security white papers.
  • Ensuring the team effectively uses MadCap Flare to produce high-quality HTML and PDF documentation.
  • Guiding the creation of HTML-based user assistant files that enhance in-product guidance.
  • Building and managing a structured review and feedback cycle with key stakeholders — developers, testing teams, program managers, installation teams, and security teams.
  • Embedding technical writing quality standards focused on content accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
  • Aligning documentation strategy with the broader UX and product experience roadmap, ensuring parity between product design intent and user-facing documentation.
  • Fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the technical writing function, including upskilling in structured authoring and content design principles.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) from an institute of repute in Design, Human Factors, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • 12 or more years of experience in User Experience design of products and software applications.
  • Demonstrated experience in a senior design leadership role, managing multidisciplinary teams including UX designers, researchers, and/or technical writers.
  • Experience working in Agile environments with lean UX methodologies.
  • International experience working with regional businesses and geographically distributed design teams.
  • Proven track record of delivering innovative, market-released UX design solutions; portfolio required.
  • Experience directing and managing external design and development firms.
  • Exposure to or direct experience overseeing technical documentation functions is an advantage.

Design & Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in UX design tools: Figma, prototyping platforms, interaction and visual design toolsets.
  • Deep understanding of Design Language Systems and brand identity programs.
  • Ability to create low-fidelity to high-fidelity prototypes across the design lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated research skills across qualitative and quantitative methods.
  • Familiarity with technical documentation platforms (e.g., MadCap Flare, HTML/PDF publishing pipelines) is desirable.
  • Understanding of structured content principles, single-source publishing, and content strategy.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Ability to translate complex vision into understandable concepts and workable design narratives.
  • Strong ability to influence product, software, hardware, and development teams during early-stage development.

Required Skills

  • B.Des, M.Des
  • Team handling
  • UX design
  • Ux Research

job.title: Assistant Manager, Finance – Reporting
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and technically sound finance professional to support the financial reporting and technical accounting functions of DayOne Data Center. With a focus on US GAAP compliance and NASDAQ IPO readiness, the Assistant Manager will assist in the preparation of financial statements, SEC filings, and technical accounting analyses. This role provides strong exposure to group reporting, external audit, and internal controls in a dynamic multinational data centre environment.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Reporting & SEC Compliance

  • Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidated financial statements in accordance with US GAAP.
  • Support the preparation of management reports and variance analyses, and contribute to clear financial commentary for management review.
  • Prepare supporting schedules and materials for executive, audit committee, and board reporting.
  • Coordinate with external auditors, IPO advisors, and regulators as directed by the Finance Manager.
  • Assist in the preparation of SEC filings, including Form S-1, 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and related disclosures for NASDAQ-listed or IPO-ready entities.
  • Support IPO readiness activities, including financial statement conversion, disclosure drafting, and coordination with underwriters and legal advisors.

Technical Accounting & Policy Development

  • Assist in researching, drafting, and reviewing technical accounting memoranda on complex accounting issues (e.g. revenue recognition, share-based compensation, business combinations, lease accounting).
  • Monitor new accounting standards and assist in assessing their impact on the Group.

Internal Controls & SOX Compliance

  • Support the design, implementation, and enhancement of SOX-compliant internal controls over financial reporting.
  • Assist in risk assessments and help address control gaps in collaboration with finance stakeholders.
  • Help maintain SOPs, reporting calendars, and training materials to support reporting efficiency.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement and automation initiatives for reporting processes and systems.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Degree holder in Finance, Accounting, or equivalent professional qualification.
  • CPA/ACCA or equivalent certification (or actively pursuing).
  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant accounting experience; Big 4 background is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of US GAAP financial reporting and SEC filings.
  • Exposure to NASDAQ IPO or public company reporting environment is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with SOX compliance frameworks and internal control concepts.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA would be advantageous.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain accounting matters clearly.
  • High level of integrity and a collaborative, ownership-driven approach to work.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

Reporting into the regional leadership team, this role combines program leadership, physical security expertise and stakeholder management to ensure security systems, processes and vendors are aligned throughout the design, construction, installation, commissioning and handover phases of our projects.

This is a highly visible regional role supporting construction and expansion projects across Asia, requiring regular travel sites. Candidates who enjoy working in dynamic environments, influencing cross-functional teams and seeing projects come to life from concept through to operational handover will thrive in this position.

Regular travel throughout Asia should be expected, including visits during design validation, installation, commissioning, operational readiness and handover phases. The successful candidate should enjoy being on-site and working directly with project teams, stakeholders and vendors to drive successful outcomes.

Responsibilities

Physical Security Program Enablement

job.title: Vice President, Portfolio Management
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Overview

The VP will serve a dual mandate — driving portfolio management excellence across Keppel’s private data centre funds, while acting as a product specialist and capital formation partner. The role sits at the intersection of portfolio management, investor relations, and product development, requiring a commercially astute individual who can credibly engage both institutional investors and internal investment teams.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Management & Fund Oversight

  • Develop and execute portfolio strategy, business plans, and annual budgets in alignment with the fund's mandate and investment guidelines.
  • Maintain centralized oversight of the private data centre funds, encompassing capital allocation, compliance with investment restrictions, performance monitoring, and adherence to governance frameworks.
  • Actively manage fund liquidity, control fund-level expenses, and implement strategies to optimize investor distributions and risk-adjusted returns.
  • Build, own, and continuously maintain life-of-fund financial models, ensuring integrity of projections, cash flow forecasting, and scenario analysis.
  • Produce rigorous fund-level performance metrics, investor reporting, and returns benchmarking against relevant private real estate, infrastructure, and data centre peer universes.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for existing investors of the Funds, to respond to their queries

Investment & Asset Management Support

  • Participate actively in the investment process — including evaluation of acquisition and divestment opportunities — by providing portfolio-level context, capital allocation perspectives, and investor return considerations.
  • Collaborate with asset management teams to monitor business plan execution across portfolio assets, escalating risks and opportunities as appropriate.
  • Contribute the portfolio and investor lens to investment committee deliberations, ensuring deal-level decisions are evaluated within the context of overall fund construction and mandate constraints.

Product Specialist / Capital Raising

  • Act as a product specialist for the data centre fund strategy in investor meetings
  • Working as part of a team to support end-to-end capital raising activities, including contributing to the development of marketing materials, pitchbooks, DDQs, RFP responses, and fund terms documentation.
  • Provide substantive responses on fund strategy, portfolio construction, performance attribution, and risk management.
  • Partner with structuring teams on the design and launch of new fund products and co-investment vehicles, ensuring alignment with market demand and investor preferences.
  • Develop and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with a broad institutional investor base including sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, insurance companies, family offices, and fund-of-funds.

Market Intelligence & Thought Leadership

  • Monitor and synthesize competitive intelligence across private real estate, digital infrastructure, and data centre investment markets, tracking trends in capital flows, fund structures, pricing, and investor sentiment.
  • Produce thematic content to support fundraising narratives, investor communications, and strategic planning.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Pre-requisites:

  • Masters / Degree in Finance / Business Administration from leading university
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience with private real estate / infrastructure funds in investment or asset management role with broad knowledge and extensive networks in the private infrastructure/ real estate markets for the Asia Pacific region.
  • Commercially astute, and possess sharp analytical, research, problem solving skills and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead investor discussions; Proven track record in dealing with international institutional investors will be viewed favorably.
  • A self-motivated team player who is meticulous, detailed oriented, organized and able to learn quickly and independently
  • Proficient with financial modelling, market and industry research in infrastructure, real estate or other private equity assets;
  • A strong communicator with excellent stakeholder management skill and ability to interact well with different functions and levels.
  • Ability to multi-task and work in fast pace dynamic environment

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Connectivity

PLATFORM

Fund Management

job.title: Senior Grid Connection Manager (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Senior Grid Connection Manager is a key technical role within STACK’s Power & Energy function, responsible for leading the technical grid connection process for large-scale data centre developments across Australia.

The role will provide technical ownership from early-stage grid connection feasibility through connection application, power-system studies, Connection Performance Standards (CPS), Generator Performance Standards (GPS), model development and acceptance, technical approvals, compliance requirements, commissioning and energisation.

Operating at transmission-scale load levels, the role will work closely with AEMO, VicGrid, Transmission Network Service Providers (TNSPs), Distribution Network Service Providers (DNSPs), specialist power-system consultancies, OEMs and STACK engineering and delivery teams to develop technically robust, achievable and commercially practical connection solutions.

The Senior Grid Connection Manager will act as a key technical interface between the electricity network and STACK’s development, engineering and delivery organisations. The role will also lead the engagement and performance management of external technical consultants and specialist contractors supporting the connection process.

The role does not require the individual to personally undertake all detailed power-system studies; however, the successful candidate must have sufficient technical depth to define study requirements, challenge assumptions, review results, identify risks and ensure technical outcomes are appropriately incorporated into the project design.

Grid Connection & Technical Interface

  • Lead the technical grid connection process for large-scale data centre developments from feasibility through energisation.
  • Manage technical engagement with AEMO, VicGrid, TNSPs and DNSPs, including technical submissions, information requests, reviews and approvals.
  • Assess connection options, network constraints, capacity, technical risks, augmentation requirements and programme implications.
  • Maintain the technical connection roadmap, key dependencies, risks and actions.
  • Provide clear technical recommendations to Power & Energy, Development and senior leadership.

CPS, Power-System Studies & Modelling

  • Lead development and technical negotiation of Connection Performance Standards (CPS), Generator Performance Standards (GPS), and associated connection requirements.
  • Define and manage the power-system study programme, including load-flow, fault-level, dynamic, EMT, harmonic, power-quality and system-strength studies as required.
  • Coordinate development and validation of facility models, ensuring they accurately represent the intended data centre electrical system and operating philosophy.
  • Review and challenge consultant outputs, assumptions and conclusions, identifying technical risks and required further analysis.
  • Ensure changes to equipment, load configuration or operating philosophy are appropriately reflected in models and studies.

Consultant, Contractor & OEM Management

  • Lead engagement and technical management of specialist grid-connection consultants, power-system engineers, testing specialists and OEM technical resources.
  • Develop clear scopes of work, technical deliverables, interfaces, programmes and acceptance criteria.
  • Manage external providers against scope, quality, programme and technical requirements.
  • Coordinate multiple consultants to ensure consistent assumptions and integrated technical outputs.
  • Obtain and review technical data and models from major equipment suppliers, including UPS, transformers, generators, BESS and other power-electronic equipment.

Engineering & Delivery Interface

  • Work closely with Engineering and Delivery to translate connection requirements into the design and delivery of upstream HV infrastructure.
  • Work closely with Engineering to ensure the downstream electrical design and actual facility load behaviour are appropriately reflected in connection studies and CPS.
  • Identify design changes that may affect connection assumptions, models, studies or technical approvals.
  • Support technical requirements for testing, commissioning, compliance and energisation.
  • Maintain alignment between the approved connection solution and the delivered project.

Technical Governance & Risk

  • Maintain clear technical governance, documentation and decision records for connection activities.
  • Identify and escalate technical connection risks early and drive resolution.
  • Track connection conditions and technical approvals through to energisation.
  • Develop repeatable standards, processes and lessons learned to improve future connection programmes.

Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of Australian electricity networks and grid-connection processes.
  • Strong understanding of AEMO, VicGrid, TNSP/DNSP, CPS and GPS requirements.
  • Strong power-system engineering knowledge covering steady-state, dynamic and EMT studies.
  • Ability to critically review and challenge technical studies and consultant outputs.
  • Strong understanding of HV systems, substations, transformers, protection, control and power quality.
  • Strong stakeholder, consultant and contractor management capability.
  • Excellent technical communication and report-writing skills.
  • Ability to translate complex technical issues into clear business recommendations.
  • Strong programme, risk and interface-management capability.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or related discipline.
  • 8+ years’ relevant experience in power systems, electricity networks, generation, large industrial loads, data centres or major electrical infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience with Australian grid-connection processes.
  • Experience working with AEMO, VicGrid, and/or TNSPs/DNSPs on complex connections.
  • Experience with CPS / GPS development or equivalent technical connection requirements.
  • Experience managing power-system studies and specialist technical consultants.
  • Experience interpreting RMS and/or EMT modelling results.
  • Strong understanding of transmission and HV infrastructure.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience with transmission-scale large-load connections.
  • Experience with hyperscale data centres or other large power-electronic loads.
  • Experience with PSCAD, PSS®E and/or PowerFactory.
  • Experience with system-strength, harmonic, fault-level and power-quality studies.
  • Experience with BESS and renewable generation.
  • Experience with 132 kV, 220 kV, 275 kV, 330 kV or higher-voltage infrastructure.

job.title: Application Support
job.description:
Job Responsibilities

Application Support :

  • Provide application support for production and UAT environments.
  • Monitor applications, logs, and alerts; proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Manage and maintain Linux servers.
  • Work on bug fixes, minor enhancements, and development support tasks using Java, Python, Angular, and Node.js.
  • Assist with API troubleshooting, debugging, and performance tuning.
  • Provide deployment support, including CI/CD pipelines, builds, and releases.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams such as Development, QA, and Infrastructure for issue resolution.
  • Maintain documentation for known issues, fixes, and support processes.
  • Support database-related activities, including basic queries, data validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Participate in on-call/customer support activities when required.
  • Learn and follow secure coding practices and software development best practices.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for customer support by logging, categorizing, assigning, and tracking application support tickets through to closure while ensuring adherence to defined SLAs.
  • Monitor the support ticket queue, proactively follow up on open issues, communicate regular status updates to customers, and coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application-related incidents and service requests, escalating complex issues when required and ensuring root cause analysis is documented.
  • Maintain clear and professional communication with customers throughout the support lifecycle, providing timely updates, managing expectations, and ensuring high customer satisfaction.
  • Create and maintain accurate ticket documentation, including issue details, troubleshooting steps, resolution notes, and knowledge base articles to improve future support efficiency.
  • Perform post-resolution validation with customers, ensure successful issue closure, and identify opportunities to reduce recurring incidents through process improvements.

Development Support

  • Assist in the development and enhancement of applications using Java and/or Python.
  • Fix bugs and implement minor feature changes.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Support API development and integration tasks.
  • Participate in code reviews and testing activities.

Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with Linux commands and shell scripting.
  • Basic knowledge of Java, JavaScript, and Python.
  • Basic exposure to Spring Boot, Flask, FastAPI, Node.js, and Angular/Angular Native.
  • Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts.
  • Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Understanding of REST APIs.
  • Familiarity with JSON, HTTP methods, and status codes.
  • Awareness of Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Understanding of Linux fundamentals.

Soft Skills

  • A self-starter who consistently looks for opportunities to innovate and enhance the customer experience.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate ideas, approaches, and technical details to peers and leaders.
  • Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and continuously develop technical skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-based environment.
  • Positive attitude and strong ownership mindset.

Qualification & Experience

  • Experience: 1–3 years
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

job.title: Data Engineer, Analytics (Singapore)
job.description:
As a Data Engineer at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Reality Labs, Threads). Your technical skills and analytical mindset will be utilized designing and building large-scale data sets, helping to craft experiences for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses worldwide.

In this role, you will collaborate with software engineering, data science, and product management teams to design/build scalable data solutions across Meta to optimize growth, strategy, and user experience for our 3 billion plus users, as well as our internal employee community.

You will be at the forefront of identifying and solving some of the most interesting data challenges at a scale few companies can match. By joining Meta, you will become part of a data engineering community dedicated to skill development and career growth in data engineering and beyond.

Data Engineering: You will guide teams by building optimal data artifacts (including datasets and visualizations) to address key questions. You will refine our systems, design logging solutions, and create scalable data models. Ensuring data security and quality, and with a focus on efficiency, you will suggest architecture and development approaches and data management standards to address complex analytical problems.

Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, identify new opportunities, and tackle upcoming challenges. You'll ensure our products add value for users and businesses, by prioritizing projects, and driving innovative solutions to respond to challenges or opportunities.

Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.

Responsibilities

  • Conceptualize and own the data architecture for multiple large-scale projects, while evaluating design and operational cost-benefit tradeoffs within systems
  • Create and contribute to frameworks that improve the efficacy of logging data, while working with data infrastructure to triage issues and resolve
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data scientists to understand data needs, representing key data insights in a meaningful way
  • Define and manage Service Level Agreements for all data sets in allocated areas of ownership
  • Determine and implement the security model based on privacy requirements, confirm safeguards are followed, address data quality issues, and evolve governance processes within allocated areas of ownership
  • Design, build, and launch collections of sophisticated data models and visualizations that support multiple use cases across different products or domains
  • Solve our most challenging data integration problems, utilizing optimal Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) patterns, frameworks, query techniques, sourcing from structured and unstructured data sources
  • Assist in owning existing processes running in production, optimizing complex code through advanced algorithmic concepts
  • Optimize pipelines, dashboards, frameworks, and systems to facilitate easier development of data artifacts
  • Influence product and cross-functional teams to identify data opportunities to drive impact
  • Mentor team members by giving/receiving actionable feedback

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent
  • 4+ years of experience where the primary responsibility involves working with data. This could include roles such as data analyst, data scientist, data engineer, or similar positions
  • 4+ years of experience (or 2+ years with a Ph.D) with SQL, ETL, data modeling, and at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, C#, Scala, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Master's or Ph.D. degree in a STEM field
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Business Support Engineer - Ads & Messaging
job.description:
We are looking for an engineer to play a key role in providing technical, engineering support to Meta’s Advertising partners, Customers and clients globally. You will have the opportunity to work together with a global team of Business Support Engineers who are expert in Meta’s Adtech to provide proactive and reactive support for partner issues and integrations while partnering with our broad cross functional teams to ensure a high quality for our products and satisfactory experience for our partners and customers. We work directly with Platform and Infrastructure teams to investigate and resolve issues reported by our partners, to properly assess and agree on actions to be taken for necessary fixes and continuous improvements in our products and deployments.

As a Business Support Engineer working on Ads at Meta, you will primarily support on Meta’s Ads Products but also have the opportunity to work cross-functionally in several of our key business areas across Business Messaging, Telecommunications and combine your experience with customer service skills with a product focus to ensure that key insights are communicated to our product teams. We are looking for people who have subject-matter knowledge in managing and maintaining integrations with 3rd-party services, who help foster developer/business relationships, who demonstrate critical thinking & blending systems design with business needs, and who have a desire to improve the support experience of our customers. You will understand industry trends, partner solutions/integrations and their implications for our product roadmap. You will work closely with other regional offices and partnership teams to support a broad range of partners across the globe to integrate Meta’s Business Products into their offering.

Responsibilities

  • Provide proactive and reactive engineering support for partners, independently managing complex outages to ensure high partner satisfaction
  • Troubleshoot large-scale distributed systems and partner integrations, maintaining reliable systems through thorough debugging, root-cause analysis, and follow-up improvements
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, automate repetitive tasks, and scale your impact with an 'AI native' mindset
  • Build, launch, and optimize AI solutions using Llama and other LLMs, owning the full lifecycle from prototype to production
  • Develop performance monitoring systems for partner integrations to ensure high availability; leverage metrics to proactively identify issues and drive improvements across teams
  • Provide 24/7 oncall support coverage via a rotation schedule (including weekends)
  • Collaborate with Platform and Infrastructure teams to investigate issues, align on fixes, and drive continuous product improvement
  • Create clear documentation, specs, guides, and presentations to communicate complex AI concepts to diverse audiences, scaling the team's knowledge internally and externally
  • Drive end-to-end execution, using sound judgment to manage stakeholder expectations and ensuring clear alignment. Develop and share AI/ML expertise, actively coach and mentor other engineers on technical troubleshooting and project executions
  • Proactively and independently analyze information to identify specific trends/opportunities, recommend appropriate and relevant tactical improvements, anticipate future business needs to improve the overall support experience, and share this knowledge across the team

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or site reliability engineering or support engineering
  • Proven experience in API development on cloud-based infrastructures, with the ability to debug, identify root causes, and independently resolve outages impacting Meta partners

  • Experience in assessing, analyzing, and resolving operational issues using data analysis (SQL)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Hands-on experience working with large language models and AI agents
  • Experience building and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience transforming data, model selection/training/optimization, and deployment at scale
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Experience with Open Source cloud stacks like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Docker containers
  • Experience in partner-facing or customer-centric engineering roles
  • Experience working in engineering environments with geographically distributed, cross-cultural teams and international stakeholders

job.title: Network Development Manager, Network Investments
job.description:
To support the fast growing user community and the introduction of new and innovative products and services, we are continually expanding our backbone network infrastructure around the globe. We are looking for a Network Development Manager to join our APAC network infrastructure group to support our growing network footprint needs. You will lead network investments through subsea cable investments, capacity and dark fiber leases and acquisitions, network infrastructure development, and construction, . Demonstrated subsea cable experience will be essential. You will — often working with partners and vendors — develop and implement strategies to provide Meta with competitive economics, flexibility and scalability, reliable delivery and high availability as well as optimized operation and maintenance arrangements.

If you are passionate about network infrastructure and building and expanding global network infrastructure, please send your resume for consideration for this role.

Responsibilities

  • Develop supply strategies, including joint build efforts with partner organizations with similar connectivity needs
  • Manages a portfolio of subsea systems and fiber infrastructure suppliers globally, but with a focus on the APAC regions
  • Identifies suppliers, negotiates commercial terms, and works with the engineering and legal departments to negotiate and execute supplier contracts
  • Project Management: Drive end-to-end execution of complex infrastructure projects across cross-functional stakeholders
  • Manages and develops partner relationships across a diverse range of countries
  • Oversees the performance and management of contracts through the full lifecycle, tracking and ensuring supplier compliance with the terms and conditions of the contract, processing of supplier invoices, creation of contract variances and renegotiation as needed
  • Understands the subsea and telecom wholesale markets' technological and commercial developments and positions Meta in the right place
  • Represents the Meta network team in conferences and trade shows
  • Maintains a deep familiarity with other major market players and competitive dynamics on both the supply and demand side; keeps track of price trends in the market to ensure the competitive commercial terms for Meta
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to develop network requirements and acquisition strategies and generates clear and objective investment analysis and recommendations for investment approvals
  • Works closely with finance and planning teams to develop budgets, forecasts, and long-range investment plans, and with Accounting and Accounts Payable for accurate processing of supplier invoices and compliance with accounting guidelines
  • Accommodate pre-planned travel as required for the role

Minimum Qualifications

  • BA/BSc or equivalent in a technical or business-related field with 8+ years of relevant experience
  • Experience in subsea cables, fiber infrastructure, and carrier market players, and familiarity with evolving commercial trends

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Financial or data modeling experience and the ability to quantitatively analyze and present findings
  • Project management experience, including coordinating procurement, construction, and operational teams across multiple workstreams including for procurement, construction and operational teams
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Demonstrates a proven track record of major deal execution and understanding of subsea cables (preferably) and/or terrestrial fiber infrastructure
  • Experience communicating investment analyses and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders and external partners, including relationship building and collaboration across diverse teams
  • Familiarity with network automation frameworks and data-driven capacity modeling tools used to support large-scale infrastructure investment decisions
  • Proven experience with major business development projects and managing joint investments with partners across multiple regions

  • Design, build, and validate automated EOL test fixtures (both AC and high-power DC test benches) using programmable electronic loads, power analyzers, grid simulators, and EV emulators.
  • Develop and maintain EOL test execution scripts and sequences using NI LabVIEW, TestStand, Python, or PLC architectures.
  • Implement and manage safety-critical systems for high-voltage and high-current testing environments, including interlocks, light curtains, emergency stop (E-stop) circuits, and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocols.

2\. Functional & Safety Testing Integration

  • Integrate mandatory electrical safety checks into the automated test cycle, including dielectric withstand (Hi-Pot), insulation resistance, and ground continuity testing.
  • Automate validation of critical safety devices such as CCID (Charge Circuit Interrupting Device) ground fault detection and overcurrent protection.
  • Automate the functional validation of communication interfaces, including vehicle-to-charger handshakes (CCS/NACS physical layers via PLC/PWM) and network interfaces (OCPP via Ethernet, Wi-Fi, or cellular).

3\. Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis

  • Troubleshoot complex test stand issues involving hardware, firmware, or test software to minimize line downtime.
  • Establish robust processes for diagnosing units that fail EOL testing; define clear "Rework" instructions and verify the effectiveness of those repairs.
  • Use diagnostic and network tracing tools (e.g., CANalyzer, CANoe, Wireshark) to analyze communication trace logs when troubleshooting vehicle-to-charger signaling failures.

4\. Continuous Improvement & Data Traceability

  • Integrate EOL test systems with the factory Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and database architectures (SQL) for complete serial-number-level test result traceability.
  • Monitor first-pass yield (FPY) and cycle times at EOL, utilizing statistical data analysis to isolate and eliminate false failures and process bottlenecks.
  • Lead the transfer of new product EOL test requirements from R&D (Design Verification Testing) to high-volume manufacturing lines.
  • Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a highly related technical field.
  • 6 to 14+ years of hands-on experience as a Manufacturing Test Engineer, with at least 6 years dedicated to End-of-Line (EOL) testing in an automotive, EVSE, battery, or high-power electronics environment.
  • Experience working directly with high-voltage AC (up to 480V three-phase) or high-voltage DC (up to 1000V+) test systems.

Technical Skills

  • Software: Highly proficient in test development environments, specifically NI TestStand/LabVIEW and/or Python for hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) automation.
  • Protocols & Standards: Solid understanding of EV charging physical layers and messaging standards (e.g., J1772, ISO 15118, DIN 70121, OCPP).
  • Equipment: Direct experience configuring and controlling programmable power supplies, electronic loads (E-Loads), digital oscilloscopes, and safety testers.
  • Safety & Compliance: Familiarity with high-voltage lab safety guidelines, NFPA 70E compliance, and UL standards relevant to EVSE (e.g., UL 2202, UL 2594, UL 2231).

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical, data-driven mindset with the ability to draw root-cause conclusions from complex test logs.
  • Excellent collaborative communication skills to interface effectively with firmware developers, hardware engineers, and production operators.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with unified EV/EVSE functional test platforms (e.g., Keysight, Chroma, or similar systems).
  • Direct experience with CTEP / NTEP metrology and calibration requirements for commercial EVSE billing accuracy.
  • Certification in Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt or Black Belt) and experience with Gauge R&R studies on test equipment.

job.title: Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support New Zealand
job.description:
As an Enterprise Account Technical Manager, you'll operate as a trusted technical consultant, earning trust across our strategic customers in New Zealand and having a direct impact in helping them gain maximum value from cloud technology. You'll craft and execute strategies to drive customer adoption and use of AWS services while providing expert guidance on architecture, support strategies, project planning, and operational excellence.

Working with some of the most iconic businesses in the country, you'll provide technical leadership and consultative expertise across the customer lifecycle. This role offers opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills while solving challenging problems in cloud adoption, migration, and optimization. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success while building long-term relationships that enable business transformation.

Key job responsibilities Build solutions and provide technical guidance as a trusted advisor, ensuring AWS environments remain operationally healthy while reducing cost and complexity Develop trusting relationships with customers at all levels, understanding their business needs and technical challenges to drive meaningful technology discussions about incidents, trade-offs, and risk management Consult with a range of stakeholders from developers through to C-suite executives, crafting strategies that help customers achieve their business objectives through effective cloud adoption Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, and Sales Account Managers to deliver comprehensive customer support Proactively identify opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS, including providing detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, and pre-launch planning

A day in the life As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), your day begins with reviewing customer operational metrics and preparing for strategic meetings. You might start with a workshop helping a retail customer architect their cloud solution, followed by collaborating with account teams to develop approaches for an upcoming migration project. After lunch, you'll lead a technical discovery session with a healthcare customer exploring analytics solutions, then spend time reviewing architectural designs and providing best practice guidance. Throughout the day, you'll be building relationships, solving complex problems, and ensuring customers maximize their AWS investment.

About the team At Amazon Web Services, we don't mind being called "peculiar." We have our own way of doing things. We're obsessed with customers, we see beauty in simplifying the complex, and we're comfortable with being misunderstood. This peculiar approach is part of our culture - focused on removing obstacles so builders can build - are part of why our people enjoy working in AWS.

Our team combines technical excellence with a customer-focused approach to help organizations across New Zealand realize the full potential of cloud technology. We're a group of passionate cloud technologists who thrive on solving complex problems and delivering transformative results for our customers. As we continue to rapidly expand in New Zealand, you'll have abundant opportunities to develop your technical, consulting, and leadership skills. You'll work alongside talented cloud experts while expanding your knowledge of AWS products, receiving mentorship, and gaining AWS certifications in a supportive, innovative environment.

We’re passionate about supporting the needs of our people and their family members. Benefits include Medical Cover, Employee Assistance Programs and Global Mobility opportunities.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of technical engineering experience
  • Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment

job.title: Senior Business Development Manager, AWS SCE Cloud Economics
job.description:
As a Cloud Economics Business Development Manager, you will quantify the cost and value benefits of running applications on AWS. You will build board-ready migration business cases, shape customers' IT financial models, and engage directly with C-level executives, Finance leaders, and IT architects to accelerate cloud adoption.

You will partner with AWS sales teams on strategic customer engagements, identify economic barriers to adoption, and develop strategies to overcome them. You will deepen your expertise in data center economics, legacy environment cost modeling, and consultative selling, while directly influencing how large enterprises in ASEAN think about their cloud investments.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as a key member of the Cloud Economics team in APJC, helping to drive sales engagements with our customers in one of our most important markets
  • Work with AWS Sales and Specialist AWS functions to help quantify the economics of running IT applications in the cloud versus a traditional data center environment
  • Act as a central resource for the Sales team to help our customers create financial models for their current and future IT landscape
  • Build case studies and reusable examples that scale Cloud Economics learnings across AWS
  • Be a resource for market insights into how our customers view the economic benefit of using AWS relative to deploying applications on-premise or in traditional data centers
  • Prepare and present business cases to senior leaders, explaining the value of migrating to AWS

About the team The AWS Cloud Economics team helps customers identify and quantify value creation opportunities at each stage of their journey to the cloud. We engage directly and collaboratively with customers, partners and internal AWS teams to deliver cloud value advisory expertise, business value case development, and Cloud Financial Management best practices and methodologies. The Cloud Economics team can help answer the customer question: “What value can I expect to achieve by using AWS?”

Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical discipline (e.g., Mathematics, Economics, Physics, Statistics, Computer Science)
  • 6+ years working with and presenting to senior executives, IT, lines of business, procurement, finance, legal and/or internal stakeholders
  • 6+ years experience in financial analysis, value engineering, or value advisory

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree
  • Familiarity with AWS pricing models, cost management tools, or Cloud Financial Management frameworks
  • Familiarity with enterprise IT infrastructure, virtualization, and cloud migration patterns
  • Experience building TCO or ROI models
  • Background in management consulting, technology advisory, or solution selling

job.title: Partner Development Manager, APJ, Strategic Consulting Partners Team, Asia Pacific & Japan
job.description:
Would you like to be part of a team that is redefining the IT industry? Amazon Web Services is leading the next paradigm shift in computing and is looking for a dynamic results oriented candidate to join as the Partner Development Manager, Asia Pacific & Japan.

The Asia Pacific & Japan (APJ) Strategic Consulting Partners Team works with Global System Integrators and Business Advisory Partners to drive accelerated business growth and large-scale customer transformations. The team manages key partnerships and deals through top-down engagement with APJ leadership of strategic partners. It owns initiatives with pan-APJ relevance and medium to long term impact by identifying patterns and running programs to unlock value. It serves as the connected tissue between global teams and APJ country Area teams, owning the execution of global programs.

Reporting into the APJ Strategic Consulting Partnerships Leader, as the Partner Development Manager for APJ within Amazon Web Services (AWS), you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of AWS' services and solutions, driving strategic initiatives across a portfolio of our most strategic consulting partners.

Your broad responsibilities will include owning one or more identified strategic initiatives and executing against the defined input and output goals. You will achieve this by establishing business and technical relationships, and managing the day-to-day interactions with Partners, APJ leadership and country partner teams. The ideal candidate will possess both a business background that enables them to drive an engagement and interact at the CXO/VP level, as well as a sales and partner management background that enables them to easily lead and influence peers and partners at a frontline across alliance, partner development, partner sales, specialized sales, and account teams. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions. The candidate for this role should also have experience working in large, matrix organizations effectively engaging with a diverse set of stakeholders to shape, lead, execute, and build mechanism that run-the-business. Experience working with large software providers and system integrators will be critical to manage complex partnerships and be comfortable, working across various teams and earn trust. The candidate should be a self-starter, self-motivated, a driver who gets things done and has a bias for action and delivering results.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage a set of strategic business development and growth initiatives to support acceleration of APJs most strategic partnerships.
  • Establish, build and execute strategic planning, initiatives and run-the-business mechanisms to drive acceleration across the organization.
  • As the voice of the partner, engage with AWS partner sales and partner core team leaders to support the growth of the partner by development of new capability and services with various AWS teams.
  • Manage and develop multiple Sales and Partner Leadership stakeholder relationships, relentlessly earning trust by aligning and executing on initiatives that support both sales and partner strategies.
  • Bar raising document writer, and able to audit/coach broader team on their written documents to accelerate initiatives, and deliver high quality executive engagements.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Overall experience of 10+ years in Partnerships management / Sales / business consulting or strategy, in technology context sales, or a mix of such experience
  • Proven track record of managing and influencing senior internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently with limited guidance, once the objectives have been set, and overall direction has been aligned
  • Willingness to travel to meet with partners, customers and internal stakeholders, attend events and support field teams on site

job.title: Senior Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support, ES – APJC-ASEAN
job.description:
The AWS Enterprise Support team is growing to meet the demands of a portfolio of always-on, latency-sensitive enterprise customers whose production workloads run across global AWS regions. As a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the named technical point of accountability for some of the team's largest accounts — owning architectural guidance, operational strategy, and proactive support delivery end to end. The team is investing in three areas where you will have immediate impact: converting recurring support patterns into reusable automation and documented procedures, deepening technical expertise in databases, containers, networking, and capacity planning, and shifting the delivery mix from reactive case work to proactive resilience reviews, cost planning, and measurable customer outcomes. If you want to own a customer relationship where every interaction matters and your contributions raise the bar for the whole team, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise customers, advising on cloud architecture, operational strategy, and launch readiness across global AWS regions.
  • Assess customer environments for architectural risks and scaling constraints, then build actionable plans that maintain business continuity for workloads with 24/7 uptime requirements and unpredictable demand patterns.
  • Collaborate with account teams, Solutions Architects, and AWS service teams for compute, database, container, and networking services to resolve complex issues and drive product improvements informed by real customer patterns.
  • Analyze operational metrics and deliver periodic performance reviews to customer leadership, translating data into clear recommendations that strengthen security posture, cost efficiency, and system reliability.
  • Contribute to the team's shared knowledge base, standard operating procedures, and reusable automation, and mentor fellow Technical Account Managers to raise the collective capability of the group.

A day in the life You might start the morning reviewing an operational dashboard for a customer whose traffic can spike without warning, then jump into a call with their engineering team — in Mandarin — to walk through a scaling plan for an upcoming product release. After lunch you could be partnering with an AWS service team to troubleshoot a networking issue that spans a complex multi-account topology, and later in the afternoon you present a quarterly architecture review to a customer's leadership, highlighting risks mitigated and opportunities ahead.

About the team We are a cross-border Enterprise Support team within AWS that serves enterprise customers headquartered in Singapore while their production infrastructure runs in global AWS regions. Our closest partners are the account teams and Solutions Architects on our shared accounts, along with AWS service teams in compute, database, container, and networking. As our customer portfolio grows and workloads become more demanding, we are looking for a senior engineer ready to take designated ownership of key accounts and help us scale proactive delivery through better mechanisms, deeper technical expertise, and shared tooling.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience
  • 7+ years of technical engineering experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment
  • Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

job.title: Specialist Solutions Architect - Amazon Connect, Applied AI Solutions
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is proud to be the pioneer and widely recognised leader in Cloud Computing. Our web services provide IT infrastructure in-the-cloud that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world, ranging from start-ups to leading web companies to Global 500 companies in industries such as financial services, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing.

AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs. As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or designing entirely new cloud-based systems. Do you enjoy solving novel and unique technical challenges for customers? Become an AWS Specialist SA!

The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS), which is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. We work backwards from our customer’s most complex and business critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist and technical solutions architecture. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire life cycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.

Key job responsibilities

  • Represent the voice of the customer; bring customer feedback to product teams to influence feature development and future product roadmap.
  • Provide advanced technical knowledge to your domain aligned GTM teams to unblock our customers’ largest and most critical business challenges.
  • Act as a thought leader sharing best practices through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public-speaking events such as AWS Summit, AWS re: Invent, etc.
  • Partner with Business Development teams to define the technical components of best in class GTM concepts, solutions, and initiatives.
  • Develop and support an AWS internal community of technical subject matter experts worldwide. Create field enablement materials for the broader SA population, to help them understand how to integrate Amazon Web Services solutions into customer architectures.

A day in the life AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

About the team The APJ CXE Specialist Solution Architecture team is a diverse group of architects located throughout Asia, Pacific and Japan. The team develops Contact Centre architectures and solutions using Amazon Connect for our customers. Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements, and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering), or Bachelor's degree
  • Knowledge of AWS services

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with end user or developer communities
  • Experience with AI/ML technologies
  • Experience developing, deploying and managing AI products at scale

job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

16 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Technical Business Analyst - Service Intelligence & Automation

Job Summary

Job Description

Who We Are

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

This includes making Telstra the place you want to work. For you, that means a having career that grows with you and working with a team powered by human connection that prioritises wellbeing and choice.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Technical Business Analyst, Service Intelligence & Automation to join the Defence & Federal Government Service Intelligence & Governance Team within the newly established Service Integration Office.

This is not a traditional requirements or reporting role. You will help design how the portfolio connects service performance, risk, governance and operational information, transforming fragmented processes and data into trusted, automated and decision-ready solutions.

Working across Defence & Federal Government service delivery, governance, leadership and support functions, you will identify high-value business problems, shape practical digital solutions and help take them from discovery through to implementation and adoption. Your work will support the SIO to create simpler ways of working, stronger portfolio visibility and a more integrated view of service health and performance.

This is a permanent full-time opportunity that can be based anywhere in Australia. Due to operational and network-access requirements, the role will require onsite work.

Candidates must be Australian citizens and hold a current Baseline Security Clearance. You must also be willing and eligible to obtain, maintain and use an Australian Government NV1 Security Clearance.

What We Offer

  • Performance-related pay
  • Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up
  • Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business.
  • Purchased annual leave scheme
  • Additional Telstra day off
  • Additional 30% off Telstra products and services
  • Toolkit provided (laptop + mobile phone + plan paid for
  • Recognition of prior service for recent defense members; carry over of long service leave to Telstra
  • 4 weeks paid Defence leave

What You’ll Do

You will:

  • Investigate complex service, governance and operational problems and translate them into clear solution requirements and delivery options.
  • Design connected information flows across performance, service health, risk, governance and operational activities.
  • Own initiatives from problem discovery and requirements definition through solution design, prototyping, implementation and adoption.
  • Develop service-intelligence products that bring together information from multiple systems and support faster, evidence-based decisions.
  • Identify and remove duplicated reporting, manual coordination and fragmented governance activities.
  • Design and implement automated workflows, self-service tools and fit-for-purpose digital solutions.
  • Establish trusted sources of information with clear ownership, controls, definitions and sustainable ways of working.
  • Use Power Platform, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SharePoint and Copilot capabilities to prototype and deliver practical business outcomes.
  • Work with data, engineering and platform specialists where solutions require deeper technical development or integration.
  • Support adoption, define success measures and assess whether implemented solutions have improved productivity, visibility or control effectiveness.
  • Help establish reusable patterns, standards and capabilities that can scale across the Defence & Federal Government portfolio.

About You

You may currently work as a:

  • Technical Business Analyst
  • Digital or Automation Business Analyst
  • Power Platform or Business Applications Consultant
  • Service Management Analyst
  • Process Automation Analyst
  • Operational Excellence Analyst
  • Service Design Analyst
  • Data and Reporting Analyst with strong business-analysis experience

You’ll bring:

  • Strong business-analysis, process-discovery and stakeholder-engagement capability.
  • The ability to move from an ambiguous problem to a structured, practical and implementable solution.
  • Experience shaping or delivering workflow automation, digital tools, dashboards or business applications.
  • Working experience with Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint or related Microsoft technologies.
  • An understanding of how data, process, technology, controls and user experience work together.
  • The ability to prototype ideas and communicate effectively with business stakeholders and technical specialists.
  • A focus on user adoption, measurable outcomes and sustainable solution ownership.
  • Experience working across organisational boundaries in a large, complex or highly regulated environment.
  • Curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, with the judgement to apply them to genuine business problems.

Experience in service management, managed services, telecommunications, government, Defence or critical infrastructure environments would be highly regarded.

You do not need to be a software engineer or data scientist. You will be technically confident, comfortable working with data and digital platforms, and able to bridge the gap between operational needs and scalable technical solutions.

job.title: Head of Manufacturing and Planning
job.description:
At Siemens Busway Vietnam, we are transforming our factory into a smarter, leaner and more agile manufacturing organization powered by Operational Excellence, Digitalization and Artificial Intelligence. As our Head of Manufacturing and Planning, you will lead the integration of Production Operations, Material Planning, Manufacturing Engineering and Maintenance to build a resilient, future-ready manufacturing organization that supports the rapid growth of Hyper Scale Data Centers and critical infrastructure projects across the world. Beyond delivering world-class performance in Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost and Productivity, you will play a strategic role in building the pathways to customer success—ensuring our manufacturing capabilities, planning strategies and continuous improvement initiatives enable Siemens to deliver reliable, scalable and sustainable solutions for our customers.

job.title: Executive Digitalization – Logistics.
job.description:
