job.title: Advanced Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Mathematical Formulation: Translate ambiguous business problems into mathematically sound framework objectives and optimisation targets.
  • Production-Grade Engineering: Write clean, modular, and maintainable code using production-level design patterns to scale mathematical models.
  • Big Data Processing: Design and manage scalable data pipelines to process massive datasets efficiently for model training and inference.
  • Deep Learning & Vision Development: Build, train, and fine-tune complex neural networks across text, audio, and visual modalities.
  • Cloud Deployment: Architect and deploy models to cloud environments, leveraging distributed computing and robust cloud infrastructure.

Required Technical Skills & Competencies

1\. Tooling, Libraries & Software Engineering

  • Core Language: Advanced proficiency in Python with a strict adherence to Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, clean coding standards, and design patterns.
  • Machine Learning Libraries: Advanced proficiency in scikit-learn (sklearn) for data preprocessing, feature engineering, and baseline modelling.
  • Deep Learning Frameworks: Core expertise in PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow for building, customizing, and training deep neural networks from scratch.
  • Big Data Ecosystem: Experience with Apache Spark (PySpark) and the Hadoop Ecosystem (HDFS, Hive, MapReduce) for handling, transforming, and querying large-scale distributed datasets.
  • Cloud Architecture: Experience building and deploying scalable machine learning applications on major cloud platforms ( AWS, Azure, or GCP).

2\. Core Mathematics & First-Principles ML

  • Foundational Math: Solid foundation in Linear Algebra (eigenvalues, SVD, matrix decompositions), Multivariable Calculus (partial derivatives, gradients, Jacobians), and Probability Theory (Bayesian inference, probability distributions, expectation maximization).
  • Machine Learning: In-depth understanding of standard Machine Learning algorithms (Trees, Boosting, SVMs, GMMs) with the ability to explain the underlying loss functions and optimizations mathematically.
  • Deep Foundations: Thorough understanding of Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs), mathematical derivation of backpropagation, hyperparameter initialization strategies (Xavier, He), optimization variants (Adam, RMSProp), and advanced regularization techniques (L1/L2, Dropout, Batch Normalization).

3\. Advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP)

  • Sequential Networks: Hands-on experience with sequence modeling, including Word Embeddings (Word2Vec, FastText), RNNs, LSTMs, and GRUs.
  • Transformer Ecosystem: Deep structural knowledge of the Transformer architecture (Self-Attention math, Multi-Head mechanisms).
  • Pre-trained NLP Models: Experience implementing and fine-tuning encoder-only (BERT, RoBERTa) and decoder-only (GPT series) architectures.

4\. Computer Vision (CV) & Document AI

  • Spatial Networks: Deep understanding of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), feature map mathematics, pooling operations, and advanced CV backbones.
  • OCR & Document Processing: Proven track record building or customizing Optical Character Recognition (OCR) systems for complex text extraction pipelines.
  • Vision Transformers: Familiarity with the adaptation of attention mechanics to visual tasks (ViTs, Swin Transformers).

Education & Experience

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s, Master's, or Ph.D. in a highly quantitative field (Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Computer Science, Physics, or Operations Research).
  • Experience: 4 to 6 years of industry experience working as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer with a portfolio of complex multimodal projects.

job.title: Sr Advanced Software Engr
job.description:
Job Description

A DevSecOps & SRE Architect leads the design, implementation, and governance of secure, resilient, and automated enterprise platforms. This role bridges the gap between development, security, and operations, embedding security as a key stakeholder in every phase of the software lifecycle while ensuring high availability, observability, and reliability of production systems

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement end-to-end DevSecOps pipelines that embed shift-left security practices (SAST, DAST, SCA, IAST) into CI/CD workflows.
  • Define and enforce Policy-as-Code and security guardrails across cloud infrastructure using tools like OPA, or Azure Policy.
  • Architect Infrastructure as Code (IaC) frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Bicep) to provision and govern cloud environments securely.
  • Build and maintain secure software supply chain practices including SBOM management, artifact signing, and dependency scanning.
  • Conduct DevSecOps maturity assessments and develop organizational roadmaps for security automation adoption.
  • Establish and enforce Zero Trust Architecture principles across network, identity, and workload layers.
  • Integrate secrets management, certificate lifecycle management, and vault solutions (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault).
  • Collaborate with AppSec and compliance teams to meet standards such as ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, SOC 2, and CIS Benchmarks.
  • Define and own the organization's SRE strategy, roadmap, and operating model, including SLI/SLO/SLA frameworks and error budget policies.
  • Design and implement observability architectures using APM tools, distributed tracing, log aggregation, and real-time alerting (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Azure Monitor).
  • Lead incident management, RCA/post-mortem processes, and drive systemic improvements to reduce MTTR and recurrence.
  • Champion chaos engineering and resilience testing practices to proactively identify failure modes before they impact production.
  • Establish toil reduction programs through automation, enabling SRE teams to focus on reliability engineering over manual operations.
  • Design high-availability, fault-tolerant architectures for distributed systems and microservices on cloud platforms.
  • Drive capacity planning, performance engineering, and scalability reviews across critical services.
  • Build Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) and self-service tooling to accelerate developer productivity while maintaining security and compliance guardrails.
  • Establish GitOps workflows for continuous delivery and configuration management at scale.
  • Oversee container orchestration strategy using Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, Rancher) and define standards for workload security, networking, and observability.
  • Guide, mentor, and upskill cross-functional DevSecOps and SRE teams, fostering a culture of reliability, security, and continuous improvement.
  • Facilitate development operations and identify gaps, setbacks, and shortcomings across processes.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to align platform strategy with organizational goals.
  • Define and track KPIs and engineering metrics (deployment frequency, change failure rate, DORA metrics, mean time to detect).
  • Deliver internal training, conduct architecture reviews, and represent the platform function in senior leadership forums.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 5-10 years of total industry experience, with 3+ years in a DevSecOps or SRE Lead role.
  • Proven track record of leading large-scale cloud-native transformation programs.
  • Certification of Cloud Platform and Infrastructure (AWS/Azure)
  • Certification of DevOps tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Ability to lead geographically distributed and cross-functional teams

Qualifications & Skills

Technical Skills

  • Cloud, Virtualization, and Infrastructure
  • Microsoft Azure, AWS, GCP, VMware, and cloud services
  • Windows Server and Linux Server administration
  • RedHat, CentOS, and Ubuntu environments
  • System sizing, software installation, maintenance, and upgrades
  • Azure / VMware backup, restore, and disaster recovery tools
  • DevOps, CI/CD, and Automation
  • DevOps pipelines and CI/CD practices
  • Bamboo, Octopus, Jenkins, Flux, and SonarQube
  • Terraform, PowerShell, Azure CLI, Shell, and Perl scripting
  • Software development and deployment automation
  • Power BI
  • Containers and Kubernetes
  • Kubernetes cluster installation, configuration, and management
  • Docker containerization
  • Containerized application deployment and operations
  • KEDA, Scale Set Operations, ISTIO
  • Networking and Directory Services
  • TCP/IP, DNS, and load balancing
  • NGINX, HAProxy
  • Active Directory, DNS configuration, Group Policy Objects, and OU structure
  • API, Architecture, and Reliability
  • Swagger and Postman
  • Mission-critical system architecture
  • High availability design
  • Performance monitoring
  • Reliable infrastructure operations

Core SRE Competencies

  • Deep expertise in secure SDLC and threat modelling
  • Experience designing SLO frameworks and error budget management
  • Strong knowledge of compliance frameworks: NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS, FIPS
  • Experience with Agile and SAFe methodologies

Preferred / Good to Have

  • Certifications: CISSP, CISM, CKA, AWS/Azure Security Specialist, Google SRE
  • Experience with AI/ML-driven DevOps automation and AIOps platforms
  • Knowledge of FinOps and cloud cost optimization strategies
  • Familiarity with Platform Engineering and Internal Developer Portals (Backstage)

Six Sigma or ITIL certification for process excellence

Required Skills

  • Devsecops
  • Python
  • SRE, Devsecops,Cloud technology, cloud cost optimzation
  • docker & Kuber

job.title: Territory Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Purpose

Lead MWM’s direct commercial development in India by identifying, developing and closing new equipment and lifecycle service opportunities with end users and other direct project stakeholders. The Territory Manager will establish MWM as a visible, technically credible and commercially responsive partner in the Indian power generation market, with priority on gas engine generator applications.

This is a direct market role.The position is not responsible for building or managing a dealership network. The successful candidate will create demand, own strategic customer relationships, and lead opportunities directly for MWM, while coordinating qualified EPCs, engineering firms, and service providers on a project-specific basis as required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own MWM’s direct sales development across India for gas engine generator sets, power modules, combined heat and power solutions, and related lifecycle offerings.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of direct opportunities with industrial end users, utilities, independent power producers, data centers, oil and gas companies, petrochemical and chemical plants, steel, cement, mining, food and beverage, textiles, pharmaceuticals, commercial infrastructure and other energy-intensive industries.
  • Develop strategic account plans for priority customers and convert market potential into qualified projects, tenders, orders and long-term customer relationships.
  • Engage early with customer decision-makers, plant engineering teams, consultants, EPC organizations and project developers to position MWM during concept development, feasibility studies, FEED and specification stages.
  • Lead the complete opportunity cycle from prospecting and qualification through application definition, solution positioning, proposal development, negotiation, order intake and structured handover.
  • Translate customer operating requirements into clear technical-commercial inputs, including fuel composition, gas pressure, site conditions, load profile, operating mode, heat recovery requirements, installation concept and commissioning expectations.
  • Coordinate closely with application engineering, quotation, project management, service, finance, legal, and commercial teams to prepare compliant and competitive solutions.
  • Lead value-based selling by quantifying customer benefits such as fuel efficiency, availability, lifecycle cost, emissions performance, operational flexibility and serviceability.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with relevant EPCs, consultants and engineering companies as project influencers and execution partners, without assigning dealer or territory rights.
  • Identify service, overhaul, long-term maintenance, upgrade, spare parts, and installed-base opportunities that strengthen customer lifecycle value.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity, forecast, customer and activity data in the company CRM system and provide clear monthly outlooks, risks, actions and market intelligence.
  • Represent MWM at targeted customer workshops, technical seminars, industry associations, conferences and exhibitions in India.
  • Monitor competitive activity, pricing dynamics, regulations, gas availability, segment trends, and customer investment plans, and convert findings into actionable sales priorities.
  • Achieve agreed order intake, revenue, margin, pipeline quality and strategic account development objectives while following internal governance and approval processes.

Target Candidate Profile

  • 8 to 12 years of progressive experience in technical B2B sales, business development or key-account management in the Indian power generation market.
  • Preferred experience with gas engine generators, reciprocating engine power plants, cogeneration or trigeneration, distributed energy, captive power, waste-to-energy, biogas, natural gas, special gas or hybrid power solutions.
  • Demonstrated success in direct selling to end users and managing complex, project-based sales cycles with multiple technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Established market access and customer relationships in one or more priority segments such as industrial captive power, oil and gas, petrochemicals, data centers, utilities, infrastructure, manufacturing or process industries.
  • Strong understanding of the Indian project ecosystem, including direct customers, EPCs, consultants, tender processes, regulatory considerations and commercial practices.
  • Ability to engage at plant, engineering, procurement, finance, and senior management levels and to build credibility with both technical and commercial decision-makers.
  • Commercial ownership, disciplined follow-up and a proven ability to progress opportunities from early-stage lead to signed order.
  • Willingness to travel extensively within India and, when required, internationally for customer meetings, factory visits, training and business reviews.

Education

Preferred degrees:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, power engineering, energy engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • B.E. or B. Tech is preferred. An M.E., MTech, or an MBA in Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or General Management is advantageous.
  • Candidates with another relevant engineering degree may be considered where supported by strong, directly relevant power-generation sales experience.

Technical and Commercial Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of gas engines, generator sets, alternators, balance of plant, electrical integration and power plant operating concepts.
  • Understanding of captive power, grid-parallel and island operation, base-load applications, CHP or CCHP, containerized and powerhouse installations, and high-ambient site conditions.
  • Ability to interpret customer specifications, single-line concepts, fuel-gas data, load profiles and technical-commercial tender requirements.
  • Competence in solution selling, financial justification, contract negotiation, risk identification, pricing discipline and stakeholder management.
  • Experience with CRM-based pipeline management and forecasting. Salesforce experience is preferred.
  • Strong written and spoken English. Proficiency in Hindi and additional Indian languages is advantageous.

Core Competencies

  • Direct customer acquisition and strategic account development
  • Technical sales and consultative value selling
  • Business development and market creation
  • Complex opportunity and tender management
  • Negotiation, commercial judgment, and closing discipline
  • Customer focus and long-term relationship management
  • Cross-functional coordination and clear communication
  • Decision-making, accountability, and structured execution
  • Market intelligence and competitive positioning
  • Forecast accuracy and CRM discipline

Measures of Success

  • Achievement of approved new equipment and service order-intake, revenue, and margin objectives.
  • Growth and quality of the qualified direct-customer pipeline.
  • Conversion of strategic opportunities and acquisition of new MWM customers in India.
  • Early specification and positioning of MWM in priority projects.
  • Development of sustainable relationships with end users, EPCs and consultants.
  • Forecast accuracy, opportunity data quality and timely execution of agreed next steps.
  • Customer satisfaction and effective coordination from opportunity development through handover.

Positioning Statement for Candidates

This role offers the opportunity to shape MWM’s direct market presence in India. It is suited to a commercially ambitious power-generation professional who wants to build strategic customer relationships, influence complex energy projects and take visible ownership of growth in one of MWM’s priority markets.

Job Description Notice

This job description is intended as a general guide to the role. It is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or effort required. The company may revise the description to address evolving business and organizational needs. Final title, grade, reporting line, targets, and employment conditions remain subject to approval by management and Human Resources.

Additional information: This job requires 5days in a week working from office.

Posting Dates:

September 9, 2026 - September 23, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilledData Specialist (Senior Data Engineer)join our Financial Systems Tech Support -CAT IT Division

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Junior Data Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have a good foundation in data engineering principles, a keen analytical mindset, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. As a Junior Data Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and infrastructure to support our organization's data needs.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN

What you will do

Data Pipeline Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines to ingest, process, and store large volumes of data from various sources.
  • Implement data workflows using ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to ensure data quality and integrity.

Data Integration and Management

  • Collaborate with data architects, product owners, business analysts, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver data solutions that meet their needs.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources, including databases, APIs, and external data providers, into a unified data platform.
  • Manage and optimize data storage solutions, ensuring efficient data retrieval and processing.

Data Quality and Governance

  • Implement data quality checks and validation processes to ensure the accuracy and consistency of data.
  • Adhere to data governance policies and best practices to maintain data security and compliance.

Performance Optimization

  • Monitor and optimize data pipeline performance to ensure timely and efficient data processing.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and system issues to maintain data pipeline reliability.

Documentation and Collaboration

  • Document data engineering processes, workflows, and solutions for future reference and knowledge sharing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making and project initiatives.

What you will have

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, data analysis, or software development.

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience on advanced SQL any Database. (Oracle, Teradata, snowflake).
  • Experience in data integration area and hands on experience in any of the ETL tools like Datastage , Informatica , Snaplogic etc.
  • Able to transform technical requirements into data collection query.
  • Should be capable of working with business and other IT teams and convert the requirements into queries.
  • Good understanding of ETL architecture and design.
  • Good knowledge in Databases, SQL, or PL/SQL
  • Good experience with CI/CD tools such as Github Actions (AzDO pipelines)
  • Good to have knowledge on Unix commands
  • Good to have an experience on AWS Glue
  • Good to have knowledge on Qlik replication tool
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.
  • Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST

Soft Skills

  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment.
  • Eagerness to learn new technologies and stay updated with industry trends.

Skills desired:

Value Realization: Knowledge of value realization methods; ability to plan, execute, monitor and manage business activities and resources to determine and achieve the actual value from a business initiative as estimated in an associated business case.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes the importance of Value Realization milestones for long-term projects.
  • Assists in measuring and attaining post-project implementation value.
  • Identifies process changes or business value integration in change initiative plans and activities.
  • Contributes to project team communication regarding the linkage of a change initiative to its associated business goals and case.

Communicating Complex Concepts: Knowledge of effective presentation tools and techniques to ensure clear understanding; ability to use summarization and simplification techniques to explain complex technical concepts in simple, clear language appropriate to the audience.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Uses comparisons to familiar ideas when introducing a technical or novel feature.
  • Separates fundamental concepts from supporting details in explaining a product or service.
  • Explains products and services with little or no use of technical jargon or advanced vocabulary.
  • Emphasizes the most important facts or features of a product or service.
  • Perceives lack of audience comprehension; further simplifies explanation when needed.

Agile Development: Knowledge of agile methodologies and the agile development lifecycle; ability to utilize formal agile methodologies, disciplines, practices and techniques for the delivery of new and enhanced applications.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Explains a specific agile process and its associated checkpoints and deliverables.
  • Works with a specific agile development methodology.
  • Interprets metrics used to measure progress and effectiveness.
  • Defines key selection and qualifying criteria for projects suitable for agile development.
  • Applies major tools and techniques associated with the specific methodology.

Cloud Computing: Knowledge of cloud-based solutions and their applications; ability to design, implement, and manage cloud-based solutions to meet business needs and improve operational efficiency.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Designs and implements a cloud-based solution to meet a specific business need or requirement.
  • Configures and deploys cloud-based infrastructure, such as virtual machines, storage, and networks.
  • Migrates applications and data to a cloud-based environment, including data migration and integration.
  • Implements cloud-based security measures, such as access controls, encryption, and firewalls.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves common cloud-based issues, such as connectivity problems and performance degradation.

Database Design (Physical): Knowledge of database systems; ability to establish a data model for designing an organization's database that runs effectively and efficiently for better business outcome.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Researches relationships between different business data sets.
  • Participates in the establishment of data structures based on their relationships.
  • Adheres to an organization's database design policies.
  • Utilizes database design tools and techniques.
  • Tests the effectiveness of the database before its release for business use.

ETL Process: Knowledge of the extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) process; ability to develop a database through the ETL process.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Loads selected data into the warehouse on a regular basis.
  • Derives necessary business or technical information from original data.
  • Acquires a large amount of data from different sources/systems.
  • Solves technical and administrative problems during the ETL process.

Information Management: Knowledge of an organization's existing and planned Information Architecture and Information Management (IM) methodology; ability to collect and manage information from different sources, and distribute this information to enhance operational efficiency.

  • Advises on improvement plans for existing and forecasted information architecture.

Modeling: Data, Process, Events, Objects: Knowledge of data, process and events; ability to use tools and techniques for analyzing and documenting logical relationships among data, processes or events.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Accountant (Finance Transformation Manager - Analytics COE)to join our COE-Accountable Reporting -Global Finance Services Division

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield, Bangalore-KA , India

What you will do

The Finance Transformation Lead plays a senior role within the Analytics Center of Excellence (COE) – Continuous Improvement (CI), accountable for shaping, leading, and delivering complex finance transformation initiatives across global finance operations.

This role is designed for a high-performing, tech‑savvy finance transformation professional with 8–12 years of experience, typically gained through management consulting, advanced analytics, finance systems, or large‑scale finance transformation programs.

The position requires strong strategic thinking, solution design capability, and stakeholder influence, acting as a trusted advisor to senior finance leaders while ensuring measurable business value delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Finance Transformation Leadership

  • Lead end‑to‑end finance transformation and CI initiatives across global finance processes, from opportunity identification through solution design, execution, and value realization.
  • Own the design of standardized, scalable, future‑state finance processes, emphasizing simplification, controls, and exception elimination rather than exception automation.
  • Shape transformation roadmaps, including initiative prioritization, investment framing, value cases, and delivery milestones.
  • Act as a design authority for finance process, analytics, and digital enablement initiatives within the CI / Analytics COE governance.

Analytics COE & Digital Enablement

  • Serve as a senior finance–analytics–technology integrator, translating business strategy into analytics, data, and system requirements.
  • Guide the use of analytics, automation, and emerging digital/AI capabilities to improve insight quality, operational efficiency, and scalability.
  • Ensure strong data governance, metric consistency, and reporting integrity across initiatives.

Stakeholder Management & Strategic Influence

  • Partner closely with GBS, Finance Leadership, Continuous Improvement Leads, Tower SMEs, Analytics teams, and IT to align transformation priorities and execution.
  • Facilitate executive‑level discussions, workshops, and decision forums using a structured, consulting‑style approach.
  • Prepare and present clear, data‑driven executive communications, including roadmaps, business cases, progress updates, and impact reporting.
  • Influence outcomes in complex, matrixed environments, often without direct authority.

Delivery Oversight & Capability Building

  • Provide direction, coaching, and informal leadership to project resources, analysts, or junior transformation roles supporting initiatives.
  • Ensure disciplined execution, risk management, and benefit tracking across the transformation portfolio.
  • Contribute to the maturation of Continuous Improvement and Analytics COE ways of working, methodologies, and playbooks.

What you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, Analytics, or a related field.
  • 8–12 years of relevant experience in one or more of the following:
  • Finance transformation or continuous improvement leadership
  • Management / finance transformation consulting
  • Advanced analytics or data‑driven finance roles
  • Finance systems, ERP, or digital transformation programs
  • Strong understanding of end‑to‑end finance processes, performance drivers, and operating models.
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross‑functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders.
  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.

Preferred Profile & Skills (Strongly Desired)

  • Senior tech‑savvy finance transformation profile, such as:
  • Former management or finance transformation consultant
  • Analytics‑led finance leader
  • Finance systems / digital transformation specialist
  • Deep data and analytics mindset: KPI design, data lineage, quality controls, and insight generation.
  • High technology literacy: strong understanding of modern finance platforms, analytics, automation, and AI enablement (hands‑on coding not required).
  • Excellent executive communication, storytelling, and change‑leadership skills.
  • Strong ability to balance strategic thinking with pragmatic execution.

Skills desired:

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices.
  • Processes large quantities of detailed information with high levels of accuracy.
  • Productively balances speed and accuracy.
  • Employs techniques for motivating personnel to meet or exceed accuracy goals.
  • Implements a variety of cross-checking approaches and mechanisms.
  • Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
  • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
  • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
  • Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
  • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Clarifies and handles multiple concurrent and diverse activities.
  • Shifts focus among several efforts as required by changing priorities.
  • Addresses potential conflicts that impact current delivery commitments.
  • Works with or leads others to re-prioritize work and reschedule commitments as necessary.
  • Responds to shifting priorities while maintaining progress of regularly scheduled work.
  • Demonstrates an expectation that there will be ongoing shifts in demands and priorities.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Accounting: Knowledge of accounting methods, processes, and tools; ability to maintain and prepare financial statements and reports using accounting methods and processes.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Utilizes cost monitoring practices, techniques and considerations.
  • Works with financial transactions and related documentation within the organization.
  • Participates in accounting practices of classifying and recording financial data.
  • Maintains existing charts of accounts.
  • Follows regulations for entering and reporting the financial content in major accounting systems.

Financial Analysis: Knowledge of tools and approaches of financial analysis; ability to read, interpret and draw accurate conclusions from financial and numerical material.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies principles used to evaluate the economics of investment decisions.
  • Interprets major types of financial statements issued by the organization.
  • Utilizes basic qualitative and quantitative tools and techniques with proficiency.
  • Works with a specific financial analysis tool set.
  • Implements valid financial analysis aligned with key criteria.

Financial Reporting: Knowledge of processes, methods, and tools of financial reporting; ability to create and maintain accurate and thorough financial reports.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows organizational practices and guidelines for product profitability reporting.
  • Analyzes errors or inaccuracies in financial reports.
  • Uses basic tools to create simple financial reports.
  • Monitors compliance with organizational standards for financial report writing.
  • Implements organizational methods and procedures for financial report writing.

Job Summary

We are seeking an IT Analyst Technical Infrastructure (OpenVMS Systems Administrator)to join our IT Infrastructure Support - CAT IT Division.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN

This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.

Shift Timing : 01:00-10:00PM IST

Position Summary

The OpenVMS Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, monitoring, and support of mission-critical OpenVMS environments supporting warehouse automation, parts distribution, and manufacturing applications across multiple global locations. This role provides operational support for both physical OpenVMS Integrity servers and emulated OpenVMS environments hosted on Vere Technologies virtual servers, ensuring high availability, system performance, security, and business continuity for critical enterprise applications.

Key Responsibilities

OpenVMS Infrastructure Administration

  • Administer and maintain a production OpenVMS Cluster
  • Monitor and maintain OpenVMS operating systems and associated layered products.
  • Plan, test, and implement operating system upgrades, patches, and software updates.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and application-related issues.
  • Perform performance analysis and capacity planning activities.
  • Coordinate maintenance activities to minimize operational impact.

Virtual OpenVMS Environment Support

  • Administer emulated OpenVMS servers
  • Apply upgrades, patches, and software maintenance to Vere Technologies platforms and supporting infrastructure.
  • Monitor virtual host performance and resource utilization.

User and Security Administration

  • Create, modify, and disable OpenVMS user accounts according to approved access requests.
  • Manage user privileges and security settings in accordance with company policies.
  • Support audit and compliance requirements related to system access and security controls.

System Monitoring and Operations

  • Monitor system health, availability, and performance across all OpenVMS environments.
  • Manage and monitor:
  • Disk capacity and utilization
  • Printer queues
  • Batch processing queues
  • System backups and recovery processes
  • Investigate and resolve operational incidents and system alerts.
  • Maintain documentation for procedures, configurations, and system changes.

Backup and Disaster Recovery

  • Execute and validate backup procedures for physical and virtual OpenVMS systems.
  • Support disaster recovery testing and recovery planning activities.
  • Ensure backup integrity and data recoverability.

Global Support

  • Provide infrastructure support for multiple business applications, including the widely utilized CAPP+ application environment.
  • Collaborate with application teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and infrastructure teams to resolve system issues and implement enhancements.
  • Support global business operations requiring high system availability and reliability.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Extensive experience administering OpenVMS operating systems.
  • Experience supporting OpenVMS Cluster environments.
  • Knowledge of OpenVMS system management, storage, user administration, and security.
  • Experience applying operating system patches, upgrades, and software maintenance.
  • Experience managing backups, disaster recovery processes, and system monitoring.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical production environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with HPE Integrity Server hardware.
  • Experience with Vere Technologies OpenVMS emulation solutions.
  • Knowledge of warehouse management systems and automated material handling environments.
  • Experience supporting global enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with high-availability and business continuity practices.
  • Experience working in manufacturing, logistics, or parts distribution environments.

Key Competencies

  • Infrastructure Administration
  • OpenVMS Systems Management
  • Cluster Administration
  • Incident Management
  • Change Management
  • Performance Monitoring
  • Capacity Planning
  • Disaster Recovery
  • Problem Solving
  • Technical Documentation
  • Customer Service
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

Scope of Responsibility

  • Supports a few physical OpenVMS Integrity servers, including a production OpenVMS Cluster and test environment.
  • Supports several emulated OpenVMS servers hosted on 9 Vere Technologies virtual servers.
  • Maintains Vere Technologies license servers.
  • Supports international locations across North America, South America, Europe, and Australia.
  • Provides operational support for mission-critical warehouse automation and parts distribution systems that directly impact order fulfillment and business operations.

**Skill Descriptors

Technical Excellence:** Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
  • Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components.
  • Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services.
  • Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence.
  • Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues.

Technology Advising: Knowledge of effective advisory methods and ability to provide valued information and advice to clients regarding products, technologies, services and solutions for a specific technology domain.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Assesses the current technology environment, expressed needs and initiatives of client organizations.
  • Uses an effective consulting method to present technology solutions that resolve stated client business issues.
  • Advises clients regarding a family of specific products, technologies or services in a technology domain.
  • Demonstrates basic competence and sound business knowledge regarding specific products, technologies or services within a domain of technology expertise.
  • Achieves consulting relationship rating of 'professional' by delivering timely, meaningful advice meeting client needs in a narrow set of specific technologies.

Hardware Infrastructure: Knowledge of computer architecture and systems programming; ability to design, build and integrate IT hardware into multi-platforms for the organization.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Assists in integrating IT hardware with the organization's existing systems.
  • Participates in the implementation of IT hardware within the organization.
  • Tracks operational problems related to IT hardware and reports them directly to the supervisor.
  • Assists in designing the main features of IT hardware according to business needs.
  • Compares IT hardware across one's own organization and its competitors.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
  • Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
  • Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
  • Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
  • Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Evaluates system documentation and user manuals for usability, accuracy and completeness.
  • Executes test cases, analyzes test results and reports on findings regularly.
  • Tests system components for compliance with functional requirements.
  • Participates in the testing of a system's ability to recover from hardware or software failures.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Demonstrates planned software changes on the local environment.

  • Analyzes the local software architecture components and products.
  • Tests key features for the entire software infrastructure environment.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
  • Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
  • Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
  • Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
  • Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

Technical Writing/Documentation: Knowledge of technical writing; ability to write technical documents such as manuals, reports, guidelines or documents on standards, processes and applications.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Prepares written text and layout of materials according to required outlines and specifications.
  • Completes and maintains technical reference documents.
  • Uses the major features, functions and facilities of an automated documentation tool.
  • Coordinates and constantly updates system operations, installations, service manuals, and help documents.

job.title: Senior Client Acquisition Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Challenger Sales Representative to join our team. As a Challenger, you will play a key role in driving sales growth by challenging customers' thinking, providing valuable insights, and guiding them toward innovative solutions. The ideal candidate is assertive, confident, and excels in complex sales environments.

  • Challenge customer assumptions by proactively engage customers in thought-provoking conversations to challenge their assumptions and broaden their perspective.
  • Provide new insights and industry knowledge that position our products/services as innovative solutions.
  • Lead sales discussions with confidence and take control of the conversation to guide customers through the decision-making process.
  • Conduct in-depth research to understand the customer's business, needs, and challenges.
  • Tailor solutions to address specific customer pain points and demonstrate a deep understanding of their unique requirements.
  • Act as an educator by teaching customers something new about their industry, market trends, or potential areas for improvement.
  • Provide valuable insights that position our offerings as strategic assets.
  • Build and maintain long-term partnerships and develop trusted advisor relationships with key executives and stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
  • Holds ownership of bigger sized portfolio revenue and account matrix.
  • Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of new opportunities, present, negotiate and close to meet sales quotas.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional internal departments to ensure that clients requirements are understood and met.
  • Assist with challenging client request or issue escalation as needed.

Requirements

  • At least Diploma in any discipline with preference for technology related discipline and minimum 6 years’ sales experience in telco and solutions selling
  • In-depth knowledge of telco & system integrator environment will be preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge customer thinking and provide unique insights tailored to the specific needs and challenges of enterprise and government clients.
  • Strong understanding of complex sales cycles and the ability to navigate procurement processes within enterprise and government organizations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and establish trust at the executive level.
  • Confidence in leading sales conversations and taking control of the sales process, especially in engagements with enterprise or government decision-makers.
  • Proven success in meeting or exceeding sales targets in a service-oriented and solution-based sales environment.

job.title: Genesys Cloud Technical Architect
job.description:
Job Summary

As a Genesys Technical Architect, you will be responsible for defining, designing and governing the technical architecture of the global Genesys Cloud contact center platform. The role will translate business and operational requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable Genesys Cloud solutions across Universal UI, voice, digital channels, routing, IVR, integrations, reporting and automation capabilities. You will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, service owners, integration teams, vendors and delivery teams to ensure architecture quality, platform standardization, solution consistency and successful implementation of Genesys capabilities across regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the end-to-end technical architecture for Genesys Cloud contact center solutions, ensuring alignment with global platform standards, business requirements and enterprise architecture principles.
  • Design scalable Genesys Cloud solutions across IVR, call flows, queues, routing strategies, skills, data tables, callbacks, voicemail, digital channels, workforce management, analytics and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Lead technical solution design for integrations between Genesys Cloud and enterprise systems such as CRM, ServiceNow, SAP, Microsoft Teams, identity management, reporting platforms and middleware solutions.
  • Translate business processes, customer journeys and operational needs into technical designs, architecture documents, configuration blueprints and implementation guidelines.
  • Provide technical leadership to delivery teams during configuration, development, testing, deployment and transition to operations for new Genesys features and enhancements.
  • Review and validate solution designs, integration patterns, security controls, data flows, API usage and configuration changes to ensure stability, performance, maintainability and compliance.
  • Missing Telco Architecture capability – Technical knowledge & setup, Global geo capability of legal laws/regulation
  • Internal SHS Infra setup – know-how & understanding
  • Integration Architecture – Data Lake / DB (Snowflake/SQL/Azure), Pipeline (Snaplogic) & other middleware with source
  • Support complex technical issue resolution by analyzing platform behavior, integration failures, routing logic, call flow defects, performance concerns and configuration dependencies.
  • Maintain technical architecture documentation, reusable design patterns, standards, decision logs and roadmap inputs for continuous platform evolution.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Strong hands-on experience in Genesys Cloud architecture, configuration and implementation for enterprise contact center environments.
  • Deep understanding of Genesys Cloud capabilities including Architect call flows, IVR, ACD routing, skill-based routing, bullseye routing, queues, users, roles, divisions, scripts, wrap-up codes and reporting.
  • Experience designing omnichannel contact center solutions across voice, email, chat, messaging, SMS, callbacks, voicemail and digital engagement channels.
  • Strong knowledge of Genesys Cloud APIs, integration patterns, event-driven architecture, authentication, SCIM/user provisioning, data actions and middleware-based integrations.
  • Experience integrating Genesys Cloud with CRM, ITSM, ERP, Microsoft Teams, identity platforms, data lake, analytics or reporting solutions.
  • Good understanding of cloud architecture, security, network connectivity, telephony concepts, SIP, SBC, BYOC/Cloud Voice concepts and enterprise identity management.
  • Ability to create technical architecture documents, solution designs, sequence flows, integration specifications, test support documentation and operational handover materials.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder & project management skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions, risks and trade-offs to business, IT and vendor stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Telecommunications or a related technical discipline.
  • 8-10 years of overall IT experience, including significant experience in contact center technology, cloud platform architecture or enterprise communications solutions.
  • Minimum 4-5 years of practical experience with Genesys Cloud or Genesys PureCloud implementation, configuration, architecture or technical leadership.
  • Genesys Cloud certifications such as Genesys Cloud Certified Professional, Architect or Developer are preferred.
  • Experience with integration platforms and cloud technologies such as Azure, AWS, Snaplogic, REST APIs, JSON, JavaScript or similar technologies is an advantage.
  • Experience working in global transformation programs, multi-country rollouts, managed service environments or distributed delivery teams is preferred.
  • Experience working with managed service providers, platform vendors and distributed support teams across multiple countries and time zones.

job.title: Application Specialist SPDM
job.description:
At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse talent with technical acumen to develop tomorrow’s reality. With Engineering Enterprise Apps and Engineering AI solutions, we are uniquely positioned to have an immediate impact on the transformation at our customers to leverage the full value of their simulation analyses and data and AI – and create much better products much faster.

About the role

The Application Specialists team is an essential component of the Engineering Enterprise Apps & Engineering AI product management team by offering top-tier expertise in the solution portfolio as well as the key industry sectors and applications. With the team of application specialists we develop advanced workflows and best practices that boost our customers' productivity. Such workflows and best practices will directly impact our ability to accelerate sales cycles in pre-sales context, as well as being an essential instrument to achieve effective customer adoption and hence create expansion opportunities at our customers.

The work involves connecting the relevant product lines from the Simcenter portfolio, fostering advanced technical thought leadership, and maximizing the visibility and business success of the Simcenter portfolio.

Responsibilities

As Application Specialist you stand in the center of a continuously evolving solution portfolio bringing new features & functionalities with every release, and the dynamics of an equally fast evolving market where new trends and opportunities arise as a result of emerging new technology. The challenge of the application specialist will be to understand our customers’ current and future challenges and to articulate the value of the EEA portfolio through well documented, industry-relevant, example use cases that show our customer the potential of advancing their ways of working with our EEA portfolio.

You will look across the boundaries of individual products and will be able to identify synergies and opportunities for improvement at the interface of our technologies so as to deliver a seamless experience for our end users.

Activities also include

  • Supporting portfolio developers, business development teams, sales and pre-sales teams in customer pursuits with dedicated Proof-of-Concept development and demonstration
  • Relaying customer and market needs and trends to the product management teams
  • Act as a sounding board to the product management teams for new requirement / specification development
  • Active stakeholder in product milestone demonstrations, technical enablement, etc
  • Assisting in the development of collateral for the relevant campaigns and technical marketing initiatives
  • Participating and presenting at internal and external webinars, seminars and user conferences
  • Promoting the portfolio through writing blog posts, posting videos, contributing in discussion forums etc.

Your qualifications

We are looking for someone who is an excellent communicator and capable of translating a value proposition and associated content at the level of different audience. You are self-organized and know how to handle incoming requests from many different angles and varying priority, while creating high-quality deliverables. You are a permanent learner – whether product, market, trends, you stay up to date and well informed.

Specific qualifications we will be looking for :

  • Extensive expertise as application engineer in simulation ; leveraging AI, data and data management, and simulation process orchestration as tools
  • Hands-on experience with Siemens’ Simcenter EEA portfolio is a plus
  • Hands-on experience in engineering verification and validation processes, through simulation and/or physical testing in either automotive, aerospace or defense industry. Awareness about the value of traceable, correctly annotated data to support reuse and improve efficiency and quality of results.
  • Strong written, communication and presentation skills in English
  • Knowledge of applicable solutions for documenting engineering workflows (SolutionLink, …) is a plus
  • Able to travel occasionally

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

At Siemens, we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds

Our Benefits & Rewards

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the SIEMENS Benefit [link](http://https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/).

The primary locations for this opportunity are Romania, Belgium, and India. The applicable salary ranges for these locations are:

Romania: RON 145.300 – RON 276.000

Belgium: €53.500 – €96.300

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees (benefits availability varies by country).

This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

job.title: Application Specialist SPDM
job.description:
At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse talent with technical acumen to develop tomorrow’s reality. With Engineering Enterprise Apps and Engineering AI solutions, we are uniquely positioned to have an immediate impact on the transformation at our customers to leverage the full value of their simulation analyses and data and AI – and create much better products much faster.

Let's make the difference together!

About the role

The Application Specialists team is an essential component of the Engineering Enterprise Apps & Engineering AI product management team by offering top-tier expertise in the solution portfolio as well as the key industry sectors and applications. With the team of application specialists we develop advanced workflows and best practices that boost our customers' productivity. Such workflows and best practices will directly impact our ability to accelerate sales cycles in pre-sales context, as well as being an essential instrument to achieve effective customer adoption and hence create expansion opportunities at our customers.

The work involves connecting the relevant product lines from the Simcenter portfolio, fostering advanced technical thought leadership, and maximizing the visibility and business success of the Simcenter portfolio.

Responsibilities

As Application Specialist you stand in the center of a continuously evolving solution portfolio bringing new features & functionalities with every release, and the dynamics of an equally fast evolving market where new trends and opportunities arise as a result of emerging new technology. The challenge of the application specialist will be to understand our customers’ current and future challenges and to articulate the value of the EEA portfolio through well documented, industry-relevant, example use cases that show our customer the potential of advancing their ways of working with our EEA portfolio.

You will look across the boundaries of individual products and will be able to identify synergies and opportunities for improvement at the interface of our technologies so as to deliver a seamless experience for our end users.

Activities also include

  • Supporting portfolio developers, business development teams, sales and pre-sales teams in customer pursuits with dedicated Proof-of-Concept development and demonstration
  • Relaying customer and market needs and trends to the product management teams
  • Act as a sounding board to the product management teams for new requirement / specification development
  • Active stakeholder in product milestone demonstrations, technical enablement, etc
  • Assisting in the development of collateral for the relevant campaigns and technical marketing initiatives
  • Participating and presenting at internal and external webinars, seminars and user conferences
  • Promoting the portfolio through writing blog posts, posting videos, contributing in discussion forums etc.

Your qualifications

We are looking for someone who is an excellent communicator and capable of translating a value proposition and associated content at the level of different audience. You are self-organized and know how to handle incoming requests from many different angles and varying priority, while creating high-quality deliverables. You are a permanent learner – whether product, market, trends, you stay up to date and well informed.

Specific qualifications we will be looking for :

  • 10+ years expertise as application engineer in simulation ; leveraging AI, data and data management, and simulation process orchestration as tools
  • Hands-on experience with Siemens’ Simcenter EEA portfolio is a plus
  • Hands-on experience in engineering verification and validation processes, through simulation and/or physical testing in either automotive, aerospace or defense industry. Awareness about the value of traceable, correctly annotated data to support reuse and improve efficiency and quality of results.
  • Strong written, communication and presentation skills in English
  • Knowledge of applicable solutions for documenting engineering workflows (SolutionLink, …) is a plus
  • Able to travel occasionally

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

At Siemens, we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds

Our Benefits & Rewards

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. job.title: Member Technical Staff
job.description:
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

Position Overview

Join our Noida center as a Member of Technical Staff and become part of a dynamic team impacting innovation at a global scale. You'll work in a high-growth environment with an exceptional learning curve, collaborating with teams that push the boundaries of Electronic Design Automation. This is your opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge software solutions while developing expertise in one of the tech industry's most exciting domains.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop robust software solutions using C/C++ and modern design patterns to support EDA product features
  • Design and implement efficient data structures and algorithms to enhance product performance and user experience
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand complex product requirements and translate them into technical implementations
  • Contribute to the architecture and optimization of graph-based algorithms for EDA applications
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain high standards of code quality and best practices
  • Take ownership of assigned features while supporting team members in a collaborative environment

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Computer Science from a reputed engineering institution
  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming languages with solid understanding of design patterns, data structures, and algorithms
  • Knowledge of graph algorithms and their practical applications in software development
  • Ability to understand and work with complex software products, solutions, and architectural problems
  • Self-motivated with strong integrity, discipline, and commitment to continuous learning
  • Team player with excellent communication skills and a collaborative approach to problem-solving
  • Experience in EDA or semiconductor software development (preferred)

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We do not discriminate based on any race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. Support H2R operations with a focus on Employee Data Management (EDM), ensuring accurate HR transactions, SLA adherence, and a seamless employee experience using HR systems.

You’ll make a difference by:

  • Manage EDM in Workday & ServiceNow
  • Process HR cases within SLAs
  • Handle HR admin requests and ensure data accuracy
  • Prepare governance reports and MIS
  • Conduct trainings and quality audits
  • Support process improvements and BAU activities
  • Resolve employee queries with a customer-focused approach

Your success is grounded in:

  • 7years–10 years in H2R / Employee Lifecycle as SME
  • 4years–5 years in EDM as SME
  • Graduate in any discipline
  • Strong communication & problem-solving skills
  • Preferred to have Middle East / Africa experience.
  • Knowledge of H2R and HR operations
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  • Experience with Workday, ServiceNow, SAP or HCM tools
  • Strong attention to detail and stakeholder management

Join us and be yourself!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

This role is based in Bangalore. You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

job.title: Cybersecurity & Compliance Advisor
job.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a Cybersecurity & Compliance Advisor to strengthen cybersecurity governance, risk management, and compliance capabilities across business functions and digital solutions. The role will serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, technology teams, and leadership by ensuring cybersecurity requirements, regulatory obligations, and corporate policies are effectively integrated into business operations and digital programs.

The Cybersecurity & Compliance Advisor will assess security risks, define mitigation strategies, support compliance initiatives, and guide teams through security assurance activities across cloud, enterprise, and operational technology environments. The position requires strong expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, security controls, risk management, and regulatory compliance, combined with the ability to translate technical requirements into practical business solutions.

This is a highly collaborative role requiring effective stakeholder engagement, governance leadership, and the ability to drive security awareness and compliance maturity across global and cross-functional teams.

A Snapshot of your Day

A typical day involves collaborating with project teams, solution architects, IT leaders, and business stakeholders to evaluate cybersecurity risks and compliance requirements for ongoing initiatives. You review security assessments, advise on remediation activities, and ensure controls align with enterprise standards and regulatory obligations.

You may participate in governance reviews, support audits, assess cloud and application security designs, and provide recommendations that enable secure business operations while balancing productivity, innovation, and risk management objectives.

How You’ll Make an Impact (responsibilities of role)

Strategic

  • Develop and promote cybersecurity governance frameworks, policies, standards, and controls that align with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise business and technology leaders on cybersecurity risks, compliance obligations, and security-by-design principles during digital transformation initiatives.
  • Drive cybersecurity risk management programs by identifying emerging threats, assessing business impact, and recommending pragmatic mitigation strategies.
  • Support the development and execution of compliance roadmaps to improve organizational security maturity and regulatory readiness.
  • Partner with stakeholders to establish security requirements for enterprise applications, cloud services, operational systems, and third-party solutions.
  • Monitor cybersecurity trends, industry standards, and evolving regulations, ensuring the organization remains aligned with best practices and compliance expectations.
  • Promote security awareness and foster a culture of accountability for cybersecurity and data protection throughout the organization.

Operational

  • Conduct security risk assessments, control reviews, and compliance evaluations across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, and operational processes.
  • Support internal and external audits by coordinating evidence collection, control validation, remediation tracking, and compliance reporting.
  • Review solution architectures, project designs, and implementation plan to identify security gaps and recommend appropriate controls.
  • Perform vendor and third-party security assessments to evaluate cybersecurity posture and contractual compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to implement security controls related to identity management, data protection, network security, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Track cybersecurity findings, vulnerabilities, and compliance deviations while driving corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support incident investigations, root cause analysis, and lessons learned activities from a governance and compliance perspective.
  • Maintain cybersecurity documentation, risk registers, policy records, and compliance artifacts to support governance and auditability.

What You Bring (required qualification and skill sets)

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security governance, compliance, risk management, or related advisory roles.
  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and industry standards such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, IEC 62443, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting compliance programs related to data privacy, information security, cloud security, and regulatory requirements.
  • Proven ability to conduct security risk assessments, define mitigation plans, and communicate risk decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with enterprise security controls including identity and access management, data protection, security monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles across Azure, AWS, or hybrid environments.
  • Experience collaborating with global cross-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to balance security requirements with operational and business objectives while driving practical outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CCSP, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity requirements within industrial, energy, engineering, manufacturing, or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Knowledge of Operational Technology (OT) security and industrial cybersecurity controls.
  • Familiarity with data privacy regulations and compliance frameworks such as GDPR and related international standards.
  • Experience with security governance platforms, GRC solutions, and audit management tools.
  • Exposure to DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle methodologies.
  • Experience leading cybersecurity awareness initiatives, compliance assessments, or regulatory audits at enterprise scale.

Tech Stack

  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC): ServiceNow GRC, RSA Archer, MetricStream, or similar platforms for risk management, control monitoring, and audit readiness.
  • Cloud Security: Microsoft Azure Security Center, Microsoft Defender, AWS Security Services, and cloud governance solutions to manage security posture and compliance.
  • Identity & Access Management: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Privileged Access Management, RBAC, and multi-factor authentication technologies.
  • Security Monitoring & Threat Detection: SIEM and security analytics platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, or equivalent solutions.
  • Vulnerability & Risk Management: Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, or similar solutions for vulnerability assessment, remediation tracking, and risk reporting.
  • Compliance & Audit Management: Policy management, evidence collection, control testing, and regulatory reporting tools supporting governance activities.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Power BI, and ServiceNow for stakeholder engagement, reporting, and governance workflows.
  • Methodologies & Frameworks: ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, IEC 62443, Risk Management Frameworks, and Security-by-Design principles.
