job.title: Bid Leader - Data Centres
job.description:
Bid Leader – Data Centres

Australia’s data centre market is growing at an unprecedented pace, and Siemens is playing a key role in powering the infrastructure behind the digital economy. Through our Electrification & Automation business, we deliver advanced power distribution, automation, digitalisation and energy solutions that help hyperscale, colocation and enterprise customers build resilient, sustainable and high-performing data centres.

We’re looking for an experienced Bid Leader to take ownership of complex data centre bids across Australia and help turn major opportunities into successful projects.

This is a high-impact role where you’ll sit at the intersection of Sales, Engineering and Project Delivery, shaping winning strategies and bringing together the people, technology and commercial thinking needed to deliver compelling proposals.

What you’ll do

You’ll lead the bid process from opportunity qualification through to submission and handover, with responsibility for:

  • Leading end-to-end bids for complex data centre opportunities, managing multiple submissions and competing deadlines.
  • Partnering with Sales to develop winning strategies, positioning, differentiators and value propositions.
  • Bringing teams together, coordinating Engineering, Procurement, Legal, Finance and Project Delivery inputs.
  • Developing technically robust and commercially competitive proposals that showcase Siemens’ capabilities.
  • Working across MV switchgear, integrated power systems and digital solutions to develop customer-focused solutions.
  • Driving clarity around scope, interfaces, assumptions, risks and commercial requirements.
  • Ensuring a smooth transition from bid to project delivery, setting projects up for successful execution.
  • Using market and competitive insights to improve win rates and strengthen future bids.
  • Helping standardise bid processes, templates and tools to support a growing data centre pipeline.

What you’ll bring

You’ll be an experienced bid, proposal or commercial professional who enjoys working in complex, fast-moving environments.

  • Experience in bid management, proposals or commercial management within complex infrastructure or electrical projects.
  • Strong exposure to data centres, utilities or other mission-critical environments.
  • Understanding of MV/LV electrical systems and EPC delivery models.
  • Strong commercial capability across pricing, contracts and risk.
  • The ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management and organisational skills.
  • A tertiary qualification in Engineering, Business or a related discipline is preferred.

What will make you successful?

You’re someone who takes ownership and enjoys winning.

You can move comfortably between strategic conversations with Sales and customers and the detail required to deliver a high-quality submission.

You’ll bring:

  • A commercial and strategic mindset.
  • Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture.
  • The ability to work under pressure and deliver to tight deadlines.
  • A customer-focused approach and the ability to understand what matters to the client.
  • The drive to continuously improve how we approach and deliver bids.

Industry experience

  • Experience across the Australian data centre ecosystem — including hyperscale, colocation, Tier 1 contractors or mission-critical engineering — will be highly regarded.

Why Siemens?

You’ll join a business that is helping shape one of Australia’s fastest-growing infrastructure markets.

You’ll have the opportunity to work on major data centre projects, collaborate with leading industry players and contribute to solutions that are critical to the digital economy.

We genuinely value our people and are committed to their wellbeing, growth and development. You’ll enjoy additional leave, dedicated time for personal development and the support of a high-performing, collaborative team.

Our commitment to you

Siemens is committed to an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to contribute, develop and succeed. We value diversity and strive to create a safe, supportive environment where everyone feels respected and heard.

If you require any reasonable accommodations or adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

job.title: Project Engineer - Data Centres
job.description:
Build the future with Siemens

At Siemens, we’re building more than world-class technology - we’re creating a workplace where people feel valued, supported and empowered to do their best work.

We’re looking for an experienced Project Engineer - Electrical & Modular Systems to join our growing team, working on complex MV and LV electrical systems, modular units, E-Houses and skids supporting critical infrastructure and data centre projects.

You’ll work across electrical, mechanical and cooling systems, collaborating with talented engineers, project teams, customers and suppliers to deliver high-quality solutions.

A culture that puts people first

At Siemens, we genuinely care about our people. We believe a positive and rewarding culture is fundamental to doing great work, which is why we place a strong focus on employee wellbeing, development and growth.

You’ll join a supportive and collaborative team where your contribution is valued, with access to training, hands-on experience and fantastic career opportunities both locally and globally. Whether you want to deepen your technical expertise, take on greater project responsibility or explore international opportunities, your career can grow with us.

What will you be doing?

You’ll play a key role in the design, coordination and delivery of MV and LV electrical systems and modular solutions, including:

  • Managing project engineering and delivery processes from design through to installation and commissioning support.
  • Working with customers to understand requirements and develop fit-for-purpose solutions.
  • Leading electrical design activities and preparing technical documentation and drawings.
  • Developing LV electrical designs including main switchboards, distribution boards and control panels.
  • Producing Single Line Diagrams, termination diagrams, General Arrangements, detailed designs and as-built documentation.
  • Coordinating electrical, mechanical and cooling interfaces across modular systems, E-Houses and skids.
  • Managing technical interfaces with customers, suppliers, subcontractors and internal teams.
  • Reviewing designs against project requirements, Siemens processes and relevant Australian/New Zealand standards.
  • Supporting Factory Acceptance Testing, installation and commissioning activities.
  • Providing technical support to project and package managers and customers.
  • Identifying and mitigating technical and design risks while maintaining a strong focus on quality and HSEQ.
  • Preparing project reports, technical documentation and operation and maintenance manuals.

What will you bring?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong technical capability with a collaborative and practical approach.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • Experience in electrical engineering, design or project engineering.
  • Strong knowledge of LV electrical systems and relevant Australian/New Zealand standards, including AS/NZS 61439.
  • Experience working across multidisciplinary engineering environments.
  • Experience with electrical design software and 2D/3D design packages.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A flexible, practical and results-oriented approach.
  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced project environment.
  • A willingness to travel occasionally to customer and production locations, including interstate and internationally where required.

Experience within the data centre or other mission-critical infrastructure sectors would be highly regarded.

Why Siemens?

Because your career is about more than your next job.

You’ll join a global technology leader with the scale and expertise to make a real difference, while being part of a team that genuinely cares about its people. With a strong focus on wellbeing, learning and development, you’ll have the opportunity to work on exciting projects while building a career that can take you places.

Diversity is one of our strengths. At Siemens, we value different perspectives, experiences and ideas and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to bring their authentic selves to work. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

Join Siemens and build a career where you can do meaningful work, keep learning and grow with a team that has your back.

job.title: Project Manager - Data Centres
job.description:
As Australia's digital economy continues to accelerate, Siemens is playing a critical role in enabling the next generation of data centre infrastructure. Through our Electrification & Automation business, we deliver innovative power distribution, automation, digitalisation and energy solutions that help hyperscale, colocation and enterprise customers build resilient, sustainable and high-performing facilities.

Siemens are looking for a highly experienced Data Centre Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of integrated power solutions across Australia's rapidly growing data centre market. Sitting within Siemens' Electrification & Automation business, you'll drive end-to-end project excellence, technical quality, and customer satisfaction across mission-critical infrastructure — delivering resilient, high-performance solutions aligned to global standards and local market needs. The successful candidate will be responsible for:

  • Leading end-to-end delivery of large-scale data centre projects, ensuring scope, schedule, cost, and quality objectives are consistently achieved across multiple concurrent programs
  • Overseeing the full lifecycle of MV switchgear and integrated power distribution systems, from design through to commissioning, maintaining best-practice standards in testing and lifecycle performance
  • Building and maintain senior relationships with data centre developers, contractors, and operators — acting as a trusted advisor and leading contract negotiations, variation management, and commercial discussions
  • Building and develop a high-performing team, coaching emerging leaders and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Leveraging digital tools, data insights, and automation to enhance productivity and enable smarter project execution
  • Championing a zero-harm safety culture, ensuring full compliance with Siemens and Australian regulatory standards

You'll have proven experience in project or program leadership within the data centre, utilities, or mission-critical infrastructure sector, with a strong track record delivering MV/LV electrical systems including switchgear, protection, and control. You're experienced in EPC delivery models and complex stakeholder environments, with a deep understanding of Australian standards, grid connections, and data centre design requirements. A tertiary qualification in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline is preferred.

You take ownership of outcomes across all project phases and thrive in high-pressure, mission-critical environments. You balance immediate delivery priorities with long-term growth opportunities, bring cross-functional teams together to achieve shared goals, and communicate with influence across executive stakeholders and diverse teams. You hold yourself to uncompromising standards in safety, engineering, and delivery.

A strong network across the Australian data centre ecosystem — spanning hyperscale providers, colocation operators, Tier 1 contractors, and mission-critical engineering consultants — will be a significant advantage in this role.

Siemens are committed to ensuring our workplace reflects the communities in which we operate, that everyone has access to the same opportunities and is treated fairly, and that we actively empower the voices of every individual voice.

P&O People Partner

**

As a P&O People Partner (f/m/d), you'll serve as the "eyes and ears" of our people, becoming the trusted point of contact for our people and leaders alike on all P&O-related topics for which human touch really matters to create a consistent people experience across the organization.   • Driving compliance and alignment: You proactively ensure local compliance with labor laws, P&O policies and regulatory requirements, safeguarding the organization and its people by collaborating closely with people representatives and adapting global policies to local needs only where required.

Drive the simplification and harmonization of policies and processes in collaboration with GBS H2R, enabling both AI adoption and automation while balancing digital and human-centered approaches. Guide workforce planning and organizational decisions related to AI adoption, productivity improvements, evolving skill requirements, and organizational transformation.

This is how you'll win us over

  • Excellent academic background, ideally in Business Administration, Human Resources or a related field.
  • 8-12 years of P&O experience in a global, dynamic environment.
  • Solid expertise and the ability to manage sensitive and complex people relations matters with integrity, emotional intelligence and professionalism.

  • Deep understanding of compliance frameworks, labor laws, employee relations and local regulatory requirements.

  • Clear and confident communicator and team player.
  • Proactive approach to personal and professional growth, using supportive networks for development.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

**Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. **At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.

About us

We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

job.title: OpenShift Platform Expert
job.description:
Hello Visionary!

We know that the only way a business thrive is if our people are growing. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

We are looking for a OpenShift Platform Expert

You’ll make a difference by:

  • As an OpenShift Platform Expert, you'll be at the forefront of installing, operating, and supporting container platforms in a sophisticated hybrid architecture spanning Siemens high-security data centers, EDGE environments, and public cloud. Your work will ensure the security and operational availability of critical IT services and applications across Siemens AG – even during prolonged disaster situations.
  • Install, migrate, and configure highly critical and complex OpenShift clusters for container and virtualization workloads across various hardware and software technologies
  • Implement project-specific customizations for tailored products and optimize performance while ensuring compliance with corporate requirements
  • Integrate IT subsystems into the overall system architecture, including central identity management
  • Independently develop automation and self-service functions using Advanced Cluster Management, Ansible Automation Platform, ArgoCD, Git, GitOps, HP-OO, and other tools
  • Continuously optimize business processes and maintain comprehensive documentation
  • Drive DevOps initiatives with CI/CD pipelines using Tekton and Jenkins
  • Harden and monitor deployed solutions according to company guidelines and industry best practices
  • Implement SELinux, iptables, and scanning tools for operating systems and container images
  • Ensure compliance using tools like Sysdig and Qualys
  • Provide expert guidance on storage providers (Trident, OpenShift Data Foundation, Container Storage Interface) and network interfaces for containerized/virtualized services
  • Advise on server/network architecture, software configurations, and applications (Apache Kafka, Postgres, MongoDB, Kong, SAP, Oracle, etc.)
  • Support DevOps teams in deploying containerized applications and debugging "12 factor apps"
  • Manage operation, administration, and configuration of container platforms while maintaining availability, integrity, and confidentiality
  • Handle complex problems with containers and virtualized infrastructures independently
  • Analyze and resolve performance issues to meet business needs and high service levels
  • Integrate solutions into operational environments (Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call duty to ensure continuous operations

You’ll win us over by:

  • BE - Electrical, Electronics & Communications or Instrumentation Engineering with 5-9 years of experience administering high-availability solutions in IT environments, 3-5 years of hands-on experience with virtual infrastructures (VMware or OpenShift) and container solutions with OpenShift
  • Experience in Container solutions: OpenShift 4.x and above
  • Virtual solutions: OpenShift 4.x and aboveCluster management: RedHat Advanced Cluster Management
  • Operating systems: RedHat Linux (RedHat CoreOS V8.x-V10.x, RHEL V8.x-V10.x), SUSE-Linux (SLES V15.x – SLES V16.x)
  • Storage management: Linux LVM, ODF, Trident
  • Platform and container hardening: Sysdig, Qualys
  • Cloud solutions: AWS
  • Programming/automation: Shell, Perl, Python, Ansible, HP-OO, Operators, Helm, Terraform, GitOps
  • High availability solutions, Firewall, Routing & Proxy, Analytical capabilities and ITIL
  • Technical English for communication with management, customers, and suppliers
  • DevOps support: CI/CD with Tekton, Jenkins, 12 Factor Apps
  • Willingness to participate in 24/7 on-call duty due to high-availability requirements
  • Flexibility to work shifts across different time zones
  • Strong presentation and communication skills
  • Self-directed approach to continuous learning and professional development

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!

This role is based in Pune, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

job.title: P&O Business Partner- Grid Technology
job.description:
Looking for challenging role? If you really want to make a difference - make it with us

At Siemens Energy India Limited, we are more than just an energy technology company. We develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in Siemens Energy’s research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Siemens Energy’s global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Your new role – challenging and future-oriented

Key Responsibilities:Business Partnering – Grid Technologies

  • Serve as the primary P&O partner for teams based at the New Mumbai Office, supporting talent, performance, and people priorities aligned to business agenda.
  • Collaborate closely with the GT - P&O Lead and other associated BP’s to translate people strategy into executable plans and ensure consistent follow-through at the NMO level.
  • Support business reviews, leadership connects, and talent discussions with structured P&O inputs, workforce data, and actionable insights.
  • Drive specific P&O cycles including performance management, talent reviews, succession planning, and capability development initiatives at the NMO level.

Office-Level P&O Support – New Mumbai Office

  • Act as the on-ground P&O point of contact for all business teams and functions co-located at the New Mumbai Office, operating in close coordination with the dotted-line P&O responsible for NMO.
  • Manage day-to-day P&O matters for multiple stakeholder groups across businesses, ensuring timely resolution and a consistent people experience across the office.
  • Support the coordination and smooth execution of high-profile leadership visits, town halls, senior stakeholder engagements, and office-level events - providing P&O facilitation and logistics as required.
  • Serve as a key connector between business leaders at NMO and the broader P&O organization, ensuring visibility, alignment, and responsive support.

Multi-Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and sustain trusted relationships with a wide and diverse set of senior business leaders, functional heads, and cross-business stakeholders operating out of or visiting the New Mumbai Office.
  • Navigate competing priorities and sensitivities across multiple business contexts with maturity, discretion, and sound judgment.
  • Engage with leaders from functions including project business, finance, operations, commercial, and technology- providing relevant and contextually appropriate P&O guidance.
  • Represent the P&O function confidently in cross-business forums, office-level governance discussions, and leadership interactions.

Talent, Workforce & Organizational Effectiveness

  • Support workforce planning, org design inputs, and headcount management for teams across NMO in coordination with respective P&O leads.
  • Enable hiring decisions, onboarding, and role transitions for new leaders and team members joining NMO-based functions.
  • Drive employee engagement initiatives, analyze engagement feedback, and develop targeted action plans in collaboration with business leaders.
  • Identify talent risks, critical role gaps, and capability needs; partner with relevant COEs and business teams on mitigation actions.
  • Support organizational change, restructuring, and transition activities-coordinating communication, documentation, and stakeholder management as required.

P&O Operations, Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure end-to-end execution of core P&O processes across the employee lifecycle for NMO-based employees, including compensation actions, transfers, separations, and policy adherence.
  • Handle employee relations matters, grievance management, and disciplinary processes in line with company policies and applicable Indian labor laws.
  • Coordinate with Centers of Excellence (COEs) and Shared Services on compensation, L&D, staffing, and HR operations matters.
  • Maintain compliance with statutory requirements, labor regulations, internal audit standards, and company policies.
  • Prepare and maintain workforce dashboards, attrition reports, and presentation material for leadership and governance forums.

What You Bring

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Human Resources, Personnel Management, Industrial Relations, Organizational Development, or a related HR discipline from a recognized institution.
  • MBA / PGDM with HR specialization preferred.

Experience

  • 8–10 years of progressive HR / P&O experience with significant exposure to business partnering across multiple functions and diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Demonstrated experience managing P&O responsibilities in a multi-business or multi-function office environment—where priorities, reporting lines, and stakeholder needs are varied and at times competing.
  • Proven ability to engage credibly and independently with senior leaders and build lasting professional relationships across organizational hierarchies.
  • Exposure to project-driven business environments (energy, EPC, infrastructure, industrial, or engineering sectors) will be a strong advantage.
  • Experience working alongside Finance, Operations, and Commercial functions to deliver integrated people solutions is an added advantage.
  • Prior experience supporting or facilitating high-profile leadership visits, senior stakeholder events, or office-level governance will be valued.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal skills—able to manage multiple leaders and agendas simultaneously without losing clarity or composure.
  • High situational awareness and the ability to read organizational dynamics across diverse business contexts.
  • Data orientation—proficiency in HR analytics, workforce reporting, and dashboard-driven insights.
  • Thorough knowledge of Indian labor laws, statutory compliance, and HR policy frameworks.
  • Excellent communication skills—clear, confident, and calibrated across levels and functions.
  • High ownership mindset with strong execution discipline; able to drive closure on multiple tracks in parallel.
  • Learning agility, adaptability, and comfort operating in a matrixed, multi-reporting-line environment.
  • Collaborative and approachable, with a professional demeanor suited to a high-visibility office environment.

job.title: Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
Location: Aurangabad

Organization: Siemens Limited: Smart Infrastructure

Mode of employment: Full time only

Functional Area: Manufacturing.

What are my responsibilities?

  • Ensures adherence to agreed processes and procedures in maintenance and ensures achievement of agreed performance standards.
  • Coordinates and monitors maintenance procedures.
  • Plans resources and executes routine maintenance projects.
  • Responsible for maintenance of semi-plant equipment.
  • Coordinates operational processes and leads employees in the team assigned.
  • If required dismantles, repairs, assembles, installs, and sets up technical equipment and machines used in a production

site.

  • Analyze basic functionality of machines and recommend rebuild/replacement parts to return to good performance.
  • Supplies to installation projects on site and support accountable Industrial Engineers.
  • Supports maintenance of technical documentations of processes and equipment.
  • May advise junior staff technically.
  • May maintain various types of equipment.
  • Familiarity with Total Productive Maintenance or Reliability Centered Maintenance concepts.
  • Utilization of CMMS to review and analyze maintenance data.
  • Utilization of problem-solving tools and troubleshooting skills to identify root cause of machine issues.
  • Develop appropriate preventive and/or predictive maintenance plans to reduce emergency maintenance and extend overall life of machines.
  • Communicate and coordinate activities within maintenance and cross-functional teams when necessary.
  • Physical presence in the workplace is a crucial function.
  • Implement and actively support the plant and corporate safety policies and initiatives.
  • This role will be cross-trained and supplement Maintenance Supervision in different areas at times.
  • Analyzes technical problems on site and completes mechanical and/or electrical repairs and work orders.

What do I need to qualify for this job?

  • ITI Electrical/ Diploma in Electrical / Electronics / Mechanical engineering with min 8-10 years of experience.
  • Experience of working in Low Voltage Products manufacturing.
  • Maintenance of automation setup

Skills

Hands-on experience of maintenance of Special purpose machine.

Working knowledge on lean production system, maintenance engineer or controls engineer

Knowledge of laser marking machines, optical vision inspection, welding machines, thermal testing, magnetic testing, and injection molding machines

Familiarity with CMMS software and other computer software as it pertains to engineering.

Familiarity with problem solving and reliability tools such as DMAIC, PFMEA, A3, 8D Corrective Action Plans, 5 Why, Fishbone and other 6 Sigma tools.

Continuous improvement project experience.

EHS Subject Matter Expertise: Safety

Production Technology Knowledge and Manufacturing Process Knowledge

Maintenance and Installation of manufacturing equipment.

Continuous improvement activities.

Good Communication skills.

Additional Qualification:

  • Excellent Team Player.
  • Quick learner.
  • Explores new technologies.

job.title: Senior Pre Sales Engineer –Delivery Lead (BMS)
job.description:
Senior Pre Sales Engineer –Delivery Lead (BMS)

________

About Siemens Smart Infrastructure

We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building

We are looking for a professional with a minimum of 5 year’s experience in BMS (Building Management System) field. The candidate must have an associate degree in Electrical/Electronics/Mechanical.

This job is based out in Chennai.

Smart Infrastructure from Siemens connects energy systems, buildings, and industries to improve the way we live and work. From building automation and HVAC to digital and cloud-based infrastructure solutions, we enable sustainable, efficient, and intelligent environments across the globe.

________

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Pre Sales Engineer –Delivery Lead to support our global Smart Infrastructure business.

This is a hybrid role that combines hands on BMS pre sales engineering with delivery leadership and stakeholder coordination.

________

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preliminary and detailed pre sales engineering for Building Management Systems (BMS) tenders.
  • Analyse tender documents to identify HVAC equipment, field devices, and system scope.
  • Review sequences of operation and validate I/O summaries and technical specifications.
  • Generate RFIs, equipment summaries, data point schedules, and bills of materials (BOM).
  • Perform sizing and selection of sensors, motorized control valves, dampers, actuators, meters, controllers, interfaces, and licenses.
  • Design BMS network architectures and produce compliance statements.
  • Develop accurate cost estimates and collate pricing data for tender submissions.
  • Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for global (onshore) pre sales and sales stakeholders.
  • Own work intake, prioritization, and delivery commitments for offshore pre sales activities.
  • Ensure consistent quality, standardization, and adherence to defined processes.
  • Proactively identify delivery risks, capacity constraints, and dependency issues and escalate early.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to pre sales engineers to improve capability and productivity.
  • Drive continuous improvement in tools, templates, and ways of working.

________

Required Skills & Experience

Must Have

  • 7+ years of experience in BMS / Building Automation pre sales engineering
  • Strong knowledge of:

o HVAC, Electrical, Hydraulics, Fire & Vertical Transport systems

o Basic instrumentation and control loops

o Open protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, M Bus, KNX

  • Proven experience interpreting tender documents, BOQs, and technical specifications
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience working across time zones
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), Visio, Bluebeam, and floor plan tools

Added Advantage

  • Experience acting as a technical focal point or lead within a pre sales or engineering function
  • Exposure to Hospitals, Data Centers, and Premium Commercial Buildings
  • Knowledge of Revit / BIM
  • Understanding of IT networking, metering, cybersecurity, and industry compliance standards

________

Why Join Siemens

You’ll play a key role in enabling a global pre sales delivery model, working with teams that influence large scale infrastructure and sustainability outcomes worldwide.

Make your mark in our exciting world of Siemens

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.

Find out more about Smart Infrastructure at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/company/topic-areas/smart-infrastructure.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers

job.title: Protection & Automation Engineer
job.description:
Hey Innovator!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future.

Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an extraordinary addition to our vibrant team.

Siemens Technology and Services Private Limited (STSPL) is the Indian subsidiary of German multinational engineering and electronics conglomerate Siemens that focuses on IT and management services. The subsidiary is split into four units: Corporate Technology India, Siemens Corporate Finance and Controlling, Global Shared Services, and Siemens Management Consulting. Located in Balewadi High Street in Pune, it has over 5000 employees.

We are looking for a Protection & Automation Engineer meeting the need for smart-mobility solutions.

We are making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions.

Your new role – Challenging and future oriented

This role focuses on delivering Protection, Automation & Control engineering for Railway & Metro traction substations, OHE/PS systems, and depot power systems. The engineer must have strong command over Siemens SIPROTEC relays, Siemens PLCs, A8000 RTUs, and communication protocols commonly used in rail applications.

  • Protection Engineering for Railway Systems
  • Prepare protection philosophy & settings for 25 kV AC traction substations.Configure and test SIPROTEC 4/5 series relays for Distance protection, Transformer protection, Distance protection, Busbar protection

Implement CFC logic for advanced interlocking used in railway traction power.Implement cyber security hardening measures2. Railway Control & Automation

  • Program Siemens PLC (S7 1500/ ET200SP) for local/remote control in Traction Substation, Sectioning Post, paralleling Posts, SP, SSP.
  • Implement interlocking logic for breakers, isolators, ATs & protection coordination.
  • Integrate PLC/RTU with SCADA systems used in railways.
  • Siemens RTU (A8000) Engineering
  • Engineer and configure A8000 RTUs for railway substations.
  • Develop IEC 60870 5 104/101 communication with Operation Control Center (OCC)
  • Create & integrate IEC 61850 SCD/ICD files for traction power automation.
  • Documentation & Project Delivery
  • Prepare railway specific engineering documents: Traction Substation, Sectioning Post, Paralleling Posts, Sub-Sectioning and Paralleling Post protection concept Drawings
  • Control & interlocking philosophy
  • Network Diagrams

Support Factory Integration Tests (FIT)/Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and support for commissioning.Ensure compliance with IEC, EN, IEEE & local standards.Support Project manager / Technical manager with Project planning We don’t need superheroes, just super minds

job.title: Maritime Electrical and Automation Senior Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

Location : Electronic city, Bangalore

About your role and impact:

As a Senior Specialist for Maritime Electrical and Automation solutions

  • You will provide advanced technical expertise in the design, integration, commissioning, and lifecycle support of marine electrical distribution systems, including switchboards, power management schemes, transformers, and protection systems.
  • You will be a part of global product development and operations team for Maritime segment system integration, closely interacting with Siemens Energy’s Center of Excellence (COE) team in Norway.
  • You will contribute towards specification development, design and integration of maritime electrical systems such as power generation (Diesel Generators, BESS), distribution, propulsion, and control circuits.
  • You will contribute to the design and development of custom application libraries (towards Machinery monitoring and control, Power Management, Alarm Management and Vessel Control systems), as needed for different maritime sub-segments across various regions, based on available standardized solution designs that aim towards high efficiency, cost-effectiveness, operational safety, regulatory requirements and address decarbonization objectives.
  • You will contribute towards documentation such as specifications, technical drawings, and user documentation (typically, single line diagrams, load analysis, short circuit calculations, cable schedules, and equipment specifications).
  • You will work closely with simulation and modeling teams towards development of ‘digital twin’ solutions involving electrical, mechanical and thermal aspects of maritime vessels, and thereby replicate, validate and predict maritime system behavior.
  • You will support operation teams and maintenance teams with diagnostics, fault analysis, corrective actions, preventive maintenance strategies, and system enhancements or upgrades, retrofits, and modernization projects on existing fleets.
  • You will support programming, configuration and testing of PLCs, SCADA and other automation systems for customer projects.
  • You will provide your expertise for onsite and remote support during project execution, installation, factory acceptance tests (FAT), harbor acceptance tests (HAT), and sea trials.
  • You will ensure operational excellence, awareness and alignment regarding maritime industry electrical standards and society regulations, through engineering reviews, verification checks, and documentation.
  • You will guide and mentor R&D and Operational teams and ensure seamless collaboration across disciplines from project concept to delivery.
  • You will demonstrate technical leadership and mentor junior engineers and collaborating with cross-functional project teams.
  • You will interact with international teams and customers with different cultures on a regular basis.
  • You will work in a flexible, multi-functional team-based development environment comprising of Siemens Energy personnel, maritime experts from industry and 3rd party consulting/OEMs.
  • You will actively contribute and drive innovations in energy efficiency, sustainability, and digitalization solutions for marine applications

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Marine Engineering, or equivalent.
  • At least 8–10 years’ experience in marine electrical and automation systems, ideally in senior or specialist roles.
  • Strong knowledge of marine electrical standards (IEC, IEEE, SOLAS) and classification society rules (DNV, ABS, LR).
  • Proficiency in electrical system design tools and PLC/SCADA programming (IEC 61131-3).
  • Knowledge related to design of LV, MV Drives and BMS will be suitable.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical skills, and strong commitment to safety.
  • Willingness to travel to shipyards, offshore facilities, and onboard vessels.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills for collaboration with cross-functional teams and technical presentations

About the Team

Become a part of our mission for sustainability: clean energy for generations to come.

We are a global team of diverse colleagues who share a passion for renewable energy and have a culture of trust and empowerment to make our own ideas a reality.

We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 96,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

job.title: Collaboration Manager - Advanced Therapies (Bengaluru)
job.description:
Job Description: Collaboration Manager - Advanced Therapies

Role Purpose

The Collaboration Manager –The role focuses on translating customer and clinical insights into impactful research activities, product improvements, and innovation opportunities.

The successful candidate will actively engage with key customer sites, support collaboration programs from concept to outcome, and ensure alignment across country teams, global business lines, R&D, and other internal stakeholders. The role also includes driving visibility of collaboration outcomes in the public domain and strengthening long-term strategic partnerships with customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with leading clinicians and researchers (institutional and non-institutional) on furthering the field of angiographic imaging science by first understanding the clinical needs and then developing solutions to address those needs.
  • Work with clinicians, research, technical, and medical staff, on-site, to support research-related interventional cases. Share clinical workflows to a broader audience within Advanced Therapies (AT) to further procedural knowledge.
  • Act as the primary interface between external collaborators and internal stakeholders including business lines, R&D, product management, and country organizations. Work closely with KoLs, physicians and internal teams (including Innovation, Business Line, Sales, Marketing, R&D) to define and execute research studies.
  • Work with AT Innovations, R&D (both in Forchheim, Germany), and on-site service personnel to install, learn detailed operation of, and pre-test prototype hardware and software.
  • Analyze research data with physicians, and prepare reports, publications, and conference presentations. Promote a culture of generating clinically and scientifically relevant outcomes that are visible through publications, presentations, workshops, and other public scientific channels.
  • Drive collaboration programs from initiation through execution, ensuring alignment on goals, milestones, timelines, deliverables, and outcomes. Track budget, milestones, and deliverables throughout the project.
  • Work with legal, research, and logistics personnel on (both internally and with academic centers) to develop research agreements that define the required equipment, funding and deliverables for each research project.
  • Facilitate strong coordination between local collaboration activities and global headquarters to ensure strategic alignment and sustainable integration. Work with project manager in Forchheim and the site Principal Investigator to define the research protocol for each project.
  • Write and present reports to AT Headquarters and Senior management regarding project results and new project ideas from the field. Represent local collaboration activities and outcomes at regional and international forums, including conferences, scientific meetings, and internal review platforms
  • Where applicable, work with the regional organization to develop research priorities for strategic partnerships with institutions.
  • Continuously monitor technology landscape and evaluate technologies (tech transfer, start-ups, think tanks etc.) for applicability to angiographic systems
  • Contribute to scientific marketing initiatives and customer engagement strategies related to collaboration programs and research outcomes
  • Ensure close interaction and alignment with R&D and development center teams to connect customer insights with future product and solution development

Attributes and Skills:

This position may suit you best if you are familiar with what is below, and would like to develop your career with Healthineers

  • Strong customer engagement and relationship management skills with the ability to work effectively across clinical, academic, and business environments
  • Excellent collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management capabilities
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously and drive execution with attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently while also thriving in cross-functional and matrixed teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to translate customer needs into actionable collaboration opportunities
  • High level of ownership, follow-through, and accountability
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic environment that requires adaptability and proactive engagement
  • Proficient knowledge of protocol development and protocol writing to be compliant to scientific rigor is a plus
  • Experience in evaluating external technologies for applicability to Siemens Healthineers portfolio.
  • Experience in programming and medical image processing including AI programming skills is a plus

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Graduate / Postgraduate qualification in life sciences, biomedical engineering, medical technology, radiology, physics, or a related technical or medical field
  • At least 10 years of professional experience in the healthcare industry, medical technology, academic research, or a related field
  • Good understanding of academic research settings, healthcare delivery systems, and radiology workflows
  • Experience working with hospitals, research institutions, or clinical investigators in a customer-facing or scientific partnership role is highly desirable
  • Knowledge of the public or institutional research funding landscape in India is an advantage
  • Basic understanding of medical image processing, data analysis methodologies, and emerging AI or machine learning concepts in imaging is desirable
  • Strong interest in medical devices, healthcare innovation, and clinical research
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to engage with scientific and non-scientific stakeholders
  • Technical understanding of medical imaging, especially 2D and 3D imaging on angiographic systems
  • Thorough understanding of clinical workflows in interventional procedures (Cardiology, Interventional and Neuro Radiology, Vascular Surgery). Neuro experience preferred.
  • Proficient knowledge in anatomical vasculature as they relate to interventional -ology (brain, liver, heart etc.)
  • Proficient knowledge of clinical software and hardware applications available on angiographic systems (Siemens Healthineers, Philips, GE, Canon and United Imaging)
  • Proficient knowledge of IQ for image analysis
  • Proficient knowledge related to X-ray dose measurements
  • Experience with other imaging modalities such as CT (preferred), MR and Ultrasound.
  • Willing to travel up to 25-40%

________

Why this role matters

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of customer collaboration, scientific innovation, and product development in one of the most advanced areas of diagnostic imaging. By building strong partnerships and translating real-world clinical needs into innovation opportunities, you will play a meaningful role in shaping the future of Advanced Therapy and improving patient care.

job.title: Drives Engineer- ACS 550 and 580
job.description:
Sr. Engineer- Electrical–Drives- Customer Services

Location: Jagdalpur, Chhattisgarh

Key Requirements

  • Proven experience in maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical drive systems in Caster, Tunnel Furnace, Rolling Mill, and other continuous process plants.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial drive technology, electrical power distribution, motor control centers (MCCs), control systems, and automation interfaces.
  • Hands-on expertise in ABB drives including ACS580, ACS800, ACS850, drive commissioning, parameterization, diagnostics, backup restoration, and firmware management.
  • Working knowledge of Siemens drive systems including SINAMICS S120, G120, and associated engineering tools such as Starter and Startdrive/TIA Portal.
  • Expertise in drive fault analysis, breakdown troubleshooting, root cause analysis (RCA), and implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Ability to diagnose and rectify issues related to:

o Drive power modules and control units

o Encoder and feedback systems

o Communication networks (Profibus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP)

o Motor and drive interlocks

o Harmonics, power quality, and electrical protection systems

  • Experience in predictive, preventive, and condition-based maintenance of VFDs and DC/AC drive systems to improve equipment reliability and availability.
  • Strong understanding of drive system integration with PLC, HMI, SCADA, and field instrumentation.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Plan, organize, and execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities for ABB and Siemens drive systems.
  • Develop maintenance strategies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and troubleshooting guidelines for drive systems.
  • Perform detailed fault diagnostics and analysis to minimize downtime and improve system reliability.
  • Create and implement preventive maintenance plans for VFDs, drive panels, motors, cooling systems, and associated equipment.
  • Monitor critical drive parameters, analyze trends, and recommend reliability improvement initiatives.
  • Carry out drive commissioning, parameter backup/restoration, software upgrades, and performance optimization activities.
  • Schedule maintenance shutdown activities, arrange required manpower, tools, and spare parts for timely execution.
  • Review ongoing maintenance work and ensure compliance with technical specifications and quality standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive records of drive faults, corrective actions, maintenance history, and reliability KPIs.
  • Develop and manage critical spare parts inventory for ABB and Siemens drives to reduce Mean Time to Repair (MTTR).
  • Coordinate with OEMs, vendors, and internal operations teams for complex troubleshooting and system upgrades.
  • Support modernization, retrofit, and drive migration projects.
  • Ensure strict compliance with electrical safety standards, LOTO procedures, arc-flash protection requirements, and plant safety regulations.
  • Prepare technical reports, maintenance analyses, presentations, and MIS reports using Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Preferred Skills

  • Advanced troubleshooting of ABB ACS800/ACS850 and Siemens SINAMICS S120 multi-axis systems.
  • Knowledge of drive networks, fieldbus diagnostics, and industrial communication protocols.
  • Experience with thermography, power quality analysis, and condition monitoring techniques.
  • Good leadership, communication, team coordination, and shift maintenance management skills.
  • Exposure to steel manufacturing processes and critical rolling mill drive applications will be highly preferred.

Qualification Requirements

  • You should have minimum 5 years’ experience preferably in Caster, Tunnel Furnace, Rolling mill with bachelor’s degree in electrical/ Electronic engineering or Diploma in electrical with 6-8 years of experience

job.title: Gas Turbine: Turbine Airfoils Casting Simulations Engineer
job.description:
Looking for challenging role? If you really want to make a difference - make it with us

Can we energize society and fight climate change at the same time?

At Siemens Energy, we can. Our technology is key, but our people make the difference. Brilliant minds innovate. They connect, create, and keep us on track towards changing the world’s energy systems. Their spirit fuels our mission.

Our culture is defined by caring, agile, respectful, and accountable individuals. We value excellence of any kind. Sounds like you?

Turbine Airfoils Casting simulation engineer plays a pivotal role in transforming how we design and manufacture complex turbine hardware design. You will lead the development and validation of conventional cast & cutting-edge DS (directionally solidified) process modeling, core breakage prediction, and foundry process modeling capabilities. Working at the intersection of design, simulation, and manufacturing, you will focus on upstream design simulation to embed manufacturability early in the development cycle, significantly reducing defects, lead times, and costs while improving component reliability.

Job requires regular interaction with global teams hence engineer should have persuasive communication skills and cross-cultural knowledge.

Your new role – challenging and future-oriented

  • Develop and validate advanced DS process modeling methodologies with a strong emphasis on core breakage prediction and mitigation.
  • Practice Siemens Energy high fidelity, extensively validated, and equiaxed casting simulation modeling methodology to provide expert foundry process modeling support to ensure robust, high-yield casting designs.
  • Drive upstream design simulation initiatives that integrate manufacturability directly into the turbine component design process.
  • Develop new cooling technologies within the constraints of manufacturability, balancing performance, thermal management, and casting feasibility.
  • Collaborate closely with design, materials, and manufacturing teams to create and implement new simulation-driven design-for-manufacturing (DFM) workflows.
  • Identify and resolve critical casting challenges through innovative modeling techniques, data analysis, and real-world validation.
  • Contribute to methodology development that pushes the boundaries of casting simulation accuracy and speed.
  • Be a point of contact, speaking partner and provide expertise regarding hot gas path heat transfer related topics in a project.
  • Developing new concepts and building CAD models using NX, design internal cooling and perform Conjugate Heat Transfer analysis of Turbine Airfoils and Heat Shields using CFX & Star CCM+, performing Casting Simulation using ProCAST.
  • Understanding of fundamental concepts in fluid mechanics (pressure drop) & heat transfer discipline (using non-dimensional correlations).
  • Able to understand physics, apply relevant assumptions, interpret and post process results.
  • Collaborating with project leads in understanding the project requirements, finding solutions to design challenges, and delivering results within agreed timeline & quality.
  • A fraction of time will be dedicated to advancing the technical expertise of other team members and mentoring.

We don’t need superheroes, just super minds:

  • Mechanical engineer with an MTech in Mechanical engineering (major in Metallurgy and Foundry, Material Science, Fluid & Thermal Science) and demonstrated expertise in the field of Casting, Solidification physics, heat transfer and fluid mechanics.
  • 5 years of experience with parametric CAD modeling in NX.
  • Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in thermal analysis and design of internal cooled gas turbine components.
  • Ability to generate thermal boundary conditions and perform Flow & Heat Transfer engineering calculations under steady state, transient heat transfer (involving all modes i.e. conduction, convection and radiation) and multi-phase CFD/CHT simulations using Star CCM+. (minimum 4 years of experience).
  • Understanding Investment Casting & Solidification physics and experience of running casting simulations using ProCAST and experience of working in foundry would be an advantage. (minimum 2 years of experience).
  • Good knowledge of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) for gas turbine airfoils.
  • Basic knowledge of Finite element analysis & ability to review the results. Good Familiarity with FE codes like Sim center 3D, ANSYS or general-purpose FEA tool.
  • Basic knowledge of Turbomachinery Aerodynamics, Mechanical Integrity (Fatigue, Creep, Fracture).
  • Exposure to SAP and Teamcenter PLM.
  • Programming skills like Python and NX Open.
  • A balance between scientific rigor and engineering judgement.
  • An attitude of curiosity, perseverance in the face of uncertainty, and a desire for engineering excellence as well as patience.

Personality

  • Strong interpersonal skills i.e., collaborator, quick learner, energetic, imaginative, innovative, ability to adapt quickly & effectively etc.
  • Willing to collaborate & work with colleagues located in multiple time zones (Europe & the US).
  • Self-driven in work tasks with a willingness to learn and try new methods to solve a problem.
  • Align with Organization Purpose, Values & Behavior & adhere to business compliance guidelines.
  • Effective communicator both verbal and non-verbal.
  • Ability to write clear and descriptive reports in English.

This is a rare opportunity to work on high-visibility, high-impact programs where your technical contributions will directly influence turbine performance, production efficiency, and long-term competitiveness. You will have the autonomy to innovate, the resources to validate your methods, and the chance to see your work move from simulation to actual hardware in some of the most advanced gas turbines in the world. If you are passionate about simulation, manufacturability, and solving complex engineering problems that matter, this is the role where you can make a lasting technical impact.

We’ve got quite a lot to offer. How about you?

This role is based in Gurugram. You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing and test automation to join our growing Quality Center of Excellence.

In this role, you will design, develop, and execute automated tests across Siemens software products in a multiplatform environment. You will combine strong software testing fundamentals with programming and automation skills to improve product quality, test coverage, and release confidence.

You will work closely with Product Management, Software Development, Applications Engineering, and Quality Engineering teams, while also collaborating with other QA specialists across Siemens in areas such as automation, performance testing, and security testing.

The ideal candidate is a logical thinker and strong problem solver who enjoys understanding how software works, identifying defects, automating repetitive activities, and continuously improving the way software is tested.**

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop test automation: Design, implement, maintain, and execute automated tests for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end scenarios using appropriate frameworks and programming languages.
  • Drive test coverage: Work with Product Managers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to understand requirements, identify risks, define test cases, and develop effective automation strategies for new features and product releases.
  • Enable continuous testing: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide rapid feedback, detect defects early, and improve the efficiency and reliability of software delivery.
  • Test APIs and data: Perform API testing using RESTful services and tools such as Postman or Swagger, and validate application data using SQL queries and SPARQL where applicable.
  • Investigate and resolve quality issues: Execute automated and functional tests, analyze failures and results, identify defects, perform structured troubleshooting, and collaborate with development teams to drive resolution.
  • Improve automation frameworks: Continuously enhance existing test frameworks, scripts, and utilities to improve maintainability, efficiency, reliability, and test coverage.
  • Collaborate and contribute to quality excellence: Maintain clear test documentation, share knowledge, and collaborate with the Siemens Quality Center of Excellence to adopt effective quality engineering practices and emerging testing technologies.**

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance / Software Testing, with hands-on experience in test automation.
  • Strong programming or scripting skills in Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable language, with the ability to develop maintainable automation solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks and tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Katalon Studio, PyTest, TestNG, JUnit, or equivalent.
  • Experience with API testing and database validation, including RESTful APIs, SQL queries, and tools such as Postman or Swagger.
  • Familiarity with SPARQL and RDF/knowledge graph concepts, including the ability to write or assess SPARQL queries for data retrieval and validation.
  • Familiarity with Git and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI, GitLab CI, or equivalent, with an understanding of integrating automated tests into pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies such as Agile, Scrum, TDD, and BDD, combined with strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.**

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to AI agents, LLM-driven applications, or AI-assisted automation, including technologies such as Anthropic Claude or equivalent.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other containerization technologies.
  • Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
  • Familiarity with security testing practices such as DAST and penetration testing concepts.
  • Experience testing browser-based applications, including functionality, performance, and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Experience or interest in Data Science, Data Visualization, Data Analytics, RDF, or Knowledge Graph technologies.
  • Experience with defect and test management tools such as JIRA, X-Ray, TestRail, or Zephyr.**

Why Us

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

Diversity & Inclusion

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

job.title: Pre Sales Automation Technical Support (Industry Developer)

You will be the decisive technical expert of your region performing following roles & responsibilities.

Accountable for all technical aspects of registration and homologation, ensuring compliance and seamless coordination with internal stakeholders.
  • Ensure support to sales teams throughout the opportunity cycle by driving prescription actions & technical support for major projects and key customers
  • Technical prescription activities & USP promotion (for RTU’s, FRTU’s and Substation Automation Systems solutions) with close engagements & leveraging the strengths of our portfolio

  • The Candidate with bachelor’s or master’s Degree (full time) in Electrical Engineering from reputed institute.
  • The Candidate Should have 10 - 14 years of relevant experience in the field of substation automation systems, RTU & FRTU’s selection, configuration, testing&comissioning. Worked in configuration, testing & commissioning of Substation Automation System (SAS) for Medim voltage, HV and EHV substations.

Adequate knowledge on Various communication protocols IEC 61850, MODBUS, GOOSE, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3 TCP, Modbus TCP, Synchrophasor (IEEE C37.118-IP) and Redundancy protocols: Line Mode, RSTP, HSR, PRP etc.
  • The candidate should have substantial experience in developing automation system schemes, complex RTU, FRTU logics and communications network architecture, including integration of required third-party products/IED’s.

job.title: Sr Software Engineer (Datawarehouse)
job.description:
At Siemens Healthineers, we bring together the world's best talent to realize our vision of a world without fear of cancer. Together, we work passionately to develop and deliver easy-to-use, efficient oncology solutions. We are part of an incredible community of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to improve people’s lives around the world. We embrace a culture of inclusivity in which the power and potential of every individual can be unleashed. We spark ideas that lead to positive impact and continued success. If you want to be part of this important mission, we want to hear from you.

Position Summary

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, test, and maintain a cloud-based oncology SaaS platform deployed on AWS and used by patients, clinicians, and healthcare providers. The platform includes modern web applications, cloud services, and data solutions leveraging Snowflake for analytics and reporting.

The ideal candidate is a strong full-stack or backend engineer with experience building scalable SaaS applications, working in Agile teams, and contributing to all phases of the software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

The product is Siemens Healthineers´s cloud-based software solution for patient relationships and care navigation management. It’s designed to connect cancer patients with their clinics online throughout the entire cancer journey. The product used by 35 000+ active cancer patients and healthcare professionals from leading oncology centers in North America and Europe.  The candidate in this role will provide strong product development leadership to a team of software engineers and test engineers, working in an agile/scrum environment.

Job Description

Position Duties:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software solutions for patient-facing and clinician-facing applications.
  • Develop and support integrations with Snowflake data warehouse solutions.
  • Build and optimize dimensional data models, data marts, and analytical datasets.
  • Develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, transform, and integrate data from multiple SaaS applications and cloud services.
  • Utilize AI-assisted software development tools to improve coding, testing, debugging, documentation, and development productivity.
  • Support development of dashboards, KPIs, operational reports, and product usage analytics.
  • Implement scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-native services on AWS.
  • Develop APIs, backend services, and user-facing features that meet functional, performance, and security requirements.
  • Participate in architecture discussions, technical design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and product teams to enable reporting, analytics, and data-driven features.
  • Own quality throughout the development lifecycle by creating unit, integration, and automated tests.

Qualifications Required: BE, MSc, MCA, Computer Science or related discipline.

Number of year’s related experience: 7-12 years

Special Knowledge / Skills:

Required:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake data warehouse and data integration solutions.
  • Strong SQL development and performance optimization skills.
  • Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java/Kotlin and Spring Boot
  • Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and AI-assisted software development tools.
  • Experience working with AWS cloud services and modern SaaS architectures.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
  • Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, HIPAA, GDPR, or similar standards.

Nice to have

  • Experience developing healthcare products conforming quality system regulations.
  • Experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, RDS, Redshift, EventBridge, or ECS/EKS.
  • Experience in healthcare domain and medical interoperability standards such as FHIR, HL7
  • Certifications from AWS or Azure

job.title: IT Infrastructure Specialist
job.description:
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

You'll make a difference by:

  • Operating and optimizing enterprise IT and factory OT networks across manufacturing plants, production workshops, offices, and data centers, ensuring reliable and secure network services.
  • Managing network infrastructure and connectivity including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless controllers, access points, WAN/SD-WAN solutions, and network management platforms.
  • Supporting Layer 2/Layer 3 networking and core services by configuring and troubleshooting VLANs, STP, link aggregation, gateway redundancy, routing protocols, DHCP, DNS, NTP, IP addressing, VPNs, and related services.
  • Ensuring wireless network performance and availability through monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization of coverage, capacity, interference, roaming, authentication policies, and client connectivity.
  • Maintaining network security and IT/OT segmentation by supporting firewall policies, NAT, ACLs, VPNs, 802.1X, NAC, RADIUS/TACACS+, certificate-based authentication, and cybersecurity compliance requirements.
  • Driving operational excellence and project delivery by supporting factory digitalization initiatives, infrastructure upgrades, incident resolution, documentation, topology management, change processes, and collaboration with global teams and vendors.

Your defining qualities:

  • Educational background in technology or engineering with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, Communication Engineering, Automation, or a related discipline.
  • Strong networking fundamentals including Layer 2 and Layer 3 technologies such as VLANs, STP, link aggregation, gateway redundancy, IPv4 subnetting, and dynamic routing protocols.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise networking technologies including switches, routers, firewalls, wireless networks, and troubleshooting across wired and wireless environments.
  • Knowledge of network protocols and security controls including TCP/IP, ARP, ICMP, DHCP, DNS, NTP, SNMP, Syslog, AAA, NAT, VPN, IT/OT segmentation, access control, and least-privilege principles.
  • Proficiency in network operations and troubleshooting using packet captures, ping, traceroute, logs, monitoring tools, and ITSM incident, request, problem, and change management processes.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work on-site, coordinate across teams and vendors, communicate effectively in English, and support planned maintenance or emergency response activities when required.

In return, we offer you:

  • Flexible Work Environment: Including a mobile working policy that supports your well-being and allows you to prioritize what matters most.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: A comprehensive package to reward your contributions.
  • Values-Driven Culture: An inclusive workplace that prioritizes diversity and belonging.
  • Continuous Learning & Development: Opportunities to grow your skills and advance your career.

Recruitment Process:

  • CV Screening
  • If shortlisted, a session with our TA Consultant to understand your motivation & your past experiences
  • 1-3 Business Interviews
  • Offer Stage

Transform the everyday with us!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.
