job.title: Research and Development Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Vertiv is seeking a Research and Development Engineer to join our high-density liquid cooling R&D team in Edenbridge, UK. The successful candidate will independently lead test design, experimental analysis, and development of next-generation liquid cooling solutions for data centre and critical infrastructure applications. This role involves hands-on laboratory work, test rig design and commissioning, data acquisition and analysis, and active collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams to advance Vertiv's thermal management product portfolio.

Responsibilities

  • Design, set up, operate, and maintain liquid cooling test rigs and experimental apparatus in accordance with Vertiv Engineering SOPs and Standard Work procedures.
  • Lead and execute product performance test design and validation protocols for high-density liquid cooling systems, including cold plate assemblies, coolant distribution units (CDUs), and rear-door heat exchangers.
  • Independently collect, record, and analyse test data, drawing conclusions and presenting findings using data acquisition systems, ensuring accuracy and traceability per Vertiv's Item and Item Structure Management SOP (PLM-ISM-SOP-001).
  • Design and prepare test apparatus and instrumentation setups for R&D experiments, ensuring alignment with defined test objectives
  • Perform routine calibration and maintenance of laboratory instruments, pressure transducers, flow meters, thermocouples, and data acquisition tools.
  • Lead the development and documentation of test procedures, work instructions, and standard operating procedures aligned with Vertiv's Model-Based Definition (MBD) process
  • Maintain laboratory housekeeping standards, ensuring cleanliness and compliance with workmanship standards (processes, tools, materials, discipline, and cleanliness)
  • Lead prototype assembly, leak testing, pressure testing and functional operation of liquid cooling components, coordinating with senior engineers as required.
  • Comply with Vertiv's Electrical Safety Programme requirements, including proper use of PPE, risk assessments, and Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) procedures when working with energised test equipment.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to Standard Work development as outlined in the VOS Global Procedure.
  • Independently compile, analyse, and present test results, anomalies, and technical observations to the R&D engineering team in a timely manner.
  • Lead and support ECN (Engineering Change Notice) release processes and configuration management activities.

Requirements

Education

  • BEng (Hons) or HNC/HND (Level 4/5) in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Thermal Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.

Experience

  • Ideally, previous engineering R&D or relevant field experience, with demonstrated ability to independently plan and conduct experiments.

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with hydraulic/fluid systems, including pumps, valves, heat exchangers, and piping assemblies.
  • Proficiency in using data acquisition systems and laboratory instrumentation (thermocouples, pressure sensors, flow meters, power quality analysis).
  • Competence in reading and interpreting engineering drawings and technical specifications.
  • Solid understanding of heat transfer principles and fluid dynamics, with ability to apply theory to experimental design.
  • Familiarity with electrical safety practices for test environments.
  • Competent in the use of Microsoft Office applications and data analysis tools.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative R&D team.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proactive approach to health and safety compliance.
  • Proven ability to independently solve engineering problems and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Nice to have

  • Foundation Degree or BEng (Hons) in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with liquid cooling systems, thermal management, or HVAC/R technologies.
  • Experience with programming languages (Python, Labview).
  • Knowledge of CAD software (Creo Parametric or equivalent) for reviewing 3D models and assemblies.
  • Experience with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) systems, particularly Oracle Product Development Cloud.
  • Familiarity with Lean manufacturing principles and Standard Work methodologies.
  • IOSH Managing Safely or NEBOSH General Certificate.
  • 18th Edition IET Wiring Regulations (BS 7671) awareness.
  • Experience working in a data centre or critical infrastructure environment.

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Vertiv is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, you can request help by sending an email to [help.join@vertiv.com](mailto:help.join@vertiv.com)

job.title: Technical Service Delivery Director
job.description:
Milan, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

This position is based in Milan, Italy.

The Service Delivery Director is responsible for end-to-end delivery of telco and ICT services, ensuring services are delivered on time, within budget, and in line with agreed service levels and customer expectations.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership across Project and Service Management, driving service excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement for enterprise and/or wholesale customers.

Service Delivery Leadership

  • Own end-to-end service delivery performance across telco and ICT portfolios (e.g. fixed line network services, cloud, cybersecurity, managed services, unified communications).
  • Act as executive sponsor for key customer accounts, ensuring strong governance, escalation management, and relationship management.
  • Ensure service delivery aligns with commercial commitments, contractual SLAs, and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive a customer-centric culture focused on service quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

2. Project Management Oversight

  • Provide executive oversight of all delivery projects, including telco provisioning, network rollout, ICT transformation, service onboarding, and customer migrations.
  • Establish and govern a standardized Project Management framework (e.g. waterfall, agile, hybrid).
  • Ensure strong project governance, risk management, dependency management, and financial control.
  • Monitor delivery KPIs such as schedule adherence, cost variance, scope control, and benefits realization.
  • Intervene proactively on at-risk or critical projects to ensure successful outcomes.

3. Service Management & Operations

  • Lead Service Management functions aligned to ITIL / ISO 20000 best practices, including:
  • Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management
  • Service Level Management
  • Capacity, Availability, and Continuity Management
  • Ensure operational readiness for new services and smooth transition from project to BAU.
  • Oversee 24/7 operational support models (internal teams and/or vendors).
  • Drive service stability, reduction of repeat incidents, and improved MTTR and SLA compliance.

4. Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Establish service delivery governance frameworks, forums, and reporting structures.
  • Ensure compliance with security, data privacy, and regulatory standards relevant to telco and ICT services.
  • Manage vendor and partner performance, including SLAs, OLAs, and contractual obligations.
  • Oversee audit readiness and remediation of service delivery risks.

5. Financial & Commercial Management

  • Own service delivery budgets, cost optimisation initiatives, and financial forecasting.
  • Ensure delivery efficiency while protecting margins and supporting revenue growth.
  • Support pre-sales and bid activities by shaping delivery models, cost estimates, and risk assessments.
  • Drive productivity improvements through automation, tooling, and process optimisation.

6. People & Capability Leadership

  • Lead and develop high-performing teams across project management, service management, and operations.
  • Build succession plans and capability uplift in areas such as cloud, cybersecurity, automation, and digital service delivery.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Set clear performance objectives and manage talent development.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Telecommunications, Information Technology, Business, or related field.
  • 15+ years of experience in telco/ICT service delivery, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles.
  • Proven track record in managing large-scale service delivery portfolios and complex ICT/telco projects.
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL, ISO 20000, and project management methodologies (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile).
  • Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, optimize costs, and drive revenue-supporting initiatives.
  • Experience in vendor/partner management and regulatory compliance.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive-level presentation skills.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Rockingham
job.description:
Rockingham, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital experiences that help people feel more connected.

We’re searching for positive, customer‑focused Retail Service Consultant to join our Rockingham team in a Full-Time capacity. If you love helping people, thrive in a supportive team environment, and bring energy to every conversation, we’d love to have you on board.

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships, with our customers and with each other.

Your day to day:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Build strong product knowledge and become an expert across the full range of tech solutions, explaining everything in a friendly, simple and accessible way.
  • Use your personality, listening skills and service centric approach to understand customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Support customers through all enquiries, anything from general questions to complex issues, using empathy, clear communication and calm de‑escalation.
  • Contribute to a welcoming, customer‑first environment by working closely with your team and helping create memorable moments for every visitor.
  • Stay adaptable and proactive, helping out in periods of high activity and jumping in where needed to keep the store running smoothly.

It starts with you!

  • Service Superpower: You naturally focus on customer needs, offer genuine support, and let great service lead to phenomenal outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers understand technology, breaking it down simply and guiding them to the right solution.
  • Problem‑Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with genuine curiosity and integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You stay steady during tricky situations, easing tension with care and working toward the best result for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support and educate one another, stay accountable and create a space where everyone succeeds together.

job.title: Offensive Security Consultant, Google Cloud, Mandiant Consulting
job.description:
About the job

Mandiant's offensive security consulting team is responsible for performing Red and Purple Team assessments of customer environments. We breach our customer networks to reveal flaws, test weaknesses, and to exercise defensive teams and capabilities. We take Mandiant's frontline incident response and intelligence knowledge and apply cutting edge techniques and tradecraft being used by threat actors in the wild.

Our consultants are offensive security experts who specialize at executing all stages of the attack lifecycle, from initial compromise, privilege escalation, lateral movement, to achieving desired objectives. We adapt to customer technologies, from on-premises networks, to modern cloud architecture, to zero-trust and identity-centric environments, and everything in between.

We work together to emulate ransomware, financial, espionage, and other threat actors, and we aim to deliver the most realistic breach scenarios.

Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.

**

Responsibilities

  • Perform Red and Purple Team assessments, including end-to-end adversarial emulation of cyber attacks against customer organisations, and other technical cyber assessments including external penetration, web application, mobile and wireless security testing.
  • Expand the team’s capabilities through tool creation, research on offensive techniques, incorporation of threat actor intelligence, internal presentations and knowledge share.
  • Develop comprehensive and accurate reports and presentations for both technical and executive audiences, and act as a trusted advisor to c-level, security leaders and other customer stakeholders.
  • Assist with scoping prospective engagements, leading teams for engagements from kickoff through remediation phase, as well as mentoring other staff.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Staff Security Engineer, Third Party Security Diligence
job.description:
About the job

There's no such thing as a "safe system" - only safer systems. Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. As a Security Engineer, you help protect network boundaries, keep computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks and provide security services to protect highly sensitive data like passwords and customer information. Security Engineers work directly with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. You also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

You use your industry experience to own and drive the resolution of complex security incidents, policy questions and technical security issues.

As a Staff Security Engineer within Alphabet’s Third-Party (3P) Risk Management program, you will be a foundational technical leader driving enterprise security initiatives, responsible for the security posture of our 3P vendors. You will move beyond traditional compliance by assessing the security posture of 3P vendors (including complex SaaS/AI tools) in collaboration with other Security teams, performing architectural reviews of critical vendors and 3P products, and building automation to expand risk assessments and risk measurement and reporting. You will partner with several Corp Eng, Compliance, Procurement and Security teams to ensure that 3P vendors meet our security standards.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Establish a foundational framework for Third-Party Security Diligence (3PSD) engineering to automate and integrate security requirements seamlessly into the broader One Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) ecosystem.
  • Architect AI/ML-driven automation to accelerate vendor on boarding velocity and implement a centralized data engine that provides executive-level visibility and granular risk metrics across Alphabet.
  • Manage Complex Escalations, act as the primary technical lead for escalations, evaluating edge-case architectures and designing technical road maps for high-risk vendors to ensure they meet Alphabet’s security standards.
  • Partner with specialized security teams (eg. Cloud, Identity, SaaS etc.) to conduct holistic reviews and engineer "Golden Path" blueprints for common high-risk third-party scenarios.
  • Provide foundational technical leadership and mentorship to security engineers, driving strategic direction and high-impact risk reduction initiatives across the organisation.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Principal Strategist, Trust and Safety Monetization Education
job.description:
About the job

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

We support our monetization partners at the intersection of platform safety and business growth. As part of Trust and Safety Monetization (TSM), we act as the operational bridge to the Global Business Organization (GBO). We ensure our partners have the clarity and support to focus on scaling their business while we maintain a safe, low-friction environment across the monetization network.

In the role of Monetization Experience Education Specialist, your mission is to shift our ecosystem from reactive support to proactive partnership by architecting and deploying high-impact educational frameworks. By collaborating closely with Account Management and Policy teams, you will decode complex compliance rules into actionable knowledge—empowering publishers and advertisers to navigate our business generation ecosystem successfully and transparently. You will require a passion for professional education, excellent communication skills, strong analytical abilities, and a proactive approach to risk mitigation.At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, deliver, and facilitate global educational programs, onboarding modules, and interactive workshops to deepen ecosystem mastery of platform mechanics and policy standards internally and externally.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to audit partner touchpoints, identify systemic misunderstandings, and transform high-friction topics into user-friendly documentation and intuitive, actionable guidance.
  • Oversee and maintain centralized learning repositories, help centers, and multimedia assets to ensure content remains accurate, current, and aligned with evolving platform updates.
  • Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure effectiveness of educational outreach. Track performance metrics and identify pain points and iteratively scale training efficacy. Synthesize data into executive-level briefings to track progress.
  • Architect and execute targeted internal and external communication campaigns to boost the visibility, adoption, and scaling of educational tools across the publisher landscape.

job.title: Sr. Engineer - Mechanical
job.description:
What you’ll do:

" The primary responsibility of this role is to lead and execute various cost out projects related Metal manufacturing processes - Castings, Forgings, Sheet Steel, Stamping, Fabrication etc.) as part Direct Material Productivity (DMP) team. This involves close collaboration with Global Procurement Organization & Product divisions to generate cost out opportunities. The applicant will be responsible for working on various aspects of Direct Material Productivity with the primary goal of identifying, developing, and maintaining services that deliver significant cost out opportunities as well as creating a robust pipeline of executable cost out projects. The applicant should have capability to analyses commodity spend data & leverage data analytics & ideation principles to create new project opportunities. The incumbent needs to have an in-depth knowledge of requirements related to electrical components design and application, including duty cycle attributes. The incumbent needs to have an ability to develop design guidelines for these components along with an ability to develop test protocols."

"List the essential functions (i.e. key responsibilities with expected end results) which must be accomplished in order to fulfill the purpose of your position as described above.

A. Execute the enterprise wide strategic projects for Metal manufacturing processes -Castings, Forgings, Sheet Steel, Stampings, Fabrication commodities working along with Global Procurement Leaders B. Execute the strategic and operational plans for VAVE, Resourcing, Negotiation, Part Rationalization to achieve measurable outputs in terms of cost out goals C. Generate new ideas that are technically and commercially viable to reduce overall cost of the products and be competitive in the market D. Drive productivity by supplier consolidations, key data improvements & avoiding part proliferation E. Identify and develop different knowledge nuggets to run data analysis which can be reused for other projects. F. Participate in supplier discussions to generate new ideas and solution to gain cost out G. Leverage DFSS methodology to identify technical risks at an early stage of product development and develop robust product that meets customer requirements and specification H. Fosters New patents/disclosures while working on New Product development, VAVE and problem-solving projects

"

Qualifications

Minimum education for this position is a Bachelor / Masters in Mechanical Engineering, with demonstrated experience in technical engineering organization. (Preferably worked in Mechanical industry - Metal manufacturing processes ) 8+ years of experience with multinational engineering organization

Skills

"Hands on knowledge of Value Engineering principles & its deployment " Work & interact with global cross-functional and cross-cultural team. Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to clearly communicate to internal/external customers and suppliers.

job.title: Associate Analyst - Logistics CI
job.description:
What you’ll do:

"Work as a key member of the GSC COE Logistics team. As CI specialist, Individual will play a vital role in leading & supporting CI initiatives across Global Logistics department. This role demands to identify opportunities for improvements, drive projects and foster culture of continuous Improvement. This role will have different scope with different geografical impact (regional, cross-regional and global), and will be related to the main Logistics strategic areas of interest. The position will be reporting to Logistics Manager- in COE and will be working closely with global stakeholders to drive CI Initiatives.

Centre of Excellence journey – will work with CI manager to implement key actions for the Centre of Excellence journey for the Logistics team.

The position will require working in a cross functional team." "•Support change initiatives across all areas of the business by identifying, quantifying, and managing projects from operations, manufacturing, supply chain and support functions. •Deploy the Continuous Improvement (CI) strategy and lean tools & techniques to meet business KPIs, focusing on process improvements in quality, cost, service, and inventory. •Implement best practice lean tools and techniques within the business, including Eaton Lean Six Sigma (ELSS) •Assisst Kaizen and 5S events to ensure methodologies align with customer demands. •Address and reduce business issues through root cause analysis and corrective action plans. •Help in driving CI projects using DMAIC. Execute time studies, get SOP updates and work instructions for new transitions •Engage Logistics function to promote Lean/CI benefits and foster a culture of continuous improvement as a core business ethos. •Maintain a flexible approach to CI, adapting to the changing needs of the business to achieve goals and objectives. •Demonstrate proficiency in ELSS tools such as Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Standard Work, and 5S; coordinate ELSS self-assessments and implement action plans to address gaps. •Deliver projects and plans that achieve annualized savings as defined by business objectives. •Lead, train, and coach others in lean tools and techniques, building expertise throughout the business and fostering a culture of continuous improvement to meet KPIs. •Own and manage the Kaizen calendar, ensuring deployment and support of activities throughout the business. •Daily monitoring of CI projects and providing resolution for bottlenecks"

Qualifications

Engineering Degree or equivalent 2-3 years’ experience in a Continuous Improvement role and environment

Skills

"Certifications in Lean/Six Sigma SAP, SharePoint & Power App preferable" "•Demonstrated experience within SCM environment •Strong knowledge of CI tools and methodologies (e.g., VSM, RIE, BPI, Kaizen) •Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams. •Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. •Effective communication and training skills •Effective presentation skills •Strong focus on standardization and automation of processes"

job.title: Executive/Senior Executive, Digital Experience (2-Year Contract)
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across 270 cities in 45 countries.

Job Description

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Website Content & Governance

  • Own the end-to-end management of property onboarding, content updates, publishing, and quality assurance across Ascott's global brand website, ensuring compliance with brand standards, SEO best practices, and content governance requirements.
  • Serve as the primary point of coordination between regional teams, internal stakeholders, and external vendors on website content initiatives and enhancement projects.
  • Establish and maintain website content governance processes, approval workflows, and quality controls to ensure content accuracy, consistency, and relevance.
  • Conduct regular content and website audits, identify optimisation opportunities, and drive remediation plans to enhance content quality and user experience.

SEO & Discoverability

  • Support the execution and continuous enhancement of the website SEO content framework to improve organic visibility, traffic, and website performance.
  • Own and drive SEO optimisation initiatives including keyword research, metadata optimisation, internal linking, content reviews, and content refresh programmes.
  • Monitor website performance across search engines and emerging AI-assisted search experiences, and identify opportunities to improve discoverability, engagement, and content effectiveness.
  • Partner with agencies and internal stakeholders to implement SEO recommendations, track performance, and provide actionable insights on search trends and optimisation priorities.

Digital Experience & Optimisation

  • Support the planning, coordination, and implementation of website enhancement and optimisation initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.
  • Analyse website and content performance data to identify opportunities to improve traffic, engagement, conversion, and overall digital experience.
  • Manage the implementation of website content layouts, campaign landing pages, and digital content experiences in accordance with brand and user experience standards.
  • Manage UAT planning and execution for website enhancements and new feature releases, ensuring quality, functionality, and business requirements are met.
  • Track project progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes, driving timely resolution and stakeholder alignment.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Manage relationships with agencies, technology vendors, and external partners to ensure quality delivery and achievement of project objectives.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendor teams to align priorities and drive execution.
  • Provide guidance and support to regional teams and properties on website content, SEO, and digital experience best practices.

Project Governance & Support

  • Support project governance activities including documentation, budgeting, purchase requests, vendor management, and invoicing for assigned initiatives.
  • Support strategic digital experience initiatives and other projects as required.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Degree in Digital Marketing, Communications, Information Technology, Business, Multimedia, Design, or a related discipline.
  • Preferably 2-5 years of experience in website content management, SEO, digital marketing, web analytics, digital experience, or related disciplines.
  • Strong understanding of SEO principles, including keyword research, metadata optimisation, content strategy, information architecture, internal linking, and technical SEO fundamentals.
  • Experience managing content management systems (CMS), website publishing workflows, and digital campaign implementation.
  • Working knowledge of web analytics platforms and the ability to translate performance data into actionable recommendations.
  • Understanding of user experience (UX) principles and digital customer journeys.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders, vendors, and concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and communication skills.
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Experience in hospitality, travel, e-commerce, or multi-market digital environments will be an advantage.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical coverage
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Remediation Specialist
job.description:
What You'll Do

  • Assess and investigate customer cases across remediation programs, executive escalations, TIO disputes, Financial Counsellor referrals and other complex customer matters.
  • Review and analyse high-profile cases, develop remediation recommendations and present outcomes to senior stakeholders where required.
  • Lead complex investigations and collaborate with Quality Control, Regulatory, Legal and operational teams to ensure appropriate customer outcomes.
  • Champion the customer voice by identifying vulnerability, assessing customer impact and recommending fair and transparent resolutions.
  • Identify root causes and systemic issues, translating insights into improvements across processes, controls and customer experience.
  • Support proactive remediation initiatives while ensuring outcomes align with regulatory obligations and customer expectations.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years' experience in a dedicated remediation, complaints, dispute resolution or customer advocacy role managing complex cases end-to-end.
  • Proven experience identifying root causes, applying remediation frameworks and delivering fair outcomes for customers.
  • Strong experience managing escalated and sensitive customer matters with sound judgement, empathy and resilience.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple business areas and senior leadership groups.
  • Strong understanding of customer vulnerability, customer experience drivers and fair customer outcomes.
  • Knowledge of regulatory, complaint management or remediation environments will be highly regarded.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present clear recommendations and insights.

The good stuff….

  • Competitive remuneration and colleague discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and outstanding shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through colleague-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.title: Telstra Retail: Part Time Customer Service & Sales Consultant RHODES
job.description:

Job Title

Telstra Retail: Part Time Customer Service & Sales Consultant RHODES

Job Summary

As a Retail Consultant, you will provide frontline support by assisting customers with product selection, service activation, and troubleshooting basic issues. You will create positive experiences through effective communication and adherence to retail standards. This role demonstrates foundational autonomy and contributes to customer satisfaction and store performance.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Hourly Rate: $33.33 per hour

*Junior rates apply for those under 20 years of age.

*Penalty rates are as follows: Additional 25% for weekday hours worked after 6 PM, 25% for hours worked on Saturday, 100% for hours worked on Sunday and 150% for hours worked on public holidays.

  • Plus 12% Superannuation
  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs with LinkedIn Learning, and develop your career with our Future Ready program designed to build on your skills and prepare you for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.

Is It You We’re Looking For?

  • Language Skills: Fluency in Mandarin and English is highly desirable, as you'll be supporting and communicating with Mandarin-speaking customers within our local community.
  • Great Communication Skills: You’re a natural at connecting with people and making their day better.
  • Solution-Oriented Approach: You enjoy thinking on your feet and tailoring solutions for each customer.
  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.
  • Passion for Learning: You’re eager to grow and develop your skills in a dynamic environment.
  • Resilience and Positivity: You have a can-do attitude, even when things get busy.
  • Customer-Facing Experience: Previous experience is a plus but not required—bring your enthusiasm and we’ll teach you the rest!

How to Apply:

Ready to kickstart your journey with us? Click "Apply Now" to submit your application! After applying, keep an eye out for an email from our partner, HireVue, to complete the next step in our assessment process.

Join Us at Telstra Retail:

When you become part of the Telstra team, you’re joining a brand that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone is respected, valued, and can thrive. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to our team!

job.title: Market Specialist, Global Response Operations, India
job.description:
The Global Response Operations organization within Global Operations responds to real-time crises, proactively identifies and evaluates emerging risks, conducts risk-related investigations, and assesses what we could be doing to best benefit our community. By understanding and consistently managing incidents and real-time crises to resolution, the organization drives continuous improvement with our partners across Meta.

The SEO (Specialized Enforcement Operations) team specifically focuses on high priority, complex or regulatory enforcement demand, where our systems or scaled solutions need specialized support. SEO team is flexible and agile, bringing enforcement experience that can be deployed to shifting priorities and dynamic emerging situations, necessary local context, language, policy, community or functional expertise.

You will work with stakeholders in Operations, Policy, legal, Process and Product teams to review and enforce content reported for potential abuse, resolve user account issues, improve the overall support experience for India, as well as solve enforcement issues across a wide range of Meta markets.

The Market Specialist will be part of a data-driven team focused on protecting our communities by enforcing on and will also help scale our operations by optimizing and automating processes, solving challenging problems and, most importantly, helping to prevent them.

Responsibilities

  • Work as part of the SEO South Asia team, enforcing on paid and organic (non-paid/user) content during a crisis response within the South Asia region while specifically representing the India Hindi Market.
  • Work as part of an On-call Operational structure to enforce on critical content, particularly in response to Government, Regulatory and Trusted Partner escalations, within SEO Regions with a higher focus on India.
  • Draw upon linguistic and cultural expertise in India's Hindi market, to identify crucial risk signals and gain valuable content insights that can help address complex operational and risk-related issues present in both advertisements and user-generated content across the region.
  • Use a combination of market knowledge and operational expertise to support new policy and product initiatives/launches in India Hindi Market and the broader South Asia Region.
  • Support development of scalable operational solutions to enhance support for our user community in the India Hindi market, while also collaborating effectively with other regions.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and address issues reported on Meta products such as requests for account support and reports of potentially abusive content including but not limited to graphic images, videos and writings, offensive or derogatory language, and other objectionable material.
  • Support enforcement efforts on agnostic and paid content that originates from multiple sources globally, where language expertise is not required.
  • Support enforcement efforts identifying integrity risks to our local and regional advertising business and enforce on these risks.
  • Support region wide programs of work supporting peak season buying initiatives, protecting advertisers, businesses and removing friction in the ad delivery process.
  • Assess top-line operational metrics and collaborate with internal cross-functional teams to improve our processes and tools.
  • Liaise closely with our Meta vendor teams to ensure all operational KPIs meet and exceed targets and work collaboratively to improve processes and tools and scale solutions.
  • Collaborate with regional cross-functional teams on leading or supporting key integrity initiatives in the market and/or the broader region.
  • Build subject matter expertise in a key area of integrity concern or theme, and support this by developing strategies and outlining and implementing comprehensive enforcement solutions.
  • This role may involve exposure to graphic and/or objectionable content including but not limited to graphic images, videos and writings, offensive or derogatory language, and other potential objectionable material, i.e. child exploitation, graphic violence, self-injury, animal abuse, and other content which may be considered offensive or disturbing.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
  • Fluency in written and conversational Hindi so as to support operations and communicate with stakeholders in Hindi
  • 5+ years of professional experience within an operations environment
  • Experience communicating with a variety of audiences and stakeholders
  • Strategic thinker with strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships with internal and external partners
  • Ability to work with graphic and/or objectionable content
  • Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
  • Experience working with ambiguity and developing new processes or solutions in response to changing circumstances

Preferred Qualifications

  • A background or understanding of the Trust & Safety Domain Technical and data skills such as Excel and SQL and experience with visualisation tools such as Tableau to drive efficient analytics and reporting
  • Language proficiency other additional Indian Languages is preferred as the role will be supporting operations for the South Asia region
  • Excellent analytical, project management, and problem-solving skills, with an interest in innovation and technology

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Complex Fraud Analyst
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband, and digital solutions.

At Optus, protecting our customers and business from fraud is critical to delivering exceptional customer experiences. As a Complex Fraud Analyst, you will play a key role in detecting, investigating, and preventing customer, subscription, and network fraud. Working within the External Fraud Risk team, you'll leverage your analytical expertise to identify emerging fraud trends, conduct complex investigations, and deliver insights that strengthen Optus' fraud risk controls and minimise fraud-related losses.

What You'll Do | Your day to day will consist of

  • Investigate and analyse customer, subscription, and network fraud incidents.
  • Monitor high-risk activity and identify emerging fraud trends.
  • Perform data analysis to uncover risks and support fraud prevention strategies.
  • Partner with stakeholders to investigate, resolve, and remediate fraud issues.
  • Provide recommendations to strengthen fraud controls and processes.
  • Prepare insights, reports, and findings for management and senior leaders.
  • Support fraud awareness and education initiatives across the business.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant legislation, regulations, and Optus policies.

What You Bring | What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Experience in a fraud, risk, investigations, or analytical role.
  • Strong data analysis skills and experience working with large datasets.
  • Ability to identify trends, investigate complex issues, and deliver recommendations.
  • Knowledge of telecommunications products and processes is highly regarded.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management capabilities.
  • A proactive, detail-oriented, and solution-focused mindset.
  • Ability to adapt in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
  • A collaborative approach and passion for protecting customers and the business.

The good stuff…. | What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and colleague discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and outstanding shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through colleague-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.title: Site Security Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As a Site Security Manager reporting directly to the Building Services Manager you will work closely with the rest of the Operations team, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Supervise the security and soft services aspects of the data centre facility operations for assigned properties
  • Manage 3rd party security staff’s performance to ensure adherence to standard operating procedures and any other requirements to deliver AirTrunk’s maintenance and compliance programs
  • Oversee maintenance and upgrades on the site security network

Your Day to Day

  • First point of contact for all visitors, responsible for the efficient processing of visitors, contractors, clients and AirTrunk staff into the facility as well as any other front of house requests
  • Conduct regular property inspections focusing on security and EHS
  • Ensure all aspects of data centre security systems are in line with AirTrunk’s policies
  • General administrative duties, such as producing reports, providing evidence for audit, and tracking time and attendance of staff
  • Coordination with Site FM team leads on security, access, and maintenance requirements
  • Ensure new security staff and security vendors are trained and qualified
  • Assist in the delivery of various accreditation initiatives, including, but not limited to, ISO 27001 and SOC 2
  • Support the Critical Environments team in the management of physical security incidents at the property
  • Develop emergency response plans and conduct drills
  • Coordinate staff when responding to emergencies and alarms
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant security regulations and standards
  • Support Building Service Manager in soft services

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of experiences and 2+ years of experience in a people management role, ideally in a physical security or operations environment
  • Data centre or mission critical background is a plus
  • Successfully managed audit and ideally experience with managing 3rd party vendors and customers
  • Security License and First Aid Certificate holder or meet requirements to acquire these
  • Experience in reporting and emergency response planning
  • Ability to comprehend, analyse and interpret operational documents
  • Can establish and review incident reports, emergency event summaries, root cause analysis reports and O&M manuals
  • Proficient in computer systems, ideally with experience in CCTV and/or EACS systems (such as Genetec or Lenel)
  • Registered as Fire Safety Officer

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer - Java Backend - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Product Software team at Equinix builds next-generation software products and architecture for our product software and services offerings. We are seeking engineers to serve as a technical pillar for the organization. In this role, you will not only design and develop product software application but also define the architectural standards for consistent APIs and event-driven microservices. You will act as a bridge between product vision and technical execution, collaborating with engineering leaders and product managers to abstract complex enterprise workflows into scalable, resilient systems. Thus, a commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, product quality and secure code is essential

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Contribute to the technical strategy and execution for modular, event-driven, and scalable microservices supporting enterprise workflows
  • Design and implement reusable frameworks and self-service modules for service onboarding, configuration, and lifecycle management
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate software design, testing, and operations - e.g., AI-assisted code reviews, test generation, and root cause analysis
  • Collaborate with senior architects and cross-functional teams on architecture decisions
  • Promote design practices that improve maintainability, observability, and operational excellence

Engineering Excellence

  • Lead by example—building secure, reliable, and observable systems that meet performance and scalability goals
  • Implement and advocate best practices for API-first development, CI/CD automation, and DevSecOps
  • Partner with product managers and peers to translate business intent into scalable technical solutions
  • Contribute to automation and AI-driven monitoring that improves reliability and accelerates problem resolution

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science and Engineering or equivalent
  • 4 - 7 years of full stack expertise in cloud-based application development on a microservice architecture with in-depth knowledge of Java
  • Experience coordinating cross cutting initiatives in a product organization and engaging with cross-functional Product Management and Engineering teams
  • Possess hands-on experience with engaging Product Managers to crystalize requirements into technology solutions for delivery
  • Hands-on experience with UI technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Typescript, ReactJS
  • Hands-on experience with frameworks and tools including Spring, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, JPA, Junit, NodeJS, Express & SQL/NoSQL, Git
  • Possesses hands-on experience and technical expertise across AWS and GCP, with proficiency in technologies such as Ansible, Containers, Kubernetes, Temporal, and Terraform, along with observability tools including Grafana, AppDynamics, and PagerDuty
  • Basic understanding of Identity concepts such as SAML, JWT, OAuth, and microservices
  • Possesses knowledge of data modelling (RDBMS, XSD, JSON), Database/XML interaction, SQL, ORM, and hands-on experience with RDBMS databases like Postgres, Oracle and RDS

Successful candidate will

  • Be a talent multiplier who gets the team around them to excel
  • Be persistent, creative and driven to get results relentlessly
  • Exhibit a strong backbone to challenge the status quo, when needed
  • Exhibit a high level of curiosity, keeping abreast of the latest trends & technologies
  • Show pride of ownership and strive for excellence in everything undertaken

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

job.title: Security Design and Integration Manager - India
job.description:
Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

The Security Design and Integration Manager will drive efforts in securing data centers across India and will be based out of Mumbai, or Hyderabad, working in a remote setup.

This role supports the delivery of physical security scope for AdaniConneX projects in the region, from early design through commissioning and turnover, and oversees compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards across security design, integration, implementation, and programming. The role also supports the integration of EdgeConneX security and customer security efforts, ensuring compliance with all applicable standards. Successful execution requires strong navigation of local construction practices, regulatory authorities, and stakeholder dynamics, and the ability to build durable working relationships with sophisticated enterprise customers. This position is customer-facing and must uphold the ideals of EdgeConneX excellence.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support the delivery of physical security scope for AdaniConneX projects across from early design through commissioning and site turnover and oversee compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards throughout.
  • Serve as subject matter expert (SME) on EdgeConneX requirements and physical security standards, providing authoritative guidance to project teams, delivery partners, and stakeholders.
  • Support the definition of project security requirements and acceptance criteria, ensuring alignment to EdgeConneX physical security standards and customer expectations.
  • Support procurement and provide technical oversight of security designers, integrators, and programmers.
  • Review security designs and submittals produced by integration partners for compliance with EdgeConneX physical security standards, including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, intercoms, and related field devices.
  • Liaise with customer security teams and local construction teams to align AdaniConneX project delivery with EdgeConneX physical security standards and customer-specific requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate and liaise with both AdaniConneX stakeholders and customer subject matter experts (SMEs) to align on security requirements, resolve issues, and maintain a shared understanding throughout delivery.
  • Oversight of physical security systems, including S2, Lenel, and Genetec systems.
  • Validate installation and configuration quality through quality checks, site walks, and commissioning reviews; audit security contractors on quality, schedule, and compliance.
  • Support closure of design gaps, defects, and punch items, including verification of corrective actions.
  • Adapt EdgeConneX baseline standards to local conditions and to authorities holding jurisdiction in India.
  • Maintain documentation quality, including design drawings, as-built records, test results, configuration records, and turnover packages.
  • Provide estimating and budgeting inputs for physical security systems when requested.
  • Collaborate with Security Operations on site turnover and operational acceptance.
  • Participate in shaping Security Design and Integration global standards and processes, and improve standards, templates, and repeatable design patterns to reduce rework and improve consistency across the portfolio.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong technical understanding of physical security systems and integration methods.
  • Ability to evaluate designs quickly, identify gaps, and make practical decisions under delivery pressure.
  • Strong vendor management sets expectations, enforces baseline requirements, and holds delivery partners accountable.
  • Strong communications, both written and verbal, in leading teams and coordinating with peers and other disciplines on driving projects and issues to closure.
  • Clear communicator who can translate technical requirements into simple, executable direction for integration partners and internal project teams.
  • Customer-facing presence; able to represent EdgeConneX professionally with sophisticated enterprise customers and sustain alignment through extended ramp and onboarding cycles.
  • Strong and effective team player working across various disciplines and peer groups; able to cover the full range of tasks required to get the job done.
  • Superb ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Disciplined execution: tracking, documentation, follow-through, and closure.
  • Comfortable operating across multiple sites and stakeholders in a multilingual Indian environment without losing attention to detail.
  • Commitment to organizational excellence and constant awareness of opportunities to improve processes and quality of deliverables.
  • Superb ability to work independently while adhering to standards.
  • Ability to use computer systems related to security management and reporting.

Experience / Education

  • 3+ years of experience in physical security design, systems integration, or physical security program delivery.
  • Minimum 2 of those years managing large-scale security design and installation projects.
  • Experience supporting critical infrastructure environments; Data center experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience delivering in India or the broader APAC region, including working knowledge of local construction practices and jurisdictional security requirements.
  • Experience working with technical drawings and standard construction deliverables such as submittals, requests for information, and as-built documentation.
  • A working knowledge or ability to learn: PCI/DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 certifications, as well as AutoCAD and associated drawing programs.
  • Candidates with experience in S2, Lenel, ExacqVision and/or Genetec are highly encouraged to apply.
  • Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Physical Security Professional (PSP), or equivalent certification preferred, or willingness to pursue.
  • Fluent in English required; proficiency in Hindi or additional Indian regional languages a plus.
  • Interest in cyber security.
  • Travel - the candidate is expected to travel around 50% regional and global travel for this position, including travel on short notice.

EdgeConneX believes inclusion – of thought, backgrounds and experiences – affects all that we do, from our employees to the solutions we deliver. Our goal is to create an environment where embracing differences helps deepen the lives and work experience of our employees, enhances our innovation and creativity, and enriches our involvement in our communities. EdgeConneX is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, as well as any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

EdgeConneX offers a competitive benefits package.

For more information on how we process your data, visit our Data Privacy Policy [here](https://www.edgeconnex.com/privacy-policy/#:~:text=Our%20goal%20is%20to%20be,to%20Personal%20Data%20we%20process.).

job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

  • Responsible for the maintenance of District Cooling System (DCS) plants, Retail Cooling Monitoring (RCM) and other field works
  • Implement and monitor service and maintenance programme
  • Support analysis and optimization of plant maintenance
  • Supervise and implement all maintenance processes including externally sourced contractors
