job.title: AI Enablement Manager (APAC) SMBG Governance and Enablement
job.description:
Meta's Small and Medium Business Group (SMBG) contributes directly to Meta's mission by connecting every small and medium business in the world with their customers on Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger, and then helping them grow through solutions like pages, advertising, messaging, commerce and many other tools. SMBG is one of two sales channels responsible for Meta's multi-billion dollar advertising business, supporting 1,000+ frontline sellers through Mid-Market Account Managers and external vendor partners globally.

The AI Enablement Manager is responsible for driving AI proficiency, AI-native enablement delivery, and AI-powered operational infrastructure across SMBG's 1,000+ frontline sellers spanning Small Business Solutions and Mid-Market segments. This role owns three distinct mandates: (1) Enabling proficiency WITH AI tools — driving skilled adoption of Meta's AI tool ecosystem, (2) Enabling THROUGH AI tools — architecting a unified, just-in-time enablement system that delivers the right information to sellers where they already spend time, replacing fragmented stand-and-deliver training with a governed push/pull model that personalizes by role, region, and segment, (3) AI Operations — using AI to run the enablement function itself, including how requests come in and get prioritized, how much we're asking of sellers at any one time, keeping content accurate as tools change, and spotting gaps early, and (4) Regional Enablement Partnership (~25%) — serving as the in-region enablement support for the Mid-Market APAC team, driving alignment with Sales Intelligence (SI) priorities, accelerating adoption in-market, capturing regional feedback, and ensuring APAC sellers receive timely, contextualized support that accounts for local market dynamics.

Sitting on the Sales Intelligence Governance & Enablement team, this role is a critical bridge between AI program managers, sales leadership, and frontline sellers — translating rapid product evolution into measurable behavior change at scale. ensuring regional needs shape global priorities while global programs land effectively in-market. The work is in close partnership with cross-functional teams including AI product teams and program managers, Sales Planning & Operations, Mid-Market APAC leadership, and regional sales teams.

A successful candidate will have a proven track record of driving AI adoption in large, distributed sales organizations and will be adept at designing both enablement programs and operational systems that scale without linear headcount. They will bring editorial judgment — the discipline to keep enablement brief, high-quality, and worth a seller's time: the discipline to keep enablement brief, high-quality, and worth a seller's time in an environment where AI makes it trivial to produce more content than anyone will read. They will be as willing to cut and consolidate as to create. They will be comfortable operating in a fast-moving AI landscape where the tool ecosystem evolves weekly, and will lead through influence in a highly cross-functional and matrixed environment. They will thrive as a regional node in a global team — proactively surfacing what APAC needs, translating global initiatives for local context, and building trust as the go-to SI resource for the Mid-Market APAC team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead AI adoption strategy across SMBG (Small Business Solutions and Mid-Market), driving the organization from current proficiency levels toward full AI-native operations across all segments and regions
  • Design, develop, and deliver AI enablement programs, including recurring protected learning time, role-based curriculum, and adoption of validated workflows, that build real competency rather than tool awareness and result in measurable seller behavior change
  • Evaluate adoption data, behavioral trends, and seller sentiment to diagnose gaps and drive continuous improvement across segments
  • Source and scale what's already working — run a mechanism to identify strong practices emerging in regions and teams, package them to a consistent standard, and promote them org-wide in partnership with regional leads and the SME and champion network
  • Architect a unified push/pull enablement system that consolidates fragmented tools into a single mechanism — delivering governance, product updates, training reinforcement, and operational guidance through AI-powered assistants and conversational tools where sellers already spend time
  • Design the content governance layer: a governed knowledge base with defined owners, update cadence, and review process that ensures sellers always receive accurate, current information
  • Build personalization capabilities that surface the right content based on who the seller is — role, region, segment, and vertical — without requiring manual curation per audience
  • Implement learning reinforcement through AI: training-aware triggers (post-session recaps, follow-ups for missed sessions), knowledge checks, and spaced reinforcement that replaces one-time delivery with continuous learning
  • Create feedback loops that track what sellers are asking and surface themes back to SI — turning seller demand signals into enablement priorities
  • Coordinate cross-channel (Global Business Group, Mid-Market, Enterprise, SBS) to prevent tool/skill fragmentation and ensure a single, scalable architecture
  • Bring structure to how AI enablement demand comes in and gets prioritized, applying automation where it removes manual triage, so it is clear what is being asked, what is already covered, and what needs a place on the roadmap
  • Manage seller mindshare as a finite resource, maintaining a single view of what AI enablement is asking of sellers in a given period and coordinating with the wider enablement, comms, and program teams so competing asks are sequenced rather than stacked
  • Operate the content lifecycle that keeps the enablement system trustworthy: detecting tool changes and flagging outdated assets, so content is corrected before a seller acts on it
  • Detect where sellers are getting stuck by drawing on the issues they raise and how they are actually using the tools — diagnose whether the cause is missing guidance, the wrong tool for the job, or a product gap, so each is routed to the team that can fix it
  • Replace manual trackers with reporting that is generated rather than maintained by hand, surfacing enablement health, adoption trends, seller sentiment, and governance compliance on demand from source systems
  • Serve as the primary SI enablement point of contact for Mid-Market APAC leadership — attending regional forums, joining key calls, and maintaining a continuous feedback loop between APAC sellers and the global SI team
  • Drive alignment of SI priorities in-region: ensure APAC teams understand upcoming launches, governance changes, and enablement initiatives, and that rollout timelines account for APAC-specific constraints (time zones, local market nuance)
  • Accelerate workflow adoption in APAC by contextualizing global enablement programs for regional relevance — adapting examples, use cases, and workflows to reflect APAC advertiser dynamics and seller workflows
  • Surface regional adoption gaps, seller friction, and unmet needs back to the global SI team with clear signal and proposed action — acting as APAC's voice in global prioritization
  • Partner with APAC Mid-Market leadership to identify region-specific champion sellers and build a local SME network that amplifies best practices and peer learning within the region

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 8+ years of experience in sales enablement, L&D, sales operations, or program management
  • 2+ years of experience applying AI, automation, or technology-driven approaches to scale enablement or operational processes
  • Project management experience and experience running strategic programs with cross-functional teams
  • Strong communicator with experience in facilitation across all levels — skilled at addressing both large and small audiences across multiple leadership levels and functions
  • Experience enabling large, distributed sales organizations (500+ people) including outsourced vendor partners across multiple regions and time zones
  • Experience building or improving operational systems and processes (intake workflows, prioritization frameworks, governance pipelines)
  • Experience dealing with ambiguity, rapid change, and unstructured problems
  • Open, collaborative and proven team player, with experience in initiating and driving projects to completion with minimal guidance or support

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with change management at scale during organizational transformations
  • Data fluency — able to pull adoption metrics, build dashboards, and translate data into action
  • Experience designing operational infrastructure using AI/automation (workflow orchestration, automated intake, intelligent routing)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Hands-on creative production capability — able to independently produce polished, consistent enablement assets at speed, such as short-form video, animation, visual explainers, or interactive micro-learning, without dependency on a dedicated creative team
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as an effective regional node within a globally distributed team — building trust, driving local adoption, and representing regional needs in global forums
  • Background in sales enablement for BPO/vendor ecosystems with multi-tier governance needs
  • Experience working in or closely with APAC sales teams, with understanding of regional market dynamics, advertiser ecosystems, and cultural nuances across key APAC markets
  • Knowledge of the advertising marketplace and ad products
  • Familiarity with tools like enterprise AI assistants and LLM-powered sales tools, such as conversational assistants embedded in CRM or sales workflow platforms
  • Experience building or managing AI-native knowledge systems (chatbots, LLM-powered agents, skill-based automation, push/pull content delivery)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Vice President, Regional Construction Execution (APAC)
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

NTT is currently looking for a Vice President, Regional Construction Execution (APAC). The Vice President, Regional Construction is a key executive role reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Construction. The successful candidate will have direct accountability for the design, supply chain and construction organizations in the region responsible for capital infrastructure investment. This role will provide strategic direction and leadership to enable and execute projects within specified timelines, budgets, and quality standards to enable the regional business goals of the company.

This is a full time remote role based in Malaysia, Singapore or Thailand.

What we are looking for

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans for the construction, design and supply chain organizations, aligning with the Global Infrastructure Development (GID) organization's overall goals, the business goals in the region and industry trends/best practices. Identify opportunities for growth, speed to market improvement, and cost optimization.
  • Team Leadership: Manage a team of construction, design and supply chain professionals, including project managers, engineers, architects, commercial managers, etc. Foster a collaborative and high-performing work environment, promoting teamwork and individual development.
  • Regional Leadership: Be the in-region leader of the broader GID team which includes the construction, design and supply chain organizations, but also global teams with in-region resources (safety, power, land, project controls and front end engineering).
  • Project Management: Ensure proper project management is occurring from initiation to completion, ensuring adherence to project plans, schedules, and budgets. Monitor progress, identify potential risks, and implement mitigation strategies as necessary.
  • Vendor and Contractor Management: Monitors the performance of general contractors, architects/engineers and other suppliers to ensure compliance, execution, quality, and safety standards.
  • Supply Base Development: Personally engage with the key principals of supply chain partners to develop a supply chain that can reliably support the business needs of the company in the region.
  • Budgeting and Financial Management: Liaisons with project controls on project funding plans, necessary financial forecasts and reports.
  • Quality Assurance: Work with CX/Quality team to ensure adherence to quality assurance and commissioning programs and regulatory requirements are met.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including sales, operations, clients and regulatory authorities. Communicate project updates, resolve issues, and maintain positive relationships with all parties involved.

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

  • Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, building codes, safety regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex construction projects on time and within budget.
  • Ability to build a strong safety culture throughout the organization.
  • Strong financial acumen and experience in budgeting, cost control, and financial analysis.
  • Proficiency in project management software, construction management tools, and MS Office suite.
  • Understanding of design and engineering.
  • Proven experience in implementing processes in a rapid growth environment
  • Knowledgeable of the basics necessary for operating in compliance where NTT is located.
  • Knowledgeable of the key supply chain operating concepts, executive relationships with supply chain partners in the region and claims management.
  • Knowledgeable of construction law and contracts.
  • Skilled at creating and maintaining a collaborative design/construction/operations environment in a global culture.

ACEDEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, or a related field. Master's degree (beneficial).

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Extensive experience (15+ years) in construction management, preferably in a leadership role within the construction industry. Ideally experience with design and supply chain sourcing in addition to construction.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Remain stationery for long periods of time.
  • Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • Perform work during regional business hours and time zones with flexibility for global coordination.

WORK CONDITIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Travel required up to 50%.
  • Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Sales Operations & Support Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

1\. Export Shipment and Collateral Management

This section focuses on operational oversight and documentation accuracy for technical products.

  • Plan, schedule, and coordinate the export of goods, including transportation, documentation, and customs requirements.
  • Ensure timely shipment and delivery of goods to meet customer expectations and avoid penalties or delays.
  • Oversee the correct preparation of export documentation such as invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin (FTA/AIFTA etc.
  • Ensure to share them in a timely manner with the relevant regional Interco team.
  • Coordinate with Engineering to ensure product specifications, technical manuals, and compliance certificates are included in the export documentation package.

2\. Product and Engineering Interaction

This section defines the collaboration with the technical teams.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Serve as the liaison between Interco/Commercial teams and the Engineering/Manufacturing departments.
  • Technical Readiness: Work with Engineering to track the design freeze, compliance sign-off, and production readiness of new or updated electrical/mechanical products intended for export.
  • maintain a foundational understanding of the technical side of the export product line to accurately represent technical status and requirements in planning meetings.
  • Risk Mitigation: Identify and proactively communicate product-related risks that could impact export timelines, such as regulatory compliance issues or last-minute design changes.

3\. Risk Mitigation & Process Optimization

This section is focused on continuous process improvement.

  • Identify and mitigate risks in the export process, including issues related to customs, logistics, or international regulations
  • Take the ownership of Developing, refining, and implementing efficient Interco export processes and workflows to streamline export operations
  • Identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies in the export processes and recommend solutions to enhance effectiveness and speed
  • Work with Engineering to define clear handover points (e.g., _Product to Documentation_ or _BOM to Logistics_) to reduce delays.
  • Resolve any issues that arise during the shipment process, such as delays, damaged goods, or customs holds

4\. Inventory, SIOP, and Product Lifecycle Management

This section includes the planning role, incorporating engineering readiness into the SIOP process.

  • Discuss with the regional Interco team and Plan to liquify the inventory in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate with regional Interco team and inform Demand /factory team if any order is expected to delay.
  • Conduct and attend weekly SIOP meeting for product readiness date.
  • Ensure Engineering's inputs on product testing, quality checks, and final assembly schedules are integrated into the SIOP meeting's discussion on the product readiness date.
  • Monitor FOC shipments (in case of need) through periodic credence meeting etc

5\. Export Order Dashboard and Interco Communication Management

  • Maintain export Smartsheet on a regular basis.
  • Share weekly OB and sales reports with LOB/region classification and tables.
  • Upload and maintain Interco order status on EBO for respective region
  • Ownership of maintaining the latest lead time sheet for all the export products on EBO
  • Lead the weekly meeting with Interco teams and effectively and timely communicate the order acknowledgement.

  • Bachelor’s Degree/ Diploma or equivalent of 5-10 years’ experience
  • Proven experience in project management, preferably in process improvement or organizational development projects.

  • Experience in implementing continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Six Sigma / Lean certifications / PMP or any other Project Management certification
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, utilizing data-driven insights for decision-making.

The AutoCAD HVAC & Revit Draftsman/Designer is responsible for preparing detailed HVAC engineering drawings, layouts, and 3D BIM models using AutoCAD and Revit software. Job Description

Brief Job Description:

Job Title

Service Engineer – Precision Air Conditioning (PAC)

Department

Service Operations – Thermal Management

Reporting To

Service Manager / Regional Service Manager

Job Summary

The PAC Service Engineer is responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and customer support for Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) systems and associated cooling equipment. The role requires ensuring maximum equipment uptime, meeting SLA commitments, and providing excellent customer service at data centers, telecom sites, IT facilities, and commercial establishments.

Key Responsibilities Installation & Commissioning

  • Perform installation, testing, and commissioning of PAC units and associated cooling systems.
  • Verify site readiness and ensure compliance with engineering drawings and safety requirements.
  • Conduct performance testing and prepare commissioning reports.
  • Coordinate with project teams, customers, and subcontractors during project execution.

Preventive Maintenance

  • Execute scheduled preventive maintenance activities for PAC units, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, condensers, CDU, FWU, and related systems.
  • Inspect compressors, condensers, evaporators, fans, control panels, sensors, and refrigerant circuits.
  • Submit maintenance reports and recommendations for improving equipment reliability.

Breakdown & Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose and rectify faults in electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, and control systems.
  • Analyze alarms and operational abnormalities using controller logs and monitoring systems.
  • Ensure timely closure of breakdown calls as per SLA commitments.
  • Support emergency and critical site requirements during breakdown situations.

Customer Support

  • Provide technical support and guidance to customers.
  • Maintain professional communication during service visits.
  • Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and effectively.
  • Prepare service reports and obtain customer sign-off upon activity completion.

Spare Parts & Inventory Management

  • Identify and recommend replacement parts and consumables.
  • Maintain service inventory and tools in good condition.
  • Support quotation preparation for repairs and spare replacement requirements.

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) guidelines.
  • Ensure proper usage of PPE during service activities.
  • Maintain compliance with customer safety regulations and permit systems.
  • Report unsafe conditions and incidents immediately.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or related field.
  • ITI (RAC/Electrical) with relevant experience may also be considered.

Experience

  • 2 to 8 years of experience in HVAC, Precision Cooling, or Critical Cooling Systems.
  • Experience in data centers, telecom infrastructure, IT facilities, healthcare facilities, or commercial buildings preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Good understanding of refrigeration cycle and HVAC principles.
  • Experience with:
  • Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) Units
  • CRAC / CRAH Systems
  • Chilled Water Systems
  • DX Cooling Systems
  • Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Condensers
  • CDU and FWU Systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot:
  • Compressors
  • EEV/TEV Valves
  • Refrigerant Circuits
  • PLC and Microprocessor Controllers
  • Electrical Panels and Drives
  • Sensors and Communication Networks
  • Knowledge of refrigerants and safe handling procedures.
  • Familiarity with BMS and remote monitoring systems.

Key Competencies

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Customer-focused approach.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently at remote sites.
  • Time management and SLA adherence.
  • Teamwork and collaboration.

Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

  • Preventive Maintenance Compliance.
  • First-Time Fix Rate (FTFR).
  • Breakdown Response Time (RT).
  • Turnaround Time (TAT) for call closure.
  • Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT).
  • Service Revenue through spare parts identification.
  • Safety Compliance and Zero Incident Record.

Travel Requirements

  • Willingness to travel extensively across assigned geographical regions.
  • Availability for emergency breakdown support, weekend work, and on-call duty when required.

Preferred Industry Experience

  • Data Centers
  • Telecom Facilities
  • IT Parks
  • Critical Infrastructure Projects
  • Pharmaceutical Facilities
  • Manufacturing Plants
  • Commercial Buildings

Preferred Certification: HVAC/R, Refrigerant Handling, Electrical Safety, Working at Height, and OEM-specific PAC product training (Vertiv, Stulz, Schneider, Rittal, Climaveneta, etc.).

job.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Application Development and Support Analyst to provide development, maintenance, enhancement, and production support for Oracle Applications. The role will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, troubleshooting application issues, and working closely with business users, technical teams, and other stakeholders to ensure system stability and continuous improvement.

The candidate will be responsible for analyzing incidents and service requests, understanding business processes, identifying root causes, coordinating resolutions, supporting enhancements, and ensuring that Oracle Applications meet business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Application Support
  • Provide production support for Oracle Applications.
  • Analyze and resolve application incidents, defects, and service requests within agreed SLAs.
  • Troubleshoot issues related to Oracle modules, interfaces, concurrent programs, reports, workflows, and database objects.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions.
  • Support application deployments, patches, upgrades, and production releases.
  • Application Development
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Perform unit testing, system testing, and support user acceptance testing.
  • Business & Stakeholder Management
  • Work closely with functional teams and business users to understand requirements and resolve issues.
  • Participate in requirement gathering, impact analysis, and solution design.
  • Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain knowledge of business processes and their relationship with Oracle Applications.

Required Technical and Functional Skills

  • Strong functional knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) and/or Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications.
  • Good understanding of one or more Oracle functional modules.
  • Strong understanding of business processes related to the supported Oracle modules.
  • Experience in production application support and incident management. Experience in Manufacturing Industry preferred.
  • Ability to troubleshoot functional issues and perform root-cause analysis.
  • Experience in requirements gathering and functional analysis.
  • Experience preparing functional specifications and test cases.
  • Strong knowledge of SIT, UAT, regression testing, and defect management.
  • Basic knowledge of SQL for data validation and investigation is desirable.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, Jira, or other IT service management tools is an advantage.
  • Experience working with Oracle Support or third-party Oracle vendors is desirable.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Typically, 3–5 years of experience in Oracle Application support or a similar role.
  • Experience supporting Oracle EBS R12 and/or Oracle Fusion Cloud is preferred.

job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of medium to large-scale Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM transformation programs.
  • Establish and manage project governance structures, steering committees, RAID logs, and delivery dashboards.
  • Ensure adherence to enterprise PMO standards, delivery frameworks, and quality gates across all phases of implementation.
  • Oversee implementations, enhancements, and optimization initiatives across Oracle Fusion HCM modules, including:
  • Global Human Resources (Core HR)
  • Recruiting Cloud (ORC)
  • Compensation & Benefits
  • Talent Management

  • HR Help Desk

  • Participate in solution design workshops, requirement gathering, testing, training, and production support activities.

  • Upstream and Downstream integrations

job.description:
Job Description

Join us as a Security & Resilience Management Specialist and take the lead in protecting our organization from emerging threats. This role combines strategic planning, hands-on incident response, and the opportunity to build a culture of security that touches every corner of our business.

What will you do?

job.title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Data, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
job.description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build.

You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers. AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.

Key job responsibilities Design and implement production-grade data pipelines, data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh architectures within enterprise HCLS environments, integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks.

Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems, ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale.

Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast-moving delivery engagements, making judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight.

Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements unique to pharma and healthcare including GxP compliance constraints, HIPAA, and regulatory data governance frameworks.

Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments.

Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations.

Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures.

Apply AI-DLC (AI-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery to redesign data workflows to become AI-native for accelerated scale and pace.

job.title: Senior Account Manager, TSG, IT & ITES, AWS India
job.description:
Do you have the business savvy and technical background to help establish Amazon Web Services as the preferred cloud platform for India's IT and ITeS industry? AWS India is seeking a Senior Account Manager to lead cloud strategy and revenue growth across one of India's most dynamic and globally influential sectors.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own the end-to-end cloud strategy for a portfolio of strategic, high-revenue IT services companies, software product firms, and technology-enabled services organizations. You will operate as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, influencing multi-year technology decisions and driving large-scale digital transformation programs. This role requires you to think at the level of how India's leading technology companies architect their platforms, modernize their delivery models, and build next-generation solutions on AWS for their global customers. You will define the strategic direction for your accounts, execute complex multi-stakeholder commercial engagements, mentor junior Account Managers, contribute to segment-level strategy, and represent the voice of the IT/ITeS customer within AWS to influence product roadmaps and go-to-market priorities.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive Cloud Adoption Across IT/ITeS Organizations: Lead strategic sales initiatives focused on workload migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation, and AI/ML adoption to help IT/ITeS companies build competitive advantage through AWS.
  • Own the long-term cloud strategy for your accounts and develop multi-year account plans that align AWS capabilities with customer business objectives, including platform modernization, IP development on AWS, and enabling customers to build cloud-native offerings for their end clients.
  • Executive Relationship Building and Influence: Establish and sustain CXO-level relationships across your accounts. Engage with CEOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers, Engineering Heads, and Delivery Leaders to position AWS as a strategic partner.
  • Influence technology decisions at the board level and drive executive alignment on large transformation programs.
  • Complex Deal Structuring and Negotiation: Lead multi-year commercial engagements including EDPs, PPAs, and custom pricing constructs.
  • Navigate complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders, legal teams, and partner ecosystems.
  • Structure deals that balance customer value with AWS business objectives.
  • Cross-Functional Orchestration: Operate as the single-threaded leader for your accounts, orchestrating across Solutions Architects, Partner teams, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver cohesive customer outcomes.
  • Segment Strategy and Market Shaping: Contribute to the IT/ITeS segment strategy by identifying industry trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace opportunities. Provide inputs that shape go-to-market priorities, pricing strategies, and product investments for the segment.
  • Revenue Growth and Pipeline Management: Own revenue targets, build and manage a healthy sales pipeline, forecast accurately, and drive deals through complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Customer Success and Expansion: Ensure successful onboarding and adoption of AWS services, identify expansion opportunities across different business units and service lines, and drive consumption growth through strategic engagement across GenAI, data analytics, and modernization use cases.
  • Thought Leadership and Advocacy: Organize and participate in workshops, hackathons, webinars, and industry events to build AWS mindshare, showcase customer success stories, and establish AWS as the innovation partner of choice for IT/ITeS organizations.

A day in the life As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be responsible for driving their cloud journey from initial engagement through large-scale adoption. Your day will involve a mix of strategic planning, customer engagement, internal collaboration, deal execution, and team development activities.

A typical day may include:

Strategic Planning: Reviewing multi-year account plans, analyzing consumption trends, identifying whitespace opportunities, and preparing for upcoming customer engagements with clear objectives and value propositions. Assessing deal progression across your portfolio, identifying blockers, and aligning resources to accelerate critical opportunities.

Customer Meetings: Conducting CXO steering committees and executive briefings with business leaders, technical deep-dives with engineering teams, and business reviews with account stakeholders to drive alignment and momentum on large transformation programs.

Internal Collaboration: Working with Solutions Architects on technical proposals, coordinating with Partner teams on joint go-to-market initiatives, engaging Product teams to address customer requirements, and providing customer feedback that influences service roadmaps critical to the IT/ITeS segment.

Deal Progression: Advancing complex commercial engagements through the sales cycle, structuring multi-year agreements, addressing procurement and commercial discussions, negotiating contracts, and removing blockers to close deals. Relationship Development: Building trusted advisor relationships through regular cadence calls, proactive outreach, sharing relevant insights and best practices, and connecting customers with AWS resources and expertise.

Knowledge Building: Staying current on AWS service launches, industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer success stories to bring fresh ideas and relevant insights to customer conversations.

job.title: Software Development Manager, AWS DynamoDB
job.description:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. Want to shape the future of a NoSQL database service that supports mission-critical workloads operating at more than 100 million requests per second? Let's take its speed and efficiency to the next level!

Amazon DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.

We are looking for an engineering leader eager to improve the discoverability, safety, and efficiency of DynamoDB.

As a software development manager on the DynamoDB team, you will lead a team of passionate engineers to build reliable and highly scalable distributed systems. This is a good opportunity to pave the path for a new generation of cloud database services, grow as a technology leader, and work with some really smart people. To succeed in the role, you must be passionate about both solving deep technical challenges and being a great people manager. You must care deeply about system availability and reliability, and understand what it means to own a mission-critical service that handles hundreds of millions of requests per second, with sub-millisecond latencies and eight 9s of availability. You must be great fun to work with. Our company credo is “Work hard. Have fun. Make history”. The right candidate will be smart, ambitious, love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun. Building, motivating and mentoring a world-class systems & software engineering team is the most important part of this role. You should have a proven track record in recruiting and retaining top talent and excel in day-to-day people and performance management tasks.

You must have a strong Agile product management and delivery experience. The successful candidate will create and implement product roadmaps for the team using Agile methodologies. This will include helping innovate and invent new value-add services layered on top of our existing services. You will need excellent technical project management skills to deliver product roadmap items as well as other cross-team projects. You will set the vision of how to evolve DynamoDB going forward.

You must have a strong operational experience, with a track record of operating highly available fault tolerant systems. The right candidate will want to measure everything and be very data driven. They will excel at using metrics, monitoring and alarming to measure and improve the operational processes and performance of their team. The candidate must be comfortable operating in a fast moving, dynamic environment.

If you want to test your limits, build a world-class team, and tackle challenges at a scale and level of impact rarely seen, join us!

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of engineering team management experience
  • 7+ years of engineering experience
  • 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
  • Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
  • Experience partnering with product or program management teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
  • Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.

Key job responsibilities 🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling

  • Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
  • Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
  • Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
  • Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations

  • Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
  • Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
  • Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
  • Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support

  • Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
  • Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation

  • Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
  • Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
  • Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning

  • Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
  • Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
  • Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
  • Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
  • Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
  • Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
  • Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination

  • Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
  • Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development

  • Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
  • Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
  • Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
  • Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
  • Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
  • 1+ years of computer networking experience
  • High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
  • Familiarity with rack decommissioning including device wipe, media destruction, and asset recovery procedures

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. job.title: Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI, Healthcare and Life Sciences
job.description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.

Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

Key job responsibilities

  • Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
  • Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
  • Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
  • Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
  • Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
  • Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
  • Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
  • Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
  • Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

job.title: Data Center Operations Cluster Manager, BOM - DCO
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Operations Manager is a senior leadership role for our compute operations teams within an AWS region. They will have managerial responsibility for safety, security, availability, scaling, costs and efficiency for their department. They lead the team that is installing, maintaining, and de-commissioning network and server equipment in a safe, secure and cost-effective manner across the region. The Data Center Operations Manager must manage across each function but also have the ability to dive deep into any given function as needed. They must have a strong background on people management with a team size of 60+ employees.

The successful candidate will be a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to problems. The candidate will have a strong understanding of network and compute architecture and have experience managing repair requests in a high volume environment, as well as managing response to high severity events. They will have a strong track record of developing talent, and managing performance of their team and organization. They will be creating, and tracking budgets; strategically planning through use of metrics; sponsoring, reporting and delivering large projects while proposing technical solutions to complicated problems. This position requires a candidate with the proven ability to drive continuous improvement and the ability to keep pace with our explosive growth while motivating others to meet the challenges of an extremely deadline-driven environment.

Key job responsibilities Lead and supervise a team of Data Center Managers and Engineers across multiple data centers, installing, maintaining and decommissioning network and server hardware.

  • Oversee the safety, security, availability, quality, and performance of the team, while driving a positive customer experience.
  • Strategic planning and forecasting; manage team and individual performance; delivering performance reviews, and address staffing needs
  • Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures.
  • Mentor, train and develop career progression for direct reports and members of the organization.
  • Obsess over team learning and development, both from a technical/functional and soft skills (critical thinking, emotional intelligence, and adaptability) development perspective.
  • Coordinate support of change management resources in partnership with electrical and mechanical operations teams.
  • Develop, improve, and share operational best practices across the region and with peers globally.
  • Ability to oversee and manage complex projects for delivery against tight timelines to exceed customer expectations.
  • Design and execute comprehensive strategic initiatives that align with organizational goals and drive operational efficiency
  • Facilitate rapid response protocols and support dynamic problem-solving initiatives
  • Provide expert guidance and mentorship to team members in high-pressure environments
  • Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing teams in a fast-paced technical environment
  • Experience with compliance requirements and industry standards (e.g., ISO, ITIL, SOC)

A day in the life Your day will be a blend of strategic leadership and hands-on technical problem-solving. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor talented engineers, and develop innovative approaches to data center management. From optimizing hardware performance to fostering team growth, you'll be at the center of our operational success.

About the team Our team is a collaborative, forward-thinking group dedicated to maintaining world-class data center infrastructure. We value continuous learning, technical innovation, and creating an inclusive environment where every team member can thrive and contribute meaningfully.

About AWS Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities, or 2+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
  • 5+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
  • Experience driving internal cross-team collaboration
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in managing managers and leading large-scale teams including performance management, talent development, and succession planning. Stringent time management skills to balance workloads in a complex and dynamic environment
  • Brings experience in operational strategy and change management, with a focus on collaborative decision-making and innovative problem-solving. Demonstrates knowledge of industry standards (ISO, ITIL, SOC) and budget management, alongside skills in developing practical operational procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, management, or technology, or Master's degree or above in engineering, management, or technology
  • Knowledge of Lean Six Sigma and process improvement methodologies
  • Experience leading large teams, with demonstrable ability to hire, develop, and manage high-performing technical teams
  • Experience operating mission-critical online services
  • Knowledge of technology principles and services including infrastructure, business applications, data management, security, application platforms, and consumer-facing technology

job.title: Senior Business Development Sales Specialist
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

10 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Senior Business Development Sales Specialist

Job Summary

Job Description

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

This includes making Telstra the place you want to work. For you, that means a having career that grows with you and working with a team powered by human connection that prioritises wellbeing and choice

Focus of the Role

As a Senior Business Development Sales Specialist in our secure networks team, you'll work with some of our largest customers to identify, shape and close Data & Connectivity (DAC) and Managed Data Network (MDN) opportunities that help businesses transform, grow and stay competitive. As Telstra execute on our Connected Future 30 strategy, Secure Networks will be a key growth engine for Telstra Enterprise. This role will be at the forefront of delivering some of our most strategic and transformative customer engagements, helping shape the future of connectivity, security, and digital innovation across Australia.

What we offer

Performance-related pay Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business.

Purchased annual leave scheme

Additional Telstra day off

Additional 30% off Telstra products and services

Toolkit provided (laptop + mobile phone + plan paid for)

We're looking for a relationship-focused sales professional to help grow our Data and Connectivity business across some of our largest AMLR (Agribusiness, Manufacturing, Logistics and Retail) customers as well as our exciting Media, Entertainment, Gaming and Sports (MEGS) portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building trusted customer relationships, identifying growth opportunities and leading strategic sales conversations. Your primary focus will be driving Data and Connectivity (DAC) and Managed Data Network (MDN) outcomes, helping customers modernise and transform their network environments.

While the role is centred on DAC and network sales, it also provides an excellent pathway into broader technology solution selling. You'll work alongside specialists across cloud, security, collaboration, professional services and managed services, giving you the opportunity to continually expand your knowledge and career.

Preference will be given to Melbourne-based candidates, as the role primarily works with Melbourne-based customers.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Growing Data and Connectivity sales across a portfolio of strategic AMLR and MEGS customers
  • Leading customer conversations around network transformation, managed networks and connectivity outcomes.
  • Building trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and becoming a valued advisor.
  • Identifying opportunities to retain, grow and expand existing customer engagements.
  • Working collaboratively with Client Partners, Specialists, Presales and Delivery teams.
  • Developing account and opportunity strategies that deliver long-term customer value.
  • Leading commercial negotiations and contributing to major bids, tenders and complex sales opportunities.
  • Maintaining a healthy pipeline and delivering accurate forecasting.

What Success Looks Like:

You'll be successful in this role if you:

  • Build strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Consistently identify and convert DAC and MDN opportunities.
  • Grow your portfolio through strategic account planning and proactive opportunity development.
  • Become a trusted advisor to customers on network and connectivity outcomes.
  • Continue developing your broader technology sales capability over time.

What We're Looking For

  • Enterprise sales, business development, or account management experience, preferably within telecommunications, networking, managed services, or technology solutions.
  • Proven ability to build strong customer relationships, identify growth opportunities, and drive commercial outcomes.
  • Strong customer engagement, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.
  • Commercial acumen with experience navigating complex sales cycles and strategic customer engagements.
  • A proactive, results-driven, and growth-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with Data and Connectivity solutions, including enterprise networking and managed services.
  • Exposure to managed network, infrastructure, or technology sales.
  • Experience working with large enterprise customers across industries such as retail, logistics, manufacturing, or related sectors.
  • Experience participating in RFPs, tenders, and strategic pursuits.
  • Knowledge of broader technology domains, including cloud, cyber security, and professional services.

If you are looking to take the next step in your career, we want to hear from you!

As part of your application with Telstra, you may receive communications from us on +61 440 135 548 (for job applications in Australia).

When you join our team, you become part of a welcoming and inclusive community where everyone is respected, valued and celebrated. We actively seek individuals from various backgrounds, ethnicities, genders and disabilities because we know that diversity not only strengthens our team but also enriches our work. We have zero tolerance for harassment of any kind, and we prioritise creating a workplace culture where everyone is safe and can thrive.
