job.title: Account Manager - Toowoomba, Warwick
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

17 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Account Manager - Toowoomba / Warwick

Job Summary

Job Description

Build Something Bigger Than a Career. Help Local Businesses Thrive.

**Account Manager

  • Toowoomba, Queensland**

At Telstra Business Technology Centre Toowoomba, we're building something special. As our local business continues to grow, we're looking for people who are passionate about helping customers get the most from technology while building meaningful relationships, making a genuine impact, and growing a rewarding career.

This is an opportunity to become a trusted adviser to local businesses across the Darling Downs, helping them embrace technology, solve real business challenges, improve productivity, and achieve their goals.

You'll spend your time building strong customer relationships, understanding what matters to their business, and connecting them with solutions that genuinely make a difference.

Focus of the role

As an Account Manager you support the development of deep customer relationships, managing and growing your own defined portfolio of accounts. This role is critical to maintaining strong customer relationships that grow TBTC. and Telstra’s revenue across our business customer portfolios. Your ability to listen to and deeply understand our customers, combined with your exceptional organisational skills will ensure you support our business customers to find the best ICT solutions to achieve their business goals. You will always put the customer first and support our pillars of Customer Obsession, Brilliant People and Partnerships, Responsible Growth and Returns and Execution Excellence.

This is a fast-paced, high-energy role where your ability to build long standing mutually beneficial relationships will be key to your success.

Why This Opportunity Is Different

Many roles focus on transactions. This role focuses on relationships.

You'll work with a portfolio of local businesses to help them maximise the value they receive from their technology investments.

You'll become a trusted partner who understands their journey, identifies opportunities to improve outcomes, and helps them navigate an increasingly digital world.

The result is long-term customer success, stronger partnerships, and sustainable business growth.

Grow Your Career Without Leaving Toowoomba

For many people, career progression often means moving away from family, friends, and community.

Here, you can enjoy the lifestyle and connection that comes with living in regional Queensland while accessing the opportunities, resources, and career pathways available through one of Australia's most recognised technology brands.

  • Industry-leading learning and development programs
  • Structured career progression opportunities
  • Ongoing coaching and mentoring
  • Exposure to emerging technologies, cyber security, cloud and AI solutions
  • Employee benefits and incentive programs
  • Opportunities to contribute ideas and influence the future direction of the business

When our customers succeed, we succeed.

  • The support of a collaborative and high-performing team
  • The backing of a trusted Australian brand

Be Part of Something That Matters

We're not looking for someone to simply inherit an established customer base. We're looking for someone who wants to help build lasting customer relationships and contribute to the continued success of our Toowoomba business.

Your contribution will be visible. You will see the impact of your work through:

  • Customers who become more productive and successful
  • Relationships that grow over many years
  • Local businesses that benefit from your advice and support
  • A team that values your ideas and contribution
  • A business that continues to grow because of the difference you make

This is a role where your work genuinely matters.

Who You'll Be Working With

You'll join a supportive, collaborative team that believes in helping each other succeed.

We celebrate wins together, learn from challenges together, and genuinely enjoy working together.

You'll have the freedom to bring your ideas, build your own style of customer engagement, and contribute to a culture that values trust, accountability, growth, and teamwork.

About You

You genuinely enjoy helping people. You build trust naturally and take pride in creating positive customer experiences. You are curious, motivated, and enjoy learning new things.

You may come from:

  • Account Management
  • Customer Success
  • Business Development
  • Customer Service
  • Banking or Financial Services
  • Retail Leadership
  • Hospitality
  • Education
  • Small Business
  • Telecommunications or Technology

What matters most is your ability to build relationships, understand customer needs, solve problems, and help people achieve their goals.

Experience can be taught. A positive attitude, genuine care for customers, and a desire to contribute to a great team are what set people apart.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success isn't measured solely by sales results. Success means:

  • Customers achieving positive business outcomes
  • Strong customer retention and loyalty
  • Trusted long-term relationships
  • Identifying opportunities that genuinely help customers grow
  • Delivering an exceptional customer experience
  • Contributing positively to team culture and business growth

Commercial results are important, but they come from putting customers first.

Join Us

If you're looking for a career where you can grow, make a difference, build meaningful relationships, and be part of a supportive team that's helping local businesses thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

Join us and help shape the future of business technology in Toowoomba.

job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Director – North & South India ###

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will be responsible for growing sales of B&R’s next-generation technology, machine connectivity, automation and edge, high-end motion systems, and technology software solutions in the southern region and market. The role demands a mix of sales acumen, technical understanding, and customer engagement.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Automation Division-B&R in Faridabad, India. Main stakeholders are Customers (OEMs, system integrators, and end users), channel partners, internal sales/application engineering teams, project execution teams, and business leadership.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Build and maintain good customer and partner relationships to generate opportunities and grow the sales pipeline.
  • Analyze customer needs and market trends to develop and present tailored techno-commercial solutions.
  • Handle negotiations and complete successful deal closures to meet business targets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless project execution and customer satisfaction.
  • Promote B&R technologies through customer engagement, industry events, CRM forecasting, and after-sales growth initiatives.

Qualifications for the role:

  • 5-10 years of experience in industrial automation sales and solution selling.
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or Mechatronics Engineering.
  • Extensive experience in automation technologies and application development.
  • Demonstrated ability in customer engagement, communication, and negotiation.
  • Experience working with multinational organizations.
  • Fluent in English and Hindi; regional language proficiency.

More about us:

B&R Industrial Automation is a manufacturer of automation technology and ABB's global center for machine and factory automation. B&R was founded in 1979 by Erwin Bernecker and Josef Rainer and has its headquarters in Eggelsberg, Upper Austria. Today, B&R is a leading global solution provider for automating machines and factories and is responsible for machine automation in ABB's Robotics & Discrete Automation division.

job.title: Commissioning Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Operations Manager - BL Excitation(AMEA)__

Your role and responsibilities

Act as Excitation commissioning engineer of projects with low to medium complexity. Ensure completion of all commissioning activities efficiently and cost-effectively, in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, and safety requirements.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to planning and implementation of Excitation/Synchro commissioning/engineering activities, identifying and developing new processes, techniques and solutions to meet current and emerging customer and business needs
  • Participate in internal project review meetings and provide technical inputs while managing customer relations at senior levels to deliver customized solutions that meet project requirements
  • Ensure approval of plant acceptance criteria, open issues closure, performance tests and adherence to safety standards
  • Lead risk and opportunity assessments for assigned projects, identify and report potential risks, evaluate mitigation options, and conduct Safety Observation tours to mitigate HSE hazards
  • Impart training and coach project teams towards safe working practices, contribute to continuous improvement of project processes, and actively share lessons learned to the knowledge repository
  • Create standard processes, tools, work plans and cost estimates in line with strategic priorities, ensuring all commissioning activities comply with required safety regulations and contractual requirements
  • Support Project Managers/Site Managers in issuing claims (new scope of work, cost impact, time impact, risk quantifications etc.) and may manage commissioning teams as required
  • Manage external organizations to ensure availability of commissioning equipment, systems, or services in coordination with Supply Chain function, Project Manager and/or Site Manager

Our team dynamics

You will work as part of a dynamic, project-focused team within the Energy Industries Division. You'll collaborate closely with Project Managers, Site Managers, and technical specialists across multiple locations. Your role involves mentoring junior team members while supporting senior leadership in delivering complex projects on schedule and within budget. The team environment emphasizes safety, innovation, and continuous improvement, with regular knowledge-sharing sessions and collaborative problem-solving approaches.

Qualifications for the role

  • More than 5 years of experience on small, medium and large ABB Excitation system (UNITROL and SYNCHROTACT family) engineering and commissioning, or equivalent experience with other similar systems
  • Holding certification on ABB excitation system commissioning will be given first preference
  • Collaborative, solution-focused approach
  • Strong written and spoken communication skills in English
  • Grid code models simulation software experiences (PSSE, PSCAD & other)

What's in it for you?

This is a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of energy transition and industrial innovation. As a Commissioning Engineer in the Energy Industries Division, you'll play a critical role in delivering integrated solutions that help traditional and emerging industries decarbonize and optimize their operations. You'll gain exposure to cutting-edge excitation and synchronization technology while contributing to projects that impact power generation, chemical processing, and beyond. The role offers significant technical growth through exposure to complex systems, advanced simulation software, and the opportunity to lead and mentor engineering teams on challenging projects.

More about us The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

This role is contributing to the to the Process Automation business in Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India You will be mainly accountable for:

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Evaluates, selects, and applies standard techniques and procedures to perform engineering assignments. Handles testing, installation, and commissioning activities. Prepares project documentation within one’s scope of deliverables.
  • Assists in preparing proposals/presentations for engineering projects/programs (provision of bills of materials, estimated engineering hours, etc.).
  • Supports the Contract Manager in change management (new scope of work, cost impact, time impact, risk quantifications, etc.).
  • Creates work plans and cost estimates in one’s area of responsibility. Reviews and approves scope, budget, and schedule for assignments and ensures quality deliverables on time and within targeted cost. Improves the effectiveness of work plans in collaboration with other functions.
  • Completes Power Management System-related risk and opportunity assessments and ensures implementation of resulting actions in one’s area of responsibility. Reports any contract/quality/program/cost issues to management along with recommendations for resolution.
  • Collaborates with the Supply Chain function to ensure that technical requirements for equipment or services are communicated and agreed on with potential suppliers. Provides technical evaluation of supplier proposals and accepts as fit for purpose supplied equipment or services.
  • Use standard processes and tools applicable to one’s area of responsibility. Ensures that engineering activities comply with required safety regulations and contractual requirements. Reports process and tool inefficiencies and suggest improvement ideas. Assigns tasks to and coordinates work with entry-level engineers, technicians, and administrative staff.

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum 4+ years of relevant experience in engineering and commissioning of Power Management Systems (PMS), covering functionalities such as primary equipment monitoring and control, load shedding, load sharing, and synchronization.
  • Hands-on experience in designing substation network architecture of control systems and control philosophy for process/power plants.
  • Working knowledge of utility communication protocols like IEC 61850, OPC, Modbus, DNP3, IEC 101/104, TCP/IP, Prefab’s, Profinet, Fieldbus, SPA, convergence of OT/IT, cybersecurity, etc. Hands-on experience with application engineering tools for any DCS.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring controllers, protocol gateways, and data concentrators on various communication protocols. Experience working with various manufacturer IEDs on IEC 61850 protocol, creating IEC, ICD, CID, and SCD files.
  • Bachelor's degree (4 years) or equivalent experience, and willingness to travel nationally and internationally up to 70%. Valid international passport.

job.title: Senior Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

As a Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customer environments. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as a "builder-consultant," moving beyond architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions.

This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will solve the integration complexities, data readiness, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment and acting as a critical feedback loop for Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll grow by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the "Discovery-to-Deployment" journey, serving as the lead developer for AI applications and transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems and MCP servers) that drive measurable return on investment.
  • Bridge the enterprise gap by architecting and coding the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters.
  • Engineer for production excellence, building high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet the requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Act as a product catalyst, identifying repeatable field patterns and technical "friction points" in Google’s AI stack and converting them into reusable modules or product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
  • Drive regional leadership and upskilling by mentoring talent, co-building with customer teams, and influencing cross-functional strategies to uplevel organizational technical capabilities.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: People Consultant
job.description:
About the job

People Operations strives to revolutionize human resources the same way that Google has revolutionized search. We are helping to find, grow and keep the remarkable assemblage of talent who are our Googlers. You'll be an advocate of Google's culture and values, partnering with our business leaders to help them build their organizations and make sure all people decisions are based on data. Whether coaching our clients on how to lead their teams, navigating and resolving employee relations issues or managing programs that help develop our Googlers, you are exceptionally focused on putting them first, and being as clear and transparent as possible to help Googlers understand how people decisions get made.

As a People Consultant you will work directly with Googlers, People Partners and other People Operations (POps) teams to provide personalized guidance, support, and solutions on a breadth of People Operations related activities requiring expertise and depth across multiple organizations and specialties.

People Consultants will ensure that employees experience the best that HR has to offer. You will focus on Googlers' experiences, provide timely responses, share knowledge and experiences with fellow team members, and balance individual needs with our philosophy, principles, and available resources.

Great just isn't good enough for our People Operations team (known elsewhere as "Human Resources"). We bring the world's most innovative people to Google and provide the programs that help them thrive. Whether recruiting the next Googler, refining our core programs, developing talent, or simply looking for ways to inject some more fun into the lives of our Googlers, we bring a data-driven approach that is reinventing the human resources field.

job.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Developer AI, Google Cloud

job.title: Security Engineer, Third Party Security Diligence
job.description:
About the job

There's no such thing as a "safe system" - only safer systems. Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. As a Security Engineer, you help protect network boundaries, keep computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks and provide security services to protect highly sensitive data like passwords and customer information. Security Engineers work directly with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. You also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

You use your industry experience to own and drive the resolution of complex security incidents, policy questions and technical security issues.

SPMA (Security and Privacy for Mergers, Acquisitions and Alphabet) team’s mandate is focused on reducing Acquisitions, third-party and Cloud risk to Google and Alphabet.

SPMA executes on its mandate through three key verticals:

  • Mergers, Acquisitions and Alphabets (M&A): Effectively and safely raise the security bar for Google’s Off Google entities (Acquisitions and Bets); helping companies navigate Google’s security landscape and processes, thereby safely and securely integrating/divesting/separating them.
  • Alphabet Use of Cloud (AUC): Manage and minimize risk from Alphabet’s use of public clouds (GCP).
  • Third-party/Vendor Security Diligence (3PSD): Ensure effective governance and minimize risk from Alphabet’s use of third-party vendors.

This role sits within the Third Party/Vendor Security Diligence (3PSD) vertical, focusing on third-party security. Alphabet’s Third Party Security Diligence program ensures security of our third-party engagements, and is part of a broader third-party risk management ecosystem.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive security diligence for critical and high-risk third-party vendors, evaluating their controls against Google's requirements, identifying risks, and recommending remediation.

Contribute to the engineering improvement of the Third Party Security Diligence (3PSD) program by developing tools, automation, and proposing process enhancements.

Assist in technically integrating 3PSD tools with the wider OneTPRM ecosystem and support data analysis to identify risk trends.

Collaborate with and provide security guidance to internal stakeholders like vendor managers and Product teams on third-party engagements.

  • Develop and maintain deep technical expertise in security domains relevant to third-party risk (e.g., cloud, application security, IAM) and help create reusable security patterns and best practices.

We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. job.title: Security Engineer, Enterprise SaaS Security
job.description:
About the job

There's no such thing as a "safe system" - only safer systems. Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. As a Security Engineer, you help protect network boundaries, keep computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks and provide security services to protect highly sensitive data like passwords and customer information. Security Engineers work directly with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. You also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

You use your industry experience to own and drive the resolution of complex security incidents, policy questions and technical security issues.

In this role, you will be responsible for securing Google’s enterprise usage of third-party SaaS platforms. You will help scale the capacity for incoming security vulnerabilities, build automated tooling to reduce manual workloads using AI, and drive risk insights and remediations. You will ensure all new SaaS launches are secure by performing security assessments and ensure the adoption of required security controls.

You should have application security experience: SaaS or Cloud Security, API security, authentication and access control, threat modeling, conducting security assessments, etc.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement robust security controls, automated tools, and services to proactively identify and mitigate security risks across Google’s enterprise SaaS ecosystem.
  • Safeguard enterprise SaaS usage by analyzing complex threat vectors, developing defensive strategies, and hardening identity and access management controls.
  • Execute comprehensive security assessments for third-party SaaS platforms, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure secure integration and adoption of rigorous security standards.
  • Engineer and maintain SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) solutions, leveraging AI-driven automation to reduce operational toil and enhance visibility.
  • Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to track and remediate vulnerabilities, ensuring a secure, scalable, and resilient operating environment.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Developer AI, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you function as an "innovator-builder," moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic accounts, you serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product road map.

In this role, you will embed with the engineering organizations of our largest customers and take Google's developer AI - Gemini Code Assist, anti-gravity IDE, SDK, CLI and the agentic surfaces beneath them - from the first conversation to a production-grade workflow. You find what actually slows an engineering organization down, design the system that fixes it, and own it end-to-end: discovery, build, roll-out, hardening, and the long tail of making it reliable.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Design and deploy production-grade agentic developer workflows on Google Cloud's AI stack, executing large-scale refactors, language migrations, spec-to-PR pipelines, and automated review/incident-to-fix loops.

job.title: Senior Delivery Manager, Platform
job.description:
ROLE SUMMARY

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Senior Delivery Manager, Platform to own the delivery of Firmus' software platform into each of our data centres, taking it from plan through commissioning and go-live to operational handover. The platform is what makes our GPU compute operable: the cloud and Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, API, and the tooling our teams build on. You work across internal engineering teams, delivery partners, and contractors to bring each site live, holding delivery to scope, schedule, quality, and commercial commitments. This role is critical to ensure each site deployed securely, on schedule, and with increasing repeatability.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Per-Site Delivery Planning & Sequencing

Own the platform's per-site delivery plan: scope, sequencing, milestones, critical path, and the readiness and acceptance criteria for each go-live. Align with the overall per-site schedule owned by the overall Technical Program Manager (TPM) and hold scope against agreed statements of work.

Deployment & Commissioning

Execute the plan at each site: integration, configuration, migration, and commissioning through to production validation and go-live against the agreed gates. Keep the deployment playbook, runbooks, and standards so every rollout is repeatable rather than bespoke.

Risk, Dependency & Change Governance

Own risk, issue, and change management across the delivery, and coordinate cross-squad and external dependencies with the Tech Leads, platform architect, and delivery TPM. Run the governance cadence of status, milestone tracking, delivery KPIs, and decision logs, and track scope change and budget against plan.

Partner & Contractor Management

Own the delivery-partner and contractor relationship end to end. Scope and brief the work, hold systems integrators and contractors to schedule, quality, and commercials, and retain internal accountability for what they execute in the blended delivery model.

Stakeholder Alignment, Reporting & Handover

Act as the single interface between platform engineering and the site programme, keeping engineering, operations, partners, and executive stakeholders aligned through each deployment. Give the leadership team straight read on status, risk, and the decisions needed. Drive the transition to operations: knowledge transfer, on-call readiness, hyper care, and the exit criteria that let a site hand over clean.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent delivery experience.
  • 10+ years delivering complex software or platform programmes to production, owning delivery end to end rather than a single workstream with at least 15 engineers.
  • Delivery is your core craft: you bring the pace and ownership that rapid, multi-site expansion demands, and you turn ambiguity and shifting requirements into a workable plan that keeps moving.
  • Track record running an integrated plan and critical path across parallel workstreams to a hard go-live, owning dependencies, risk, change, and budget, and coordinating with a wider programme management.
  • Proven experience managing delivery partners, systems integrators, and contractors in a blended model, holding them to schedule, quality, and commercials while retaining internal accountability.
  • Experience deploying a platform across multiple sites or environments, from commissioning and go-live through operational handover to a run team, and building the repeatable playbook of standards, runbooks, and acceptance gates that makes each rollout faster than the last.
  • Proven ability to align engineering, operations, delivery, vendor, and executive stakeholders through complex programmes.
  • Enough technical fluency to challenge engineers on software architecture, Kubernetes, CI/CD, cloud and API without a translator, plus a working understanding of the hardware and telemetry domain, including GPU or high-performance compute, out-of-band telemetry such as Redfish and network fabric, enough to manage integration and commissioning.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English. You can give leadership a straight read on a complex delivery, explaining the situation and the decision needed without losing the substance.
  • Awareness of delivering against security and compliance controls such as SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001.

Bonus points

  • Experience delivering GPU or AI compute, high-performance computing, or high-density data centre platforms.
  • Experience delivering observability, monitoring, or telemetry platforms across metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Formal delivery or programme management certification, such as PMP and Agile or Scrum experience.
  • Experience introducing AI-assisted or agent-based tooling into delivery or operations.

LOCATION

Singapore

Role Summary

A highly experienced, hands-on Senior Integration Developer responsible for designing and delivering complex, enterprise-grade integration solutions. Drives advanced development, owns Low-Level Design (LLDs), and ensures high-quality, CI/CD-driven delivery using Azure Integration Services, while mentoring teams and contributing to architecture alignment.

Core Development (Primary Focus)

Testing, Debugging & Production Support

Monitoring, Reliability & Performance

AI & Copilot-Enabled Development

  • Azure Integration: Deep expertise in Azure Integration Services (AIS).

  • Programming: Strong coding expertise in C#, .NET, REST APIs, JSON, XML.
  • Design Skills: Proven experience in owning LLDs and contributing to HLDs.
  • Integration Patterns: Strong knowledge of event-driven, distributed, and microservices-based architectures.
  • Azure CI/CD: Hands-on expertise in designing and managing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
  • Debugging & Performance: Advanced troubleshooting and optimization skills.
  • AI & Copilot Skills:
  • Active and effective use of GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot

Preferred Skills

job.title: HR Operations Specialist
job.description:
HR Operations Specialist

How will you do it?

Johnson Controls is seeking a highly motivated and experienced HR Operations Specialist. The HR Operations Specialist will play a critical role in supporting day-to-day HR operations and ensuring processing of transactions with high accuracy and attention to detail. Scope involves processing of Hiring, Reference Letters, Personal data changes, Job data changes, Terminations and more. The role will involve transition of processes from offshore locations and hence the incumbent will ensure the learning curve is maintained until self-sufficiency within transition timelines.

Skills & Experience

  • Primary jobs involve handling job requisitions such as bulk creation, validation and approval using various business rules.
  • Processes other workday administration such New Hires, Terminations, Employment Changes, Employment Verification, etc. including follow up with managers and HRBPs to clarify information, obtain approvals or request corrections.
  • Process the transactions accomplishing KPIs defined by processes and according to the Case Management Framework and the SOX Matrix.
  • Audits of data entry accuracy done by HR Ops team members
  • Well versed with data protection principles, knows how to process confidential and sensitive employee information.
  • Attention to detail – be able to accurately process transaction.
  • Solid understanding of Workday and HR ServiceNow.
  • Articulate work instructions and write standard operating procedure (SOPs). Support other team members and new joiners.

What we look for

  • 2 - 5 years of work experience in HR Shared Services.
  • Good at multi-tasking and time management to manage the workload efficiently.
  • Good excel skills (vlookup, PIVOTs, formatting etc.)
  • Experience working in a global or multinational company with strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Self-motivated and a quick learner, be able to deliver under challenging and dynamic environment to meet changing demands of customers.

job.title: Area Sales Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Who we are ?

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

How you will do it

As Sales Executive, you will be responsible for targeting new customer growth by promoting and selling our aftersales services such as, spare and replacement parts, emergency and planned service and maintenance and planned service agreements, on HVAC, Refrigeration, Fire and Remote Monitoring services to a wide range of customer within our segment.

We are seeking people with passion, enthusiasm and the tenacity to seek those opportunities then execute on them. You will be by supported by enterprise tools, data sets, valuable customer insight and value selling concepts to deliver targeted growth. You will also ensure effective adoption of Company systems, tools, pricing policies and sales processes.

Through using our current market intelligence and industry networking tools you will blend field activity with conversations with new clients to capture any opportunities available to you. Salesforce.com is the CRM tool within the business and our Marketing function is also able to support with external communications and tailoring customer campaigns you require to assist you with performing your growth strategy.

What we look for

5-7 years of experience in HVAC/Refrigeration/ Fire Protection systems within the Marine and Navy Market covering field sales and in-depth knowledge of business development, opportunity, and pipeline management. Highly self-motivated with a strong drive to meet and exceed sales goals. Proven track record of achieving results and closing deals. Experience with Material Organisation, dockyards will be added benefit.

Responsible and accountable for end-to-end ownership of sales. This includes short terms and long-term strategy for business, owning the product portfolio, identifying customer needs and creating strong value proposition to serve these needs.

Make quotations, costing, estimation, getting quotes from suppliers, submitting the quotes on portal and other online platforms, negotiating the quotes with customer buyer departments followed by close liaising within the team will be the main scope.

Ability to identify and pursue new business opportunities through various channels like networking, utilising internal and market data and social media

Excellent verbal and written communication skills (English/ local language) to effectively convey value propositions and build relationships with potential clients. Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships with customers, understanding their needs and providing appropriate solutions. Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies and sales techniques to stay ahead in the market.

Knowledge on compressors, chillers, refrigeration mandatory and experience with Indian Navy procurement departments preferred.

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

Full/ Part-time: Full time

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

About the role

This role will be responsible for Airside Product development(AHU / FCU / CRAH / CRAC / Fan-wall products), Product engineering, New product development programs.

Key Job deliverables

  • Lead design and development of new airside products and platform enhancements.
  • Develop product concepts, layouts, detailed designs, and engineering documentation.
  • Translate customer and business requirements into engineering specifications.
  • Own product engineering deliverables throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Engineering Design : Perform engineering calculations related to Airflow, Pressure drop, Fan selection, Acoustic performance, Coil Design, Structural integrity. Create and review: GA drawings, Manufacturing drawings, BOMs, Design documents, Technical specifications, ETOs, Value engineering
  • Cross Functional Collaboration : Work with Sales, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Quality, Product Management, Lab teams, Global Engineering teams. Support factory launch and production readiness activities.
  • Strong technical know-how and ownership in data center/non-DC airside cooling products

EDUCATION & EXPERINCE PREFERRED

Bachelors / Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering.

10- 15 years Experience in HVAC product design and development Airside products (AHU / FCU / CRAH / CRAC / Fan-wall products), Product engineering, New product development programs

Essential Competencies/ Primary Skill Set:

**

1. Airside Engineering & HVAC Expertise

  • Strong technical knowledge of airside products including AHU, FCU, CRAH, CRAC, fan-wall, ducted and related HVAC systems.
  • Sound understanding of airflow dynamics, pressure drop calculations, fan selection, heat transfer, psychrometrics, IAQ and thermal performance.
  • Ability to perform engineering analysis and optimize product performance, efficiency and reliability.
  • Knowledge of data center airside cooling applications and high-density cooling requirements is preferred.

2. Product Development & System Engineering

  • Hands-on experience in new product development from concept through production release.
  • Strong understanding of stage-gate / NPD processes and engineering design methodologies.
  • Ability to translate customer requirements into product specifications and engineering deliverables.
  • Experience in product architecture definition, design reviews, prototype development and product validation.

3. Mechanical Design & Engineering Analysis

  • Experience in airside product design, component selection and engineering calculations.
  • Ability to perform airflow, fan performance, pressure drop and thermal analysis.
  • Understanding of product performance optimization, design robustness and reliability requirements.
  • Familiarity with design for manufacturability (DFM) and design for cost principles.

4. Product Validation & Testing

  • Experience in developing validation plans and supporting product qualification activities.
  • Ability to analyze test data, identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Knowledge of product performance testing, reliability testing and engineering problem solving.
  • Strong focus on delivering quality and first-pass validation success.

5. Compliance & Regulatory Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of relevant HVAC industry standards such as AHRI, ASHRAE and ISO.
  • Understanding of product certification, compliance requirements and design verification processes.
  • Ability to ensure engineering designs comply with applicable regulations and customer specifications.

6. Design Tools & Digital Engineering

  • Proficiency in CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, CATIA, Inventor or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience with AutoCAD, BOM management and PLM systems.
  • Ability to create and review engineering drawings, specifications and product documentation.
  • Familiarity with engineering databases and product configuration tools.

7. Program Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Ability to manage multiple engineering activities and deliver to committed timelines.
  • Strong collaboration skills while working with manufacturing, sourcing, quality, laboratory and product management teams.
  • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a global engineering environment.

Desirable Competencies/ Secondary Skill Set:

**

1. Data Center Cooling Applications

  • Experience in Data Center AHU, CRAH, fan-wall systems and mission-critical cooling solutions.
  • Understanding of containment strategies, redundancy concepts and high-density cooling applications.
  • Exposure to hyperscale and colocation data center cooling requirements.

2. Advanced Engineering & Simulation Tools

  • Knowledge of CFD analysis for airflow and thermal optimization.
  • Exposure to FEA analysis for structural assessment and product durability.
  • Familiarity with engineering simulation and virtual validation tools.

3. Cost Optimization & Localization

  • Experience in value engineering, cost reduction and product localization initiatives.
  • Understanding of supplier selection, alternate components and cost-driven design decisions.
  • Ability to support regional product competitiveness through localization activities.

4. Manufacturing & Industrialization Support

  • Understanding of manufacturing processes related to airside products.
  • Exposure to factory launch activities, pilot builds and production readiness assessments.
  • Experience supporting smooth transition from development to manufacturing.

5. Controls & System Integration

  • Basic understanding of HVAC controls, sensors and system integration requirements.
  • Familiarity with product selection tools and digital product configuration platforms.
  • Understanding of connected and intelligent HVAC solutions is desirable.

6. Continuous Improvement & Certifications

  • Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma or structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Professional certifications such as Six Sigma Green Belt, PMP or equivalent are desirable.
  • Participation in technical forums, professional bodies or industry standards activities is an added advantage.

7. Customer & Market Orientation

  • Understanding of customer requirements and application engineering concepts.
  • Ability to support technical discussions with customers, consultants and internal stakeholders.
  • Awareness of market trends, competitor offerings and emerging technologies in the airside industry.

job.title: Senior Manager Software Engineering, Bangalore
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Cat Digital seeks a seasoned Senior Software Engineering Manager to lead the Helios Platform Services India Team, building and scaling core platform capabilities that power Caterpillar’s digital ecosystem.

This senior leadership role combines people leadership, technical direction, and product strategy. You will drive delivery and evolution of enterprise-grade capabilities that help product teams move faster through reusable, secure, and scalable services.

You will partner with global engineering, product, architecture, and business leaders to accelerate Helios adoption and strengthen a reusable, API-driven engineering culture.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead multiple teams delivering domain and core services on Helios, Caterpillar’s largest data platform.
  • Drive end-to-end delivery across design, development, deployment, and operations.
  • Ensure platform services meet enterprise-grade standards for scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Own delivery commitments, roadmaps, and execution for the India-based teams.

Platform Strategy and Architecture

  • Partner with product, architecture, and principal engineering leaders to define the Helios roadmap.
  • Drive adoption of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, and event-driven systems.
  • Ensure services are built as reusable, standardized components aligned with design principles.
  • Align platform services with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance requirements.

People Leadership and Organization Building

  • Build, mentor, and scale high-performing teams, including engineering managers and senior engineers.
  • Build a strong leadership bench and succession pipeline.
  • Lead hiring, talent development, and performance management in line with Cat Digital standards.
  • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and engineering excellence.

Operational Excellence and Quality

  • Own platform reliability, availability, and operational health, including SLA/SLO adherence, observability, and incident management.
  • Drive adoption of DevOps, CI/CD, and automated quality practices, including TDD and BDD.
  • Institutionalize metrics-driven engineering across quality, velocity, stability, and customer impact.

Platform Adoption and Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with product teams to accelerate onboarding and adoption.
  • Partner with global stakeholders to prioritize platform investments and resolve cross-team dependencies.
  • Act as a key bridge between India engineering teams and global Helios leadership.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

  • Drive innovation in platform capabilities, including automation, AI enablement, and developer experience improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to modernize legacy systems and improve operational efficiency.
  • Champion a product mindset, with APIs treated as products and services owned across their lifecycle.

Required Qualifications

  • 18+ years of experience in software engineering with significant exposure to platform or enterprise-scale systems
  • 8+ years in engineering leadership roles managing multiple teams and managers
  • Strong experience building and operating cloud-native platforms (AWS)
  • Proven track record delivering shared services and platform services used by multiple products
  • Deep understanding of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, APIs, distributed systems, DevOps, CI/CD, and automation.
  • Experience leading large-scale, globally distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of AI models and their use in improving developer and business outcomes.
  • Ability to normalize and contextualize data from diverse sources for real-time decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive cross-functional alignment.
  • Demonstrated ability to define platform strategy, guide architectural decisions, and align engineering execution with business goals.
  • Strong organizational design and talent development skills, including hiring, mentoring, and performance management.

What You Will Bring

  • Strong strategic thinking with a bias for execution.
  • Ability to operate at both the system and organizational levels.
  • A platform-first mindset centered on reuse, consistency, and developer experience.
  • Executive presence and the ability to influence across functions.
  • Passion for building teams, leaders, and long-term engineering capability in India

Success Measures

  • Increase adoption and usage across products.
  • Improve platform reliability, scalability, and developer experience.
  • Build a strong engineering culture and leadership pipeline.
  • Deliver the platform roadmap and business outcomes predictably.

Why This Role Matters

Helios is the foundation of Caterpillar’s digital ecosystem, enabling reusable services, cross-product integration, and enterprise-scale innovation. This role is central to scaling the India team into a strategic execution engine for global priorities.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Posting Dates:

September 3, 2026 - September 13, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Facility Procurement Professional
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition Supports supply related activities for a facility to deliver excellence and integration between procurement and the team supporting facility.

Responsibilities

  • Supporting delivery of a lean, responsive, and resilient material and services flow for the facility from source to dock and additional required points.
  • Recognizing the potential for cost and inventory reductions, and quality improvement, as well as responsibility for soundness of business proposals and risk assessment.
  • Operating and monitoring the supply network procurement functions to meet the defined response time, cost, quality, and lean targets enabling optimal and efficient facility operations.
  • Collaborating with business partners and suppliers and resolving facility specific supplier issues.

Required Skillset:

1) Knowledge of effectively managing NPI/NSI programs within Procurement function; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of resources to achieve project objectives.

2) Knowledge of methodology, processes, and strategies of new product introduction / new source introduction; ability to develop an effective NPI/NSI sourcing strategy to meet NPI/NSI deliverables at a program level.

Degree Requirement Degree or equivalent experience desired with 8+years of experience

Skill Descriptors

Process Management: Knowledge of business process improvement tools and techniques; ability to understand, monitor, update, control, or enhance existing business or work processes. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Employs process flows, cycle time, process time and waste concepts as appropriate.
  • Walks through steps, decisions, measurements, dependencies and hand-offs for a specific process.
  • Creates process flow or workflow diagrams.
  • Document types of process decisions and potential impact of each decision.
  • Identifies and monitors common process bottlenecks.

Data-driven Decision Making: Knowledge of the data-driven decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to gather and analyze data to make organizational decisions that align with strategic business objectives and goals. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for data-driven thinking in a Decision-Making process.
  • Discerns between "signal" and "noise" when interpreting data.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in the process of choosing KPIs and metrics to influence decisions.
  • Utilizes the basic data collection and evaluation tools and techniques.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
  • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
  • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
  • Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
  • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Manufacturing Requirements Planning (MRP): Knowledge of the processes, practices and systems used in manufacturing requirements planning (MRP); ability to optimize planning for manufacturing cycles and ensure capacity and materials availability. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Participates in developing materials requirements and costs for custom requests.
  • Uses job schedule, plant and machine schedule and inventory systems to initiate and oversee jobs.
  • Uses available tools to analyze order and develop quotes and realistic delivery dates.
  • Plans and schedules production runs for specific products and assures availability of materials.
  • Follows key criteria to collect information needed to make good production decisions for operation.

Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows procedures in carrying out routine supplier management tasks.
  • Uses electronic systems or tools to record/retrieve supplier information and carry out transactions with suppliers.
  • Resolves routine supplier issues; escalates non-routine issues up chain of command.
  • Researches alternative vendors or suppliers; participates in supplier selection.
  • Works with suppliers to ensure that purchases meet delivery date and quality specifications.

Logistics Management: Knowledge of the processes, tools and operational considerations for effective and efficient movement of goods and materials; ability to understand, predict and control the movement of goods, materials and supplies. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Uses tools, with guidance, to forecast delivery times, determine costs and assess performance.
  • Works with logistics in a domestic environment.
  • Maintains records of all shipments and invoices using an established system.
  • Assists in the development of process flows to track lead time by activity.
  • Participates in integrating logistics processes and developing effective networks.

Supply Chain Management: Knowledge of functions, principles and techniques used in supply chain management; ability to develop and implement strategies, practices and tools for controlling the whole processes. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Recognizes software systems or components used to manage supply chain.
  • Participates in supply chain analysis and uses it to spot trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Discusses considerations for integrating partner and supplier transactions.

Role Definition

The Senior Design Engineer is responsible for the design, development, validation, and continuous improvement of Motor Grader Ground Engaging Tools, including cutting edges, end bits, ripper points, and associated wear components. The role applies advanced engineering principles, virtual product development tools, performance simulation, wear modeling, and validation methodologies to deliver solutions that improve customer productivity, wear life, durability, manufacturability, and total owning and operating costs.

Key Technical Responsibilities

  • Lead design and development of Motor Grader Ground Engaging Tool (GET) components including cutting edges, end bits, ripper points, shank protection systems and wear packages.
  • Develop solutions that improve machine productivity, penetration performance, wear life, serviceability and customer value.
  • Perform structural, fatigue, performance, and wear simulations to support design decisions and reduce physical validation cycles.
  • Utilize Virtual Product Development (VPD) tools to predict stress, durability, material behavior, and wear characteristics under various customer applications.
  • Develop and validate wear-performance models using field data, laboratory testing, and simulation results.
  • Analyze system interactions between blade, cutting edge, moldboard and ripper systems to optimize performance and life-cycle cost.
  • Evaluate alternative materials, heat treatments, casting, forging and wear technologies to improve product performance.
  • Support prototype builds, laboratory testing, field validation and production implementation.
  • Lead root-cause investigations for field issues using analytical, simulation and test data.

Skill Descriptors:

Analytical Thinking & AI Uses:

Knowledge of analytical techniques, engineering tools, simulation methods, and AI-assisted technologies that promote effective problem solving; ability to identify root causes of design and performance issues and develop multiple solutions that optimize customer value, durability, manufacturability, and cost.

Effective Communications:

Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Managing Multiple Priorities:

Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.

Technical Excellence & Innovation:

Knowledge of mining applications, Ground Engaging Tool (GET) systems, wear technologies, and engineering methodologies; ability to develop innovative solutions to complex technical challenges while improving customer value, product performance, durability, and cost competitiveness.

Computer-Aided Design & Engineering:

Knowledge of engineering tools (Creo, Teamcenter, ANSYS, DEM, Wear Simulation) and techniques of parametric design, simulation, and knowledge-based engineering; ability to design, analyze, simulate, validate, and optimize Ground Engaging Tool (GET) systems throughout the product development lifecycle.

Product Design and Development:

Knowledge of product features; ability to design, build, and develop a new product, technology, or service from concept through to production.

We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the HV Site Engineer reporting to the Associate Director, HV Infrastructure, you will work closely with our Technology, Development, Construction, Commissioning and Operations teams, making your mark in several ways:

  • Lead the safe and effective on-site delivery of high voltage (HV) infrastructure across AirTrunk projects, ensuring installations meet approved designs, quality requirements, programme commitments and operational needs
  • Coordinate contractors, consultants, network service providers and internal teams through construction, testing, energisation, commissioning and handover
  • Provide practical site-based engineering solutions to HV issues, with a strong focus on safety, constructability, reliability and continuity of operations

Your Day to Day

  • Manage the on-site delivery of HV networks across new and existing AirTrunk sites, ensuring work is completed safely and in accordance with approved designs, applicable codes, standards and AirTrunk requirements
  • Oversee the installation of HV equipment and systems, including switchgear, transformers, protection relays, SCADA, earthing, cabling and DC systems
  • Review issued-for-construction drawings, specifications, method statements, inspection and test plans, safe work method statements and vendor documentation before site execution
  • Supervise and collaborate with principal contractors, specialist subcontractors and suppliers to achieve safe, practical and high-quality outcomes on time and within budget
  • Complete site inspections, monitor workmanship and quality records, and drive the timely resolution of non-conformances, defects and punch-list items
  • Coordinate HV access, isolations, permits and switching activities with authorised personnel, Site Specialists and Operations teams
  • Act as the site technical interface between designers, consultants, contractors, vendors, network service providers and AirTrunk stakeholders
  • Support testing, energisation and commissioning activities, including witnessing tests, reviewing results and confirming that systems are ready for safe operation
  • Prepare and review methods of procedure, switching plans and other site execution documents in conjunction with the Site Specialist and commissioning teams
  • Resolve site queries, constructability issues, clashes and design discrepancies through timely technical clarification and controlled change processes
  • Support the investigation and resolution of HV incidents, standing issues and emerging technical risks that fall outside local Operations capability
  • Identify opportunities to improve safety, programme, cost, quality and system performance, and share lessons learned across projects
  • Ensure complete project handover, including as-built drawings, test records, operation and maintenance manuals, asset information, training and outstanding-action close-out

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum five years of experience in HV construction, site engineering or project delivery, preferably within data centres, critical infrastructure, utilities or large-scale industrial projects.
  • Strong practical knowledge of HV equipment and installations, including switchgear, transformers, protection systems, SCADA, earthing, cabling and auxiliary DC systems.
  • Working knowledge of applicable Australian electrical standards, network service provider requirements, workplace health and safety obligations and HV safe systems of work.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret single-line diagrams, schematics, layouts, specifications and issued-for-construction documentation.
  • Experience reviewing method statements, safe work method statements, inspection and test plans, test documentation and contractor quality records.
  • Sound understanding of HV installation, testing, protection, energisation, commissioning and operational handover requirements.
  • Experience supervising contractors and coordinating multiple work fronts within a live construction environment.
  • Strong commitment to electrical safety, permit-to-work controls, risk management and high-quality site execution.
  • Ability to identify and resolve technical, constructability and interface issues while maintaining programme and operational priorities.
  • Experience managing RFIs, non-conformances, defects, punch lists, red-line mark-ups and as-built documentation.
  • Competency with common engineering and document-control tools; familiarity with AutoCAD, PowerFactory, ETAP or similar applications is advantageous.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to coordinate contractors, consultants, authorities and multidisciplinary internal teams.
  • Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.
  • A collaborative, accountable and delivery-focused approach, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced site environment.
  • Willingness to travel to AirTrunk project sites as required.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Commercial Manager - Construction & MEP - Mumbai, India
job.description:
Job Summary

This position reports directly to the Director, Commercial Management, India, within the Global Design & Construction organization. The primary responsibility of this role is to provide commercial management oversight across Equinix's portfolio of major expansion and construction projects throughout India. The incumbent will work closely with cross-functional internal project teams and stakeholders at various levels of seniority to support successful project delivery.

The role is expected to provide strategic and day-to-day leadership specifically focused to drive down construction costs, provide assurance against internal financial controls, reporting processes and help manage all major contract risks.

Responsibilities

Pre-Contract

  • Procurement of third-party consultants including Design, Commercial and Pre-Construction Services
  • Development of detailed Request for Proposals (RFP) and service deliverables for the commercial management services
  • Day to day management of third-party commercial consultants to ensure deliverables are met in a timely manner and to a high standard
  • Development of General Contractor and supplier procurement strategies in conjunction with the Construction Management (CM) team
  • Working with Legal and Procurement Centre of Excellence (COE) to prepare General Contractor Contracts including negotiation of Contract terms
  • Collation and presentation of market insights for the construction industry in the relevant country including market activity, comparative builds, construction cost indices, key suppliers and benchmarking information
  • Preparation of budgets for all design stages including feasibility estimation, detailed cost modelling, benchmarking analysis and presentation of this to senior management throughout funding approval stages
  • Advice on the most economical design and construction delivery strategy including budget comparisons
  • Identification of market and region-specific commercial risks and development of practical mitigation strategies
  • Ensuring that all cost data is prepared and presented in the Equinix WBS throughout the Project lifecycle
  • Input and action of Value Engineering (VE) exercises at all stages of design. The output must include clear cost evaluation to support decision making
  • Prepare annual and quarterly cashflow forecasts for active and pipeline projects
  • Prepare and oversee monthly reports for budget, cashflow, risk and change management

Post Contract

  • Day to day management of third-party commercial consultants to ensure deliverables are met in a timely manner and to a high standard
  • Monitor adherence against budget throughout the project lifespan including cost checks and reviews, value engineering and cost saving initiatives and evaluation of alternates
  • Oversee and provide guidance on commercial change management and change evaluation efforts on all projects
  • Monitor and report monthly and quarterly on project portfolio cash flow for the region
  • Provide Construction in Place (CIP) data to Finance
  • Pro-actively lead all commercial risk management efforts including commercial audits, contingency analysis and management
  • Prepare and oversee monthly cost reports for budget, cashflow, risk and change management
  • Monitor the financial close-out on all projects including settlement of all vendors
  • Prepare lessons learned cost analysis and detailed Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) analysis of outturn costs

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in quantity surveying, construction, business, financial, Engineering or related field

  • Must be able to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Must have strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Must have strong computer skills, particularly with Excel, Power BI, Cost Management Tools

job.title: Data Center Concierge III - Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
job.description:
Job Summary

The position will suit someone who is a strong communicator, experienced and organised in completing routing and ad-hoc tasks, admin focused and with the ability to deliver outstanding customer service at all times. Applicants may come from multifaceted industries including but not limited to hospitality, reception, administration or other customer centric roles and will be working Monday-Friday in a permanent position.

This is a customer facing role, so applicants should enjoy client interaction and have the confidence to identify customer trends, issues or concerns, taking appropriate actions where possible and call out accordingly when needed.

Key responsibilities

Our Concierge will provide support to datacenter facilities and administrative duties following standard procedures:

  • Supports customers by coordinating visits and schedules in the data center; assists on semi-routine inquiries and issues
  • Directly coordinates activities with the Equinix Response Center (ERC), as needed
  • Keeps records of activities within the data center including circuit inventories, installed power inventories and labor hours expended
  • May generate purchase requisitions and coordinate with vendors for delivery and invoicing
  • Generating Siebel Reports for customer SH requests
  • Assist security with supervising the security office, signing in visitors, validation and assignment of access via the Siebel and EACS
  • Work closely with site security and report security related incidents to the Security Operations Control Centre
  • Perform ad hoc support tasks for IBX Operations teams, including but not limited to parking administration, CCTV and access control data retrieval and analysis, event coordination, and maintenance management system administration.
  • Take an active role in emergency response preparedness, including participating in evacuation drills and incidents by coordinating and managing designated muster areas, accounting for personnel, and supporting site emergency procedures.

Customer Support and onsite Customer Liaison

  • Supports the coordination of tasks to the appropriate cross-functional teams
  • Maintains positive business relationships with local vendors in support of customer's administrative needs; provides information about local vendors to customers upon request
  • Maintains customer care areas/conference rooms for cleanliness and fully stocking amenities as the need arises; may provide backup coverage to cross functional teams to support inventory ordering
  • Communicates semi-routine operating datacenter procedures to customers on-site, while building and developing positive customer relationships
  • Coordinates customer work visits with security and escorts customers and/or vendors, within a reasonable vicinity, as required
  • Assists with tracking, following-up, and reporting on routine or new customer inquiries and issues while customers are on-site
  • Provides general induction learning tours to new customers to orient them to the site and escorting customers to their spaces within the data center and unlocking racks where required
  • Resolving issues related to lower customer satisfaction score by coordinating with cross functional team

Benefits of Equinix and the role:
