job.title: Construction Safety Manager ( Data Centre)
job.description:
Overview

Lead regional Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) governance for data centre construction projects, ensuring compliance with company standards, local regulations and industry best practices. The role provides independent oversight of project safety performance, contractor compliance, incident management and continuous improvement across the project lifecycle.

**

Make an Impact by

EHS Governance & Compliance

  • Develop and maintain regional construction EHS standards, procedures and governance requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with project HSE plans, environmental requirements, Permit-to-Work systems, Design for Safety principles and local regulations.
  • Review key contractor safety documents such as risk assessments, method statements, lifting plans and emergency response plans.
  • Conduct compliance reviews and audits and track corrective actions to closure.
  • Review and evaluate contractor EHS capability for regional tender including tender evaluation assessment.

Site Safety & Contractor Oversight

  • Conduct regular site inspections and governance reviews across regional projects.
  • Monitor high-risk activities including excavation, lifting, working at height, electrical works, hot work, confined space, MEP works, testing and commissioning.
  • Assess and monitor contractor EHS capability and performance, escalating significant concerns where required.
  • Drive safety improvement initiatives with project and contractor teams.

Risk & Incident Management

  • Oversee project risk assessments and verify appropriate controls are in place before work starts.
  • Ensure Design for Safety principles are integrated into design and construction activities.
  • Review incident investigations and root cause analyses, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
  • Analyse incident trends and share lessons learned across the region.

EHS Performance & Reporting

  • Participate in project and regional EHS governance monthly and quarterly meetings.
  • Prepare EHS dashboards and reports covering incidents, audits, training compliance, safety observations and key performance indicators.
  • Conduct regular EHS performance reviews with project leaders and senior management.

##

Environmental & Commissioning Safety

  • Monitor compliance with environmental requirements, including noise, dust, waste, chemical storage, water discharge and spill prevention.
  • Provide safety oversight for mission-critical works, including HV/LV electrical installation, energisation, testing and commissioning.
  • Review isolation procedures and risk controls before energisation and commissioning activities.

##

Authority

  • Request the Project Lead to stop or suspend unsafe work where there is imminent danger or serious non-compliance.
  • Require corrective actions before work resumes and escalate repeated or severe violations to senior management.
  • Recommend contractor suspension for serious or repeated safety breaches.

##

Skills for Success:

**

How You will Make An Impact:

**

  • Validate effectiveness of security tools managed by CISO Singtel Singapore, Cyber Security Engineering
  • Supporting and ensuring adequacy of Cyber Security posture for security tools managed by CISO Singtel Singapore, Cyber Security Engineering
  • Continuous review of current technology stack being managed is fit for use and cost effective.

**

1. Engineering:

  • Deliver new security tools to uplift overall security posture of Singtel Singapore
  • Ensure that SOPs are documented, performed and in compliance with relevant security policies and standards
  • Subject matter expert for assigned technology stack(s), providing guidance to the team on managing the technologies including optimizing performance and capacity.
  • Work with stakeholders in IT and Enterprise to uplift coverage for assigned technology stack(s) where applicable
  • Work with the various SMEs of the various security systems managed by Cyber Engineering or other technical SMEs to ensure delivery of outcomes including tracking of the tasks required to meet the outcome
  • Engage relevant teams and/or vendors to diagnose and rectify technical problems where necessary
  • Ensure documents or processes required as part of project delivery methodology is adhered to
  • Support and provide inputs to design of technology stack(s) as subject matter expert so that it is fit-for-use, conforms to security best practices and is cost effective.

**

2 Customer Experience and Teamwork:

  • Demonstrate professional, pro-active qualities in dealing with internal clients and stakeholders.
  • Work with all stakeholders to meet operation and security requirements.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, effective communication and teamwork with peers.

**

3 Continuous Improvement:

  • Maintain strategic vendor partnerships, relevant education and certification.
  • Complete relevant education and training as required.
  • Keep abreast of relevant technology and cyber threat landscape.

**

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Cyber Security, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline
  • A minimum of 3 to 6 years of relevant experience, with at least 2 years focused on cybersecurity in telco operations, network environments, or enterprise IT within the telecommunications domain including minimally 3 years hands-on experience in designing, administration or deployment of IT infrastructure components including implementing best practices like security hardening
  • Experienced in application hosting and operations across both on-premises systems and multi-cloud environments including AWS and Azure
  • Working IAM knowledge such as Active Directory, Multi-factor authentication
  • Good analytical and communication skills

Springwood, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a vibrant and motivated Casual Retail Service Consultant to join our Springwood team. If you love helping people, thrive in being a part of a supportive crew, and bring positive energy to every interaction, then we’d love to have you on board!

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

job.title: Director, Group Network Cyber Security
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

This is a technical leadership role within Group Strategy, Engineering and Innovation (GSEI) in Group Technology Network, responsible for providing strategic direction and deep expertise in telecommunications network cybersecurity across the Singtel Group, including its regional associates.

The role will lead and collaborate with network and cybersecurity subject matter experts across Singtel Operating Companies (OpCos) and regional associates to ensure alignment with Singtel Group’s broader strategic objectives.

The person will define, develop, and institutionalise network cybersecurity design principles, frameworks, and guidelines across multiple network domains, drawing from industry standards, best practices, and lessons learned from past incidents and operational experience.

Make an Impact by

**

a. Strategy Development

  • Partner closely with Group Cybersecurity to define and evolve the network security strategy and framework in alignment with Singtel Group’s business objectives, risk appetite, and industry trends.
  • Provide thought leadership on network cybersecurity, ensuring long-term resilience, scalability, and regulatory readiness across the Group.

b. Network Architecture & Design Governance

  • Establish and maintain a group-wide network security architecture framework, incorporating industry-recognised standards, specifications, and best-practice design principles.
  • Drive consistent adoption of network security guidelines across multiple network domains (e.g. core, access, transport, cloud, edge) to strengthen the Group’s overall security posture and operational resilience.

c. Technology Evaluation & Future Readiness

  • Identify, assess, and provide strategic guidance on emerging technologies and trends such as 6G, AI for Networks, and Networks for AI.
  • Articulate how evolving network security requirements and capabilities will both influence and be influenced by—the design, deployment, and operation of these technologies.
  • Translate complex technical implications into clear recommendations for leadership and stakeholders.

d. Group Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Foster strong collaboration and knowledge sharing across Singtel Group and regional associates within the network security domain.
  • Create and sustain platforms, forums, and communities of practice to share experiences, expertise, lessons learned, and incident insights.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, collective ownership, and proactive risk and incident management across the Group.

**

Skills for Success

**

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in telecommunications networks, with significant depth in network cybersecurity across large-scale, carrier-grade environments.
  • Proven experience in a technical leadership, architecture, or strategy role, within a telco network environment.
  • Strong track record of defining and implementing network security frameworks, architectures, and design principles across multiple network domains.
  • Hands on experience translating industry standards and best practices (e.g. 3GPP, ETSI, NIST, ISO/IEC, Zero Trust, Security by design) into practical, deployable network security controls.
  • Experience working with or influencing regional operating companies or affiliates, balancing group governance with local regulatory and operational requirements.
  • Experience evaluating and shaping security requirements for emerging technologies such as Quantum safe, 5G/6G, network virtualisation, cloud-native networks, AI-enabled networks, and automation.

**

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Deep understanding of telecommunications network architectures and protocols, including fixed, mobile, IP, transport, and cloud-native network environments.
  • Strong expertise in network security domains, including network segmentation, identity and access management, encryption, key management, signalling security, API security, and monitoring/detection.
  • Knowledge of secure network design and security tools, resilience engineering, redundancy, and high-availability principles in carrier-grade environments.
  • Familiarity with regulatory, compliance, and assurance requirements relevant to telecommunications and critical infrastructure security.

**

Leadership & Collaboration Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organisation, working across multiple OpCos, functions, and geographies without direct authority.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with various layer of stakeholders in various domain as such cybersecurity, network engineering, operations and risk/
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven capability to build communities of practice, encourage knowledge sharing, and foster a culture of security-by-design across the Group.

**

Professional Attributes

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance security, business objectives, cost, and operational practicality.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and forward-looking approach to risk management.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
  • Relevant professional certifications and knowledge (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CIS controls, GSMA security guidelines and control, cloud security controls) are advantageous.

**

**

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

**

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

**

**

job.title: Manager, Hardware Marketing
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll shape the devices and propositions that millions of customers use every day, partnering with leading global handset brands to deliver innovative products and compelling customer experiences.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As the Manager, Hardware Marketing, you will own the commercial success of assigned handset brands by driving product strategy, pricing, vendor partnerships and go-to-market execution.

Working closely with global device manufacturers and cross-functional teams, you will develop compelling product propositions, lead integrated marketing campaigns and optimise portfolio performance to drive hardware revenue, customer acquisition and market competitiveness.

##

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Own the end-to-end commercial performance of assigned handset brands, including revenue, profitability and product lifecycle management.
  • Develop pricing strategies, promotional offers and value propositions that maximise commercial performance and strengthen market competitiveness.
  • Build strong partnerships with handset vendors, leading commercial negotiations, joint business planning and marketing investments.
  • Lead go-to-market planning and execution for new handset launches, seasonal campaigns and portfolio refreshes across all customer channels.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Digital, Retail and Consumer Operations teams to deliver integrated marketing campaigns and exceptional customer experiences.
  • Drive in-base upsell, cross-sell and customer acquisition initiatives to increase hardware sales, attachment rates and overall revenue.
  • Monitor portfolio performance through financial reporting, sales analysis and commercial insights, recommending actions to optimise results.
  • Conduct competitive analysis on pricing, products, promotions and market trends to identify opportunities and maintain market leadership.
  • Manage marketing operations, including pre-sales readiness, post-sales processes, rebate claims and operational governance.
  • Handle customer escalations relating to handset products, promotions and commercial policies, working closely with internal stakeholders to deliver timely resolutions.
  • Develop business cases for new initiatives and evaluate commercial opportunities, investment returns and business impact.
  • Continuously improve business processes and reporting to enhance operational efficiency and commercial execution.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing or a related discipline.
  • At least 5–7 years of experience in Product Marketing, Category Management or Commercial Marketing, preferably within the telecommunications, mobile device, consumer electronics or hardware industry.
  • Strong experience managing product portfolios, pricing strategies and commercial performance.
  • Proven experience leading go-to-market planning and integrated marketing campaigns.
  • Strong vendor management and commercial negotiation skills.
  • Experience managing P&L, revenue performance and financial analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using data to drive commercial decisions.
  • Experience conducting market research, competitive analysis and product positioning.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple business functions.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills, with experience creating compelling presentations and business cases.
  • Experience with Power BI or similar business intelligence tools is an advantage.
  • Detail-oriented, commercially driven and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Associate Engineer - FEA
job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform basic Finite Element Analysis using ANSYS Workbench for mechanical structures and components.
  • Support linear static, vibration, seismic, and basic non-linear analysis as per project requirements.
  • Prepare geometry, apply boundary conditions, generate mesh, run simulations, and review analysis results.
  • Create shell and solid meshes and define basic connections such as contacts, bolts, and welds.
  • Interpret simulation results and support senior engineers in providing design improvement recommendations.
  • Coordinate with design and product engineering teams for model checks, inputs, and analysis clarification.
  • Prepare clear analysis reports and maintain proper documentation of assumptions, results, and conclusions.

  • Full-time ME/M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Machine Design, Aerospace, Production, Applied Mechanics, or related specialization from a reputed institute.
  • 0 to 1 year of experience in Finite Element Analysis.
  • Hands-on experience in ANSYS Workbench is required.
  • Exposure to Space Claim or Design Modeler for geometry preparation will be preferred.
  • Basic understanding of solid mechanics, finite element method, strength of materials, and mechanical vibrations.
  • Knowledge of meshing, contacts, boundary conditions, load application, and result interpretation.
  • Basic exposure to Creo/Pro-E for model review and checking will be an added advantage.
  • Good analytical ability, willingness to learn, problem-solving mindset, and attention to detail.

job.title: Engineer I - Field Service
job.description:
Job Description

The PAC Service Engineer is responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and customer support for Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) systems and associated cooling equipment. The role requires ensuring maximum equipment uptime, meeting SLA commitments, and providing excellent customer service at data centers, telecom sites, IT facilities, and commercial establishments.

Key Responsibilities Installation & Commissioning

  • Perform installation, testing, and commissioning of PAC units and associated cooling systems.
  • Verify site readiness and ensure compliance with engineering drawings and safety requirements.
  • Conduct performance testing and prepare commissioning reports.
  • Coordinate with project teams, customers, and subcontractors during project execution.

Preventive Maintenance

  • Execute scheduled preventive maintenance activities for PAC units, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, condensers, CDU, FWU, and related systems.
  • Inspect compressors, condensers, evaporators, fans, control panels, sensors, and refrigerant circuits.
  • Submit maintenance reports and recommendations for improving equipment reliability.

Breakdown & Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose and rectify faults in electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, and control systems.
  • Analyze alarms and operational abnormalities using controller logs and monitoring systems.
  • Ensure timely closure of breakdown calls as per SLA commitments.
  • Support emergency and critical site requirements during breakdown situations.

Customer Support

  • Provide technical support and guidance to customers.
  • Maintain professional communication during service visits.
  • Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and effectively.
  • Prepare service reports and obtain customer sign-off upon activity completion.

Spare Parts & Inventory Management

  • Identify and recommend replacement parts and consumables.
  • Maintain service inventory and tools in good condition.
  • Support quotation preparation for repairs and spare replacement requirements.

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) guidelines.
  • Ensure proper usage of PPE during service activities.
  • Maintain compliance with customer safety regulations and permit systems.
  • Report unsafe conditions and incidents immediately.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or related field.

Experience

  • 4 to 8 years of experience in HVAC, Precision Cooling, or Critical Cooling Systems.
  • Experience in data centers, telecom infrastructure, IT facilities, healthcare facilities, or commercial buildings preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Good understanding of refrigeration cycle and HVAC principles.
  • Experience with:
  • Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) Units
  • CRAC / CRAH Systems
  • Chilled Water Systems
  • DX Cooling Systems
  • Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Condensers
  • CDU and FWU Systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot:
  • Compressors
  • EEV/TEV Valves
  • Refrigerant Circuits
  • PLC and Microprocessor Controllers
  • Electrical Panels and Drives
  • Sensors and Communication Networks
  • Knowledge of refrigerants and safe handling procedures.
  • Familiarity with BMS and remote monitoring systems.

job.title: Commissioning Technician - Thermal, VIC
job.description:
Job Description

The Thermal Customer Engineer (Technician) – Commissioning is a highly specialised technical role within the APAC ANZ division, responsible for delivering end-to-end commissioning of precision cooling systems including Computer Room Air Conditioning (CRAC), Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAH), Fan Wall Units (FWU), and Coolant Distribution Units (CDU). Reporting directly to the Service Operations Manager – Start Up Services, ANZ, this role is pivotal in ensuring the reliable and efficient operation of mission critical Thermal Infrastructure across large-scale environments, including Tier 1 Data Centres.

Key Responsibilities

Planning & Reporting:

  • Time Sheets - Digital reporting tool to be used to accurately record hours worked each day.
  • Commissioning/Service Reports - to be completed within set timeframes.
  • Proactively communicate project progress and any site issues to the Project Manager & Service Operations Manager.

Operational Delivery:

  • Own the commissioning process from start to finish - You'll lead the full commissioning cycle across Vertiv's complete range of CDU, CRAC, CRAH, FWU & TWU units, delivering critical infrastructure that keeps the world's most important facilities running.
  • Work on landmark projects - Carry out L2, L3, and L4 commissioning tasks alongside experienced Vertiv Project & Commissioning Managers. If you've previously worked on Tier 1 Data Centre sites, you'll feel right at home here.
  • Broaden your expertise - This isn't a one-dimensional role. You'll also support the Service Team with maintenance and time & material works, giving you exposure across the full asset lifecycle.
  • Be the face of Vertiv - Build trusted relationships with our customers through professional, solutions-focused interactions. Your feedback helps shape how we deliver for our clients.
  • Never stop growing - Access ongoing training across multiple Vertiv technologies, keeping your skills sharp and your career moving forward.

Enjoy the perks - A fully maintained company vehicle and the support you need to represent Vertiv at the highest standard, every day.

Daily Work Duties and expectations:

  • Travel to various sites, including remote locations, requiring a valid Driver's Licence.
  • Undertake overnight or extended travel as project demands require.
  • Working on and around Energised Electrical equipment, adhering strictly to safety protocols.
  • Safely work on live refrigerant lines and pressure vessels, in compliance with refrigerant handling regulations and licensing requirements.
  • Working and Heights (needs Work at Heights Training and refreshed every 5 years)
  • Operate within HVAC mechanical systems, demonstrating physical adaptability including working in awkward body positions as required by the equipment configuration.
  • Undertake manual handling tasks, including lifting, carrying, and relocating equipment and components in accordance with WHS guidelines (e.g Compressors, Gas Bottles etc.).

WHS, Environment & Quality:

  • Comply with all Work, Health & Safety, Environment and Quality obligations
  • Actively champion a safety-first culture on all sites, leading by example and encouraging safe behaviours among colleagues and contractors.
  • I dentify, report, and mitigate workplace hazards promptly and effectively.

job.description:
Job Description

Senior Engineer – Code Compliance

Electrical & Thermal Products \| Vertiv Power and Thermal Management

| | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Experience<br> 5–10 years | Function<br> Code Compliance | Scope<br> Power + Thermal | Level<br> Senior Engineer |

Position Summary

The Senior Engineer – Code Compliance, Electrical & Thermal Products will support Vertiv Power and Thermal Management product lines by ensuring that product designs, engineering documentation, electrical systems, thermal systems, components, submittals, and certification deliverables comply with applicable product safety standards, electrical codes, thermal equipment requirements, customer specifications, and regional regulatory expectations.

This role is intended for a senior engineer with 5–10 years of experience in electrical design, thermal product engineering, safety/compliance, certification support, design review, or code compliance for industrial, data center, HVAC, power, or critical infrastructure products.

Product Scope

| | | | --- | --- | | Vertiv Power Products | Vertiv Thermal Products | | UPS and power systems; power distribution units; switchgear/switchboards; electrical panels; energy storage/battery systems; integrated modular solutions; racks and site monitoring systems. | CRAC units; fan walls; AHUs; XDUs; chillers; air cooling; liquid cooling; heat rejection/reuse equipment; controls and related cooling-system documentation. |

Key Responsibilities Electrical & Power Product Compliance

  • Review electrical schematics, single-line/three-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, power calculations, grounding and bonding systems, cable management, lighting/power distribution plans, monitoring/control systems, BOMs, installation documents, and maintenance documentation.
  • Ensure electrical designs comply with applicable electrical codes, product safety requirements, customer specifications, and regional regulatory expectations.
  • Support compliance for power products such as UPS, switchgear, switchboards, PDUs, power distribution systems, energy storage, integrated modular solutions, and site monitoring systems.
  • Support standards alignment for power products such as UL891 switchboards and UL1558 switchgear where applicable.

Thermal Product Compliance

  • Review thermal product designs and documentation for CRAC, fan wall, AHU, XDU, chiller, air cooling, liquid cooling, heat rejection, and heat reuse systems.
  • Support compliance review of submittals, airflow summaries, unit drawings, component performance, fan data, filter data, electrical cabinet heat calculations, safety notes, and component specification sheets.
  • Support testing, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting documentation, Method Statements, Risk Assessments, Site Acceptance Test procedures, and incident documentation where relevant to compliance deliverables.
  • Support refrigerant and regulatory-readiness reviews for cooling products, including low-GWP refrigerant transition requirements when applicable.

Cross-Product Standards & Certification Support

  • Interpret and apply product safety, electrical, thermal, environmental, and regional standards during NPD, sustaining engineering, customer projects, product changes, and product release activities.
  • Participate in design reviews with engineering, product management, manufacturing, quality, sourcing, and business unit teams to identify compliance risks early and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain compliance checklists, standards matrices, technical justifications, evidence packages, compliance reports, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Coordinate with internal compliance teams, certification bodies, suppliers, and product teams for certification evidence, product approvals, component changes, and compliance documentation.

Required Qualifications

| | | | --- | --- | | Area | Requirement | | Education | Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical  Engineering, Thermal Engineering, HVAC Engineering, Power Systems, or related engineering discipline. | | Experience | 5–10 years of experience in electrical design, thermal/HVAC product engineering, compliance engineering, product safety, certification support, or code compliance. | | Product exposure | Experience with power systems, power distribution, switchgear/switchboards, UPS, PDUs, racks, electrical panels, HVAC systems, CRAC, AHU, fan wall, XDU, chiller, liquid cooling, or data center infrastructure products. | | Electrical capability | Ability to review schematics, wiring diagrams, power calculations, grounding/bonding, control panels, component selections, BOMs, and installation documents. | | Thermal capability | Understanding of thermal product operation, airflow, cooling performance, hydronic/hydraulic/pneumatic fundamentals, and data center cooling principles. | | Standards knowledge | Working knowledge of NEC, UL, CSA, IEC, CE, NFPA 70E, thermal/HVAC-related standards, and regional compliance requirements relevant to the product scope. | | Documentation | Ability to prepare compliance matrices, design review notes, certification evidence, risk assessments, test documentation, corrective-action records, and technical justifications. | | Collaboration | Ability to work with product engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical/thermal engineering, quality, manufacturing, sourcing, suppliers, certification agencies, and business unit teams. |

Desirable Qualifications

  • Prior experience in data center infrastructure, critical power, thermal management, cooling systems, industrial electrical equipment, or mission-critical products.
  • Experience with power products such as UPS, switchgear, switchboards, PDUs, battery/energy storage systems, power distribution systems, and integrated modular solutions.
  • Experience with thermal products such as CRAC, fan wall, AHU, XDU, chillers, direct expansion systems, chilled water systems, liquid cooling, heat rejection, and heat reuse systems.
  • Familiarity with emerging high voltage data center and server rack standards.
  • Familiarity with product certifications and regional compliance requirements across North America, Europe, and global markets.
  • Refrigerant regulations, low-GWP refrigerant readiness, and LEED and BREAM sustainability documentation as applies to Data Centers where applicable.

Main Compliance Standards / Codes to Focus On

| | | | --- | --- | | Category | Standards / Codes | | Electrical installation & safety | NEC / NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, OSHA electrical safety requirements, lockout/tagout/tryout, arc flash, energized-work controls. | | Power product safety | UL508A, UL1995, UL891, UL1558, applicable CSA requirements, NEMA, ANSI, IEEE, IEC, and CE depending on product and market. | | Thermal / HVAC product compliance | Product-specific HVAC and thermal equipment standards relevant to CRAC, fan wall, AHU, XDU, chillers, airflow, filters, heat rejection, cooling performance, electrical cabinet heat, and component performance documentation. | | Quality / management systems | ISO 9001, ISO 45001, and ISO 14001 where applicable to manufacturing, safety, and environmental management systems. | | Data center / integrated systems | Local/regional electrical and construction codes, customer specifications, interoperable power/thermal system integration requirements, and standards playbook alignment. |

job.description:
Job Description

Job Title: Application Development & Support Specialist

Function/Department: IT / Sales Applications

Reports to: Manager Application Development & Support

Location: Pune, India

Vertiv, a $4.5B global organization with nearly 30,000 employees, designs, builds and services critical infrastructure that enables vital applications for data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities. We support today’s growing mobile and cloud computing markets with a portfolio of power, thermal and infrastructure management solutions.

Position Summary:

The Application Development & Support Specialist will be responsible of the development of the Oracle Sales Cloud applications. He/She will be the subject matter expert of the Oracle Sales Cloud application including its integration with other digital tools.

The role will provide in-depth application support for Oracle Sales Cloud applications, execute and monitor application enhancements requests, develop and configure front end application design, coordinate with DB and backend integrations, escalate issues to application providers, deliver instance for development regression testing and facilitate regular meetings with assigned group.

Key Duties

  • Contribute into the development and the deployment of Oracle Sales Cloud System Configuration particularly in the designing, building, testing, implementation and stabilization.
  • Deploy system enhancements, service requests (change requests) ensuring solution is scalable and meets overall business requirements and identify/document functional gaps
  • Support regression and integration testing when there is a new release as well as in any situation when quick or detailed testing is a must.
  • Participate in root cause analysis / corrective action for critical issues and incidents
  • Analyze production configuration issues and resolve any technical gaps
  • Develop, support, maintain interfaces between Oracle Sales Cloud and related business critical systems.
  • Generate and maintain documentation for changes made to systems.
  • Collaborate with the Project Management Office to estimate the delivery timelines, estimate resourcing needs, and identify risks & issues upfront
  • Work system specifications and develop functioning programs using the Oracle Sales Cloud Platform or other Sales Enablement platforms
  • Develop test plans to ensure proper system functionality and defects free release and meet business requirements. Maintain systems to ensure reliability and performance.
  • Escalate issues and requests to vendor or implementation partner and ensure timely resolution.
  • Work effectively with remote team members, outsourced resources, and users to complete tasks.
  • Conduct ongoing quality reviews and analysis of data in Oracle Sales Cloud. Identifies data quality issues and escalates for corrective action

School Background / Working Seniority

  • Experience in Oracle Sales Cloud integrations with other sales platforms
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
  • International experience
  • Exposure /internship in an international System Integrator company is a plus

Basic Skills

  • Strong English language skills
  • Analytical, and Problem-solving skills are required

Technical / Functional skills

  • Exposure to Oracle Sales Cloud platform, Oracle cloud CX (Sales and Service) and Redwood
  • Exposure to Oracle ERP systems
  • Exposure with Oracle Visual Builder (VBCS), VBS
  • Exposure with PL/SQL or MS SQL, Java and Javascript is preferred
  • Exposure creating Functional Requirement Documentation
  • Excellent Communication and Teamwork skills
  • Process Discipline and Documentation skills essential
  • Ready to move beyond own area of comfort
  • Ability to be adaptable and flexible while responding to deadlines on assignments and workflow fluctuations

Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.   • Customer Obsession, Strong interpersonal skills, Should be strong in verbal/written communication, Prompt/ Quick thinker, Be Empathetic ,Personable and attentive, Ability to prioritize and multitask Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.

Key job responsibilities 🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling

  • Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
  • Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
  • Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
  • Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations

  • Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
  • Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
  • Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
  • Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support

  • Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
  • Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation

  • Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
  • Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
  • Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning

  • Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
  • Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
  • Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
  • Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
  • Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
  • Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
  • Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination

  • Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
  • Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development

  • Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
  • Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
  • Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
  • Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
  • Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
  • 1+ years of computer networking experience
  • High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
  • Familiarity with rack decommissioning including device wipe, media destruction, and asset recovery procedures

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.

Key job responsibilities 🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling

  • Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
  • Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
  • Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
  • Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations

  • Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
  • Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
  • Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
  • Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support

  • Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
  • Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation

  • Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
  • Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
  • Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning

  • Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
  • Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
  • Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
  • Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
  • Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
  • Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
  • Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination

  • Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
  • Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development

  • Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
  • Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
  • Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
  • Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
  • Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

job.title: Solutions Architect, AWS SGP
job.description:
Are you an Architect at heart who also thinks like an engineer? Do you get energized helping customers solve complex problems—not just on a whiteboard, but by building alongside them?

We're looking for a Solutions Architect to join our Singapore team, working with diverse customers across the full breadth of their cloud journey. You'll help customers migrate to the cloud, modernize legacy applications and databases, build cloud-native solutions, and explore how GenAI & Agentic AI can drive their business forward.

We value practitioners—people whose judgment is grounded in real-world experience building and shipping solutions. You'll partner hands-on with customers, turning ideas into working prototypes and production-ready architectures. Whether the challenge is a complex migration, a legacy modernization, a greenfield application, or helping a customer understand how AI can transform their business—you'll bring curiosity, technical depth, and a bias for action.

If you thrive in ambiguity, adapt quickly when priorities shift, and measure your success by the outcomes you help customers achieve—we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities Key job responsibilities

  • Partner with diverse customers to design, build, and implement solutions across cloud adoption, migration, modernization, and new workloads
  • Work hands-on with customer teams—building prototypes, proofs of concept, and production-ready architectures together
  • Assess legacy applications and databases, and co-create practical modernization roadmaps that reduce technical debt and enable innovation
  • Guide customers through cloud migrations—helping them move workloads efficiently and securely
  • Help customers explore how AI and emerging technologies can enhance their applications, operations, and customer experiences
  • Apply practitioner-level judgment to identify the right opportunities and focus effort where it creates the greatest customer and business impact
  • Navigate shifting priorities with agility—realigning quickly as customer and business needs evolve
  • Share knowledge broadly through workshops, technical content, and community engagement

A day in the life Your morning might start with whiteboarding a migration strategy for a customer moving their first workloads to the cloud. By afternoon, you're hands-on—pairing with their engineers to build a proof of concept for modernizing a legacy database. The next day could be completely different: helping a customer design a cloud-native application, or exploring how AI could solve a long-standing business challenge. Your recommendations carry weight because they're informed by your own experience building. When priorities shift, you adapt. You're always learning—and bringing that knowledge back to customers.

About the team You'll be part of the AWS Singapore Solutions Architecture team, based in our Singapore office. We work with diverse customers across industries—helping them adopt cloud, migrate and modernize their technology landscape, adopt AI, and build for the future. Our team values builders who are curious, collaborative, and customer-obsessed. We learn from each other, support each other's growth, and celebrate diverse perspectives. Whether you're presenting to executives or coding alongside engineers, you'll find a team that values both technical depth and human connection.

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 5+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
  • Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
  • Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Executive, Engineering & Sustainability
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across 270 cities in 45 countries.

Job Description

Job Responsibilities

  • Manage sustainability initiatives and engineering projects, including but not limited to solar photovoltaic (PV) installations, M&E enhancement works, smart building technologies, and environmental sustainability programs.
  • Coordinate with operations teams, business units, and stakeholders to ensure accurate collection, validation, and reporting of utility and sustainability data. Support GRESB submissions, sustainability disclosures, and periodic reporting of CapitaLand sustainability targets and performance indicators.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement innovative technologies and sustainability solutions to improve energy efficiency, water conservation, waste management, and recycling performance across the portfolio.
  • Conduct feasibility studies, pilot trials, technical assessments, and performance evaluations of emerging technologies, and oversee project execution from planning through implementation.
  • Collaborate with corporate functions, operations teams, vendors, consultants, and external stakeholders to develop and drive sustainability, innovation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Analyze operational performance and sustainability metrics, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and recommend strategies to enhance environmental performance and resource efficiency.
  • Prepare management reports, business cases, presentations, and recommendations for project approvals and stakeholder decision-making.
  • Undertake any other duties and projects as assigned by manager.

Requirements

  • Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 to 4 years of relevant experience in sustainability, engineering, facilities management, green building initiatives, or the built environment sector.
  • Familiarity with green building certifications, sustainability reporting frameworks, energy management, and environmental regulations.
  • Strong project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently.
  • Effective interpersonal, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Experience with sustainability data analytics and reporting tools will be an advantage.
  • Knowledge of GRESB, BCA Green Mark, ESG reporting, energy management, or carbon reduction initiatives would be an added advantage.

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Production Scheduler
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Production Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to generate a detailed production schedule based on the production plan to maximize the use of resources and meet established production specifications and schedules. Each day, you will feed information on production capacity issues and material availability. You will also showcase your expertise by releasing manufacturing work orders.

The work model for the role is: #LI – Onsite

This role is contributing to the Automation – Energy division in-Bangalore-Nelamangala region in India.. Main stakeholders are production, Procurement, Inventory, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, Maintenance teams, and Vendors.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Developed and managed production schedules to meet customer delivery requirements and production targets.
  • Executed daily MRP activities to ensure material availability and seamless production planning.
  • Defined production sequences, routing, and lead times to align with the master production schedule.
  • Monitored actual versus planned production, identified deviations, and implemented corrective actions.
  • Managed production orders and coordinated shop floor operations to optimize productivity and resource utilization.
  • Controlled raw material, WIP, and finished goods inventory to maintain optimum stock levels and production continuity.
  • Maintained BOMs in SAP/ERP systems and generated MIS/KPI reports to support planning and performance management.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Communication (ECE), Mechanical, Instrumentation, or related engineering disciplines.
  • Possess 2-5 years of experience in Production Planning, Scheduling, Manufacturing Operations, Inventory Management, or related functions within OEM and manufacturing environments.
  • Strong knowledge of production planning, inventory control, shop floor operations, Material Requirement Planning (MRP), production scheduling, and capacity planning processes.
  • Hands-on experience working with SAP/ERP systems, Bill of Materials (BOM), production orders, and manufacturing execution processes to support operational efficiency.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions such as VLOOKUP and HLOOKUP, with the ability to prepare MIS reports, KPI dashboards, and production performance analytics.
  • Knowledge of ISO 9001:2015 quality standards, Kaizen methodologies, and continuous improvement practices within a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and vendor coordination skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams and support business requirements, including up to 10% travel.

More about us:

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and thrive in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain experience delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

This Position reports to:

Operations Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, equipment performance, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also showcase your expertise by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to achieve the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Smart Power division at Nashik, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Identifying and recommending improvement opportunities and implements improvement projects, ensuring adherence to timeframe, quality, and cost requirements.
  • Approving the design for processes developed internally or externally and performing final tests with respect to the project.
  • Providing support to Production during the internal/external process/equipment start-up, defining action plans and training relevant maintenance and production resources.
  • Evaluating new process technologies to improve productivity, quality, and cost reduction, defining and leading testing activities, approval criteria, and external provider choices.

Qualifications for the role

  • You are highly skilled in manufacturing process optimization, Lean Manufacturing, WCM, continuous improvement, line balancing, takt-time optimization, and waste elimination within a manufacturing/industrial environment.
  • You have 5 to 8 Years

job.title: In-process Quality engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Quality Specialist ###

Your role and responsibilities In this role, you will have the opportunity to assist local unit in developing the necessary capabilities to effectively control products and systems. Each day, you will ensure compliance with internal, customer, and industry requirements within a cost-effective and safe working environment. You will also showcase your expertise by participating in the development and implementation of standards and test methods to ensure only compliant products, software, and services are released to the customer.

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Smart Power division at Nashik, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting test protocols, as assigned, to ensure products, systems, or software meet specified requirements and customer expectations in incoming, manufacturing, factory test labs, or final inspection quality, including internal testing routine and Factory Acceptance Testing (F.A.T.) as applicable.
  • Supporting quality control needs and activities for supplier quality, production quality, testing and validation, and engineering, as applicable in the local organization.
  • Executing and assisting specific quality-related training, promoting a passion for quality and integrity in all actions, with a focus on result orientation.
  • Collecting, recording, and evaluating data to be interpreted according to the internal ABB specifications, customer norms, and applicable national and/or global standards while maintaining a high level of integrity.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering
  • 6–8 years of experience in Supplier Quality / Manufacturing Quality, preferably in LV switchgear domain.
  • Strong knowledge of LV switchgear products (ACB, MCB, MCCB) and their applications.
  • Hands-on experience with quality tools: GRR, SPC, PPAP, FMEA, 8D, etc.
  • Good understanding of manufacturing processes and assembly techniques for electrical products.
  • Experience in handling supplier audits and quality compliance activities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with expertise in root cause analysis methodologies.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Analytical Lead, Planning and Measurement, Large Customer Sales
job.description:
About the job

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

The Planning & Measurement team at Google is a critical part of our advertising business, ensuring that our clients understand the value and impact of their campaigns. We're searching for a passionate and experienced Analytical Lead to join our team and help drive better measurement practices across a portfolio of clients in e-commerce, gaming and travel.

In this role, you'll be a trusted advisor and consultant, working closely with both internal teams and external clients to develop and implement robust measurement strategies. You will leverage Google's cutting-edge data and technology to provide actionable insights that improve advertising effectiveness and drive business results.

Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Build strong relationships with key client stakeholders, understanding their business objectives and measurement needs. Partner closely with Google Sales teams, Product teams, and Engineering teams to ensure alignment and drive product innovation.
  • Craft media plan guidance (across performance and brand) in accordance with customer business objectives. Stay aware of industry trends and best practices in measurement, sharing knowledge and insights with clients and internal stakeholders through presentations, workshops, and thought leadership content.
  • Develop customized measurement frameworks and roadmaps for clients, encompassing a range of methodologies and Google's measurement solutions
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of campaign performance data, leveraging statistical techniques and causal inference to uncover meaningful insights and recommendations.
  • Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests to optimize campaign performance and demonstrate the value of different media channels and strategies.

job.title: Outcome Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

The Google Cloud Platform (GCP) team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security and reliability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers, developers, businesses, educational institutions and government agencies see the benefits of our technology come to life.

As a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Outcome Customer Engineer (OCE), you will partner with a cross-functional team at Google, to drive initial and ongoing business growth for our customers, providing technical advisory, clearing blockers and ensuring they get the maximum benefit from their investment faster. You will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and helping shape the future of businesses of all sizes using technology to connect with customers, employees and partners. You will manage and execute the deployment plan, transitioning scoped workloads into production by providing technical leadership to customers and partners. You will have a direct impact on the velocity and incremental consumption of customer workloads, leading to accelerated value realization, higher adoption, and future expansion opportunities.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and orchestrate a structured, deployment plan across customer, professional services, and partner teams, onboarding the implementation team, clearing blockers, managing timelines and progress, and ensuring readiness (e.g., capacity, training).
  • Employ coding, debugging, or systems design to resolve technical blockers and accelerate deployment.
  • Drive and track progress of the initial and ongoing ramp of workloads, moving customers from agreement to consumption as quickly as possible. Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to customers or partners during ramp, delivery, migration, or implementation phases.
  • Identify expansion opportunities for new workloads within the account during project execution.
  • Drive the product usage to help customers realize value on an ongoing basis and secure future agreement renewals.
