job.title: Staff Gen AI Engineer, Forward Deployed, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

As a Generative AI (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you are an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality within partners for our customers. Unlike traditional advisory roles, you will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke and scalable agentic solutions directly with our partners, for and within the customer’s environment. This role is designed for high-agency engineers with a founder’s mindset. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with strategic partners, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical connector and feedback loop for the partner to Google, transforming real-world field and partner insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap. You will serve as the agent engineer bridging the gap between AI prototypes and production-grade reality for our strategic AI partners and their own FDE teams.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a team lead and developer within the strategic AI partner for AI applications, working with partner’s teams to transition from rapid prototypes to production-grade, replicable agentic workflows (multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable ROI.
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure partner developed agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable partner and field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
  • Co-build with a strategic AI partner’s own Forward Deployed Engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.
  • Help partners to build their own agentic delivery capabilities to set them up for long-term success, focusing on the ROI at customer engagements ensuring customer activation.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Customer Engineer, Platform, Start-ups, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer, you will partner with sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to our customers and serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use the expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans while using the business acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present solutions. You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving engagement within existing ones. You will have technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend business expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of GCP portfolio.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting business goals.
  • Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots and workshops.
  • Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers, continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
  • Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
  • Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Content Safety
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Content Safety organization in Core provides safety solutions that protect Google’s users from exposure to offensive, sensitive or harmful content. The team unblock and accelerate Google's product launches by providing quality implementations of company-wide standards for Responsible Artificial Intelligence (AI). The team combines subject matter expertise in the content safety domain and a practice of machine learning and AI-based techniques with the production-grade experience in serving infrastructure and product integrations to protect users from harm, maintain Google’s engagement in the area of online safety across the industry, and make foundational models and the internet safer for society.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and drive the technical direction for high-quality, future-proof, and performant content safety solutions across both server-side and on-device (e.g., edge) environments.
  • Design robust, scalable software architectures, modular interfaces, and complex data models to resolve highly ambiguous and shifting system requirements.
  • Lead the development, deployment, and optimization of highly performant agentic flows (e.g., both stateless and stateful) and multi-step AI orchestration pipelines at scale.
  • Establish rigorous validation standards, routing logic, and tool-use schemas to ensure deterministic, safe, and compliant execution across autonomous safety agent pipelines.
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders and cross-functional partners across regions to translate high-level business goals into concrete technical execution plans.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Android Trust
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our team's mission is protecting billions of Android users from abusive apps, including malware, content abuse, impersonation, and behavioral abuse. We develop products and services to ensure a safe and high quality experience for users of Android apps across the Android ecosystem. We also protect Google's brand and business. Our work spans our production infrastructure and novel research (publishing in security conferences). Our efforts sit in the areas such as supervised/unsupervised ML and generative AI for detecting content, privacy, and security violations, static program analysis of multiple languages used by Android apps, dynamic program analysis on secure environments in both real devices and Virtual Machines (VMs), enhancing and automating reverse-engineering and threat mitigation, and agentic AI threat models and defense.

Android is Google’s mobile operating system powering more than 3 billion devices worldwide. Android is about bringing computing to everyone in the world. We believe computing is a super power for good, enabling access to information, economic opportunity, productivity, connectivity between friends and family and more. We think everyone in the world should have access to the best computing has to offer. We provide the platform for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and developers to build compelling computing devices (smartphones, tablets, TVs, wearables, etc) that run the best apps/services for everyone in the world.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and scale virtualized and physical device-based analysis platforms for large-scale app execution and monitoring.
  • Write system-level code to perform deep inspection and instrumentation of apps while defeating evasion techniques.
  • Lead design reviews and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to architect defense strategies for agentic AI threat models.
  • Triage and resolve complex system issues by analyzing impacts on hardware, network, and service quality.

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

Google is seeking a Lead Portfolio Manager for Energy Contracts and Asset Management to support the sustainable, reliable, and efficient scaling of its expanding data center footprint. Driven by the rapid growth of AI and next-generation cloud services, this role is critical in ensuring that physical infrastructure scales in alignment with the company's bold carbon-free energy goals.

In this position, you will manage a multi-region portfolio of power purchase agreements (PPAs), utility tariffs, and clean energy contracts. Responsibilities include monitoring asset performance, proactively identifying risks to capacity, and ensuring full contractual compliance. To streamline operations, you will leverage artificial intelligence and design automated, scalable tools that transform complex operational data into actionable business narratives for leadership.

You will bring deep expertise in Asia Pacific energy markets, particularly across project development, operations, supply contracting, utility tariffs, rate structures, and PPAs. You should be skilled at identifying operational improvements, scaling portfolio operations through technological innovation, and generating strategic insights to guide executive decision-making. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. Responsibilities

  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to maximize the value of Google’s global energy contracts (PPAs, electricity supply agreements, and utility tariffs) while ensuring all performance metrics and compliance requirements are met or improved.
  • Identify, design, and deploy AI solutions, custom automation, and scripting to streamline contract ingestion, automate performance tracking, and scale portfolio operations across APAC.
  • Synthesize large datasets of complex operational, market, and financial data into clear, compelling narratives and visual presentations that deliver actionable strategic insights back to the business.
  • Own and automate energy portfolios spend tracking, budgeting, and analysis to clearly communicate drivers of energy spend variance at scale.
  • Coordinate with multi-functional experts across Google (including Finance, Legal, Sustainability, Site Selection, and Data Center Operations) to ensure alignment on energy goals and project execution.

job.title: Network Implementation Engineer, AutoCAD Drafter
job.description:
About the job

As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.

As a Network Implementation Engineering, you will be responsible for the evaluation, design, and construction of Google's space in colocation facilities across the globe. You will plan, design, and generate construction level Computer Aided Design (CAD) drawings for the spaces we utilize across the globe. You will have a wide scope of background across the data center industry, including operations, engineering (network, electrical, or mechanical), making the time more effective at the work we perform.

Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.

Responsibilities

  • Draft Statement Of Work (SOW) design/engineering drawing sets.
  • Design spaces that meet needs along with maintaining flexibility for the future.
  • Create LISP routines to automate and improve drafting efficiencies.
  • Review proposals, costs, and submittals related to the build of the colocation spaces.

job.title: Data Center Technician, Global Server Operations
job.description:
About the job

Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or functions.
  • Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and apply the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
  • Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards.
  • Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end-of-life via part replacement or maintenance, in a team setting.
  • Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with defined solutions and limited guidance.

job.title: HVAC Service Technician
job.description:
Join a Global Leader in Building Technologies

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the future of smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. As a global leader in HVAC, building automation, energy efficiency, and decarbonization solutions, we help customers operate some of the world's most critical facilities, including hospitals, data centres, universities, pharmaceutical sites, and advanced manufacturing environments.

For over 140 years, Johnson Controls has been delivering innovative solutions that improve building performance, enhance efficiency, and create better outcomes for our customers and communities. Today, our people continue to lead the way through cutting-edge technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to excellence.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Service HVAC Technician to join our Sunshine Coast team, based in Warana.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technician looking to work on a diverse range of commercial HVAC systems while enjoying the lifestyle benefits of the Sunshine Coast. You'll be supported by a highly experienced national technical network and have access to industry-leading training, development, and career opportunities.

Whether you're currently servicing commercial HVAC systems, working with chillers, refrigeration, or mechanical services, this role offers the chance to broaden your technical expertise and grow your career with a global organisation.

Why Technicians Choose Johnson Controls

  • Work-life balance with flexibility built into our culture
  • Variety of work across commercial, healthcare, education, industrial, and critical infrastructure sites
  • Access to advanced technology, systems, and equipment
  • Ongoing technical training and industry-recognised development programs
  • Opportunities to expand into Chillers, Building Management Systems (BMS), Controls, and specialised solutions
  • RDO or overtime options to suit your lifestyle and earning goals
  • Career pathways locally, nationally, and globally
  • Strong team culture backed by one of the world's leading building technology companies

What You'll Be Doing

  • Service, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair commercial HVAC equipment
  • Diagnose faults and provide practical, customer-focused solutions
  • Complete preventative and reactive maintenance activities
  • Install, commission, and test HVAC systems and components
  • Provide technical support and recommendations to customers
  • Maintain accurate service reports and compliance documentation
  • Collaborate with a skilled team of technicians and technical specialists
  • Ensure all work is completed safely and in accordance with industry regulations

What You'll Bring

  • Certificate III in Air Conditioning & Refrigeration (or equivalent)
  • Queensland Restricted Electrical Licence (minimum requirement)
  • Experience servicing and maintaining commercial HVAC systems
  • Strong fault-finding and diagnostic skills
  • A customer-focused approach and excellent communication skills
  • Current driver's licence
  • Commitment to workplace safety and quality workmanship

What's On Offer

  • Competitive salary package
  • Company vehicle and tools of trade
  • Ongoing training, certifications, and professional development
  • Exposure to leading-edge HVAC and smart building technologies
  • Supportive leadership and collaborative team environment
  • Long-term career security with a global industry leader

About Johnson Controls Australia

Johnson Controls operates one of Australia's largest HVAC and building services networks, supporting customers nationwide with innovative solutions that improve performance, sustainability, and reliability. Our technicians are at the forefront of delivering critical services that keep buildings operating efficiently and safely.

Ready for Your Next Career Move?

If you're looking for more variety, greater technical exposure, stronger career development, and the backing of a global leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and take the next step in your HVAC career with Johnson Controls on the Sunshine Coast.

Applicants must have full Australian working rights. Pre-employment checks, including medical, reference, police, and drug & alcohol screening, will be required as part of the recruitment process.

At Johnson Controls (JCI), you'll join a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, working on industry-leading building automation technologies while enjoying the lifestyle that makes the Sunshine Coast such a desirable place to call home.

For over 140 years, Johnson Controls has been helping customers create smarter, more efficient, and more sustainable buildings. As a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, we help organizations optimize performance, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with greater resilience across industries such as healthcare, data centers, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and we're committed to creating opportunities where careers thrive.

About the Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Building Automation Service Technician to join our established and high-performing Sunshine Coast Service Team.

In this role, you'll service, maintain, and optimize complex building automation systems across a diverse portfolio of commercial customer sites, helping to deliver smarter and more energy-efficient buildings.

What's in it for You?

  • Competitive salary package plus fully maintained company vehicle
  • Choice of RDOs or overtime opportunities
  • Genuine commitment to work-life balance and flexibility
  • Access to internal remote technical support from industry experts
  • Structured technical training and ongoing professional development
  • The opportunity to work with industry-leading building automation technologies

You are a technically capable and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving complex problems and delivering outstanding outcomes.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Electrical Licence or Restricted Electrical Licence
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in building controls following apprenticeship completion
  • Experience with Building Performance and Energy Efficiency solutions
  • Strong understanding of commercial HVAC operations
  • Knowledge of chiller, boiler, and airside plant performance and design requirements
  • Experience with IT systems, network communications, and PC hardware configuration
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Strong commitment to safety, including proactive hazard identification and risk resolution

Grow with JCI

As a global organization, we actively support internal career progression. Whether you're looking to deepen your technical expertise, move into project delivery, explore other business areas, or develop into a leadership role, we'll help you achieve your career goals.

  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment

job.title: Project Manager (L&D Shared Services)
job.description:
** L&D Shared Services – Project Manager

Job Description

**

What you will do 

Manage end-to-end L&D content delivery projects by owning planning, governance, coordination, execution, tracking, and closure across the project lifecycle. The Project Manager will work closely with internal project coordinators, project leads, instructional designers, QA analysts, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure learning deliverables are delivered on time, within scope, within cost, and with the expected quality. The role requires strong operational discipline, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, intake governance, effort and timeline estimation, reporting, quality governance, analytics-driven planning, conflict resolution, and continuous improvement to support the current L&D Shared Services operating model.

In addition to the above, the Project Manager will be expected to:

Own project governance by managing scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, stakeholder expectations, and delivery commitments across active projects.

Enable smooth coordination between internal teams, external stakeholders, vendors, IDs, QA analysts, and coordinators to ensure clear handoffs and accountability.

Drive operational excellence through intake tracking, POD updates, vendor workflow governance, reporting hygiene, process documentation, and continuous improvement.

How you will do it 

  • Lead project planning, execution, monitoring, and closure for L&D content development and learning delivery projects.
  • Participate in requirement gathering, clarify scope, define delivery approach, and create phase-wise project and communication plans.
  • Support effort, cost, timeline, and resource estimation to enable realistic delivery commitments and project prioritization.
  • Determine and govern the execution strategy across in-house teams and vendors based on scope, capacity, skills, timelines, and delivery complexity.
  • Partner with project coordinators for internal coordination, trackers, meeting logistics, documentation, and follow-ups.
  • Partner with project leads for external stakeholder coordination, requirement alignment, escalations, and delivery commitments.
  • Manage vendor engagement under the hourly model, including initiation, onboarding inputs, effort tracking, communication, and delivery governance.
  • Coordinate with instructional designers, QA analysts, and vendors to ensure content quality, review cycles, rework tracking, and timely sign-offs.
  • Define and track quality expectations, quality metrics, review outcomes, and QA reporting inputs in partnership with QA stakeholders.
  • Maintain project plans, RACI details, trackers, status reports, action logs, risk logs, and project documentation for transparency and continuity.
  • Provide timely updates through stakeholder meetings, project reviews, dashboards, business reports, success stories, and stakeholder escalation management.
  • Use available analytics, project data, and delivery trends to inform project planning, scope discussions, risks, capacity decisions, and improvement actions.
  • Identify risks, blockers, capacity concerns, scope changes, and dependency issues early; escalate with recommended actions where needed.
  • Resolve conflicts, remove execution barriers, and drive alignment across internal teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support successful delivery.
  • Drive intake discipline by supporting requirement clarity, prioritization inputs, delivery readiness, and alignment with shared services processes.
  • Evaluate completed projects, capture lessons learned, track feedback, and recommend process improvements to improve speed, quality, cost discipline, and stakeholder experience.
  • Stay informed on L&D trends, authoring standards, and operational best practices to support scalable and relevant learning solutions.

**

Qualification & Experience

  • Graduate or postgraduate degree in business, learning, project management, operations, or a related field.
  • 8–12+ years of experience in project management, learning operations, content development, shared services, or vendor-managed delivery environments.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects across global stakeholders, vendors, instructional design, QA, and operations teams.

Skills

  • Strong project governance, planning, tracking, risk management, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to manage cross-functional work across PM, coordinator, ID, QA, vendor, and business stakeholder groups.
  • Strong estimation and planning skills, including effort, timeline, cost, resource, and phase-wise delivery planning.
  • Project financial and cost governance mindset with the ability to manage multiple projects within agreed timelines, cost expectations, and quality standards.
  • Strong documentation discipline, including project plans, status reports, trackers, action logs, SOPs, and handover notes.
  • Experience with dashboards, reporting governance, analytics, and tools such as Power BI, MS Project, Planner, SharePoint, Excel, and Jira or equivalent tools.
  • Working knowledge of learning content development processes, authoring tools, SCORM/xAPI standards, review cycles, quality metrics, and QA workflows.
  • Vendor management experience, including execution strategy, workflow coordination, effort tracking, communication, issue resolution, and delivery quality checks.
  • Ability to influence without authority, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, drive accountability, and work effectively across time zones.
  • Strong customer orientation with a focus on quality, responsiveness, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Preferred

  • Understanding of instructional design, adult learning principles, learning technologies, and multimedia/content production workflows.
  • Experience working in shared services, GCC, L&D operations, or vendor-partnered delivery models.
  • Familiarity with HVAC, Building Automation, Fire & Security, or similar industrial/technical learning environments.

job.title: Quality Analysts I – Reporting
job.description:
Quality Analyst I - Reporting

What you will do

Responsible for ensuring the quality, compliance, and effectiveness of learning solutions and operational processes delivered by the L&D Shared Services team. Partner with cross-functional teams to conduct quality reviews, testing, audits, and data analysis to ensure deliverables meet stakeholder expectations, business requirements, and quality standards.

How you will do it

  • Conduct quality reviews of eLearning, ILT/VILT, videos, job aids, LMS content, SharePoint sites, and digital learning solutions.
  • Perform manual testing of LMS platforms, learning technologies, and workflow applications.
  • Validate content accuracy, functionality, accessibility, branding, learner experience, and business requirements.
  • Identify, track, analyze, and report defects and quality issues.
  • Analyze quality trends and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support audits, governance reviews, compliance assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain quality checklists, review frameworks, and standard operating procedures.
  • Create quality dashboards, reports, and metrics using Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
  • Perform data analysis and provide actionable insights to support business decisions.
  • Drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA), process standardization, and quality improvement efforts.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote quality best practices.

What we look for

  • Graduate or Postgraduate degree from a recognized university.
  • 5-8 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Learning Quality, Process Excellence, Data Analytics, or Learning Operations.

  • Strong understanding of quality assurance, manual testing, and defect management.

  • Hands-on experience with Python, R, or SAS.
  • Experience with structured/unstructured data analysis and statistical techniques.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, Excel, and data visualization.
  • Experience in data mining, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and data storytelling.
  • Knowledge of Root Cause Analysis (RCA), process auditing, and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality of learning solutions and associated deliverables developed by the L&D Shared Services team. You will perform quality reviews, testing, and validation activities to ensure deliverables meet defined quality standards, stakeholder requirements, compliance guidelines, and business expectations.

You will collaborate with Instructional Designers, Learning Technologists, Graphic Designers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to support error-free, consistent, and high-quality learning experience delivered on time.

Position: EHS / Safety Officer - IBMSLocation: BangaloreEmployment Type:** Contractual (Based on Business Requirement)

Job Summary We are seeking a proactive and experienced EHS / Safety Officer to support and oversee Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) compliance for IBMS (Integrated Building Management System) projects across Bangalore. The candidate will be responsible for implementing safety programs, conducting site inspections, ensuring statutory compliance, and promoting a strong safety culture across project sites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct regular safety inspections, audits, and risk assessments for IBMS project activities.

Experience Required

job.title: Sr. Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition:

As a Senior Data Scientist, you will lead analytics programs, provide technical direction, and partner with cross functional stakeholders to deliver high impact solutions for Caterpillar business units, dealers, and customers.

The Senior Data Scientist will:

  • Lead and contribute to 3 - 4 concurrent analytics projects with significant business impact
  • Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to solve business problems
  • Coach and mentor other Data Scientists in model development, validation, and deployment
  • Provide technical leadership while balancing innovation with customer commitments
  • Communicate complex analytical results clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Proactively research and apply emerging analytics methods and technologies
  • Develop a deep understanding of Caterpillar’s products, systems, processes, customers, and market environment

Responsibilities

  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of statistical and machine learning algorithms.
  • Strong command of MS Office and data visualization tools such as Power BI.
  • Proven leadership abilities, self-motivation, effective interpersonal skills, and exceptional communication capabilities.

Desirable Qualifications:

  • Practical experience with Deep Learning and Agentic AI
  • Proficiency with Snowflake and AWS
  • Experience with GitHub, DBT, Copilot, and cloud-native tools

Education Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in statistics, economics, mathematics, engineering, or a related quantitative discipline with 7-10 years of quantitative analytics experience; alternatively, a Master's degree with 4-6 years of relevant experience, or a PhD with 1-3 years of relevant experience

Skill Descriptors Business Statistics: Knowledge of the statistical tools, processes, and practices to describe business results in measurable scales; ability to use statistical tools and processes to assist in making business decisions.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Machine Learning: Knowledge of principles, technologies and algorithms of machine learning; ability to develop, implement and deliver related systems, products and services.

Programming Languages: Knowledge of basic concepts and capabilities of programming; ability to use tools, techniques and platforms in order to write and modify programming languages.

Query and Database Access Tools: Knowledge of data management systems; ability to use, support and access facilities for searching, extracting and formatting data for further use.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project

Hybrid and flexible work environment due to the scope of role supporting global projects.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Posting Dates:

August 27, 2026 - September 3, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Lead Digital Consultant
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

The Integrated Components & Solutions (ICD) division owns Caterpillar’s Wear & Maintenance (W&M) components business — the ground engaging tools, undercarriage, hose & coupling, fluids & filters, and associated hardware that keep the world’s machines running. Our team is building the digital, data, and AI capabilities that make these products easier for customers and dealers to find, buy, use, and get value from.

As Digital Architect, Wear & Maintenance (W&M), you will help bring our W&M digital strategy to life. Partnering closely with the W&M Customer Experience strategy lead, industry business partners, and engineering teams, you will assist with development, execution, and prioritization — turning strategy into projects, requirements, and delivered results. This is a hands-on, technical role as well as a coordinating one: you will help design, build, and validate AI- and data-driven solutions for W&M and connect them into Caterpillar’s digital channels, working across the full W&M digital stack — from the underlying data, to the AI capabilities that use it, to the customer- and dealer-facing channels where it all comes together.

You will play a key role in developing and validating these solutions and integrating them, while also supporting the analytics behind smarter customer and dealer experiences.

Job Summary

Assist the W&M Customer Experience strategy lead to champion a customer-back mindset in the development of the W&M digital experience; execute and prioritize W&M digital projects; and serve as the key technical contributor and coordinator across the teams and systems that make up the W&M digital ecosystem. You will help design, build, and validate W&M AI tools, using approaches such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), and connect them into the Cat customer-facing ecosystem. Our team owns the AI “tools” that expose W&M offerings and capabilities to Caterpillar’s customer-facing applications such as VisionLink, Cat Central, SIS2, and the Cat AI Assistant.

You will be a key part of the team that owns the W&M domain logic, data quality, and the solutions that live within the AI-powered digital ecosystem. You will serve as an integrator — engaging heavily with engineering, digital, and industry teams to build and support the analytics that power recommendations, remaining-life insights, and easier quoting.

What You Will Do

  • Develop and validate W&M AI tools (using approaches such as MCP) that make it easy for customers to discover our offerings and capabilities; partner with Cat Digital to get them integrated and implemented.
  • Build and support Customer Experience analytics that improve the customer and dealer experience with the digital ecosystem — examples include: surfacing remaining-life estimates, providing product recommendations, speeding up quoting, and improving service-option visibility.
  • Write and maintain SQL and Python to query data, prototype solutions, and validate that AI- and data-driven capabilities return accurate, trustworthy results.
  • Contribute to and support our core product and component data — helping close gaps, improve accuracy, and ensure high quality, because good data is the foundation of every digital and AI capability.
  • Serve as a W&M domain expert, ensuring solutions reflect our business needs and how customers and dealers work.
  • Communicate requirements, progress, and results clearly to stakeholders across functions and geographies.
  • Serve as project owner and coordinate efforts across many partner teams, managing dependencies and keeping delivery aligned to W&M priorities.

What You Will Have:

  • Requirements Analysis: Extensive knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques for requirements analysis; ability to elicit, analyze, and document required business functionality and non-functional requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  • Project Management: Extensive knowledge of project management concepts, methods, and tools; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects to ensure delivery against scope, priorities, and business outcomes. Additionally, proven ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, or activities across teams, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.
  • Effective Communications: Extensive understanding and demonstrated application of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively receive, interpret and convey ideas, information, and business needs in written & oral communications across many geographies and functional disciplines.
  • Analytical Thinking: Extensive knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Ability to utilize data design methodologies, tools and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical design.
  • Data Management: Knowledge of the processes, tools, and techniques of data management; ability to maintain the quality, integrity, and accessibility of organizational data across its lifecycle and integrate data resources for business processes and functional support. Ability to utilize AI to accelerate data maintenance and management and develop and deploy AI-powered tools as needed.

Considerations for Top Candidates:

  • 6+ years of experience leading complex, multi-functional projects and coordinating cross-functional teams with demonstrated results.
  • Hands-on proficiency, or a demonstrated ability to learn, SQL and Python for querying data, building prototypes, and validating solutions.
  • Exposure to data platforms and pipelines (e.g., Snowflake, SQL, ETL) and comfort turning data into usable, trustworthy results.
  • Interest in and aptitude for modern AI capabilities and agent/tool integration approaches (e.g., MCP, LLM-based tools), with the ability to learn to build, connect, and validate them.
  • Demonstrated ability to help prioritize work and drive execution across multiple partner teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in a collaborative, cross-functional, cross-geography environment.
  • General knowledge of Wear & Maintenance products (ground engaging tools, undercarriage, maintenance parts) is a plus; familiarity with engineering/BOM data or heavy-industry domains is valued.

Additional Details:

  • This position requires the candidate to work full-time at the Caterpillar office in Chennai, India.
  • This position may require up to 10% travel.

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

job.title: Senior Principal Data Architect
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

Serve as the senior data architecture authority for DXP Data, translating business, analytics and AI priorities into secure, scalable, operable and cost-aware architecture across AWS, Snowflake, ingestion, analytics and AI. Own target architecture, domain data models, reusable patterns and governance-by-design, and guide engineering teams and partners.

Accountabilities

  • Architecture Strategy: Own the DXP Data target and reference architecture, principles, transition states and multi-year capability roadmap.
  • Data Models and Products: Set direction for enterprise-aligned domain models, design semantic structures, data contracts and reusable data-product architecture supporting C360 and self-service analytics.
  • Design Authority and Governance: Approve material designs, manage exceptions and architecture debt, and ensure security, privacy, quality, lineage, interoperability and operability are designed in.
  • Standards and Paved Roads: Define and drive adoption of reusable patterns across ingestion, storage, modelling, serving, integration, metadata and AI-enabled data use cases.
  • Business and Technology Alignment: Convert stakeholder priorities into sequenced architecture outcomes, explicit trade-offs and actionable decisions.
  • Technical Leadership by Influence: Guide engineering, stewardship, analytics and vendor teams through reviews, prototypes, decision records, mentoring and knowledge transfer.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture Roadmap: Maintain current, target and transition architectures; prioritize architecture runway, modernization, decommissioning and technical-debt reduction.
  • Data Product Design: Lead conceptual and logical modelling, guide physical design, and define data-product boundaries, contracts, ownership, quality and service expectations.
  • Reference Patterns: Define implementable patterns for batch, CDC, streaming and file ingestion; orchestration; warehouse/lakehouse design; sharing; metadata and lineage.
  • Assurance and Operability: Review material designs and changes for correctness, security, resilience, scale, observability, cost and performance before build or release commitment.
  • Technology Evolution: Evaluate and prototype platform choices across AWS, Snowflake, ingestion/orchestration, open formats, semantic or knowledge layers and AI; document evidence, TCO and risks.
  • Stakeholder and Team Enablement: Facilitate decisions, challenge unclear requirements, assess partner designs and uplift internal capability through reusable guidance and coaching.

Qualifications

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • Scope: Data architecture and governance across the DXP Data Platform and C360 ecosystem, including AWS, Snowflake, Datapipe/Airflow/Airbyte, SageMaker, metadata, analytics enablement, and evolving data and AI platform capabilities.
  • Decision Rights: Approval of target/reference architecture, strategic data and solution designs, enterprise/domain modelling patterns, data-product architecture, technology recommendations, architecture standards and exceptions; escalation of material security, quality, operational, cost, or architectural risks before delivery or go-live.
  • Stakeholders: DXP Data Domain Owner, Enterprise and Solution Architecture, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Data Quality Stewards, BI/Analytics, Data Science/AI, Business Data Owners, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity/ISO, Legal/Risk, application domain teams, and strategic partners.
  • Role Boundary / Resources: Senior individual-contributor and design-authority role operating across internal and vendor-augmented teams in Singapore, Malaysia and India. Engineering leads retain people leadership, implementation delivery and Day-2 operational ownership; the architect sets direction, assures design & operational quality, and drives cross-team alignment and capability uplift.

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience is preferred. Candidates with 12+ years may be considered where they demonstrate equivalent principal-level scope. Experience should include at least 7 years owning enterprise or domain data architecture and acting as a senior design authority in production-scale, multi-domain environments.
  • Proven ownership of data-platform strategy, target and reference architecture, modernization roadmaps and architecture governance across internal and partner delivery teams.
  • Deep expertise in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling, including customer/party models, dimensional and relational patterns, semantic layers, data products and data contracts.
  • Strong technical fluency in cloud data-platform architecture - preferably Snowflake and AWS - and modern ingestion, orchestration, warehouse/lakehouse, open-table, metadata, lineage and self-service analytics patterns.
  • Hands-on SQL and Python credibility sufficient to profile data, validate assumptions, prototype critical patterns and review implementation choices. Airflow and relevant ingestion technologies such as Airbyte, NiFi/Openflow or Glue are advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to embed security, privacy, classification, access control, quality, resilience, recoverability, observability, cost and regulatory requirements into implementable architecture.
  • Practical understanding of AI/ML and agentic use cases, including AI-ready data, semantic grounding, responsible-AI controls and secure use of enterprise data.
  • Executive-level stakeholder leadership and a track record of leading through influence in vendor-augmented environments. Telecommunications or Customer 360 experience is advantageous.

job.title: Director, Electrical Systems
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As Director of Electrical Systems based in Sydney or Singapore, you will report to the Senior Director -Technical Operations and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in several ways:

  • You are a multi disciplined data centre technical operations SME
  • Multiskilled with electrical (HV/MV/LV) experience and knowledge across a wide range of asset types and data centre designs.
  • You are a highly experienced technical manager with great communication skills and a leader of leaders.
  • As the Director of Electrical Systems, you will interface with key areas of the business such as Design & innovation, construction, commissioning & procurement as the voice of the customer.

Your Day to Day

  • Manage a team of Electrical specialists to ensure effective solutions implementation and issue resolution.
  • Represent Technical Operations in all design aspects of new builds and upgrades including vendor selection. FWT/FOK, Commissioning and testing as needed.
  • Define & augment when required our product specifications with an “Operational Lens”
  • Define the required maintenance (frequency and scope) on all electrical critical infrastructure & develop standards which will be implemented across the portfolio.
  • Partner with site operations on event RCA’s, product failures, risks and be the central Electrical Systems feedback loop for our design / procurement teams.
  • Oversight and resolution of the Electrical operational aspects of new project deployments.
  • Development of Electrical operations strategies for new sites across APAC, with a focus on local codes & regulations especially in emerging regions where codes are evolving.
  • Support operational incidents and escalation with technical expertise.
  • Effective and timely Problem resolution within Electrical Systems.
  • Vendor engagement on product performance

Requirements

  • You have 10+ years of experience in working in either data centres or mission critical environments
  • Ideally, you have experience working for a data centre operator and have previous hyperscale experience in the APAC market
  • You have tenured experience with managing a team of specialist electrical engineers.
  • You are a strong team player and exceptional communicator with influencing skills – working across partner teams in AirTrunk such as Development, Design/ Procurement.
  • You are the subject matter expert for all aspects of Electrical Systems operations including aspects such Low/Medium/High Voltage installations.
  • Ideally, you have strong commercial acumen to understand the commercial implications of engineering decisions
  • You are willing to travel to other APAC regions on a regular basis

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer (Electrical) - Singapore, Central Singapore
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Critical Facilities Engineer (Electrical) is a senior technical specialist responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and safe operation of mission-critical power infrastructure within the data center environment. This role provides technical leadership for electrical operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, and incident response activities while supporting the continuous delivery of highly resilient services to customers.

Working with a high degree of independence, the engineer leads complex electrical maintenance activities, supports critical switching operations, identifies operational risks, and drives continuous improvement initiatives that enhance infrastructure reliability, safety, and efficiency.

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Operate, maintain, and support mission-critical electrical infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, transformers, PDUs, breakers, and associated distribution systems
  • Perform advanced preventive and corrective maintenance activities to ensure the reliability and availability of critical power systems
  • Lead electrical troubleshooting efforts and resolve complex infrastructure issues, minimizing operational risk and customer impact
  • Monitor the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), responding to alarms and identifying potential risks before service impacts occur
  • Lead and coordinate critical electrical operations, including maintenance windows, switching procedures, energization activities, and infrastructure recovery efforts
  • Conduct site inspections and assess the health and performance of electrical infrastructure, recommending corrective actions and reliability improvements
  • Support electrical capacity planning and load management activities to ensure infrastructure readiness for future growth
  • Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, operational efficiency, and energy performance

Site Administration

  • Prepare, review, and authorize technical documentation including Maintenance Operation Protocols (MOPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs), and switching plans
  • Ensure maintenance activities are executed safely and in accordance with operational, regulatory, and company requirements
  • Maintain accurate infrastructure records, maintenance history, and operational documentation

Incident Management

  • Serve as a technical lead during electrical incidents, infrastructure failures, and power-related events
  • Provide guidance to on-site teams during incident response and restoration activities
  • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) investigations and develop corrective and preventive action plans
  • Lead post-incident reviews and recommend improvements to operational processes and infrastructure resilience

Vendor Management

  • Manage and coordinate electrical service providers, contractors, and vendors performing maintenance and project activities
  • Review vendor work plans, technical proposals, and maintenance recommendations
  • Ensure work is performed in accordance with safety requirements, industry standards, and data center operational procedures

Work Orders & Capacity Management

  • Lead resolution of complex work orders and infrastructure-related requests
  • Support electrical capacity planning, power utilization analysis, and infrastructure growth initiatives
  • Provide technical reviews of customer power requirements and infrastructure impacts
  • Support commissioning, testing, and integration of new electrical systems

Collaboration

  • Act as a technical mentor to engineers and technicians, sharing expertise and supporting team development
  • Partner with Critical Facilities, Customer Operations, Security, Design & Construction, and vendor teams to deliver operational excellence
  • Identify underlying infrastructure issues and recommend long-term reliability improvements
  • Leverage internal and external technical resources to resolve complex electrical challenges

Additional Projects

  • Lead electrical infrastructure projects, including upgrades, capacity expansion, modernization, and reliability improvement initiatives
  • Support lifecycle management and replacement strategies for critical electrical assets
  • Participate in commissioning, integrated systems testing, and acceptance activities for new infrastructure deployments
  • Recommend and champion initiatives that improve uptime, reliability, safety, and operational efficiency

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline preferred
  • Minimum 5 years of experience operating and maintaining critical electrical infrastructure in data centers, utilities, industrial facilities, telecommunications, or other mission-critical environments

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with mission-critical power systems, including: UPS systems Diesel generators Switchgear and breakers Transformers Low- and medium-voltage distribution systems Power monitoring systems
  • Experience performing electrical switching activities, maintenance planning, and incident response
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex electrical faults and identify root causes
  • Experience leading maintenance vendors and coordinating infrastructure projects
  • Strong understanding of electrical safety practices, operational risk management, and permit-to-work processes

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

job.title: Data Center Concierge III - Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
job.description:
Job Summary

The position will suit someone who is a strong communicator, experienced and organised in completing routing and ad-hoc tasks, admin focused and with the ability to deliver outstanding customer service at all times. Applicants may come from multifaceted industries including but not limited to hospitality, reception, administration or other customer centric roles and will be working Monday-Friday in a permanent position.

This is a customer facing role, so applicants should work onsite, enjoy client interaction and have the confidence to identify customer trends, issues or concerns, taking appropriate actions where possible and call out accordingly when needed.

Key responsibilities

Our Concierge will provide support to datacenter facilities and administrative duties following standard procedures:

  • Supports customers by coordinating visits and schedules in the data center; assists on semi-routine inquiries and issues
  • Directly coordinates activities with the Equinix Response Center (ERC), as needed
  • Keeps records of activities within the data center including circuit inventories, installed power inventories and labor hours expended
  • May generate purchase requisitions and coordinate with vendors for delivery and invoicing
  • Generating Siebel Reports for customer SH requests
  • Assist security with supervising the security office, signing in visitors, validation and assignment of access via the Siebel and EACS
  • Work closely with site security and report security related incidents to the Security Operations Control Centre
  • Perform ad hoc support tasks for IBX Operations teams, including but not limited to parking administration, CCTV and access control data retrieval and analysis, event coordination, and maintenance management system administration.
  • Take an active role in emergency response preparedness, including participating in evacuation drills and incidents by coordinating and managing designated muster areas, accounting for personnel, and supporting site emergency procedures.

Customer Support and onsite Customer Liaison

  • Supports the coordination of tasks to the appropriate cross-functional teams
  • Maintains positive business relationships with local vendors in support of customer's administrative needs; provides information about local vendors to customers upon request
  • Maintains customer care areas/conference rooms for cleanliness and fully stocking amenities as the need arises; may provide backup coverage to cross functional teams to support inventory ordering
  • Communicates semi-routine operating datacenter procedures to customers on-site, while building and developing positive customer relationships
  • Coordinates customer work visits with security and escorts customers and/or vendors, within a reasonable vicinity, as required
  • Assists with tracking, following-up, and reporting on routine or new customer inquiries and issues while customers are on-site
  • Provides general induction learning tours to new customers to orient them to the site and escorting customers to their spaces within the data center and unlocking racks where required
  • Resolving issues related to lower customer satisfaction score by coordinating with cross functional team

Benefits of Equinix and the role:

  • Salary package including healthcare allowance and annual bonus
  • Extensive on-job induction, training and continued learning and access to a range of company employee benefits
  • Career development and further opportunities within Equinix
  • Join an industry leader in the Data Centre world
  • Permanent position working Monday-Friday onsite daytime hours

job.title: SG | Manager (Service Assurance), Group Data Centre Operations
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As Manager (Service Assurance), Group Data Centre Operations (GDCO), you will be part of the Service Assurance team with responsibilities across data centres in Southeast and Northeast Asia. In this role, you will drive the performance of key operational processes to achieve continuous improvement and operational excellence, manage audit programmes to ensure compliance with required certifications including security (ISMS), processes (SMS & BCMS), and energy and environmental standards, and support the deployment and adoption of IT tools and systems to enable process automation and performance reporting.

  • Plan, schedule, and conduct internal audits for ISO 27001, ISO 20000-1, ISO 22301, and ISO 50001 standards, prepare audit reports and follow up with auditees to close findings.
  • Plan, schedule, and complete external audits by engaging certification bodies to achieve and maintain ISO 27001, ISO 20000-1, ISO 22301, and ISO 50001 certifications.
  • Monitor and review operations processes, including incident and change management to drive continuous improvement of key KPIs.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of physical security controls and operations to maintain and enhance overall sites security posture.
  • Support the setup and maintenance of ISMS, BCMS, and SMS management systems.
  • Contribute to the documentation of key operational policies, processes, manuals, SOPs to drive alignment and consistency across countries.
  • Support the automation of operational processes and performance reporting using appropriate IT tools and systems.
  • Provide training and coaching to the data centre operations teams and auditees on audit requirements and processes.
  • Support all service assurance-related activities, initiatives, and projects.
  • Any other tasks as assigned by the Management

Requirements

  • Degree or Diploma in IT, Mechanical & Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in a Data Centre environment.
  • Experience in data centre or critical environment operations (e.g., M&E facilities, security operations) and ITSM processes (incident, change, problem management).
  • ISO Lead/Internal Auditor certification (ISO 27001, 22301, 20000-1, or 50001) with hands-on audit and certification experience.
  • Familiarity with ISMS, BCMS, SMS frameworks and ITSM/operations support tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-cultural communication skills; bilingual in English and an additional Southeast Asian language is preferred.
  • Self-driven with strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver results with minimal supervision.

We thank you for your interest and effort taken to submit your application. Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: SG | Specialist, Data Centre Site Operations
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As the Specialist, Data Centre Site Operations (DCSO), you will be responsible for the following:

  • Work in rotating shifts to support large scale data centre’s 24x7 onsite operations and critical facilities.
  • Perform 24x7 monitoring of BMS systems (upstream to downstream), critical facilities equipment and other equipment associated with the data centre environment including fire safety, plumbing, mechanical, and electrical systems.
  • Act as first responders and the Level 1 escalation point for all onsite operational incidents and issues. Perform hands-on troubleshooting and ad-hoc repair of mechanical and electrical (M&E) equipment.
  • Respond and perform all remote hands requests within the Operational and Service Level Agreements.
  • Document and update accurately and promptly all relevant activities and requests on the STT GDC Web Portal ticketing system (user requests, incidents, change, problems, provisioning, etc.), ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library).
  • Ensure effective implementation of data centre safety, security and customer support policy and procedures.
  • Oversee the security operations onsite, including processes, manpower and ability to use security software systems.
  • Co-ordinate and support all internal contractors and vendors activities onsite, including reviewing of Permit-To-Work (PTW) documents, scheduling of resources, enforcement of house rules, adherence to best practices, compliance to safety procedures, etc.
  • Co-ordinate, plan and support all preventive and reactive maintenance activities with little to no disruption to STT GDC’s services.
  • Create accurate and regular reporting to internal stakeholders when necessary (incident reports, health reports, daily reports, etc.).
  • Write and update Standard Operating Procedures and Emergency Operating Procedures for DSCO related procedures and processes.
  • Provide administrative support in assets inventory and procurement of parts/equipment.
  • Knowledge of copper/fibre deployment and be willing to learn to use tester to perform cabling troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate and supervise the activities of contracted personnel providing services or performing work in the data centre. Coordinate all preventive/contracted/general maintenance, ensuring zero/minimum disruption of building services Carry out any other duties as and when assigned by the Team Leads and Management.

Requirements

The role provides operational leadership for new data centre start-ups, ensuring a smooth transition to in-country DC Operations teams while maintaining alignment with Group policies, standards, and best practices.   • Review and align regional engineering policies, procedures, and operational practices to establish consistent Group-wide operating baselines.
  • Drive global change management, problem management, incident review, and lessons-learned processes to improve operational reliability.
  • Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) on engineering and operational matters, supporting critical incident recovery, root cause analysis, and service improvement initiatives.
  • Conduct energy and water efficiency assessments and recommend sustainability and optimisation initiatives across the portfolio.

  • Develop and maintain operational risk management, governance, and capacity planning frameworks.
  • Review and analyse operational Capex and Opex budgets across regions to drive standardisation, benchmarking, and cost optimisation.
