job.title: Facility Manager
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Reporting to Vice President (Infrastructure Operations) and dotted to BOM2 Operations Manager, this role

is to manage the Data Center Facilities Operations teams to ensure the most efficient utilization of the Data

Center facilities resources, lowest possible operating PUE, consistent maintenance practices and service

uptime of the data centers. This role will be based in Mumbai, India.

Key responsibilities

  • Ensure consistency in the maintenance procedures of the DC Critical Electrical, Cooling, Fire Protection & Building Management System (BMS) infrastructure per DE maintenance policy or manufacturers’ recommendation and customer specifications (if required).
  • Perform Risk Assessment and develop appropriate method statements for critical infrastructure maintenance or infrastructure upgrade / replacement activities
  • Ensures services and activities of maintenance contractors and service providers as appropriate to DC facilities operations, maintenance, design and construction services in support of corporate and customer objectives (if required).
  • 3rd Level On-call emergency response & support as necessary to maintain the highest level of operations and availability to building systems, Electrical infrastructure efficiency & lowest possible operating PUE (through energy improvement program)
  • Maintain appropriate vendor relationships to obtain the required service support and competitive price for maintenance, repair & new installations.
  • Implement training & mentoring practices for Facilities Operations team members to ensure knowledge refresh, skills upgrade and quality results.
  • Ensure compliance of policies and procedures for occupational health & safety in the workplace, information security management, environmental management systems; incident management; and comply with all legal regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate and support for the existing and new initiative certifications such as ISMS, ISO 27001, 14001 and 45001, PCI DSS, etc., development and implementation works for Digital Edge India, taking guidance from HQ
  • Support Sales, Sales Engineering & Product Management team for key potential customer / Hyperscale deals.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • More than 12 years of work experience in Data Center operations and Facilities management
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Extensive operational knowledge of electrical distribution (e.g. switchgear, transformers, automatic transfer switch, UPS, STS, Drups, battery management systems, generators, and PDUs to the branch level), cooling system, fire protection & Building Management system.
  • Possess facility management and/or data centre related certifications, such as CDCP, CDCS or equivalent
  • Effective communication skills with the ability to successfully interact with both internal and external customers
  • Strong project management, trouble-shooting and organizational skills.
  • Experience in telecommunications / digital infrastructure sectors, especially on the process side, is beneficial
  • A team player willing to be hands-on in a dynamic and fast paced environment

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Associate Director, Service Delivery
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Service Delivery

Service Delivery encompasses the end-to-end deliverables specified in the Service Contract provided by Singtel Group (or its subsidiaries). This includes service governance, client engagement with customers, and managing the expectations and outcomes for both external and internal senior stakeholders. Service Delivery also focuses on account growth and ensuring an excellent customer engagement experience.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is responsible for managing multiple account delivery teams in alignment with Singtel's commitments to various service contracts.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is also expected to develop strategic and tactical plans to ensure delivery meets contractual obligations to customers. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to): -

  • Driving service delivery to meet and exceed contractual SLA commitments.
  • Sponsoring delivery teams in implementing digitalization initiatives to enhance efficiency and improve the service engagement experience.
  • Managing senior stakeholders (e.g. CxOs, VPs, and IT Heads) through effective communication and portfolio management during major incidents.
  • Building and strengthening client relationships through in-depth knowledge of customer domains.
  • Identifying opportunities and supporting the Sales Team in pursuing new business prospects to grow the EWO portfolio.

Operations

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to lead both the Service and Technical delivery team in day-to-day operations matters, and ensure services are delivered with pride and sustainable model to meet our SLA deliverables. Operation delivery includes leading team on delivery excellence, and drive towards continuous service improvements, and to enhance the service values to the customer.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is also expected to engage and manage 3rd party partners and vendors, to align their delivery competency and capabilities with Singtel service contract to our customers.

Financial Management

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to manage the financials for the service portfolios under the purview, in accordance with the Business Case of the service contracts on Cost of Delivery, recovery of cost in respective cost centre in a healthy state.

Financial management responsibilities include but not limited to: -

  • Annual AOP budgeting, financial planning across the portfolio.
  • Manpower and resourcing budgeting
  • Operation run rate and forward planning
  • Monthly financial status tracking and progressive report
  • Operations and Financial optimization

People and Growth

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to coach and mentor Service Delivery Managers, and delivery teams, whether under direct or indirect management (e.g., third-party partners or contractors). This includes providing thought leadership and demonstrating strong people management skills for the various teams within the service portfolios.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is responsible for developing a Portfolio Strategy and Tactical Performance Measurement for the teams under their supervision. They should adopt a top-down approach to KPI setting for the delivery teams within the portfolio.

Additionally, the Associate Director, Service Delivery should conduct routine communication sessions with members of the delivery teams and their direct reports to provide directives and guidance. This includes holding weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual meetings, as well as one-on-one sessions and performance assessments, as required.

Corporate Engagement

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support Global Delivery 5 key initiatives within their portfolio: -

  • Customer First,
  • Quality First,
  • People First,
  • Digital First,
  • Security First,

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support any other Singtel and/or SEB corporate program and events, as required.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support and promote collaboration within the delivery teams, Singtel and/or SEB organization.

Skills for Success:

  • ITIL Foundation
  • Min 8-10 years working in enterprise scale IT environment or 15 years in senior delivery role managing in Cross Domains (multiple technical domains) enterprise environment

Proficient in:

  • Service Delivery Management
  • Project Management
  • ITIL Foundation
  • Proficient in at least 2 or more technical workstreams (Network, System, DB, Storage, Hosting, Cloud, Workplace services, Telco services)
  • Executive Stakeholders Management
  • People management
  • Presentation skills
  • Project P&L & Portfolio Financial Management
  • Coaching / Mentorship skillsets

Adelaide, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it's easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is passionate about getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers. It's not about surface-level change. It's about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.**

The Specialist Care Community supports customers experiencing complex or heightened vulnerability. The team manages sensitive cases referred by internal teams and external authorities across voice and messaging channels, providing timely, professional and compassionate support.

Customers may be experiencing domestic and family violence, homelessness, incarceration, financial hardship, disability or other forms of vulnerability. In some cases, customers may be experiencing more than one vulnerability at the same time.

As a Specialist Care Consultant, you will coordinate sensitive and complex customer cases from start to finish. You will work closely with experts, team leaders and internal and external stakeholders to investigate concerns, negotiate appropriate outcomes and improve the way we support vulnerable customers.

This role is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference while developing specialist skills in case management, investigation, negotiation, risk identification and stakeholder engagement.

This role operates within a 24-hour, 7-day specialist support environment. Successful applicants will participate in a rotating roster that includes day, evening, overnight, weekend and public holiday shifts.

An example of shifts are; 7:30am – 3:30pm , 10:00am – 6:00pm & 11:30pm – 7:30am. Please note this role has hybrid working options after 6 months.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage complex customer cases involving technical support, account and billing queries.
  • Investigate complaints, identify risks and coordinate cases through to resolution.
  • Partner with internal teams and external stakeholders, including the Telecommunications Industry Ombudsman (TIO), NBN Co, financial counsellors, Public Trustee offices and other support agencies.
  • Negotiate tailored resolutions that balance customer, regulatory and business needs.
  • Identify trends and share insights to improve team capability and customer outcomes.
  • Support customers experiencing distress by following established de-escalation, safety and escalation procedures.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated empathy, emotional resilience and the ability to maintain professional boundaries while supporting customers experiencing distress or crisis.
  • Strong experience managing complex customer enquiries, complaints, and escalations for vulnerable customers, with effective liaison and stakeholder management across regulatory bodies
  • Strong investigation, negotiation, influencing and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities within a 24/7 rotating roster.
  • A collaborative approach and strong stakeholder relationship skills.
  • Confidence following established safety and escalation procedures when supporting customers in crisis.

The good stuff …

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U’s industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.

We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170. We’re here to help. When you contact us, please advise your preferred method of contact and we will be in touch within 48 hours. For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity).

job.title: Associate, Commerce Configuration & Operations
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Manage end-to-end commerce configuration execution across digital web and app journeys, covering plans, promotions, pricing reflections, campaign changes and related customer-facing setup.
  • Drive readiness for weekly changes, launches and BAU requests through accurate setup, disciplined validation and first-time-right execution.
  • Govern configuration quality and consistency by applying structured validation, issue resolution and adherence to agreed operating processes.
  • Support migration and transformation readiness by managing legacy clean-up, new configuration setup and end-to-end checks across plan, promo, price and content reflections.
  • Produce and maintain configuration documentation, knowledge materials and execution guidelines to reduce key-person dependency and improve delivery scalability.
  • Provide enablement and knowledge transfer to PM, PO, configuration and UAT stakeholders to improve understanding of setup logic, dependencies and operational requirements.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Information Technology or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in digital configuration, commerce operations, campaign setup or related digital delivery roles. Telecom or digital commerce experience is preferred.
  • Strong working knowledge of digital configuration across promotions, pricing, campaign setup, validation and deployment support in multi-system environments.
  • Strong coordination, documentation, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive structured execution across multiple teams.
  • Good understanding of customer-facing digital journeys, configuration governance, operational readiness and end-to-end reflection checks.

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Insurance Product Marketing Manager
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Be a Part of Something BIG!

The Insurance Product Marketing Manager is responsible for planning and implementing marketing activities to drive digital sales for general insurance.

The Manager should possess a strategic mindset, ability to build partnership and collaborate with the wider businesses across Singtel. The Manager should also be highly analytical, data driven and detail-oriented to manage end-to-end product marketing campaigns to drive business growth. The Manager is a highly motivated individual who works independently in a fast-paced and hands-on environment.

Make an Impact by

  • Tasked to achieve growth in business sales through business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-customer (B2C) initiatives.
  • Manage budget and develop projection/forecast to drive the yearly target.
  • Lead and strategies go-to-market plan to achieving yearly financial targets.
  • Responsible for building brand and product awareness through above-the-line marketing by advertising through digital and out-of-home channels. For below-the-line marketing, leverage on internal stakeholders’ communication to reach out to relevant segment of audience.
  • Work closely with marketing communication and customer lifecycle management teams to develop comprehensive marketing plans to execute campaigns to achieve sales objectives.
  • Monitor and review campaign performance via Google Analytics and Tableau and gather data insights from Business Analytics team.
  • Use of Adobe Experience Manager to setup marketing pages and to create a smooth customer journey to drive sales conversion.
  • Work closely with legal team to develop agreements for partnerships and terms for campaigns.
  • Work closely with product and UX/UI team to improve the customer journey for assigned product in driving business goals.
  • Manage and train tele-agent to acquire new customers and retain existing customers by driving renewal sales.
  • Work closely with Operation team to handle customers’ enquiries
  • Prepare weekly reports to analyse business results with senior management.

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Marketing, Business, or its equivalent.
  • At least 4-5 years of product marketing, preferably in the insurance industry.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite (eg. excel, word and powerpoint)
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Has a positive attitude and eagerness to learn

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Internal mobility opportunities

**

job.title: Senior Delivery Architect (ICT)
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Delivery Architect to lead the design and delivery of complex network solutions for enterprise customers.

This role combines deep technical expertise, customer-facing skills, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure successful solution design, implementation, and operational readiness.

The Senior Delivery Architect will also play a key role in strategic design governance and internal capability building.

**

Customer Engagement & Communication

  • Work closely with customer architects to understand requirements and design tailored WAN/LAN and security solutions.
  • Attend weekly customer meetings to track progress and ensure design implementation aligns with expectations and timelines.
  • Deliver compelling presentations to customers and internal management, effectively communicating design decisions, risks, and recommendations.

Solution Design & Delivery

  • Develop detailed network designs (WAN, LAN, routing, security) and oversee implementation.
  • Drive end-to-end delivery, from architecture through deployment and testing.
  • Ensure seamless handover of designs by acting as a Technical Delivery SME (Day 1) and ensuring readiness with the Technical Operations SME (Day 2).
  • Participate in the Design Council (internal and external) to review architecture, assess feasibility, and validate solutions through testing.

Internal Collaboration & Governance

  • Support RFPs and pre-sales efforts, ensuring ESP’s capabilities address both Day 1 (setup) and Day 2 (operations).
  • Collaborate with delivery and operations teams to address design challenges and align on best practices.
  • Contribute to reusable frameworks, playbooks, and processes to improve consistency and scalability.

Operational Excellence & Escalation Support

  • Ensure solutions are robust, secure, and scalable, meeting customer performance and availability requirements.
  • Provide insights on Day 1 → Day 2 processes, ensuring smooth transitions into operational support.
  • Lead or contribute to design validation, performance testing, and risk mitigation planning.
  • Be prepared to attend weekly calls outside of business hours when required to support global or regional customers.
  • Provide on-call support during weekends or public holidays for critical escalations or coverage, ensuring minimal customer impact.
  • Participate in RCA/RFO and to be presented to customer and internal management team.

**

Skills for Success:

  • Proven experience in network design and delivery, with strong expertise in WAN, LAN, routing, and security Cloud and Automation.
  • Strong understanding of network security,cloud,automation principles, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage large-scale, complex network design deployments and operations.
  • Exceptional presentation skills for both customer engagements and internal management discussions.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills across multiple teams and organizations.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience with Day 1 delivery and Day 2 operations processes is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on solution feasibility and long-term supportability.
  • Flexibility to work during non-standard hours, weekends, or public holidays when business-critical escalations require support.

job.title: Senior Technical Specialist
job.description:
• Work Pattern: either Rotating shift roster, including morning, afternoon and night OR Monday to Friday, 9am - 5pm

Ready to reimagine your career at Optus?

  • Rapidly resolve complex network faults beyond the Managed Service’s scope and manage critical incident escalations to minimise customer impact.
  • Lead root cause analysis, implement permanent corrective actions, and participate in change governance including representation at Change Advisory Board meetings.
  • Recommend and approve network design changes to improve service reliability and support the introduction of new technologies and products.
  • Ensure planned network upgrades and deployments are aligned with quality and performance standards, and contribute to network expansion strategies.
  • Work closely with Engineering, Vendors, and Managed Service Suppliers to align operational processes and architecture standards, ensuring technical supportability.
  • Provide regular technical insights into KPIs and SLAs, identify performance gaps, and support resolution efforts through stakeholder collaboration.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives through automation of incident management and alarm handling, while contributing to the evolution of operational tools and strategies.

It starts with you!

  • Extensive hands-on expertise in maintaining and troubleshooting multi-vendor (Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, Fortinet, Checkpoint, …) IP and security networks in a Tier 2 or Tier 3 environment.
  • Strong understanding of service provider network design, routing and switching, and security practices.
  • Experience with network automation tools such as Python and Ansible is desirable.

IP Operations:

  • Strong understanding of DDoS protection, detection, and mitigation strategies.
  • High proficiency in IP/MPLS technologies, including BGP, OSPF, IS-IS, and Segment Routing.
  • Demonstrated capability in maintaining and troubleshooting large-scale IP/MPLS networks within service provider environments.
  • Cisco CCNP SP and above, and/or equivalent vendor certifications (Juniper, Nokia, etc.) are desirable.

The good stuff…

  • Supportive team and office environment, with vibrant campus life, variety of facilities including restaurants, cafes, gymnasium, GP, and post office.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon, or paid secure parking facilities available!

job.title: Snr Project Mgr, Proj(TS) Ldrship
job.description:
Overview

The Infrastructure Project Manager who will be responsible for the managing and implementing of Infrastructure-based projects with quality, within scope and to ensure deliverables are on time and conform to processes and standards meeting customer’s requirements. The incumbent is also responsible for projects resource scheduling, tracking, risk management and quality assurance.

What will you do?

Project & Service Management

  • Lead, deliver and maintain projects within time, scope and cost
  • Ensure project delivery quality
  • Plan & establish project schedules, quality plans, budgets, and communication and risk management plans
  • Manage issues arising out of scope definition and disputes that impacted scope, schedule and cost
  • Manage issues arising from integration of various components of the project, e.g. hardware, software installation, testing, business process review, redesign, application development, migration and data conversion etc
  • Manage project financials, ensuring project cost/ revenue forecast is done accurately
  • Oversee the implementation of the project with regard to schedules, budget, manpower and quality
  • Resolve project overrun issues
  • Track project progress and report to Senior Management and Customer
  • Manage resources in terms of mobilising resources during different periods of time from team to team to maximise productivity or minimise wastage
  • Lead the project and service team on smooth project transition to operation in accordance to customer requirement and processes.
  • Manage project operation and ensure service level is maintained without financial penalty and security incident due to negligent or lack of awareness
  • Leverage Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other Microsoft 365 tools to analyze project performance metrics, resource utilization, and financial data.
  • Develop interactive dashboards and visual reports to track project progress, risks, and KPIs for internal and customer reporting.
  • Use data-driven insights to support forecasting, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Utilize Kanban-style tools such as Trello, Microsoft Planner, or Project for the Web to visualize project workflows, manage task assignments, and monitor progress in real time.
  • Implement agile project tracking methods to improve transparency, accountability, and responsiveness across project phases.
  • Integrate Slack or Microsoft Teams for streamlined communication, status updates, and collaboration among cross-functional teams.

Customer/Vendor/ Stakeholder Management

  • Manage contracts and subcontractors
  • Effectively engaged stakeholders in project decisions and execution
  • Build long-term customer relationships by anticipating and exceeding customer’s expectation
  • Negotiate with customers on change control mechanism to meet schedules and prioritize changes based on business needs
  • Strong customer-service orientation
  • Present project data and trends using Microsoft PowerPoint and Power BI to facilitate stakeholder engagement and decision-making.
  • Translate complex data into clear visual narratives to support change management and prioritization discussions.

Team Management

  • Work cohesively, lead, guide, manage and motivate the projects’ team members in delivering quality project works, eliminating project exceptions and delighting the customers
  • Plan for optimal use of resources across teams comprising of Project and Technical competencies
  • Manage performance review of team and maintain open communication with team for feedback on continuous improvement
  • Ensure high individual and staff billability
  • Promote the use of collaborative platforms (e.g., Trello, Microsoft Planner, Slack) to enhance team coordination, task ownership, and productivity.
  • Facilitate daily stand-ups or sprint reviews using Kanban boards to ensure alignment and timely issue resolution.

The ideal candidate should possess:

1.Technical Competency – WAN Migration Experience

  • Demonstrated experience in managing WAN migration activities.
  • Ability to coordinate with Internet Service Providers for timely WAN deployment.
  • Strong project tracking skills to ensure milestones and timelines are met.

2. Experience in Tech Refresh Environments

  • Proven capability in handling system setup in collaboration with customer counterparts.
  • Experience in planning and executing migration from legacy to new systems.
  • Ability to integrate new systems into existing infrastructures (e.g. GovTech DC/GCC/GDC/Axisnet) seamlessly.

3. Domain Knowledge and Process Awareness

  • While in-depth knowledge of GovTech practices is not mandatory, familiarity with relevant processes is advantageous.

This includes:

Submission of documentation (e.g., SRs, rack mount plans, cabling plans).

Coordination of TAF sessions for obtaining stakeholder approvals.

Understanding of system integration requirements related to operations (e.g., management tools, alerting systems, backup solutions), which requires coordination with existing operational teams

4. Professional Attributes

  • The Project Manager must demonstrate a high level of professionalism, humility, and patience.
  • Must be able to effectively engage with stakeholders, listen actively to concerns, and facilitate collaborative, win-win outcomes across all parties—including the customer, internal teams, and external vendors.

5. Data Analysis & Visualization Competency

  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel (advanced functions, pivot tables, charts) for data manipulation and reporting.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Power BI for building dashboards, visualizing trends, and generating actionable insights.
  • Ability to interpret data to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities that inform project strategy and execution.

6. Agile & Kanban Project Tracking

  • Proficient in using Trello, Microsoft Planner, or Project for the Web to manage tasks, visualize workflows, and track deliverables.
  • Familiarity with Slack or Microsoft Teams for real-time communication and integration with project tracking tools.
  • Ability to adapt Kanban principles to infrastructure project environments for improved efficiency and stakeholder visibility.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

job.title: Associate Specialist, Sourcing – DC Ops
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Associate Specialist, Sourcing – DC Ops is responsible for supporting procurement and sourcing activities related to client fit-out projects within the Finance Transformation and Procurement business unit. This role ensures cost-effective purchasing, compliance with company standards, and timely delivery of materials and services required for the Operations Team.

What we are looking for

  • ### KEY responsibilities
  • ### Assist in sourcing and procurement for client fit-out projects, including vendor identification, RFQs, and bid analysis.
  • ### Maintain accurate records of purchase orders, contracts, and supplier agreements.
  • ### Collaborate with internal teams (project managers, finance, operations) to align sourcing strategies with project timelines and budgets.
  • ### Monitor supplier performance and resolve issues related to delivery, quality, or compliance.
  • ### Support cost optimization initiatives and contribute to continuous improvement in procurement processes.
  • ### Ensure adherence to company policies, legal requirements, and sustainability standards.
  • ### KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES
  • ### Strong understanding of procurement principles and sourcing strategies.
  • ### Familiarity with construction or fit-out materials and vendor landscape.
  • ### Proficiency in MS Excel and procurement tools (e.g., SAP Ariba or similar).
  • ### Analytical mindset with attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • ### Good communication and negotiation skills.
  • ### Required: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
  • ### Preferred: Certification in procurement (e.g., CIPS, CPSM).
  • ### REQUIRED EXPERIENCE
  • ### 2–4 years of experience in procurement or sourcing, preferably in construction or client fit-out projects.
  • ### Exposure to vendor management and contract administration.
  • ###

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • ### Regularly moves equipment and other hardware up to 25 lbs.
  • ### Frequently move about inside and outside of data center / facility
  • ### Remain stationary for long periods of time.
  • ### Ascend / Descend a ladder and perform duties atop a raised platform.
  • ### Position self in small spaces.
  • ### Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • ### Perform work during US business hours and time zones.
  • ### Work conditions & other requirements
  • ### Work onsite at a data center location.
  • ### Exposure to varying temperatures and loud noises.
  • ### Exposure to outdoor weather conditions.
  • ### Travel required 10% of time.
  • ### Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.
  • ###

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

###

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Design Engineer - Power Distribution
job.description:
Eaton’s Electrical Engineering Services & Systems Division (EESS) is currently seeking a Design Engineer - Power Distribution. This role can be based remote within the United States.

The Project Operations Team provides comprehensive engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services throughout the entire project lifecycle. Our team specializes in handling both greenfield and brownfield turnkey electrical projects and has expertise in designing and constructing high and medium-voltage substations and developing power distribution solutions for utilities, government, data centers, industrial, and commercial facilities. This position is remote within the United Sates.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $97,000 - $143,000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the engineering and design of medium- and high-voltage power distribution and substation projects, delivering safe, reliable, and innovative solutions for our customers.
  • Ability to independently develop complete engineering packages including single/three lines, AC/DC schematics and wiring, cable/conduit plans, equipment layout plans, etc for turnkey projects.
  • Coordinate electrical and civil design packages to ensure quality, constructability, and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Develop complete engineering packages, coordinating electrical and civil design activities to ensure quality, constructability, and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Drive project success by managing design deliverables, schedules, budgets, and technical accuracy in partnership with project managers, field teams, and customers.
  • Apply value-driven engineering practices to optimize designs, improve efficiency, and deliver cost-effective solutions without compromising quality or performance.
  • Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to develop technical solutions that address evolving power system needs.
  • Participate in site assessments and field walkdowns to evaluate existing infrastructure and support the development of engineering proposals and project scopes.
  • Prepare engineering estimates, review technical documentation, and support project planning activities.
  • Mentor and collaborate with fellow engineers and designers, sharing technical expertise and contributing to a culture of continuous learning and professional growth.
  • Support projects across the United States through occasional travel (approximately 10%) for customer meetings, site visits, and project support activities.

Qualifications

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of a BS in electrical or mechanical engineering from an accredited institution
  • Minimum of seven (7) years electrical engineering or electrical design experience
  • Experience in medium voltage power distribution or substation design
  • Must be able to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now and within the future. Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Professional Engineer qualification
  • Field experience in testing/commissioning medium voltage equipment
  • Working knowledge of NERC/FERC, NESC, NEC, ANSI, NETA
  • Experience with AutoCAD and/or MicroStation

job.description:
Job Description

Brief Job Description:

The Field Service Engineer:

  • Provide consistent quality and support to customers across the region.

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

  • Assist Delivery of project site works on data center operational equipment's - Installation, commission, test and handover to client over multiple projects.
  • Assist in the completion of preventative maintenance tasks for all aspects of  Electrical Panel/UPS/Chiller/PAC/PAHU etc panels.

job.title: Manager Purchasing
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

  • The job entails developing and implementing purchasing strategies, managing supplier relationships, negotiating contracts, and ensuring the timely delivery of goods and services while optimizing costs.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and implement procurement strategies to support the operations of the company.
  • Manage and lead a team of buyers and other purchasing staff, providing guidance on procurement processes, supplier management, and contract negotiation.
  • Evaluate supplier performance, negotiate contracts, and ensure compliance with quality and safety standards.
  • Monitor inventory levels and adjust orders as needed to meet demand.
  • Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely delivery of goods and services.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve the procurement process to increase efficiency and reduce costs.
  • Analyze market trends and identify opportunities for cost savings and process improvements.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and implement procurement best practices.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, including negotiating favorable terms and resolving any issues that may arise.
  • Proven experience in strategic procurement and supplier relationship management.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and purchasing software.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Knowledge of procurement regulations, policies, and procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, business administration, or a related field.
  • Master degree desirable
  • 8-10 years of experience in procurement, with at least 4 years in a leadership role.
  • Good English communications skills – written & verbal.
  • Strong project-management skills.
  • Computer skills – proficiency in Microsoft-Office suite

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • The role is primarily based in a manufacturing facility, requiring regular site visits and interaction with production teams.
  • Required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) and adhere to safety protocols.
  • The role involves extended periods of sitting in front of a computer.
  • Occasional standing or walking may be required during meetings, presentations, or site visits
  • Work is primarily conducted in an office environment with controlled temperature and lighting.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • Travel to different office or plants locations, client sites, or conferences may be necessary.

job.title: Manufacturing Quality Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Incoming Material Inspection

  • Perform incoming inspection as per Inspection Plans, Drawings, Specifications, and SOPs.
  • Verify dimensional, visual, functional, and documentation requirements of incoming materials.
  • Conduct sampling inspection as per approved sampling plans.
  • Ensure proper identification, traceability, and segregation of non-conforming materials.

Supplier Quality Coordination

  • Coordinate with Supplier Quality and suppliers for incoming quality issues.
  • Raise supplier defect reports and track corrective actions.
  • Support supplier performance monitoring and improvement activities.
  • Participate in supplier visits, audits, and technical discussions when required.

Non-Conformance Management

  • Identify and document incoming defects through NCR/PDIR systems.
  • Implement containment actions to prevent defective material usage.
  • Support root cause analysis and verification of corrective actions.
  • Ensure timely disposition of rejected and blocked stock materials.

Quality Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain inspection reports, quality records, and traceability documents.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, QMS requirements, and inspection procedures.
  • Support internal, customer, and certification audits.
  • Maintain calibration status of inspection and measuring equipment.

Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze incoming rejection trends and supplier PPM performance.
  • Drive initiatives to reduce incoming defects, line stoppages, and blocked stock.
  • Support digitalization and process improvement projects in Incoming Quality.
  • Participate in Kaizen, Lean, and quality improvement activities.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Work closely with Sourcing, Supplier Quality, Engineering, Production, and Stores teams.
  • Support MRB activities and material disposition decisions.
  • Participate in daily quality review meetings and escalation management.

Qualifications

  • Diploma/Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Production, or Industrial Engineering.
  • 1-3 years of experience in Incoming Quality, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or Quality Assurance.

Required Skills

  • Incoming Inspection Techniques
  • Drawing Reading & GD&T
  • Measurement Equipment Handling
  • Root Cause Analysis (5 Why, Fishbone)
  • 7 QC Tools
  • SAP/ERP Knowledge
  • Quality Documentation & Reporting
  • Supplier Defect Management
  • PFMEA and Control Plan Understanding

Preferred Commodity Experience

  • Sheet Metal Parts
  • Fabricated Components
  • Machined Parts
  • Copper Bus Bars
  • Electrical Components (MCB, MCCB, Relays, Contactors, ATS)
  • Wiring Harnesses
  • Plastic and Rubber Components
  • Packaging Materials

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Incoming PPM Reduction
  • Supplier Defect Closure Effectiveness
  • Incoming Inspection On-Time Completion
  • Blocked Stock Reduction
  • Line Rejection Reduction
  • Supplier Corrective Action Closure Time
  • Audit Compliance Score

Competencies

  • Attention to Detail
  • Problem Solving
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Team Collaboration
  • Communication Skills
  • Ownership & Accountability
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

job.title: Customer Engineer - Power, NSW
job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary/Objectives of Incumbent:

The purpose of this position is to carry out service of equipment, after hours service, commissioning and service contracts as planned and directed by the Service Operations Manager and Service Supervisor – Power.

Key Responsibilities

_Planning & Reporting:_

  • Ensure that service reports, expense claims and any other reports required by Management are completed and submitted by the due date.
  • Time Sheets must be filled out correctly (ie, accurately record of hours worked, and all call out and response times) and submitted to the Operations Manager or Service Supervisor – Power by the due date each week.  A Doctor’s Certificate must be supplied for any more than two days absence from work due to illness/injury.
  • Field Service Reports are to be completed for every service call made.  These reports MUST also be signed by the customer whether the work is chargeable or not.  All items used on a job, whether Liebert spares or consumables must be detailed on the FSR.

_Operational Delivery:_

  • Carry out commissioning, service contract maintenance and after-hours service commitments in a professional, efficient manner, and achieve a high level of service to our clients within the restraints of time, expense and profitability.
  • Maintain proper levels of relationships between the Company and our customers, by ensuring all complaints are reported promptly so that remedial action can be taken.
  • Ensure that a level of competence is maintained to adequately handle the degree of technology required by application to training available and personal updating.
  • At all times ensure that your Company vehicle, personal dress and appearance are presentable within the restraints of the work to be carried out, the Company policy is well understood and that Company business is carried out in an efficient and professional manner.
  • Spare Parts Van stock requisitions must be filled out when stock is required to maintain accurate records of stock in service vans and store.

_Continuous Improvement:_

  • To be aware at all times of both Sales & Service opportunities for the Company, and to report any such opportunities to Management.
  • To ensure that the Sales Department is made aware of all new sales opportunities and prospects, and to work closely with them in achieving this business.

_WHS, Environment & Quality:_

  • Comply with all Work, Health & Safety, Environment and Quality obligations
  • Actively promote safety in the workplace

_Daily work duties and expectations_

  • Driver's License is required (may involve visit to remote sites)
  • Overnight or longer trips may be required.
  • Unaccompanied (Lone worker)
  • After-hours work and being on an On-Call Roster are needed.
  • Attending customer Service calls.
  • Occasional use of ladders
  • Working in tight and restricted locations.
  • Working on and around Energized Electrical equipment.

Main contacts within Company

Specialist Knowledge:

  • Technical knowledge in data centres, telecom, commercial & industrial or similar industries

Practical Experience:

  • Proven track record within the power industry as a service technician

  • Learning agility

job.title: Associate Engineer Fluid Dynamics Engineering VIII
job.description:
Job Description

To perform CFD Analysis for system and component levels using Different Software’s Such as RealityDC & Celcius EC / Ansys Fluent / Ansys Icepak / Ansys Optislang / Ansys CFX. Engineer needs to prepare analysis model, Conduct model checks and/or creating parametric models with available CAD packages and perform the sensitivity analysis. He / She should be able to generate the CFD mesh/model and run steady/ transient flow/thermal analysis using different software’s and analyze the results as well as prepare the reports clearly. Utilize the analytical skill set and simulation tools to analyze the fluid flow systems and recommendations for design improvements. It is added advantage if He/ She is having fan operation and performance curve as well as flow bench / Wind tunnel operation

  • ME/M.Tech with specialization in Thermal Engineering/ Aerospace / Mechanical from a reputed Institute.
  • Undergone on Fluid Mechanics/CFD/ Heat Transfer / Thermodynamics during masters
  • Minimum 6 years of analysis experience in any CFD Analysis software.
  • Experience in Cadence software / Ansys Icepack / Ansys Sherlock / Ansys Multiphase / Ansys Aeroacoustics is added advantage.
  • Comfortable in working with Creo/Pro-E for model checking.
  • Should be able to Interpret analysis results for base design and suggest modification
  • Sound knowledge of fundamentals of Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics & Thermodynamics
  • Knowledge of telecommunication products like cabinets, enclosures, Datacenter, Refrigeration Cycle etc.  & Sheet metal will be added advantage

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

The primary responsibility of this role is to lead the squads to meet their goals :

  • for customer satisfaction through a robust customer feedback loop
  • quality
  • time to market
  • development costs
  • product costs

but as well to support the Product Owner and the squad members in the Agile transition to common alignment, self-organization, fostering communication, encouraging adaptation and flexibility to changes.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

What she/he will do:

  • Guide the Squads focusing on creating high value releases, along with being a Scrum Master for the respective squad
  • Partner with Product Owner to ensure strategy and execution alignment
  • Be the key facilitator and primarily responsible for facilitation of Squads events
  • Drive continuous improvement by coaching Squad members in Agile methodologies to maximize efficiency and self-improvement, and drive change management.
  • Manage inter-dependencies between squads, identify risks and opportunities for execution and business success.
  • Identify, escalate, and help find resolutions to Squads impediments
  • master Agile processes and fine tune them to Squad needs (e.g., mixing Scrum & Kanban to manage maintenance & development) while providing tools and methodologies to accelerate Squad delivery
  • Lead animation of a multidiscipline cross functional squad -- Design & Engineering, Industrialization, Purchasing, Quality, Manufacturing plants, Launch.

But also :

  • Follow-up the budget of the Squads
  • Collaborate to the agile transformation of the squad

QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor’s degree

  • 8+ years of work experience
  • 3 years of product or project development experience would be advantageous
  • Strong facilitation techniques
  • Ability to build and lead Squads in a matrix
  • Promotes Agile values and principles
  • Outstanding communication, facilitation, negotiation, and coaching skills
  • Knowledge of an Agile Framework (i.e. Scrum, Kanban)
  • Planning and problem solving with product management and delivery Squads
  • Strong organization, communication, and interpersonal skills. Able to communicate priorities. Interaction with senior leadership.
  • Experience in one or more of the cross functional disciplines for New product development lifecycle (Design, Test , Quality, Industrialization etc.)

job.title: Sr. Procurement Category Manager, Data Center Sourcing and Procurement (DCSP)
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Infrastructure team provides AWS and Amazon.com with the compute, network and datacenter capacity that are the foundations of the retail and cloud business. We are seeking a Procurement professional to support the APAC data center procurement space in India.

As a Sr. Procurement Category Manager, you will create and implement sourcing strategies for the complex construction procurement and related categories and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to reduce risks and costs for Amazon. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery. Additionally, you will drive results through methods that include competitive bidding, negotiating, and analyzing data and market trends for your category. You will also create global Procurement processes and tools to drive innovation across teams.

Key job responsibilities Manage General Contractor and Construction Procurement category Strategy and Delivery for India

Construction material supply chain sourcing and program management

Achieve cost savings through negotiations, value engineering through the supply chain, and strategic initiatives

Analyze category data and metrics to establish and implement procurement category strategies

Understand trends in customers’ needs and concerns across categories and regions to influence customers’ priorities

Provide in-depth knowledge about the supply market and supplier capabilities, technically and geographically, to the business.

Develop mechanisms and metrics to track supplier performance related to delivery, quality, and cost

Create supplier scorecards to measure and track supplier performance

Lead business reviews to discuss best practices and issues and to ultimately improve supplier performance and strengthen business partnerships

Innovate within the procurement space, automating and/or improving tools or processes to better support the Procurement Lifecycle

Provide support throughout the contracting process, as well as management of contracts post-execution

Some travel may be required, up to 25%.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of program, project or product management, or leading product implementation experience
  • 6+ years of related industry experience
  • 8+ years of data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of high volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent
  • Experience in high-volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments
  • Experience with Continuous Improvement and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Experience in global supply chain management, managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company
  • Experience in program, project or product management, or leading product implementation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
  • Experience in negotiations with global suppliers with a proven track record in cost reduction
  • Experience in procurement practices working with engineering, supply chain and Tier 1 OEM partners
  • Experience practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, or equivalent)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: SDE2 - Just Walk Out , Just Walk Out
job.description:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

At Amazon, we hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers. The focus we have on our customers is why we are one of the world’s most beloved brands – customer obsession is part of our company DNA. Our Software Development Engineers (SDEs) use latest technology to solve complex problems and get to see the impact of their work first-hand. The challenges SDEs solve for at Amazon are big and influence millions of customers, sellers, and products around the world. We are looking for individuals who are passionate about creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity and the pace of a company where development cycles are measured in weeks, not years. If this sounds interesting to you, apply and come chart your own path at Amazon. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. For an update on your status, or to confirm your application was submitted successfully, please login to your candidate portal. NOTE: Amazon works with a high volume of applicants, so we appreciate your patience as we review applications

Key job responsibilities

  • Collaborate with experienced cross-disciplinary Amazonians to conceive, design, and bring innovative products and services to market.
  • Design and build innovative technologies in a large distributed computing environment and help lead fundamental changes in the industry.
  • Create solutions to run predictions on distributed systems with exposure to innovative technologies at incredible scale and speed.
  • Build distributed storage, index, and query systems that are scalable, fault-tolerant, low cost, and easy to manage/use.
  • Design and code the right solutions starting with broadly defined problems.
  • Work in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  • Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

job.title: Head of Marketing, India, AWS , Field Marketing-APJ
job.description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a senior marketing leader to define and execute the marketing strategy for India — one of the fastest-growing and most strategically important markets in the Asia Pacific region. This is a player/coach role: you will set the long-term marketing direction for India while staying deeply connected to execution across demand generation, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), events, digital marketing, and public relations.

As the Head of Marketing for India, you will be the single-threaded owner of marketing strategy, planning, and campaign execution targeting startups, developers, digital natives, SMBs, enterprises, and public sector customers across India. You will lead and develop a high-performing regional marketing team, drive orchestration across global marketing functions — including the Integrated Demand Centre (IDC), digital marketing, and events (Flagship and Cohort) — and deliver locally resonant programs that accelerate customer acquisition, pipeline growth, and brand awareness.

You will partner closely with the India sales leadership team, cross-functional marketing leaders across Asia Pacific & Japan (APJ), and global corporate teams to ensure marketing programs are tightly aligned to business priorities and deliver measurable impact.

The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with executional rigor, has a proven track record of building and scaling marketing functions in India's technology landscape, and brings a genuine passion for cloud technology and an entrepreneurial mindset.

Key job responsibilities

  • Create compelling, results-driven marketing plans, complete with market assessments that deliver identified objectives to the business
  • Overseeing implementation of the Marketing strategy for India - including campaigns, events, digital marketing, and PR.
  • Lead overall implementation of marketing programs including lead generation activities,

eMarketing campaigns, product & solutions sales support, reference programs, customer & developer marketing programs, etc.

  • Organize, assist and implement marketing events, including the AWS Summits, exhibitions, seminars, tradeshows and product launches.
  • Day to day management and development of the marketing team.
  • Work closely with the company’s Sales team; enabling them to meet their commercial objectives by providing them with appropriate tools, materials and presentations.
  • Develop and execute customer-driven, locally oriented marketing strategies and programs that will increase customer demand, sales, and positively impact Amazon Web Services brand equity.

A day in the life The Head of Marketing for India will be responsible for building and executing marketing plans that deliver customer acquisition and retention programs necessary to power AWS's continued growth in India. The role's core responsibility is to use a combination of strong strategic planning and hands-on execution skills to successfully plan, develop, execute, and measure demand generation programs that deliver marketing contribution to the sales pipeline. You will operate at the intersection of strategy and action — setting the quarterly roadmap in the morning, reviewing campaign performance data over lunch, and joining a customer event debrief in the afternoon. No two days look the same, and that's what makes this role exciting.

Basic Qualifications

  • 15+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
  • Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
  • Experience managing and developing marketing teams
  • Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements and measure marketing effectiveness

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working cross-functionally with partner teams to drive adoption and usage of brand assets and messaging
  • Experience in strategic marketing management and market analysis and demonstrated ability to build and execute a strategy with clear goals and objectives to align to business and service objectives, and support portfolio objectives
  • Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
  • Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
  • Experience in B2B technology marketing, cloud computing, or SaaS industries
  • Deep understanding of the India technology and enterprise market landscape
  • Experience in traditional and emerging media channels including digital display, online video, paid social, and event marketing
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred

job.title: Security Solution Architect, APJC Customer Security, APJC Customer Security
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Secure AI Solution Architect to join our APJC Customer Security team in a content-and-frameworks role. Customers across the region are asking the same questions about building securely with AI — how to give autonomous agents an identity, how to defend against prompt injection, how to govern the AI development lifecycle, how to evidence AI governance for a regulator. The approaches that answer these questions are being proved with customers today; what's missing is the layer that turns them into clean, documented, deployable patterns the whole field can use. You build that layer.

Working hands-on, you take validated approaches and turn them into reference implementations that work out of the box. You test them against real customer requirements, then package them into a published library that Solutions Architects across the region draw on. Your work is the difference between a pattern proved once and a pattern the whole region can reuse.

You are technically self-sufficient: you write the code, build the reference implementation, test it, and document it so a Solutions Architect in any area can adopt it without specialist presence. We are looking for a builder who enjoys taking a defined but difficult technical problem and turning it into an elegant, well-documented answer others can build on. Deep AWS experience helps but is not required at entry; we can teach the services. What we need is strong hands-on technical craft, security depth, and the instinct to build things that scale beyond yourself.

Key job responsibilities

  • Take validated Secure AI approaches (agentic-AI identity patterns, AI security frameworks, AI development lifecycle controls, guardrail and governance-evidence patterns) and build them into clean, deployable reference implementations — working code, not slideware.
  • Test each pattern against real customer requirements to confirm it holds, then package it into the published library that the field draws on.
  • Write the code, reference architectures, and documentation to a standard that a Solutions Architect or partner in any APJC area can adopt without specialist presence.
  • Work with the AWS service teams (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) — bringing field requirements and customer data into the product conversation and taking away clarity to turn into guidance.
  • Stay current on the AWS AI and security product set, translating new and upcoming capability into field-ready reference implementations as it lands.
  • Surface customer needs and gaps as feature requests, contributing to the feedback loop that shapes what ships next.

A day in the life You start the morning building out an agentic-identity reference implementation that two areas have asked for. A customer engagement last week surfaced a gap around cross-account tool-use authorisation; you build the fix, test it, and update the library entry so every area gets the improved version.

Mid-morning you join a session with the AgentCore service team. You bring the field data — what APJC customers are hitting on non-human identity — and take away clarity on what can ship as guidance now versus what needs a product change. You'll turn that into an updated reference architecture this week.

After lunch you go heads-down and build — hands on keyboard — turning an AI development lifecycle control you prototyped into a documented reference implementation with code, deployment steps, and a short workshop a field Solutions Architect could run themselves.

You close the day handing the finished pattern to the go-to-market team to fold into the next immersion-day curriculum, publishing the write-up to the field, and briefing the Associate SA on what's ready to be packaged into next week's community event. No two days look the same, but the thread is consistent: you build it once, and the whole region gets to build on it.

About the team

APJC Customer Security helps customers across the region adopt AI on AWS with confidence — ensuring security, risk, and regulation accelerate AI adoption rather than slow it down. We run two coupled programmes: Secure AI (making AWS the best place to build securely with AI) and AI for Security (using AI to help customers defend themselves). As one of two Solution Architects, you build the reusable technical foundation both programmes scale on. You work with the AWS service teams who build the products and the field teams who take guidance to customers. You will have a clear development path, a peer community of specialists, and see your work reused across the entire region.

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
  • Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
  • Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Technical Account Manager, ES – APJC-ASEAN
job.description:
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

As a Technical Account Manager you will provide consultative architectural and operational guidance delivered to help customers achieve the greatest value from AWS.

As we continue to rapidly expand in Singapore, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop your technical, consulting and leadership skills. You’ll work with talented cloud technologists whilst expanding your knowledge of AWS products. You’ll also have the chance to receive mentorship and gain AWS certifications.

Key job responsibilities
