job.title: Associate Security Solution Architect, APJC Customer Security, APJC Customer Security
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an Associate Secure AI Solution Architect to join our APJC Customer Security team. Customers across the region are moving fast on AI and need guidance on building securely. The patterns and frameworks that answer their questions exist — but they don't reach the field at scale without someone who owns the packaging, the events, the community, and the enablement. That's you.

Your primary mandate is the scale engine: the webinars, community events, enablement series, and builder circles that build Secure AI skills across the field, and the packaging of reference patterns into content a Solutions Architect or partner can pick up and use without a specialist in the room. You own this end to end — logistics, scheduling, content readiness, delivery, and follow-up.

Alongside the scale work, you get real keyboard time. You help build and test prototypes and reference implementations in sandbox environments, learning the AWS AI and security services (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) and modern development tooling as you go. You take well-scoped pieces of work through to done with guidance, and grow toward owning harder problems independently over time.

This is a role for someone early in their career who is genuinely excited by security and AI, learns fast, loves helping others succeed, and wants to build a deep technical foundation in one of the most important areas in the industry.

Key job responsibilities

  • Organise and run the channels that build Secure AI skills at scale — webinars, community events, enablement series, and builder circles — owning end-to-end coordination across multiple areas and time zones.
  • Package reference patterns and frameworks into field-ready enablement — briefings, guides, and workshop kits — that a Solutions Architect or partner can pick up and use without a specialist in the room.
  • Grow a community of practice around Secure AI, keeping content current and accessible so skills build consistently across the field and customers.
  • Track reach, engagement, and field adoption of the content and events you run, and share what you learn so the next round is sharper.
  • Get hands-on keyboard time building and testing prototypes and reference implementations in sandbox environments — learning the AWS AI and security services and modern development tooling as you go.
  • Take well-scoped, straightforward pieces of technical work through to done with guidance — learning the Secure AI control patterns (agent identity, prompt-injection defense, AI development lifecycle controls, guardrails, governance evidence) as you contribute to them.
  • Grow your technical depth and judgment over time, building toward owning harder problems independently.

A day in the life You start the morning in a sandbox, helping build out and test part of an agentic-identity reference pattern. You pick up a well-scoped piece — wiring up and validating one of the guardrail configurations — and take it to done, learning how the whole pattern fits together as you go.

Mid-morning you switch to the scale side of the role: you are running a webinar next week that brings a new pattern to the field, so you finalise the run-sheet, line up the presenter, and send the invites across the areas. You also tidy a workshop kit so any field Solutions Architect can deliver the session themselves.

After lunch you turn a reference architecture that was just published into a crisp enablement guide and a short briefing a Solutions Architect can take straight into a customer conversation. You check in with a builder-circle community you help run and clear a couple of small blockers for the organisers.

You close the day looking at how the last community event landed — who joined, what resonated, which content got reused — and share a short read-out with the team. No two days look the same, but the thread is consistent: you are learning to build, and making sure what the team builds reaches everyone

About the team APJC Customer Security helps customers across the region adopt AI on AWS with confidence — ensuring security, risk, and regulation accelerate AI adoption rather than slow it down. We run two coupled programmes: Secure AI (making AWS the best place to build securely with AI) and AI for Security (using AI to help customers defend themselves). As an Associate Secure AI Solution Architect, you own the enablement and community engine that helps the whole programme scale. You will have a clear development path, a peer community to learn from, and the chance to build a deep technical foundation in one of the most important areas in the industry.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++
  • Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
  • Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

job.title: Snr. Civil Design Engineer, Design Engineering
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

You’ll collaborate with a diverse team of people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standard of safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. The Data Center Engineering (DCE) team is looking for a passionate, results-oriented, inventive Civil Engineer to drive design and construction in a client-side technical lead role for the delivery of our enterprise data center campus projects.

As a Civil Engineer, you will work as part of the wider DCE Team collaborating with our Real Estate, Design Services, Construction and other partner teams. You will be responsible for the successful delivery of design delivery ensuring we continue to meet and exceed our industry leading quality and performance requirements.

Utilizing your Civil Engineering expertise, you will assist in assessing site constraints, developing acceleration strategies and supporting overall campus planning, development and construction. This position ultimately plays a pivotal role for the delivery of Data Center projects.

The successful candidate will be strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly with a history of delivering for their customers. The role requires creative engineering balanced with high quality and customer focus. You must be able to work as part of a large and dynamic team, including many internal stakeholders, customers as well as external stakeholders like design consultants, developers and general contractors.

Key job responsibilities

  • Develop and communicate conceptual designs and create/maintain project documentation before, during, and after construction.
  • Develop and maintain design standards, design prototypes, and template specifications related to site design.
  • Review Due Diligence assessments to determine site constraints, risks and develop investigation scopes.
  • Create, review, and release design consultant request for proposals.
  • Manage our external civil design consultants through the design and construction process.
  • Develop and review designs for grading, storm water, flood mitigation, utilities, and pavements.
  • Deep understanding of interdependent civil design elements to develop optimised earthworks and utilities designs and minimise the construction schedule.
  • Lead our internal modelling and documentation resources.
  • Coordinate with internal and external Architecture, Structure and MEP design engineers.
  • Effectively communicate design standards to internal and external project partners.
  • Manage multiple fast paced projects simultaneously.
  • Think outside of the box to find innovative solutions prior to and during the construction process to reduce costs without negative impacts on quality or reliability.
  • Travel for site assessments, internal design meetings, construction review, and interfacing with authorities having jurisdiction. Anticipated travel is approximately 25%.

A day in the life Given Amazon's global presence, 25% travel is required. This includes international travel to inspect and audit current and future data center sites. Collaboration with international teams is essential, and you may need to travel for workshops to develop schematic and detailed design documentation packages.

AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect

India

**Location & work modality: India ( Remote)

About Submer

Submer enables organizations scaling AI to overcome the limits of traditional datacenters across power, compute density and efficiency.

We design and deliver scalable, high-density AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling, supporting everything from early AI deployments to full-scale production environments.**

What Impact you will have

We are looking for AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect

Department: Solutions Engineering / Presales

Position Summary

The AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect is responsible for designing end-to-end AI infrastructure solutions that enable customers to deploy scalable, high-performance AI and HPC environments. The role combines technical presales, solution architecture, infrastructure sizing, and deployment planning to deliver commercially viable and operationally sound AI infrastructure solutions.

The architect serves as the technical authority for compute, networking, storage, AI software stack, and infrastructure integration while working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product Management, OEM partners, and the Facilities Presales & Design teams to ensure that the AI infrastructure requirements are fully aligned with the data center's power, cooling, space, and physical infrastructure capabilities.

This role owns the AI infrastructure architecture and complements the facility design process.

What you will do

Key Responsibilities

  • AI Infrastructure Presales
  • Partner with Sales to qualify AI infrastructure opportunities.
  • Engage with customers to understand AI workloads, performance expectations, scalability requirements, and operational objectives.
  • Conduct technical discovery workshops and architecture discussions.
  • Prepare technical proposals, presentations, and solution demonstrations.
  • Support RFI, RFP, and RFQ responses.
  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor throughout the sales lifecycle.
  • AI Infrastructure Solution Architecture

Design complete AI infrastructure solutions including:

  • GPU compute clusters
  • AI Factory infrastructure
  • HPC platforms
  • High-performance storage
  • AI networking fabrics (Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE)
  • Kubernetes and container platforms
  • AI software stack integration
  • Cluster management
  • Security architecture
  • Monitoring and observability
  • Automation platforms
  • Scalability and expansion planning

Develop:

  • Solution architecture
  • Infrastructure sizing
  • Bill of Materials (BoM)
  • Reference architectures
  • Technical specifications
  • Solution documentation
  • Deployment architecture
  • Infrastructure Integration with Data Center Design

Work closely with Facilities Presales, Design, and Engineering teams to ensure the AI infrastructure solution is fully compatible with the proposed data center environment.

Provide technical inputs related to:

  • Rack power density
  • Rack layouts
  • GPU server deployment
  • Network topology
  • Cable density
  • Space requirements
  • Liquid cooling interfaces
  • CDU connectivity requirements
  • Infrastructure dependencies
  • Expansion strategy

Validate that the AI infrastructure can be successfully deployed within the facility constraints without owning the facility design itself.

  • Solution Validation & Delivery Readiness

Collaborate with Delivery and Engineering teams to ensure solution feasibility.

Support:

  • Technical design reviews
  • OEM interoperability validation
  • Deployment planning
  • Installation readiness
  • Factory acceptance planning
  • Site acceptance planning
  • Commissioning support
  • Technical handover to delivery teams

Maintain ownership of the AI infrastructure solution throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Operational Architecture

Ensure the proposed solution is designed for long-term operational success by considering:

  • Serviceability
  • Scalability
  • High availability
  • Redundancy
  • Cluster management
  • Monitoring
  • Capacity management
  • Firmware lifecycle
  • Upgrade strategy
  • Infrastructure observability
  • Operational support requirements
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Sales
  • Product Management
  • Delivery
  • Professional Services
  • Facilities Presales
  • Facilities Design & Engineering
  • OEM partners
  • System Integrators
  • Customer Infrastructure teams
  • AI Engineering teams

Act as the primary technical interface for all AI infrastructure-related discussions.

Technical Expertise

AI Compute

  • NVIDIA GPU platforms
  • AMD GPU platforms
  • Intel AI platforms
  • GPU cluster design
  • AI Factory architectures
  • HPC infrastructure

Networking

  • Ethernet (100/200/400/800G)
  • InfiniBand
  • RoCE
  • Spine-Leaf architectures
  • AI fabric design

Storage

  • Parallel file systems
  • High-performance NAS
  • Object storage
  • NVMe-over-Fabrics
  • AI data pipelines

Software

  • Kubernetes
  • Docker
  • Slurm
  • NVIDIA AI Enterprise
  • GPU scheduling
  • Cluster management
  • Infrastructure automation

Infrastructure

  • Server platforms
  • Rack integration
  • Infrastructure sizing
  • High-density deployments
  • Liquid-cooled server technologies
  • Infrastructure monitoring
  • DCIM integration

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree is preferred.
  • 8–15 years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, HPC, AI infrastructure, or solution architecture.
  • At least 5 years in a customer-facing Presales or Solutions Architecture role.
  • Experience designing GPU-based AI infrastructure and high-density compute environments is highly desirable.

Preferred Certifications

  • NVIDIA Certified Professional (or equivalent)
  • AWS Solutions Architect
  • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect
  • Red Hat OpenShift
  • VMware VCP
  • Cisco CCNP/CCIE

Core Competencies

Collaboration

  • Stakeholder management

  • OEM engagement
  • Customer relationship management

What we offer

  • A great work environment characterized by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.

job.title: Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)
job.description:
:

Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)

Houston, Texas

Apply

Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)

Location: Remote (US-based strongly preferred)

Department: Legal

Reports To: General Counsel

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Submer

Submer designs and delivers end-to-end AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling.

We help organizations scale AI beyond the limits of traditional datacenters by enabling higher density, greater efficiency and lower environmental impact – accelerating time-to-AI from first deployment to full production.

What impact you will have

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Group Legal Counsel to join our growing team. This role will provide critical support to the Legal Department across a variety of corporate, commercial, compliance, and administrative legal matters. The ideal candidate will ideally be based in the the US and possess professional fluency in both English and Spanish, as they will support legal matters and documentation involving Spanish-speaking stakeholders and operations in Spanish-speaking jurisdictions.

This is an excellent opportunity for a strong, commercially minded, high-performing legal professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced, international business environment and partnering closely with executive leadership, outside counsel, and cross-functional teams.

What you’ll do

Corporate & Commercial Transactional Support

  • Act as a strategic legal partner at the group level, advising, reviewing and supporting negotiations on large client project agreements, partnerships, and vendor/supplier contracts across entities and jurisdictions.
  • Support fundraising activity: coordinate diligence, review and negotiate term sheets, MoUs, subscription agreements, SAFEs/convertible instruments, and related financing documents alongside outside counsel and finance.
  • Review and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, from high-value client/vendor contracts to routine administrative documentation.
  • Partner with corporate finance on transactional matters, including entity structuring, intercompany agreements, and support for M&A or investment activity as needed.

Corporate Governance & Compliance

  • Lead entity management, board documentation, and corporate record maintenance across the group's legal entities, spanning multiple jurisdictions (including Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India).
  • Own regulatory filings, corporate compliance requirements, and monitoring of key deadlines and renewals across all jurisdictions where the group operates.
  • Design and drive internal compliance initiatives and policy management, ensuring policies are actually usable and adopted, not just written.
  • Flag legal and regulatory risk proactively to leadership, with practical recommendations rather than just issue-spotting.

Global & Cross-Border Legal Support

  • Draft, review, and translate legal, corporate, and business documents between English and Spanish; support Spanish-speaking employees, vendors, customers, and legal advisors.
  • Coordinate with local counsel across the group's jurisdictions; including Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India; to align global agreements with local law and practice. Note: the company is actively expanding internationally, so this footprint will likely grow.
  • Serve as a central point of contact for cross-border legal questions, helping the business navigate differing regulatory, employment, and contracting norms across regions.
  • Proactively build familiarity with the regulatory norms of new jurisdictions as the company expands into them, rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Flag where local law expertise or local counsel input is needed, and manage those relationships efficiently to avoid duplicated or unnecessary external spend.

Legal Operations & Efficiency

  • Own and modernize the company's legal operations function — contract lifecycle management, document repositories, matter tracking, and legal request intake.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, templates, and playbooks that reduce turnaround time and reliance on outside counsel.
  • Build and maintain a library of standard forms (NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, vendor agreements, employment-related documents) to accelerate day-to-day contracting.
  • Set and manage the outside counsel strategy: decide what should be handled in-house vs. externally, negotiate rates/scopes, and review external counsel work product for quality and cost before it reaches leadership.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Work alongside another senior lawyer to cover the full scope of the group's legal needs - this is a genuine partnership role
  • Bring independent judgment to the table: proactively flag risks, propose alternatives, and voice disagreement constructively rather than simply executing instructions.
  • Operate effectively amid organizational change - the company's structure is actively evolving, and this role will need to adapt scope and priorities as that unfolds rather than expecting a fixed mandate.
  • Mentor and potentially oversee paralegal or junior legal support as the function scales.

What you’ll need

  • Law degree and membership in good standing of a bar of a U.S. State, preferably Texas.
  • Minimum 7–15 years of experience as a practicing attorney, ideally with a mix of law firm and in-house/corporate legal department experience.
  • Fully remote role — you can be based anywhere in the world; US preferred and maintaining U.S. business hours (Central Time) required.
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal).
  • Able to operate semi-autonomously with modest supervision
  • Strong commercial legal background
  • Industry experience in technology, fintech, or other relevant commercial sectors
  • Comfort working across a genuinely global legal footprint (currently Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India, with further international expansion expected) - you don't need to already be an expert in each local law, but you should be willing and able to build familiarity with new regulatory norms as the company grows into new markets.
  • Demonstrated experience drafting, negotiating, and managing a broad range of commercial and corporate contracts across borders.
  • Experience supporting mid-large-scale fundraising, financing, or investment transactions (equity, debt, or venture-style deals).
  • Strong grounding in corporate governance, entity management, and regulatory compliance in a multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction structure.
  • Track record of managing outside/local counsel relationships across multiple countries and controlling legal spend.

job.title: Associate Director/ Director, Southeast Asia (Real Estate Investment)
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

As part of the CapitaLand Investment SEA business, you will be part of the SEA Investment team, reporting to the Head of Investment. You will play a pivotal role in supporting and leading investment, M&A, and related activities within the Southeast Asia (SEA) Investment landscape. Your key responsibilities will encompass the following areas:

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive investment strategies to support existing funds and facilitate the creation of new funds, with the objective of growing Funds Under Management (FUM).
  • Identify and secure pipeline assets for the fund through proactive deal sourcing and origination efforts.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to develop optimal investment structures and capital strategies to enhance investment returns.
  • Perform comprehensive market studies, develop operating assumptions, and conduct financial analyses with investment team to evaluate the feasibility of potential investments.
  • Conduct thorough due diligence and negotiations on potential pipeline assets and fund-related investments, ensuring compliance with investment criteria and risk management standards.
  • Oversee the preparation and submission of investment-related documentation required for internal and fund investment committee approvals.
  • Ensure successful execution of divestment transactions to optimize portfolio performance.
  • Lead and mentor junior investment team members fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Good understanding in a wide variety of asset classes.
  • The Company may assign additional duties and/or vary the scope of work according to business requirements. Flexibility and adaptability to evolving business needs are essential.
  • Experience in fund management is preferred, but open to exploring candidates with fund management perspective, with a solid track record of deal experience in Southeast Asia.
  • Open to candidates from banking sector but possess good knowledge of Real Estate.
  • Proficient in stakeholder management.
  • Resourceful, solution-oriented with the ability to connect the dots to drive successful investment outcomes in a dynamic and competitive environment.

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

job.title: BMS Technician
job.description:
Shape the Future of Smart Buildings with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls, we're a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. For more than 140 years, we've helped customers optimise energy performance, reduce carbon emissions, and improve operational efficiency across some of the world's most critical facilities, including data centres, hospitals, pharmaceutical sites, advanced manufacturing facilities, and leading universities.

Backed by industry-leading technology, deep technical expertise, and a world-class service organisation, we deliver innovative solutions that make buildings safer, smarter, and more connected. When you join Johnson Controls, you're joining a team that is redefining the future of the built environment.

About the Opportunity

Due to continued growth, we're seeking an experienced BMS Technician to join our high-performing Queensland Service Team based in Brisbane.

This role is ideal for a seasoned BMS professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, working across diverse customer sites, and building trusted relationships with clients. You'll be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimising sophisticated building automation systems that support mission-critical operations.

You'll have the autonomy to manage your day-to-day work while being backed by a highly skilled national technical support network and a global organisation committed to your professional development.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary package + fully maintained company vehicle
  • Overtime opportunities available
  • Work-life balance and flexible work arrangements
  • Ongoing technical training and development
  • Access to remote specialist engineering support
  • Exposure to complex and high-profile customer sites
  • Clear pathways into senior technical, engineering, project, and leadership roles
  • Stability and career growth with a global industry leader

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, maintenance, fault finding, and repairs on Building Management Systems (BMS) and associated HVAC control systems
  • Diagnose and resolve complex system and communication faults
  • Deliver contract servicing and reactive breakdown support
  • Conduct system performance analysis and optimisation
  • Prepare quotations and manage small upgrade projects
  • Commission and validate control system modifications
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships through technical expertise and responsive service
  • Ensure all work is completed safely and in accordance with company and industry standards

About You

We're looking for an experienced technician who is passionate about technology, customer service, and delivering high-quality outcomes.

You will ideally have:

  • Minimum 3 years' post-apprenticeship experience in Building Automation, BMS, or Building Controls
  • Strong knowledge of commercial HVAC systems and mechanical services
  • Experience diagnosing and servicing BMS controls and field devices
  • Electrical Disconnect/Reconnect Licence (essential)
  • Strong IT, networking, and system integration skills
  • Excellent problem-solving and fault-finding capability
  • Outstanding customer communication skills
  • A proactive approach to safety and continuous improvement
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence

Build Your Career with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls, we actively promote from within and invest in our people. Whether your goal is to become a technical specialist, move into project delivery, or develop into a leadership position, we'll provide the training, support, and opportunities to help you get there.

If you're an experienced BMS Technician looking for more challenging work, greater career opportunities, and the backing of a global market leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Only applicants with current Australian working rights will be considered.

Please note that pre-employment checks, including reference checks, medical assessments, criminal history checks, and drug & alcohol testing, form part of our recruitment process.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our success. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and create better outcomes for our customers, communities, and employees. We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute, grow, and succeed.

Able to support SOW refinements with various vendors ensuring all the mandatory information are clear and objectives are met

Experience

  • Experience with SAP (S4 Hana), Ariba tools.
  • Knowledge of best practices for Service Now – Hardware Sourcing

job.title: Commissioning Manager
job.description:
Build a career with confidence!

We are a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

Role Overview

The Commissioning Lead is responsible for leading and coordinating the successful delivery of commissioning and warranty activities across the designated region. The role ensures projects are commissioned safely, efficiently and to the required technical and quality standards, while meeting client expectations, project requirements and commercial objectives. The Commissioning Lead works closely with internal teams, technicians, clients and contractors to drive timely resolution of issues, effective project handovers and a high standard of customer service.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Lead commissioning activities across warranty sites and designated client accounts, ensuring projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to required standards.
  • Monitor and manage commissioning and warranty performance, ensuring outcomes meet project, client and business requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to Field Technicians in resolving commissioning, warranty and technical issues.
  • Coordinate commissioning handovers, scheduling, resourcing and project requirements with CML, Service Coordinators and Local Branch Managers.
  • Manage warranty claims and ensure all commissioning, warranty and project documentation is completed accurately and within required timeframes.
  • Support the transition from warranty to preventative maintenance, ensuring PM requirements are communicated and established prior to the expiry of the Defects Liability Period (DLP).
  • Build strong relationships with clients and contractors, providing responsive service and supporting effective delivery of commissioning and warranty works.
  • Identify recurring issues and continuous improvement opportunities, providing feedback to management to improve processes, technical outcomes and customer satisfaction.

Required Competencies & Qualifications

  • 5–10 years’ experience in HVAC, HVACR or a related mechanical services industry.
  • Proven experience in service, account management, commissioning or a customer-facing technical role.
  • Strong technical knowledge and demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve HVAC and mechanical service issues.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the confidence to build trusted relationships with clients and contractors.
  • Strong organisational, planning and follow-up skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver outcomes within required timeframes.
  • Demonstrated leadership, negotiation and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues.
  • Ability to identify customer needs and opportunities, with strong commercial awareness and sales capability.
  • HVAC, engineering or related technical qualifications, supported by strong computer skills and excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively as a team player, building strong relationships at all organizational levels.
  • Strong capability to work both independently and as part of a team, with a service-oriented mindset.
  • Proficiency in English (written and verbal communication).

Benefits

  • Competitive salary package + Full time opportunity
  • Excellent job stability + Ongoing training and development opportunities
  • Inclusive work environment + Supportive management team
  • Opportunity to work across diverse operations throughout Australia

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

What You Will Do

Manage staffing, budgeting, and operational oversight for India-based engineering teams across - design, implementation, and testing for Caterpillar’s Dealer ERP and CRM system based on Microsoft Dynamics 365 apps and supporting modules (Sales, Customer Insights, Commerce, Contact Center, Field Service, Finance, Supply Chain Management, Project Operations) ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical standards.

  • Collaborate with the Product Management team to create and share product roadmaps that align with Microsoft's Wave 1 and Wave 2 release cycle.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

  • Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.

  • Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
  • Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.

Building Relationships and Using Influence:

Considerations For Top Candidates:

  • Strong understanding of dealer operations and business processes in equipment/heavy machinery industries

  • Security: Knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), role-based security, and data protection in Dynamics 365 implementations

Certifications (preferred)

job.title: GBS Finance Transition Program Coordinator
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled GBS Finance Transition Program Coordinator to join our GBS Finance PMO Team. The incumbent would know the GBS Finance Transition Methodology and is fully aware of various phases along milestone acceptance criteria. The incumbent would be committed to delivering GBS transition programs on-time, within budget and to specification by improving the effectiveness of project teams through the application of professionally accepted program and project management methods, techniques, tools (MSProject, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.), and training. Provides expertise in specific areas of Transition project management to ensure the most efficient transfer of finance in support of the Global Finance Services Organization strategy and operating model rollout. The incumbent will be supporting Transition Project Managers on transitioning financial processes from global Caterpillar locations to Caterpillar GBS location.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield Office, Bangalore, India

What you will do

Job Roles and Responsibilities

  • This position is the role of a fully capable transition project management professional. The incumbent has outsourcing transition project management experience (captive or third party), whereby they can support the GBS Transition Managers to execute transition project planning, Knowledge Transfer, Ramp-up / Service Readiness Testing and Stabilization.
  • This position requires the incumbent to be knowledgeable in GBS Transition Project Methodology and various milestones which need to follow in finance processes transition project
  • The incumbent is an expert in MSProject, PowerPoint and SharePoint tools and can make complex project plans in the MS Project application.
  • The incumbent must be able to interpret and transfer work breakdown structure (WBS) into project management software. Interpret & communicate Voice of Customer (VOC) and Voice of Business (VOB) needs. May create report packages and communicate or post program or project status, may also include maintenance of a program SharePoint site.
  • Specific work assignments are as follows: Coordinate with GBS Transition Managers in scheduling various transition governance meetings, solution meetings, knowledge transfer meetings and arranging for milestone calls.
  • The incumbent can coordinate with third party service provider and various stakeholders to make the GBS transition project successful.
  • The incumbent manages projects that are moderately complex in nature and will require some supervision. This is a staff position that requires a foundational understanding of transition project management tools & processes. The incumbent will have the ability to facilitate project teams, will lead chartering sessions with assistance, will develop network diagrams, and will help lead integration & compression sessions. Work assignments may be specialized in nature but may also require some coordination between other staff personnel needed for larger and more complex programs.
  • The incumbent has the ability to make schedule changes/corrections during transition meetings and compression sessions. Supports Transition Project Managers in facilitating update meetings, maintains program level issues/action logs, risk registers/FMEAs, scope change requests/logs, program work plans, and provides workshop planning, execution and follow-up assistance. Capture and publish meeting minutes as needed.
  • Create accurate and detailed schedules with occasional follow-up by Transition Project Management Supervisor. The incumbent captures project information, and with periodic assistance from the project team interprets, identifies relationships between activities, analyses data from schedule updates, and works with project team members to resolve logic errors. Helps explain changes due to updates; will occasionally recommend actions to resolve schedule problems, and updates plan accordingly based on actions taken by team to resolve schedule problems.
  • Conduct detail-planning meetings with some supervision. The incumbent possesses the ability to work with functional areas to develop their detailed activities and schedule. Provides recommendations to project team needed to increase accuracy of program and project schedules, provides guidance to team in understanding and following program and project management standard processes, and works daily with team members to emphasize the importance of the program schedule to be successful in implementing on time, with in cost, and at the required quality targets. Provides administrative planning and follow-up for program team, steering committee, and governance review meetings.

What you will have

  • Four-year college or university degree
  • Three to five years of progressive job-related experience in GBS Transition Project Management and supporting Transition Project Managers to run the project efficiently
  • Experience creating detailed work plans within a MSProject software including duration-based activities, resource forecasts, and scope.
  • Very effective interpersonal skills including team leadership skills, excellent communication skills, and strong analytical and organizational skills.
  • Shift Timing – As per the project requirement

Desired Qualification

  • College or university degree accounting in a domain related to management, economics, or technology.
  • Certification in Project Management - PRINCE II, PMP, Agile.
  • Professional training in project management software.
  • Professional training on techniques for leading and facilitating meetings.
  • Previous Green Belt experience.

Skills desired:

Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Comments on the organization's business model and financial goals.
  • Communicates key considerations for business decision making process.
  • Cites examples of types of information needed to make sound business decisions.
  • Participates in business task to get things done in own unit or area.
  • Caters to key stakeholders and their priorities.

Planning: Tactical, Strategic: Knowledge of effective planning techniques and ability to contribute to operational (short term), tactical (1-2 years) and strategic (3-5 years) planning in support of the overall business plan. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Contributes to short-term operational plans.
  • Anticipates and adapts to plan changes.
  • Monitors progress of work against plan as required to meet objectives.
  • Reports variances and makes agreed-upon corrections.
  • Under guidance, develops tactical plan for own direct responsibility.

Process Management: Knowledge of business process improvement tools and techniques; ability to understand, monitor, update, control, or enhance existing business or work processes. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Employs process flows, cycle time, process time and waste concepts as appropriate.
  • Walks through steps, decisions, measurements, dependencies and hand-offs for a specific process.
  • Creates process flow or work flow diagrams.
  • Documents types of process decisions and potential impact of each decision.
  • Identifies and monitors common process bottlenecks.

What you will get:

  • Work Life Harmony
  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Relocation assistance

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

  • Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan
  • Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers)

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

job.title: Lead, Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

Establish reliable and scalable quality engineering practices for StarHub’s digital platforms across mobile, web, backend and cloud-native systems. The Senior SDET will partner with engineering, product, architecture, DevOps/SRE, security and delivery teams to shift quality left, build meaningful automated quality gates, transition vendor-owned automation into sustainable in-house ownership, and provide fast, risk-based release confidence during migration, refactoring and platform modernisation initiatives.

Accountabilities

  • Take ownership of the existing test automation from vendors and establish clear quality and governance standards, documentation, CI integration, reliability and maintainability expectations so automation becomes an integral part of product engineering.
  • Improve coverage, reliability and efficiency of automated tests across different platforms like web, mobile and backend
  • Improve quality of releases in terms of user experience and satisfaction by ensuring testability and automated tests are treated as first class citizens in the SDLC

Responsibilities

  • Partner with developers to design and implement tests at the right layer of the test pyramid or testing trophy, including unit, component, contract, API, integration, e2e, visual, accessibility
  • Setup automated quality gates across the SDLC to ensure issues are found as early as possible
  • Establish and track metrics for test automation to drive improvement and accountability
  • Improve test automation coverage, reliability and efficiency.
  • Use AI agents and coding assistants responsibly to assist with test planning, requirements analysis, risk discovery, test design, automation development, test data generation, failure triage, coverage gap analysis, documentation and refactoring.
  • Build internal tools, libraries, and platforms that make quality practices easier for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, data setup, environment reliability and release confidence.
  • Work with stakeholders across engineering and QE to ensure alignment on automation approaches and goals.
  • Work with vendors to deliver automation solutions to the standards defined.
  • Write clear technical documentation, RFCs, test plans, READMEs, onboarding guides and quality playbooks.

Areas of Impact:

  • Stakeholders: QA, Engineering, Program/Delivery Management, Product
  • Decision Rights: Strongly advise QA/Automation tools and license purchase, strongly advise KPIs for the test automation team
  • Resources: ~10 automation resources from vendors as peers, some existing licenses for UiPath, BrowserStack

Ideal Track Record:

  • Delivered automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) covering significant critical user journeys and behaviours, measurable regression improvement times in hours if not in days
  • Designed, or at least significantly contributed to, and implemented automated test frameworks from scratch that have measurably improved test efficiency.
  • Designed dashboards for reporting on test automation stats to stakeholders
  • Integrated tests with CI/CD pipelines
  • Used AI coding assistants or agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent for testing, automation, documentation, triage or quality analysis.
  • Managed test environments and test automation infrastructure on cloud services like AWS, GCP, Browserstack, LambdaTest.
  • Built internal tools and utilities to make testing and QE easily accessible for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders improving productivity.

job.title: Director, Enterprise Client Solutions
job.description:
Job Description

The Director of Enterprise Client Solutions acts as the primary deal architect, story orchestrator, and strategic execution lead for the Chief of Enterprise. He / she leads a team of client-facing orchestrators to align multidisciplinary teams to pitch and convert large complex enterprise opportunities into technically feasible, commercially sound, multi-year deals. This role requires a highly effective communicator who can engage and influence C-suite, procurement, and Board-level stakeholders through clear, compelling executive narratives that articulate EBG’s distinctive value proposition.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Technology Advisor

  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, including business, technology, procurement, and operational leaders.
  • Works closely with Strategic Account GMs to drive strategic account plans, including client priorities, whitespace opportunities, stakeholder maps, competitive position, and growth actions.
  • Lead executive client engagements, value-discovery workshops, solution briefings, and business reviews.
  • Act as the single orchestration point for strategic clients, ensuring coordinated engagement across internal teams.

Solution and Pursuit Leadership

  • Identify, qualify, and shape complex opportunities across connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, data and AI, digital workplace, managed services, and industry solutions.
  • Translate client challenges into clear value propositions, business cases, solution roadmaps, and commercial propositions.
  • Lead multidisciplinary pursuit teams comprising account managers, solution specialists, architects, bid, pricing, commercial, delivery, and partners.
  • Drive bid strategy, win themes, executive sponsorship, solution governance, risk reviews, and proposal quality for priority pursuits.
  • Ensure solutions are commercially sound, technically deliverable, scalable, and aligned to the client’s target operating model.

Delivery, Service and Value Realisation

  • Ensure a robust handover from pursuit to delivery, with agreed scope, assumptions, risks, commercials, success measures, and executive governance.
  • Partner with delivery and service-management leaders to resolve escalations and protect client outcomes.
  • Lead post-implementation value reviews to identify service improvements, upsell opportunities, renewals, and references.
  • Champion client experience, ensuring commitments made during the sales process are delivered in practice.

Internal and Partner Orchestration

  • Mobilise service lines to define offerings, product roadmaps, and specialist support required for client opportunities.
  • Work with technology services tribes on solution architecture, technical assurance, implementation approach, and managed-service design.
  • Build and activate strategic partnerships with technology providers, system integrators, and regional delivery teams.
  • Develop reusable account insights, industry plays, solution blueprints, and client references.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, telecommunications, consulting, managed services, or complex solution sales.
  • Demonstrated experience leading strategic accounts and multi-service solution pursuits.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, data/AI, and managed services.
  • Proven commercial acumen, including business-case development, pricing, contract negotiation, and margin management.
  • Experience working with C-suite and senior public-sector, regulated-industry, or large-enterprise stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Win rate for priority pursuits and complex bids
  • Renewal rate, expansion revenue, and customer lifetime value
  • Client satisfaction, executive relationship strength, and referenceability
  • Delivery handover quality, major-escalation resolution, and value-realisation outcomes
  • Forecast accuracy and adherence to commercial and pursuit governance

job.title: Product Manager, Ask Maps
job.description:
About the job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

The Ask Maps team is on a mission to build the next generation of Google Maps, powered by Maps’ geospatial capabilities and the latest Gemini models.

We are transforming the Maps experience to a Gemini powered one that puts the user in complete control of their real-world trips, adapting to deep personal context, and anticipating needs before they arise.

You will be stepping into a high-stakes, hyper-growth environment. Our addressable market is massive - over 2 billion users rely on Google Maps.

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

Responsibilities

  • Drive development and secure buy-in for a product outlook that identifies, defines, and supports the overall product narrative and direction, achieving an outcome that is greater than the sum of its parts.
  • Define the long-term direction for how we understand users’ typical mobility patterns and how we can help them proactively for their trips.
  • Partner with other Geo and Google teams to leverage cutting-edge personalization, geospatial intelligence, and agentic capabilities. Build scalable data and quality infrastructure to power personalized mobility suggestions.
  • Launch 0-to-1 Mobility features that make Maps more intuitive, proactive, and assistive. Iterate rapidly based on user feedback to refine AI-driven mobility interactions to drive topline growth for Maps.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.description:

Additionally, as the world moves toward an increasingly agentic environment, you will define what "agentic safety" means at Google, architecting frameworks to secure AI agents as they interact with connected apps and servers.

You will provide technical direction, oversight, and guidance to engineering staff. Regionally, you will serve as the technical lead for the APAC region, providing technical oversight and guidance to teams in India and collaborating closely with engineering and product leadership with other teams across the US and UK.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our Devices & Services team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences for users. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make our user's interaction with computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. Whether finding new ways to capture and sense the world around us, advancing form factors, or improving interaction methods, the Devices & Services team is making people's lives better through technology.

Responsibilities

  • Drive the technical vision, multi-year roadmap, and execution strategy for Google’s transition to autonomous defense, ensuring we can scale our defenses ahead of emerging AI-driven threats.

You will drive the software automation roadmap to improve the quality and reduce the cycle time for network planning and design.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Your role will be focused in Thailand and South East Asia. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

job.title: Data Center Operations Facilities Manager
job.description:
About the job

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facility Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You'll provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

You will develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

The Google Australia Sovereign Cloud team builds, delivers, and operates secure private cloud services. We provide a flexible, reliable, and scalable end-to-end capability—from the cloud to the edge—to enable operation in complex environments. We deliver and operate these private cloud deployments for the most critical Australian Federal Government customers, helping scale, secure, and maintain the deployment while working closely with Google product teams to continually improve our technology.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Responsibilities

  • Own efforts to perform compliance activities for a data center and analyze compliance results for data centers globally. Ensure regional and global teams are complying with project/schedule guidelines and Google design standards.
  • Lead efforts to monitor data center systems operations, control site activities to minimize risk, and to ensure effective response to any excursions.
  • Lead efforts to ensure all sites are following facility, maintenance, and standard programs globally while exhibiting strength in improvement to said policies and programs.
  • Own the development of strategies to keep operational costs to a minimum, improve efficiency, and reduce environmental impact at a site, along with driving site-level development of programs and initiatives.
  • Incorporate subdomain expertise and experience to enhance data center design to optimize equipment and operations for next generation data centers.

job.title: Digital Designer
job.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Digital Designer sits at the front end of scale, shaping the creative assets that fuel our performance marketing and automated ad workflows. The role brings strong design judgement to layout, visual hierarchy, typography, and composition, while taking a results-driven, test-and-learn approach to creative development. Working within structured design systems, the ideal candidate creates brand-consistent assets that can scale across formats and campaign variants, responds to platform performance, and iterates creative work to drive stronger marketing outcomes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Interpret campaign production briefs and execute digital creatives across approved template systems and format families
  • Populate dynamic creative templates with campaign content including copy, pricing, product imagery, and CTA elements
  • Generate digital ad variants across all required placements using the ad automation platform, understanding template logic and catching layout anomalies proactively
  • Adapt and optimise assets for platform-specific specifications using Adobe Creative Suite
  • Ensure layout accuracy, brand consistency, copy integrity, and technical compliance across all outputs
  • Export and package final deliverables across required formats including static and animated assets
  • Maintain organised asset management, naming conventions, version control, and production file structures
  • Identify layout inconsistencies, formatting issues, or outputs outside approved templates and escalate when necessary
  • Support scalable production workflows and contribute to operational efficiency improvements
  • Undertake other duties, responsibilities, and projects as assigned by the supervisor or management, in line with evolving business and operational needs

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in digital production, graphic design, advertising production, or performance marketing creative environments
  • Portfolio demonstrating strong digital campaign execution and high-volume production capability
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency, in-house, or commercially driven production environments
  • Experience producing creatives for sales campaigns, festive campaigns, product launches, and promotional events
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy
  • Experience adapting digital creatives across multiple placements and format requirements
  • Able to work accurately within established template systems and brand guidelines
  • Strong attention to detail and self-review discipline before final submission
  • Experience handling multiple deliverables and timelines within fast-moving production environments
  • Able to work independently while maintaining consistency and production accuracy

REQUIREMENTS

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Familiarity with ad automation and dynamic creative workflows is advantageous
  • Basic motion or After Effects skills is advantageous
  • Basic proficiency in AI-assisted creative tools is advantageous
  • Solid understanding of digital ad specifications across social and display platforms
  • Strong file management and version control discipline

job.title: Senior Copywriter
job.description:

28 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Senior Copywriter

Job Summary

Job Description

Senior Copywriter – Roam (Telstra’s In-House Creative Agency)

Location: Sydney, NSW Reports to: Creative Lead (Copy) Type: 6-month contract

About Roam

Roam is Telstra’s in-house creative team. We’re a collective of hybrid makers and storytellers from all corners of the industry. We partner closely with Telstra’s marketing team and agency partners to push craft and creativity in everything we do. We move fast, think sharp, and make it memorable. We’re here to raise the bar, create meaningful customer experiences, and make every interaction count.

##

The Role

We’re looking for a copywriter who thrives in the world of 1:1 communications and service messaging. From emergency comms to basic customer service updates, you’ll have a keen eye for detail, and the ability to create clear, compelling, and customer-focused copy that strengthens relationships and drives action across a range of 1:1 channels.

This is a hygiene job for a large communications platform. The right candidate won’t mind rolling up their sleeves and deep diving into a range of different copy templates to weed out repetition and delete unnecessary comms.

With that in mind, you’ll get to shape communications that feel relevant, useful, and distinctly human. Working closely with our strategists, producers, marketers, and channel specialists, you’ll also be required to deliver consistent customer communications that adhere to Telstra’s brand and tone of voice.

A strong understanding of customer behaviour, personalisation, accessibility, and compliance is essential. You’ll know how to turn complex messages into simple, engaging communications that connect with our customers and drive action.

What you’ll do

  • Write engaging, customer-centric service messaging across a range of channels, including email, SMS, push notifications, in-app messaging, and other 1:1 communications.
  • Occasionally develop messaging across the customer lifecycle, including acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, and loyalty initiatives.
  • Collaborate with designers, strategists, producers, and marketing teams to create effective customer experiences.
  • Translate customer insights and business objectives into relevant, actionable communications.
  • Apply personalisation principles to create messages that feel timely, useful, and tailored.
  • Ensure all copy meets accessibility, legal, and compliance requirements, while maintaining a strong brand voice.
  • Use testing, performance insights, and customer feedback to continually improve communications.
  • Work fast without sacrificing craft, clarity, or attention to detail.

What you’ll bring

  • Proven experience as a copywriter within service messaging, CRM, direct marketing, customer communications, or a creative agency environment.
  • Exceptional writing skills across short-form and long-form communications, with a sharp eye for detail.
  • Experience writing for email, SMS, push notifications, and customer journey communications.
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle marketing, personalisation, and behavioural messaging.
  • Ability to balance creativity with performance objectives, compliance requirements, and accessibility standards.
  • Strong collaboration skills and a passion for customer-centred thinking.
  • A curiosity for optimisation, testing, and continuously improving customer experiences.

We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As a Treasury Manager (based in Sydney, Australia) for an initial 6 month fixed term contract, you will work closely with our global and local Treasury, Finance and Corporate Development teams, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Functional responsibility for treasury reporting to internal and external stakeholders
  • Contribute to development and refinement of best in class treasury framework, policies and other financial governance.
  • Lead and/or contribute to group treasury initiatives such as process improvements, system implementations and upgrades etc...
  • Collaborating with local and offshore stakeholders, maintaining and strengthening these relationships and building new relationships over time.

What You'll Do

Reporting & Compliance

  • Prepare and deliver comprehensive financial reports on treasury activities for various stakeholders, including board packs, due diligence packs, and investor roadshow packs.
  • Ensure accurate accounting and reporting of all treasury instruments, including mark-to-market valuations.
  • Support internal and external audits, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal policies as required.
  • Monitor compliance of all treasury activities with relevant policies, market best practices and debt facilities and escalate for management and execution as required.
  • Conduct regular reviews and audits to meet and exceed compliance obligations, target to build centre of excellence.
  • Modelling and analysis of cash and liquidity risks, interest rate risks and FX risks (transaction and translation)

Treasury Systems & Operations

  • Help implement and promote best practices in treasury management, operational processes, and reporting.
  • Contribute to the definition and delivery of business requirements for interfaces between the Treasury Management System (TMS) and other internal and external systems (e.g. ERP, banking platforms).
  • Manage TMS notional accounts and reconciliations, establish Middle Office (MO) controls to ensure alignment between physical bank accounts in TMS, ERP, and bank platforms for reporting obligations
  • Drive process improvements, automation, and system enhancements to improve efficiency, accuracy, and control.

Treasury Data, Controls & Oversight

  • Hold functional responsibility for treasury data quality, ensuring all transactional data is complete, accurate, timely, and fit for decision‑making.
  • Own and maintain controls over data capture, validation, and reporting, providing independent oversight of Front Office execution and assurance over Back Office processing.

Leadership:

  • Lead the middle office accounting and reporting function maintaining the collaborative and high-performance culture in place today.
  • Balance project management responsibilities with day-to-day operations

What You'll Bring

  • A Bachelor's degree (or above) in business, commerce, economics, finance or similar field
  • 10+ years previous corporate treasury experience ideally in a business with an international footprint
  • Group Treasury roles within multicurrency, multi-jurisdictional organizations ideally in Data Center/Technology and/or Commercial real estate/REIT and/or project finance
  • Curiosity about Sustainability/ESG (some knowledge of ESG financing desirable)
  • A fast learner who thrives working in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong attention to detail, integrity and ambition

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

job.title: Senior Program Manager, Corporate Real Estate Design & Delivery- APAC - Bangalore, Karnataka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

As Senior Program Manager, Corporate Real Estate Design and Delivery for APAC you will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of Corporate Real Estate office fit-out capital projects across the APAC region, from project initiation through completion and handover.

Working closely with the Global Senior Delivery Manager, Design Studio, Regional CRE stakeholders, Finance, and external delivery partners, you will lead multiple concurrent projects across diverse markets, ensuring they are delivered on time, on budget, and to Equinix’s global design, quality, and governance standards.

This is a hands-on delivery leadership role requiring strong programme management capability, commercial acumen, and the ability to operate effectively across different cultures, time zones, and levels of project maturity.

You will act as the regional point of accountability for delivery, while contributing to the evolution of global delivery standards, playbooks, and ways of working.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of APAC office fit-out projects, from feasibility and business case through construction, handover, and post-occupancy review
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects across the region, ensuring programme alignment, sequencing, and risk mitigation
  • Ensure all projects are delivered in accordance with approved scope, budget, schedule, and quality standards
  • Proactively identify, manage, and resolve delivery risks, issues, and dependencies, escalating where appropriate
  • Implement and follow the global Project Delivery Playbook and Toolkit, ensuring consistent application across APAC projects
  • Manage project governance processes, including gateway / tollgate reviews, change control, and reporting
  • Ensure all material changes to scope, cost, or programme are managed through formal Change Order processes with auditable decisions

  • Support the preparation of business cases, including cost estimates, programme schedules, procurement strategies, and benchmarking
  • Own day-to-day cost control, forecasting, and cashflow management for regional projects
  • Work closely with Finance and Financial Analysts to ensure accurate financial reporting and budget adherence
  • Run procurement activities, including consultant and contractor appointments, fee negotiations, and contract administration
  • Act as the primary delivery interface for APAC CRE stakeholders, business leaders, and functional partners
  • Manage and coordinate external project partners, including project managers, cost managers, designers, contractors, and vendors
  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with regional and global stakeholders, balancing local nuance with global standards
  • Represent the Delivery Studio in regional forums, updates, and working sessions
  • Work as an integrated delivery partner with the Design Studio to ensure design intent, programme, and budget are aligned
  • Collaborate with Workplace, IT, Security, Sustainability, and Operations teams to ensure holistic project delivery
  • Support the Global Senior Delivery Manager in implementing process improvements, tools, and best practices across APAC
  • Capture and contribute to lessons learned, post-occupancy evaluations, and regional performance insights
  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, value creation, and regional scalability
  • Contribute to Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and regional reporting with clear, data-driven insights

Key Competencies

  • Strong programme and project management capability with the ability to manage complex, multi-market portfolios
  • Commercially astute with a clear understanding of cost, value, and risk trade-offs
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with governance frameworks and reporting structures
  • Confident communicator able to adapt style and content for senior leaders, technical teams, and external partners
  • Comfortable working across time zones and cultures, balancing regional autonomy with global alignment
  • Solutions-oriented, resilient, and calm under pressure in live delivery environments

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Project Management, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, or similar
  • 12+ years’ experience in programme or project management within corporate real estate, commercial fit-out, or workplace delivery
  • Proven experience delivering office fit-out capital projects across multiple locations or regions
  • Strong working knowledge of commercial management, procurement, and contract administration
  • Familiarity with built environment delivery frameworks (RIBA or equivalent)
  • Experience working in or across the APAC region is strongly preferred
  • Professional accreditation (RICS, APM, PMP, PRINCE2 or similar) is highly desirable
