job.title: AI Transformation Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Role Overview

As a AI Transformation Engineer, you will help translate AI and automation ideas into working solutions that improve how StarHub's network and operations teams run day to day. You will work alongside senior engineers to build, test, and deploy practical AI use cases — from automating manual workflows to surfacing insights from network and operational data.

This is a hands-on, learning-focused role for an early-career engineer. You will get broad exposure across the technology transformation — data pipelines, machine learning, LLM-based tooling, and process automation — while building the judgement to deliver solutions that are reliable, compliant, and genuinely useful.

Key Responsibilities

1. Building & Delivering AI Solutions

  • Support the design, development, and testing of AI and automation use cases under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and scripts that prepare, clean, and transform network and operational data for AI models.
  • Develop and refine prompts, retrieval (RAG) workflows, and lightweight integrations for LLM-based internal tools.

2. Automation & Process Improvement

  • Identify repetitive manual tasks across engineering and operations that are good candidates for automation.
  • Implement workflow automations and monitor them in production, escalating issues and iterating on improvements.

3. Data, Testing & Documentation

  • Run experiments, evaluate model outputs, and help measure accuracy, latency, and reliability against clear success criteria.
  • Document solutions, data sources, and design decisions so work is reproducible and auditable.

4. Collaboration & Compliance

  • Work closely with data, network, and platform engineers, and take part in code reviews and knowledge-sharing.
  • Follow PDPA and internal data-governance practices when handling customer and network data.

Qualifications

  • Degree (or final-year / recent graduate) in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 0–2 years; internships, academic projects, or personal projects in AI, data, or automation are welcomed.
  • Working knowledge of Python, ML and AI; basic understanding of how LLMs and SLMs are used in applications.
  • Exposure to telecom or network data, cloud platforms, or LLM tooling (e.g. RAG, prompting) through study or projects.
  • Foundational familiarity in: Python/AI Agents/Git/Version Control/Rest APIs/ML Fundamentals/LLMs/SLMs/Prompting/RAG Basics/Pandas/NumPy/Data pipelines/Cloud Basics/Automation Scripting/Data Visualization

job.title: Data Centre Critical Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

The primary responsibility for this role is to:

•Maintain records and update all M&E, building & schematic drawings of the facilities in and security of the estates under our care

•Conduct regular checks of the premises for potential safety hazards and unsafe conditions, initiate corrective measures to maintain a safe and healthy work environment, in compliance with prevailing legislative and regulatory requirements

•Manage new leases and timely renewal of existing ones, covering offices, shops and technical sites:

o Negotiate with building owners, manage LOIs and agreements, follow-up with all related administration matters

o Conduct regular meetings with respective business units

o Monitor current industry rental rates

o Liaise with relevant authorities to ensure the leases comply with authorities’ requirements, if any

o Liaise with internal business units eg Legal, Finance, Business Units, for any changes of lease terms, rental and service fees, property tax, etc

o Liaise with external tenants in StarHub’s owned-premises, including the generation of billing invoices to tenants

o Ensure timely handover/ takeover of premises to/from building owners

•Carry out risk assessments and management

•Perform 24 x 7 standby duties, respond to and rectify all situations

•Carry out any other assignments from the management

Qualifications

  • Job Requirement

•Fresh Diploma graduates with positive attitude and willingness to work in a start-up environment are welcome to apply

•Self motivated with strong drive and the willingness to take on challenges

•Good written and oral communications skills, with ability to interact will people of all levels, especially with end customers;

•Good working attitude with minimum supervision and ability to perform under pressure

•Possess initiative and professionalism with the ability to multi task.

•Service oriented manner is essential. Must be a team player coupled with strong communication and problem solving skills and shall demonstrate the ability to work independently

job.title: Salesforce/CloudSense Lead

job.title: Service Delivery Manager

job.title: Lead Systems Analyst
job.description:

job.title: Data Scientist
job.description:

The data scientist works closely with key internal and external stakeholders to develop new Al products or new application areas for Al.

Constantly review and ensure that current methodology conforms and meets industry standards.
  • Propose and develop new analytics models and innovative techniques and algorithms to enhance SmartHub capabilities and value proposition of Telco Big Data.
  • Independently develop solutions that adopt and leverage on latest AI/ML models including GenAI and LLM to deliver exceptional value to internal/external stakeholders.

job.title: Principal Systems Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

job.title: Middleware Architect
job.description:
Role Mission:

This role exists to define, standardize, and evolve the enterprise middleware and integration architecture to support growing digital, partner, and internal platform demands. As systems scale in volume and complexity, the organization requires a cohesive architecture that ensures reliability, security, and reuse across services and integrations. The role provides technical leadership to align business requirements with cloud-native, API-driven solutions while reducing operational risk and complexity.

Accountabilities:

  • Enterprise middleware and integration architecture strategy.
  • API and microservices architecture governance.
  • Platform scalability, resilience, and non-functional standards.
  • Security, compliance, and architectural best practices.
  • Technical leadership and cross-team alignment.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and maintain reference architectures, design standards, and patterns for middleware, APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Architect cloud-native, containerized services and integration solutions that are scalable, secure, and highly available.
  • Govern API lifecycle management, including design guidelines, versioning strategies, traffic management, and consumption models.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, security, and operations teams to ensure observability, automation, and platform readiness for production workloads.
  • Provide architectural guidance, conduct design reviews, and mentor engineering teams while engaging stakeholders and vendors as required.

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • Engineering & Platform Teams

Works closely with middleware, integration, and application development teams to define architecture standards, review designs, and guide implementation of cloud-native and API-based solutions.

  • DevOps & Operations

Partners with DevOps, SRE, and operations teams to ensure platforms meet non-functional requirements such as availability, performance, scalability, observability, and disaster recovery.

  • Security & Risk Management

Collaborates with security, risk, and compliance teams to embed security-by-design principles, ensure secure integrations, and meet enterprise governance and audit requirements.

  • Business & Product Stakeholders

job.title: Lead, Cyber Engineering
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission

Reporting to the Manager, Cyber Engineering, this role is central to ensuring the organization’s adherence to regulatory and internal policies, managing cyber risk, and maintaining a robust governance framework. The ideal candidate brings proven first-line GRC operations experience across critical telecom and enterprise environments, a track record of translating complex threats into business-impact language, and the ability to lead full-cycle audit delivery with minimal supervision.

Accountabilities

As a 1.5LoD Cyber Risk Specialist, you will be the dedicated technical partner for Business Unit Heads (Risk Owners) and Technical Leads (Control Owners). Your responsibility is to understand and identify cyber threats impacting the business, manage the system development lifecycle of security controls, and ensure full compliance with StarHub policies and Singapore’s regulatory frameworks (IMDA TCS/BCS, CSA CCoP 2.0). You will also provide specialist guidance on AI/LLM security risks as the organization expands its use of generative AI technologies.

Short Description

Responsibilities

Risk & Control Ownership Support

  • Advisory to Risk Owners: Assist Business Unit Heads in overseeing the security posture of critical assets. Translate technical vulnerabilities (CVSS, pen-test findings) into Business Impact narratives that enable informed risk acceptance and capex sign-off.
  • Control Lifecycle Management: Act on behalf of Control Owners to design, implement, and document technologies and safeguards (Directive, Deterrent, Preventive, Detective, Corrective, Compensating) required to mitigate identified risks.
  • Execution Oversight: Coordinate with Control Performers (Support Teams) to ensure daily security activities are executed according to defined standards and documented SOPs.
  • Documentation: Maintain formalized standard operating procedures, runbooks, and plans aligned with StarHub’s Information Security policies, ISO/IEC 27001/20000/22301, and national/sectoral requirements.

Operational Cyber Risk Management

  • Threat Modelling: Lead threat modelling sessions (jointly with your Manager) during the design phase of new systems, AI deployments, and infrastructure changes to identify attack vectors, abuse cases, and control gaps before production go-live; maintain reusable threat libraries mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Risk Assessments: Execute cyber risk assessments on gaps surfaced through policy deviations, vulnerability scans (Tenable Nessus), penetration tests, security events, external threat intelligence, and audit findings across IT, OT, 5G, and ISP environments.
  • Remediation Strategy: Propose risk mitigation and treatment strategies using the full safeguard taxonomy. Ensure remediation plans are technically sound, operationally viable, and aligned to StarHub’s Information Security policies and Singapore regulatory obligations (IMDA TCS/BCS, CSA CCoP 2.0, Cybersecurity Act, PDPA).
  • Transparency: Provide Risk Owners with operational impact assessments, ensuring service disruption implications are clearly understood before residual risk is accepted.
  • Continuous Monitoring: Track and report on remediation plan status, ensuring closure within agreed timelines; maintain a consolidated cyber risk inventory with credible impact ratings, justifications, treatment plans, and named accountable parties.

Compliance (Audit & Assessment) Management

  • Collaborate with the Information Security Office (ISO) to facilitate end-to-end audit and assessment processes, including CII audits, CSA Cyber Trust Mark reviews, StarHub control self-assessments, and ad-hoc assessments. Lead milestone stewardship with zero missed deliverables.
  • Support the selection and appointment of auditors, providing consultation on scope, fees, and operational feasibility.
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive audit plan covering scope, resource allocation, and budgeting to verify that StarHub’s systems, infrastructure, and operations are resilient and fully compliant with all internal policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Take responsibility for the collection and verification of technical evidence (logs, screenshots, configurations). Ensure all artefacts accurately reflect the current state of critical assets and meet ISO standards before submission; conduct pre-submission rehearsal reviews to head off avoidable findings.
  • Collaborate with Risk and Control Owners to develop technically sound and operationally viable remediation plans for draft audit findings, including management action plans with justified timelines.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field (Masters preferred).
  • 6-8 years; experience in cybersecurity and GRC, with exposure to the Telecommunications sector and an understanding of service risk, SLAs, network environments, and the balance between service availability and cyber resilience.
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA); certified or actively pursuing; or equivalent (CISSP, SSCP, or ISC2 certification).
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience supporting ISO 27001, ISO 20000, and/or ISO 22301 compliance cycles including evidence curation, control walkthroughs, and finding closure.

Good to Have

  • Solid knowledge of compliance frameworks and regulatory requirements: NIST CSF/SP 800-53, ISO 27001, CSA CCoP 2.0, Singapore Cybersecurity Act, PDPA, PCI DSS, and IMDA Code of Practice for Broadcasting & Telecommunications.
  • Host configuration review and hardening experience to CIS Level 1/2 benchmarks (Windows/Linux/network).
  • Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and operational technology (OT) or critical information infrastructure (CII), and trade-offs between public and private cloud environments.
  • Hands-on proficiency with Tenable Nessus or equivalent vulnerability management tooling; familiarity with SIEM/SOAR platforms (Sentinel, Chronicle, Splunk, QRadar) and EDR tools (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Carbon Black).
  • AI/LLM Security Governance: Familiarity with NIST AI RMF, OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, and MITRE ATLAS; experience assessing generative AI solutions for risk, data-privacy exposure, and adversarial threats (prompt injection, data poisoning, model inversion).
  • Scripting or automation capability (Python, KQL, PowerShell) applied to GRC workflows, evidence capture, or risk reporting.

Constantly review and ensure that current methodology conforms and meets industry standards.

job.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

Establish reliable and scalable quality engineering practices for StarHub’s digital platforms across mobile, web, backend and cloud-native systems. The Senior SDET will partner with engineering, product, architecture, DevOps/SRE, security and delivery teams to shift quality left, build meaningful automated quality gates, transition vendor-owned automation into sustainable in-house ownership, and provide fast, risk-based release confidence during migration, refactoring and platform modernisation initiatives.

Accountabilities

  • Take ownership of the existing test automation from vendors and establish clear quality and governance standards, documentation, CI integration, reliability and maintainability expectations so automation becomes an integral part of product engineering.
  • Improve coverage, reliability and efficiency of automated tests across different platforms like web, mobile and backend
  • Improve quality of releases in terms of user experience and satisfaction by ensuring testability and automated tests are treated as first class citizens in the SDLC

Responsibilities

  • Partner with developers to design and implement tests at the right layer of the test pyramid or testing trophy, including unit, component, contract, API, integration, e2e, visual, accessibility
  • Setup automated quality gates across the SDLC to ensure issues are found as early as possible
  • Establish and track metrics for test automation to drive improvement and accountability
  • Improve test automation coverage, reliability and efficiency.
  • Use AI agents and coding assistants responsibly to assist with test planning, requirements analysis, risk discovery, test design, automation development, test data generation, failure triage, coverage gap analysis, documentation and refactoring.
  • Build internal tools, libraries, and platforms that make quality practices easier for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, data setup, environment reliability and release confidence.
  • Work with stakeholders across engineering and QE to ensure alignment on automation approaches and goals.
  • Work with vendors to deliver automation solutions to the standards defined.
  • Write clear technical documentation, RFCs, test plans, READMEs, onboarding guides and quality playbooks.

Areas of Impact:

  • Stakeholders: QA, Engineering, Program/Delivery Management, Product
  • Decision Rights: Strongly advise QA/Automation tools and license purchase, strongly advise KPIs for the test automation team
  • Resources: ~10 automation resources from vendors as peers, some existing licenses for UiPath, BrowserStack

Ideal Track Record:

  • Delivered automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) covering significant critical user journeys and behaviours, measurable regression improvement times in hours if not in days
  • Designed, or at least significantly contributed to, and implemented automated test frameworks from scratch that have measurably improved test efficiency.
  • Designed dashboards for reporting on test automation stats to stakeholders
  • Integrated tests with CI/CD pipelines
  • Used AI coding assistants or agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent for testing, automation, documentation, triage or quality analysis.
  • Managed test environments and test automation infrastructure on cloud services like AWS, GCP, Browserstack, LambdaTest.
  • Built internal tools and utilities to make testing and QE easily accessible for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders improving productivity.

job.title: Associate Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Receive, inspect, asset-tag, label, store, issue, dispatch and track IT/network equipment and accessories.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records, including serial numbers, asset tags, warranty status, location, stock movement and project allocation.
  • Manage spare network equipment, SFPs, cables, modules, power supplies and other accessories.
  • Coordinate equipment delivery, collection and movement between warehouses, offices, vendors and customer sites.
  • Prepare equipment for deployment, including staging, packing, labelling and handover documentation.
  • Coordinate RMA, faulty equipment replacement, warranty claims, repairs and return-to-vendor activities.
  • Maintain delivery notes, collection forms, stock reports, inventory trackers and audit-ready documentation.

Level 1 Network Support

  • Perform basic checks on power, cabling, LED/link status, ports, SFPs and physical connectivity.
  • Assist with device staging, rack-and-stack, patching, labelling, hardware replacement and site deployment.
  • Perform first-level troubleshooting for LAN, WAN, WLAN, firewall and connectivity-related incidents.
  • Collect relevant technical information such as hostnames, IP addresses, serial numbers, device models, firmware versions, interface status, screenshots and basic logs.
  • Perform basic troubleshooting using ping, traceroute, cable checks and link verification.
  • Conduct post-replacement connectivity testing.
  • Maintain network documentation, including port maps, rack layouts, deployment trackers and inventory records.
  • Escalate complex routing, firewall, wireless, configuration or security issues to Level 2/3 engineers with clear diagnostic information.
  • Networking: Cisco, Aruba/HPE, Huawei, Palo Alto
  • Security: Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point
  • Management: ClearPass, Aruba Central, Cisco ISE, Panorama, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, Huawei NCE Campus

Qualifications

  • Minimum NITEC, Higher NITEC or equivalent in IT, Networking, Electronics, Logistics, Supply Chain, Warehouse Management or a related discipline.
  • Experience in IT logistics, warehouse operations, inventory management, IT asset management or network equipment handling.
  • Basic understanding of LAN, WAN, WLAN, IP addressing, VLANs, cabling and first-level network troubleshooting.
  • Able to identify and handle network equipment such as switches, routers, firewalls, access points, SFPs, modules, cables, power supplies and rack/patching components.
  • Comfortable performing basic physical and connectivity checks and assisting with equipment deployment or replacement.
  • Strong coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work with vendors, couriers, suppliers, field engineers, project managers and technical teams.
  • Good documentation and administrative skills, including experience with spreadsheets, ticketing systems, inventory systems and asset trackers.
  • Willing to work across warehouse, office and customer-site environments.
  • Comfortable supporting site rollouts, hardware refreshes, equipment swaps and scheduled maintenance activities when required.
  • Relevant hands-on experience may be considered in lieu of formal qualifications.

Preferred Certifications

  • CCNA
  • CompTIA Network+
  • ITIL Foundation
  • Huawei HCIA
  • Aruba entry-level certification
  • Palo Alto PCNSA
  • Fortinet entry-level certification
  • Equivalent networking/IT certifications

job.title: Senior Client Acquisition Manager (Financial Services Industry)

job.title: Bid & Commercial Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Provide contract management, bid management and post contract management support.

  • Analyze and advise on the solution, delivery, 3rd party, legal and finance risks associated with the bid accurately.

  • Reduce the losses caused by giving away important commercial legal positions through poor contract negotiations.

  • Negotiate and draft complicated ICT and telco deals and combined ICT / Telco deals.

  • Singapore citizenship due to security and sensitivity considerations
  • Minimum 6 or more years of experiences in contracts drafting and contracts negotiation:

-Customer contracts (e.g. RFP’s, RFQ’s, quotations, ITQ’s, MOU’s, letters of intent, NDA’s, etc); and

3rd party contracts (e.g. reseller, partner, teaming, subcontracts, SOW’s, MSA’s, etc).

  • Advantageous to possess an educational background in Law or related, however, not required
  • Minimum 5 years of experiences in managing complex tender bids and third party back to back contract negotiations

job.title: Support Manager (FRCS), CASE
job.description:

job.title: Service Line Marketing Manager

  • Lead end-to-end demand generation campaigns across digital, events, content, ABM and field marketing channels.

job.title: Solutions Specialist Lead, Cybersecurity
job.description:
Job Description

Role Overview The Cybersecurity Service Line Lead will be responsible for driving the growth, positioning, and delivery excellence of the cybersecurity business in Malaysia. Stationed in Malaysia, this role serves as the strategic and operational bridge between regional leadership, local sales teams, cybersecurity delivery functions. The ideal candidate brings deep cybersecurity expertise, strong commercial acumen, and hands on experience engaging with customers, enabling sales, and ensuring end to end implementation of cybersecurity solutions. This is a highly visible, high impact leadership role focused on expanding market presence, shaping solution offerings, and ensuring the successful delivery of secured deals within the Malaysian market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Leadership & Market Development

• Develop and execute the cybersecurity go to market strategy for Malaysia in alignment with regional business objectives. • Identify new market opportunities, emerging risks, and competitive trends to expand the cybersecurity footprint. • Build and nurture relationships with enterprise customers, industry partners, and cybersecurity associations to strengthen market presence. • Provide pre sales support including solution scoping, RFP/RFQ responses, and customer presentations.

  • Sales Collaboration & Revenue Growth

• Work hand in hand with the Malaysia sales team to drive cybersecurity pipeline growth and secure new business. • Provide sales enablement: coaching, solution insights, competitive positioning, and value articulation. • Assist in crafting tailored proposals and ensuring commercial viability of cybersecurity offerings. • Track pipeline progress and support forecast accuracy for cybersecurity business in Malaysia.

  • Solution Expertise & Offering Development

• Act as the subject matter expert for cybersecurity services and solutions, including consulting, managed security services, infrastructure security, cloud security, and compliance. • Collaborate with the Singapore Enterprise CISO and delivery teams to refine service offerings and ensure compliance with governance, risk, and security frameworks. • Contribute insights to regional product roadmaps based on customer feedback, emerging threats, and regulatory changes.

  • Delivery Alignment & Execution Excellence

• Ensure smooth handover of secured deals to delivery teams and maintain oversight of delivery quality and timelines. • Work closely with the Delivery Head to address escalations, resourcing needs, and project risks. • Monitor delivery performance, customer satisfaction, and SLAs for cybersecurity engagements. • Provide input to continuously improve delivery methodologies, processes, and cybersecurity capabilities.

  • Stakeholder Management & Regional Collaboration

• Maintain strong alignment and communication with both Singapore and Malaysia leaders on business performance and strategic priorities. • Liaise with the Singapore cybersecurity team to ensure cohesive security strategies and solution alignment across markets. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (sales, delivery, product, marketing) to execute regional cybersecurity initiatives.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience • Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; advanced certifications preferred (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CEH, ISO27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer). • At least 15 years of experience in cybersecurity, including at least 8 years in a leadership or service line management role. • Strong understanding of cybersecurity technologies, standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices. • Demonstrated success in supporting sales teams and driving revenue for cybersecurity services. • Proven experience managing or overseeing delivery of cybersecurity projects or managed services. • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business domains. • Able to travel within Malaysia and occasionally to Singapore.

job.title: Account Director (Hospitality)

job.title: Senior Manager, Category Lead
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and experienced Senior Category Manager to lead and oversee the development and execution of category strategies across multiple spend areas. This role will directly manage a team of category managers and play a critical role in driving commercial performance, supplier innovation, and enterprise-wide value creation.

The ideal candidate will combine strong leadership skills with deep procurement and category management expertise, along with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and foster cross-functional collaboration.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of category managers to ensure high performance and career growth.
  • Define and drive category strategies across assigned spend areas, ensuring alignment with business goals and procurement best practices.
  • Partner with senior business leaders to understand requirements, define sourcing strategies, and align procurement initiatives to enterprise objectives.
  • Oversee end-to-end sourcing processes, including market analysis, RFx, evaluation, negotiation, and contract management.
  • Promote supplier relationship management (SRM) practices to improve performance, foster innovation, and deliver sustainable value.
  • Conduct regular reviews and performance evaluations of strategic suppliers.
  • Drive cost optimization, risk mitigation, and supply assurance across categories.
  • Champion data-driven decision-making through spend analysis, market intelligence, and supplier benchmarking.
  • Ensure category strategies incorporate ESG, compliance, and risk considerations.
  • Contribute to the evolution of procurement policies, frameworks, and digital tools.
  • Act as a senior member of the procurement leadership team, supporting broader transformation, capability-building, and governance.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field (Master’s or CIPS certification is a plus).
  • At least 5 years of experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or procurement operations.
  • Proven track record of managing complex sourcing initiatives and delivering measurable value.
  • Commercially savvy with strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven track record of delivering cost savings, value creation, and risk mitigation.
  • Experience with procurement tools and systems.
  • High level of integrity, adaptability, and results orientation.
  • Results-oriented mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

job.title: Project Manager (ICT)
job.description:
Job Description

The Project Manager takes ownership for planning, delivering and achieving the objectives of complex or medium-to-large-scale projects. Project Manager defines the project management plan to manage the project progress, resource, cost; and facilitates interaction and tasks of various stakeholders to reduce the risks of overall failure. Project Manager applies knowledge and skills aligned with the industry’s project management best practices and methodologies. As such, Project Manager needs to have good understandings of the different phases from "Initiating" to "Closing" and be able to proficiently execute and adhere to the organisation’s project management processes.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Accountable for the start-to-finish delivery of complex, high-value or strategic projects with high quality, within budget and according to agreed schedule and users’ requirements
  • Front clients, provide status updates & ensure customer satisfaction is achieved
  • Manage relationships and align with diverse teams of internal/external stakeholders
  • Actively plan, manage and report project scope, schedules, cost and resources
  • Monitor resource utilization to facilitate planning and scheduling of resources
  • Identify, assess and manage the risks/issues of the project, and take appropriate prevention action or resolution
  • Manage escalations and project scope creep or mitigates it when it occurs, or changes in users’ requirements according to Change
  • Control processes, schedule slippage, technical problems and shortages of resources
  • Work closely with business/product managers and support teams to ensure end objectives are met
  • Willingness to take on additional functions, such as, involve in project (PMO) governance and process, mentor junior or new team members, participate in presales activities, corporate initiatives, etc.

Qualifications

  • Accredited University Degree in Project Management, IT or related disciplines. Relevant experience without the required educational portfolio will also be considered
  • Must possess Project Management Certification, e.g. CITPM, PMP, PRINCE2, SCRUM/AGPM, etc.
  • Minimum 5 years of Project Management experience, preferably in medium-to-large scale ICT projects in various industries, including Government, Education, Health, FSI, Hospitality/MICE or Commercials, etc.
  • Experience in working in large matrix organization or MNC
  • Knowledge of PMO or understand (and be able to apply) project management governance and process
  • Ability to demonstrate experience in managing diverse groups of stakeholders & clients
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation, negotiation and communication skills including ability to influence and communicate to all levels of stakeholders
  • Able to multi-task and is result-oriented, with energy and able to deliver in a very fast-paced environment
  • Logical and analytic approach in handling situations, problems or issues

*We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Product Manager - Managed Connectivity
job.description:

job.title: EBG QA Engineer
job.description:
Role Mission

The Dev-QA Engineer (CRM) is responsible for ensuring the reliability, quality, and stability of CRM platforms across EBG domains, including Whalecloud EBS, Salesforce (SFDC), and telco CRM ecosystems.

This role focuses on end-to-end CRM testing, integration validation, and automation across customer lifecycle processes (e.g., onboarding, billing, order management, customer data synchronization).

The engineer will collaborate closely with developers, integration teams, and business stakeholders to establish robust QA frameworks, automation practices, and quality gates, ensuring high system integrity across cross-platform integrations and cloud migration initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated and manual test cases for CRM systems (Whalecloud EBS / SFDC / Telco CRM platforms).
  • Validate end-to-end CRM flows, including:
  • Customer onboarding & lifecycle
  • Order management & fulfillment
  • Billing and charging integrations
  • Customer data synchronization across systems

Perform integration testing across multiple platforms, including:

  • CRM ↔ Billing (e.g., BSCS)
  • CRM ↔ Middleware (Axway / APIs)
  • CRM ↔ Data platforms (EDW, ODS)

Develop and execute API testing (REST/SOAP) for CRM services and integrations. Build and maintain test automation frameworks for:

  • API testing
  • UI testing (where applicable for SFDC / portals)
  • Batch and file-based processing validation

Collaborate with developers to:

  • Define test scenarios and acceptance criteria
  • Ensure sufficient test coverage for new features and integrations

Support UAT, SIT, and regression testing cycles, ensuring alignment with business requirements. Validate data integrity and reconciliation across systems (critical for telco and financial flows). Identify defects, perform root cause analysis, and ensure timely resolution with development teams. Establish and enforce QA best practices, including:

  • Test strategy
  • Test data management
  • Defect lifecycle management

Participate in release validation and production readiness checks, especially for CRM-related deployments. Support cloud migration testing (e.g., AWS), ensuring system behavior consistency post-migration.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–6+ years of experience in QA / Dev-QA roles, preferably in CRM or telco environments.
  • Strong experience in CRM systems, such as:
  • Whalecloud EBS (preferred)
  • Salesforce (SFDC)
  • Other telco CRM platforms

Hands-on experience in:

  • API testing (Postman, REST tools)
  • Integration testing across multiple systems
  • SQL and data validation

Experience with test automation tools/frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, or similar). Familiarity with batch processing, file-based integrations, and middleware platforms. Understanding of end-to-end telco processes:

  • Customer lifecycle
  • Billing & charging
  • Order management

Experience working in Agile / DevOps environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in Whalecloud EBS implementation or support
  • Experience in Salesforce QA (Apex testing, integration validation)
  • Knowledge of Axway / API Gateway integrations
  • Exposure to AWS/cloud migration testing
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab, Bitbucket pipelines)
  • Familiarity with data platforms (EDW, ODS) and reconciliation testing
  • Understanding of telco architecture and cross-system dependencies

job.title: Senior Engineer, Security Platform & Infrastructure
job.description:
Job Description

Overview

As the Senior Engineer for Security Platform and Infrastructure, you will manage and enhance endpoint security across telecommunication environments. The role includes Day 1 implementation and Day 2 operational support activities related to Design, Implement and Manage the Security platforms and coordination with Managed Security Service Providers (MSSP) and OEMs.

This role requires expertise in endpoint security technologies, threat detection, operational governance, and collaboration with internal teams, vendors, and MSSP partners to ensure secure and reliable operations. On top of this desire to learn, think out of the box and introduce new security initiatives to support Day 1 and Day 2’s responsibilities.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead and participate in the deployment, configuration, and onboarding of EDR solutions across telecommunications environments including servers, workstations, cloud workloads, and remote endpoints.
  • Perform EDR agent deployment, health verification, policy configuration, and integration with other platforms like ticketing, SIEM and SOAR platforms.
  • Coordinate with infrastructure, network, cloud, and application teams for successful onboarding and rollout activities.
  • Work closely with MSSP partners and vendors during implementation, transition, and go-live phases.
  • Validate log forwarding, alert generation, telemetry collection, and endpoint visibility across environments.
  • Support infrastructure readiness activities including sizing, connectivity validation, firewall rules, proxy configurations, and cloud integrations.
  • Participate in Proof of Concepts (POC), product evaluations, feature testing, and security tool assessments.
  • Develop onboarding documentation, operational runbooks, implementation procedures, and knowledge transfer materials.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity architecture and governance teams to align EDR deployment with security standards and compliance requirements.
  • Conduct tuning and optimization of EDR policies, detection rules, exclusions, and alert thresholds to reduce false positives.
  • Manage endpoint security posture by monitoring agent health, policy compliance, coverage gaps, and platform performance.
  • Perform Day 2 operational activities including upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, policy management, and platform maintenance.
  • Support Infra related vulnerability, remediation coordination, and hardening initiatives.
  • Support audit, compliance, and regulatory activities related to endpoint security platform and operations.
  • Coordinate with vendors and MSSP partners for issue resolution, feature enhancements, and product roadmap discussions related to the platform.
  • Participate in 24x7 on-call support and incident related to the platform and infra whenever required and need to be on standby.
  • Lead and work with cross-functional stakeholders and processes to meet the business requirements.

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security, or related discipline.
  • 2 – 4 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, EDR management, SOC operations, or endpoint security engineering within telecommunication or large-scale environments.
  • Familiarity with EDR/XDR platforms such as Palo Alto XDR or CrowdStrike Falcon or Sentinel One or VMware Carbon Black.
  • Experience working with MSSP/SOC providers and managing operational governance.
  • Familiarity with Windows, Linux, macOS, cloud (AWS and Ali), and hybrid infra environments.
  • Familiarity with PowerShell, Python, or Bash scripting is an advantage.
  • Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK framework and endpoint attack techniques.
  • Good to have certifications such as CEH, CISSP, Security+, GIAC, or vendor-specific EDR certifications.

Essential Skills

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience in endpoint security and security operations.
  • Effective stakeholders, vendors, and MSSP management capabilities.
  • Good communication and incident coordination skills.
  • Knowledge of operational governance, SLA management, and service delivery.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SOC, infrastructure, application, and security teams.

job.title: Functional Lead, People Systems
job.description:
Role Mission

Lead the business process design, functional optimisation, and adoption of StarHub’s People Systems to enable effective workforce management, compliant HR operations, and a modern employee experience. This role acts as the functional authority for People Systems, translating HR strategy and business needs into clear process design, system requirements, and adoption outcomes across the employee lifecycle.

Accountabilities Own end-to-end functional design and optimisation of People Systems across the hire-to-retire lifecycle. Serve as the primary business interface between HR, IS, and vendors for People Systems initiatives. Ensure HR processes are standardised, scalable, and system-enabled, not workaround-driven. Drive adoption of People Systems through clear process design, governance, and usability. Ensure functional alignment with HR policies, compliance requirements, and workforce strategy.

Responsibilities Lead functional design for People Systems processes, including core HR, recruitment, performance, rewards, learning, and workforce administration. Translate HR business needs, policies, and operating models into clear functional requirements and process flows. Define and maintain end-to-end HR process standards, ensuring consistency across business units. Partner with HR stakeholders to simplify, harmonise, and optimise HR processes before system enablement. Work closely with IS and vendors to ensure system configuration reflects intended business outcomes, not technical convenience. Define functional acceptance criteria and support UAT to ensure solutions meet business needs. Drive functional governance, including change impact assessment, prioritisation, and release readiness from a business perspective. Support HR change and adoption efforts through clear articulation of what is changing, why, and how work will be done differently. Monitor process performance and user feedback to identify continuous improvement opportunities.

Areas of Impact Consistent, efficient HR processes across the enterprise. Improved employee and manager experience through clear, intuitive People Systems processes. Reduced manual work, exceptions, and policy deviations. Strong alignment between HR strategy, policy, and system-enabled execution. Improved adoption and value realisation from HR transformation initiatives

Ideal Track Record 8–12 years of experience in HR operations, HR transformation, or People Systems functional roles. Strong hands-on experience designing end-to-end HR processes across the employee lifecycle. Proven ability to translate HR policy and business needs into system-enabled process design. Experience working with enterprise HR platforms (e.g. SAP SuccessFactors) from a functional/business perspective. Demonstrated success partnering with HR, IS, and vendors in complex organisations. Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments preferred

job.title: Technical Project Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Project Manager who can combine agile delivery discipline with deep technical literacy to coordinate development and release cycles across StarHub’s digital domains.

In this role, you will work closely with Domain Owners (DOs), Engineering Managers (EMs), Journey Solution Designers (SDs), and Release Program Managers (RPMs) to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery across systems that support StarHub’s consumer and enterprise journeys.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with agile project delivery in a DevOps or software engineering environment, preferably both front-end and back-end within modern native environments — with a solid understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, microservices, observability, and end-to-end delivery metrics.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery & Agile Management

  • Drive agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and maintain team rhythm and cadence.
  • Manage backlog hygiene, ensuring stories are well-defined, estimated, and prioritized.
  • Plan and execute phased delivery strategies, ensuring release readiness through Blue/Green deployments, canary releases, and feature flagging.
  • Track delivery health through velocity, throughput, and scope stability metrics.
  • Identify and resolve blockers, risks, and cross-domain dependencies early.
  • Maintain clear delivery dashboards and status reporting to senior stakeholders.

Technical Coordination & Planning

  • Partner with Domain Owners and Tech Leads to align on architecture, delivery scope, and capacity planning.
  • Coordinate with DevOps and QA/QE teams to ensure readiness for integration, testing, and release.
  • Support implementation of continuous delivery and observability practices across teams.
  • Define, Monitor and report on key delivery KPIs, including deployment frequency, Mean Time To Recovery, defect Leakage rate, change failure rate ensuring all releases meet defined Service Level Objectives and performance baselines.
  • Participate in sprint demos and ensure acceptance criteria are met for each increment.

Stakeholder & Cross-Domain Collaboration

  • Work with Journey Solution Designers (SDs) and Release Program Managers (RPMs) to align sprint deliverables to journey-level milestones.
  • Collaborate with Journey Owners (JOs) and business stakeholders to clarify priorities and expected outcomes.
  • Communicate risks, decisions, and delivery trade-offs clearly across key stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement & Governance

  • Drive adoption of agile and DevOps best practices across DXP teams.
  • Analyze delivery metrics to identify improvement opportunities in velocity, predictability, and quality.
  • Support incident RCA reviews and ensure learnings are converted into actionable backlog improvements.
  • Contribute to standardized delivery governance, templates, and documentation across domains

Qualifications

Requirements & Qualifications

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Agile, PMP, or DevOps certifications (e.g., CSM, SAFe, PMI-ACP) preferred.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in software delivery or digital product management, with at least 3 years in a technical project management, delivery lead or scrum master capacity.
  • Proven track record managing agile teams delivering software through CI/CD pipelines within modern cloud native architecture and container orchestration (EKS/Kubernetes).
  • Proven experience coordinating frontend (Vue.js, Flutter) and backend engineering deliveries.
  • Strong understanding of API management, event-driven architecture, and modern deployment strategies (Blue/Green, Canary, Feature Flags).
  • Strong familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Jenkins, Monday.com, Splunk.
  • Experience in telecommunications, digital platform delivery, or large-scale integration programs is an advantage.

Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile, DevOps, and continuous delivery practices.
  • Ability to translate technical complexity into clear, actionable plans.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a bias for execution.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and resilient in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

job.title: Brand & Social Manager / Senior Manager
job.description:
Job Description

This role shapes an iconic brand by defining the strategy and driving the execution of the StarHub brand across the Consumer Business. As guardian of the StarHub brand, this person brings the brand voice to life across paid, owned and earned touchpoints, including social and influencer channels, to drive reach and engagement with key audiences. This role works closely with the Corporate Comms & Brand and Enterprise teams to ensure alignment and coherence in everything we do.

job.title: Senior Engineer
job.description:
Job Description- Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Role Overview

We are looking for a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating enterprise cloud and application infrastructure. The role will own the technical architecture and implementation of servers, virtualization, Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms, networking, storage, and application deployment environments, while working closely with technology vendors and system integrators for implementation and support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy hybrid cloud and on-prem infrastructure across AWS, VMware, Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud, including GPU compute platforms.
  • Architect and implement Kubernetes/OpenShift platforms, covering cluster design, sizing, HA, networking, storage, security and DR.
  • Define compute, GPU, virtualization, storage, network and capacity architectures for enterprise and cloud-native workloads.
  • Design application platforms using VMs, containers, Kubernetes/OpenShift and cloud-native services; support application onboarding and migration.
  • Implement IaC and automation using Terraform/Ansible and CI/CD pipelines for repeatable infrastructure deployment.
  • Integrate platforms with IAM, DNS, load balancers, PKI, monitoring, logging, backup and security services.
  • Own HLD/LLD, architecture reviews, sizing, implementation plans, acceptance criteria and operational runbooks.
  • Drive performance, resilience, security, capacity management, lifecycle upgrades, patching and technology refresh.
  • Support POCs/MVPs involving cloud, GPU, Kubernetes, automation and emerging infrastructure technologies.

Vendor & Partner Management

  • Act as technical owner for cloud, infrastructure and system-integration vendors.
  • Evaluate and recommend solutions across AWS, VMware, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, Kubernetes/OpenShift, GPU and virtualization.
  • Review vendor HLD/LLD, configurations, deployment plans and technical deliverables.

Opportunities to learning and development and get involvement in the advanced technology projects.

  • The opportunities includes learning and development in advanced technology areas such as-Agentic AI, Knowledge graph, AI security and Quantum Security.
  • Agentic AI & Knowledge Graph: LangGraph, OpenAI/Azure AI Foundry, Neo4j, GraphRAG, vector databases, RAG and AI orchestration frameworks.
  • AI & Quantum Security: Palo Alto AI security, NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, IBM watsonx.governance, HSM/KMS, PKI, PQC, cryptographic discovery and crypto-agility tools.

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with Linux servers, virtualization, compute, storage, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and/or OpenShift; experience managing vendor-led implementations is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of private cloud, hybrid cloud, and cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Experience with Docker/container platforms, Helm, Git, and CI/CD.
  • Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or other Infrastructure-as-Code technologies.
  • Strong understanding of networking including DNS, load balancing, routing, firewalls, VPN, ingress/egress, and network segmentation.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure monitoring, logging, observability, backup, and disaster recovery
  • Scripting/programming knowledge in Python, Bash, or similar languages.

Qualifications

Experience & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
  • 5-8 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, systems engineering, or related roles.
  • Proven experience in building enterprise infrastructure and deploying applications.
  • Experience working with technology vendors/system integrators on infrastructure implementation projects.
  • Cloud, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or infrastructure certifications are desirable.

Key Competencies

  • Cloud & infrastructure architecture
  • Server and platform engineering
  • Kubernetes/OpenShift platform management
  • Application deployment
  • Infrastructure automation
  • Vendor and system-integrator management
  • DevSecOps and infrastructure security
  • Troubleshooting and technical problem solving
  • Capacity, scalability, availability and resilience
  • Strong technical documentation and stakeholder management

job.title: Partner Manager, Platform Technology
job.description:
Job Description

-Manage end-to-end relationships with technology vendors whose products and services form the foundational building blocks of the organisation's internally-built platform, which is productised and offered as-a-Service to customers.

  • Collaborate closely with the Enterprise Architect and key technology vendors to co-develop and incubate new service offerings that can be built on top of the organisation's existing managed services portfolio — translating vendor technology capabilities into differentiated, market-ready services.
  • Engage vendors as strategic innovation partners to identify emerging technology capabilities (e.g., AI-driven operations, SASE, network analytics, automated remediation) that can be integrated into the managed services stack and brought to market as new revenue-generating offerings.
  • Work with the Enterprise Architect to assess the technical feasibility, integration complexity, and architectural fit of new vendor-enabled services; support the development of service blueprints, reference architectures, and go-to-market collateral for new offerings.
  • Participate in joint roadmap planning sessions with vendors to align vendor product evolution with the organisation's managed services strategy, ensuring new platform capabilities are proactively adopted into the service portfolio.
  • Design and maintain Unit of Measure (UOM)-based cost structures that decompose underlying vendor costs into granular, service-consumable units (e.g., per user, per device, per node, per GB, per API call, per ticket, per licence seat), forming the basis for the platform's customer-facing pricing, tiered service packages, and margin management.
  • Translate vendor commercial schedules into standardised internal cost-to-serve models and rate cards, enabling accurate platform product pricing, cost allocation across service tiers, and P&L visibility for the platform business.
  • Perform projected vs. actuals cost reconciliation using UOM consumption data to ensure platform economics remain aligned with customer consumption patterns; identify and address licence over-provisioning, under-utilisation, and cost inefficiencies.
  • Collaborate with Presales, and Solutions Architecture teams to ensure vendor component costs and new service constructs are accurately reflected in the platform's commercial offerings — including subscription tiers, consumption-based billing, and bundled service packages.
  • Lead end-to-end contract negotiations, renewals, and amendments for platform vendor agreements in collaboration with Legal and Procurement; structure vendor terms to support scalability, multi-tenancy, co-innovation, and service-level commitments of the customer-facing platform.
  • Own platform vendor spend tracking and budget forecasting in collaboration with Finance; identify cost optimisation opportunities through vendor consolidation, volume-based pricing negotiations, licence reclamation, and UOM tier renegotiation to improve platform gross margin.
  • Conduct periodic vendor risk assessments for platform components covering cybersecurity posture, regulatory compliance (e.g., MAS TRM, PDPA), availability, and business continuity — ensuring vendor risks do not cascade into customer-impacting service disruptions.
  • Conduct RFI/RFP/RFQ processes for platform component refresh or new capability onboarding; benchmark existing vendor terms and technologies against market alternatives to keep the platform competitive.
  • Produce executive-ready dashboards and reports on platform vendor costs, new service development pipeline, component performance, licence utilisation, and risk posture for Product, Technology, Finance, and C-suite stakeholders.

Qualifications

-Degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field with at least 5–8 years of relevant experience in technology vendor management, platform product commercialisation, or technology procurement within a managed services, telco, or enterprise IT environment.

  • Demonstrated experience in co-developing or incubating new technology service offerings in partnership with vendors and enterprise architects, translating vendor capabilities into managed services or as-a-Service products.
  • Demonstrated experience in building UOM-based cost structures and pricing models for technology platform services (e.g., per-user, per-device, per-GB, per-transaction), with the ability to translate vendor input costs into customer-facing service pricing and margin models.
  • Proven experience managing commercial relationships and contracts with platform technology vendors such as ServiceNow, Palo Alto, HPE/Aruba, AWS, Elastic/Datadog, or equivalent.
  • Understanding of platform product economics — including cost-to-serve modelling, tiered subscription pricing, consumption-based billing, and gross margin management for as-a-Service offerings.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture concepts and the ability to engage meaningfully with Enterprise Architects on service design, integration patterns, and technology roadmap alignment.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or shared-infrastructure cost allocation models is advantageous.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Enterprise Architecture, Presales, Solutions Architecture, Service Delivery, and Finance teams to align vendor innovation and commercial structures with the organisation's managed services and go-to-market strategy.
  • Strong analytical and commercial acumen; able to translate complex vendor cost structures, new service economics, and performance metrics into clear narratives for product, finance, and C-suite audiences.
  • Able to manage multiple vendor relationships concurrently, work independently, and thrive in a dynamic environment where the platform product and managed services portfolio are continuously evolving.

job.title: Growth Manager, MVNO
job.description:

This role will be responsible for accelerating subscriber growth and revenue performance through strategic engagement with existing partners and the development of new partnerships. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, you will take a data-driven and experimental approach to unlock growth opportunities, collaborating closely across brand, product, and operations. job.title: Senior Provisioning DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Role Mission:

The Application DevOps Engineer will be involved in the end-to-end delivery lifecycle including solution design, application development, QC testing, CI/CD automation and continuous optimization of cloud-native platforms. The candidate will need to manage Kubernetes operations, infrastructure provisioning and software upgrades to ensure systems remain reliable, secure and scalable. The candidate will be working in a team in routine on-call rotations to support day-to-day operations, incident resolution, customer care and defect fixes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and Development:
  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and resilient microservices using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with Apache Camel and its core Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIPs).
  • Implement RESTful APIs and ensure services meet performance, security, and stability requirements.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and efficient code following best practices and design patterns.
  • Containerization and Deployment:
  • Develop and manage services deployed on OpenShift/Kubernetes, including defining Dockerfiles and Kubernetes resource configurations (Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, etc.).
  • Work with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) for automated build, test, and deployment.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot services running in the OpenShift environment.
  • Architecture and Data:
  • Contribute to the architectural design of microservices, focusing on principles like loose coupling, high cohesion, and fault tolerance.
  • Implement various data persistence technologies, including relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).
  • Integrate services using messaging systems (e.g., Red Hat AMQ) where required.
  • Collaboration and Quality:
  • Perform code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge within the team.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards and industry regulations by performing security vulnerability scans (SAST, DAST, SCA) and disaster recovery exercise.
  • Support on-call duty on shift rotation and handle production incident and root cause analysis with minimal supervision.
  • Knowledge Management:
  • Build technical documentation from scratch, maintaining working documents on architecture overviews, API specifications and system integrations.
  • Create and maintain operational runbooks to support the team and internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.

• Java Expertise: Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in developing enterprise applications using Java and the Spring Boot framework.

• Microservices and API: Strong understanding of microservices architecture, principles, and best practices. Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.

• Containerization: Proficient with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift for deployment and orchestration. Experience with OpenShift-specific features is a significant advantage.

• Database: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.

• Tools: Familiarity with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD tools.

• Combined experience in DevOps, SRE, or Software Engineering. • Familiar with containerized environments, Kubernetes internals, and Helm. • Hands-on production experience with Jenkins and CI/CD best practices. • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript). • Solid understanding of AWS core services, IAM security, and cost-optimization practices. • Comfortable with Linux internals, networking fundamentals, and shell scripting. • Agile mindset with experience working in Scrum teams. • Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.

  • Develop and manage services deployed on OpenShift/Kubernetes, including defining Dockerfiles and Kubernetes resource configurations (Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, etc.).
  • Work with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) for automated build, test, and deployment.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot services running in the OpenShift environment.
  • Architecture and Data:
  • Contribute to the architectural design of microservices, focusing on principles like loose coupling, high cohesion, and fault tolerance.
  • Implement various data persistence technologies, including relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis).
  • Integrate services using messaging systems (e.g., Red Hat AMQ) where required.
  • Collaboration and Quality:
  • Perform code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge within the team.
  • Ensure compliance with security standards and industry regulations by performing security vulnerability scans (SAST, DAST, SCA) and disaster recovery exercise.
  • Support on-call duty on shift rotation and handle production incident and root cause analysis with minimal supervision.
  • Knowledge Management:
  • Build technical documentation from scratch, maintaining working documents on architecture overviews, API specifications and system integrations.
  • Create and maintain operational runbooks to support the team and internal stakeholders.
  • AI Competency:
  • Familiar with or have experience in agentic SDLC with competencies in prompt and context engineering, agent orchestration and supervision, and AI assisted delivery.
  • Automate data gathering, pattern finding, auto fixing or self-healing with anomaly detection and analysis.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Java Expertise: Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in developing enterprise applications using Java and the Spring Boot framework.
  • Microservices and API: Strong understanding of microservices architecture, principles, and best practices. Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs.
  • Containerization: Proficient with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift for deployment and orchestration. Experience with OpenShift-specific features is a significant advantage.
  • Database: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
  • Tools: Familiarity with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD tools.
  • Combined experience in DevOps, SRE, or Software Engineering.
  • Familiar with containerized environments, Kubernetes internals, and Helm.
  • Hands-on production experience with Jenkins and CI/CD best practices.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Solid understanding of AWS core services, IAM security, and cost-optimization practices.
  • Comfortable with Linux internals, networking fundamentals, and shell scripting.
  • Agile mindset with experience working in Scrum teams.
  • Experience with AIOps practices and tools is an added advantage.

job.title: Platform Lead, Mobile Engineering (4G/5G)
job.description:

The Platform Lead, Mobile Engineering is responsible for the strategy, design, deployment, operation, and commercial success of Private 4G/5G Mobile Core platforms and services. The role leads a multidisciplinary team responsible for building and operating secure, resilient, and scalable private cellular networks for enterprise, industrial, campus, utilities, transportation, smart city, and mission-critical environments.

The Lead will own the end-to-end lifecycle of the Private Mobile Core service, including solution architecture, platform engineering, network operations, service assurance, customer onboarding, vendor management, and innovation. The role will also drive the adoption of cloud-native 5G Core technologies, network automation, AI-enabled operations, and industry-specific solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Mobile Core Architecture and Design

  • Enterprise Private Core (4G/5G)
  • IMS platforms
  • Subscriber management systems
  • Authentication and security platforms
  • Network slicing architecture
  • Edge computing integration
  • Operational support systems
  • Define standards for:
  • High availability
  • Security
  • Multi-tenancy
  • Scalability
  • Regulatory compliance
  • Drive cloud-native and containerized mobile core architectures.

Platform Engineering and Service Delivery

  • Lead the engineering team responsible for:
  • Platform build and deployment
  • Core network integration
  • Automation and orchestration
  • Software upgrades
  • Technology lifecycle management
  • Establish Infrastructure-as-Code and Network-as-Code practices.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for network functions.
  • Oversee onboarding of new customer environments and services.

Network Operations and Service Assurance

  • Own 24x7 operational performance of the Private Mobile Core platform.

  • Incident management
  • Problem management
  • Change management
  • Capacity management
  • Service assurance
  • Drive operational excellence through:
  • AIOps
  • Predictive analytics
  • Automated remediation

Security and Compliance (work with CISO)

  • Ensure compliance with telecommunications regulations and spectrum requirements.
  • Establish security controls for:
  • Subscriber data
  • Core network functions

  • Edge computing environments

Vendor and Ecosystem ManagementManage strategic partnerships with mobile core ecosystem providers such as:

Organization StructureThe Lead will lead a team comprising:

Platform Engineering & Operations TeamResponsible for:

  • Core deployment
  • Integration
  • Automation
  • Lifecycle management

  • Incident response
  • Service assurance
  • Change management

Requirements

job.title: Application Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking a talented and analytical Application Engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will apply your software engineering expertise to design, develop, debug, and implement high-quality web applications and specialized utility programs that meet our end-users' needs.

Working with a high degree of autonomy, you will tackle unfamiliar technical challenges, recommend continuous improvements to existing applications, and ensure system reliability. The ideal candidate is a structured thinker, an eager learner, and a collaborative team player who communicates ideas effectively and integrates seamlessly into a dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities

job.title: Salesforce/CloudSense Lead
job.description:
Job Description

job.description:
Job Description

The Principal Systems Analyst drives the delivery of enhancement requests and projects across Enterprise applications. Working with business stakeholders, internal engineering teams, and external vendors, the role balances priorities, resources, and timelines while shaping practical solutions on Salesforce (SFDC) CRM and peripheral systems. The incumbent champions process optimisation, quality assurance, and continuous improvement in a fast-paced, multi-project environment.

Responsibilities

  • EBG pipeline management: manage the SURF request and project pipeline across all EBG applications, balancing priorities, resources, and timelines to keep delivery on track
  • Multi stream leadership: guide multiple work streams simultaneously, coach project leads, standardize practices, and ensure each release meets scope, schedule, and quality expectations
  • Solution direction: provide solutioning guidance on SFDC and cross system designs, ensuring practicality, seamless integration, and future readiness
  • Budget ownership and vendor management: own and monitor the Group B budget, partner with vendors to align deliverables, resolve issues, and maintain strong working relationships
  • Process optimization: champion initiatives that simplify workflows, eliminate manual workarounds, and improve deployment reliability
  • Testing and release assurance: oversee SIT, UAT, and production readiness checkpoints, ensuring smooth handovers to operations with minimal post release disruption
  • Primary liaison: serve as the main contact for business leaders, PMO, and technology teams, provide clear updates, manage expectations, and address risks promptly
  • People leadership: lead business analysts, developers, and testers, fostering a collaborative culture focused on ownership, continuous learning, and high quality delivery
  • Governance representation: present delivery status, risk mitigations, and key decisions in change boards and steering committees, ensuring transparency and organizational alignment
  • Continuous improvement mindset: promote a culture that proactively identifies opportunities and embeds lessons learned into future deliveries
  • Stakeholder liaison and management: liaise with business stakeholders to gather and prioritise requirements and act as the primary point of contact for all EBG SURF requests
  • Release coordination: coordinate SIT, UAT, and production-readiness activities, production deployment, investigate issues, and drive root-cause analysis to ensure smooth handovers to operations
  • Application and process analysis: conduct analysis of existing applications and business processes, produce functional specifications, and recommend preventive actions for enhancements and defects

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in application delivery, systems analysis, or solution design within large-scale enterprise or telecommunications environments
  • Hands-on expertise with Salesforce Sales and Service Clouds, including declarative tools (Flows, Process Builder) and integration patterns; certifications advantageous
  • Solid understanding of order management, billing, and provisioning processes and their interaction across CRM and fulfilment systems
  • Proven experience managing project budgets and vendor relationships, with strong negotiation and issue-resolution skills
  • Familiarity with Agile/DevOps methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and REST/SOAP APIs
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a history of driving root-cause analysis and preventive measures
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, able to bridge technical and business viewpoints effectively
  • Demonstrated leadership in guiding cross-functional teams and delivering multiple concurrent projects under tight deadlines
  • Experience with Telco transformation, CRM, CPQ (CloudSense) and Digital Channels considered an advantage
  • Knowledge and experience in Telco BSS/OSS considered an advantage

job.title: Manager, Cybersecurity Assurance
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:The role of Cyber GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) is to ensure that an organization's cybersecurity strategy aligns with its business goals, manages policies/standards/frameworks, manages cyber risks effectively, provides oversight and independent 2nd line control review/testing, and adheres to external regulations.

Accountabilities

  • Drive and lead the end-to-end lifecycle of information security governance & policy management.
  • Drive and lead the cyber risk management and reporting.
  • Drive and lead the 2nd line assurance & compliance monitoring.
  • Drive 2nd line oversight and support for audit engagement with 1st line stakeholders.
  • Drive security culture, advisory & stakeholder engagement

Responsibilities

  • Manage the development of Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies for adoption
  • Manage the Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies compliance risk
  • Manage the cyber risk oversight by evaluating the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management practices and controls implemented by 1st line (i.e. risk owner, control owner, control supervisor, control performers) of Starhub to ensure proper adherence to risk assessment processes.
  • Manage the Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies security/risk deviation process
  • Manage the Starhub risk profile and maintain the Starhub risk register for IT Security / Cybersecurity risks relating to CII & Non-CII
  • Develop and drive regular monitoring and reporting of Starhub key risk indicators for Cybersecurity
  • Manage regular risk reporting and risk escalation to Senior Management or other relevant risk forums
  • Manage Control & Compliance Framework through timely updates of industry standards and regulatory compliance requirements
  • Perform 2nd line assurance review (e.g. control review/testing) on 1st line stakeholders to ensure adherence with Starhub policies and Sub-policies / Regulatory compliance requirements, provide actionable, recommendations, and engage stakeholders for implementation
  • Provide timely communication / awareness to stakeholders on Starhub policies and sub-policies for implementation
  • Provide advisory to stakeholders on Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies requirement
  • Conduct briefings and trainings on Cyber risk / Policy awareness (i.e. Cyber risk management process, Policy compliance, Emerging cyber risk/trend, Issues and Observations from 2nd line control review/testing, and audit related findings) to relevant stakeholders and to support the Starhub Cybersecurity Awareness Programme.
  • Provide 2nd Line oversight and support throughout the audit engagement with 1st line stakeholders: ensuring readiness before the audit begins, facilitating fieldwork execution, and monitoring remediation of findings post-audit.
  • Maintaining a tracker for audit findings (or audit issues registers) to monitor remediation progress, to ensure audit closure issues, to support the scoping for 2nd line assurance review.

Qualifications

1.More than 5 years of experience in information/cybersecurity and risk management Experience in leading cybersecurity risk assessment and risk reduction initiatives

2.Experience in IT/IT-Security policy development and implementation

3.Experience in driving IT-security thematic assessment and IT audits

4.Good knowledge and experience with handling IT-security and cybersecurity audits

5.Good knowledge of experience in driving compliance to meet cybersecurity regulatory requirements

6.Good problem analysis and resolution skills

7.Good and experience stakeholder management skills
