job.description:
Date: 31 Aug 2026

Location:

Macquarie Park, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

**

About the role

As our Service Delivery Provisioning Manager, you’ll lead the end-to-end delivery and activation of complex telecommunications services for enterprise, wholesale and consumer customers. You’ll manage a team of approximately 10 Network Engineers and oversee the full order-to-activation lifecycle across a broad portfolio of voice, data and connectivity products, including enterprise internet, private networks, Ethernet, SD-WAN, optical transport, SIP trunking, inbound voice and nbn-based access services.

This is a high-impact leadership role focused on improving delivery quality, speed and consistency. You’ll shape operational strategy, govern outsourced delivery partners, strengthen processes and knowledge management, and champion automation across a changing network portfolio, including the evolution towards NaaS and SASE convergence.

**

What You’ll Do

  • Lead service delivery provisioning operations across the Optus product catalogue, ensuring SLA commitments, order-to-activation targets and quality standards are achieved.
  • Lead, coach and performance-manage a team of Network Engineers, building capability, workforce capacity and a cross-skilled engineering team.
  • Govern outsourced delivery partners through clear quality standards, vendor KPIs, knowledge transfer and process discipline.
  • Act as the escalation authority for complex or business-critical provisioning issues, removing blockers and driving timely resolution.
  • Establish and monitor performance across cycle time, first-time-right, backlog, rework, SLA compliance and vendor quality, communicating trends, risks and remediation plans to senior leaders.
  • Partner with Product, Sales, Solutions Architecture, Network Operations, Service Assurance and IT platform owners to support product readiness, service handover, fault resolution, operational acceptance and new product onboarding.
  • Identify recurring issues and automation opportunities, guiding workflow, tooling, scripting and continuous-improvement initiatives across the provisioning function.
  • Prepare the team for new ways of working by building capability, supporting change adoption and embedding new technologies, tools and delivery practices into day-to-day operations.

**

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • 8+ years’ experience in telecommunications, including at least 3 years leading network engineering, service delivery or provisioning teams in a carrier, managed service provider or vendor environment.
  • Proven experience owning service delivery provisioning operations at scale across voice and data services, ideally within a Tier 1 or Tier 2 operator, with external carrier or vendor experience highly regarded.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise connectivity and voice services, including Internet, IPVPN, Ethernet WAN, SD-WAN, DWDM transport, SIP trunking, cloud-based voice and OTT voice models.
  • Sound understanding of the complete order-to-activation lifecycle, OSS/BSS and order management platforms, ITSM tools, network fundamentals and service handover. Experience with platforms such as ServiceNow, Netcracker, Blue Planet or Siebel is advantageous.
  • Demonstrated capability in outsourced partner management, product readiness, BRT/UAT, operational acceptance, process governance and root-cause resolution.
  • Strong people leadership, stakeholder engagement and analytical skills, with the confidence to influence engineering, product, sales and senior stakeholders at Director level and above. Automation and scripting literacy, particularly Python, is preferred.
  • A Bachelor of Engineering in Telecommunications, Electronics or IT, or equivalent industry experience. CCNA/CCNP, ITIL Foundation or PMP qualifications are desirable.

**

job.title: Oracle Fusion ERP Functional Consultant-Finance
job.description:
Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion ERP Functional Consultant with strong hands-on expertise across Oracle Fusion Financials and related ERP modules. The role involves working directly with business users, analyzing requirements, resolving production issues, supporting implementations or enhancements, and contributing to project documentation and testing activities.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a support model, managing multiple assignments independently, and engaging with customers as a functional expert

Responsibilities

  • Work directly with business users as an Oracle Cloud ERP functional expert to understand requirements, issues, and business priorities.
  • Gather and analyze business requirements, perform fit-gap analysis, and recommend functional solutions aligned with Oracle Fusion ERP capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across Oracle Fusion ERP modules in a support environment.
  • Prepare and contribute to project documentation, including solution design documents, functional specifications, setup documents, test scripts, and training materials.
  • Configure Oracle Fusion ERP modules and write functional configuration documents.
  • Create, review, and execute test scenarios across SIT, UAT, and other test environments.
  • Collaborate with technical and integration teams, especially in large customer environments involving complex integrations.
  • Explain business requirements and functional designs to project team members, stakeholders, and customer teams.

Qualifications & Skills

Mandatory Skills

  • 5+ years of functional experience in Oracle Fusion ERP.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Oracle Fusion Financials and related modules, including:
  • General Ledger
  • Accounts Payables
  • Accounts Receivables
  • Fixed Assets
  • Cloud PPM Suite, including PFM and PEM
  • Expenses
  • Financial Accounting Hub
  • Revenue Management Cloud Service
  • Lease Accounting
  • Oracle Fusion Joint Venture Management
  • Project Costing
  • Billing
  • Cash Management
  • Contracts
  • Hands-on experience with the Oracle Fusion Redwood theme.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple task assignments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Customer-facing skills with the ability to communicate clearly and lead discussions.
  • Willingness and ability to work in a support model.
  • Positive attitude and strong learning capability to pick up additional Oracle Fusion modules as required.

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience in at least one Oracle Fusion Redwood migration.
  • Awareness of Redwood methodologies and ability to assess project readiness for Redwood adoption.
  • Understanding of VBS/VBCS and how it works within Oracle Fusion applications.
  • Experience working with large enterprise customers involving integrations.
  • Ability to quickly learn new skills and adapt to changing customer or project needs.

Self-Assessment Questions

  • Do you have 5+ years of hands-on Oracle Fusion ERP functional experience, especially across Fusion Financials modules such as GL, AP, AR, FA, Cash Management, Billing, Contracts, and Project Costing?
  • Have you worked directly with business users to gather requirements, perform fit-gap analysis, and resolve production issues?
  • Are you comfortable preparing functional specifications, configuration documents, test scripts, setup documents, and training materials?
  • Do you have hands-on experience with the Oracle Fusion Redwood theme or exposure to a Redwood migration project?
  • Are you comfortable working in a support model while managing multiple priorities and communicating directly with customers?

Qualifications

Career Level - N/A

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing [accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com](mailto:accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com) or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

job.title: Senior Cybersecurity Analyst (Cybersecurity Advisor)
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives.

For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking an Senior Cybersecurity Analyst (Cybersecurity Advisor)to join our AP Cybersecurity - CAT IT Divisionto serve as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders. This role is responsible for driving regional cybersecurity governance, risk management, security assessments, compliance programs, and security advisory services across the organization. The successful candidate will help ensure that cybersecurity risks are effectively identified, communicated, and managed while enabling business innovation in a secure and compliant manner.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN

This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.

Shift Timing : 01:00-10:00PM IST

Position Summary

The OpenVMS Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, monitoring, and support of mission-critical OpenVMS environments supporting warehouse automation, parts distribution, and manufacturing applications across multiple global locations. This role provides operational support for both physical OpenVMS Integrity servers and emulated OpenVMS environments hosted on Vere Technologies virtual servers, ensuring high availability, system performance, security, and business continuity for critical enterprise applications.

Security Advisory & Risk Management

  • Serve as a trusted cybersecurity advisor to business leaders, project teams, and technology stakeholders.
  • Provide expert guidance on cybersecurity objectives and compliance with corporate security policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Communicate complex cybersecurity risks, vulnerabilities, and recommendations in a clear and actionable manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support business decision-making by balancing security requirements with operational and business objectives.

Security Governance & Compliance

  • Conduct security assessments, compliance reviews, and risk evaluations to ensure adherence to established security frameworks and standards.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of cybersecurity controls and recommend enhancements where necessary.
  • Produce high-quality security assessment reports and communicate findings to stakeholders in a timely manner.
  • Support internal and external audit activities and regulatory compliance initiatives.

Security Architecture & Solution Review

  • Review and advise on the security architecture of new applications, infrastructure projects, cloud solutions, and outsourced services.
  • Evaluate purchased products, internally developed solutions, and third-party services through established cybersecurity processes, including:
  • Software Asset Management (SAM)
  • Secure Configuration Baselines (SCB)
  • Third-Party Cyber Risk Assessment (TPCRA)
  • Secure Development and Security Review Processes
  • Recommend security controls and best practices aligned with enterprise security standards.

Vulnerability & Risk Remediation Management

  • Coordinate and support vulnerability assessments, risk assessments, and control reviews.
  • Partner with risk owners to develop and track remediation plans and ensure risks are managed according to the Risk Treatment Plan (RTP) process.
  • Monitor remediation progress and provide regular reporting to management.

Incident Response & Security Operations Support

  • Support Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) activities when required.
  • Coordinate cybersecurity incident investigation and response efforts within assigned business areas.
  • Ensure timely communication and escalation of security incidents and emerging risks.

Security Awareness & Education

  • Support the organization's Cybersecurity Awareness Program.
  • Deliver security awareness activities, phishing simulation campaigns, and targeted security communications.
  • Develop and present cybersecurity messages aligned with enterprise security directives.
  • Promote a strong security culture across the organization.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay current with evolving cybersecurity threats, technologies, regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Research emerging security standards, frameworks, and technologies, and assess their applicability within the organization.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of cybersecurity processes, policies, and controls.

Other

  • Travel may be required based on business needs.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, IT risk management, security consulting, or related areas.
  • Strong knowledge of at least two or more of the following cybersecurity domains:
  • Information Security Governance
  • Risk Management and Compliance
  • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
  • Cryptography and Data Protection
  • Network and Communication Security
  • Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC)
  • Cloud Security
  • Security Architecture
  • Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery
  • Security Operations and Incident Response
  • Regulatory and Legal Compliance
  • Demonstrated ability to perform security assessments, risk evaluations, and security consulting engagements.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence business and technical stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.

Preferred Certifications

One or more of the following certifications are highly preferred:

  • CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
  • CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)
  • CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
  • CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)

Additional certifications such as CCSP, Azure Security Engineer, AWS Security Specialty, or relevant cloud security certifications are a plus.

Skill Descriptors

Communicating Complex Concepts: Knowledge of effective presentation tools and techniques to ensure clear understanding; ability to use summarization and simplification techniques to explain complex technical concepts in simple, clear language appropriate to the audience.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Uses comparisons to familiar ideas when introducing a technical or novel feature.
  • Separates fundamental concepts from supporting details in explaining a product or service.
  • Explains products and services with little or no use of technical jargon or advanced vocabulary.
  • Emphasizes the most important facts or features of a product or service.
  • Perceives lack of audience comprehension; further simplifies explanation when needed.

Consulting: Knowledge of techniques, roles, and responsibilities in providing technical or business guidance to clients, both internal and external; ability to apply consulting knowledge appropriately.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the roles and responsibilities of a consultant.
  • Lists the typical phases of a consulting assignment or project.
  • Presents a professional image, especially when dealing with customers.
  • Describes the consulting process and relationship with clients.

Cybersecurity Standards and Policies: Knowledge of developing cybersecurity policies, standards and procedures; ability to develop and communicate policies, standards and procedures that guide interactions with customers.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows efficient and effective auditing and compliance reporting.
  • Provides feedback for improvement of procedures and policies.
  • Assists in the development and implementation of specific cybersecurity policies and procedures.
  • Participates in the development of organizational cybersecurity policies and standards.
  • Generates status reports for senior management to ensure the implementation of cybersecurity standards and policies.

Cybersecurity Risk Management: Knowledge of tools, techniques, approaches and processes of cybersecurity risk management; ability to ensure organizational network operation and minimize negative effect by cybersecurity risks.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Responds to cyber security incidents following established security protocols.
  • Applies the methods and processes used in tracking and prioritizing vulnerabilities in organizational cyber environment.
  • Assesses the value of organizational assets.
  • Analyzes and documents cyber security threats specific to your organization.
  • Produces and interprets common cyber risk assessment and management reports.

Information Security Management: Knowledge of the processes, tools and techniques of information security management; ability to deploy and monitor information security systems, while detecting, controlling and preventing violations of IT security.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows procedures for the handling of computer security incidents and vulnerabilities.
  • Participates in monitoring, back-up, recovery and archival activities.
  • Assists in dealing with key issues and requirements for appropriately securing information.
  • Analyzes data security and integrity considerations relevant to one's own function.
  • Implements published information security management practices and guidelines.

Information Security Technologies: Knowledge of technologies and technology-based solutions dealing with information security issues; ability to protect information security across the organization using encryption technologies and appropriate security software.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Collects and documents information about new information security tools.
  • Explains computer forensics, authentication mechanisms and digital certificates.
  • Installs, upgrades or maintains firewall technology or anti-virus software.
  • Participates in evaluating information security features against business requirements.
  • Utilizes a specific hardware or software security technology to control risks.

Information Technology (IT) Security Policies: Knowledge of IT security policies, standards, and procedures; ability to utilize a variety of administrative skill sets and technical knowledge to ensure cyber security compliance.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Performs information gathering and research on key elements of IT security policies.
  • Assists senior colleagues in identifying and analyzing critical issues in IT security policies.
  • Executes IT security policies and standards within a specific region in organization.
  • Conducts performance reviews on implementation of IT security policies.
  • Generates status reports for senior management to ensure the implementation of IT security policies.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
  • Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
  • Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
  • Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
  • Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
  • Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

What you will get:

  • Work Life Harmony
  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Relocation assistance

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

  • Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan
  • Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO)

EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans and individuals with disabilities - are encouraged to apply.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.description:
Job Summary

The Physical Security Enablement IV supports the operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of physical security systems within a mission-critical data center environment. This role applies strong technical knowledge and sound judgment to support security infrastructure, customer requirements, incident response, audits, and operational projects.

Working closely with cross-functional teams, vendors, and site stakeholders, the role contributes to maintaining a safe, secure, and compliant environment while helping ensure a positive customer experience.

Responsibilities

Work Orders

  • Support security installations, de-installations, and customer security deployments.
  • Manage non-standard customer security requests and custom orders, coordinating with internal teams and vendors as required.
  • Track customer security ticketing requests and support reporting, compliance, and audit requirements.
  • Assist senior team members with the development and distribution of Requests for Proposals (RFPs) for security infrastructure projects.
  • Coordinate auxiliary security equipment and support troubleshooting activities to minimize operational disruption and downtime.
  • Support maintenance and troubleshooting of security-related equipment and systems where required.

Incident Management

  • Respond to on-site security incidents and operational events, including security system failures, access control issues, and service disruptions.
  • Support incident investigations, reporting, and root cause analysis activities.
  • Apply knowledge of the security incident decision matrix and support incident declarations with the Equinix Operations Center (EOC).
  • Coordinate with stakeholders on Internal Incident Reports (IIRs) and Post Incident Reports (PIRs) as required.
  • Assist with the implementation of corrective actions and operational improvements resulting from incident reviews.

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Support the operation and maintenance of physical security systems, including Access Control Systems (ACS) and Video Management Systems (VMS).
  • Investigate and resolve security system faults, condition reports, and operational issues in accordance with site standards and procedures.
  • Support preventive maintenance programs, system patching, upgrades, and lifecycle management activities.
  • Participate in customer-facing activities, including security audits, custom security requests, and cage build initiations.
  • Coordinate security asset inventory and IP address management for security devices and infrastructure.
  • Support security infrastructure projects and system enhancements that improve site security and operational effectiveness.

Vendor Management

  • Coordinate vendor activities supporting customer security deployments and site security infrastructure.
  • Support vendor work reviews and monitor activities to ensure compliance with site procedures, safety requirements, and operational standards.
  • Work with site management teams and third-party auditors to support internal and external audit activities.
  • Assist in maintaining documentation and records associated with security systems and vendor activities.

Site Administration

  • Apply security procedures, operational standards, and quality controls to ensure security systems remain compliant and effective.
  • Maintain and update security drawings, asset records, and site-specific documentation.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance procedures, system effectiveness, and operational performance.
  • Assist in ensuring security processes are consistently applied across the site.

Collaboration

  • Partner with security stakeholders and operational teams to support maintenance activities, system upgrades, and infrastructure projects.
  • Coordinate security activities that may impact facility operations, customer environments, or infrastructure deployments.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives related to new builds, site expansions, and operational improvements.
  • Share knowledge and provide operational support to colleagues and stakeholders when required.
  • Contribute recommendations that improve security operations, infrastructure resilience, and customer experience.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma, technical certification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 2–4 years of experience in physical security, data center operations, critical infrastructure, security systems, or a related technical environment.

job.title: Field Service Technician - Shreveport, LA
job.description:
Job Description

At Vertiv, we design, manufacture, and service the mission-critical infrastructure technologies for vital applications in data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial environments. We are the trusted Service Provider for 70%+ of Fortune 500 companies, including industry-leading data centers and providers of colocation and cloud service.

Why Vertiv is the best company for Field Service professionals:

  • Vertiv is an industry leader in Technology and Services with a best-in-class Customer Service and Safety culture
  • Company leaders have many years of hands-on Field Service experience in this industry and many others
  • Tremendous focus is placed on employee technical and leadership development
  • Technical Training takes place in our state of the art Training Academy or Regional Training Center with a strong focus on immersive, hands-on learning
  • Competitive benefits include: Company vehicle, smartphone, laptop, personal protective equipment (PPE), other tools-of-the-trade, 401k, Profit Sharing, & Generous PTO/Vacation Plan, Medical, Vision & Dental & more
  • Abundant technical resources including 24/7 Technical/Factory Support and technical online libraries of product documentation, work instructions, and self-help troubleshooting guides
  • Company-wide commitment to promoting a strong work/life balance
  • An employer-of-choice for Veterans with technical backgrounds

The Field Service Technician is primarily responsible for scheduled and remedial (break-fix) service on Small to Medium UPS, Power Distribution Units & Battery system products serviced by Vertiv, commensurate with appropriate classroom and on-the-job training.  The Field Service Technician is required to establish, promote and maintain excellent rapport with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives and others as appropriate.  The Field Service Technician is primarily responsible to support products and services sold to our “Edge” market segment, including retail, financial, and municipal customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

ROLE

  • Perform service tasks as assigned and as per company policies and procedures
  • Capable of working under direct supervision or independently based upon training completion
  • Render on-site and phone assistance to customers
  • Communicate with Technical Support on technical or procedural issues
  • Implement Field Change Notices per published guidelines
  • Keep current on Safety Bulletins, Safety Field Change Notices, Field Change Notices, and Service Tips

SAFETY

  • Operate in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Maintain and operate company vehicle in accordance with local laws and company policy
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Adhere to work hours policy guidelines – “14 hours rule”
  • Report all work related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel.

ADMINISTRATION

  • Complete accurate and timely administrative tasks (i.e. Time cards, expense report, mileage reports, Service Request task closure, service reports) per company guidelines
  • Maintain individual inventory and perform cycle counts in accordance with company policy
  • Maintain company property (company vehicle, credit cards, PPE, test equipment, laptop, etc.) per company policies

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Provide estimated time of arrival to the customer where applicable
  • Complete scheduled maintenance documentation properly and provide to the customer and local office upon completion of each assignment
  • Strive to provide all customers a “first time fix” for their equipment
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates per company guidelines
  • Attend Customer Meetings as required

PERFORMANCE

  • Maximize productivity by combining service opportunities
  • Complete all technical and administrative work in an efficient and timely manner
  • Capable of making technical and commercial decisions under pressure
  • Properly evaluate site and equipment for appropriate billing status
  • Maintain productive utilization rate per company guidelines
  • Perform inventory cycle counts per company guidelines
  • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations
  • Meet or exceed on-site response time requirements for each customer
  • Understand and comply with company startup/escalation processes and procedures
  • Maintain proper and adequate level of internal communications

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience (one or more of the following)

  • ASEET or AMEET, or progress towards, is preferred
  • High School or Vocational School Diploma
  • 2-4 years military experience in a related technical field
  • 0-2 years of relevant industry experience

Interpersonal and Administrative Skills

  • Communicate professionally and respectfully in both written and verbal forms
  • Manage time effectively by prioritizing and balancing technical tasks with administrative tasks
  • Collaborative with peers, customers, suppliers, and leadership
  • Complete administrative tasks (i.e. report writing, time entry, expense reporting, material debriefing, inventory counting, etc.) in a timely fashion

Technical skills

  • Make basic site evaluation skills to include: environmental temperature, and general operating conditions
  • Familiarity with electrical / electronic test equipment and fundamentals
  • Follow written technical documentation (i.e. procedures and product manuals) to perform service tasks
  • Employ elementary fix/repair techniques based on directed supervision
  • Complete service tasks and return unit to full operating conditions based upon directed supervision
  • Summarize and report all work related tasks performed in written and verbal form
  • Efficient with a personal computer and associated applications (Microsoft Office, Vertiv software, etc.)

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Travel is required
  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Due to the safety sensitive aspect of the role, candidates are required to successfully pass a drug test prior to employment. In addition, you will also be required to complete and pass a pre-employment background check and a motor vehicle records check.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell. The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Must be able to consistently lift up to 50 pounds and occasionally up to 75 pounds.

Notes: Vertiv will make reasonable accommodations whenever necessary for all qualified employees or candidates with disabilities (as defined by applicable law), provided that (1) the individual is otherwise qualified to safely perform the essential functions of the job and (2) such accommodations due not impose an undue hardship.

THE VERTIV OPPORTUNITY

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv's Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

Our Core Principles: Safety \| Integrity \| Respect \| Teamwork \| Inclusion

Our Strategic Priorities

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

Vertiv Behaviors

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers' vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today's data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

job.title: Telstra Retail: Part Time Customer Service & Sales Consultant WARRINGAH MALL
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

27 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Telstra Retail: Part Time Customer Service & Sales Consultant WARRINGAH MALL

Job Summary

As a Retail Consultant, you will provide frontline support by assisting customers with product selection, service activation, and troubleshooting basic issues. You will create positive experiences through effective communication and adherence to retail standards. This role demonstrates foundational autonomy and contributes to customer satisfaction and store performance.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Hourly Rate: $33.33 per hour

*Junior rates apply for those under 20 years of age.

Penalty rates are as follows: Additional 25% for weekday hours worked after 6 PM, 25% for hours worked on Saturday, 100% for hours worked on Sunday and 150% for hours worked on public holidays.*

  • Plus 12% Superannuation
  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs through LinkedIn Learning and take advantage of a range of development opportunities designed to build your skills and support your career growth, helping you prepare for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.

Is it You We’re Looking For?

  • Great Communication Skills: You’re a natural at connecting with people and making their day better.
  • Solution-Oriented Approach: You enjoy thinking on your feet and tailoring solutions for each customer.
  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.
  • Passion for Learning: You’re eager to grow and develop your skills in a dynamic environment.
  • Resilience and Positivity: You have a can-do attitude, even when things get busy.
  • Customer-Facing Experience: Previous experience is a plus but not required—bring your enthusiasm and we’ll teach you the rest!

How to Apply:

Ready to kickstart your journey with us? Click "Apply Now" to submit your application! After applying, keep an eye out for an email from our partner, HireVue, to complete the next step in our assessment process.

Join Us at Telstra Retail:

When you become part of the Telstra team, you’re joining a brand that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone is respected, valued, and can thrive. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to our team!

job.title: Head of Industry Marketing
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

17 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Head of Industry Marketing

Job Summary

Job Description

Who We Are

At Telstra, we're building a connected future where everyone can thrive. As Australia's leading telecommunications and technology company, we help businesses connect, transform and grow through innovative technology solutions, customer-centric experiences and trusted partnerships. Within Telstra Enterprise, we work with some of Australia's largest organisations to solve complex challenges and unlock new opportunities for growth.

Focus of the Role

As the Head of Industry Marketing, you will play a pivotal leadership role within Telstra Enterprise, shaping how we engage and grow across key industries in Australia.

Reporting to the Head of Marketing, Telstra Enterprise, you will lead the development and execution of industry-led marketing strategies that drive customer engagement, influence pipeline growth and deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

This is a highly visible leadership role operating at the intersection of Marketing and Sales, requiring strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking and exceptional stakeholder influence. You will lead a team of experienced marketers and partner closely with senior Sales leaders and executive stakeholders to ensure marketing investment is aligned to growth priorities, customer needs and revenue outcomes.

Your ability to connect strategy with execution, inspire high performance and foster a strong team culture will be critical to success.

What We Offer

Performance-related pay Access to thousands of learning programs so you can level-up Global presence across 22 countries; opportunities to work where we do business.

Purchased annual leave scheme

Additional Telstra day off

Additional 30% off Telstra products and services

Toolkit provided (laptop + mobile phone + plan paid for)

What You'll Do

As the Head of Industry Marketing, you will:

  • Lead the industry marketing strategy for Telstra Enterprise, aligning priorities to growth ambitions and sales objectives.
  • Drive measurable commercial outcomes through integrated, full-funnel marketing programs, with accountability for influenced pipeline and performance targets.
  • Develop marketing strategies grounded in a deep understanding of Enterprise customers, industry segments, buying journeys and market needs.
  • Partner closely with senior Sales leaders and executive stakeholders to ensure strong alignment between marketing and commercial priorities.
  • Lead, coach and inspire a team of senior marketers, creating an environment that enables high performance, growth and accountability.
  • Build and maintain strong planning, prioritisation and execution disciplines to ensure the team delivers impact at pace.
  • Leverage data, insights and performance metrics to optimise investment decisions, campaign effectiveness and business outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance customer engagement, strengthen market positioning and accelerate growth across priority industries.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation and collaboration across the broader Enterprise Marketing function.
  • Champion best-practice marketing approaches that enhance customer experiences and support long-term business success.

About You

You are an experienced and commercially focused marketing leader with a strong track record of driving business growth through strategic industry-led marketing. You understand how to translate customer and market insights into impactful marketing programs that deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

You are comfortable operating in complex stakeholder environments, influencing executive leaders and aligning diverse teams around a shared vision. Equally strategic and execution-focused, you thrive in fast-paced environments where accountability, collaboration and results matter.

To be successful in this role, you'll bring:

  • Extensive experience (15+ years) in B2B and/or B2E marketing leadership roles, with a strong understanding of Enterprise customers, industries and market dynamics.
  • Proven success delivering commercial outcomes through marketing, including ownership of pipeline contribution, demand generation and marketing performance metrics.
  • Deep understanding of Enterprise customer buying journeys and how marketing influences demand, engagement and growth.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience partnering with senior executives and commercial leaders.
  • Strong leadership experience building, developing and leading high-performing teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritise effectively, work at pace and deliver outcomes in dynamic environments.
  • Strong analytical and commercial capability, using data and insights to inform decisions and continuously optimise performance.
  • A collaborative leadership style that fosters trust, accountability, innovation and engagement.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience within technology, telecommunications or enterprise solutions environments.
  • Experience operating within large, complex matrix organisations.
  • Experience partnering closely with Sales teams to drive commercial outcomes.
  • Experience leading industry, portfolio or segment marketing functions.
  • Strong understanding of modern demand generation, account-based marketing and customer lifecycle marketing approaches.

Culture & Leadership

This role is as much about how you lead as what you deliver.

You are a leader who:

  • Builds engaged, high-performing teams grounded in trust, clarity and accountability.
  • Creates an environment where people feel supported, challenged and motivated to do their best work.
  • Brings a growth mindset, continually lifting standards, encouraging new thinking and improving the way teams operate.
  • Leads with energy, transparency and ownership, setting a strong example for performance and culture.

job.title: Project Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Engineering Manager ###

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by applying basic design thinking/design for excellence concepts in projects.

The work model for the role is # LI - Hybrid.

This role is contributing to the to the Process Automation business in Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • As a Project Engineer – Automation, you will be responsible for the end‑to‑end engineering and execution of automation projects in Oil & Gas, Refinery, Chemicals, Specialty Chemicals, and emerging process industries.
  • You will independently execute projects from FEED stage through commissioning and handover, acting as a technical interface to end customers, while ensuring compliance with ABB quality, safety, and cybersecurity standards.
  • Execute automation projects from FEED / Concept Engineering through Detailed Engineering, FAT, SAT, Commissioning, and Project Closure
  • Deliver engineering scope in line with contract requirements, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and cybersecurity policies
  • Act as technical focal point for customers, EPCs, and internal stakeholders and identify technical risks early and propose mitigation strategies
  • Automation System Design & Engineering and Industrial Networking & Cybersecurity and Design and implement solutions using industrial communication protocols:

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Proven Project Engineer experience in automation projects and DCS, PLC.
  • Looking for 5–10 years of relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated execution of end‑to‑end projects (FEED → Commissioning)
  • Experience in Oil & Gas, Refinery, Chemicals, Specialty Chemicals
  • Willing to travel to abroad as per project requirements
  • BE / BTech in Control Engineering, Electrical, Electronics, or equivalent.

More about us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reducing risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Supervisor Data Analytics
job.description:
Job Description

Who are we?

At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected.  With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.

We are currently seeking a Supervisor Data Analytics to join our dynamic team in Piove di Sacco (PD), Italy!

The Data Analyst Supervisor leads a team of data analysts (on-site and globally distributed) within the Customer Insight function, reporting to the Senior Manager Marketing Data Science. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines people management, project ownership, and deep technical contribution.

The supervisor owns the full BI delivery chain, from designing and optimizing ETL pipelines in Snowflake (in partnership with IT) through building robust Power BI data models and semantic layers, to delivering polished reports and apps to the right audiences. A critical part of the role is ensuring proper data governance: every stakeholder sees only the information they are authorized to access, based on business policies, organizational structure, and regional scope.

Beyond technical delivery, the role carries strong project management accountability: scoping, planning, and driving multiple concurrent BI initiatives from concept to production. The supervisor acts as the key bridge between the data team and the wider business, translating requirements Marketing and other functions into scalable, well-architected analytics solutions.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable mentoring junior analysts, challenging a data model design, presenting insights to senior leadership, and building long-term strategic relationships across regions and functions to keep data solutions aligned with where the business is heading.

What kind of work will you be doing?

Team Leadership & Project Management (40%):

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data analysts across multiple locations and time zones.
  • Plan and prioritize team workload, balancing recurring reporting activities with strategic BI projects.
  • Manage BI projects end-to-end: scoping, planning, execution, delivery, and post-launch optimization.
  • Conduct performance reviews, set development goals, and support career growth of team members.
  • Establish and maintain consistent methodologies, standards, and documentation across the team.
  • Gather requirements and align priorities with stakeholders across IT, Sales, Finance, and Operations.
  • Build and nurture strategic relationships with cross-regional and cross-functional partners to drive long-term alignment and unlock collaboration opportunities.

BI Architecture & Hands-On Delivery (30%):

  • Own the BI architecture and semantic layer design, partnering with IT on platform-level decisions and infrastructure while retaining ownership of the analytics and reporting layer.
  • Design and optimize the data flow from source to consumption: ETL pipelines in Snowflake, Power BI datasets, report delivery to end users.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports: advanced DAX, data modeling, calculated tables, and performance optimization.
  • Define and manage data access and visibility rules across all reports and apps, ensuring that each stakeholder and audience sees only the information they are authorized to access, based on business policies, organizational roles, and regional scope.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across all BI outputs.
  • Identify and implement improvements to reporting processes, automation, and self-service capabilities.

Surveys & Voice of Customer (20%):

  • Coordinate the team's VoC activities, overseeing survey design, execution, and analysis using Qualtrics across regions.
  • Ensure VoC results are translated into actionable insights that inform product, sales, and marketing decisions.
  • Guide the integration of survey data into the broader BI ecosystem to enrich reporting and segmentation.

AI/ML Support (10%):

  • Provide support to AI/ML initiatives when needed, contributing expertise on data readiness, quality, and pipeline integration.
  • Help the team explore opportunities to apply advanced analytics and automation to existing processes.

What will make you successful?

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field (Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or related).
  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis, BI development, or analytics roles.
  • Proven experience leading or coordinating a team (even informally).
  • Advanced proficiency in Power BI: complex data models, DAX, workspace governance, app deployment, and audience-based access management.
  • Solid SQL skills: writing, optimizing, and troubleshooting queries in Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses.
  • Experience designing or managing ETL/ELT pipelines and understanding of data architecture principles.
  • Experience with data governance, access control, and compliance in BI environments.
  • Strong project management skills: ability to run multiple concurrent projects with clear timelines and deliverables.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication: ability to influence without authority across functions and regions.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).

Nice-to-Have

  • Python for data manipulation, automation, or analytics.
  • Experience with Qualtrics or similar survey platforms.
  • Exposure to AI/ML concepts and tools.
  • Experience in a global, matrix organization.
  • Knowledge of marketing analytics, customer segmentation, or pricing analysis.

What we are looking for

  • A hands-on leader who can switch between strategic thinking and getting into the detail.
  • Strong ownership mentality: takes accountability for delivery quality and team performance.
  • Ability to build trust and develop strategic relationships across regions and functions.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-changing, global environment.
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues and drives continuous improvement.
  • Availability for international travel.

If YOU are the person we are looking for, feel free to apply and let's start drafting your future career in a healthy and growing environment!

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPALS: Safety.  Integrity. Respect.  Teamwork.  Diversity & Inclusion.

job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The _Electrical Design Engineer_ will develop electrical design HDLC units such as In row CDU and In rack CDU as well as 2 phase products. He/she will closely follow objectives of quality, environment and costs working in cooperation with manufacturing engineering, controls engineering, procurement, suppliers, mechanical engineering, and product marketing. The Electrical Engineer will contribute to the release of new products; will work in a cross-functional development group; manage a variety of tasks and activities in a dynamic environment; and solve complex problems where no precedence exists.

This position will be based onsite at Vertiv's Ironton, OH location (3040 S 9th St., Ironton, OH 45638).

Responsibilities

  • Design new and low voltage electrical enclosures (>240 volts AC).
  • Harness Design, schematic creation and 3D modeling of wiring and cabling inside equipment.

  • Capable and proficient at understanding and applying various standards of NEC (NFPA70), CSA/UL, and IEEE to do a proper selection of electrical components that meet agencies requirements.
  • Collaboration and guideline across the disciplines of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, process engineering, as well as production and offering teams. Work with these teams for design reviews, meeting cost metrics, and brainstorming around customer pain points.

  • Create, revise and audit unit wiring schematics and network connection drawings

job.title: Sr. Engineer Reliability Engineering XI
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Sr. Engineer – Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab. The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement.

The role will work closely with Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab.
  • Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements.
  • Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data-acquisition systems.
  • Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions.
  • Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures.
  • Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions.
  • Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability.
  • Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions.
  • Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams.
  • Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities.
  • Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers.
  • Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure.
  • Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation.
  • Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required.
  • Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities.
  • Mentor junior engineers/technicians on reliability testing, instrumentation, data analysis, and troubleshooting.

Key Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Reliability Engineering and Reliability Testing.
  • Hands-on experience with reliability and environmental testing.
  • Knowledge of FMEA, FTA, RCA, 8D, Weibull analysis, life testing, and accelerated life testing.
  • Understanding of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and environmental stress testing.
  • Experience with data acquisition systems, sensors, instrumentation, and test equipment.
  • Ability to troubleshoot test setups and identify test-system vs. product failures.
  • Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
  • Knowledge of relevant industry/testing standards and engineering practices.
  • Good understanding of product design and manufacturing processes.
  • Strong technical documentation and reporting skills.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline.
  • Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in Reliability Engineering, Product Validation, Testing, or Engineering Laboratory functions.
  • Hands-on experience working in a Reliability/Test/Validation Lab is preferred.
  • Experience in HVAC, thermal management, cooling systems, data-center equipment, power electronics, or similar engineered products will be an advantage.

Key Competencies

  • Reliability & Failure Analysis
  • Laboratory & Test Management
  • Technical Problem Solving
  • Data Analysis
  • Root Cause Analysis
  • Product Testing & Validation
  • Project Ownership
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Attention to Detail
  • Technical Documentation
  • Decision Making

Key KPIs

  • On-time completion of reliability and qualification testing
  • Reliability test execution quality and accuracy
  • Reduction in repeat/recurring test failures
  • Timely identification and closure of reliability issues
  • Effectiveness of RCA and corrective actions
  • Laboratory equipment availability and utilization
  • Compliance with testing, calibration, safety, and documentation requirements
  • Contribution to product reliability and design improvements

About Us

job.title: Senior Worldwide (WW) GTM Specialist, Amazon WorkSpaces
job.description:
The workspace is no longer just for humans. Enterprises are moving from traditional virtual desktops to intelligent, cloud-native environments where people and AI agents work side by side — governed by design, observable by default, and delivered anywhere. Amazon WorkSpaces is leading this transformation with WorkSpaces for Agents (now generally available), alongside WorkSpaces Personal, WorkSpaces Core, and WorkSpaces Applications. Together with services like AWS Context and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, we're building the operating environment for the next enterprise workforce — one where AI agents navigate applications, automate workflows, and build institutional knowledge inside trusted boundaries. The companies that lead won't just have the smartest AI — they'll build the most trustworthy place for intelligence to work.

AWS is seeking a Worldwide (WW) GTM Specialist to accelerate adoption of Amazon WorkSpaces' AI and agentic capabilities. You will be part of a dedicated team focused on bringing these emerging solutions to market — defining the vision for agentic workspaces, building GTM motions around AI-enhanced features, and helping customers understand how governed cloud workspaces become the operating environment for their human + agent workforce. You'll be charting new territory at the intersection of end-user computing and enterprise AI — identifying early adopters, shaping lighthouse engagements, and building repeatable plays that scale.

You are a strategic thinker who operates with urgency. You combine deep business acumen with enough technical depth to be credible with CIOs and IT leaders navigating the shift to agentic work. You understand that the hardest problem isn't teaching an agent to click — it's making sure those clicks happen inside an environment the organization can trust. You've built GTM strategies in emerging technology categories, rallied cross-functional teams around a shared vision, and delivered measurable business results. You're energized by ambiguity — because that's where the biggest opportunities live.

Key job responsibilities

  • Define and execute the GTM strategy for Amazon WorkSpaces AI and agentic solutions — identifying high-value customer segments where agents can drive immediate productivity gains, and building programs that accelerate early adoption of WorkSpaces for Agents, AI-enhanced desktop experiences, and governed agentic environments.
  • Shape the narrative around the future of agentic workspaces — positioning AWS as the leader in trusted environments where humans and AI agents work together, with built-in governance, observability, and identity management that enable enterprises to scale autonomous work confidently.
  • Engage directly with enterprise leaders and partners to articulate how governed cloud workspaces solve the trust, security, and compliance challenges that keep agentic AI stuck in pilots — connecting agentic workspace capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
  • Build and scale lighthouse engagements with early adopters deploying AI agents in enterprise environments — generating compelling proof points around agent governance, productivity, and the human + agent operating model, then operationalizing those wins into repeatable plays.
  • Develop deep fluency in the WorkSpaces AI portfolio (WorkSpaces for Agents, integration with AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AWS Continuum) to articulate how the pieces fit together for customers across industries.
  • Establish data-driven mechanisms to measure adoption of agentic features, track program effectiveness, and continuously optimize the path from pilot to production-scale agent deployment.
  • Evangelize the agentic workspace vision externally through thought leadership, events, and industry engagement — and internally across AWS to drive mindshare and investment in this emerging category.
  • Orchestrate field uptake of AI-focused sales plays, equipping the broader sales organization to identify and qualify agentic workspace opportunities and deliver value through repeatable mechanisms.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional or military experience
  • 5+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience
  • 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
  • 5+ years of working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations experience
  • 5+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
  • Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
  • Experience selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
  • Experience selling AI/ML solutions
  • Experience in selling nascent products/services into new markets
  • Experience leading complex, multi-year initiatives that may be cross-functional and/or span business and technology
  • Understanding of enterprise desktop/workspace environments and the security, compliance, and identity requirements that govern them

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. job.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Solutions Engineer reporting to the Solutions Engineering Manager, you will work closely with the rest of the Technology – Technical Solutions team, as well as the Head of Customer Success, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Support the team by learning and understanding the customer and market requirements, ensuring business alignment
  • Help to drive the delivery of the customer solution and product through the complete data centre cycle
  • Support translating customer requirements into key design projects of our data centres in the India region and in preparing presentations to customers and executives.

Your Day to Day

  • Provide support to the Solutions Team in the RFP proposal and deliver key technical / engineering documents
  • Provide support in production of key technical and sales collateral – High Level M&E Schematic and Technical presentation materials
  • Assist in high-level space planning and engineering solutions for our customers
  • Involved in pioneering various engineering solutions relating to design, calculations and other engineering aspects
  • Assist in the development of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
  • Support in preparing pitch decks, presentation packs and collateral for customers and executives
  • Support the connectivity team working with carriers in the region

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE)
  • 5–8 years’ relevant experience, ideally within data centres, critical infrastructure, engineering consulting or technical solutions.
  • Fluent in MS Office (Power Point, Word, Excel) and good knowledge of BlueBeam and Basic AutoCad
  • Basic knowledge of CFD is an advantage but not required – this only applies if you’re mechanical trade
  • Analytical mindset
  • Good technical writing, documentation, and communication skills

job.title: Head of Site Acquisition
job.description:
• Lead the development and execution of CDC's site acquisition strategy, ensuring a sustainable pipeline of development opportunities, enabling our future growth!
  • Make your mark in a newly created role, reporting into our Chief Development Officer
  • Role open to both Sydney and Melbourne-based candidates

About Us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand’s leading operator of secure, world-class data centre facilities. CDC plays a unique role in the fabric of the nations in which we operate, and we take this responsibility very seriously.

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

Reporting into our Chief Development Officer, the Head of Site Acquisition will play a critical role in shaping CDC's future growth strategy through the identification, assessment and acquisition of strategically important sites across Australia and New Zealand. This role will provide leadership across CDC's site acquisition function, helping build a long-term development pipeline that supports future customer demand and campus expansion. Working at the intersection of property, infrastructure, and development, you'll lead site acquisition initiatives from early-stage opportunity identification and feasibility through to transaction execution and handover into development. This is a highly visible role that partners across, landowners, utilities, government agencies and industry advisors, driving favourable outcomes for the business.

  • Lead the development and execution of CDC's site acquisition strategy, ensuring a sustainable pipeline of development opportunities aligned to long-term business objectives.
  • Manage site selection activities, including feasibility assessments, due diligence and development viability reviews.
  • Drive negotiations with landowners, agents, advisors and other key stakeholders to secure land and property interests.
  • Collaborate with utilities, network providers and government authorities to assess power, infrastructure and service requirements.
  • Prepare and present business cases, commercial recommendations and acquisition strategies to support investment decisions - ensuring recommendations are commercially sound, technically viable, and aligned to business priorities.
  • Partner closely with development, construction and operational teams to ensure a seamless transition of acquired sites into delivery.

What’s in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy - Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You

Combining significant experience in site acquisition, land strategy, infrastructure development or major projects, you are a commercially savvy leader who knows how to identify opportunities, navigate complexity and influence diverse stakeholder groups to achieve successful outcomes. With strong commercial judgement and a relationship-driven approach, you're comfortable balancing strategic thinking with hands-on delivery to secure favourable outcomes for the business.

  • Experience in site acquisition, infrastructure development, property development, energy, utilities, renewables or other large-scale critical infrastructure environments.
  • Strong commercial acumen - leading negotiations, supporting investments decisions, property transactions, and due diligence capability.
  • Understanding of site selection, feasibility and infrastructure, electricity, and utility constraints.
  • Proven ability to negotiate and influence a diverse range of stakeholders through a collaborative and relationship-driven approach.
  • Ability to work through ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and seek continuous improvement in process and tools.

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and encourages everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.
