Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives.

For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking an IT Analyst Technical Infrastructure (Sr. VMware/UCS Engineer)to join our IT Infrastructure Support - CAT IT Division.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN

This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.

Shift Timing : 01:00-10:00PM IST

Position Summary

The OpenVMS Systems Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, monitoring, and support of mission-critical OpenVMS environments supporting warehouse automation, parts distribution, and manufacturing applications across multiple global locations. This role provides operational support for both physical OpenVMS Integrity servers and emulated OpenVMS environments hosted on Vere Technologies virtual servers, ensuring high availability, system performance, security, and business continuity for critical enterprise applications.

Key Responsibilities

OpenVMS Infrastructure Administration

  • Administer and maintain a production OpenVMS Cluster
  • Monitor and maintain OpenVMS operating systems and associated layered products.
  • Plan, test, and implement operating system upgrades, patches, and software updates.
  • Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and application-related issues.
  • Perform performance analysis and capacity planning activities.
  • Coordinate maintenance activities to minimize operational impact.

Virtual OpenVMS Environment Support

  • Administer emulated OpenVMS servers
  • Apply upgrades, patches, and software maintenance to Vere Technologies platforms and supporting infrastructure.
  • Monitor virtual host performance and resource utilization.

User and Security Administration

  • Create, modify, and disable OpenVMS user accounts according to approved access requests.
  • Manage user privileges and security settings in accordance with company policies.
  • Support audit and compliance requirements related to system access and security controls.

System Monitoring and Operations

  • Monitor system health, availability, and performance across all OpenVMS environments.
  • Manage and monitor:
  • Disk capacity and utilization
  • Printer queues
  • Batch processing queues
  • System backups and recovery processes
  • Investigate and resolve operational incidents and system alerts.
  • Maintain documentation for procedures, configurations, and system changes.

Backup and Disaster Recovery

  • Execute and validate backup procedures for physical and virtual OpenVMS systems.
  • Support disaster recovery testing and recovery planning activities.
  • Ensure backup integrity and data recoverability.

Global Support

  • Provide infrastructure support for multiple business applications, including the widely utilized CAPP+ application environment.
  • Collaborate with application teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and infrastructure teams to resolve system issues and implement enhancements.
  • Support global business operations requiring high system availability and reliability.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • Extensive experience administering OpenVMS operating systems.
  • Experience supporting OpenVMS Cluster environments.
  • Knowledge of OpenVMS system management, storage, user administration, and security.
  • Experience applying operating system patches, upgrades, and software maintenance.
  • Experience managing backups, disaster recovery processes, and system monitoring.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical production environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with HPE Integrity Server hardware.
  • Experience with Vere Technologies OpenVMS emulation solutions.
  • Knowledge of warehouse management systems and automated material handling environments.
  • Experience supporting global enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with high-availability and business continuity practices.
  • Experience working in manufacturing, logistics, or parts distribution environments.

Key Competencies

  • Infrastructure Administration
  • OpenVMS Systems Management
  • Cluster Administration
  • Incident Management
  • Change Management
  • Performance Monitoring
  • Capacity Planning
  • Disaster Recovery
  • Problem Solving
  • Technical Documentation
  • Customer Service
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

Scope of Responsibility

  • Supports a few physical OpenVMS Integrity servers, including a production OpenVMS Cluster and test environment.
  • Supports several emulated OpenVMS servers hosted on 9 Vere Technologies virtual servers.
  • Maintains Vere Technologies license servers.
  • Supports international locations across North America, South America, Europe, and Australia.
  • Provides operational support for mission-critical warehouse automation and parts distribution systems that directly impact order fulfillment and business operations.

**Skill Descriptors

Technical Excellence:** Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
  • Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components.
  • Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services.
  • Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence.
  • Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues.

Technology Advising: Knowledge of effective advisory methods and ability to provide valued information and advice to clients regarding products, technologies, services and solutions for a specific technology domain.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Assesses the current technology environment, expressed needs and initiatives of client organizations.
  • Uses an effective consulting method to present technology solutions that resolve stated client business issues.
  • Advises clients regarding a family of specific products, technologies or services in a technology domain.
  • Demonstrates basic competence and sound business knowledge regarding specific products, technologies or services within a domain of technology expertise.
  • Achieves consulting relationship rating of 'professional' by delivering timely, meaningful advice meeting client needs in a narrow set of specific technologies.

Hardware Infrastructure: Knowledge of computer architecture and systems programming; ability to design, build and integrate IT hardware into multi-platforms for the organization.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Assists in integrating IT hardware with the organization's existing systems.
  • Participates in the implementation of IT hardware within the organization.
  • Tracks operational problems related to IT hardware and reports them directly to the supervisor.
  • Assists in designing the main features of IT hardware according to business needs.
  • Compares IT hardware across one's own organization and its competitors.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
  • Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
  • Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
  • Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
  • Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Supports the project leader in developing and executing system test plans.
  • Evaluates system documentation and user manuals for usability, accuracy and completeness.
  • Executes test cases, analyzes test results and reports on findings regularly.
  • Tests system components for compliance with functional requirements.
  • Participates in the testing of a system's ability to recover from hardware or software failures.

Systems Software Infrastructure: Knowledge of computer architecture and system software interaction; ability to design and build a fundamental architecture of operating systems, database management systems, communications protocols, compilers and other development tools.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Reports software connectivity and integration issues.
  • Demonstrates planned software changes on the local environment.
  • Administers software migration and contingency plans related to own function.
  • Analyzes the local software architecture components and products.
  • Tests key features for the entire software infrastructure environment.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
  • Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
  • Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
  • Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
  • Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

Technical Writing/Documentation: Knowledge of technical writing; ability to write technical documents such as manuals, reports, guidelines or documents on standards, processes and applications.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Implements technical documentation standards, guidelines and best practices.
  • Prepares written text and layout of materials according to required outlines and specifications.
  • Completes and maintains technical reference documents.
  • Uses the major features, functions and facilities of an automated documentation tool.
  • Coordinates and constantly updates system operations, installations, service manuals, and help documents.

What you will get:

  • Work Life Harmony
  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Relocation assistance

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

  • Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan
  • Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at www.caterpillar.com/careers

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO)

EEO/AA Employer. All qualified individuals, including minorities, females, veterans and individuals with disabilities - are encouraged to apply.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Designs, develops, builds, and implements new components, products, or technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Create 3D-models and technical drawings for plant equipment and systems
  • Design mechanical components
  • Design piping systems
  • Perform design calculations
  • Coordinate technical activities with customers and suppliers
  • Support procurement activities by reviewing supplier drawings and documentation
  • Assist troubleshooting and resolving technical issues during manufacturing and installation
  • Supervise on-site installation activities
  • Creating Specification of Powerplant
  • Reviewing Customer Specification

Degree Requirement:

Requires a degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or Materials Science curriculum.

Skill Descriptors

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
  • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
  • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
  • Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
  • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Recognizes changing demands and priorities; validates changes with management.
  • Obtains information about how current assignments contribute to organizational goals.
  • Completes current work according to assigned priorities.
  • Responds to day-to-day operational priorities while still making progress on project work.
  • Performs at least 2-3 concurrent activities without reducing productivity.

Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
  • Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components.
  • Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services.
  • Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence.
  • Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues.

Computer-Aided Design & Engineering: Knowledge of tools and techniques of specialized graphics programs; ability to produce, analyze, simulate and test product design drafts.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Generates specifications for parts or components with CAD software.
  • Reuses design components via reusable libraries following standard procedures.
  • Uses CAD to perform basic drafting such as wire frames, solid objects and array of objects.
  • Performs routine changes to computerized schematics or drawings.
  • Creates views of objects in 2 and 3 dimensions; creates perspective drawings and orthogonal views.

Product Design - MFG: Knowledge of processes, approaches, tools and techniques of product design; ability to convert customer and market requirements into product design.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Participates in the conception process of a manufacturing product vision.
  • Collects and analyzes customer and market requirements, and generates reports.
  • Utilizes design methods to implement the construction of a new design model.
  • Uses automated tools to design or modify the design of a product.
  • Assists in the testing and refinement of a new product design.

Product Design and Development: Knowledge of product features; ability to design, build, and develop a new product, technology, or service from concept through to production.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Builds three-dimensional models with basic materials.
  • Communicates with professionals to understand various requirements of product design.
  • Tests and evaluates alternative means of production being considered for use.
  • Uses automated tools to design or modify the design of a product.
  • Assists in building a complex prototype of product.

This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization.

Additional Information: This job requires working from office five days in a week.

Posting Dates:

August 28, 2026 - September 10, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Manager, Compliance
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Job Summary

The Manager, Compliance is a senior individual contributor who serves as a key deputy to the Director, Compliance. The role leads the design, implementation and ongoing enhancement of the company’s global corporate compliance programme, with particular emphasis on compliance risk assessment, policy and procedure development, governance reporting, and oversight of core compliance processes.

Working independently and collaboratively across jurisdictions and business functions, the Manager translates regulatory and ethical requirements into practical controls and helps foster a culture of integrity across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Compliance Risk Assessment: Spearhead global compliance risk assessments by working with subject-matter experts and business units to identify, evaluate and prioritise compliance risks. Develop risk methodologies, dashboards and heat maps, track mitigation actions, and prepare clear updates for senior management, the Risk Committee and the Board.
  • Policies and Procedures: Lead the review, drafting, creation, implementation and ongoing maintenance of compliance policies, procedures and desk instructions. Provide practical guidance to business teams and monitor key policy areas, including conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, related-party transactions, personal account dealing and insider trading.
  • Compliance Registers and Controls: Establish and oversee key compliance registers, including conflicts of interest, related-party transactions, and gifts and hospitality. Ensure declarations are assessed, decisions and conditions are documented, periodic reviews are completed, and issues are escalated and resolved appropriately.
  • Screening and Monitoring Oversight: Oversee risk-based screening and ongoing monitoring of vendors, customers and other third parties in collaboration with onboarding teams. Review higher-risk findings, adverse information, sanctions and politically exposed person matches, determine appropriate risk treatment, and ensure monitoring requirements are documented and completed.
  • Regulatory and Requirements Monitoring: Monitor and interpret emerging local and international laws, regulations and standards affecting the business. Assess their impact and partner with relevant functions to implement requirements across the company’s jurisdictions.
  • Training and Advisory: Develop and deliver practical compliance training for employees and management. Advise stakeholders on the application of policies and coordinate recurring training, attestations, and completion tracking.
  • Incident Management and Investigations: Lead or support investigations into suspected compliance breaches and whistleblower reports. Maintain appropriate audit trails, conduct root-cause analysis, recommend corrective actions, track remediation and liaise with relevant authorities when required.
  • Programme Development and Collaboration: Support the Director, Compliance in building a scalable global compliance function. Work closely with Legal, Risk, Finance, Procurement, onboarding teams and other stakeholders, while providing guidance to colleagues responsible for day-to-day compliance operations.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Education: A recognised bachelor’s degree in law, business, finance, audit, risk management or a related field. A law degree may be helpful for regulatory interpretation and drafting but is not required.
  • Experience: Approximately 8–12 years of progressive experience in core corporate compliance, compliance risk, operational risk, audit or a closely related field, with demonstrated ability to operate independently and lead complex compliance work.
  • Risk Assessment: Substantial hands-on experience designing, conducting, and reporting compliance risk assessments. Experience translating assessments into dashboards, heat maps, action plans and senior governance reporting is strongly preferred.
  • Policy and Governance: Strong experience drafting policies and procedures and communicating complex requirements in clear, precise English. Experience preparing materials for senior management, risk committees or Boards is highly advantageous.
  • Industry Background: Experience in banking, financial services or another highly regulated industry is preferred. Candidates from multinational, pharmaceutical, medical, manufacturing or other sectors will be considered where they can demonstrate extensive compliance risk-assessment and core compliance experience.
  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of corporate governance, third-party risk, sanctions and AML screening, and relevant data privacy requirements such as GDPR and PDPA. Cross-border or multi-jurisdictional experience is advantageous.
  • Capabilities: Excellent analytical judgement, problem-solving, stakeholder management, writing and communication skills. Highly organised, ethical and discreet, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and handle sensitive information.
  • Ways of Working: A responsible, driven and collaborative team player who can work with limited supervision, take ownership of outcomes and contribute effectively in a growing function.

Added Advantage

  • Practical experience using artificial intelligence to improve compliance processes, analysis or reporting. Experience with agentic AI capabilities would be a significant advantage but is not a mandatory requirement.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

The Senior Director is responsible for leading the full lifecycle delivery of DayOne’s data centre developments in Indonesia, ensuring projects are executed safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the highest technical and compliance standards. This role provides strategic leadership, technical oversight, and operational execution across design, permitting, procurement, construction, commissioning, and stakeholder engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership & Governance
  • Lead the overall programme for Indonesia data centre developments.
  • Establish governance structures, KPIs, and executive reporting.
  • Proactively manage regulatory, design, cost, and schedule risks.
  • Project Delivery & Execution
  • Define and manage project scope, schedules, budgets, and resource plans.
  • Guide delivery from feasibility to operational handover.
  • Ensure statutory approvals and compliance
  • Maintain control over quality, schedule, cost, and change management.
  • Technical Excellence
  • Oversee architectural, structural, MEP, civil and mission-critical engineering systems.
  • Lead design reviews, resilience planning, and sustainability optimisation.
  • Drive value engineering and lifecycle cost improvements.
  • Ensure commissioning frameworks meet Tier standards.
  • Contractor, Consultant & Vendor Management
  • Select and manage EPCs, QS firms, consultants and specialist vendors.
  • Build relationships with Spanish authorities, energy suppliers and telecom partners.
  • Oversee contractor QA/QC, H&S, environmental and labour compliance.
  • Ensure accountability for delivery excellence.
  • PMO & Portfolio Oversight
  • Manage reporting cadence, dashboards, risks, and programme controls.
  • Champion improvements in planning tools, methodologies, and digital workflows.
  • Commercial, Financial & Executive Support
  • Lead forecasting, cashflow planning, procurement, and claims management.
  • Build business cases and strategic recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Maintain oversight of budget, contingency, and contractual obligations.

Candidate Profile

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Construction Engineering, Architecture, or related discipline.
  • 10-15+ years experience in large-scale construction; mission-critical preferred.
  • Strong understanding of statutory processes and regulations.
  • Proven leadership of multidisciplinary engineering and construction teams.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with hyperscale data centres, MEP systems, commissioning.
  • Strong industry relationships.
  • MBA/EMBA or advanced engineering degree.
  • Experience with high-availability technical operations.

Success Indicators

  • Delivery within cost, schedule, and quality parameters.
  • Strong relationships with authorities, contractors, and utilities.
  • High-quality governance, reporting, and risk management.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Director, Water Infrastructure Strategy
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

At AirTrunk, we’ve all come together to deliver Data Centres that meet and grow with the needs of our large cloud, content and enterprise customers.

Water management is a key pillar of our sustainability commitments. We design and operate our Data Centers to source water responsibly, reduce reliance on potable water where appropriate, limit usage in water-stressed areas and improve water productivity to support energy, carbon and community outcomes. Through strong water stewardship, we seek to balance business growth with catchment-level resilience, responsible resource use and measurable sustainability impact.

In this leadership role, you will define and lead AirTrunk’s water strategy across the portfolio, managing a team of managers to deliver sustainable, commercially robust and operationally resilient water outcomes.

You will make your mark in a number of ways:

  • Set and own the regional water strategy for Data Center sites, ensuring scalable, sustainable and resilient water supply solutions across existing and future markets.
  • Lead, coach and develop a team of managers responsible for utility connections, upgrades, alternative supply options, water infrastructure delivery and site-level optimisation.
  • Oversee portfolio-wide assessment of water stress, supply risk and regulatory conditions, translating insights into long-term strategic plans and investment priorities.
  • Build executive-level partnerships with utilities, authorities, customers and solution providers to unlock recycled, industrial and alternative water sourcing opportunities.
  • Define the roadmap to water positivity, including on-site and off-site water solutions, reuse strategies, discharge optimisation and measurable sustainability outcomes.
  • Develop and implement a water stewardship framework that aligns site-level water decisions with regional sustainability objectives, local catchment conditions, stakeholder expectations and long-term operational resilience.
  • Establish governance, performance metrics and reporting cadence for water usage, metering, efficiency, risk management and delivery performance across the portfolio.
  • Influence design, site selection, development, commercial and operations decisions to ensure water strategy is embedded into major business and customer commitments.

Your Day to Day

  • Lead a team of managers, setting priorities, removing barriers, allocating resources and ensuring consistent delivery across markets and projects.
  • Represent AirTrunk with senior utility, government, customer and strategic partner stakeholders to shape water supply, infrastructure and sustainability outcomes.
  • Provide executive oversight of water projects, including supply connections and upgrades, infrastructure investments, commercial contracts, risk mitigation and delivery milestones.
  • Partner with customers at senior levels to understand water requirements, influence commitments and ensure AirTrunk’s water strategy supports customer growth and sustainability expectations.
  • Translate water sustainability strategy into practical implementation plans, including recycled water adoption, water reuse, efficiency initiatives, catchment partnerships, performance targets and transparent reporting.
  • Work with Design, Site Selection, Development, Commercial and Operations leaders to align water decisions with business strategy, technical requirements and long-term operating performance.
  • Prepare and present executive-level recommendations, investment papers, governance updates and performance reports for senior leadership forums.
  • Establish operating rhythms for the team, including portfolio reviews, cross-functional escalation, performance tracking and continuous improvement of water strategy delivery.

Requirements

  • Minimally 10 years of relevant experience e.g. water utilities, water project development and delivery, water sustainability water infrastructure services, water consulting, water treatment and recycled water, etc.
  • Strong understanding of the water supply landscape in several of our Asia-Pacific and Japan markets (including Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Hong Kong and Japan)
  • Strong expertise in water supply design principles and various water technologies such as water treatment/recycling/recovery/capture
  • Relationships and networks in the water industry in the above markets
  • Strong analytical thinking and comfortable with data analysis and presentation (especially in PowerPoint and Excel)
  • Provide leadership, mentoring, and technical guidance to the regional team.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multiple concurrent large-scale projects or programs.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, leadership, and problem-solving skills. Ie. Build and maintain strong working relationships with consultants, contractors, suppliers, customer representatives, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Construction Project Manager - Sydney, New South Wales, Australia
job.description:
Job Summary

The Construction Project Manager is responsible for independently leading the delivery of complex, mission-critical data center construction projects across Australia. This role manages projects from initiation through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover while ensuring alignment with business objectives, budget commitments, quality standards, and schedule requirements.

As a recognized subject matter expert, the Construction Project Manager drives project execution excellence, develops business cases and improvement initiatives, contributes to construction standards and best practices, and provides guidance to project teams and stakeholders across disciplines. The role partners closely with Design, Procurement, Operations, Engineering, Network, and external vendor organizations to successfully deliver data center capacity and infrastructure investments.

Reporting into the Australian Director, we are looking for someone who has a strong learning mindset and receptive to coaching, hold all stakeholders to account where required, be open to constructive feedback – and we are willing to put significant time, support and resources into developing the successful candidate.

For this position we are looking for someone with a GC background, data center experience would be a big advantage, with a minimum requirement experience in project delivery in complex builds from adjacent industries.

Key responsibilities

Project Management

  • Independently lead complex data center construction projects from inception through handover
  • Manage project scope, budget, schedule, quality, risk, and operational readiness objectives
  • Develop and review business cases, project plans, cost forecasts, and delivery strategies
  • Ensure construction activities are executed in accordance with company standards, safety requirements, and regulatory obligations
  • Lead project governance, status reporting, issue resolution, and executive communications

Construction Delivery

  • Direct and coordinate architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, suppliers, and commissioning partners
  • Oversee ground-up construction, expansions, renovations, retrofits, and critical infrastructure upgrades
  • Monitor project performance metrics and implement corrective actions as needed
  • Evaluate construction methods, procurement strategies, and delivery approaches to improve outcomes
  • Ensure project documentation is complete and maintained throughout the project lifecycle

Subject Matter Expertise

  • Serve as an experienced construction PM experienced in managing mission-critical/data delivery
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of construction standards, processes, tools, and methodologies
  • Identify opportunities to improve project delivery efficiency, cost performance, quality, and risk management
  • Support lessons learned reviews and knowledge-sharing initiatives across the organization

Stakeholder and Vendor Management

  • Build and maintain effective relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Design, Procurement, Operations, Finance, Legal, and IT
  • Manage vendor performance, contract compliance, change management, and commercial considerations
  • Influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations and strong project leadership

Qualifications, key skills and attributes:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or Trade qualification with relevant project experience
  • Responsible for construction project management in delivering mission-critical, industrial, advanced manufacturing, telecommunications, or data center construction projects
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent construction projects through planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover
  • Demonstrated experience in project controls including budgeting, forecasting, scheduling, risk management, and change management
  • Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems supporting critical infrastructure environments
  • Experience managing general contractors, consultants, suppliers, and commissioning providers
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive project outcomes without direct authority
  • Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills
  • Learning mindset to ensure all training and development opportunities are taken up

Benefits of the role:

  • Permanent, full-time role with salary package including annual bonus, health allowance and company shares
  • Free access to onsite gyms, EV chargers and a wealth of company, financial and wellness employee benefits
  • Develop expertise across all Australian construction projects, with future prospect to lean into projects across the region in future years
  • Reporting to a Director who will be focused on given the successful candidate support, ongoing training and development and guidance in the role
  • Role stability within booming industry, strong career growth opportunities (role is to backfill internal promotion) and work on complex, mission critical projects
  • Client-side move, mission-critical construction, Australian portfolio, strong development, regional exposure and a growing industry.

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

job.title: Intern, Accounting and Finance Services
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

About the Internship

This internship goes beyond traditional finance operations by providing opportunities to participate in finance transformation, process governance, Shared Service Centre (SSC) oversight, data analytics, automation and AI initiatives.

The intern will work closely with stakeholders to improve finance processes, strengthen controls and support the digitalisation of finance operations.

Scope of Exposure

The responsibilities and learning opportunities described below represent potential areas of exposure during the internship. Actual assignments will be determined based on business priorities, project availability and operational needs during the internship period. While every effort will be made to provide a meaningful and well-rounded experience, interns may be exposed to only some of the areas listed and their responsibilities may evolve based on ongoing business requirements and projects.

Key Responsibilities

Finance Operations & Reporting

  • Support month-end, quarter-end and year-end finance activities.
  • Assist in the preparation, review and analysis of financial information and management reports.
  • Support accounting processes and financial reporting activities.
  • Perform data extraction, reconciliations and validation exercises.
  • Assist in documenting finance processes, workflows and standard operating procedures.

Process Improvement, Automation & AI

  • Participate in the design and implementation of automation and AI-enabled solutions for finance processes.
  • Conduct process reviews to identify inefficiencies, manual activities and opportunities for digitalisation.
  • Assist in developing dashboards, analytical tools and automation solutions to improve productivity, controls and reporting.

Compliance, Controls & Data Analytics

  • Perform data analysis to identify policy non-compliance, control exceptions and unusual transaction patterns.
  • Support monitoring activities through review of transactional data and key risk indicators.
  • Assist in developing management reports and dashboards that provide insights into compliance, operational performance and process effectiveness.

Shared Service Centre (SSC) Governance & Quality Review

  • Support the review and validation of work performed by the Shared Service Centre (SSC) to ensure completeness, accuracy and compliance with established procedures.
  • Perform quality checks on SSC deliverables before final approval by Keppel process owners or team leads.
  • Assist in reviewing Master Data Management (MDM) requests by validating supporting documentation, data accuracy and compliance with governance requirements.
  • Identify exceptions, recurring issues and process gaps, and escalate observations to the relevant stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work with stakeholders on operational and transformation initiatives.
  • Gather business requirements, document feedback and support implementation of improvement projects.
  • Prepare analysis papers, presentations and management updates for decision-making and governance discussions.

What You Will Learn

During the internship, you will gain hands-on exposure to:

Accounting & Finance Operations

  • End-to-end finance processes including Record-to-Report (R2R), Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C).
  • Financial reporting, reconciliations and finance operations in a large corporate environment.

Data Analytics & Business Insights

  • Techniques for analysing large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, control weaknesses and compliance gaps.
  • Development of management dashboards and performance reporting.

AI & Automation in Finance

  • Practical experience in identifying and implementing automation opportunities.
  • Exposure to AI tools, workflow automation projects.
  • Understanding how technology can enhance efficiency, controls, governance and decision-making within finance functions.

Shared Services Governance & Performance Management

  • Understanding how organisations govern and oversee Shared Service Centre operations.
  • Exposure to quality assurance reviews, management approvals and control monitoring activities.
  • Experience in reviewing SSC deliverables, service performance metrics and continuous improvement initiatives.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Application of finance policies, internal controls and governance frameworks.
  • Experience in identifying risks, monitoring compliance and supporting audit activities.

Professional & Business Skills

  • Stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Business communication, presentation and project management skills.
  • Participation in real business transformation initiatives.

This internship is ideal for students interested in combining Finance, Data Analytics, Governance, Shared Services Management, Automation and AI to solve real business challenges and drive meaningful improvements across finance operations.

job.title: Senior ICT Server Infrastructure Project Engineer (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

STACK is seeking an experienced Senior ICT Server Infrastructure Project Engineer to lead the design, deployment, commissioning and operational handover of highly available server, storage and virtualisation infrastructure for new data centre projects. Reporting to the Senior Manager, ICT Engineering, this delivery-focused role requires strong System Integrator project experience and hands-on expertise in server hardware, SAN/NAS storage, virtualisation and clustered platforms.

Key Responsibility

  • Support the OT Engineering team to design highly available, fault-tolerant platforms, including VMware vSphere clusters, Microsoft Hyper-V failover clusters, and SAN/NAS storage layouts.
  • Work closely with the OT Engineering team to produce compute and storage sizing calculations, hardware Bills of Materials, rack elevations, and cabling/port schedules for server, storage and virtualisation builds for new project tenders.
  • Manage and coordinate with ICT vendors to ensure the intended server, storage and virtualisation design for the campus is successfully deployed to meet project timelines.
  • Develop and execute test scripts for server, storage and virtualisation infrastructure Testing & Commissioning, including HA/failover, replication, backup/restore and performance validation.
  • Oversee the transition and successful handover of Network, Server and Storage services to operations and support teams.

Qualification and required technical and working experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Information Technology or Computer Science.
  • At least five years of hands-on experience within a System Integrator project-delivery team, delivering successful implementations of server, storage and virtualisation infrastructure for data centres or large, complex IT infrastructure projects.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of server hardware architecture, including Dell PowerEdge, HPE ProLiant, Cisco UCS or Lenovo, and out-of-band management.
  • Core skills in enterprise SAN/NAS storage arrays, with hands-on experience across NetApp ONTAP and/or Pure Storage FlashArray.
  • Strong virtualisation skills across VMware and Microsoft Hyper-V, including clustering, HA, DRS, vMotion, Live Migration and Hyper-V Replica.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

job.title: Senior Server Administrator
job.description:
Date: 27 Aug 2026

Location:

ID

Company: Digital Edge DC

Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

Reporting to the Critical IT Director, this role is the regional owner of Digital Edge’s mission-critical on-premises server infrastructure across our data centre portfolio. This is an estate of more than 100 physical servers, supporting more than 180 critical virtual machines. It unites deep engineering ownership of high-performance server clusters built on the hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) concept with 24/7 operational excellence. The role owns the physical server hardware and the hypervisor layer that underpin the HCI platform; the operating systems and applications running within the virtual machines are managed by their respective owners and sit outside the scope of this role. The platform is vendor agnostic, and the role demands a deep understanding of the underlying technology stack of compute, virtualisation, software-defined storage and the management planes that bind them. The emphasis is not on deploying the latest and greatest virtualization technology, but on consistency of deployment and a disciplined operational mindset across the portfolio.

Key responsibilities

  • Performance, Optimization & Capacity Engineering
  • Own end-to-end performance engineering of high-performance server clusters, establishing baselines and tuning compute, virtualisation and storage layers to eliminate bottlenecks across the stack.
  • Lead capacity planning and forecasting for the regional server estate, modelling workload growth and ensuring headroom for expansion without over-provisioning.
  • Define and track KPIs for cluster health, utilisation and efficiency, driving continuous optimisation of resource allocation and workload placement.
  • Benchmark and evaluate new server hardware generations and HCI software releases, validating price-performance before fleet-wide adoption.
  • Infrastructure Strategy & Resilience Architecture
  • Own the regional server infrastructure architecture and design standards, built on the hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) concept while remaining vendor agnostic across hardware and software platforms.
  • Design and continually enhance high-availability, clustering, replication, backup and disaster-recovery architectures to meet mission-critical availability targets.
  • Develop the multi-year technology roadmap for the server platform, prioritizing consistent, standardized deployments and operational stability over adoption of the newest technology, with predictable lifecycle management and hardware refresh cycles.
  • Act as the subject-matter expert (SME) and technical authority for server infrastructure across the regional portfolio, engaging early in data centre design and expansion projects to inform compute deployment decisions.
  • 24/7 Operations, Availability & Security
  • Run day-to-day operations and maintenance of production server clusters at the hardware and hypervisor layers within a 24/7 operational model, including provisioning, patching, configuration, change, asset and fault management.
  • Deploy and operate supporting platform services alongside the core clusters, such as backup infrastructure (e.g. Proxmox Backup Server).
  • Serve as the escalation point for major incidents affecting the server estate, providing 24/7 standby on rotation as the last-resort escalation tier, and leading root-cause analysis and driving permanent corrective actions.
  • Own security hardening of the server estate, including hypervisor and firmware baselines, vulnerability remediation, access control and audit readiness.
  • Ensure comprehensive monitoring, alerting and observability coverage across the fleet, enabling proactive detection of capacity, performance and availability risks.
  • Automation, Tooling & Standardization
  • Build and maintain infrastructure automation and infrastructure-as-code using tools such as Ansible, Terraform and Python to streamline provisioning, configuration and operations.
  • Drive standardisation of server builds, golden images, cluster configurations and operational runbooks across the portfolio.
  • Propose and implement system enhancements that improve the performance, reliability and efficiency of the server infrastructure.
  • Vendor & Stakeholder Management
  • Manage OEM, software and support vendors, including evaluation, coordination and escalation, while preserving the platform’s vendor-agnostic posture.
  • Serve as the primary interface for the internal teams whose virtual machines run on the platform, managing onboarding, capacity requests and resource allocation against agreed service levels.
  • Communicate proactively with virtual machine owners on planned maintenance windows, platform changes and incidents affecting their workloads, setting clear expectations on service impact and restoration.
  • Define and document the shared-responsibility boundary between the platform and virtual machine owners, keeping hypervisor-level and guest-level duties clearly delineated.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

**

The successful candidate:

  • Diploma/ Degree in computer science, engineering or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in server and compute infrastructure engineering and operations within mission-critical environments (data centre, colocation, cloud or service provider)
  • Deep hands-on expertise with HCI and virtualisation platforms (e.g. Proxmox VE with Ceph, VMware vSphere/vSAN, Nutanix, Hyper-V), including cluster design, high availability and live migration, with a vendor-agnostic mindset and familiarity with supporting services such as Proxmox Backup Server and Proxmox Mail Gateway
  • Strong understanding of enterprise server hardware, including firmware lifecycle, out-of-band management (iDRAC, iLO, BMC) and facilities considerations such as power, cooling and rack density
  • Experienced in administering Linux at the hypervisor and storage layers at scale, with a strong understanding of Ceph (RBD, CephFS, replication and erasure coding) and data protection (backup, replication, disaster recovery)
  • Hands-on experience with automation and infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Ansible, Terraform, Python), and with monitoring, observability and capacity-management tooling
  • Ability to participate in a 24/7 rotational standby as the last-resort escalation point, and to support planned maintenance windows
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with clients, senior management, staff and vendors

**

Preferred (advantageous):

  • Professional certifications, such as VMware VCP/VCAP, Nutanix NCP/NCM, Microsoft (Windows Server / Azure Local) or Red Hat (RHCE) certifications.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Network Operations & Services Engineer
job.description:
36875

Job location:

Bangalore, IN

Gurugram, IN

Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.

Why we need this role

As a Technical Lead, Assisted Services within Premium Network Services, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management and execution of customer change requests (MACD - Move, Add, Change, and Delete. Acting as a trusted operational contact for customers who have contracted Assisted Services, you will ensure that service requests are tracked, documented, validated, and implemented in accordance with defined operational processes and service commitments.

Working within extended European business hours, you will manage and execute customer changes while delivering an exceptional customer experience. For changes requiring implementation outside of business hours, you will prepare detailed Methods of Procedure (MoPs) to enable successful execution by operational shift teams.

To be successful in this role, you will develop and apply technical expertise across IP networking, SD-WAN, and emerging SASE technologies. You will work closely with Customer Solution Engineers (CSEs), Technical Solution Engineers (TSEs), Operations teams, and customers to ensure network changes are delivered efficiently, accurately, and with minimal service impact. As part of the Premium Network Services offering, you will play a key role in maintaining customer satisfaction and driving operational excellence.

What you will do

Own customer changes as part of the Assisted Services Package contracted by the client - MACD (Move, Add, Change, Delete).

Act as the primary customer contact for MACD-related activities.

Validate and translate customer requirements into executable network changes.

Implement changes across IP, SD-WAN, and related network technologies.

Troubleshoot issues arising during change implementation.

Create and maintain Methods of Procedure (MoPs) for planned changes.

Coordinate with CSEs, TSEs, and Operations teams to ensure successful delivery.

Ensure all requests are accurately documented and tracked.

Contribute to process improvements and operational excellence.

What we're looking for

Essential Skills: Experience supporting and implementing changes within IP/SDN networking environments.

Good understanding of IP networking fundamentals and routing technologies.

Experience supporting Versa Networks SD-WAN solutions.

Familiarity with GUI and CLI-based network management tools.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Ability to interpret customer requirements and implement network configurations.

Strong customer communication skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Desirable Skills.

Exposure to SASE technologies, particularly Versa Networks and Fortinet.

Understanding of ITIL service management principles.

Experience in managed services, premium support, or customer-facing roles.

Familiarity with change management processes and operational procedures.

job.title: Senior Specialist, Procurement - DC Operations
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Specialist, Procurement – DC Operations is responsible for managing procurement activities within data center operations, ensuring cost efficiency, compliance, and timely delivery of goods and services. This role supports strategic sourcing initiatives, vendor management, and process optimization to align with organizational goals and operational requirements.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Execute procurement strategies for data center operations, including review, negotiate, and redline commercial contracts to ensure alignment with business requirements and risk mitigation objectives.
  • Provide procurement support and coverage for other regions as required.
  • Manage vendor relationships to ensure quality, compliance, and performance standards.
  • Analyze procurement data to identify cost-saving opportunities and improve operational efficiency.
  • Lead and facilitate day-to-day procurement operations for the assigned region, ensuring effective delivery of sourcing and procurement activities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Finance, Operations, Engineering) to forecast demand and align procurement plans.
  • Ensure adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, and sustainability goals.
  • Support risk management by monitoring supplier performance and mitigating supply chain disruptions.
  • Maintain accurate records of procurement transactions and prepare reports for management review.
  • Responsible for the timely review, approval, and release of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and Purchase Orders (POs) in accordance with company policies, procurement procedures, and delegated authority requirements.
  • Coach, mentor, and support the development of junior procurement team members.

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

  • Strong understanding of procurement processes, supply chain management, and vendor negotiation.
  • Familiarity with data center operations and associated hardware/software procurement.
  • Proficiency in procurement tools and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle).
  • Analytical mindset with ability to interpret data and drive decisions.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.
  • Preferred: Professional certifications such as CPSM (Certified Professional in Supply Management) or CIPS.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 7-10 of years procurement or supply chain experience, preferably in data center or technology infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated experience in vendor management and contract negotiation.
  • Exposure to global procurement practices and compliance standards.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Regularly moves equipment and other hardware up to 50 lbs.
  • Frequently move about inside and outside of data center / facility
  • Remain stationary for long periods of time.
  • Ascend / Descend a ladder and perform duties atop a raised platform.
  • Position self in small spaces.
  • Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • Perform work during US business hours and time zones.

Work conditions & other requirements

  • Work onsite at a data center location.(Hybrid)
  • Exposure to varying temperatures and loud noises.
  • Exposure to outdoor weather conditions.
  • Travel required 20% of time.
  • Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.

job.title: Operations Finance Senior Analyst
job.description:
About the Role

This is a core plant finance role — you'll be sitting at the plant, working closely with operations, and owning the numbers that drive manufacturing performance. From tracking hourly rates to building the factory P&L, you'll be the finance partner the plant relies on daily. If you've worked in a manufacturing setup and enjoy being close to the action, this is your kind of role.

Key Responsibilities

1.  Factory P&L Ownership

  • Prepare and maintain the monthly Factory P&L for the Ambernath Annex — IS & Switchgear Factory
  • Track fixed vs. variable costs, analyse deviations, and flag margin risks early
  • Ensure timely and accurate monthly cost closure

2.  Hourly Rate Tracking & Analysis

  • Capture, compute, and monitor the plant hourly rate (cost per hour) on a monthly basis
  • Analyse movement in hourly rates — volume-driven vs. cost-driven variances
  • Present hourly rate trends and bridge analysis to plant leadership

3.  Plant KPIs & Operational Excellence

  • Own and report key plant KPIs — Efficiency %, Productivity %, Earned Hours, Conversion Cost per Hour
  • Drive Plant Operational Excellence by partnering with operations to identify cost levers and track improvement actions
  • Prepare monthly plant performance scorecards

4.  Productivity Savings

  • Track and validate productivity savings initiatives at the plant level
  • Maintain a savings tracker with clear project-wise breakdowns and YTD impact
  • Coordinate with operations and CI teams to quantify and sign off on realized savings

5.  PDSL (Promise Date Service Level) Analysis

  • Analysis of PDSL Forecast v/s Actuals
  • Gaps in Understanding why PDSL was not met

6.  Rate Contracts & Vendor Rate Management

  • Review and track rate contracts for key plant services (labour, maintenance, logistics, consumables)
  • Monitor vendor rates against benchmarks and flag deviations
  • Support procurement finance in rate negotiations with cost data and spend analytics

7.  Headcount Analysis — Hired vs. Required

  • Maintain and report monthly Headcount Hired vs. Headcount Required for the plant (permanent + contract)
  • Analyse manpower cost per unit and productivity per head
  • Flag over/under-staffing and support workforce planning with data

8.  Budgeting, Forecasting & MIS

  • Support annual budgets and periodic rolling forecasts (4+8, 8+4) for plant costs
  • Prepare plant-level MIS and flash reports
  • Build bridge analysis — Actuals vs. Budget vs. Prior Year

9.  Oracle ERP Operations

  • Handle day-to-day plant accounting transactions in Oracle — JVs, cost uploads, accruals, reconciliations
  • Ensure correct cost centre and account mapping
  • Generate reports and extracts from Oracle for analysis

10.  Compliance & Standards

  • Ensure all plant accounting is in line with applicable Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Cost Accounting Standards (CAS)
  • Support internal/external audits with plant-level documentation
  • Maintain strong internal controls over plant financial processes

Must-Have Skills & Qualifications

AreaRequirement

| | | | --- | --- | | Qualification | CMA (ICMAI) — Qualified | | Experience | 3–4 years in a manufacturing plant finance / plant controlling role | | Accounting Standards | Well-versed with Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Cost Accounting Standards (CAS) | | Industry | Core manufacturing (mandatory) — preferably heavy engineering, electrical, or process industry | | ERP | Hands-on Oracle ERP experience (GL, Costing, Inventory modules) | | Cost Accounting | Strong understanding of CAS, standard costing, variance analysis, absorption costing | | Communication | Strong verbal and written communication — can present to plant leadership confidently | | Excel | Advanced — pivots, lookups, large data handling, dashboard-level MIS |

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Earned Hours methodology and conversion cost frameworks
  • Experience working with intercompany (ICO) transactions or contract manufacturing setups
  • Familiarity with CapEx tracking and project accounting
  • Understanding of energy cost analysis and utility rate tracking

What We're Looking For

  • Someone who's comfortable on the shop floor — not just behind a desk
  • Can connect the dots between operational actions and financial outcomes
  • Proactive — doesn't wait for month-end to spot issues
  • Can explain cost movements in simple language to non-finance teams
  • Takes ownership of the numbers and drives action, not just reporting

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Vertiv is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, you can request help by sending an email to [help.join@vertiv.com](mailto:help.join@vertiv.com)

job.title: Team Coordinator -Integration - P3
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The Team Coordinator assists the supervisor in the operation of an area of a department so that the Supervisor may increase focus on the people in the area and not be as involved in daily specific workflow issues.  The Team Coordinator is primarily responsible for ensuring continuous production flow by relieving bottlenecks within the department, filling in positions as needed, identifying part/resource shortages, and finding solutions and/or notifying Supervisors that solutions are needed, facilitating implementation of Lean Manufacturing processes, and requesting non-personnel related assistance of other departments by completing work orders and requesting engineering and SFA assistance. May be required to do other reasonable manufacturing duties as assigned.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reduces production bottle necks on manufacturing product line.
  • Address and correct workflow issues.
  • Learns all positions and fills in as needed.
  • Identifies part and resources shortages and provides solutions.
  • Communicates above situations to Supervisors, Engineers and Managers as appropriate.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School graduate or GED and minimal WorkKeys scores for the position.
  • 4+ Years Experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous lead position experience.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds unassisted.
  • Able to lift between 50 and 100 pounds assisted.
  • able to learn to work with all hand tools required of all positions within the area, including general work tools, pneumatic and hydraulic tools, brazing and wiring tools and equipment, forklifts, etc.
  • Able to effectively direct the flow of others.
  • Able to foster teamwork and resolve conflict.
  • Able to work long hours and a variety of shits as needed.
  • Able to learn and utilize materials tracking system.

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to work in an environment with temperatures occasionally above 100 degrees or below 32 degrees.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • 10% May need to travel when appropriate depending on product line needs.

job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

26 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Telstra Retail: Part Time Customer Service & Sales Consultant MORNINGTON

Job Summary

As a Retail Consultant, you will provide frontline support by assisting customers with product selection, service activation, and troubleshooting basic issues. You will create positive experiences through effective communication and adherence to retail standards. This role demonstrates foundational autonomy and contributes to customer satisfaction and store performance.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.

Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Hourly Rate: $33.33 per hour

*Junior rates apply for those under 20 years of age.

Penalty rates are as follows: Additional 25% for weekday hours worked after 6 PM, 25% for hours worked on Saturday, 100% for hours worked on Sunday and 150% for hours worked on public holidays.*

  • Plus 12% Superannuation
  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs with LinkedIn Learning, and develop your career with our Future Ready program designed to build on your skills and prepare you for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.
