That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to optimize the Production organization’s assembly methods, processes, and equipment to minimize labor hours in accordance with business strategies related to quality, efficiency, costs, and safety. Each day, you will ensure appropriate production methods, cycle time, equipment performance, and materials/components in support of production targets. You will also showcase your skills by defining the working phase sequence of a new production process to align with the targeted product cost and equipment investment budget.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification Smart Power Business to be based at Nelamangala, BANGALORE, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Oversee Industry 4.0 and Smart Factory initiatives, identifying innovative ideas and developing them into practical manufacturing solutions.
  • Manage project planning, execution, budgeting, and implementation of Smart Factory projects within defined timelines and priorities.
  • Analyze existing material flow, information flow, operational processes, and factory architecture to design and implement future-ready smart manufacturing systems.
  • Identify key technical requirements across direct and indirect manufacturing processes and develop standardized, automated, and optimized solutions.
  • Plan and facilitate assembly processes, layouts, and assembly line qualification, while effectively managing stakeholders, negotiations, communication, and complex problem-solving.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical, Electromechanical, Mechatronics, or related Engineering, with 12–15 years of relevant experience in Automation or Industrial Engineering.
  • Advanced practical knowledge of PLC, SCADA/HMI, Industry 4.0, IoT, and smart factory technologies.
  • Proficiency in industrial communication protocols including Modbus TCP/IP, RS232/RS485, Ethernet, Profinet, and Profibus, with good knowledge of LAN/Wi-Fi networking.
  • Experience with NI-LabVIEW and programming technologies such as C#/.NET, MVC, WPF, and Python; knowledge of MySQL/MS-SQL or other RDBMS.
  • Working knowledge of CAD tools such as Pro-Engineer/Creo or AutoCAD, along with basic understanding of machine design and fixture development.
  • Working knowledge of Operational Excellence methodologies, including Kaizen, 5S, Value Stream Mapping, Theory of Constraints, Visual Management, and Root Cause Analysis.
  • Extensive problem-solving, project management, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to guide automation and Smart Factory initiatives from concept through implementation.

More about us:

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

  • Project Planning and Monitoring: Assign responsibilities, delegate authorities, and implement quality systems.
  • Technical Issue Resolution: Resolve key technical and quality issues and provide technical guidance to the team.
  • Client and Project Manager Interface: Interface with customers and project managers regarding engineering discipline issues.

  • Project Reporting: Report project status to customers and management.

  • 2+ Yrs of experience in Telecom, Oil& gas. Engineering Documentation and Design: Experience in preparing Telecom engineering documentation, design specifications of Security systems (CCTV, PAGA, ACS) &Radio systems, cabinet/panel GA and wiring drawings, heat dissipation and power consumption calculations, building and field layouts and test procedures.
  • Testing and Standards Compliance: Experience in building Telecom test strategies and plans and understanding standards and regulatory requirements.

job.title: CFIN P2P & Treasury Solution Architect
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

CFIN P2P and Treasury Solution Lead ###

Your role and responsibilities:

We are seeking a skilled Procure to Pay (P2P) & Treasury (TRE) Solution architect to play a key role in configuring, implementing, and supporting P2P/ TRE processes within the Central Finance (CFIN) system. The P2P/ TRE Solution architect will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, process owners, and technical teams to ensure seamless integration of P2P/TRE functions within the CFIN framework. This role requires deep functional knowledge of P2P/TRE processes, as well as the ability to translate business requirements into system configurations that optimize efficiency, accuracy, and business performance. This position requires close coordination with Deployment team, Functional architects and external vendors, to maintain and evolve the P2P/TRE architecture, ensuring it meets business needs and complies with ABB's standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • P2P/TRE Process Configuration: Configure and maintain Procure to Pay (P2P) & Treasury (TRE) processes such as. within the Central Finance (CFIN) system, ensuring alignment with business needs and industry best practices. Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders and process owners to thoroughly understand their requirements, document functional specifications, and translate these into system configurations.
  • System Integration: Facilitate seamless integration of P2P/TRE processes within the CFIN system, as well as with other enterprise systems (ERP, GTS, etc.), ensuring smooth data flow and automation of processes across platforms. User Support & Training: Provide ongoing functional support to end-users, addressing issues, offering solutions, and conducting training to ensure optimal utilization of the system and full understanding of P2P/TRE processes.
  • Testing & Validation: Participate in testing and validation activities for new configurations, enhancements, and fixes, ensuring they meet business and functional requirements. Process Optimization: Regularly monitor and evaluate P2P/TRE processes to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency improvements, and best practice implementation within the CFIN system. Documentation & Compliance: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for P2P/TRE system configurations, process flows, and integration points, ensuring compliance with internal standards and regulatory guidelines.
  • Collaboration with Technical Teams: Work closely with IS architects, developers, and technical teams to ensure that functional requirements are correctly implemented and aligned with system design specifications. Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution: Provide expert troubleshooting support for P2P/TRE -related system issues, working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to resolve any challenges promptly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about the latest industry trends, best practices, and system updates to continuously enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of P2P/TRE processes within CFIN. Project and New Demand Management: Take ownership of configuring new demands or changes in system functionality, ensuring proper alignment with system design documentation and business requirements. P2P/TRE-Related Data Management: Oversee the management and accuracy of P2P/TRE-related data within the system, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and compliance with business rules across all P2P / TRE processes.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in P2P/ TRE - SAP ECC, GCM, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN, or IT architecture. Proven experience (5+ years) in P2P / TRE process management, with a strong background in system configuration and implementation within SAP or similar ERP environments (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN). Strong functional.
  • knowledge of P2P/ TRE processes, including procurement, invoicing, payments and Treasury functions (cash management, liquidity forecasting, bank reconciliations) Experience in configuring P2P/ TRE processes in SAP or similar ERP systems, with a solid understanding of integration points and data flows across systems. Familiarity with Central Finance (CFIN) and integration with other finance-related modules.
  • Experience with requirements gathering, business analysis, and documentation of functional specifications. High level understanding on Global Bank Payment set up High level understanding in areas of PINO - Payment in name of & POBO - Payment on behalf of Strong experience in vendor correspondence & futuristic approach for various bank payment rejection & global solution approach to handle such situations.
  • High level understanding of payment solutions at global level. Experience in GCM-Global Cash management & various Bank connections globally. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and technical teams. A strong focus on continuous improvement and automation, with a passion for driving innovation within enterprise systems.
  • Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and third-party service providers to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

More about us:

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who delivers forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results and operates with the highest standards.

We value people from different backgrounds. Apply today for your next career step within ABB and visit www.abb.com to learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Solutions Analyst
job.description:
About Goodman

At Goodman, your career is more than just a job – it’s about growth, innovation, and making a lasting impact. Whether you’re building your career in property, data centres, finance, legal, or beyond, we value diverse perspectives and seek individuals who are passionate about driving our business forward.

As providers of essential infrastructure for the digital economy, Goodman has been developing its data centre capability since 2005. Since then, we have grown to become a large owner of powered sites globally. Our global power bank of 5.0GW includes completed facilities, secured power and potential data centre projects across 13 major international cities. This has been built up over time through our expertise in securing land, planning and power in highly sought after locations in major global cities.

Solutions Analyst

Join Goodman’s Australian Technology Centre of Excellence and play a key role in supporting and improving the systems that underpin our property, finance and operational platforms.

We are looking for a Solutions Analyst to support the delivery, enhancement and ongoing operation of our business applications environment, with a strong focus on Yardi. You will help translate business needs into practical system improvements, supporting reliable, integrated and easy-to-use technology across Goodman’s Australian business.

About the role

This is a hands-on solution delivery role where you will work closely with business stakeholders, Group IT and external vendors to design, test and implement system changes, support project and production environments, and help ensure our platforms are stable, integrated and aligned to best practice.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys being close to the business, solving practical system problems and building deep expertise in a core property technology platform.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, test and implement Yardi changes, enhancements and configuration updates.
  • Provide administration and support across test, project and production environments.
  • Troubleshoot application issues and coordinate resolution with vendors and internal IT teams.
  • Develop and test interfaces between applications and support IT and user acceptance testing.
  • Prepare deployment scripts, change submissions, rollback plans, backups and technical documentation.
  • Act as a Yardi subject matter expert, supporting best-practice use of the platform.
  • Provide guidance, training and mentoring to users to build capability and improve adoption.
  • Contribute to governance, risk management and continuous improvement across Goodman’s technology platforms.

About you

Strong hands-on Yardi experience is important for this role, ideally across configuration, administration, testing or application support. You will be comfortable working across technical and business teams, translating requirements into practical system outcomes and supporting users through change.

You will bring strong analytical and problem-solving skills, good communication skills, close attention to detail and a practical, delivery-focused approach. Experience preparing technical documentation, user guides and deployment materials will be highly regarded. Knowledge of property management, general ledger systems, SQL, Power BI or TM1 would also be beneficial.

This role would suit someone who enjoys combining systems knowledge with business understanding. You will be practical, curious and comfortable working across both detail and bigger-picture outcomes — from troubleshooting an issue through to supporting project delivery, user adoption and continuous improvement.

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

##

Business Analyst

Goodman is looking for a Business Analyst to join our AU Technology Centre of Excellence in Sydney. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of Finance, Technology and business transformation, helping shape practical solutions that improve how our teams work every day.

In this role, you will partner closely with finance leaders, technology teams and business stakeholders to understand what the business needs, where processes can be improved, and how systems can better support decision-making, efficiency and growth. You will play a hands-on role across finance systems and business application projects, from discovery and requirements through to testing, business readiness, implementation and post-go-live support.

You will also have the opportunity to build broader project delivery experience. Where a dedicated Project Manager is not in place, you will support planning, governance, reporting, vendor coordination and post-implementation review, giving you exposure across the full project lifecycle and the opportunity to take on greater delivery responsibility over time.

What you’ll do

  • Act as the link between Finance, Technology and the wider business, translating business needs into practical technology solutions.
  • Work with finance leaders and subject matter experts to understand current processes, identify pain points and shape better future-state ways of working.
  • Lead the requirements journey from discovery through to sign-off, creating clear documentation that gives business, technical and vendor teams a shared understanding of what needs to be delivered.
  • Support solution validation, process mapping, user acceptance testing, defect resolution and business readiness.
  • Help ensure change lands well by supporting end-user documentation, training material, communications and adoption activities.
  • Coordinate delivery where required, including project planning, status reporting, risk and issue tracking, governance checkpoints and post-implementation review.
  • Partner with vendors, technical teams and business stakeholders to deliver solutions that are practical, fit for purpose and aligned to business priorities.

What you’ll bring

  • 3–5 years’ experience in business analysis, business process transformation or software implementation projects.
  • Strong finance or accounting knowledge, gained within property, investment, funds management or a related environment.
  • Experience working with finance systems, reporting tools or business applications - Yardi is essential
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Experience supporting UAT, requirements traceability, business readiness and change communications.
  • A practical, structured approach, with the confidence to work across business and technology teams

We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. job.title: Senior Application Engineer(DX Units/VRV/VRF/DX units/AHU))
job.description:
Role: Senior Application Engineer (DX Units/VRV/VRF/DX units/AHU)

Location: Gurugram

Full/ Part-time: Full time

About Carrier:

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow Carrier on social media platforms @Carrier.

About the Role

Looking for highly talented, organized application engineering professionals who are very strong related to DX Units/VRV/VRF/DX units/FAH/AHU products.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Receive inquiries from Sales Engineers or Sales Manager via phone / email / by hand.
  • 7 to 10 years of proficient experience in selecting and configuring DX cooling systems based on cooling loads, application type, and energy efficiency criteria.
  • In-depth knowledge of VRF system design, including heat recovery, simultaneous heating/cooling applications, and indoor/outdoor unit compatibility.
  • Skilled in the application and selection of FAHU systems, including integration with treated fresh air systems and humidity control.
  • Generating SAP quotations inline with project specifications.
  • Preparing technical submittals with compliance statement
  • Providing technical clarifications / assistance to SE, consultants, customers.
  • Customer engagement to resolve technical issues and optimization.
  • Assisting to update on the latest software, catalogs and information from Carrier wherever applicable.

Role Purpose

  • Work closely with sales to understand client needs and deliver optimal solutions.
  • Interpret project specifications and recommend suitable HVAC systems and components.
  • Ensure all solutions meet industry codes (ASHRAE, ISO, local regulations) and energy efficiency standards.
  • Ability to analyze technical submittals, product data sheets, and performance curves to validate equipment suitability.

Minimum Requirements

  • Engineering Degree, preferably in Mechanical Engineering
  • 3-6 years prior relevant experience as an application Engineer
  • Strong understanding of HVAC systems and thermodynamics.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey technical concepts clearly.
  • Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail.

Benefits

We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and well‑being programs. Offerings vary by role and location and are designed to support employees’ health, security, and success.

job.title: Project Engineer
job.description:
Build a career with confidence!

Automated Logic is now part of Carrier, a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

The Role

In this role, you’ll play a key part in shaping the technical excellence of our projects. You’ll produce engineering documentation, develop BMS software and graphics, optimise control systems, and provide on-site technical support to ensure every project is accurate, efficient, and fit for purpose.

Key responsibilities

  • Create and update engineering drawings, points lists, functional descriptions, and O&M manuals
  • Develop BMS software, graphics, programming, and site-building
  • Tune PID loops and support commissioning teams with troubleshooting
  • Conduct site visits to ensure programs and graphics meet operational requirements
  • Configure system IP networks, including internet connectivity
  • Identify value-adding, cross-selling, and efficiency improvement opportunities
  • Communicate effectively and work collaboratively across teams
  • Participate in training, promotions, and cross-functional initiatives
  • Support a culture of continuous improvement and quality standards

Requirements

  • Strong experience with BMS, HVAC, building controls, or automation systems
  • Background in managing or supporting technical teams
  • Experience with installations, commissioning support, and controls engineering
  • Well-developed analytical, reporting, and problem-solving abilities
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and self-motivated
  • Able to manage multiple tasks and shifting priorities
  • Strong relationship-building ability and a solutions mindset

Benefits

  • Attractive salary package + Full time permanent opportunity
  • Car allowance + mobile phone + laptop
  • Excellent job stability + Ongoing training and development opportunities
  • Inclusive work environment + Supportive management team

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity, and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops, and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork, and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback, and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

job.title: Engineering Project Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Engineering Project Manager: Drive Global Earthmoving Technology Innovation

Are you ready to transform the earthmoving industry by leading the development of core software and hardware system components for an international system integration team within our Caterpillar Trimble Control Technologies (CTCT) division? Join us to drive cutting-edge technology from concept to market, making a tangible impact on global construction and mining operations.

About Us

The CTCT division (a joint venture between Trimble and Caterpillar) develops positioning and control products for earthmoving and paving machines in the construction and mining industries, using technologies such as GPS, optical total stations, lasers, and sonics. The products are used in a range of applications where the operator of the machine benefits from having accurate horizontal and vertical guidance.

What Makes This Role Great:

Empowered to Challenge and Lead:

You will be empowered to challenge and elevate the program management function within CTCT while leading complex, high-impact projects that directly drive customer success and T5 operational outcomes.

Systems-Level Integration & Product Direction:

In this role, you will bridge engineering, hardware, software, and product teams to guide new product introductions (NPI) from concept to commercialization. Success requires working at the system level—partnering with software, hardware, and installation solutions teams to architect and integrate complex components into cohesive, market-ready solutions.

Delivering Unique, Sellable Systems:

You won't just track deliverables; you will translate multi-disciplinary technology streams into unique, sellable systems. By aligning hardware design cycles, software releases, and system validation, you will directly influence product strategy and deliver scalable systems that solve complex customer challenges.

Key Exciting Responsibilities

  • Drive the development of core system components, leading an international system integration team through the established phase gate process (T5).
  • Spearhead project planning by coordinating work breakdown, estimation, and resource requirements to build and maintain clear master product schedules.
  • Ensure project success by actively managing resources, team dynamics, and change control to meet established schedules, cost targets, and contractual objectives.
  • Proactively monitor project needs, identify risks, and execute mitigation plans, communicating key insights to senior management and product teams.
  • Champion organisational accountability for following the T5 outcome process across product teams.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on technical project management experience within cross-functional teams and software development organisations.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects concurrently, proactively identify issues, and maintain strong professional relationships.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with Agile software development, including backlog planning and value team facilitation.
  • A recognised Project Management certification.
  • Background working internationally with diverse cultures.

General Information

Location: Christchurch, NZ (In Office)

The office in Christchurch, New Zealand (handily located on the Little River Link Cycleway).

Travel Requirement:Less than 10%

Why You'll Love Working With Us

We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

  • You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide. Our impact is tangible, from connected machines that save fuel to data-driven insights that reduce waste.
  • Collaborate with like-minded people:Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging. We're a company of "visionary pragmatists" who think boldly and build things that work.
  • Be an owner:CTCT thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."

Compensation & Benefits:

Competitive salary based on degree and professional industry working experience. The Total Rewards package includes:

  • Competitive remuneration package
  • Attractive Bonus
  • Career development with global prospects
  • A strong commitment to safety and your wellbeing
  • An inclusive workplace culture focused on quality, customer service and the environment
  • A commitment to diversity and inclusion, equal opportunity, and equal outcome
  • The opportunity to do truly meaningful work in a supportive, constructive culture that encourages you to make the most of your talents.

Additional Information

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

This employer is not currently hiring foreign national applicants that require or will require sponsorship tied to a specific employer, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities which can be found through our employment website at [www.Caterpillar.com/Careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/Careers)

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

August 26, 2026 - September 13, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

  • Guiding the evolution of the technical design, technical project planning, performance analysis, and development testing. Participating in supplier selection and capabilities assessment.
  • Monitoring, exploring, and testing new technologies, materials, and components to understand product or process improvement opportunities.

Quality Management: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques and ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.

job.title: Chiller Team Leader - Perth
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Why Johnson Controls?

Being a Global company, you will work with some of the best people in the industry. This role will offer you autonomy and flexibility to make it your own and provide a pathway for a long-term career JCI career.

  • Global company with strong systems and support
  • Permanent full-time opportunity
  • Base + super + car allowance + incentive

​

About this opportunity:

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a Service Team Leader – Chiller to lead a team of skilled Technicians. This is an exciting opportunity to combine your technical expertise with leadership skills in a forward-thinking organization that offers clear career progression.

What’s in it for you?

  • Help grow our Perth operations – be part of something expanding, not shrinking.
  • Lead an experienced team – work with Techs who know their stuff.
  • Hands‑on leadership – stay on the tools while guiding a good crew.
  • Paid overtime – get paid properly for the extra effort.
  • Company vehicle or allowance – plus fuel card, e‑tag, etc.
  • Work–life balance that actually works – flexibility is part of the job, not just a buzzword.
  • Plenty of autonomy – run your day, support your team, and make decisions on the spot.
  • Solid Technical backup – remote support, training, and experts you can call when things get tricky.
  • Room to grow – whether you want more leadership, project work, or deeper Chiller skills.
  • Fully equipped workshop – everything you need to get the job done right.

We’re looking for a leader with ideas and initiative to make this role their own.

Looking for your next step?

If you're a skilled Chiller Technician who’s ready to take on more responsibility without giving up the hands‑on work you enjoy, this is a great move. Lead a solid team, stay technical, and grow your career with the backing of a global business that genuinely invests in its people.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive operational excellence within the Chiller service team
  • Oversee maintenance, retrofit, and repair of York Chillers, applying HVAC theory, mechanical layouts, and control systems knowledge
  • Lead Technicians, Apprentices, and subcontractors to deliver high-quality service
  • Perform senior-level technical tasks including preventive maintenance, installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers
  • Assist with service project management: scheduling, estimating, resource planning, and logistics
  • Manage customer accounts and support business development initiatives
  • Support the Service Team Manager with branch operations

What We’re Looking For

  • Technical qualification in HVAC or equivalent experience (Degree or Trade Certificate)
  • Minimum 5 years’ related experience, or 7 years without formal qualification
  • Strong leadership skills with proven ability to motivate and develop teams
  • Commercial acumen and sound business judgment
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Demonstrated technical expertise to build trust and credibility

How to Apply Feeling inspired to move forward in your career? Simply click APPLY NOW and join a team where your expertise makes an impact.

#LI-AR2

job.title: Technical Account Manager – Data Centres
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) – Data Centre Thermal Solutions. This role serves as the primary technical interface between Johnson Controls and key Data Centre customers across the Pacific region, with a specific focus on chilled water plants, precision cooling, and advanced thermal management solutions.

The TAM provides deep technical leadership across chiller systems, liquid cooling, and thermal plant architectures, while also taking ownership of technical pricing strategy and bid development for complex opportunities. This ensures solutions are not only technically robust but also commercially competitive and aligned with customer value expectations.

A core element of the role is supporting the Strategic Account Manager (SAM) to drive commercial growth. The TAM brings thermal engineering expertise, early-stage cooling design influence, and bid/pricing leadership that strengthens Johnson Controls’ commercial strategies and opens new business opportunities.

Operating within a matrixed organisation, the TAM aligns technical, commercial, and delivery stakeholders to ensure chiller and cooling plant solutions are positioned, designed, priced, and delivered to win in a competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

Trusted Technical Advisor – Thermal Systems

  • Act as the trusted advisor for data centre cooling and thermal plant solutions, with a focus on chillers, CRAH/CRAC, and liquid cooling
  • Provide guidance on cooling strategies for hyperscale and high-density environments
  • Support customers in achieving resilience, redundancy, and energy efficiency targets

​

Solution Design & Architecture Governance

  • Lead the design of chilled water systems and central plant architecture
  • Develop integrated solutions covering chillers, pumps, heat rejection, and BMS integration
  • Own system performance, efficiency (PUE), and lifecycle optimisation
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks across capacity, redundancy, and control strategies

​

Early Engagement & Cooling Design Influence

  • Influence cooling plant design, chiller selection, and system architecture at pre-RFP stage
  • Lead Johnson Controls’ contribution to Basis of Design (BoD)
  • Position high-efficiency and next-gen cooling technologies within project designs

​

Pricing, Bid Management & Commercial Ownership

  • Own the technical pricing strategy for thermal solutions, including chilled water plants and liquid cooling systems
  • Lead and coordinate end-to-end bid development, ensuring alignment between engineering, procurement, and commercial teams
  • Develop accurate cost models, equipment selections, and solution configurations that balance performance, risk, and competitiveness
  • Drive value engineering to optimise cost while maintaining technical integrity and customer requirements
  • Ensure proposals clearly articulate total cost of ownership, energy efficiency savings, and lifecycle value
  • Support commercial negotiations by providing technical justification for scope, pricing, and solution differentiation
  • Maintain governance over bid quality, margin integrity, and risk management across all submissions

​

Opportunity & Technical Sales Support

  • Partner with SAMs on major pursuits from early-stage through award
  • Develop compelling technical and commercial value propositions
  • Support high-quality proposals with cooling system design, narratives, and performance insights

​

Market & Domain Expertise – Cooling

  • Maintain deep expertise in:

Chillers (air & water-cooled)

  • Free cooling and heat rejection
  • Liquid cooling (direct-to-chip, immersion)

Stay current with AI-driven high-density cooling demands and sustainability trends

​

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Align engineering, product, supply chain, and delivery teams
  • Support seamless handover ensuring clarity on thermal system design and performance expectations

​

Pipeline & Technical Governance

  • Build and qualify pipeline focused on cooling infrastructure opportunities
  • Ensure technical and commercial accuracy in CRM, pricing tools, and proposals
  • Maintain compliance with Johnson Controls governance standards

​

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (preferred) or related discipline
  • 10+ years’ experience in HVAC/chiller systems and thermal plant solutions, ideally within data centres
  • Demonstrated experience in technical sales, bid management, and pricing of complex engineered solutions
  • Strong expertise in:

Chilled water systems and central plant design

  • Chiller selection and optimisation
  • Cooling strategies for high-density environments

Proven ability to develop competitive, technically sound, and commercially viable bids

Experience in cost modelling, value engineering, and margin management

Strong understanding of BMS/controls integration for thermal optimisation

Ability to influence consultants and customers at early design stages

Experience operating in matrix organisations across global stakeholders

Strong communication skills translating technical solutions into commercial value

High discipline in CRM and pipeline management (Salesforce preferred)

Self-driven, resilient, and effective in large, complex pursuit environments

If you are interested in this role, please click the Apply now button.

JCI’s Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviours we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands

Job Description

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) – Data Centre Thermal Solutions. This role serves as the primary technical interface between Johnson Controls and key Data Centre customers across the Pacific region, with a specific focus on chilled water plants, precision cooling, and advanced thermal management solutions.

The TAM provides deep technical leadership across chiller systems, liquid cooling, and thermal plant architectures, while also taking ownership of technical pricing strategy and bid development for complex opportunities. This ensures solutions are not only technically robust but also commercially competitive and aligned with customer value expectations.

A core element of the role is supporting the Strategic Account Manager (SAM) to drive commercial growth. The TAM brings thermal engineering expertise, early-stage cooling design influence, and bid/pricing leadership that strengthens Johnson Controls’ commercial strategies and opens new business opportunities.

Operating within a matrixed organisation, the TAM aligns technical, commercial, and delivery stakeholders to ensure chiller and cooling plant solutions are positioned, designed, priced, and delivered to win in a competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

Trusted Technical Advisor – Thermal Systems

  • Act as the trusted advisor for data centre cooling and thermal plant solutions, with a focus on chillers, CRAH/CRAC, and liquid cooling
  • Provide guidance on cooling strategies for hyperscale and high-density environments
  • Support customers in achieving resilience, redundancy, and energy efficiency targets

​

Solution Design & Architecture Governance

  • Lead the design of chilled water systems and central plant architecture
  • Develop integrated solutions covering chillers, pumps, heat rejection, and BMS integration
  • Own system performance, efficiency (PUE), and lifecycle optimisation
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks across capacity, redundancy, and control strategies

​

Early Engagement & Cooling Design Influence

  • Influence cooling plant design, chiller selection, and system architecture at pre-RFP stage
  • Lead Johnson Controls’ contribution to Basis of Design (BoD)
  • Position high-efficiency and next-gen cooling technologies within project designs

​

Pricing, Bid Management & Commercial Ownership

  • Own the technical pricing strategy for thermal solutions, including chilled water plants and liquid cooling systems
  • Lead and coordinate end-to-end bid development, ensuring alignment between engineering, procurement, and commercial teams
  • Develop accurate cost models, equipment selections, and solution configurations that balance performance, risk, and competitiveness
  • Drive value engineering to optimise cost while maintaining technical integrity and customer requirements
  • Ensure proposals clearly articulate total cost of ownership, energy efficiency savings, and lifecycle value
  • Support commercial negotiations by providing technical justification for scope, pricing, and solution differentiation
  • Maintain governance over bid quality, margin integrity, and risk management across all submissions

​

Opportunity & Technical Sales Support

  • Partner with SAMs on major pursuits from early-stage through award
  • Develop compelling technical and commercial value propositions
  • Support high-quality proposals with cooling system design, narratives, and performance insights

​

Market & Domain Expertise – Cooling

  • Maintain deep expertise in:

Chillers (air & water-cooled)

  • Free cooling and heat rejection
  • Liquid cooling (direct-to-chip, immersion)

Stay current with AI-driven high-density cooling demands and sustainability trends

​

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Align engineering, product, supply chain, and delivery teams
  • Support seamless handover ensuring clarity on thermal system design and performance expectations

​

Pipeline & Technical Governance

  • Build and qualify pipeline focused on cooling infrastructure opportunities
  • Ensure technical and commercial accuracy in CRM, pricing tools, and proposals
  • Maintain compliance with Johnson Controls governance standards

​

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (preferred) or related discipline
  • 10+ years’ experience in HVAC/chiller systems and thermal plant solutions, ideally within data centres
  • Demonstrated experience in technical sales, bid management, and pricing of complex engineered solutions
  • Strong expertise in:

Chilled water systems and central plant design

  • Chiller selection and optimisation
  • Cooling strategies for high-density environments

Proven ability to develop competitive, technically sound, and commercially viable bids

Experience in cost modelling, value engineering, and margin management

Strong understanding of BMS/controls integration for thermal optimisation

Ability to influence consultants and customers at early design stages

Experience operating in matrix organisations across global stakeholders

Strong communication skills translating technical solutions into commercial value

High discipline in CRM and pipeline management (Salesforce preferred)

Self-driven, resilient, and effective in large, complex pursuit environments

If you are interested in this role, please click the Apply now button.

JCI’s Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviours we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands

job.title: BMS Project Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What you will do

Acts as on-site project leader to plan, execute, and complete assigned projects. Delegates tasks to execute and fully complete assigned projects. Coordinates communication with customer during all phases of the project. Coordinates the work of subcontractors.

How you will do it:

  • Define scope, budget and schedule for projects.
  • Device project implementation methodology.
  • Plan and oversee work schedule for the multiple small to medium scale project under responsibility, in coordination with supervisor.
  • Identify potential project risks and recommend appropriate resolutions.
  • Establish effective communication with customer.
  • Track and update progress, task and project health to supervisors.
  • Ensure and monitor compliance to applicable codes, practices, QA/QC policies, performance standards and specifications.
  • Perform regular quality audit for all the suppliers and sub-contractors.
  • Identify and secure variation order.
  • Cost control - Track, monitor and ensure delivery of financial commitment as per KPI.
  • Managing reports and documents.
  • Work closely with Sales team for tender bidding.
  • Supervision of sub-contractors’ work at site.
  • Schedule purchase and deliveries of all materials for the project in a timely manner.

  • Follow-up on payment from customers and verify payment to our suppliers.
  • Train customer and provide first year maintenance warranty schedule visit.
  • Hand over project to customer and later to service team.

What we look for:

  • Degree with minimum 1 years relevant working experience in BMS project.
  • Excel, Word and Project essential.
  • Require interaction with clients, consultants and sub-contractors, etc.
  • Need to work odd hours as and when required, whenever the work need to be done on time.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: HVAC Service Technician
job.description:
Build a Career with a Global Industry Leader

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the future of smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. As a global leader in HVAC, building automation, energy efficiency, and decarbonisation solutions, we help customers operate more efficiently while reducing their environmental footprint.

For over 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered innovative solutions across some of the world's most critical industries, including data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. Backed by cutting-edge technology, industry-leading products, and a highly skilled service team, we're creating smarter, more resilient environments for our customers and communities.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

Work-Life Balance

Enjoy a role that offers flexibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to manage your day effectively while servicing a diverse customer portfolio across Melbourne.

Ongoing Training & Development

Benefit from structured onboarding, continuous technical training, and remote support from highly experienced specialists whenever you need it.

Career Growth Opportunities

Whether you're looking to broaden your HVAC expertise, step into leadership, or pursue dual-trade qualifications, we provide clear pathways for career progression backed by competitive remuneration.

Industry-Leading Technology

Work with some of the most advanced HVAC and building management systems in the market, including Johnson Controls' world-renowned YORK equipment and technologies.

Inclusive & Supportive Culture

Join a team that values safety, collaboration, innovation, and diversity, where your contribution is recognised and your growth is supported.

About the Opportunity

Due to continued growth, we are looking for an experienced and motivated HVAC Technician to join our Melbourne Service team.

This hands-on field-based role offers excellent variety, autonomy, and exposure to a broad range of commercial and industrial HVAC systems. You'll work across maintenance, repairs, commissioning, and installations while developing your technical expertise through ongoing training and support.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Perform preventative and scheduled maintenance across commercial HVAC systems
  • Commission, install, service, troubleshoot, and overhaul mechanical equipment
  • Work on a wide range of equipment including chillers, package units, split systems, and central plant installations
  • Gain exposure to Johnson Controls' Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • Prepare quotations for small works and manage assigned service projects
  • Interpret technical drawings, schematics, and plans
  • Complete small commercial installations and upgrades
  • Deliver exceptional customer service while ensuring high safety standards

What You'll Bring

  • Trade qualification in Refrigeration & Air Conditioning or Electrical with HVAC experience
  • Experience servicing commercial air conditioning systems
  • Chiller experience highly regarded
  • Restricted Electrical Licence
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence
  • Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills
  • A customer-focused approach and commitment to safety

A Unique Advantage

As the OEM for YORK chillers, we provide exclusive in-house chiller training and technical development opportunities, giving you access to industry-leading knowledge and career-enhancing skills that few employers can offer.

Interested?

If you're looking for a stable, long-term career with a global organisation that invests in its people, we'd love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion about the role, contact Janis Sotelo at [janis.sotelo@jci.com](mailto:janis.sotelo@jci.com).

Join Johnson Controls and help create smarter, more sustainable buildings across Melbourne and beyond.

Applicants must have full Australian working rights. Pre-employment medical, criminal history, and drug & alcohol screening requirements apply.

job.title: Sr Developer - Enterprise integration
job.description:
Title: Lead Integration Developer

Exp: 9–12 Years

Role Summary

A strategic and hands-on Integration Leader responsible for driving end-to-end delivery of enterprise integration solutions. Ensures alignment with enterprise architecture, leads technical design (HLD/LLD), and builds high-performing teams while leveraging modern cloud, AI, and Copilot-enabled development capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Integration Architecture & Delivery

  • Own and lead end-to-end integration solution design and delivery across complex enterprise programs.
  • Define and implement integration architectures, API strategies, and reusable frameworks aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Create, review, and govern High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs) ensuring scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Drive architecture governance, technical design reviews, and best practices adoption.

Azure Integration Services Implementation

  • Lead development using Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, and broader Azure Integration Services.
  • Design highly resilient, secure, and scalable workflows and orchestrations.

API Management & Governance

  • Design, publish, secure, and monitor APIs via Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Drive enterprise API governance, lifecycle management, versioning, and security standards.

Messaging & Event-Driven Architecture

  • Build and implement event-driven and asynchronous architectures using Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and Event Hubs.
  • Champion loosely coupled, scalable integration patterns.

Hybrid Integration

  • Architect and implement integrations between on-premises systems and cloud platforms, ensuring seamless and reliable connectivity.

AI & Copilot-Driven Engineering

  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot (GitHub Copilot, M365 Copilot) to improve developer productivity, accelerate code development, and enhance solution quality.
  • Utilize Generative AI for:Automated code generation, refactoring, and documentation (LLDs, API specs)
  • Intelligent workflow design and optimization
  • AI-assisted debugging, testing, and root cause analysis

Integrate AI-powered services (Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services) within integration solutions to enable intelligent data processing and decision-making.Promote AI-first engineering practices, including prompt engineering and responsible AI usage.Monitoring, Security & Compliance

  • Implement end-to-end observability using Cribl.
  • Ensure secure data handling, compliance, and governance across integration solutions.

Technical & Team Leadership

  • Provide strong technical leadership and direction across teams.
  • Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and enforce engineering standards.
  • Mentor team members, enabling skill development in integration, cloud, and AI technologies.
  • Manage technical risks, escalations, and critical design decisions.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, architects, business stakeholders, and vendors.
  • Align technology solutions with business goals and enterprise strategy.
  • Build and nurture a high-performing, collaborative, and innovation-driven integration team.

Required Skills

  • Experience: 9–12+ years in software engineering with strong focus on cloud and iPaaS integrations.
  • Azure Expertise: Deep hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services (AIS).
  • Development Skills: Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, XML.
  • Design Skills: Extensive experience in LLD/HLD creation, architecture design, and solution documentation.
  • API Expertise: Strong experience in API architecture, governance, and lifecycle management.
  • Integration Patterns: Expertise in event-driven, microservices, and hybrid integration architectures.
  • AI & Copilot Skills: (Good to have)Hands-on usage of GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot for development acceleration
  • Understanding of prompt engineering and AI-assisted development workflows
  • Exposure to Azure OpenAI / AI services integration

Delivery Experience: Proven experience leading large-scale enterprise integration delivery.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with MuleSoft architecture / coexistence strategies.
  • Exposure to advanced AI/ML integration use cases and intelligent automation.
  • Knowledge of data transformation standards (EDI, XML, JSON) and large-scale data pipelines.
  • Familiarity with AI governance, ethics, and secure AI adoption in enterprises.

Preferred Certifications

  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
  • Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
  • DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)
  • (Good to have) Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102)

  • Contribute to long-term removal of obsolete components and reduction of platform dependency risk.
  • Integrate firmware with higher-level software modules, communication stacks, diagnostics, and application functions used in PAGA / PAVA systems.
  • Support interaction between physical layer interfaces, node communications, and application-layer functions used for alarm, paging, routing, monitoring, and supervision.

  • Support design reviews, system architecture activities, and issue resolution across the product lifecycle.
  • Contribute to documentation required for product introduction, controlled change, validation, and support.

  • Monitor compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, customer, and company EHS requirements by conducting workplace inspections, site assessments, and compliance reviews, and supporting regulatory inspections and customer audits.
  • Support project teams, subcontractors, and stakeholders in managing workplace risks through the development, review, and implementation of Risk Assessments (RA), Safe Work Procedures (SWP), Method Statements, and other risk control measures.
  • Investigate accidents, near misses, dangerous occurrences, occupational illnesses, and environmental incidents, prepare investigation reports, identify root causes, and follow up on corrective and preventive actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Coordinate and participate in EHS audits and assessments, including ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ConSASS, Global CAP, internal audits, customer audits, and other EHS evaluations, while ensuring timely closure of audit findings and non-conformities.
  • Plan, coordinate, and support EHS training and awareness programs, including employee orientation, toolbox meetings, safety briefings, contractor training, and safety campaigns to promote a strong safety culture and workforce competency.
  • Monitor EHS performance indicators and incident statistics, analyse trends, prepare reports, and provide recommendations to improve EHS performance, compliance, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support the implementation of emergency preparedness and response programs, including fire prevention activities, emergency response planning, evacuation exercises, and emergency drills to enhance readiness and effectiveness.
  • Work closely with internal and external stakeholders, including project teams, subcontractors, clients, suppliers, and regulatory authorities, to ensure alignment with EHS requirements and promote continuous improvement in workplace safety and environmental performance.
  • Provide day-to-day EHS support to assigned projects and workplaces, including identifying unsafe conditions and behaviours, recommending corrective measures, stopping work where there is imminent danger, supporting EHS committee activities, and performing other EHS-related duties as assigned by management.

What we look for:

  • Degree or Diploma in Environmental, Health & Safety, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Registered Workplace Safety and Health Officer (WSHO) and Environment Control Officer (ECO) certification.
  • Familiarity with ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.
  • Experience in construction, engineering, HVAC, facility management, or related industries is an advantage.
  • Strong communication, investigation, problem-solving, audit and stakeholder management skills.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Senior Project Manager - Applied
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Role Summary

The Senior Manager – Applied Projects will be responsible for managing a portfolio of HVAC and chiller projects in Gujarat, ensuring successful execution in line with project commitments related to cost, schedule, quality, revenue, and customer satisfaction. The role involves close coordination with project teams, customers, and internal stakeholders to drive project performance and timely closure.

Key Responsibilities

Project Portfolio Management

  • Manage and monitor a portfolio of 50–70 HVAC/chiller projects of varying sizes and execution stages.
  • Track project progress and ensure adherence to established project management processes and milestones.
  • Conduct regular project reviews and follow up on action plans to ensure timely execution.

Planning, Monitoring & Risk Management

  • Monitor project budgets, forecasts, and financial performance throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Identify, track, and report project risks, opportunities, and issues in a timely manner.
  • Maintain project risk registers and issue logs and work with stakeholders to drive resolution.
  • Escalate critical concerns and support implementation of mitigation plans.

Project Execution

  • Ensure project execution is aligned with key performance parameters:Cost
  • Schedule
  • Quality
  • Revenue
  • Customer Expectations

Support project teams in resolving execution challenges and achieving project objectives.Drive timely progression of projects through defined toll gates and closure processes.

Customer & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Maintain regular communication with customers, consultants, contractors, and internal teams.
  • Monitor customer commitments and ensure timely closure of pending actions.
  • Assist in resolving project-related issues to maintain customer satisfaction.

Team Management

  • Guide project managers and execution teams in meeting project deliverables.
  • Provide support in planning, monitoring, and resolving operational challenges.
  • Promote adherence to company processes, compliance requirements, and best practices.

Commercial & Operational Controls

Support project teams in ensuring:

  • Schedule baseline approvals from customers during HOTO.
  • Deliveries and project milestones are achieved as per agreed schedules.
  • Revenue realization is in line with approved forecasts.
  • Timely invoicing and collection of payments.
  • Unbilled Revenue (UBR) remains within acceptable limits.
  • Accurate project status reporting and forecasting.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 10–15 years of experience in HVAC, chiller, or related project execution roles.
  • Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a customer-facing environment.
  • Good understanding of project management principles, including budgeting, planning, scheduling, and risk management.
  • Strong coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to analyze project performance and take corrective actions where required.
  • Proficiency in project planning and reporting tools.
  • Should have managed 5-10 engineers/ managers in his present/ past roles.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • On-time project completion.
  • Revenue achievement against forecast.
  • Gross margin performance.
  • Collection and receivables management.
  • UBR control.
  • Quality and customer satisfaction metrics.
  • Timely closure of project risks and issues.

Role Summary

The incumbent will be responsible for managing the execution of multiple HVAC and chiller projects simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery in line with customer requirements, contractual commitments, and company objectives. The role will focus on project planning, coordination, schedule management, commercial follow-up, and driving projects through defined toll gates from HOTO to closure.

The incumbent will work closely with customers, vendors, site teams, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution & Coordination

  • Manage HVAC/chiller old, ongoing and new projects at different stages of execution.
  • Ensure projects are executed as per approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements.
  • Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, factories, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Track project milestones and drive closure of pending activities.

Schedule Management

  • Prepare and maintain project schedules in coordination with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Obtain customer approval for schedule baselines during HOTO.
  • Monitor progress against planned schedules and initiate corrective actions for delays.
  • Drive timely completion of project milestones and support toll gate movement.

Commercial & Financial Management

  • Monitor project costs, committed costs, and revenue realization.
  • Support achievement of forecasted revenue for assigned projects.
  • Ensure timely preparation and submission of invoices as per contractual milestones.
  • Follow up with customers for payment collections and resolution of commercial issues.
  • Maintain Unbilled Revenue (UBR) within prescribed limits.

Risk & Issue Management

  • Identify project risks and implementation challenges at an early stage.
  • Maintain project risk and issue logs.
  • Escalate critical risks, delays, and customer concerns to the Senior Project Manager in a timely manner.
  • Work with stakeholders to implement mitigation and recovery plans.

Customer Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for assigned projects.
  • Maintain regular communication with customers regarding project status, schedules, deliveries, and outstanding actions.
  • Address customer concerns promptly and coordinate internal support for resolution.
  • Ensure customer expectations are effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle.

Material & Resource Coordination

  • Coordinate with procurement, logistics, factory, and service teams to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Track material availability and installation readiness.
  • Monitor resource deployment requirements at project sites.

Reporting & Governance

  • Update project status, forecasts, and financial metrics regularly.
  • Participate in project review meetings and provide accurate project performance updates.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational project management processes and documentation requirements.
  • Support movement of projects through defined stage gates and successful project closure.

Desired Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of HVAC systems, chillers, and applied projects.
  • Knowledge of project management fundamentals including:Planning and Scheduling
  • Cost Monitoring
  • Risk Management
  • Quality Compliance
  • Customer Management

Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.Good communication and negotiation skills.Proficiency in MS Project, Excel, ERP, and project tracking tools.Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
  • PMP/Project Management certification would be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • On-time achievement of project milestones.
  • Successful movement of projects through toll gates.
  • Revenue realization against forecast.
  • Timely invoicing and collection performance.
  • UBR maintained within target limits.
  • Customer satisfaction.
  • Schedule adherence.
  • Quality and safety compliance.
  • Timely closure of project risks and issues.

job.title: Application Engineer- Fire & Security
job.description:
Job Description

What you will do

This position is responsible to design Fire & security systems like Fire Alarm, Access Control, Intruder Alarm, and CCTV per respective account standards.

How you will do it

  • Should have strong domain knowledge of Fire & Security System engineering.
  • Should have global customer facing experience.
  • Works independently & is fully proficient in applying established standards/practices.
  • Should act as interface to customers and is responsible to ensure that projects are executed within agreed schedule and budget to meet the customer technical specification requirements.
  • Should be able to independently carry out Hardware Detail Design, Engineering and Application Development, Battery Calculations, Voltage drops calculations etc.
  • Should be able to develop Typical / Templates for Complex systems and develop project specific standards.
  • Should be able to read, Understand Control Narratives, Logic diagrams, Io Matrix etc.
  • Monitors and controls assigned work scope against the project plan, ensures effective change control, and identifies risks / opportunities.
  • Ensures that the proposed engineered solution meets project requirements in terms of functionality, standards, quality, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure group work in compliance with QMS procedures.
  • Identify possible improvement opportunities and manage their implementation.
  • Ensure common methods, techniques, tools, and products are being effectively applied and provide feedback for future improvement.
  • Ensures that the implementation of application is reviewed with respect to project standards and quality documents.
  • Ensures that the final deliverable meets the functional specifications of the customer by doing the quality checks.
  • Usage of engineering tools for optimization of Engineering man hours to improve productivity & Quality.

What we look for

  • Diploma/BE (Electrical/ Electronics).
  • 3-8 years’ experience in Fire & security system design is mandatory.
  • Fire code & security domain knowledge mandatory.
  • NICET/ BS 5839 & Security system product Certifications will be added advantage.
  • Good knowledge of AutoCAD.
  • Good communication skills.

job.title: Application Engineer
job.description:
What you will do:

The Application Engineer is responsible for technical support – primarily customer quotations and business development case studies for various composite applications. Key emphasis will be on the ability to understand customer requirements and rapidly demonstrate how composite based solutions can be utilized to provide solutions with costing, timing, and resources included in the proposals. This position will require travel with the business development team to customer facilities during visits to discuss these future opportunities in depth.

How you will do it:

  • Provides customer support by responding to requests for technical queries with detailed analysis of building management system, schedule of creation, tooling costing, and submittal of design and process improvements, when applicable, to meet all customer product needs.
  • Works with engineering, sales, and ops staff to understand standard component fabrication techniques, standard composite materials to use, and current demands of our customers to formulate design details for the sales staff and our customers.
  • ·Provides product technical engineering information by creating and giving presentations on customer proposals. This contains, but is not limited to, 3D representations of finished goods, 3D representations of tooling, etc.
  • ·Prepares cost estimates by studying blueprints, plans, and related customer documents; consulting with engineers, and other professional and technical personnel.
  • Conceptual design of composite components and assemblies to support proposals
  • Generate solid and surface component and assembly CAD models
  • Ability to compose detailed bill of materials for proposals
  • Work as part of a team of design and engineering and ops staff
  • Knowledge of ACMV and controls associate with Johnson Control Metasys will be an advantage

What we look for:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Process & Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical Engineering with minimum 1 year relevant working experience
  • Possess knowledge in PLC programming. Pcvue or ICONICS software
  • Transportation composite or other composite experience preferred
  • Willing to learn new things

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy
