You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What you will do:

The Senior Application Engineer will lead the application engineering team in providing technical support, primarily focusing on customer quotations and business development case studies across various composite applications. This role emphasizes understanding customer requirements and swiftly demonstrating how composite-based solutions can effectively address their needs, including cost, timing, and resource requirements outlined in proposals. Travel to customer facilities will be essential for in-depth discussions about future opportunities alongside the business development team.

How you will do it:

  • Oversee the application engineering team, providing configuration, enhancement, and support for technical documentation and presentations to clients.
  • Customize and introduce new features to Metasys software and in-house developed applications based on end-user requirements.
  • Design and construct new applications tailored to meet customer specifications and needs.
  • Guide application engineers in writing and executing tests on complex programming, troubleshooting issues as they arise, and supporting product launches.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshoot application issues while performing tests on complex programming and assisting in product launches.
  • Assist the application manager in process improvements to enhance productivity and efficiency.
  • Collaborate with system integrators (SI) to monitor their performance with quality assurance/quality control checks and ensure completion sign-off.
  • Guide application engineers in executing software upgrades and managing software licensing.
  • Manage vendor relationships, including scoping application services and reviewing deliverables.
  • Collaborate as part of a design, engineering, and operations team.
  • Knowledge of ACMV and controls associated with Johnson Controls Metasys will be advantageous.

To supervise Application Engineers on their following tasks:

  • Deliver customer support by responding to technical queries with detailed analyses of building management systems, tooling costs, and design/process improvements to meet all customer needs.
  • Collaborate with engineering, sales, and operations teams to understand standard fabrication techniques, composite materials, and customer demands to develop design details.
  • Create and present technical engineering information based on customer proposals, including 3D representations of products and tooling.
  • Prepare cost estimates by analyzing blueprints, customer documents, and consulting with engineers and technical personnel.
  • Conduct conceptual designs of composite components and assemblies to support proposals.
  • Generate accurate CAD models of components and assemblies.
  • Develop detailed bills of materials for proposals.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in transportation composites or other composite applications preferred.
  • Knowledge of PLC/BMS programming is require

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Commissioning Technician (Data centers)
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

About this opportunity

  • Permanent full-time opportunity
  • Attractive base + super + car allowance
  • Career and training opportunities

About Silent-Aire (A Johnson Controls Company)

Silent-Aire, a global leader in hyperscale data center cooling and mission‑critical infrastructure, is proudly part of Johnson Controls. Known for its innovative modular data center solutions and advanced cooling technologies—including custom HVAC and direct expansion (DX) systems—Silent-Aire supports some of the world’s largest cloud providers. As part of Johnson Controls, Silent-Aire combines deep engineering expertise with world‑class manufacturing, commissioning, and service capabilities, delivering reliable, scalable, and energy‑efficient solutions for high‑performance environments.

The Opportunity

Due to continued growth, we are seeking a skilled Commissioning Technician / Regional CCX Technician to join our Sydney team.

In this role, you will execute, coordinate, and support commissioning and construction activities related to Silent-Aire products. You’ll play a key part in ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction, operational performance, and compliance with safety and quality standards.

As an MCS Regional CCX Technician, your responsibilities span:

  • CCX Service Agreement Fulfilment
  • QA/QC
  • Preventative Maintenance, Operations Training & Technical Support
  • Technical Advisory

What You Will Do

  • Lead and coordinate day-to-day CCX services including inspections, installations, repairs, start-up, functional testing, and troubleshooting of Silent-Aire equipment.
  • Work closely with client project teams from installation through commissioning and handover.
  • Collaborate with SAE Engineering and QA/QC teams to understand design requirements and provide feedback on improvements.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, offering prompt technical support and issue resolution.
  • Develop and maintain deep technical expertise across the product and service portfolio.
  • Monitor and report on project progress, risks, milestones, and impacts to quality, cost, or schedule.
  • Support regional growth initiatives and contribute to developing the technical and customer infrastructure.
  • Work collaboratively with APAC technicians and management to improve regional performance and profitability.
  • Complete daily reporting and ensure all documentation is accurate and submitted on time.
  • Collect, analyse, and summarise operational data and trends.
  • Protect company information and comply with all business, safety, and quality procedures.
  • Perform additional duties or hands-on tasks as required.

What We’re Looking For

  • University or college degree in engineering or related technical discipline (preferred).
  • Trade school education/certification (an asset).
  • Minimum five years’ experience as a technician—ideally within the HVAC industry.
  • Strong analytical and computer skills; proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Experience with budgeting, forecasting, or financial reporting (advantageous).
  • Strong communication skills, professionalism, adaptability, and dependability.
  • Ability to build effective internal and external relationships.
  • Commitment to safety initiatives and quality standards.
  • Above‑average troubleshooting skills; self‑motivated and responsible.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and collaboratively support cross-functional teams.
  • Must meet site access requirements and pass all pre-employment checks (drug/alcohol testing, medical, background, references, driving record).
  • Willingness to travel as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

  • Global organisation offering strong career development pathways
  • Long-term progression into technical or leadership roles
  • Supportive team culture and access to market-leading technology
  • Strong commitment to safety and ongoing professional development

If you interested in this role, please click the apply button.

job.title: Application Engineer - Fire & Security
job.description:
What you will do

This position is responsible to design Fire & security systems like Fire Alarm, Access Control, Intruder Alarm, and CCTV per respective account standards.

How you will do it

  • Should have strong domain knowledge of Fire & Security System engineering.
  • Should have global customer facing experience.
  • Works independently & is fully proficient in applying established standards/practices.
  • Should act as interface to customers and is responsible to ensure that projects are executed within agreed schedule and budget to meet the customer technical specification requirements.
  • Should be able to independently carry out Hardware Detail Design, Engineering and Application Development, Battery Calculations, Voltage drops calculations etc.
  • Should be able to develop Typical / Templates for Complex systems and develop project specific standards.
  • Should be able to read, Understand Control Narratives, Logic diagrams, Io Matrix etc.
  • Monitors and controls assigned work scope against the project plan, ensures effective change control, and identifies risks / opportunities.
  • Ensures that the proposed engineered solution meets project requirements in terms of functionality, standards, quality, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure group work in compliance with QMS procedures.
  • Identify possible improvement opportunities and manage their implementation.
  • Ensure common methods, techniques, tools, and products are being effectively applied and provide feedback for future improvement.
  • Ensures that the implementation of application is reviewed with respect to project standards and quality documents.
  • Ensures that the final deliverable meets the functional specifications of the customer by doing the quality checks.
  • Usage of engineering tools for optimization of Engineering man hours to improve productivity & Quality.

What we look for

  • Diploma/BE (Electrical/ Electronics).
  • 3-8 years’ experience in Fire & security system design is mandatory.
  • Fire code & security domain knowledge mandatory.
  • NICET/ BS 5839 & Security system product Certifications will be added advantage.
  • Good knowledge of AutoCAD.
  • Good communication skills.

job.title: Technical Support Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Who we are

Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings.

We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through OpenBlue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions.

Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission.

Please visit and follow Johnson Controls linkedin for recent exciting activities.

APAC Linkedin [Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin ](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/)

Career [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://youtu.be/EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue [OpenBlue: This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://youtu.be/bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What you will do

Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced HVAC professional to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing top-quality service, maintenance, and repair of HVAC and industrial refrigeration systems at various client facilities. You will serve as the primary contact for all technical service issues, ensuring client satisfaction through effective troubleshooting and resolution of complex systems.

Required Capabilities

HVAC & Chiller Expertise

  • Practical work experience with HVAC system with various York chiller models, primarily YK, YVAA, YMC2, and YZ chillers.
  • Hands on Experience in commissioning of numerous chillers like Mag bearing, Centri, Screw, Scroll with different type of refrigerant R-22, R-134a, R407,R123, R1233ZD, R513A
  • Hands on Experience in conducting the chiller PM activity for various model chillers.
  • Good knowledge on AHUs, FCU, Cooling towers, water Pumps, EC fans used in the HVAC system.
  • Capable to handle the critical issues by taking quick appropriate decision with action plans to resolve the issues.

Electrical & Electronics Expertise

  • Ability to test and diagnose power electronic components such as Diode, SCRs, IGBTs, capacitors, and inductors.
  • Able to understand the Circuit Breaker settings and provide the cable sizing
  • Understand the root cause of the power electronic components failure and be able to prepare the root cause analysis for the failure.
  • Able to test and identify defective components at the PCB level in advanced multilayer electronic boards
  • Able to troubleshoot the various types of motor used in the chiller application and AHUs
  • Able to understand the various types of control logic used in chiller microcontrollers.
  • Capable of programming and debugging software for microprocessor-based controllers and PLC-based controllers

VSD starter & Troubleshooting

  • In-depth understanding of Variable Speed Drive (VSD) starter application, benefits in chiller, terminology and working principles.
  • Skilled in troubleshooting York starter models used in chillers, including D-Drive, Vyper, Hyper, and Python drives.
  • Knowing the importance of the Harmonic Filter in the VSD application and its function and troubleshooting.

Refrigeration System and Performance testing Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of refrigeration systems and capability to troubleshoot issues using operating data, History data or SD card data from chillers.
  • Able to interpret and analyze Pressure-Enthalpy (P–H) diagrams to evaluate refrigeration cycle performance, identify system inefficiencies, and assist in troubleshooting issues related to compressors, evaporators, and condensers
  • Chiller performance testing and field troubleshooting of performance related issues.
  • Understanding of psychrometry and its application in the HVAC industry

Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment.

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: Sr. Application Engineer II-Presales Chiller
job.description:
Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do:

As a Technical Chillers expert, this role will be focused on Solution Development with complete accountability of Pre-Sales life cycle support. Drive the overall process of Application Engineering and ensure our customer receive the best solution as per requirements

  • Enterprise Accounts Ownership: Work in close collaboration with our lead Account Managers & clients as the primary contact for technical support and Pre-Sales Engineering for Chillers. You will directly work with our enterprise clients, such as Vantage, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Keppel, Air trunk, Micron, and others, right from the Pre-tendering phase all the way to Project handover.
  • Value Engineering: Engage actively in offering the optimized solutions using available products to provide best techno commercial offering. Work closely with Chiller factories and Global Products Team on special quotes and complex technical compliance. Conduct thorough sweet spot analysis to ensure our specifications are included in the early stages of BOD projects.
  • Basis of Design: Work closely with the BOD/Sales team to understand the Project needs and provide technical chiller solutions/specifications. By doing so, we aim to ensure that our offerings are well-integrated from the initial stages, leveraging our expertise to contribute to winning the project.
  • Global Exposure: - The candidate will work closely with the Regional Sales Team on Chillers Pre-Sales Engineering for local projects across the APAC region, covering countries like Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Hong Kong, India, Korea, Taiwan, Philippines and Australia.
  • Mentorship: Guiding and coaching team members to enhance their skills through knowledge sharing.
  • Field product management support: - Collaborate with a cross-functional team, including Life Cycle Solutions, Sales, Global Products and Factory teams, to analyze trends, work on identifying product and solution gaps related to vertical market needs and provide insights and recommendations of new features to enhance products

What we look for:

  • BE/ME Mechanical or equivalent.
  • Demonstrate a high level of knowledge of Chillers – Screw, Scroll & Centrifugal.
  • A solid understanding of the principles of large refrigeration systems and associated equipment is required.
  • Preference will be given to individuals having technical expertise in Chillers.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Chillers product selection process, preparing selections, specifications review and quotations.
  • Ability to perform successfully in a multifunctional-team-work environment and be able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must be a quick learner & should have a keen eye for problem solving
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills
  • People management experience would be an added advantage.

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou).

job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Job Title: Site Engineer – IR Projects (Contractual Role)

Job Location: Hyderabad / Ahmedabad Employment Type: Contractual Experience: 5+ Years

Job Summary

We are looking for a Site Engineer – IR Projects with hands-on experience in HVAC/Industrial Refrigeration (IR) project execution. The candidate will be responsible for project planning, scheduling, site execution, coordination, installation supervision, and ensuring timely completion of projects while maintaining quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute and monitor HVAC/Industrial Refrigeration (IR) projects at site.
  • Prepare and track project schedules, milestones, and progress reports.
  • Coordinate with customers, contractors, consultants, vendors, and internal teams for smooth project execution.
  • Supervise installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities.
  • Ensure adherence to project timelines, quality standards, and safety requirements.
  • Monitor manpower deployment and material availability at site.
  • Conduct site inspections and resolve technical issues during project execution.
  • Prepare daily/weekly progress reports and update stakeholders on project status.
  • Support project documentation, billing, and closure activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in HVAC or Industrial Refrigeration project execution.
  • Strong experience in:Project Planning & Scheduling
  • Site Execution & Coordination
  • Installation & Commissioning Activities
  • Resource Planning
  • Contractor Management
  • Project Documentation

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in Industrial Refrigeration, Cold Storage, Process Cooling, Chillers, or HVAC Projects.
  • Good understanding of project management principles and site safety practices.
  • Ability to handle multiple project activities and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

job.title: Service Technician
job.description:
TITLE- Service Technician

Location – Haldia

WD No: WD30273820

What you will do

  • Diagnose and rectify defects in Fire Detection and Alarm Systems (FDAS) and control panels onboard ships.
  • Execute retrofit and commissioning activities for AFDS and fire extinguishing systems (CO₂, FM200, Water Mist, Foam).
  • Perform annual maintenance contracts (AMC) for AFDS and fire extinguishing systems.
  • Troubleshoot software issues within control panels, including program upload/download.

How you will do it

  • Interpret manuals, P&ID diagrams, and electrical drawings for troubleshooting.
  • Apply control philosophy knowledge to implement retrofit solutions.
  • Analyze onboard logbook data to identify and resolve system defects.
  • Ensure compliance with marine safety standards and operational excellence.

What we look for

  • Education: Diploma/Degree in Instrumentation or Electronics Engineering
  • Experience: 5–7 years of hands-on service experience

Required

  • Expertise in servicing Addressable Fire Detection Systems and Fire Extinguishing Systems (CO₂, FM200, Water Mist, Foam).
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and report-writing abilities.
  • Willingness to travel across Indian ports.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of conventional/addressable fire detection systems.
  • Experience with naval and marine ship systems.

job.title: HVAC Service Technician
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and customer-focused HVAC Service Technician to install, inspect, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration (HVAC/R) systems. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to delivering excellent service while ensuring system efficiency and safety compliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform preventive maintenance, inspections, and repairs on HVAC systems and equipment.
  • Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and control system issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Install, test, and commission HVAC equipment including air conditioners, chillers, heat pumps, furnaces, ventilation systems, and refrigeration units.
  • Monitor system performance and recommend upgrades or replacements when needed.
  • Read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, and technical manuals.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and company policies.
  • Maintain accurate service records, work orders, and maintenance reports.
  • Respond to emergency service requests and equipment breakdowns.
  • Communicate effectively with customers regarding service findings, recommendations, and repair costs.
  • Manage tools, equipment, and spare parts inventory responsibly.
  • Support energy efficiency initiatives and optimize HVAC system performance.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma, ITI, or Technical Certification in HVAC, Refrigeration, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in HVAC installation, maintenance, and repair.
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, refrigeration cycles, electrical controls, and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Familiarity with building automation systems (BAS) and HVAC controls.
  • Ability to use diagnostic tools, gauges, meters, and testing equipment.
  • Valid driver's license (if field service role).
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and emergency call-out

Job Title: Electrical Engineer – Commissioning (Contractual Role)

Location: Ahmedabad Employment Type: Contractual Experience: 5+ Years

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer with strong expertise in commissioning of Electrical Panels, PLC Panels, and Instrumentation Systems. The candidate will be responsible for site execution, testing, troubleshooting, commissioning, and handover of electrical and control systems while ensuring compliance with project specifications and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute commissioning activities for Electrical Panels, PLC Panels, MCC Panels, PCC Panels, and Instrumentation Systems.
  • Perform loop checking, I/O testing, functional testing, and troubleshooting of control systems.
  • Coordinate with site teams, contractors, customers, and vendors during commissioning activities.
  • Review electrical drawings, schematics, GA drawings, cable schedules, and instrument datasheets.
  • Ensure compliance with project specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements.
  • Support installation verification, pre-commissioning, and system start-up activities.
  • Prepare commissioning reports, punch-point lists, and project documentation.
  • Assist in resolving electrical and instrumentation issues during project execution and handover.
  • Monitor project schedules and ensure timely completion of commissioning milestones.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Electrical & Instrumentation commissioning.
  • Hands-on experience in:Commissioning of Electrical Panels (MCC/PCC)
  • PLC & Control Panels
  • Instrumentation Systems
  • Loop Checking & Calibration
  • Testing & Troubleshooting
  • Site Execution & Commissioning

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of PLC, SCADA, VFDs, Sensors, Transmitters, and Control Systems.
  • Experience in Industrial Projects, Process Plants, HVAC, Water Treatment, Refrigeration, or Manufacturing projects.
  • Ability to independently handle site commissioning activities.
  • Strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.
  • Familiarity with electrical safety practices and commissioning procedures.

job.title: Application Engineer
job.description:
What you will do

The purpose of this role is to design sprinkler and gas suppression systems in accordance with BSEN / NFPA / FM / IS codes and standards. The Fire Suppression Design Team supports Fire Life Safety Sales & Design, including : Fire Protection & Gas Suppression Systems. Primary responsibility will include Project take-offs, specification interpretation, scope of work creation, risk analysis, building code compliance, and value engineering ideas.Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.

How you will do it:

  • Independent execution of project throughout the lifecycle.
  • Design the Fire Suppression system per local codes & standard requirements.
  • Review MEP drawings, Tender Specs etc. and identify Fire Suppression Requirements.
  • Complete input study with the help of input checklist and raise the RFIs.
  • Prepare Fire Suppression Layout & Engineering BOM.
  • Ensure quality assurance and defect free Fire Suppression Drawings delievery.
  • Adherence with all processes and guidelines to execute project within timeline.
  • Learn and use company design, bid, and quote tools

Decisions:

  • This position produces estimates and proposals that highly influence the company’s competitiveness and success for winning new work. This role interprets documents and applies knowledge to create accurate estimates to be market competitive.

Decision Impact:

  • The quality of the estimate determines the success of winning new work and the profitability for the work that is won.

Guidelines / Policies:

  • This position follows the defined workflow processes and policies in place

What are we looking for:

  • BE /M.Tech (Mechnical / Chemical / Instrumentation / Electrical/ Electronics)
  • 4-8 Years’ experience in relevant field
  • Prefer NFPA certified ,CFPS & LPCB Certification attain within 12 months of hire date
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Should have strong domain knowledge of Fire Fighting & Gas Supression System
  • Should be able to independently carry out Designing Of Gas supression systems like Novec, FM200, Inergen ,Co2 systems, Sprinkler, Hydrant, Water Spray & Special Hazards, Software Hydraulic Calcualtion,Value Engineering and Pump room design, Water Demand calcaultion & Co-ordination part etc.
  • Knowledge on BSEN ,NFPA & Relevant codes & standards.
  • Proficient digital literacy on AutoCad, FireCad,SprinkCad, Revit, Navisworks.
  • Suppression System & Product knowledge will be an added advantage.
  • Understanding the tender documents & specifications.
  • Must be a quick learner and team player.
  • Highly organized and able to optimally lead multiple simultaneous projects.

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: Application Engineer- Fire & Security
job.description:
Job Description

What you will do

This position is responsible to design Fire & security systems like Fire Alarm, Access Control, Intruder Alarm, and CCTV per respective account standards.

How you will do it

  • Should have strong domain knowledge of Fire & Security System engineering.
  • Should have global customer facing experience.
  • Works independently & is fully proficient in applying established standards/practices.
  • Should act as interface to customers and is responsible to ensure that projects are executed within agreed schedule and budget to meet the customer technical specification requirements.
  • Should be able to independently carry out Hardware Detail Design, Engineering and Application Development, Battery Calculations, Voltage drops calculations etc.
  • Should be able to develop Typical / Templates for Complex systems and develop project specific standards.
  • Should be able to read, Understand Control Narratives, Logic diagrams, Io Matrix etc.
  • Monitors and controls assigned work scope against the project plan, ensures effective change control, and identifies risks / opportunities.
  • Ensures that the proposed engineered solution meets project requirements in terms of functionality, standards, quality, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure group work in compliance with QMS procedures.
  • Identify possible improvement opportunities and manage their implementation.
  • Ensure common methods, techniques, tools, and products are being effectively applied and provide feedback for future improvement.
  • Ensures that the implementation of application is reviewed with respect to project standards and quality documents.
  • Ensures that the final deliverable meets the functional specifications of the customer by doing the quality checks.
  • Usage of engineering tools for optimization of Engineering man hours to improve productivity & Quality.

What we look for

  • Diploma/BE (Electrical/ Electronics).
  • 3-8 years’ experience in Fire & security system design is mandatory.
  • Fire code & security domain knowledge mandatory.
  • NICET/ BS 5839 & Security system product Certifications will be added advantage.
  • Good knowledge of AutoCAD.
  • Good communication skills.

job.description:
Who we are

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

What you will do

We are seeking an Engineering Intern to join the Project Delivery, SEA. Reporting to the HVAC team, the intern will drive customer proposals, project plans, as well as document engineering designs and schematics with guidance from the team. The successful individual will work closely with stakeholders to identify project requirements, and develop proposals including costing, durations and required resources.

How you will do it:

As an intern, you will work closely and support the team in the following activities:

  • Conceptualize composite components and models, develop drawings, designs and schematics (e.g. 3D modelling of finished goods, tooling)
  • Analyze blueprints, plans, relevant customer documents to identify and propose requirements
  • Generate cost estimation based on project requirements
  • Facilitate and support project findings, relevant operation trainings, closing and handover process
  • Act as a liaison between internal and external project stakeholders

What we look for:

  • Pursuing a relevant degree or diploma for built environment (e.g. electrical/mechanical/mechatronics engineering)
  • Prior experience and/or interest in building management systems/thermodynamics
  • Prior experience and/or interest in utilizing CAD will be beneficial

job.title: HVAC Equipment Service Technician 5
job.description:
Job Summary

The Service Manager – Applied HVAC Chiller is responsible for leading the service operations business for centrifugal, screw, scroll, and absorption chillers across the assigned region. This role involves managing a team of service engineers, technicians, and supervisors while ensuring customer satisfaction, operational excellence, revenue growth, service contract management, and adherence to safety and quality standards.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in applied HVAC systems, chillers, controls, and mechanical systems, combined with proven people management and customer relationship skills.

Key Responsibilities

Service Operations Management

  • Manage end-to-end service delivery for applied HVAC chiller equipment.
  • Oversee planned preventive maintenance (PPM), breakdown service, troubleshooting, repairs, retrofits, and modernization projects.
  • Ensure timely response and resolution of customer service requests and complaints.
  • Monitor service KPIs including response time, first-time fix rate, uptime, contract renewals, and customer satisfaction.
  • Drive operational efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.

People Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, coach, develop, and motivate a team of service engineers, supervisors, and technicians.
  • Conduct performance reviews, talent development discussions, and succession planning.
  • Ensure adequate workforce planning, resource allocation, and technician utilization.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on safety, quality, and customer excellence.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and technical training activities.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Act as the primary escalation point for key customers.
  • Build strong relationships with facility managers, consultants, contractors, and end users.
  • Conduct regular customer reviews and identify opportunities for service improvements.
  • Ensure high customer retention and contract renewal rates.

Financial & Business Management

  • Manage service P&L for the assigned territory/business.
  • Drive service revenue growth through AMC/CMC contracts, repairs, upgrades, retrofit opportunities, and parts sales.
  • Monitor costs, productivity, profitability, and budget adherence.
  • Forecast manpower, revenue, and operational requirements.

Technical Excellence

  • Provide technical guidance on centrifugal, screw, and air-cooled/water-cooled chillers.
  • Support complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.
  • Ensure compliance with OEM standards and engineering best practices.
  • Maintain expertise in HVAC controls, BMS integration, VFDs, refrigeration systems, and energy optimization.

Safety & Compliance

  • Promote a zero-incident safety culture.
  • Ensure compliance with EH&S, local regulations, and company policies.
  • Conduct regular safety audits, toolbox talks, and risk assessments.
  • Ensure proper documentation and service reporting.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or related field.
  • 10–15 years of experience in HVAC service operations.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of people management experience leading field service teams.
  • Strong experience in applied HVAC systems, especially centrifugal and screw chillers.
  • Experience managing service contracts and customer-facing operations.

Preferred Skills

Technical Skills

  • Applied HVAC systems
  • Centrifugal Chillers
  • Screw Chillers
  • Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Chillers
  • Chiller Controls & Automation
  • Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • Variable Frequency Drives (VFD)
  • Refrigeration Cycle Diagnostics
  • Energy Efficiency Solutions
  • Root Cause Analysis

Leadership Skills

  • Team Leadership
  • Performance Management
  • Coaching & Mentoring
  • Conflict Resolution
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Customer Relationship Management
  • Business Acumen
  • Strategic Planning

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Key Responsibilities

Service & Account Management

Operational Excellence

job.title: BMS Software Design - Datacenter
job.description:
Application Engineer (Software) - Datacenter

What you will do

The primary responsibility of this role is to lead global Data Center Building Management System (BMS) engineering projects, ensuring compliance with project specifications, customer requirements, and account-specific standards. The role requires independent ownership and execution of projects throughout the entire lifecycle, while serving as the first point of escalation for technical and project-related issues. Ensure adherence to data center-specific engineering and project execution processes, maintain high quality standards through a "First Time Right" approach, and deliver projects on schedule to achieve operational excellence and maximize customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs like MEP drawings and engineering submittal to generate following deliverables for systems covered into Datacenter Project
  • Configuration of software program for supervisory and DDC level controllers
  • Perform simulation of software and validation reports to prepare for software commissioning package delivery
  • Prepare FAT, FWT and SAT test script for validation of software
  • Provide demo sessions to end customer for functionality check of software
  • Optimize database with Trend, Alarm, Point COV management
  • Coordinate with all stakeholders for clarification on RFI’s & progress tracking
  • Perform FWT test at factory location
  • Provide remote / onsite support for site commissioning activities
  • Provide remote commissioning support to site team for troubleshooting issues, control loop tunning and guide site team with test script
  • Perform 3rd party controller integration with different communication protocols like BACnet IP, Modbus and troubleshoot issues with help of software like wireshark, ModScan etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance and defect free software package delivery
  • Adherence with all processes and guidelines to execute project within timeline
  • During pre-bid stage support sales team for providing/validating controls solution for systems into Datacenter project.

What we look for

  • BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical/ Electronics / Electronics & Communication
  • Hands on experience with Software Engineering scope for Datacenter Vertical
  • Good Understanding of Data Centre mechanical / electrical systems with expertise for instrumentation and control
  • Able to handle complex programming for systems like chilled water system, CDU, CRAH, CRAC, AHU with redundancy requirement at equipment or DDC level
  • Knowledge of HVAC systems from Datacenter vertical like Chilled Water System, Cooling Towers, Primary & Secondary pumping systems, Fluid Coolers, Heat Exchanger, CRAH, CRAC, CDU, Different types of AHUs, FCUs, VAV systems etc.
  • Strong knowledge of BMS architecture with different types of Operator workstations, Supervisory Controllers, DDC controllers, Sensors & Actuators etc.
  • Good understanding Network topology and architecture
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, LON, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols
  • Able to handle Modbus, BACnet IP/MSTP integration
  • Must be proficient in wiring of starters, field devices, safety interlocks & panels
  • Experience in engineering, installing and commissioning of HVAC & BMS systems for Datacenter projects or other infrastructure projects like pharmaceuticals, airports, commercial buildings, hospitals
  • Must be a quick learner & should have a keen eye for problem solving
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills

Preferred

4 to 8 years of relevant experience in Building Automation Industry Datacenter Vertical, BMS Design Engineering or Industrial Automation.

Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we’ve been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since.

About the Role

We are seeking a Business Development Manager to drive growth for our Applied business. This is a strategic sales role focused on securing new opportunities and expanding relationships with key stakeholders.

This position can be based in either Sydney or Melbourne, offering flexibility for the right candidate.

You’ll have autonomy, flexibility, and the chance to work with some of the best minds in the industry. If you’re a self-starter with a passion for solution selling and building strong networks, this is your opportunity to make an impact.

  • Calling on target organisations to identify profitable sales opportunities. Managing the preparation and submission of sales proposals in line with Johnson Controls corporate policies and processes

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Who we are :

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

**Position: Quality Engineer – Project Company: Johnson Controls (or Johnson Controls–type projects) Location: Project Sites / Regional Reporting To: Project Quality Manager / Project Manager**

Job Description - The Quality Engineer – Project is responsible for planning, implementing, and monitoring quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) activities across Johnson Controls project execution. The role ensures compliance with company standards, project speciﬁcations, international codes, and customer requirements throughout the project lifecycle—from design review to commissioning and handover.

Key Responsibilities : Project Quality Planning  Develop and implement Project Quality Plans (PQP) in line with Johnson Controls Quality Management System.  Ensure quality requirements are integrated into project schedules, method statements, and execution plans.  Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and subcontractors to align quality objectives. Quality Assurance & Control  Conduct incoming material inspections, ensuring compliance with approved submittals and speciﬁcations.  Monitor installation, testing, and commissioning activities for HVAC, BMS, Fire Alarm, Security, or Energy Solutions systems.  Perform site inspections, audits, and surveillance to ensure workmanship quality.  Ensure compliance with applicable standards (e.g., ISO 9001, ASHRAE, NFPA, IEC, local authority requirements). Documentation & Reporting  Review and approve ITPs, method statements, and inspection checklists.  Maintain quality records including inspection reports, NCRs, CARs, MIRs, and test results.  Prepare quality dashboard reports and KPIs for project review meetings.  Support preparation of as-built documentation and handover dossiers. Non-Conformance & Corrective Actions  Identify, issue, and manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).  Conduct root cause analysis and ensure eective corrective and preventive actions.  Verify closure of quality issues and lessons learned implementation. Audits & Compliance  Support internal, customer, and third-party audits.  Ensure project compliance with Johnson Controls policies, HSE requirements, and client speciﬁcations.  Coordinate with certiﬁcation bodies and regulatory authorities when required. Stakeholder Coordination  Liaise with clients, consultants, authorities, and subcontractors on quality matters.  Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and ﬁnal inspections.  Provide quality awareness and guidance to project teams.

Key Skills & Competencies  Strong knowledge of QA/QC processes in building systems or industrial projects  Familiarity with HVAC, BMS, Fire & Security systems (Johnson Controls product experience preferred)  Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and speciﬁcations  Strong analytical, documentation, and report-writing skills  Effective communication and stakeholder management  Problem-solving and continuous improvement mindset

Qualiﬁcations & Experience  Bachelor’s Degree/ Diploma in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, or related discipline)  3–8 years of experience as a Quality Engineer or QA/QC Engineer in project environments  Experience with ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems  Knowledge of relevant standards (ASHRAE, NFPA, IEC, ISO, local codes)  Professional certiﬁcations (CQE, IRCA Lead Auditor, PMI-related) are an advantage

Tools & Systems  Quality management systems and audit tools  MS Oice (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)  Project documentation and reporting tools  ERP/Project systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent – preferred)

Behavioral Expectations  Commitment to Zero Defect and Right-First-Time philosophy  Compliance with Safety, Ethics, and Integrity standards  Proactive approach to quality risk management  Collaboration across multi-disciplinary project teams

job.title: Project Engineer
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

##

Role - Project Engineer - IBMS, Mumbai (1-Year Contract Role)

Johnson Controls delivers innovative building technologies that support smarter, healthier, and more sustainable environments. In this role, you will support project execution and project management activities for IBMS delivery in Mumbai, with hands-on involvement in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.

This is a one-year contractual opportunity, renewable annually based on performance. It is well suited to candidates with a strong background in project execution or project management and practical experience in IBMS site delivery.

Role Overview

As a Project Engineer, you will help drive the execution of IBMS projects from planning through site delivery, coordination, testing, and handover. You will work closely with internal teams, contractors, vendors, and stakeholders to help ensure work is delivered safely, on time, and to the expected technical and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end execution of IBMS projects, including CCTV and ACS systems.
  • Coordinate with project managers, site teams, contractors, vendors, and clients to support smooth project delivery.
  • Monitor site progress against project plans, timelines, and execution requirements.
  • Review technical drawings, specifications, and work instructions to support installation readiness and site execution.
  • Track material availability, site requirements, and execution dependencies to help avoid delays.
  • Support installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities for IBMS systems.
  • Raise and follow up on site issues, technical concerns, and coordination gaps in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, progress updates, and handover records.
  • Support quality checks and help ensure work is completed in line with project and safety expectations.

How You Will Do It

  • Stay close to the site execution work and understand what is needed to keep IBMS delivery moving forward.
  • Own tasks and follow-ups with accountability, integrity, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcome.
  • Use practical problem-solving and candid communication to remove obstacles and improve execution every day.
  • Work as one team with project management, engineering, vendors, and site stakeholders, building trust through collaboration and shared standards.
  • Keep documentation, progress tracking, and coordination updates accurate so that work remains visible and controllable.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Background in project execution or project management within IBMS projects.
  • Hands-on experience in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.
  • Experience supporting site-based project delivery, installation, testing, commissioning, or handover activities.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and site documentation.
  • Strong coordination, communication, and follow-up skills.
  • Good problem-solving mindset with attention to quality and execution detail.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to large-scale commercial, infrastructure, or facility-related projects.
  • Experience coordinating with multiple contractors and vendors on active project sites.
  • Additional exposure to integrated building systems or ELV project environments.

Why Join Us

This role gives you the opportunity to build strong IBMS project delivery experience with a global leader in smart and sustainable building solutions. You will gain hands-on exposure to project execution, strengthen your domain knowledge in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS, and contribute to meaningful work in a performance-based contractual role.

If you are ready to bring your project execution or project management experience to a hands-on IBMS role in Mumbai, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Application Engineer II
job.description:
Job Description

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer:

Competitive salary

  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc)
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Fire Alarm Panels, Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc)
  • Knowledge on Simplex & Zettler fire alarm product along with Xtralis, Securiton & Wagner product for Aspirating Smoke Detection system
  • Simplex & VESDA certifications will have added advantage
  • Expertise in Fire Alarm Code and Guidelines. Should be familiar with local code requirement for Singapore, Hong Kong & Malaysia region.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.), Blue Beam
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, Modbus, and other protocols.
  • Should have good experience for subcon/vendor engagement keeping close

co-ordination with procurement

  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

3-6 years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System’s Desing and Estimation.

job.description:
About us:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

###

What you will do: As Senior Solution Architect – OpenBlue (APAC), you will drive technical solutioning and customer engagement for the OpenBlue digital platform across the Asia Pacific region. You will partner closely with Sales, Product Management, Engineering and Delivery teams to design digital building solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes in energy efficiency, sustainability, operational excellence and occupant experience.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in Smart Buildings and IoT with consultative selling, value engineering and solution architecture capabilities.

###

How you will do it:

  • Partner with Sales teams to qualify opportunities and develop winning technical strategies
  • Lead customer discovery workshops to understand business, operational and digital transformation requirements
  • Design scalable end-to-end OpenBlue solutions leveraging IoT, cloud, analytics, AI and enterprise integrations
  • Develop solution architectures, technical proposals, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts (POCs) and RFP responses
  • Build business cases, ROI models and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analyses that quantify customer value
  • Present solution and value propositions to technical and executive stakeholders
  • Act as the regional liaison between customers, Sales and Product Management by capturing market requirements, coordinating product feedback and supporting roadmap discussions
  • Collaborate with Delivery teams to ensure smooth transition from pre-sales to implementation
  • Develop reusable solution templates, reference architectures and sales enablement assets
  • Stay current on Smart Building, Energy Management, AI and Digital Building technologies while supporting strategic customer engagements across APAC

###

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline
  • 8+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales or Digital Building solutions
  • Experience with Smart Buildings, Building Management Systems (BMS/BAS), IoT, Cloud Platforms and Enterprise Integration
  • Strong understanding of energy management, sustainability and connected building technologies
  • Experience preparing technical proposals, conducting customer workshops and supporting complex solution sales
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong problem-solving skills with high attention to detail
  • Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural regional environment

Preferred Skills

  • Technical
  • Smart Buildings, BMS/BAS, HVAC and Building Controls
  • IoT, Edge Computing and Cloud Platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP)
  • APIs and enterprise integrations
  • Data analytics, AI and digital platforms
  • Cybersecurity fundamentals for OT/IT environments

Business & Commercial

  • Consultative selling and solution design
  • Value engineering, ROI and TCO analysis
  • Executive presentations and stakeholder management
  • Product coordination and Voice of Customer management
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Sales and Delivery teams

Job Description – Project Engineer (Contractual Role)

Location: Mumbai Employment Type: Contractual (Contract to be renewed every year based on performance) Experience: 4–7 Years

Role Summary:

The Project Engineer will be responsible for end‑to‑end project execution of IBMS / ELV systems, ensuring timely installation, quality compliance, testing, and commissioning at project sites. The role demands strong hands‑on experience in IBMS, CCTV, and CFS systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Execute and manage IBMS / ELV projects at site.
  • Supervise installation, testing, commissioning, and handover of systems.
  • Handle project execution activities related to:

IBMS (Integrated Building Management Systems)

  • CCTV Systems
  • CFS (Critical / Fire & Life Safety Systems)

Coordinate with project managers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams.

Resolve technical and operational issues at site in coordination with stakeholders.

  • Practical exposure to installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
  • Mandatory experience in CCTV and CFS systems.

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and schematics.
  • Good communication, coordination, and problem‑solving skills.

Qualification & Experience:

  • Diploma / BE / BTech in Electrical / Electronics / Instrumentation / E&C or related discipline.
  • 4–7 years of relevant experience in IBMS / ELV projects.
  • Experience in commercial buildings, IT parks, data centers, or industrial projects preferred.

Project Manager / Senior Project Engineer

job.title: Integrated Solutions Service Tech 3
job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Assistant Manager – Service (IBMS) to lead service operations for Integrated Building Management Systems (IBMS). The incumbent will be responsible for managing service delivery, preventive and corrective maintenance activities, customer relationships, technical support, team management, and ensuring high system uptime across client sites.

Key Responsibilities

  • ### Manage end-to-end service operations for IBMS/BMS installations across multiple customer locations.
  • ### Lead a team of service engineers and technicians for maintenance and troubleshooting activities.
  • ### Ensure timely execution of preventive maintenance (PM), corrective maintenance (CM), and Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) obligations.
  • ### Support commissioning, upgrades, and system modifications as required.
  • ### Analyze system faults and provide effective solutions to minimize downtime.
  • ### Review service reports, maintenance schedules, and customer compliance documentation.
  • ### Coordinate with project, sales, and technical teams for smooth service delivery.
  • ### Monitor customer satisfaction and maintain strong client relationships.
  • ### Ensure adherence to SLAs, safety standards, and operational KPIs.
  • ### Identify opportunities for service revenue, AMC renewals, and modernization projects.
  • ### Conduct technical training and mentoring for service engineers.
  • ### Manage spare parts inventory and coordinate with vendors for replacements and repairs.

Key Skills & Requirements

  • ### Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • ### 6–10 years of experience in Building Automation, IBMS, BMS, or Building Technologies.
  • ### Hands-on experience with systems such as:

Honeywell

  • ### Siemens
  • ### Schneider Electric
  • ### Johnson Controls
  • ### Delta Controls
  • ### Tridium/Niagara

Strong knowledge of:

  • ### HVAC Controls
  • ### Fire Alarm Systems
  • ### Access Control Systems
  • ### CCTV Surveillance
  • ### Energy Monitoring Systems
  • ### DDC Controllers
  • ### PLCs and VFDs

Knowledge of communication protocols such as BACnet, Modbus, KNX, LonWorks, and TCP/IP.

Ability to interpret electrical schematics and control drawings.

Strong leadership, customer management, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ### Experience handling large commercial buildings, data centers, hospitals, airports, or industrial facilities.
  • ### Exposure to AMC management and service business operations.
  • ### Relevant certifications in BMS/IBMS, HVAC Controls, or Building Automation Systems.

job.description:
Job Description

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Gordon Brothers Industries, now proudly part of the Johnson Controls family, is Australia’s largest Industrial Refrigeration company. With offices in every mainland state, we design, build, and service industrial refrigeration solutions across mining, chemical, food and beverage, and more.

As we continue to grow and innovate, we’re seeking an experienced and motivated Industrial Refrigeration Technician to join our Melbourne team.

The Role

Reporting to the Service Manager, you’ll be responsible for delivering high-quality service and maintenance across a wide range of industrial refrigeration systems. We’re looking for someone reliable, self-driven, and solutions-focused—someone who can keep jobs running smoothly with a proactive and flexible approach.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Carry out planned and unplanned service and maintenance on industrial refrigeration systems
  • Complete all required paperwork accurately and on time
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with customers
  • Participate in company training programs and service meetings

What You’ll Bring

Required:

  • Qualified or experienced Refrigeration Mechanic
  • Current valid driver’s licence
  • Current ARC licence
  • Current Restricted Electrical licence

Ideally you’ll also have:

  • Previous industrial refrigeration experience
  • Strong work ethic and excellent communication skills
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Strong time management skills and ability to meet deadlines
  • Willingness to work flexible hours
  • Ammonia system experience (advantageous but not essential)
  • A positive and proactive approach to safety

What We Offer

  • Opportunity for OEM factory training with Frick and Sabroe equipment
  • Competitive pay rate
  • Fully maintained company vehicle & mobile phone
  • Training and development through internal and external courses
  • Real opportunities for career growth
  • A strong focus on work–life balance
  • Employment under our registered Enterprise Agreement (available via the Fair Work Australia website)

How to Apply Click APPLY to submit your application.

Only applicants with full working rights in Australia will be considered.

Please note: pre-employment checks (references, medical, criminal history, and drug & alcohol testing) will form part of the recruitment process.

Before applying, you can learn more about us at [www.gordonbrothers.com.au](http://www.gordonbrothers.com.au/)

job.title: Engineering Intern, HVAC
job.description:
Who we are

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do

We are seeking an Engineering Intern to join the Project Delivery, SEA. Reporting to the HVAC team, the intern will drive customer proposals, project plans, as well as document engineering designs and schematics with guidance from the team. The successful individual will work closely with stakeholders to identify project requirements, and develop proposals including costing, durations and required resources.

How you will do it:

As an intern, you will work closely and support the team in the following activities:

  • Conceptualize composite components and models, develop drawings, designs and schematics (e.g. 3D modelling of finished goods, tooling)
  • Analyze blueprints, plans, relevant customer documents to identify and propose requirements
  • Generate cost estimation based on project requirements
  • Facilitate and support project findings, relevant operation trainings, closing and handover process
  • Act as a liaison between internal and external project stakeholders

What we look for:

  • Pursuing a relevant degree or diploma for built environment (e.g. electrical/mechanical/mechatronics engineering)
  • Prior experience and/or interest in building management systems/thermodynamics
  • Prior experience and/or interest in utilizing CAD will be beneficial
  • Able to commit to a full-time internship for 6 months
  • Possess good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Possess critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Motivated and passionate to challenge status quo and drive for continuous improvement

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction. Maintain project quality, on time delivery and manage escalations.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Backend, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Provides coaching and professional development to team members in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills to bridge the gap.

  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.

What we look for

  • Expertise in NFPA / BS 5839/EN/ FM.

  • Liaise with other functional manager –EMB FW, PC SW, V&V, Design office and program managers.
  • Participates in the evaluation of hardware and software compatibility recommending program specifications.
  • Recommends program refinements and changes to better achieve desired functionality and/or enhance program capabilities. Counsels’ designers in the use of various design tools.
  • Facilitate and ensures individual and team roles and responsibilities are understood; performance measurement objectives are identified, measured and monitored on an ongoing basis to provide feedback and take necessary action to address shortfalls. Involved in employment issues, such as staffing, termination and employee relations issues.
  • Ensures a positive work environment and awareness by all staff of company goals and objectives.
  • Make recommendations regarding verification and validation procedures and processes to improve the quality of the team(s) and hardware group.
  • Follows and ensures workplace operating and environmental, health and safety procedures and guidelines compliance.

What we look for

-

  • Thorough knowledge of applicable HW design and development practice; design
  • techniques, systems, and platforms.
  • - Excellent problem solving, interpersonal communication and project management skills a
  • must.
  • - Strong leadership skills inspire team confidence and respect while motivating team
  • members in a creative and effective manner.
  • - Must have a desire to achieve excellence in customer satisfaction, process and product
  • quality and reliability.
  • - Strong understanding of different embedded product development life cycles (waterfall,
  • iterative) and contemporary HW design assurance processes and automated tools.
  • - Must have experience in managing and working with distributed team members.
  • - Knowledge of internet and e-business processes, disciplines and standards

-

  • Must be extremely detail-oriented with respect to documentation and communication

Preferred

-

  • BE/BTech/ME/MTech (ECE/EIE/ETC/CSE) Degree in a technical field is required.
  • - 14+ yrs experience on Hardware end to end product design along with 3+ years in
  • managerial experience

-

  • Experience in leading Hardware Product Development for Industrial Product.
  • - Knowledge of regulatory standards for EN and UL for industrial products.

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction.
