Job Title: Deputy Project Manager - IBMS Location: Kolkata Experience: 8-12 Years Industry: Building Automation / ELV / IBMS / Smart Buildings

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Deputy Project Manager - IBMS to support the planning, execution, and delivery of Integrated Building Management System (IBMS) projects. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end project execution, stakeholder coordination, resource management, and ensuring timely project completion while maintaining quality, safety, and commercial objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and execute IBMS projects from initiation to commissioning and handover.
  • Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, OEMs, and internal teams for seamless project delivery.
  • Oversee installation, integration, testing, and commissioning of IBMS and associated ELV systems.
  • Monitor project schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource utilization.
  • Ensure project execution adheres to approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
  • Track project progress and prepare periodic status reports, MIS, and project documentation.
  • Manage subcontractors and site teams to ensure timely completion of activities.
  • Handle project risks, change requests, and escalation management.
  • Support procurement and material planning activities to avoid project delays.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards, statutory requirements, and company policies.
  • Coordinate with engineering and programming teams for system integration and troubleshooting.
  • Participate in client meetings and provide technical and execution-related support.

Technical Expertise Required

Strong experience in execution and project management of the following systems:

  • Integrated Building Management System (IBMS)
  • Building Management System (BMS)
  • Fire Alarm System (FAS)
  • Access Control System (ACS)
  • CCTV / Video Surveillance System
  • Public Address System (PA)
  • Intrusion Detection System
  • Networking and Structured Cabling
  • HVAC Integration
  • Energy Monitoring System (EMS)
  • SCADA Integration (preferred)

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Electrical & Electronics, or related Engineering discipline.
  • Project Management certification will be an added advantage.

Desired Experience

  • 8-12 years of experience in IBMS/BMS/ELV project execution and project management.
  • Proven experience in handling commercial buildings, IT parks, hospitals, airports, metro, industrial, smart city, or large infrastructure projects.
  • Hands-on experience in project planning, scheduling, coordination, commissioning, and client management.
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams and contractors.

Required Skills

  • Strong project execution and management capabilities.
  • Knowledge of IBMS architecture, protocols, and system integration.
  • Good understanding of HVAC, electrical, and ELV systems.
  • Proficiency in MS Project, Primavera, AutoCAD, and MS Office.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Commercial awareness and contract management understanding.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight timelines.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • On-time project delivery.
  • Project profitability and cost control.
  • Successful commissioning and handover.
  • Customer satisfaction.
  • Quality and safety compliance.
  • Team productivity and resource optimization.

Location: Kolkata (with travel to project sites across Eastern Region as required).

job.title: Senior Project Engineer
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

##

Role - Project Engineer - IBMS, Mumbai (1-Year Contract Role)

Johnson Controls delivers innovative building technologies that support smarter, healthier, and more sustainable environments. In this role, you will support project execution and project management activities for IBMS delivery in Mumbai, with hands-on involvement in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.

This is a one-year contractual opportunity, renewable annually based on performance. It is well suited to candidates with a strong background in project execution or project management and practical experience in IBMS site delivery.

Role Overview

As a Project Engineer, you will help drive the execution of IBMS projects from planning through site delivery, coordination, testing, and handover. You will work closely with internal teams, contractors, vendors, and stakeholders to help ensure work is delivered safely, on time, and to the expected technical and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end execution of IBMS projects, including CCTV and ACS systems.
  • Coordinate with project managers, site teams, contractors, vendors, and clients to support smooth project delivery.
  • Monitor site progress against project plans, timelines, and execution requirements.
  • Review technical drawings, specifications, and work instructions to support installation readiness and site execution.
  • Track material availability, site requirements, and execution dependencies to help avoid delays.
  • Support installation, testing, commissioning, and handover activities for IBMS systems.
  • Raise and follow up on site issues, technical concerns, and coordination gaps in a timely manner.
  • Prepare and maintain project documentation, progress updates, and handover records.
  • Support quality checks and help ensure work is completed in line with project and safety expectations.

How You Will Do It

  • Stay close to the site execution work and understand what is needed to keep IBMS delivery moving forward.
  • Own tasks and follow-ups with accountability, integrity, and a clear focus on delivering the right outcome.
  • Use practical problem-solving and candid communication to remove obstacles and improve execution every day.
  • Work as one team with project management, engineering, vendors, and site stakeholders, building trust through collaboration and shared standards.
  • Keep documentation, progress tracking, and coordination updates accurate so that work remains visible and controllable.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Background in project execution or project management within IBMS projects.
  • Hands-on experience in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.
  • Experience supporting site-based project delivery, installation, testing, commissioning, or handover activities.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and site documentation.
  • Strong coordination, communication, and follow-up skills.
  • Good problem-solving mindset with attention to quality and execution detail.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to large-scale commercial, infrastructure, or facility-related projects.
  • Experience coordinating with multiple contractors and vendors on active project sites.
  • Additional exposure to integrated building systems or ELV project environments.

Why Join Us

This role gives you the opportunity to build strong IBMS project delivery experience with a global leader in smart and sustainable building solutions. You will gain hands-on exposure to project execution, strengthen your domain knowledge in IBMS, CCTV, and ACS, and contribute to meaningful work in a performance-based contractual role.

If you are ready to bring your project execution or project management experience to a hands-on IBMS role in Mumbai, we encourage you to apply.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager – BMS to join our Melbourne (Scoresby) team. You will lead the delivery of complex Building Management System and Integrated Building Systems projects across commercial and mission‑critical environments.

This is a hands‑on senior role where you will take full ownership of project delivery—from design and engineering through to commissioning and close‑out—while acting as the primary interface with customers, consultants, and contractors.

You’ll apply your technical expertise, commercial acumen, and leadership capability to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end‑to‑end delivery of BMS / IBMS projects, including design, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and documentation
  • Ensure compliance with customer specifications, QA standards, and regulatory requirements
  • Manage project scope, schedules, resources, and budgets to achieve contractual and financial outcomes
  • Provide strong leadership to project teams to drive performance and accountability
  • Build and maintain effective relationships with clients, contractors, consultants, and internal stakeholders
  • Conduct and manage FATs, SATs, system commissioning, and building tuning
  • Maintain accurate financial forecasting, cost control, and reporting
  • Prepare and manage project QA documentation and standardised deliverables
  • Provide regular project updates and reporting to senior management
  • Ensure all works comply with OHS&E and safety‑first principles
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, standardisation, and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Uphold Johnson Controls’ KPIs, ethical standards, and professional conduct at all times

What You Bring

  • Trade qualification in Electrical or HVAC, or an Engineering qualification with HVAC experience
  • Strong background in Building Automation Systems (BAS/BMS) design, architecture, and delivery
  • Proven experience managing BMS / IBMS projects, including third‑party protocol integrations
  • Solid understanding of controller design, alternative control strategies, and system optimisation
  • Strong experience with commercial HVAC systems (chillers, boilers, airside plant)
  • Knowledge of energy efficiency and building performance solutions
  • Sound understanding of IT, networking, and industrial communication protocols
  • Experience conducting FAT, SAT, commissioning, and technical handover
  • Competency in MS Word, Excel, Project, and Visio

(BIM, AutoCAD, and system documentation tools advantageous)

  • Ability to standardise software, points lists, documentation, and support libraries
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and report‑writing skills
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities
  • Passion for safety, quality, and customer success

Experience

  • Minimum 2+ years post‑qualification experience in HVAC and/or building controls
  • Extensive experience in commercial BMS project delivery

Why Join Johnson Controls?

  • Global organisation with long‑term project pipeline and stability
  • Work on large‑scale, technically complex building projects
  • Clear career pathways into senior leadership or advanced technical roles
  • Strong investment in training, certification, and professional development
  • Supportive, collaborative culture with access to market‑leading technology
  • Genuine commitment to safety, wellbeing, and sustainability

Ready to Apply?

Job Summary

Regional Project Manager - Global Marine & Navy

Johnson Controls helps create smart, healthy, and sustainable environments around the world. In our Global Marine & Navy business line, you will help deliver technically complex projects that support customer performance, safety, and long-term value.

Role Overview

As Regional Project Manager, you will lead multiple projects across the Marine & Navy segment, ensuring disciplined execution from contract review through delivery and handover. This role is focused on ownership, coordination, and strong project control across operational, commercial, and customer-facing activities.

What will you do?

  • Lead the execution of multiple projects within the Global Marine & Navy business line, ensuring clear scope, delivery, and handover.
  • Manage project timelines, milestones, risks, and deviations to keep work on track.
  • Oversee operational and financial performance for assigned projects, including follow-up on budget and progress.
  • Coordinate closely with sales, design, and Supply chain to align deliverables with customer expectations and contractual requirements.
  • Support projects involving HVAC, refrigeration, controls, and provision plant scope where applicable.
  • Support Projects on Fire suppression and Halo hanger firefighting systems
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure compliance with Johnson Controls, legal, and contractual standards.
  • Maintain the monthly outlook plan for the financial year and update plan on monthly basis as per revenue planned
  • Drive a professional handover process and ensure customers receive a complete and well-executed solution.
  • Visit Shipyards, Indian Navy and other customers to review ongoing projects & maintain customer focus. In addition meet relevant teams in Shipyard to gather information on future projects and requirements /Specs.
  • Manage the AR, Unbilled and TWC
  • Focus on employees EHS and KPI

How You Will Do It

  • Own outcomes with accountability, safety, and integrity by following through from contract review to final handover.
  • Stay close to the work and remove obstacles by aligning quickly with customers, sales, technical specialists, and Supply chain colleagues.
  • Improve every day through candid problem-solving by tracking deviations early, addressing root causes, and keeping project execution transparent.
  • Win as one team by building trust, sharing information openly, and using diverse perspectives to support the best project decisions.
  • Use a structured project management approach to balance scope, schedule, quality, and financial control across several concurrent projects.

What we look for?

  • Mechanical Engineering /Marine Engineering or Electrical/ Electronic engineering graduate/ Masters from reputable college/University
  • Minimum of 15-20 years’ experience in Marine/ Navy projects
  • Proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Experience handling technically complex projects with customer, commercial, and operational coordination.
  • Strong ability to manage schedules, risks, handover activities, and financial follow-up.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Indian Navy/CG background with Cdr/Capt equivalent with 20 Plus years of service
  • Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, controls, or provision plant projects.
  • Background in contract-based project delivery within marine, offshore, or navy environments.
  • Experience working in an international project setting.

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate.  Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: HVAC Finance Controller, EMEA Region
job.description:
What you will do:

The EMEA HVAC Controller will drive results in the accounting functions that support a cluster of ledgers and countries (29 ledgers, 14 pure and remaining commingle with other domains) for the segment EMEA.

This role, reporting through Controllership under the CATO organization, will serve as an advisor to the sub region CFOs and business/operations leaders to ensure accounting and reporting integrity and effective controls and compliance, confirming consistency to US GAAP and Company policy.

This strategic individual will lead the reporting and monitoring of actual results and control of financial results consistent with long-term business objectives. This person will provide direction, training and counseling to its various stakeholders on a wide variety of business/financial/accounting issues to ensure achievement and alignment of business processes across the enterprise.

How you will do it:

  • Proactively works with the business and operations to oversee, review and sign-off on the monthly, quarterly and annual closing processes. This includes review of the key reserves and account reconciliations and overall balance sheet, cash flow and financial metric trends to ensure accuracy and potential gaps.
  • Ensure that strong controls are implemented and maintained for key projects that include entities migrations and ERP implementations. Identify opportunities and drive movement of activities to the Company’s COEs (e.g. RTR), including standardization. Liaison with cross functional teams (technical accounting, governance, RTR, BU Finance, etc.) and peers to ensure a harmonized environment throughout the Controllership organization.
  • Monitors and supports the internal control function to ensure controls in the represented cluster of countries are adequate, efficient and in line with the Company’s and locally managed policies.
  • Participate on cross-functional teams to support financial accounting, reporting and control activities for complex transactions within Pillar (restructurings, supplier contracts, M&A, leases, etc.)
  • Collaborate with, coach and monitor the Record to Report (“RTR”) teams that support the underlying or transactional details of each Pillar. Create talent pipeline through the Company’s SBCs to strengthen finance functions.
  • Engage and collaborates with FP&A surrounding the plans and forecasts for alignment with business objectives, market opportunities and the ability to execute. Provides recommendations and direction to the management team.
  • Proactively identifies business/financial opportunities and corrective actions and implements them or communicates them to management for implementation.
  • Provides financial leadership, training and direction to the financial and operating team to improve their financial and business skills so they can more effectively manage their responsibilities.
  • Identifies best business practices and facilitates the propagation of these practices throughout and indirectly impacting the countries/ledgers
  • Provides support for development and enhancement of IT financial and business systems.
  • Provides support for all accounting performed at the global business centers for the centralized functions.
  • Directs team in support of the above objectives.
  • Goal setting and performance reviews for all direct reports.

What we look for

  • Qualified CA/CMA
  • 15+ years progressive finance and accounting experience
  • Demonstrated ability to add value to business performance
  • Advanced computer skills including OneStream, Microsoft Office products and financial reporting software
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, and the ability to work effectively with all levels of the organization

job.title: Head Of Compliance, India
job.description:
Head Of Compliance, India

Johnson Controls is a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization. We help customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified compliance leader to head the India compliance agenda and support the continued development of our ethics and compliance program. Reporting to the Interim Chief Ethics and Compliance Officer, this role is a key member of the Compliance Leadership Team and works closely with senior business management, Finance, Human Resources, the Law Department, Regional Compliance Counsels, and global compliance experts.

The role is responsible for strengthening compliance culture, supporting anti-corruption and fair competition efforts, and ensuring practical, effective controls across India.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain effective communication with senior management in India on compliance matters and support programs that strengthen tone at the top and the Speak Up culture.
  • Identify regional compliance risks and design focused training, communications, and program initiatives to address them.
  • Review and approve third-party due diligence, high-risk payment transactions, and employee-disclosed conflicts of interest relating to India.
  • Organize and facilitate India Compliance Committee meetings with senior business leaders and stakeholders from Finance, Legal, and HR.
  • Support internal investigations led by the Forensics team and oversee remediation and disciplinary processes, including escalation to the Disciplinary Sub-Committee where appropriate.
  • Direct internal investigations conducted under legal privilege, with focus on anti-corruption, anti-trust, and other regulatory risks.
  • Respond promptly to detected offenses and work with the Chief Ethics and Compliance Officer, Regional Compliance Counsels, local leadership, Human Resources, and local counsel to define corrective actions.
  • Support M&A due diligence and post-acquisition integration activities in India.
  • Lead or co-lead projects with senior management to strengthen program design and reduce compliance exposure across the country.
  • Support corruption-risk assessments, fair competition reviews, anti-corruption compliance audits, and targeted risk assessments of business units.
  • Develop and monitor plans to implement policies, procedures, and standards of conduct throughout the country.
  • Help maintain a data-driven, proactive monitoring program for customers, vendors, and employee transactions.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance and support to employees across India on a wide range of compliance issues.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of the compliance program through updated policies, training, communications, data analytics, monitoring, and other initiatives.

How You Will Do It

  • Own the India compliance agenda with accountability, integrity, and a clear focus on doing the right thing.
  • Stay close to the business, remove obstacles quickly, and translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical solutions.
  • Use candid dialogue, data, and sound judgment to improve programs every day and respond effectively to emerging risks.
  • Work as one team with Finance, HR, Legal, Forensics, regional counsels, and business leaders to deliver consistent outcomes.
  • Apply disciplined follow-through on investigations, remediation, disciplinary actions, monitoring, and reporting so commitments become measurable action.

job.title: Sr E&IC Engineer
job.description:
Who we are?

##

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

## For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

##

What will you do?

We are looking for a hands‑on EC\&I Controls & Automation Engineer with a strong software bias, specifically in PLC programming, HMI development, and secure automation systems. This role strengthens our control and automation software capability within the India team, which is already strong in instrumentation and EC&I design. The objective of this role is to add depth in control and automation software, including PLC/HMI implementation, Cause & Effect logic, control philosophy development, and OT cybersecurity‑aware IEC 62443 system design requirements. This is a technical delivery role, not project management. The engineer will support oil & gas and process automation systems, including Hydraulic Power Units (HPU), CAFS, INERT / gas‑based fire suppression systems, and other safety‑critical control applications.

  • ## PLC, HMI & Automation Software (Primary Responsibility)
  • ## ➢ Develop, test, and maintain PLC programs using Siemens TIA Portal.
  • ## ➢ Design and implement HMI applications using WinCC / WinCC Unified.
  • ## ➢ Implement control sequences, interlocks, permissive, alarms, trips, and shutdown logic.
  • ## ➢ Develop, review, and execute Cause & Effect (C\&E) matrices and ensure correct implementation in PLC logic and HMI behavior. ➢ Support closed‑loop testing and simulation (e.g. PLCSIM Advanced).
  • ## ➢ Perform hands‑on troubleshooting of PLC logic, HMI screens, communication issues, and field I/O. 2. HPU, CAFS & INERT Fire Suppression Control Assessment
  • ## ➢ Support control system design and assessment for: • Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) • Compressed Air Foam Systems (CAFS) • INERT / gas‑based fire suppression systems
  • ## ➢ Develop and verify automation sequences, interlocks, and fail‑safe logic for hydraulic and fire suppression systems.
  • ## ➢ Review instrumentation inputs, valve actuation logic, feedback signals, alarms, and shutdown conditions.
  • ## ➢ Ensure fire suppression control logic aligns with Cause & Effect diagrams , safety requirements, and site operating philosophy.
  • ## ➢ Support FAT, SAT, and commissioning activities for safety‑critical systems. 3. Control Philosophy & Automation Documentation
  • ## ➢ Prepare and maintain: • Control Philosophy narratives • Functional Design Specifications (FDS) • Automation sequence descriptions • Cause & Effect diagrams
  • ## ➢ Translate process and safety requirements into clear PLC logic and HMI functionality .
  • ## ➢ Interface with EC\&I and process teams to ensure correct automation implementation. 4. OT Cybersecurity & Secure Automation Design
  • ## ➢ Apply OT cybersecurity principles in PLC and HMI system design.
  • ## ➢ Support secure control system network topology, including: • Network segmentation (zones & conduits concept) • Separation of control, safety, and enterprise networks • Secure remote access concepts
  • ## ➢ Ensure automation designs align with IEC 62443 awareness‑level requirements.
  • ## ➢ Participate in cybersecurity design reviews from an automation engineer perspective (not IT policy ownership).
  • ## ➢ Identify and mitigate basic cybersecurity risks related to PLCs, HMIs, and industrial networks.
  • ## Note: This is not an IT cybersecurity role, but OT cybersecurity awareness and correct engineering practices are required. 5. EC\&I Integration, Testing & Delivery
  • ## ➢ Work with EC\&I design documents (SLDs, I/O lists, cable schedules).
  • ## ➢ Support control panel design reviews, software loading, and configuration checks.
  • ## ➢ Execute and support Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT).
  • ## ➢ Support commissioning, troubleshooting, and handover of automation systems. Required Skills & Experience Must‑Have
  • ## ➢ 5–10 years experience in EC\&I / Controls / Automation engineering .
  • ## ➢ Strong PLC programming experience (Siemens TIA Portal mandatory).
  • ## ➢ HMI development experience (WinCC / WinCC Unified preferred).
  • ## ➢ Hands‑on experience with Cause & Effect logic and control narratives .
  • ## ➢ Practical experience with industrial automation systems .
  • ## ➢ Experience supporting FAT, SAT, and commissioning .
  • ## ➢ OT cybersecurity awareness (secure control system networks, segmentation). Nice to Have
  • ## ➢ Oil & gas / process automation experience.
  • ## ➢ Experience with HPU, CAFS, INERT fire suppression systems . ➢ Basic functional safety exposure (SIL / IEC 61508 / IEC 61511). ➢ PLCSIM Advanced or similar simulation tools. ➢ AutoCAD / EPLAN (review level).

What we look for

  • ## 5–10 years experience in EC\&I / Controls / Automation engineering .
  • ## ➢ Strong PLC programming experience (Siemens TIA Portal mandatory).
  • ## ➢ HMI development experience (WinCC / WinCC Unified preferred).
  • ## ➢ Hands‑on experience with Cause & Effect logic and control narratives .
  • ## ➢ Practical experience with industrial automation systems .
  • ## ➢ Experience supporting FAT, SAT, and commissioning .
  • ## ➢ OT cybersecurity awareness (secure control system networks, segmentation). Nice to Have
  • ## ➢ Oil & gas / process automation experience.
  • ## ➢ Experience with HPU, CAFS, INERT fire suppression systems . ➢ Basic functional safety exposure (SIL / IEC 61508 / IEC 61511). ➢ PLCSIM Advanced or similar simulation tools.
  • ## ➢ AutoCAD / EPLAN (review level).

##

What we offer:

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

job.description:

What we offer:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

What You Will Do

The Safety Engineer will be responsible for ensuring compliance with Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) standards across project sites.   • Experience conducting safety audits, inspections, and incident investigations.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.

Preferred

  • Certification in Industrial Safety, NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent EHS qualification.

  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

job.title: Sr. Service Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings.

We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through OpenBlue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions.

Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission.

###

Please visit and follow Johnson Controls linkedin for recent exciting activities.

APAC Linkedin [Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin ](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/)

Career [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://youtu.be/EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue [OpenBlue: This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://youtu.be/bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What you will do

HVAC Chiller Service Engineer - Troubleshooting

We are seeking an experienced HVAC Chiller Service Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing HVAC chiller systems, ensuring efficient operation and minimizing downtime. The role requires a strong technical background, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to maintenance and service.

What we look for:

  • ### Diagnose and troubleshoot issues with HVAC chiller systems, including compressors, evaporators, condensers, and associated components.
  • ### Perform routine maintenance and repairs on chillers to ensure optimal performance and longevity.
  • ### Identify and resolve mechanical and electrical faults, utilizing diagnostic tools and industry best practices.
  • ### Conduct inspections and testing of HVAC equipment to confirm system functionality and compliance with safety standards.
  • ### Provide on-site technical support to clients, including emergency repairs and troubleshooting.
  • ### Maintain accurate records of services performed, parts used, and recommendations for future maintenance.
  • ### Collaborate with other team members to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
  • ### Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and company policies.
  • ### Stay updated on new technologies and industry developments in HVAC systems

###

Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment.

###

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands

job.title: Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Who we are:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do:

The Graduate Solutions Engineer Program is designed to develop the next generation of engineering leaders for smart buildings, data centers, and mission-critical infrastructure. Through a structured rotational program, participants will build deep technical expertise across multiple engineering disciplines while gaining practical experience in energy efficiency, digital technologies, controls, HVAC systems, and mission-critical environments.

During the 18-month rotational program, you will work alongside experienced engineers and subject matter experts, gaining hands-on experience across electrical, mechanical, controls, and digital domains. The program is designed to strengthen core engineering fundamentals, cultivate multidisciplinary problem-solving capabilities, and equip participants with the skills to design and deliver integrated solutions for increasingly complex customer challenges.

How you will do it:

  • Join the BMS Project/Service team to design and implement control programming for new or existing BMS sites, facilitating synergy between electrical control systems and mechanical operations
  • Engage with the HVAC Energy Solution/Service team to perform chiller performance reviews, audit reporting and maintenance, gaining insights that intertwine different components in energy management
  • Contribute as a member of the digital delivery and solution architect team, tasked with implementing and delivering JCI’s OpenBlue digital solutions.
  • Participate in Data Center and mission-critical infrastructure projects, gaining exposure to cooling systems, sustainability initiatives, operational resilience, and optimization strategies.
  • Participate in research projects with external organizations (e.g. Higher Learning Institution, startups) as a part of the JCI Innovation Center
  • Undertaking a full cycle project in the final year of the program
  • Engage in cross-functional collaboration to leverage collective expertise and drive innovative solutions in the design and implementation of comprehensive building systems & data center solutions.
  • Receive mentoring and coaching from experienced engineers and industry experts to accelerate technical and professional development.
  • Stay informed about industry trends and advancements in both electrical and mechanical fields to ensure solutions remain cutting-edge and relevant

What we look for:

  • Graduating student or recent graduate with a degree background in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Infrastructure and Project Management, Urban Systems/Energy Management, or a related field, with up to 2 years of experience.
  • A strong interest in sustainability and a desire to learn and apply concepts related to smart building solutions that encompass multidisciplinary engagements
  • Robust analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, with a capability to approach challenges from both electrical and mechanical perspectives.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to facilitate teamwork across engineering disciplines.
  • Able to thrive in a collaborative and dynamic work environment, adapting to evolving project needs.
  • Shortlisted candidates will participate in a video interview and an assessment center to showcase their skills and fit for the role

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Associate Service Sales Engineer
job.description:
About us: Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do:

As Associate Service Sales Engineer, you will be supporting the sale of Labour & Materials (L&M) labour hours, travel, and materials for service tasks, and the sale/administration of Planned Service Agreements (PSA) for uptime.

Gain exposure to digitalization and retrofit opportunities while working under supervision to help generate quotes, manage opportunities, and engage customers.

How You Will Do It:

Primary Responsibilities (L&M & PSA Focus)

  • L&M sales:

Assist in pricing and selling Labour & Materials for field service tasks, including labour hours, labour rates, travel charges, and materials used. Ensure quotes reflect accurate scoping and margin targets, with engineering support as needed.

  • Quote preparation:

Prepare clear L&M quotations with defined labour, travel, and materials elements; use standard templates and guidance to ensure consistency.

  • PSA sales

Support the promotion and administration of PSA (Planned Service Agreements) for uptime, including quoting, basic proposal development, and coordination with operations and teams.

  • Attaching L&M/PSA:

Work with teams to identify opportunities to include L&M on service jobs or to offer PSA alongside existing services; support strategies to improve attach rates.

  • Customer data collection:

Gather site and equipment data, maintenance history, and usage information to tailor L&M quotes and PSA scopes; maintain accurate records in the CRM.

  • CRM & documentation:

Keep opportunities, quotes, and related documents up to date in the CRM; ensure accuracy and compliance of commercial paperwork.

Secondary Responsibilities (Digitalization & Retrofit)

  • Digitalization support: Assist in promoting digital service offerings (monitoring platforms, connectivity) by collecting customer data and supporting value-based proposals as directed.
  • Retrofit support: Aid in identifying retrofit/upgrade opportunities; coordinate with field/engineering teams for initial scoping and proposal preparation.

Operational & Support Responsibilities

  • Quotation support: Prepare quotes, pricing inquiries, and basic technical proposals under supervision; ensure timely, accurate documentation.
  • Customer engagement: Assist in proactive communication before, during, and after quotes; follow up on AR, PO, TOC, and other commercial documents.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Support regional offices and coordinate with Operations, Procurement, and Engineering to fulfill customer needs; assist with market surveys and competitive analysis as required.
  • Documentation & delivery: Ensure electronic documentation is complete and compliant; support timely parts delivery and service execution planning

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • L&M quotes won and L&M attach rate (percentage of opportunities converting to L&M quotes/sales).
  • PSA revenue, gross margin, and renewal activity (as applicable).
  • L&M/PSA pipeline growth and conversion rate.
  • On-time service delivery and adherence to project timelines.
  • Margin achievement on L&M and PSA engagements.
  • Customer satisfaction and retention metrics.

Relationships

  • Internal: Sales, Operations, Admin, Procurement, Engineering, Regional Offices.
  • External: Customers, Vendors, Contractors, Service Partners.

What We Look For:

  • Qualifications & Experience:

Diploma or Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related) or equivalent.

  • 1–3 years of relevant experience in service sales, maintenance, or related field; experience with L&M stand-alone quotes or service work is a plus.
  • Exposure to industrial sectors (manufacturing, oil & gas, heavy equipment) is beneficial.
  • Familiarity with digital service platforms is advantageous.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Foundational sales aptitude with ability to articulate value-based solutions.
  • Customer-centric, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and able to work independently as well as across functions.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills; proficient with CRM and MS Office.
  • Quick learner, willing to develop expertise in L&M (Labour & Materials) and PSA.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

  • Should have strong domain knowledge of Fire Alarm (Simplex, Edwards, Notifier etc.)
  • FAS commissioning and programming for Simplex Panels, certification would be an added advantage.

  • Ensure quality assurance and defect free hardware and software package delivery

  • Demonstrate adherence to operational process requirements to drive efficiency
  • Should be able to maintain assigned KPIs and should own to meet them.
  • Achieving customer satisfaction by completing the work on time.
  • Maintaining relationships with key influencers / decision-makers with customer organizations to get the certifications on work done
  • Coordinate with other vendors for interface
  • Co-ordination with the Architects, Clients and Contractors at various stages of the project
  • Managing team of site engineers & Technicians working under and supporting on technical aspects to resolve the customer query / issues at sites

What we look for

  • ME/BE/ Diploma (Electrical/ Electronics/Instrumentation/ Electronics & Telecommunication)
  • 5-8 years’ experience in Fire Alarm commissioning
  • Knowledge on NFPA 72, IBC & Relevant codes & standards.
  • Other system design and commissioning will be added advantage.
  • Time bound delivery of project deliverables
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work with detail as well as with general assignments
  • A professional, results oriented individual with a high degree of self-motivation
  • Strong Communication & Presentation Skills.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and motivated JDE EnterpriseOne CNC (Configurable Network Computing) Consultant with 5+ years of hands-on experience in administering, configuring, upgrading, and supporting JD Edwards EnterpriseOne environments. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in CNC architecture, system administration, performance tuning, security management, and deployment activities across development, testing, and production environments.

  • Support JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Tools Release upgrades and platform migrations.

  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues related to JDE applications, servers, and databases.
  • Maintain and support integrations involving AIS, Orchestrator, BSSV, and third-party applications.
  • Coordinate and execute backup, recovery, cloning, and disaster recovery activities.
  • Work with infrastructure teams on server management, operating systems, networking, and middleware support.
  • Create and maintain CNC documentation, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Collaborate with functional consultants, developers, DBAs, and business stakeholders to resolve production issues.
  • Provide on-call support for critical business applications and production incidents.
  • Ensure system compliance with organizational security and audit requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience as a JD Edwards EnterpriseOne CNC Consultant.
  • Strong knowledge of JDE EnterpriseOne architecture and CNC administration.
  • Experience with:Enterprise Server
  • Deployment Server
  • HTML Server
  • AIS Server
  • BSSV Server
  • Orchestrator Studio
  • WebLogic Server

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Oracle JD Edwards EnterpriseOne certifications preferred.
  • Experience with DevOps practices, automation scripting (PowerShell, Shell Scripts, Python), and CI/CD processes is a plus.
  • Knowledge of JD Edwards Orchestrator and digital transformation initiatives.

Key Deliverables

  • Stable and high-performing JD Edwards environments.
  • Successful implementation of upgrades, patches, and deployments.
  • Timely incident resolution and root cause analysis.
  • Compliance with security, audit, and governance standards.
  • Accurate technical documentation and knowledge transfer activities.

Preferred Candidate Profile

job.description:
Who we are:

Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings.

We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through OpenBlue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions.

Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission.

  • ### Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and company policies.

###

Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment.

###

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: Baan Functional Consultant
job.description:
Baan Functional Consultant (Open) - Bangalore | 4 to 7 Years

Johnson Controls helps create smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, and this role supports the ERP platforms that keep business operations running smoothly. As a Baan Functional Consultant, you will help business users and support teams maintain stable ERP processes, resolve functional issues, and improve the day-to-day experience across Baan IV and ERP LN environments.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Baan Functional Consultant with hands-on experience in ERP functional support and user issue resolution.   • Coordinate with technical teams on fixes, enhancements, and interface-related issues.

  • Stay close to the business process and the people using it so you can understand the real problem, not just the symptom.
  • Use structured analysis and candid root-cause discussion to prevent repeat issues and improve support quality over time.

job.title: HR Technology Analyst – HCM Core Workday
job.description:
What You Will Do

As an HR Technology Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting Workday organizational structure maintenance, HR data governance, and system operations across the organization. You will serve as a strategic partner to HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders by translating business requirements into effective Workday solutions that support operational efficiency and workforce management.

Demonstrating Workday expertise, the HR Technology team partners with HR stakeholders to answer system functionality questions, resolve issues, maintain organizational structures, and ensure data integrity. The Analyst will play a critical role in maintaining Workday organizational data, including supervisory organizations, cost centers, locations, and related business structures while supporting key HR processes and organizational changes.

How You Will Do It

  • Configure and maintain Workday organizational structures, including Supervisory Organizations, Cost Centers, Companies, Locations, Business Sites, and Custom Organizations.
  • Manage organizational changes resulting from restructures, acquisitions, divestitures, leadership transitions, and workforce planning initiatives.
  • Partner with HR, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders to ensure organizational data is accurate, compliant, and aligned with business requirements.
  • Maintain organizational hierarchies and support governance processes related to workforce structure and management.
  • Analyze and validate organizational data to ensure consistency and integrity across Workday.
  • Support HR business processes that rely on accurate organizational assignments and structure maintenance.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Workday organizational management functionality and related business processes.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues related to organizational structures, staffing models, and worker assignments.
  • Lead testing efforts for Workday releases and enhancements, validating organizational structures, security access, and business process functionality.
  • Support security administration to ensure appropriate access to organizational and workforce data.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify opportunities for process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Create and maintain process documentation, governance procedures, and end-user training materials.
  • Participate in Workday enhancement projects, including organizational redesign initiatives and process improvements.
  • Support audits, compliance activities, and data governance initiatives through accurate maintenance of organizational structures.

What We Look For

job.title: Assistant Manager-Service
job.description:
Who we are

Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings.

We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through OpenBlue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions.

Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission.

###

Please visit and follow Johnson Controls linkedin for recent exciting activities.

APAC Linkedin [Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin ](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/)

Career [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://youtu.be/EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue [OpenBlue: This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://youtu.be/bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What you will do

HVAC Chiller Service Engineer - Troubleshooting

We are seeking an experienced HVAC Chiller Service Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing HVAC chiller systems, ensuring efficient operation and minimizing downtime. The role requires a strong technical background, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to maintenance and service.

What we look for:

  • ### Diagnose and troubleshoot issues with HVAC chiller systems, including compressors, evaporators, condensers, and associated components.
  • ### Perform routine maintenance and repairs on chillers to ensure optimal performance and longevity.
  • ### Identify and resolve mechanical and electrical faults, utilizing diagnostic tools and industry best practices.
  • ### Conduct inspections and testing of HVAC equipment to confirm system functionality and compliance with safety standards.
  • ### Provide on-site technical support to clients, including emergency repairs and troubleshooting.
  • ### Maintain accurate records of services performed, parts used, and recommendations for future maintenance.
  • ### Collaborate with other team members to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
  • ### Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and company policies.
  • ### Stay updated on new technologies and industry developments in HVAC systems

###

Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment.

###

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Role: Project Manager - HVAC IR (Industrial Refrigeration) Location: Chennai Department: Projects / Operations Experience: 10-15 Years

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager - HVAC IR to lead the execution and delivery of Industrial Refrigeration and HVAC projects. The incumbent will be responsible for end-to-end project management, including planning, execution, stakeholder management, cost control, resource allocation, quality assurance, and timely project completion while ensuring compliance with safety standards and customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage complete project lifecycle for Industrial Refrigeration (IR) and HVAC projects from kickoff to commissioning and handover.
  • Develop project execution plans, schedules, budgets, and resource deployment strategies.
  • Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders for seamless project execution.
  • Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation plans to achieve project milestones.
  • Ensure adherence to project budget, profitability targets, and contractual obligations.
  • Lead site execution teams and supervise installation, testing, commissioning, and system handover activities.
  • Manage procurement coordination, material planning, and vendor performance.
  • Ensure compliance with EHS standards, quality procedures, and statutory requirements.
  • Conduct regular project review meetings and provide progress reports to management and customers.
  • Handle change orders, claim management, billing, collections, and project documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
  • PMP/Prince2 certification will be an added advantage.
  • 10-15 years of experience in HVAC and Industrial Refrigeration project execution.
  • Strong understanding of refrigeration systems, chilled water systems, ammonia refrigeration, cold storage applications, and HVAC installations.
  • Experience in managing large industrial, manufacturing, food processing, pharmaceutical, cold chain, or warehouse projects.
  • Proficiency in project planning tools such as MS Project or Primavera.

Desired Skills

  • Project Management
  • HVAC & Industrial Refrigeration Systems
  • Budget & Cost Control
  • Contract Management
  • Risk Management
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Resource Planning
  • Vendor & Subcontractor Management
  • EHS Compliance
  • Team Leadership

Key Competencies

  • Excellent communication and customer management skills.
  • Strong leadership and people management capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Result-oriented approach with focus on quality, safety, and profitability.

Preferred Industry Experience

  • Industrial Refrigeration
  • Cold Storage & Warehousing
  • Food & Beverage Processing
  • Pharma & Life Sciences
  • Manufacturing Plants
  • Large Commercial & Industrial HVAC Projects

job.title: Compliance Data Analytics, Monitoring, and AI Co-ordinator
job.description:
What you will do

#

Johnson Controls (the "Company") is seeking an experienced data analytics, AI, and digital professional to serve as Coordinator, Compliance Data Analytics, Monitoring and AI. This role will support the execution and delivery of the Ethics and Compliance (E&C) function's data analytics, monitoring, AI, and digital strategy.

The primary objective of the role is to strengthen the Company's ability to prevent and detect compliance risks by turning data into insight. The role will help the E&C function identify emerging risks earlier, respond to them faster, and reduce the likelihood and severity of issues that could negatively impact the Company. Collectively, this role supports a more proactive, resilient, and data-driven compliance program.

This person will work closely with the compliance team and other stakeholders, and will report to the Associate Director, Integrity Helpline and Compliance Digital Projects and have a dotted line reporting to the Compliance Director, India.

What you will do

  • Supporting the development and operation of the Ethics and Compliance (E&C) data analytics and monitoring program, including identifying and collecting relevant data, developing customer and supplier transaction analytics, and developing automated anomaly detection to identify fraud, waste, and abuse
  • Developing analytics and tools that consolidate and analyze E&C data to identify emerging risks and provide insights and context to the E&C team and other stakeholders
  • Designing, building, deploying, maintaining, and continuously improving Copilot Studio AI agents that support employees with compliance topics, and inform and strengthen the E&C program
  • Developing and implementing agentic AI solutions to automate recurring E&C tasks and processes
  • Building and analyzing Power BI dashboards and reports to surface risk trends, insights, and program performance for the E&C team and business leaders
  • Maintaining the E&C program's key performance indicators and Bowler charts, and supporting the consolidation and automation of E&C reporting
  • Collaborating with E&C, IT, and other stakeholders to understand needs, obtain the data and tools required to deliver initiatives, and stay current with the latest technological developments

What we look for:

Candidates for this role must possess the following:

  • 10 years or more of related experience in data analytics and monitoring, AI/automation, and digital solution delivery, preferably in a multi-national corporation.
  • Proficiency with the Microsoft Power Platform (including Copilot Studio).
  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required.
  • Proficiency in data visualization, data governance and experience working with enterprise data sources (such as SAP, Oracle, or Snowflake) is preferred.
  • Knowledge or experience working with Ethics and Compliance is an advantage.

The candidate must also demonstrate the following personal qualities:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, translating business and compliance needs into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • The ability to lead and deliver solutions end-to-end, and to independently manage projects and initiatives from concept through delivery.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with the ability to work in a matrixed, multicultural, and international environment.

Johnson Controls is a global diversified technology and multi industrial leader, serving a wide range of customers in more than 150 countries. Among our core values we rank Integrity First, and our commitment to sustainability dates back to our roots in 1885 with the invention of the first electric room thermostat. We are committed to helping our customers win and creating greater value for all of our stakeholders through strategic focus on our buildings and energy growth platforms.

job.title: Senior Engineering Manager - Digital Solutions Development
job.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a modern, hands-on Engineering Manager who can lead high-performing software engineering teams in an increasingly AI-enabled development environment. This role extends beyond traditional people management and requires a strong blend of technical leadership, customer engagement, architectural guidance, and engineering execution.

The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise, remain closely connected to hands-on development, and leverage AI-assisted development practices to accelerate innovation, improve productivity, and deliver customer-centric solutions at speed.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical direction and architectural guidance for enterprise software products and platforms.
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to engineering best practices, security standards, and design principles.
  • Guide teams on application architecture, design patterns, and technology selection.
  • Troubleshoot and support resolution of complex technical issues when required.
  • Drive adoption of modern software engineering methodologies and AI-assisted development practices.

Engineering Delivery

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of software features and enhancements.
  • Accelerate product delivery through automation, developer productivity tools, and AI-enabled engineering workflows.
  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Engage directly with customers, business stakeholders, and product management teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Develop rapid prototypes and proof-of-concepts to validate ideas and demonstrate product capabilities.
  • Present technical solutions, product demonstrations, and roadmap updates to internal and external stakeholders

Team Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and develop engineering talent.
  • Establish a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration, and innovation.
  • Coach engineers on technical growth, modern development practices, and problem-solving approaches.
  • Support performance management, succession planning, and team development initiatives

AI-First Engineering Culture

  • Champion the adoption of AI-assisted software development tools and practices.
  • Identify opportunities to automate routine engineering tasks and improve delivery efficiency.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and incorporate them into engineering strategies where appropriate.

TECH STACK

Angular 17+ | .NET 8 / C# | Azure | SQL Server / PostgreSQL

REST / GraphQL APIs | GitHub Actions / CI-CD | AI Dev Tools | Docker / Kubernetes

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with progressive leadership responsibilities.
  • Proven experience leading software development teams in enterprise environments.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in modern web application development.
  • Experience managing full software development lifecycle activities
  • Strong expertise in Angular for front-end application development.
  • Strong understanding of modern web architecture and design patterns.
  • Experience conducting code reviews and mentoring development teams.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with cloud-native and scalable application architectures.
  • Experience with .NET / ASP.NET Core application development.
  • Experience building enterprise SaaS products and digital platforms.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and modern engineering productivity platforms.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and deployment pipelines.
  • Knowledge of containerization and cloud platforms (Azure preferred).

Desired Leadership Competencies

  • Technical credibility with engineering teams.
  • Customer-focused mindset.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with execution.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Innovation mindset with a passion for continuous learning.
  • Ability to drive change and adopt emerging technologies.

Additional Evaluation Criteria

Candidates demonstrating the following will be strongly preferred:

  • Active GitHub profile showcasing personal projects or technical contributions.
  • Open-source community participation.
  • Stack Overflow contributions or technical thought leadership.
  • Technical blogs, conference speaking engagements, or community involvement.
  • Evidence of continuous learning and experimentation with emerging AI technologies.

job.title: Service Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Service Engineer to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and support ELV and security systems, including Access Control Systems, Fire Alarm Systems (FAS), CCTV Surveillance Systems, Servers, and Building Management Systems (BMS). The candidate should have strong technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and the ability to provide timely support to clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Installation, commissioning, testing, and maintenance of Access Control, CCTV, FAS, and BMS systems.
  • Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network-related issues in security and automation systems.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance activities as per service schedules.
  • Configure and troubleshoot servers, workstations, and system software related to security platforms.
  • Monitor system performance and ensure maximum uptime for client installations.
  • Coordinate with customers to understand service requirements and provide timely resolutions.

Job Description

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. job.title: BMS Hardware Design - Datacenter
job.description:
Job Description

Application Engineer (Hardware Design) – Datacenter

What you will do

The primary responsibility of this role is to lead global Data Center Building Management System (BMS) engineering projects, ensuring compliance with project specifications, customer requirements, and account-specific standards. The role requires independent ownership and execution of projects throughout the entire lifecycle, while serving as the first point of escalation for technical and project-related issues. Ensure adherence to data center-specific engineering and project execution processes, maintain high quality standards through a "First Time Right" approach, and deliver projects on schedule to achieve operational excellence and maximize customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review MEP drawings to generate following drawings / documents for systems covered into Datacenter Project

Shop Drawings (ACAD drawings)

  • Detailed IO List contains all hardware points, software points and integration points if applicable, along with trend and alarm details as applicable
  • Creation of Bill of material, selection of sensors, control valves, dampers, air flow stations, controllers etc.
  • Generation of Panel GA
  • Generation of detailed Control devices and controller wiring, terminations, interlock wiring

Engineering Documents

Preparation of BMS Network diagram as per specifications and approved solution

Generation of detailed description of operation control based on specifications and design intent

Generation of various schedules like Valve, Flowmeter, Damper, panel, DDC etc.

Preparation of test scripts for panel factory witness tests

Generation of initial review sheets and RFI’s

  • Coordination with all stakeholders for clarification on RFI’s, tracking progress and with different vendors during finalization of BOQ
  • Ensure quality assurance and defect free hardware package delivery
  • Adherence with all processes and guidelines to execute project within timeline
  • During pre-bid stage support sales team for providing/validating controls solution for systems into Datacenter project.

What we look for

  • BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical/ Electronics / Electronics & Communication
  • Hands on experience with Hardware Engineering scope for Datacenter Vertical
  • Good Understanding of Data Centre mechanical / electrical systems with expertise for instrumentation and control, panel wiring, complex relay logic
  • Experience in detailed panel design – power calculation, selection of panel enclosure, terminal blocks, fuses, panel heaters, light etc.
  • Knowledge of HVAC systems from Datacenter vertical like Chilled Water System, Cooling Towers, Primary & Secondary pumping systems, Fluid Coolers, Heat Exchanger, CRAH, CRAC, CDU, Different types of AHUs, FCUs, VAV systems etc.
  • Strong knowledge of BMS architecture with different types of Operator workstations, Supervisory Controllers, DDC controllers, Sensors & Actuators etc.
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, LON, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols
  • Must be proficient in wiring of starters, field devices, safety interlocks & panels
  • Experience in engineering, installing and commissioning of HVAC & BMS systems for Datacenter projects or other infrastructure projects like pharmaceuticals, airports, commercial buildings, hospitals
  • Must be a quick learner & should have a keen eye for problem solving
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills

Preferred

4 to 8 years of relevant experience in Building Automation Industry Datacenter Vertical, BMS Design Engineering or Industrial Automation.

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. job.description:
Johnson Controls is a global diversified technology and multi-industrial leader serving a wide range of customers in more than 150 countries. Our 135,000 employees create intelligent buildings, efficient energy solutions, integrated infrastructure and next generation transportation systems that work seamlessly together to deliver on the promise of smart cities and communities. Our commitment to sustainability dates back to our roots in 1885, with the invention of the first electric room thermostat. We are committed to helping our customers win and creating greater value for all of our stakeholders through strategic focus on our buildings and energy growth platforms.

Being a Global company, you will work with some of the best people in the industry. This role will offer you autonomy and flexibility to make it your own and provide a pathway for a long-term career JCI career.

  • Global company with strong systems and support
  • Permanent full-time opportunity
  • Base + super + car allowance + incentive

About the role

This role will develop and manage the Service business in both recurring (Preventative Service Agreement) and non-recurring (Labour & Material) revenue streams to achieve a designated financial plan and develop profitable business with new and existing customers.

You will look after:

  • Service: Lead, drive and cascade service objectives to our customers and team members in line with our values, approach and required methodologies. PSA and L&M contractual objectives & operational excellence is to be delivered at all times, with ownership and accountability for the service teams operational excellence outcomes.
  • Customers: Service existing and potential customers to ensure that the company’s products and services outcomes continue to meet the customer & business requirements, whilst gathering information regarding future opportunities. Proactively implement processes to ensure client relationships are maintained, managed and developed. Act professionally at all times and take complete ownership of client relationships, engagement and satisfaction.
  • Growth: Support the management team with the formulation and execution of Service growth strategies.
  • Mentoring/Guidance: Mentor, influence and co-ordinate the service team, including but not limited to sales, technicians, team leaders, coordinators and admin resources to ensure alignment and delivery of service to ensure growth and profitability.
  • Account Management: Implement, maintain and develop account management strategies, to target specific industries and markets, based on current and future business requirements. Review, negotiate and support business contract management activities.

About you

  • Preferred to have a strong knowledge of BAS/BMS with Engineering or Technical qualification
  • Performs all business activities with integrity and the highest ethical standards
  • Experience in developing successful relationships with customers and delivering results
  • Outstanding written, verbal communication and soft skills
  • Excellent networking skills, business minded, change orientated and is proactive
  • Has a strong established network in the local market
  • Focuses on customers, consultative approach and solution focused
