job.title: HVAC Technician
job.description:
Join a Global Leader in Building Technologies, Sustainability & Advanced HVAC Solutions

At Johnson Controls, we're transforming how the world's buildings perform. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers optimize energy use, reduce carbon emissions, and maintain mission-critical environments across industries including data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, education, and commercial infrastructure.

With more than 140 years of innovation and expertise, Johnson Controls combines world-class technology, industry-leading service capabilities, and a highly skilled field team to deliver solutions that matter. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, helping customers achieve better performance while building rewarding careers.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced HVAC Service Technician to join our Brisbane team in Windsor.

In this role, you'll work across a diverse portfolio of commercial and industrial sites, servicing and maintaining a broad range of HVAC equipment and systems. Whether you're a seasoned technician looking for your next challenge or someone eager to expand into chillers, BMS, and advanced building technologies, we'll provide the training, support, and opportunities to help you succeed.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a respected industry leader offering long-term career stability, ongoing technical development, and genuine pathways for advancement.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

Work With Industry-Leading Technology

  • Service and maintain commercial HVAC systems across multiple industries
  • Gain exposure to advanced technologies, including chillers, controls, and Building Management Systems (BMS)
  • Learn from one of the most experienced technical teams in the industry

YORK OEM Advantage

As a YORK OEM, we provide exclusive access to in-house chiller training and manufacturer-supported technical development programs. This gives you the opportunity to build specialised expertise and accelerate your career in advanced HVAC systems.

Career Development Without Limits

  • Structured training and development programs
  • Ongoing manufacturer and technical certifications
  • Career progression opportunities across Australia and internationally
  • Access to specialist technical support and remote experts

A Culture That Supports You

  • Flexible work arrangements because work-life balance matters
  • RDO or overtime options to suit your lifestyle and financial goals
  • Strong team culture and supportive leadership
  • Global organisation with local team values

What You'll Be Doing

  • Service, maintain, troubleshoot and repair commercial HVAC systems
  • Diagnose faults and provide effective solutions for customers
  • Perform scheduled preventative and reactive maintenance
  • Install, commission and optimise HVAC equipment and components
  • Complete service documentation and maintain accurate records
  • Collaborate with customers and internal teams to deliver exceptional outcomes
  • Ensure all work is completed safely and in accordance with industry and regulatory requirements

What You'll Bring

  • Certificate III in Air Conditioning and Refrigeration (or equivalent)
  • Queensland Restricted Electrical Licence (minimum requirement)
  • Previous experience in HVAC service, maintenance or repairs
  • Strong fault-finding and diagnostic skills
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Current driver's licence
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and professional workmanship
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

What's In It For You?

  • Competitive salary package + benefits
  • Ongoing technical training and career development
  • Exposure to industry-leading HVAC technologies
  • YORK OEM training and specialist chiller pathways
  • Flexible work arrangements and work-life balance
  • Supportive team environment
  • Long-term career opportunities with a global leader

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls is a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. Through our extensive service network, we deliver innovative HVAC, controls, fire, security, and energy solutions that improve building performance and create more sustainable communities.

Our Brisbane team plays a critical role in supporting customers across Queensland, delivering technical excellence, trusted expertise, and exceptional service every day.

Compliance Requirements

  • Full Australian working rights are required
  • Pre-employment medical assessment, criminal history check, and drug & alcohol screening will be conducted

Ready for Your Next Career Move?

If you're looking for a role that offers technical challenge, career growth, flexibility, and the backing of a global industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and take your HVAC career further with Johnson Controls.

For a confidential discussion, contact Janis Sotelo at [janis.sotelo@jci.com](mailto:janis.sotelo@jci.com)

#LI-JS4

job.title: Business Development Manager - HVAC Projects
job.description:
As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

About the Company:

Johnson Controls is the global leader for smart, healthy and sustainable buildings. At Johnson Controls, we’ve been making buildings smarter since 1885, and our capabilities, depth of innovation experience, and global reach have been growing ever since.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Business Development Manager to drive growth for our HVAC Retrofit (projects) business. This is a strategic sales role will focus on delivering secured sales through HVAC project solutions in the built environment.

This position is based in Sydney.

You’ll have autonomy, flexibility, and the chance to work with some of the best minds in the industry. If you’re a self-starter with a passion for solution selling and building strong networks, this is your opportunity to make an impact.

What You’ll Do:

  • Leverage your local industry knowledge to develop a pipeline of project opportunities focused on Mechanical plant upgrades.
  • Use your industry knowledge and technical acumen to develop solutions to support our customers with meeting their ambitions for their plant, tenants and stakeholders.
  • Industry networking to promote visibility of JCI in the market.
  • Driving growth via new recurring service and project opportunities by identifying, qualifying, selling and closing (end-to-end sales cycle).
  • Work in partnership with local teams for successful development of proposals and estimates.
  • Establish and build trusted client relationships in order to identify, define and develop asset modernisation programs.
  • Preparing and delivering client presentations.
  • Negotiation and agreement on contract terms and conditions.
  • Close deals and initiate handover to service delivery teams
  • Develops short and long range sales plans and prepares sales strategies and submissions to reach nominated targets for the Service Business.
  • Calling on target organisations to identify profitable sales opportunities.
  • Managing the preparation and submission of sales proposals in line with Johnson Controls corporate policies and processes.
  • Influences tender requests to include Johnson Controls specified Products and Systems/Solutions.
  • Delivers assigned business plans achieving secured sales volume ($) and gross margin ($) vs Plan.
  • Provides information to management regarding the industry and recommends plans to maximise future business in line with the Service growth strategy.
  • Represents Johnson Controls in the marketplace by observing the highest standards of professionalism, integrity and demeanor.

​

Why Johnson Controls?

Being a Global company, you will work with some of the best people in the industry. This role will offer you autonomy and flexibility to make it your own and provide a pathway for a long-term career JCI career.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Someone with exceptional customer facing & technical skills to transition into business development or an experienced technical salesperson with a hunting mindset.
  • Proven ability to identify customer needs and priorities.
  • 5+ years’ experience in the HVAC industry –Preferably project delivery or operations experience.
  • Demonstrate financial and business acumen with strong skills in customer relationship management.
  • Strong pipeline management (experience in using Salesforce ideal)
  • Proven track record in delivering strong results with full accountability.
  • Excellent communication & interpersonal skills, both internally and dealing with customers and stakeholders
  • Excellent networking skills, business minded, change orientated and pro-active.
  • Strong established network in the local market

​

Ready to Apply?

Click APPLY NOW to submit your application in confidence.

JCI’s Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate.  Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: EHS Officer (part time - 3 days per week)
job.description:
Help Build a Safer, More Sustainable Future with Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

Joining JCI means becoming part of a global organisation where you'll collaborate with some of the industry's most experienced professionals. We offer a supportive and inclusive culture, opportunities for professional development, and the flexibility to make a genuine impact while shaping your own career journey.

This role is ideal for an experienced EHS professional seeking flexibility, autonomy, and the opportunity to influence safety, quality, and environmental performance across a diverse New Zealand business.

About the Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced EHS Officer to join our Auckland-based team on a part-time basis (3 days per week).

Reporting into the Pacific EHSQ team, you will play a key role in supporting our New Zealand operations, driving compliance, continuous improvement, and fostering a strong safety culture. This position offers exposure to a variety of business functions and projects, creating excellent opportunities for professional growth within a global organisation.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Develop, implement, and maintain JCI's Integrated Business Management Systems (EHSQ).
  • Ensure compliance with company systems through regular audits and assessments.
  • Conduct and coordinate site audits, inspections, and compliance reviews.
  • Support EHSQ reporting and performance metrics across the Pacific region.
  • Manage non-conformance reports (NCRs) and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead quality assurance activities and monitor performance against established procedures.
  • Deliver EHSQ and compliance training to employees and stakeholders.
  • Assist with incident investigations and the implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant health, safety, environmental, and quality legislation.
  • Conduct risk assessments and develop safe work method statements.
  • Coordinate Health & Safety Committee activities and communicate outcomes to key stakeholders.
  • Provide expert advice on health, safety, environmental, welfare, and quality matters.
  • Manage Return to Work processes and injury management activities.
  • Champion best practices and drive a proactive culture aligned to our commitment to Zero Harm.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • Qualification in Quality Assurance or a related discipline (preferred).
  • Minimum Certificate IV in Workplace Health and Safety or equivalent.
  • Lead Auditor qualifications in ISO 9001, ISO 45001, and ISO 14001.
  • 3-5 years' experience within a heavy manufacturing, industrial, or similar environment.
  • Incident investigation training or qualification (preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of workplace health and safety legislation and quality management systems.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and SharePoint.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and influencing skills.
  • A proactive approach and passion for creating safe, high-performing workplaces.

Compliance Requirements

  • Full New Zealand working rights.
  • Ability to successfully complete a pre-employment medical assessment, criminal history check, and drug and alcohol screening.

Ready for Your Next Career Move?

If you're looking for a role that offers meaningful work, flexibility, professional growth, and the opportunity to make a lasting impact within a global industry leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Click Apply to submit your application.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Janis Sotelo at [janis.sotelo@jci.com](mailto:janis.sotelo@jci.com).

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, diversity and inclusion are fundamental to who we are. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, strengthen collaboration, and create better outcomes for our customers and communities.

We are committed to creating an environment where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic self to work. Together, we foster a culture where everyone has the opportunity to grow, contribute, and succeed.

job.title: Mining Technical Training Consultant
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Your Work Shapes the World

At Caterpillar, the work we do matters. For more than 100 years, we've delivered products and solutions that support mining, construction, and infrastructure worldwide. Our teams combine engineering expertise, manufacturing excellence, and disciplined execution to deliver equipment that performs in the toughest conditions.

We are seeking an experienced Training Consultant to join Resource Industries, responsible for designing, developing and delivering MineStar service training programs for Caterpillar dealers and mining customers. Based in Perth or Brisbane, this role is ideal for someone with strong practical experience installing, commissioning, integrating, maintaining and troubleshooting MineStar, or similar mining technology systems.

You will play a key role in building the capability of dealer technicians and customer support personnel, ensuring they have the skills and knowledge required to safely support and maintain MineStar solutions in operational mining environments.

Whether you're an experienced trainer or a technical specialist looking to move into a training-focused role, your field experience, technical expertise and ability to translate complex concepts into practical learning outcomes will be critical to your success.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver technical training programs covering MineStar products, systems and service procedures.
  • Provide instruction on the installation, commissioning, configuration and maintenance of MineStar technologies.
  • Deliver practical, hands-on training focused on machine integration, onboard hardware, communications networks and system troubleshooting.
  • Support dealer and customer technicians in developing diagnostic and fault-finding capability.
  • Develop and continuously improve training materials to align with product updates and industry best practice.
  • Partner with product support, engineering, dealers and customers to identify capability gaps and training requirements.
  • Provide coaching and technical mentorship to service personnel across Caterpillar's dealer network.
  • Promote safe work practices and Caterpillar service excellence standards

What You Will Bring

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience installing, commissioning, troubleshooting and supporting MineStar systems in mining environments.
  • Strong understanding of onboard mining technology, machine electronics, communications systems and system integration.
  • Experience working directly on mobile mining equipment and supporting mining technology deployments in operational environments.
  • Well-developed diagnostic and fault-finding skills across hardware, software and communications systems.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to technicians and service personnel.
  • Willingness to travel to support dealer and customer training requirements.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience with MineStar Fleet, Terrain, Health or Command products.
  • Caterpillar dealer or OEM field service experience.
  • Experience delivering technical training, mentoring or coaching technicians.
  • Trade, technical or engineering qualifications relevant to mining technology, electrical systems, communications or mobile equipment.
  • Background in mining, heavy mobile equipment, oil & gas, or other heavy industrial environments.

What Will Set You Apart

The successful candidate will bring practical field experience and a strong understanding of how MineStar systems are installed, integrated, commissioned and supported on mining equipment.

While experience using MineStar as an operator, planner, dispatcher or system administrator is valuable, this role is best suited to candidates who have directly supported the deployment, maintenance and troubleshooting of MineStar technologies on machines.

Additional Information

  • Site-based in Perth orBrisbane (5 days per week)
  • Also you will be required to travel for 30 to 60% of the time
  • Visa sponsorship is not available

Employee Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration, including bonus and share options
  • Generous parental leave with flexible payment options
  • Strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity
  • Employee discounts across health, wellbeing, travel, and retail
  • Global career progression and development opportunities within Caterpillar

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role with a global industry leader, apply via:

www.caterpillar.com/careers

Your road to success begins with Caterpillar.

Join a global leader and build a career with real impact.

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Caterpillar of Australia is not currently hiring applicants who require sponsorship. As a global company, opportunities may be available in other locations via our careers website.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Senior Desktop Support Engineer
job.description:
Position Objective

The Group (GRP) Senior Field Support Engineer is responsible for providing technical assistance and support to Goodman Group employees at the Goodman Headquarters (Hayesbery) office. You will provide white-glove support to the Group Board and Executive team and ensure seamless experiences in their use of Goodman technology and devices. You will support their use of collaborative technology including audio-visual technology to ensure successful business events and meetings. You will play a crucial role in maintaining the stability and efficiency of our desktop infrastructure, ensuring that all Group system users have access to the necessary tools and resources to perform their job functions effectively.

This role demands a proactive, service-oriented professional who thrives in high-pressure environments and understands the nuances of executive-level support.

Key Responsibilities

Executive Support

  • Deliver high-touch, discreet, and responsive IT support to Goodman Board and Executive teams and their immediate teams.
  • Manage and maintain executive devices (laptops, mobile phones, tablets), ensuring optimal performance and security.
  • Provide on-site and remote support for meetings, presentations, and travel-related tech needs.
  • Anticipate and resolve issues before they impact executive productivity.

Event Technology Enablement

  • Lead the technical setup and support for internal and external business events, including town halls, board meetings, and hybrid conferences.
  • Coordinate AV, video conferencing, and collaboration tools (including Goodman Teams and others like Zoom, Webex) to ensure flawless execution.
  • Liaise with internal teams, vendors and office management teams to ensure venue readiness and technology compatibility.
  • Support and maintain meeting room audio-visual technology including collaboration with 3rd party vendors to resolve ongoing issues.

Operational Excellence

  • Resolve complex technical issues related to desktop operating systems (Windows and macOS), applications, and network connectivity.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of support activities, configurations, and incident resolutions.
  • Collaborate with IT teams to ensure alignment with broader infrastructure and security policies.
  • Monitor and report on support metrics, identifying areas for improvement.
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in desktop support to provide innovative solutions and improve existing processes.
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and access rights across various systems, ensuring data security and compliance with company policies.
  • Participate in IT projects, such as system upgrades, migrations, and deployments, ensuring successful implementation and minimal disruption to end-users

Flexibility, Availability and Facilities

  • Provide early morning and after-hours support as required, including occasional weekends and travel.
  • Be available for rapid response to urgent executive needs, including remote troubleshooting and support.
  • Maintain tidiness of the IT Services Tech Hub and IT build room ensuring safety and cleanliness at all times.

Knowledge, Experience and Skill Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).

Proficient in troubleshooting and resolving complex technical issues related to desktop systems, applications, and network connectivity.

Specific areas of knowledge: Compliance & Technical Knowledge

Subject Matter

Essential/

Desirable

Experience supporting board-level executives with excellent communication, professional, discretion, and customer service skills.

Essential

Strong customer service orientation with a focus on providing exceptional support and building positive relationships with end-users.

Essential

Proven experience working as a Field or Desktop Support Engineer or in a similar technical support role, with a focus on providing second and third-level support.

Essential

Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 Tools and Teams; experience working with Zoom, and other collaboration tools.

Essential

Strong knowledge of contemporary Desktop operating systems (Windows, macOS), hardware, and software applications.

Essential

Experience with service management, desktop management and remote support tools (e.g., CA Service Desk, ServiceNow, SCCM, JAMF, TeamViewer).

Essential

Experience with Active Directory, and user account management in a Windows domain environment.

Essential

Proven ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and manage multiple assignments simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Essential

Industry certifications such as CompTIA A+, Microsoft Certified Desktop Support Technician (MCDST), or ITIL Foundation are advantageous.

Desirable

Experience

10+ years experience in desktop support roles across large organisations

Essential

Experience dealing with senior internal and external stakeholders

Essential

Skills/Characteristics

Ability to influence senior stakeholders and build strong relationships.

Essential

Strong and professional communication skills.

Essential

Willingness to adapt to changing schedules and event demands.

Essential

Calm under pressure with a proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

Essential

Self-starter/highly motivated, can work autonomously.

Essential

Strong attention to detail and commitment to excellence.

Essential

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

job.title: Solutions Architect Manager, AI & Growth - ASEAN, ASEAN APO PSA Team
job.description:
Are you passionate about helping AI-driven consulting partners to scale across ASEAN using the cloud and AI services? We are looking for an experienced and technically strong people manager to lead our Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) teams within the ASEAN Partner Organization. This role owns the technical strategy, team development, and partner engagement for:

  • AI Partner PSAs: A team of Partner Solutions Architects who support AI/ML Consulting Partners to co-build solutions on AWS, co-sell through AWS Marketplace, and scale globally across AWS Regions. These partners are building next-generation AI applications leveraging Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, and other AWS AI/ML services.
  • Growth Partner PSAs: A team of Partner Solutions Architects supporting AWS Growth Partners, driving technical enablement, solution design, and scale motions through the channel partners to accelerate Cloud and AI adoption across ASEAN markets.

This is a highly visible, dual-charter leadership role that requires to cover ASEAN countries (Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Philippines) to engage directly with partners, lead executive briefings, and represent AWS at area and country events.

Key job responsibilities Technical Strategy, Migration & Modernization & AI Enablement

  • Set the technical vision, Migration & Modernization and AI acceleration strategy across teams, identifying common enablement needs and opportunities for shared tooling, mechanisms, agentic tools and AI/ML reference architectures.
  • Stay current on AWS AI/ML services (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Quick, Kiro etc.) and industry trends to inform partner technical guidance and co-build motions.
  • Build mechanisms to measure and improve partner technical outcomes including Migration & Modernization, AI competency and Managed Services certifications, validated AI solution designs, Marketplace listings, and customer wins.
  • Drive partner enablement programs for both AI Partners and Growth Partners, ensuring partners can effectively leverage generative AI, agentic tools, foundation models, and ML services in their solutions.
  • Establish technical bar-raising mechanisms to ensure partners deliver production-quality AI/ML solutions to end customers.

Stakeholder & Partner Engagement

  • Serve as a senior technical voice to AI Partner and Growth Partner executives, building trusted advisor relationships at the CTO/VP Engineering level.
  • Represent partner technical needs internally, influencing AWS AI service teams, partner programs, and product roadmaps to better serve the ASEAN partner ecosystem.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Partner Development Managers (PDMs), Sales, Marketing, Training, and Professional Services to drive holistic partner success across the AI and distribution segments.
  • Present at partner events, executive briefings, AWS Summits, and industry forums across ASEAN to elevate AWS partner technical thought leadership in AI.
  • Cultivate relationships with AI Partner founders and Growth Partner technical leadership to drive co-innovation and joint go-to-market motions.

People Management and Operational Excellence

  • Define and track team goals and performance metrics aligned to ASEAN Partner organizational priorities and business outcomes.
  • Recruit, hire, and retain top technical talent across ASEAN; build a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team culture that spans multiple countries and cultures.
  • Establish scalable operating rhythms, reporting mechanisms, and continuous improvement practices across both team charters.
  • Manage resource allocation, capacity planning, and prioritization across AI Partner and Growth Partner engagement models.

About the team The Partner Solutions Architecture (PSA) organization is the technical backbone of the AWS Partner community. PSAs work hands-on with AWS Partners to raise their technical bar, help them build differentiated solutions, and ensure customers receive world-class outcomes through the partner channel. The ASEAN Cloud and AI Acceleration team is at the forefront of driving AI adoption across Southeast Asia’s diverse and rapidly growing markets. This role offers a unique leadership opportunity: you will shape how AWS engages technically with both the fast-moving Partner segment (startups and ISVs building AI-first solutions) and the high-scale Growth Partner channel (distributors enabling downstream resellers). By leading across these two domains, you will develop cross-pollination strategies, identify common AI enablement patterns, and build mechanisms that amplify partner impact at scale. You will work closely with Partner Development Managers, AWS service teams, and regional leadership to ensure ASEAN partners are equipped to deliver AI solutions to customers.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of enterprise IT application work that includes at least 2 years of hands-on software development or DevOps engineering experience
  • 2+ years of architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc. experience
  • 8+ years of technology solutions development and evangelising end-to-end technology roadmaps that guide IT transformations toward cloud computing experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience leading and growing teams of senior technology professionals, ideally in customer facing roles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
  • Knowledge of cloud technology partner ecosystem and related products
  • Experience in a technical role within a sales organization

job.title: Sr Staff Agentic AI Engineer - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

Build the Surfaces Where Humans Command the Agents

Equinix Incubation builds the agentic systems that run the software delivery lifecycle end to end: AI agents, with humans directing the work and owning every gate. Agents without great human surfaces are just noise. This role builds the surfaces.

You will own the consoles and dashboards through which product managers approve, engineers review, security screens, and executives see value: decision inboxes, review queues, gate approvals, and live value boards. It is full-stack work where the front end is the product and the stakes are trust.

Responsibilities

Build the Consoles

  • Design and build persona consoles: decision inboxes, review surfaces, approval queues, and commitment views, one clear surface per role
  • Make agent work legible: what an agent did, why, with what confidence, and what needs a human, rendered so a busy owner decides in seconds
  • Sweat the interaction details with UX; approval fatigue is the failure mode, and design is the defense

Build the Value and Telemetry Layer

  • Build the dashboards that report cycle time, throughput, quality, adoption, agent health, and cost, live from the pipeline
  • Turn telemetry into narrative: executive value boards that show committed versus realized without manual curation
  • Instrument everything; the platform's credibility rests on numbers nobody has to assemble by hand

Engineer the Full Stack

  • Build the backend-for-frontend layer, APIs, and event consumers that connect consoles to the orchestrator and enterprise systems such as Jira
  • Implement enterprise-grade authentication and authorization (SSO, OAuth) and respect data boundaries by design
  • Ship on the approved enterprise React stack with CI/CD, automated testing, and observability as defaults

Raise the Bar

  • Use agents in your own workflow and feed friction back into the platform; you are user zero
  • Set frontend and BFF patterns others reuse: components, state, accessibility, performance
  • Bring craft: the fundamentals still decide whether this works

What Success Looks Like

  • Approvers clear their queues in minutes and trust what they see; nobody asks for a spreadsheet export as a workaround
  • Executives quote your value board in their own decks
  • Console patterns you built become the default for every new agent the fleet adds
  • The stack stays fast, tested, and observable as surfaces multiply

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 6-10 years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of large-scale production systems.
  • Significant hands-on experience designing and deploying LLM-powered applications, AI agents, or intelligent automation platforms.
  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks, testing strategies, and governance models for AI-enabled systems.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python or Java or TypeScript.
  • Strong background in distributed systems, APIs, platform engineering, cloud-native architectures, and event-driven systems.
  • Experience leading technical initiatives across teams.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI systems to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to influence architecture, standards, and engineering direction.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep experience with agent frameworks and technologies such as MCP, A2A, LangGraph, OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, or Vertex AI.
  • Experience building developer platforms, internal engineering products, or enterprise orchestration systems.
  • Experience with RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, knowledge graphs, and enterprise search.
  • Experience leading AI governance, privacy reviews, security reviews, and responsible AI initiatives.
  • Strong record of technical leadership through open-source contributions, patents, technical publications, or industry speaking engagements.

Why This Role

Incubation is a durable capability, not a project team: the team persists, and the product rotates. Agentic delivery is product one; the next incubation bets follow. Every agent the platform adds makes the human surfaces more important, not less. You will define how a global organization sees, steers, and trusts its AI workforce.

Job Description

Job Description

The Service Desk Analyst provides support for basic incident resolution and requests reported by APAC Schneider Employees. Responsibilities include initial assessment, research, and resolution of basic incidents and requests regarding use of applications, software and infrastructure components. The Service Desk Analyst would be responsible for collecting information through a customer conversation, probing, accessing support tools, and additional support teams if needed. Problems beyond the scope of their ability or responsibility are resolved by engaging other support teams in a timely manner.

Responsibilities:

1) Addresses and resolves basic incidents and requests; logs all incidents and requests; engages

other service desks or appropriate support teams to resolve incidents that are beyond the scope of

their ability or responsibility.

2) Uses the appropriate CTI categories for logging incidents and requests.

3) Creates a positive customer support experience and builds strong relationships through deep

problem understanding, ensuring timely resolution or escalation, communicating promptly on

progress, and handling customers with a professional attitude.

4) Ensures the end-to-end customer experience and acts as a single point-of-contact for the

job.title: Senior Specialist Construction
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Specialist – Civil Construction Project is responsible for leading and managing the civil engineering scope for large scale, mission critical data centre projects. The role combines deep technical expertise in civil engineering with strong project management capabilities to ensure high quality, cost effective, and timely delivery of civil works. This position requires close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams, strict adherence to safety and quality standards, and effective oversight across the full project life cycle from design and permitting through construction and commissioning.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead civil engineering activities for data centre construction projects from concept to commissioning.
  • Review and validate civil design drawings, specifications, and engineering calculations.
  • Oversee site execution of civil works: excavation, grading, foundations, base build, fit‑out works, external infrastructure, and civil finishes.
  • Ensure civil works adhere to project quality, safety, and compliance standards.
  • Collaborate closely with structural, architectural, MEP teams, and contractors to ensure integrated project delivery.
  • Monitor onsite progress and implement corrective actions to maintain schedule and quality.
  • Support project managers in delivering civil scope on time and within budget.
  • Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:
  • Strong understanding of civil engineering principles, construction materials, and data centre infrastructure requirements.
  • Knowledge of site development, foundations, utilities, drainage, and civil finishes.
  • Familiarity with mission‑critical construction standards and multidisciplinary coordination (Structural, MEP, Architecture).
  • Ability to interpret drawings, specifications, and technical documents accurately.
  • Strong project management skills including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and risk management.
  • Proficiency with project tools such as Primavera P6, MS Project, Excel, and SharePoint.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem‑solving skills.
  • High focus on quality, safety, documentation accuracy, and timely delivery in fast‑paced environments.
  • Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (mandatory).
  • Required Experience:
  • 8–12 years of civil engineering experience.
  • 3–5 years in data centre or mission‑critical construction.
  • Experience in large-scale infrastructure or industrial projects.
  • Strong civil site execution experience (foundations, grading, utilities, external works).
  • Experience working with multidisciplinary teams (Structural, MEP, Architecture).

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

NTT Global Data Centers is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

job.title: Client Delivery Manager
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

As a Client Delivery Manager, you support the company's objectives by ensuring corporate interests are safeguarded before the customer contract is signed (feasibility and implementation options) as well as organizing the implementation after the contractual agreement with the customer has been concluded. The implementation specifically relates to the contractually owed services, typically for qualified customer solutions that cannot be fulfilled through a standardized delivery process but require project coordination over various delivery units for planning (pre-sales phase) and during the actual delivery. Client Delivery Management is responsible for the planning, execution, acceptance, and follow-up of qualified, non-standardized delivery projects.

What we are looking for

Main tasks:

  • Coordination of contractual requirements and the services and deliveries to be provided with customer management and the departments
  • Planning and implementation of customer projects involving all necessary stakeholders and coordination of interfaces
  • Monitoring deadlines, milestones, dependencies, and risks- General project reporting and timely escalation to management
  • Tracking of risks and development of measures for risk mitigation
  • Planning and conducting cross-disciplinary coordination, quality gates workshops, and supporting project participants to achieve project goals- Assistance in project planning (definition and coordination of project goals, resource/time/effort budgeting, planning of work packages)
  • Definition of project workflow and project process organizations, planning and conducting the project kickoff with the involved departments
  • Operational support in (sub-)projects by performing PM tasks (e.g. moderation of workshops)
  • Continuous development of project methodology within the team and optimization of processes and tools for comprehensive project management

Requirements

Professional skills

  • University degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in business administration, engineering, computer science, or comparable professional experience
  • Demonstrated experience in successful delivery of managed services to clients, meeting service level agreements (SLAs) and quality standards, with contractual agreements and compliance requirements as well as monitoring contract performance
  • Knowledge of power supply and cooling of data centers, Cx ing, Fit-Out, Security, Connectivity infrastructure, as well as product knowledge (racks, networking, data center and IT-related services, etc.)
  • Experience and certification in common project management methods such as Prince2, Scrum are desirable
  • At least 2-5 years of relevant professional experience and proven successes in project management in (national and international) data center environments
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Willingness to travel
  • Negotiation-level proficiency in English, both written and spoken
  • Ensure discretion and professional handling of highly sensitive customer information.
  • Very good knowledge of handling IT devices and software systems, including very good knowledge of MS Office
  • Entrepreneurial thinking and action
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills.

Soft skills

  • Customer Centric Mentality
  • High competence in dealing with internal and external stakeholders
  • Reliability, sense of responsibility, and team spirit
  • Strong customer and results orientation, a self-structured working style, ability to delegate, and communicate at all matrix levels
  • A high degree of independence and initiative

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

Vertiv is seeking an Application Developer to support the development and maintenance of Vertiv’s enterprise Shopify eCommerce platform within the Digital organization. Technical Skills

  • Familiarity with the Shopify platform, including Liquid templating, Storefront API, and Admin API.

  • Basic understanding of REST and GraphQL; familiarity with Postman or equivalent API testing tools.
  • Exposure to version control systems (GitLab) and CI/CD pipeline concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to Rust or willingness to learn Rust for WASM-based Shopify Functions.

  • Experience with ServiceNow for incident tracking.

Job Description

Job Description

Brief Job Description:

Responsible for providing on-site and remote technical support, maintenance, and troubleshooting for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, PDU (Power Distribution Units), STS (Static transfer Switches), AHF(Active Harmonic filters) and other similar Power electronics products. The role requires extensive knowledge of UPS systems, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work independently or as part of a team to ensure the reliability and performance of power systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Support:

Provide on-site and remote support for installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of UPS systems.

Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network-related issues affecting UPS performance.

job.title: Assistant Engineer - Field Service
job.description:
Job Description

Assistant Engineer - Field Service

Bengaluru, India

Job Description

UPS System Maintenance Engineer:

A UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) engineer installs, maintains, and repairs UPS systems to ensure continuous power for critical equipment. This role often involves troubleshooting technical issues, performing preventative maintenance, and providing customer support. They also conduct site surveys, design systems, and manage project timelines.

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

  • Installation and Commissioning:

Installing and setting up new UPS systems, including associated equipment like transfer switches and power distribution units.

  • Onsite Maintenance and Repair:

Performing routine maintenance, diagnosing and repairing faults, and replacing components like capacitors & batteries.

Configure, and maintain UPS systems in accordance with manufacturer specifications and industry best practices.

Conduct routine maintenance for AC / DC Power Systems Hardware and testing of UPS systems to ensure optimal performance and reliability.

Performing routine maintenance of Li-ion / Nicad / Sealed Lead Battery Maintenance.

Drafting of service reports following Breakdown / maintenance visits.

  • Onsite Troubleshooting:

Identifying and resolving technical issues with UPS systems, often using diagnostic tools and software.

Maintain accurate records of work performed and parts used in accordance with company policies and procedures.

Remote support / corrective attendance on short notice to priority sites during critical system failures / doomsday scenarios.

Development of upgrade plans to suit client needs. System modifications / upgrades.

  • Customer Support:

Providing technical support to clients, answering questions, and training them on the proper use of UPS systems.

Work with clients to identify their power requirements and recommend appropriate UPS solutions.

  • Documentation:

This role also has a customer facing element to it, so good email communications and literacy/report writing skills are a must.

Maintaining accurate records of maintenance, repairs, and site visits.

Able to read and provide Single Line Diagram.

  • Safety:

Adhering to safety regulations and procedures when working with electrical equipment.

  • Project Management:

Managing project timelines and ensuring successful completion of installation and maintenance tasks.

Collaborate with other team members and subcontractors to complete projects on time and within budget.

  • Site Assessments:

Evaluating customer sites to determine the appropriate UPS system requirements.

Qualifications

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

  • Qualification in diploma / degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering with at 3-4 years’ experience in UPS services & Computer related discipline

Additional / Preferred Qualifications:

  • Expert Knowledge in UPS systems in a data center or similar environment
  • Experience in 3 phases UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supplies)
  • A strong understanding of electrical and electronic systems, including power distribution, automatic Transfer Switch, PDU, SKRU and related components
  • Strong, demonstrable troubleshooting/fault-diagnostics skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for interacting with clients and team members
  • A commitment to providing excellent customer service and support
  • Familiarity with Energy Management / Automation Systems
  • Knowledge and understanding in reading Electrical One Line Schematics
  • Be efficiently organized and able to prioritize multiple tasks

job.title: Sr. Engineer BIM
job.description:
Job Description

Vertiv Global Engineering Centre, Pune is looking for dynamic and experienced BIM MEPF Lead with well-versed in basic coordination with all trades to work closely in with BIM Manager.

BIM - Senior Engineer is responsible for coordinating the BIM efforts of all project teams at Vertiv. This includes ensuring that all members of the team are following BEP, Vertiv standards and process, adhering to the model standards set with right software, exchanging of data regularly.

In addition to these duties the Senior engineer-BIM is also responsible for training new members on BIM process, Maintaining BIM models throughout project life cycle and developing BIM tools and templates on Revit. Family/Content Creation using the Revit tool for the Data Centers and other Vertiv Products. He/ she will be responsible for delivering quality deliverables as per the organization’s standards. Work closely with different LoB’s and stakeholders to meet deadlines. He should ensure all team related timesheet, quality plan, project updates on time.

Job Specifications:

  • Must have full time bachelor’s degree in engineering (mechanical or electrical preferred)
  • Must have 6-8 years of experience in BIM modeling using Revit.
  • Proficient in implementing BIM requirements (creating families, floor plans, 3D modelling, MEP services, clash detection, schedules, BOQ, coordination) associated with large projects.
  • Design & domain knowledge of MEP engineering systems for data centers (preferred).
  • Strong understanding of BIM principles and practices.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, Autodesk Revit in MEP, Navisworks and other BIM related tools
  • Proficiency in Dynamo Scripting & APIs to create custom tools and workflows that address specific project needs is required.
  • Creation of Parametric and non-parametric families
  • Develop plans, sections, elevations, and details from a 3D BIM model for projects of all sizes and technical complexities.
  • Setup and manage large sheets set including revisions and markups for each project. Plot drawings to pdf & dwg.
  • Knowledge of COBie implementation and 4D to 7D deliverable at LOD 350.
  • Supervise and contribute to create Revit content/families (Parametric) and oversee maintenance of family libraries according to relevant projects and Vertiv Products.
  • Review, estimate and give inputs into delivery schedules and level of efforts required to produce deliverables.
  • Collaborate with BIM managers and project managers to ensure BIM deliverables align with project timelines and objectives.
  • Create and maintain all BIM documentation not limited to BEP, MOM, LOD matrix.
  • Train, mentor and troubleshoot CAD & Revit modeling, Navisworks queries.
  • Create and maintain quality checks and follow standards for project and revit content delivers.
  • Excellent in English communication and prestation skills.
  • Strong Conceptual, problem solving and Analytical Skills.
  • Demonstrate positive attitude, high ethics, and a working successfully under pressure in a time-constrained environment.

job.title: Senior Engineer Thermal
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

  • This position will work as a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure Solutions team for the mechanical HVAC design of integrated modular solutions, reporting to and supporting the lead engineer on the project until a valid HVAC technical solution is achieved. The role is responsible for preparing documentation such as single-line diagrams, cooling load calculations, mechanical equipment modelling in Revit, and basic calculations. The thermal engineer must have knowledge of relevant international standards (North American, European, Indian, OR Australian/NZ region) and a basic understanding of international and other standards related to overall HVAC design.
  • Be responsible for mechanical HVAC design on a dedicated (small/medium) project and will coordinate HVAC mechanical installations with other disciplines.
  • Handle one or multiple projects at a time for technical details and also with cross-functional teams. Provide inputs to CFD team and also review analysis.
  • Well versed with details of cooling equipment functions(Leibert) and incorporate cooling equipment in project. Learn and understand equipment details and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Piping design, chiller design, precision cooling units, etc...
  • Preferred experience in Data Center projects or relevant field.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop project concepts and detailed designs

Create mechanical design documentation based on input data (information, requirements, standards): thermal load, ventilation, layouts, detailed drawings, descriptions, schedules, instructions, material submissions, presentations, marketing materials, etc.

Follow and consider international, national, company standards and good engineering practices during design

Use knowledge and experience to meet project task requirements

Participate in kick-off meetings, regular project team meetings, and site coordination meetings

Report project status to the lead project engineer.

Based on Project and priorities he needs to align with North America, India region, EMEA or ANZ region timeline

Proactively collaborate with all team members during project execution

Initiate Requests for Information (RFI) when further clarification is needed

Prepare defined documents according to the document list (DLIST)

Review and approve workshop documentation prepared by subcontractors

Define descriptions of materials and services required for project execution

Specify required certificates for materials to be ordered

Support suppliers with additional information during the bid submission phase

Provide technical approval for received supplier bids

Provide technical support to subcontractors and installers during production/installation

Collaborate with the manufacturing team and on-site implementation team

Work with the site manager during installation, providing technical solutions to raised issues

Cooperate with Quality Control during component/system quality checks and site installation

Collaborate with the commissioning engineer in preparing test documentation

Participate in internal testing and FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing

AUTHORITIES

Review and approve external mechanical design documentation with support from the lead thermal engineer

  • Approve/reject technically received supplier bids with support from the lead thermal engineer
  • Approve/reject proposed changes by subcontractors to approved workshop documentation with support from the lead thermal engineer

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Education: ME/Mtech OR Bachelor's / Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (preferably in Thermodynamics)
  • 5-7 years of experience
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Software:
  • Required: Revit, AutoCAD, MS Office
  • Preferred: MagiCAD, Linear
  • Other skills: attention to detail, problem-solving ability, organisation, creativity, teamwork, diligence

job.title: Director, Investment, Data Centre (Based in Singapore)
job.description:
The Role

This position will be primarily responsible for leading the Group’s Data Centre investment activities across Asia Pacific, including asset acquisitions, development projects and M&A opportunities. The role will involve originating and evaluating opportunities, driving investment execution, and supporting the growth of the Group’s data centre platform in the region.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop and drive business strategies for data centre markets in Asia Pacific region, including the pursuit and evaluation of new investment and business opportunities.
  • Drive portfolio growth by building strategic relationships with key market participants, operators, developers, advisers and capital partners.
  • Originate and assess data centre investment opportunities, including site feasibility, power availability, connectivity, development risk, tenant demand and market competitiveness.
  • Formulate market entry and exit strategies to optimise returns upon disposition, supported by deep-dive analytical reviews to identify opportunities that enhance profitability and value creation.
  • Develop and implement sound business plans for sourcing acquisition and investment opportunities, including strategies to achieve short and long-term growth and profit objectives.
  • Lead investment transactions end-to-end, including origination, research, deal evaluation and structuring, financial analysis, financial modelling, approval processes, negotiation and execution.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders, including development, asset management, legal, finance and tax teams, as well as external advisers, to support transaction execution and portfolio growth.

Job Requirements

  • Degree in Engineering, Building, Real Estate, Business, Finance or a related discipline.
  • Candidates with Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) qualification would be an added advantage.
  • At least 12 years of relevant working experience in real estate investments, asset acquisitions, development projects and/or M&A transactions.
  • Prior exposure to data centres, infrastructure or related asset classes will be preferred.
  • Resourceful, with strong analytical capability and proficiency in financial modelling.
  • Proven track record in originating, evaluating, underwriting and executing investment transactions.
  • Strong investment, financial and commercial acumen, with experience in site selection, business development and/or development management in data centre property investments preferred.
  • Excellent leadership skills, strong initiative, sound business judgement and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

#LI-WL

job.title: GTM Specialist, Infrastructure Migration and Modernization, WWSO India
job.description:
The Infrastructure Migration and Modernization Go-To-Market (GTM) team is responsible for growing the adoption of a portfolio of services that enable our customer’s transformation from commercial software-based legacy platforms to modern, cloud-native services on the AWS cloud. As a part of this team, you will have the opportunity to help shape the future of how customers transform AI-ready application and database workloads by modernizing their technology stack across compute, memory, storage, commercial licensing and allied infrastructure workloads. You will develop scalable motions to establish new business in target market segments and enable the global field organization to drive the day-to-day interactions that identify prospects for long-term business opportunities. You will be the single-threaded owner for developing and executing the GTM plan for the assigned portfolio and act as the extension of the AWS Infrastructure Migration and Modernization product team to customers globally, understanding their use cases, gathering customer feature requests and feedback, and influencing product direction. You will also work directly with the most interesting and demanding customers - leaders in their respective fields - earning trust to understand their requirements and turn them into reality. You will demonstrate Customer Obsession, representing the voice of the customer as you work with product teams across AWS to evolve AWS services.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as a key member of the WWSO India GTM team and focus on increasing adoption of AWS Infrastructure Migration and Modernization services.
  • Help define market segments, customer base, and industry verticals we target, build and own a strategic Go-To-Market plan for target market segments in line with AWS strategic direction.
  • Work with AWS partners to develop their capability, capacity and selling skills to drive our customers’ transformation at scale.
  • Engage senior stakeholders (CIO/CTO/CDO/Head of Applications) in large enterprises to understand their top business priorities and challenges, build the business case for AI-led digital transformation, by working alongside AWS account team, Migration BD and solution architects.
  • Conduct AI-led infrastructure assessments to derive AWS TCO, present AWS value proposition for cloud migrations, and drive the use of AI tools for workload transformation.
  • Support creation of lighthouse references and share customer and market insights with WW service teams to influence roadmap for services and tools and develop investment programs.
  • Work with sales and technical leadership to drive accountability, establish engagement models, and mechanisms for review and reporting.

About the team Are you a customer-obsessed builder with a passion for helping customers achieve their full potential? Do you have the business savvy, Infrastructure Migration and Modernization background, and sales skills necessary to help position AWS as the cloud provider of choice for customers? Do you love building new strategic and data-driven businesses? Join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Application Modernization team as a Go-to-Market Specialist! The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS), which is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. We work backwards from our customer’s most complex and business critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist and technical solutions architecture. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire life cycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big and helping our customers arrive at the most optimal technology decisions for an AI future - spanning infrastructure, applications, database, analytics, and security.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional or military experience
  • 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
  • 6+ years of working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
  • Experience selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications
  • Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross-functional teams
  • Experience developing, leading, negotiating and executing corporate and/or business transactions
  • MBA

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Solutions Architect, Cross Industries
job.description:
• Do you like helping customers solve technical problems?
  • Would you like to do this using the latest cloud computing technologies?
  • Do you have a knack for helping companies understand Emerging Technology Domains such as GenAI, Agentic AI, Analytics , Microservices architectures including the integration approaches?
  • Do you thrive on rolling up your sleeves , a Builder who can help Architect new and emerging technologies along with been consultative to ensure success?
  • Do you want to be part of the Retail / CPG team helping to establish Amazon Web Services as a leading technology platform for some of the largest Brands & Customers in India.

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

As a Solution Architect, you will have the opportunity to help shape and deliver on a strategy to build mind share and broad use of Amazon’s utility computing web services within strategic accounts and partners. Your broad responsibilities will include: owning the technical engagement and ultimate success around specific implementation projects, and developing a deep expertise in the Amazon Web Services technologies as well as broad know-how around how applications and services are constructed using the Amazon Web Services platform.

The ideal candidate will possess customer-facing skills that will allow him/her to represent AISPL well within a customer’s environment and drive discussions with senior personnel within the company, as well as a technical background that enables him/her to easily interact and give guidance to software developers and architects. He/she should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Serve as a key technical member of the Retail/CPG Account team in helping to ensure customer success in building applications and services on the Amazon Web Services platform.
  • Scope each customer engagement, with attention towards clear and well-defined objectives and success criteria.
  • Own each technical engagement, and help ensure a timely and successful delivery of value. (delivery of actual solutions to be done by Amazon Web Services partners)
  • Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the solution architect community.
  • Understand the Amazon Web Services market segments, customer base, and industry verticals.

Key job responsibilities This role is within the Retail/CPG team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and based out of Delhi

  • As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  • Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short-term technology decisions are aligned with their long-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
  • You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
  • As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.

To be successful in this role you need to be passionate builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.

Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9).

A day in the life The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. job.title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities

About You

You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors. You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!

About The Role

As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.

Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):

  • Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
  • Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
  • Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
  • Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
  • Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
  • Liaising with internal teams & management groups
  • Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
  • Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
  • Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.

People Management. As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.

Incident Management. You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.

Vendor Management. An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.

Process Improvement. You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable

Health & Safety. Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
