job.description:
Do you want to be part of a global team that relentlessly pursues procurement excellence, improves operational processes and outcomes, and manages compliance and business risks? Do you have a solid procurement background, excel at program and stakeholder management, and thrive in a fast-paced environment?

We are hiring a Program Manager - Procurement Excellence to work closely with procurement stakeholders, operations, functions, systems and engineering to enable scalable, well-controlled business processes and decision-making.

This role sits within a broader team of program managers that operates as highly embedded business partners to procurement, focused on operational effectiveness and impact, scalable mechanisms, and risk-informed execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong business process thinking, stakeholder influence, operational rigor, and technical literacy to help teams move quickly while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

The ideal candidate require a high tolerance of ambiguity aligned to AWS Day 1 culture, ability to influence executive decisions, drive strategic initiatives and change management that deliver meaningful programmatic improvements.

This is not a traditional audit or policy-focused role. We designed this role for individuals who enjoy solving operational problems, driving influence and alignment across teams, and building scalable mechanisms in fast-paced environments. Over time, this role has opportunity to evolve toward broader technical program management style leadership responsibilities.

Your role

Business Partnership & Operational Enablement

  • Partner closely with Technical, Engineering, Operations, Procurement, and Risk stakeholders to shape scalable business processes and controls.
  • Engage early with teams to influence decisions, identify risks, and enable efficient execution.
  • Translate risk and controls requirements into practical, actionable operating mechanisms.

Risk & Controls Integration

  • Design and improve scalable controls, guardrails, and operational frameworks that support business velocity while managing risk appropriately.
  • Simplify and modernize existing processes to align with evolving business needs and risk appetite.
  • Ensure controls are operationally practical and embedded into day-to-day workflows.

Business Process & Mechanism Ownership

  • Identify process gaps, friction points, and operational inefficiencies across programs and workflows.
  • Build mechanisms, playbooks, decision frameworks, and scalable patterns that improve consistency and reduce ambiguity.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across governance, operational readiness, and execution processes.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Audit Readiness

  • Act as a business partner to Procurement teams and a key coordination point across Risk, Audit, Assurance, Legal, Technical and Engineering teams.
  • Streamline audit readiness and evidence gathering through scalable operational processes rather than manual coordination.
  • Ensure teams have clarity on ownership, expectations, and escalation paths.

Technical & Operational Collaboration

  • Engage effectively with technical teams by understanding system architecture, workflows, dependencies, and operational trade-offs.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure controls and operational requirements are designed into solutions early.
  • Use data and operational signals to identify risks, trends, and improvement opportunities.

What good looks like for this role:

  • Procurement teams and functional partners proactively engage you as a trusted partner early in planning and execution.
  • Decisions move faster because of your involvement, not slower.
  • Processes become simpler, clearer, and more scalable over time.
  • Risk Management and controls are embedded into operational workflows rather than managed as separate activities.
  • Stakeholders experience clear ownership, practical guidance, and streamlined engagement across governance functions.

  • Purely policy or checklist-driven approaches.
  • Candidates who operate primarily through approvals or gatekeeping or arm's length approach
  • Candidates who identify problems without driving practical solutions.

job.title: Order Handling Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Manager Order Handling ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide customer support, including technical support, order, and payment-related assistance to achieve target levels of service quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Each day, you will implement customer support strategy to increase operational excellence and customer satisfaction in the sales process. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting achievement of established targets by overseeing progress and implementing improvement actions as needed.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Distribution Solution division at Nashik, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Focusing on achievement of defined targets, including inventory turn on finished goods, requested on-time delivery, and Net Promoter Score.
  • Processing orders by coordinating with Sales, Product Marketing, Logistics, and other internal teams to ensure that customers receive accurate and timely delivery of products.
  • Acting as the first port of call for customers’ queries and orders and ensuring the resolution of customer issues.
  • Supporting in pre-sales or after-sales service by resolving customer issues and ensuring effective and efficient customer communication by utilizing specific commercial communication tools.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across business processes to enhance order execution efficiency and operational excellence.
  • Lead digitalization and automation projects to improve overall business efficiency, productivity, and process effectiveness.

Qualifications for the role - Degree in Electrical Engineering (should be full-time)

-

Minimum 5 to 8 years experience in Order Management, Project management, Customer Service, Sales Operations, or Supply Chain processes.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, including Excel, Power BI, Power Automate, for data analysis, reporting, collaboration, and process automation.
  • Experience using ERP systems (SAP preferred) and digital business tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret operational data and drive improvements.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment

- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

More about us ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as lowvoltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Service Engineer - Robotics
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Service Team Leader ###

Your role and responsibilities In this role, you will have the opportunity to execute robot service activities as per work instructions and in accordance with ABB standard processes, quality standards, and safety guidelines. The role requires strong expertise in industrial robotics, troubleshooting, and automation technologies, along with the ability to deliver high-quality customer service, ensure system reliability, and support continuous improvement of robotic applications.

The work model for the role is: #Li_Onsite This role is contributing to the customer service in Bangalore and South region.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Deliver installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and emergency repair services for ABB robotic systems and associated automation equipment at customer sites.
  • Accountable for diagnosing and resolving mechanical, electrical, software, and PLC communication issues to minimize downtime, improve system reliability, and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Provide onsite and remote technical support, conduct customer training, and build strong customer relationships through effective communication and responsive service.
  • Manage field service activities across India, including extensive travel (60-70%), timely response to customer requirements, and regular reporting of service status and project progress.
  • Support robot system integration, identify opportunities for service and business growth, and recommend improvements that enhance customer operations and system performance.

Qualifications for the role

  • Diploma / BE / B. Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Mechatronics, or related field.
  • Minimum 5-8 Years of experience in industrial robotics, with hands-on expertise in ABB Robots, robot applications, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
  • Strong knowledge of industrial robotics applications, robotic systems, and automation technologies.
  • Sound understanding of ABB robot programming, operation, maintenance, and application support, with strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting capabilities.
  • Good understanding of industrial automation systems, PLCs, and related robotic peripheral equipment.
  • Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies, products, and evolving customer requirements in the automation and robotics industry.
  • More about us

ABB Robotics & Discrete Automation is a pioneer in robotics, machine automation and digital services, providing innovative solutions for a diverse range of industries, from automotive to electronics to logistics. job.title: Principal Network Architect, Backbone Network
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Role Summary

As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity at Firmus, you will lead the architecture and technical assurance of the backbone connectivity platform that underpins the Firmus AI Factory ecosystem and Firmus AI Cloud. The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support of the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity, with focus on building and evolving Firmus’s national and international backbone across terrestrial and subsea networks, optical transport, IP backbone, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity.

The role directly reports to the Network Engineering team as a principal technical lead and acts as a dedicated support the Head of Connectivity as the primary technical authority for backbone architecture. You will translate Firmus’s connectivity strategy into a scalable, resilient and vendor-neutral architecture, define the standards and design patterns that guide implementation, and ensure the backbone network positions Firmus as a leader in AI-ready connectivity.

This role is responsible for the technical integrity of the backbone architecture across the full lifecycle, from concept and design assurance through delivery readiness, operational resilience and continuous improvement. You will work across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers, data-centre partners and internal engineering teams to ensure Firmus’s network connectivity is high-performance, secure, operationally robust and ready to scale with the company’s AI infrastructure growth.

Key Responsibilities

As Principal Network Architect, Backbone Connectivity, you will own the technical architecture of Firmus's backbone network and act as the principal technical adviser to the Head of Connectivity, while operating as a senior technical lead within the Network Engineering team. You will convert the Firmus Connectivity Strategy into an integrated, executable backbone architecture spanning subsea and terrestrial fibre, optical transport (DWDM/OTN), IP/MPLS and segment routing, data-centre interconnection and partner connectivity. You will define the reference architecture, standards and reusable design patterns that guide engineers and partners, ensuring every AI Factory and Firmus AI Cloud service attaches through resilient, diverse and scalable backbone nodes free of unmanaged common-mode failure.

Working across carriers, subsea operators, terrestrial fibre providers and data-centre partners, you will set minimum resilience profiles, validate physical-route and shared-risk-link-group diversity, and provide independent technical assurance that designs can be delivered, operated and scaled safely across their full lifecycle. You will act as technical design authority in vendor and technology selection for backbone and subsea services, lead complex backbone changes and cutovers, mentor the engineering team, and benchmark Firmus's designs against leading global operators and hyperscalers — keeping Firmus at the forefront of AI-ready network connectivity.

What you’ll bring

You are, first and foremost, an accomplished network architect for large-scale, mission-critical connectivity infrastructure. You bring deep expertise in national and international backbone design across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea systems, including landing-station connectivity, cable-landing diversity, and terrestrial route and duct engineering. You are fluent in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent and client-side optics, ROADM and amplification/regeneration planning) and in IP backbone design, including IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange, and high-capacity data-centre and customer interconnection. You understand how to design resilient, diverse networks free of unmanaged common-mode failure, using SRLG analysis, engineered failure-state capacity and physical-route evidence to prove your claims rather than assert them.

Across the delivery lifecycle, you are equally at home leading architecture and design reviews, carrier and technology-vendor governance, technical evaluation of backbone and subsea services, change control, cutover planning, and operational-readiness and handover to network operations. You have authored or materially shaped reference architectures, design standards, reusable patterns and architecture decision records at a hyperscale operator, carrier, or equivalent, and you know how to keep an architecture modular and vendor-neutral so the business can flex across managed services, wavelengths, dark fibre and subsea assets as demand and economics change. You are comfortable engaging carriers, subsea consortia, internet exchanges and major equipment vendors, and you can drive value engineering and sustainability outcomes without compromising resilience or performance.

Above all, you have the temperament of a senior technical leader operating across geographies: strong systems thinking, calm judgement under delivery and incident pressure, the confidence to challenge design and vendor assumptions constructively, and the communication skill to carry a room of network engineers, a customer technical review, and an executive readout with equal clarity. You bring commercial awareness, comfort operating across cultures and time zones, and a genuine passion for building AI-ready network connectivity that performs reliably from day one and positions Firmus as a leader in the field.

Skills & Experience

The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation in network and connectivity engineering, ideally with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science or a related discipline, together with more than 12 years of progressive experience designing and operating large-scale backbone networks across carrier, hyperscale, cloud or specialist AI infrastructure environments. They will have deep, hands-on expertise as a principal-level network architect or distinguished engineer on national and international backbone programmes, and a proven track record owning reference architectures, design standards and technical assurance across a portfolio of concurrent connectivity initiatives.

This experience should include end-to-end design and delivery across terrestrial long-haul fibre and subsea cable systems — including landing-station connectivity, route and duct diversity, and SRLG-based resilience modelling — alongside deep expertise in optical transport (DWDM/OTN, coherent optics, 100G/400G/800G) and IP backbone design (IP/MPLS, segment routing, EVPN, traffic engineering, peering, transit and internet exchange). They will have led technical evaluations of carriers, subsea operators and equipment vendors, defined the technical sections of RFPs and evaluation criteria, and worked effectively across the design-to-operate interface with Network Engineering, Data Centre and Operations teams.

Experience authoring or contributing materially to global backbone reference architecture, minimum standards or interconnection strategy at a hyperscale, carrier or AI infrastructure operator is a strong differentiator, as is experience delivering into APAC markets — particularly Indonesia, Australia and Singapore — under diverse regulatory, licensing and provider conditions. Above all, the successful candidate will combine hands-on architectural depth with the influence and communication skills to lead as a senior technical authority

  • *

Location & Reporting

  • This role is based in Sydney, Australia.
  • Reporting to Senior Manager, Networking

**

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Head of Physical Security - Data Centres
job.description:
About Goodman

At Goodman, your career is more than just a job – it’s about growth, innovation, and making a lasting impact. Whether you’re building your career in property, data centres, finance, legal, or beyond, we value diverse perspectives and seek individuals who are passionate about driving our business forward.

As providers of essential infrastructure for the digital economy, Goodman has been developing its data centre capability since 2005. Since then, we have grown to become a large owner of powered sites globally. Our global power bank of 5.0GW includes completed facilities, secured power and potential data centre projects across 13 major international cities. This has been built up over time through our expertise in securing land, planning and power in highly sought after locations in major global cities.

We are seeking an experienced Head of Physical Security, Data Centres to establish and lead the physical security strategy, governance framework and operating model across our growing portfolio. Reporting to the General Manager, IT, Cyber and Security – Data Centres, this role will work closely with senior leaders across Critical Environments, Operations, Design, Construction, Digital Integration, Property and Enterprise Security.

This is a unique opportunity to build and mature a security function from the ground up while influencing the design, construction and operation of some of Australia's most critical digital infrastructure.

The Opportunity

  • As Head of Physical Security, you will be responsible for setting the strategic direction for physical security across the data centre lifecycle, from site selection and design through to construction, commissioning, operations and customer assurance.
  • You will lead the development of security standards, governance frameworks and assurance programs while ensuring physical security controls align with cyber, information security and operational technology requirements.
  • You will also act as the senior security representative for customers, regulators, industry bodies and government agencies, helping ensure our facilities meet the highest standards of resilience, compliance and trust.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Security Across the Data Centre Lifecycle

  • Establish and execute the physical security strategy, standards and roadmap for the data centre portfolio.
  • Embed security-by-design principles into new data centre developments and major capital projects.
  • Provide leadership throughout design, construction, commissioning and operational readiness phases.
  • Ensure physical security requirements are considered alongside uptime, resiliency, customer commitments and operational outcomes.

Protect Critical Infrastructure

  • Lead the design and assurance of layered security controls including:

Access control systems

  • CCTV and video management platforms
  • Perimeter intrusion detection
  • Vehicle and pedestrian access management
  • Visitor management systems
  • Security Operations Centres
  • Guard force operations

Develop and maintain site security plans, response procedures and escalation frameworks. Lead threat, vulnerability and risk assessments across existing and future sites.

Customer Security & Assurance

  • Act as the senior physical security contact for hyperscale, cloud and enterprise customers.
  • Support customer audits, security questionnaires, inspections and due diligence activities.
  • Ensure facilities meet customer assurance requirements and security obligations.
  • Partner with customers to understand emerging security expectations and incorporate them into future planning.

Governance, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Own physical security policies, standards and assurance programmes across the portfolio.
  • Lead audit preparation, evidence management, compliance reviews and remediation activities.
  • Maintain alignment with industry and government security frameworks including:

Hosting Certification Framework (HCF)

  • Defence Industry Security Program (DISP)
  • PSPF
  • ISO 27001
  • SOC and customer assurance requirements

Contribute to broader cyber and information security governance where physical security controls support overall security outcomes.

Build and Lead a High-Performing Function

  • Establish and mature the physical security operating model for the data centre business.
  • Lead strategic relationships with guarding providers, security integrators, consultants and specialist advisers.
  • Develop future organisational capability, succession plans and leadership frameworks.
  • Provide executive-level reporting and risk insights to senior leadership.

About You

  • 10+ years' experience in physical security, protective security, critical infrastructure or mission-critical environments.
  • Direct experience supporting hyperscale, colocation or large-scale data centre operations is essential
  • Demonstrated success developing and implementing physical security strategies, governance frameworks and assurance programmes.
  • Strong knowledge of data centre security technologies, including electronic access control, CCTV, perimeter detection and security operations centres
  • .Experience managing customer audits, security reviews and compliance obligations
  • Knowledge of PSPF, DISP, HCF, ISO 27001 and other security and assurance frameworks.
  • Experience operating within converged physical, cyber and operational technology environments.
  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement and executive communication skills.

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

Role Overview

The Commissioning Technician is responsible for the safe, compliant, and efficient commissioning of Building Management System (BMS) projects to ensure successful project delivery in line with scope, programme, quality, and customer expectations.

The role is accountable for executing commissioning activities, verifying system functionality against design intent, supporting engineering integration, and ensuring all systems are fully operational, documented, and ready for client handover. The Commissioning Engineer plays a critical role in delivering defect-free projects and enabling a smooth transition to the Service team.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Commission BMS and associated systems in accordance with project requirements, functional descriptions, drawings, sequences of operation, company standards, and WHS requirements.
  • Conduct functional testing, fault-finding, and rectification, including device/controller replacement, wiring re-termination, installation issues, programming adjustments, graphics modifications, and control optimisation.
  • Configure and optimise system functions, including alarms, trends, advanced parameters, and integration with third-party systems and high-level interfaces such as WebCTRL.
  • Maintain safety, quality, and compliance by following SWMS, site-specific safety requirements, company policies, and ensuring systems are fully tested and validated prior to handover.
  • Maintain accurate commissioning documentation, including test records, mark-ups, defect registers, and closeout documentation, ensuring all issues are tracked and resolved.
  • Work collaboratively with Project Managers, customers, subcontractors, and stakeholders to provide clear commissioning updates, manage risks and actions, achieve project milestones, minimise rework, and support successful project delivery.

Required Competencies & Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience in commissioning BMS or HVAC control systems
  • Strong understanding of HVAC systems, controls, and networking
  • Experience with BMS platforms such as WebCTRL
  • Ability to interpret drawings, specifications, and functional descriptions
  • Experience working on construction or building services projects
  • Experience fault-finding and system optimisation
  • Familiarity with working alongside Project Managers, engineers, and other trades.
  • Maintain Company standards by ensuring personal adherence to Company policies and practices.
  • Take appropriate care to always represent Carrier in a professional manner (in appearance, speech, dress, etc.).

Benefits

This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

job.title: Specialist, Indirect Procurement
job.description:
Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

About the Role

  • Support strategic sourcing and procurement activities across indirect spend categories to achieve cost savings, process efficiency, compliance, and supplier performance objectives.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to manage sourcing, contracting, supplier engagement, spend analysis, and purchase requisition requirements.
  • Drive procurement best practices, policy compliance, and data-driven decision-making to deliver business value and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute sourcing and procurement activities across indirect categories such as IT, Professional Services, Marketing, Facilities, HR, Travel, Fleet, MRO, and Corporate Services.
  • Conduct spend analysis and identify cost-saving, productivity, and supplier optimization opportunities.
  • Manage RFx processes including RFI, RFP, RFQ, bid analysis, supplier evaluation, and negotiation support.
  • Collaborate with Category Managers, business stakeholders, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to support sourcing initiatives.
  • Support contract review processes and ensure all sourcing activities adhere to procurement policies and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor supplier performance and assist in developing supplier scorecards and governance processes.
  • Create and maintain procurement dashboards, savings trackers, sourcing pipelines, and management reports.
  • Support purchase requisition (PR) to purchase order (PO) processes and resolve procurement-related operational issues.
  • Ensure data accuracy in procurement systems such as SAP Ariba, SAP, Coupa, Oracle, or equivalent platforms.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, automation opportunities, and process standardization within procurement operations.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain, Procurement, Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 6-8 years of experience in Indirect Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Procurement Operations, or Category Management support.
  • Strong understanding of sourcing methodologies, supplier management, contract management, and procurement processes.
  • Experience working with procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, SAP, Coupa, Oracle, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and data analysis/reporting.
  • Strong analytical, stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Experience supporting global procurement operations across multiple regions is preferred.
  • Professional certifications such as CPSM, CIPS, CSCP, or equivalent are an added advantage.

Preferred Competencies

  • Strategic Sourcing
  • Spend Analytics
  • Supplier Relationship Management
  • Contract Management
  • Cost Optimization
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Procurement Compliance
  • Data Analysis & Reporting
  • SAP Ariba / Procurement Systems
  • Continuous Improvement & Automation

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. We are seeking an experienced Senior Lead to drive AI-powered engineering transformation across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The ideal candidate will lead the design, development, adoption, and governance of enterprise-scale AI accelerators that improve software productivity, quality, modernization, knowledge management, and engineering efficiency.

The role involves building and scaling AI-driven platforms, collaborating with business units and engineering organizations, driving technology modernization programs, and establishing best practices for AI adoption across global teams. This position will work closely with architects, product teams, engineering leaders, cloud providers, and external technology partners to shape the future of AI-enabled engineering.

Responsibilities

AI Product & Platform

  • Development and enhancement of AI-powered engineering platforms and accelerators.
  • Drive the roadmap for solutions supporting requirements management, software design, coding, testing, knowledge management, and software modernization.
  • Define reusable architectures, frameworks, and engineering standards for AI-enabled platforms.

  • Knowledge Discovery & Enterprise Search

Engineering Modernization

Legacy code understanding

  • Platform migration
  • Technology upgrades
  • Re-platforming programs

Develop AI-based approaches for modernization assessment and execution.

Create engineering insights and diagnostics for software health, technical debt, and performance optimization.

AI Governance & Adoption

  • Establish AI governance frameworks, guardrails, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with security, legal, compliance, and enterprise architecture teams.
  • Define responsible AI adoption processes and maturity models.
  • Measure and report productivity savings, quality improvements, and business impact.

Stakeholder & BU Engagement

  • Partner with business units and engineering organizations to identify AI transformation opportunities.
  • Conduct workshops, ideation sessions, technical reviews, and solution assessments.
  • Present architecture recommendations and productivity insights to senior leadership.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor lead engineers, software engineers, and AI specialists.
  • Drive technical excellence, innovation culture, and continuous learning.
  • Support talent development, career progression, and succession planning.
  • Foster a data-driven and outcome-oriented engineering culture.

Requirements

job.title: Underground Technologies Sr. Project Lead
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About Caterpillar & MineStar

Caterpillar is a global leader in mining technology, delivering integrated solutions that improve safety, productivity, and operational performance.

Cat® MineStar™ Solutions is our flagship digital platform, connecting equipment, people, and data across mining operations. Through advanced automation, tracking, safety, and productivity technologies, MineStar enables customers to operate more efficiently while supporting safer and more autonomous mining environments.

The Underground Technologies team develops and supports a broad portfolio of solutions including automation and tele-remote machine operation, positioning and production recording, people and vehicle tracking, and proximity awareness and collision avoidance systems. These solutions are deployed globally and help customers safely and efficiently manage their underground mining operations.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Sr. Project Lead - Underground Technologies to lead investigation and resolution activities for customer-reported issues across Caterpillar’s underground technology portfolio.

This role sits at the intersection of customer support, engineering, product development, and validation. You will work closely with product support teams, deployment specialists, systems engineers, software developers, architects, and validation teams to understand complex customer challenges, perform deep technical analysis, and drive engineering improvements that enhance product quality and customer outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Lead Customer Issue Resolution

  • Lead a small technical team responsible for daily customer issue triage across the Underground Technologies product portfolio.
  • Work closely with Product Support, Deployment, and Application Specialists to understand customer-reported issues and prioritise investigation activities.
  • Facilitate technical discussions across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Track issue progress from initial report through analysis, root cause identification, and resolution.

Drive Technical Analysis

  • Perform detailed analysis of customer and engineering data to understand system behaviour and identify root causes.
  • Develop advanced data collection and experimentation plans to support complex investigations.
  • Apply modern data analysis techniques and AI-assisted tools to accelerate problem solving and engineering decisions.
  • Identify product improvement opportunities through analysis of customer issues and operational trends.

Partner with Engineering Teams

  • Work with architects and software engineering teams to determine corrective actions and long-term product improvements.
  • Support implementation and validation of engineering solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership for cross-functional investigations involving hardware, software, communications, and operational systems.

Improve Product Quality

  • Partner with Systems Integration and Validation teams to improve engineering test coverage, data collection methods, and troubleshooting processes.
  • Develop better validation approaches for identifying issues before deployment.
  • Drive continuous improvement in root cause analysis and product quality processes.

Support Underground Technology Solutions

  • Automation and Tele-remote capabilities for LHDs
  • Positioning and Production Recording systems
  • People and Vehicle Tracking solutions
  • Proximity Awareness and Collision Avoidance technologies

Stakeholder Leadership

Partner with:

  • Product Support and Deployment teams to understand customer challenges
  • Software, Systems, and Architecture teams to develop effective solutions
  • Integration and Validation teams to improve product robustness
  • Global customers and mining operations to support data-driven investigations

Act as a technical leader who can align teams, communicate complex findings, and drive resolution of highly complex system-level issues.

What You Bring

Experience

  • Previous experience in underground mining and mining technologies.
  • Technical leadership experience leading teams or complex engineering initiatives.
  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving complex systems issues in operational environments.
  • Experience working across multiple engineering disciplines including software, systems, integration, and validation.

Capabilities

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to lead investigations involving multiple stakeholders and technical disciplines.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to influence technical direction and drive alignment across organisations.
  • Experience working in global cross-functional teams.

Technical & Domain Knowledge

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

  • Underground mining technologies
  • Data analytics and data science
  • AI-based tools for data analysis
  • Mining automation and tele-remote systems
  • Positioning and production management systems
  • People and vehicle tracking technologies
  • Proximity awareness and collision avoidance systems
  • Systems integration and validation

What Success Looks Like

  • Faster identification and resolution of customer-reported issues.
  • Improved product quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction.
  • Strong collaboration between support, engineering, and validation teams.
  • Better engineering data collection and root cause analysis capabilities.
  • Measurable improvements delivered across Caterpillar’s Underground Technology products.

Why Join Us

  • Work on some of the most advanced underground mining technologies in the world.
  • Help shape the future of underground automation and autonomy.
  • Solve challenging real-world engineering problems impacting mining operations globally.
  • Influence product quality and technology strategy across a growing portfolio.
  • Be part of a highly collaborative global team focused on innovation, safety, and customer success.

Additional Information

Location:This position can be based in either Perth (Bibra Lake) or Brisbane

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

August 12, 2026 - August 27, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Production Support Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Schedules, plans and oversees material procurement, production and delivery processes.

Responsibilities

  • Participates in scheduling production and delivery processes in accordance with current productivity and cost efficiency standards.
  • Develops and executes material planning for a product line to ensure that all material requirements for assigned programs are met within the allocated time frame.
  • Organizes the flow of materials within the manufacturing unit and the transferring of materials to and from the inventory or warehouse.
  • Generates forecasts and manages replenishment planning for parts and materials to ensure specified service levels are met.

Degree Requirement

Degree or equivalent experience desired

Skill Descriptors

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP): Knowledge of the process, issues and considerations for systematically managing distribution of inventory for multiple plants or warehouses; ability to apply related knowledge and experience in real practice.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Works with real-time inventory software, moving supplies to where needed, when needed.
  • Interprets the impact of bottlenecks and delays on operating costs.
  • Follows processes and applies technologies for items and inventory management.
  • Assists in solving issues related to distribution to meet orders or inventory replenishment requirements.
  • Works with basic distribution requirements planning (DRP) processes and operations.

Internal Resource Coordination: Knowledge of the techniques, tools and applications associated with coordination of internal resources; ability to synchronize and integrate activities, responsibilities, and command and control structures to ensure that internal resources are used most efficiently in pursuit of business objectives.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies basic characteristics of good business relationships or partnerships.
  • Attends training to learn coordination skills with individuals and groups.
  • Lists major techniques, tools and approaches for resource coordination.
  • Describes the organization's culture and policies for coordinating with others.

Manufacturing Requirements Planning (MRP): Knowledge of the processes, practices and systems used in manufacturing requirements planning (MRP); ability to optimize planning for manufacturing cycles and ensure capacity and materials availability.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes basic concepts of materials and capacity management processes and procedures.
  • Describes product life cycle and associated MRP cycle.
  • Identifies parameters and considerations used in making decisions about production runs.
  • Describes the use of bills of materials and other documentation needed to provide supplies.

Materials Handling and Management: Knowledge of material handling and management in plants; ability to perform, monitor and improve processes related to storage, transportation and handling of raw and hazardous materials.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies key issues involved with different types of manufacturing materials.
  • Discusses considerations for physical management of major types of materials.
  • Identifies types of materials used in manufacturing flagship products or components.
  • Describes packaging regulations and locates those specific to the requirements of the situation.

Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Seeks help to modify priorities as new information surfaces or conditions change.
  • Demonstrates the ability to estimate the time and resources required to complete tasks.
  • Identifies own key assignments, schedules, and process steps.
  • Applies the concept of 'critical path' in order to complete work in a timely manner and keep larger tasks on track.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the value of a disciplined approach to problem solving.
  • Describes problem reporting and escalation practices.
  • Utilizes accepted procedures for problem analysis and resolution.
  • Identifies key aspects of problem-solving techniques used in own area.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Provides examples of the characteristics of effective business relationships.
  • Identifies key business relationships in own organization.
  • Describes the nature of a productive business relationship.
  • Explains the benefits of building business partnerships.

This position requires the candidate to work a 5-day-a-week schedule in the office.

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

八月 19, 2026 - 九月 1, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: MineStar® Site Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar is seeking a MineStar® Site Manager to join our Underground Mining Technology team.

Based in Perth or Brisbane on an international FIFO roster, this role supports MineStar® Fleet and Command for Underground systems at Freeport Indonesia. As Caterpillar’s senior representative on site, you will work closely with customer leadership teams to develop, implement and manage product support strategies, equipment management processes and technology adoption initiatives that deliver measurable operational outcomes.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an experienced mining technology professional to lead customer engagement and drive the long-term success of autonomous and fleet management solutions at one of the world's largest underground mining operations.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Acting as Caterpillar's primary MineStar® representative and trusted advisor at site
  • Developing strategies to improve technology performance, fleet utilisation and customer outcomes
  • Monitoring key site performance metrics including availability, production, operating costs, utilisation and safety
  • Identifying customer needs and supporting the deployment of new products, technologies and services
  • Providing guidance on equipment management, technology adoption and operational improvement initiatives
  • Leading the resolution of complex operational and technical issues
  • Supporting system implementation, upgrades and continuous improvement activities
  • Analysing performance data to identify optimisation opportunities
  • Aligning Caterpillar support activities with customer objectives and recovery strategies
  • Coaching and developing site personnel to maximise capability and system utilisation

To be successful in this role, you will have:

  • A bachelor’s degree in mining engineering, IT, Software Engineering or a related discipline, required to meet Indonesian work visa eligibility requirements
  • Significant experience in mining technology, MineStar®, fleet management systems, automation or operational technology (OT)
  • Strong knowledge of mining operations, equipment management and operational improvement
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across operational and leadership teams
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with a focus on customer success
  • Australian Citizenship or Permanent Residency, and the ability to obtain and maintain all visas, work permits and approvals required to work in Indonesia

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary based on qualifications and professional industry experience.

The Total Rewards package includes:

  • Competitive remuneration package
  • Site, Shift and FIFO Allowances
  • Attractive Bonus and Share options
  • Career development with global prospects
  • A strong commitment to safety and your wellbeing
  • An inclusive workplace culture focused on quality, customer service and the environment
  • A commitment to diversity and inclusion, equal opportunity and equal outcome
  • SMART spending APP
  • The opportunity to do truly meaningful work in a supportive, constructive culture that encourages you to make the most of your talents

Additional Information

  • FIFO roster
  • Candidates must be based in Australia and meet the requirements to obtain an Indonesian work visa

How to Apply

If you're ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role with a global industry leader, apply via:

www.caterpillar.com/careers

Your road to success begins with Caterpillar.

Join a global leader and build a career with real impact.

_Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer._

_Caterpillar of Australia is not currently hiring applicants who require sponsorship. As a global company, opportunities may be available in other locations via our careers website._

This position requires working onsite five days a week. Posting Dates:

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Production Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the unit in achieving the set production targets by adhering to the systems and processes. Each day, you will use machinery and equipment on the shop floor. You will also showcase your expertise by reading and interpreting the technical diagrams/instructions for assembly of products/systems/panels. The work model for the role is: {onsite/hybrid/remote} {insert Linkedin #}

The work model for the role is: {onsite/hybrid/remote} {insert Linkedin #}

This role is contributing to the {insert product group/business area/division/function} in {insert region}. Main stakeholders are {insert main stakeholder groups if available}.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting all types of assembly work to produce semi-finished or final products/systems/panels, including the packing where integrated with production lines.
  • Performing work manually or by using light hand tools.
  • Carrying out regular quality testing as part of a defined production process.
  • Operating within standard operating procedures and maintaining a clean work area.

Our team dynamics (Optional) You will join a {insert adjectives – e.g. dynamic, talented, high performing} team, where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

  • You are immersed in / engaged in / absorbed in / highly skilled in/ you enjoy working with {relevant tools and methodologies} and the {insert relevant industry/sector} market
  • Ability to demonstrate your experience in / Have established skills / advanced skills / You have {insert number of years} years of experience in {insert relevant field}

(OPTIONAL: working as {insert relevant role} with {insert relevant products or technologies})

  • Possess an enhanced knowledge of / You are qualified in / Highly adept in {insert specialized software/platforms}
  • You are passionate about / you are captivated by / you are innovative around {insert relevant soft skills} and {insert relevant soft skills}
  • Degree in / Have a demonstrated track record in / Extensive knowledge of / Proven experience of {insert specific degree, qualification} in {insert subject}
  • You are at ease communicating in {insert required language skill(s)}
  • You hold current {insert required licenses} valid in {insert job location} and {insert country-specific VISA/work permit} {where required}

What's in it for you? (Optional)

job.title: IS Technical Solution Architect for SAP MDG
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

IS Service Owner ###

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to own software solution architecture across multiple architecture categories and ensures its alignment with enterprise and data architecture standards. Also, responsible for the design and build, integrity, and quality of an IS solution and associated IS services delivered to business. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring continuous improvement and compliance.

The work model for the role is #Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Corporate Finance Function and is part of the Finance IS Domain and Corporate Finance.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Design and architect robust and scalable software solutions using front-end and back-end technologies including highly scalable, fault-tolerant and durable messaging queue systems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Develop and maintain applications in SAP4HANA/MDG environment
  • Ensure code quality through best practices, including clean code principles, code reviews, and automated testing.
  • Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry trends to continuously improve our development processes.
  • Demonstrate strong DevOps acumen
  • System Integration: Facilitate seamless integration of finance processes within the MDG system, as well as with other enterprise systems (ERP, SAP TC, etc.), ensuring smooth data flow and automation of processes across platforms.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelors or Masters Degree, preferably in Computer Sciences, Engineering, Math or similar
  • At least 10+ years of experience with a strong background in system configuration and implementation within SAP.
  • Proven understanding of SAP solutions.
  • Hands-on experience in SAP environment with proven understanding of complexity and intricacies of it – is a strong plus.
  • Understanding of compliance requirements is a strong plus.
  • Certifications required - ITIL V4 foundation
  • Certifications preferred- SAP/MDG technology specific certifications, IT architecture certification.

More about us

We value people from different backgrounds. Apply today for your next career step within ABB and visit www.abb.com to learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory Our mission in ABB IS (Information Systems) is to harness the power of information technology to deliver valuable, reliable, and competitive IS services for ABB. If you have a strong technical skills, analytical mind, and the drive to help us stay ahead of the competition, you are the one we are looking for.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Fraud Warning: Any genuine offer from ABB will always be preceded by a formal application and interview process. We never ask for money from job applicants.

For current open positions you can visit our career website [https://global.abb/group/en/careers](https://global.abb/group/en/careers) and apply.

Please refer to detailed recruitment fraud caution notice using the link [https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning](https://global.abb/group/en/careers/how-to-apply/fraud-warning).

job.title: Accounting and Reporting Analyst_P2P
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. This Position reports to:

TA Regional Lead - India, Malaysia, Indonesia & Oversight Countries ###

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support general accounting activities in line with defined strategies, policies, and procedures. Each day, you will be responsible for managing and analyzing record to report data. You will also exhibit your proficiency by ensuring accurate financial reporting and compliance with the relevant accounting standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Operational Service based in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

Leadership & People Management

  • Conduct one-on-one meetings, provide feedback, and mentor team members for growth.
  • Lead hiring, training, and performance appraisals for the AP team.
  • Manage attendance, leave planning, and ensure adequate backup for all activities.
  • Organize daily huddles and regular reviews to monitor process health and address issues.

Operational Excellence

  • Ensure accurate processing of AP transactions and adherence to SLA/TAT timelines.
  • Oversee month-end close activities, including account reconciliations and journal entries.
  • Present dashboards with SLI & KPI reports to business users and drive improvements in Paid on Time (POT) metrics.

Process Improvement & Compliance

  • Drive process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support implementation of best practices and harmonization across AP processes.
  • Ensure compliance with ABB Group Accounting Standards, local GAAP, and internal controls.
  • Lead internal control testing and documentation for financial reporting compliance.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for country heads and clients, ensuring service satisfaction.
  • Manage customer queries and enhance customer experience through timely resolution.

Analysis & Reporting

  • Perform transaction analysis, identify discrepancies, and ensure corrective actions.
  • Deliver KPI/SLI reports and insights to stakeholders for decision-making.
  • Utilize ERP tools (SAP, Oracle) and reporting platforms (Power BI) for data analysis and visualization.
  • Handle escalations, perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement preventive measures.
  • Manage new projects and process transitions from other business units to ABB GBS.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Commerce.
  • 7–11 years of experience in Accounts Payable, with at least 3+ years in a leadership role.
  • Strong knowledge of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) and reporting tools (Power BI).
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and team leadership skills.
  • Proven experience in process improvement, compliance, and project management.

More about us:

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who deliver forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results whilst operating at the highest standards. job.title: CFIN M&A Solution Architect
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Head of Central Finance ###

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

We are looking for a M&A CFIN architect to support System of Record (SOR)–related activities within the Central Finance (CFIN) landscape. This role supports mergers, acquisitions, divestments, and new company code onboarding by assisting in the alignment and integration of acquired entities’ SOR finance data and processes into the target CFIN environment, in line with defined business requirements and standards.

This position requires close coordination with Deployment team, Functional architects and external vendors, to maintain and evolve the CFIN M&A Solution Architect, ensuring it meets business needs and complies with ABB's standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Assist in configuring and deploying M&A-related finance solutions in CFIN for new company codes, mergers, acquisitions, and divestments.
  • Support SOR data migration from source systems, including initial load, AVL load, and data validation for new clients.
  • Work across O2C, P2P, R2R, Tax, and Treasury processes to ensure accurate integration and operational readiness.
  • Perform financial reconciliations, system testing, and support issue resolution during deployments.
  • Assist with real-time data replication and CPAY activation to enable seamless transactions and reporting in CFIN.
  • Collaborate with CFIN solution teams, IS architects, M&A leads, vendors, and business stakeholders to support integration and deployment activities.
  • Follow ABB standards, data governance, and regulatory requirements while building expertise in CFIN, SAP S/4HANA, and SOR processes for continuous improvement.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

Background & Experience:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications in SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN, or IT architecture.
  • 7-10+ years of experience as CFIN Finance Architect, or similar role, with strong hands-on experience in mergers, acquisitions, and divestments, including finance systems integration and separation activities.
  • Deep expertise in SAP Central Finance (CFIN), SAP S/4HANA Finance, and related ERP platforms, with practical experience integrating acquired entities, harmonizing finance processes
  • Proven experience in M&A integration capabilities, such as data migration, Testing Automation, legal entity setup, intercompany processing, and transitional service arrangements (TSA).
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end finance processes (Order to Cash, Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Tax, Treasury) as they relate to M&A integration and carve-out scenarios.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and technical teams.
  • A strong focus on continuous improvement and automation, with a passion for driving innovation within enterprise systems.
  • Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and third-party service providers to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring adherence to inventory targets and supply plan optimization.

This role is contributing to the Motion business based at Bangalore, India:

  • Maintaining the right inventory levels, optimizing them according to the company’s targets while ensuring high customer service level.

job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Head of Central Finance ###

Your role and responsibilities:

We are seeking a skilled Record to Report (R2R) Solution architect to play a key role in configuring, implementing, and supporting R2R processes within the Central Finance (CFIN) system. The R2R Solution architect will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, process owners, and technical teams to ensure seamless integration of R2R functions within the CFIN framework. This role requires deep functional knowledge of R2R processes, as well as the ability to translate business requirements into system configurations that optimize efficiency, accuracy, and business performance. This position requires close coordination with Deployment team, Functional architects and external vendors, to maintain and evolve the R2R architecture, ensuring it meets business needs and complies with ABB's standards.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • R2R Process Configuration: Configure and maintain Record to Report (R2R) processes such as General Ledger (GL) accounting, month-end and year-end closing, financial reporting, consolidation, reconciliations, intercompany accounting, Group Reporting, Intercompany, reconciliation and financial statement. within the Central Finance (CFIN) system, ensuring alignment with business needs and industry best practices.
  • Requirements Gathering & Analysis: Collaborate with business stakeholders and process owners to thoroughly understand their requirements, document functional specifications, and translate these into system configurations. System Integration: Facilitate seamless integration of R2R processes within the CFIN system, as well as with other enterprise systems (ERP, Trintech, Basware, etc.), ensuring smooth data flow and automation of processes across platforms. User Support & Training: Provide ongoing functional support to end-users, addressing issues, offering solutions, and conducting training to ensure optimal utilization of the system and full understanding of R2R processes.
  • Testing & Validation: Participate in testing and validation activities for new configurations, enhancements, and fixes, ensuring they meet business and functional requirements. Process Optimization: Regularly monitor and evaluate R2R processes to identify opportunities for automation, efficiency improvements, and best practice implementation within the CFIN system.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for R2R system configurations, process flows, and integration points, ensuring compliance with internal standards and regulatory guidelines. Collaboration with Technical Teams: Work closely with IS architects, developers, and technical teams to ensure that functional requirements are correctly implemented and aligned with system design specifications.
  • Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution: Provide expert troubleshooting support for R2R-related system issues, working collaboratively with cross-functional teams to resolve any challenges promptly. Continuous Improvement: Stay informed about the latest industry trends, best practices, and system updates to continuously enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of R2R processes within CFIN.
  • Project and New Demand Management: Take ownership of configuring new demands or changes in system functionality, ensuring proper alignment with system design documentation and business requirements. R2R-Related Data Management: Oversee the management and accuracy of R2R-related data within the system, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and compliance with business rules across all R2R processes.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field. Relevant certifications in R2R/ FICO - SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN, or IT architecture. Proven experience (5+ years) in R2R process management, with a strong background in system configuration and implementation within SAP or similar ERP environments (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, SAP CFIN).
  • Strong functional knowledge of Record to Report processes, including Hyperion & Financial Management & reconciliations Experience in configuring R2R processes in SAP or similar ERP systems, with a solid understanding of integration points and data flows across systems. Familiarity with Central Finance (CFIN) and integration with other finance-related modules. Experience with requirements gathering, business analysis, and documentation of functional specifications. High level understanding of Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation & should have good exposure in making Rules/Exposures & locking down the complex scenario to make better ICMR capabilities with more futuristic visibility.
  • High level understanding of Balance sheet account reconciliation & how this concept can help us to achieve wider view, Visibility based on Hyperion & Financial Management & reconciliations done on various levels, High level understanding of global & structural on FSVs: Financial statements Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and technical teams.
  • A strong focus on continuous improvement and automation, with a passion for driving innovation within enterprise systems. Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and third-party service providers to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions. Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, dynamic work environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

job.description:
