ABB’s Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world’s largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner.

We offer a broad range of automation, electrification and digital solutions for process, hybrid and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control and software as well as measurement and analytics solutions and services.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, we are looking for an experienced Principal Software Engineer – Full Stack to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role requires a strong technical leader with extensive experience in React or Angular, .NET, and modern software architecture to design and deliver scalable industrial software platforms.

You will lead the architecture and development of cloud-native, high-performance applications that integrate Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) systems while driving engineering excellence across the software development lifecycle. You will also champion AI-assisted software engineering practices by enabling development teams to leverage LLM-powered coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate software delivery, testing, and architectural decision-making.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • ### Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable full-stack applications using React/Angular, .NET, microservices, and cloud-native technologies while ensuring high performance, maintainability, and software quality.
  • ### Drive engineering excellence by defining software architecture standards, mentoring development teams, promoting best practices, and leading adoption of modern software development methodologies including AI-assisted engineering workflows.
  • ### Design and deliver secure, reliable, and highly available industrial software solutions by integrating enterprise applications with automation platforms, real-time communication protocols, REST APIs, WebSockets, and modern cloud technologies.
  • ### Collaborate with architects, product managers, and cross-functional engineering teams to deliver complex software solutions, reduce technical debt, improve system performance, and ensure predictable delivery of high-quality releases.

Qualifications for the role:

  • ### 12+ years of experience in Full Stack Software Development with strong expertise in .NET (C#), ASP.NET Core, React or Angular, and enterprise-scale application development.
  • ### Proven experience designing scalable microservices architectures, RESTful APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications using modern software engineering principles.
  • ### Strong knowledge of SQL Server, PostgreSQL or NoSQL databases along with backend frameworks, ORM technologies, and frontend state management concepts.
  • ### Experience with Azure or AWS cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes/K3s), DevOps practices, and software security standards.
  • ### Good understanding of industrial automation technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, SCADA, MES, IoT platforms, and integration between Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) systems is preferred.
  • ### Demonstrated technical leadership with experience mentoring engineers, defining engineering standards, driving architectural decisions, and successfully delivering complex enterprise software solutions across cross-functional teams.
  • ### BE/BTech/ME/MTech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related engineering disciplines with excellent communication skills and passion for innovation, continuous learning, and AI-driven software engineering practices.

More about us

ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area automates, electrifies and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial infrastructures. Through its five divisions, it serves customers across energy, process, hybrid and maritime industries by delivering innovative automation, digitalization and industrial software solutions that enable safer, smarter and more sustainable operations.

Production Manager ###

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. That's our story. Make it your story.

In this role, you will support the deployment of the continuous improvement strategy for a local organizational unit, including promoting a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Mentors and coaches’ teams achieve operational excellence and drive improved results. Deploys and leads projects to improve and sustain local business performance.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Smart power Business and the role reports to Manufacturing Quality Manager and is in Nelamangala, Bangalore, India as a Quality Specialist /Test Engineering Supervisor, will support production processes to ensure optimization of cost, quality and on time delivery of products.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Safety, Production & Resource Management: Ensure people and equipment safety by assessing risks and implementing preventive measures; manage production resources, manpower, overtime, leave, and testing requirements to ensure smooth operations.
  • Quality, Testing & Compliance: Ensure conformance to quality and production requirements, including torque verification, equipment calibration, production test system validation, and adherence to the Quality Management System.
  • Technical & Cross-Functional Support: Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, Project, Sales, Quality, and Service teams to validate new hardware/software releases, resolve technical issues, support new product introductions, and provide technical updates on LV Switchgear & Controlgear.
  • Continuous Improvement & Capability Development: Participate in PFMEA and problem-solving activities, identify and implement process improvement initiatives, and support employee onboarding, training, and cross-functional skill development.
  • Customer & Factory Support: Support customer issue resolution and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), conduct customer visits when required, and coordinate with manufacturing factories to provide technical support and ensure timely resolution of product and process issues.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related field, with a minimum of 5 years of quality experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Supervisory Experience: Prior experience in a supervisory role with the ability to lead teams, coordinate laboratory/testing activities, and ensure timely execution of quality requirements.
  • Electrical & Mechanical Testing: Hands-on experience in electrical/mechanical testing, troubleshooting, electronics assembly, and laboratory testing of products and components.
  • Quality Standards & Systems: Strong understanding of ISO 9001:2015 requirements, with familiarity with IEEE, UL, IEC/EN 62040-3 standards and SAP.
  • Test Equipment & Specialized Testing: Experience in calibration and handling of test equipment, non-conforming material disposition, test parameter verification, wire continuity, HiPot testing, CT ratio testing, and power quality analysis.
  • Test Setup & Documentation: Ability to prepare test samples, design and build electrical/mechanical test fixtures and setups, develop special test procedures, and accurately record test data, observations, calculations, charts, and graphs.
  • Laboratory Quality & Reporting: Conduct environmental, mechanical, and electrical laboratory tests in accordance with defined procedures; identify abnormalities, analyze results, and prepare clear, concise, and accurate laboratory reports.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. job.title: Principal Engineer - Architect
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Lead ###

In this role, you will have the opportunity to initiate and drive technology, software, product, and/or solution development using in-depth technical expertise in a specific area. Each day, you will act as the first point of contact in Research and Development (R&D) for in-depth product or technology-related issues. You will also showcase your expertise by supporting strategic corporate technology management and future product/software/solution architecture.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid #LI Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Process Automation Business of Process Control Platform Division in Bangalore Location.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Design and develop scalable cloud-native and edge-enabled industrial software solutions using microservice architectures.
  • Drive end-to-end product development from requirements analysis and architecture design through implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Define and govern application, data, integration, and security architectures across cloud and edge environments.
  • Lead major technology initiatives, providing technical direction, mentorship, and architectural oversight to engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with product management, R&D teams, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
  • Establish and promote software engineering best practices, coding standards, and architectural governance.
  • Drive DevOps adoption, CI/CD strategies, automated testing, and release management practices.
  • Ensure high availability, scalability, observability, and maintainability of distributed systems.
  • Champion cybersecurity principles, secure-by-design approaches, and compliance with industrial security standards.
  • Lead quality improvement initiatives, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement programs across the product portfolio.
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies in cloud, edge computing, industrial connectivity, and AI-driven solutions.
  • Contribute to strategic technology roadmaps aligned with ABB’s industrial digitalization and automation objectives.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 15+ years of hands-on software engineering experience with C#/.NET/.NET Core and modern web technologies.
  • Strong expertise in microservices, distributed systems, software architecture patterns, SOLID principles, and system design.
  • Experience designing and implementing IoT solutions using REST APIs, WebSocket, MQTT, AMQP, or similar technologies.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, MicroShift, K3s, or other container and edge orchestration platforms.
  • Strong cloud-native experience on Azure, AWS, or GCP, preferably for Industrial IoT workloads, including Azure IoT Hub or AWS IoT Core.
  • Deep understanding of security concepts including OAuth2, OpenID Connect, Zero Trust architecture, PKI, certificate management, and secure edge deployments.
  • Experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms, including automated testing and release strategies.
  • Strong knowledge of observability practices, including logging, monitoring, tracing, and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
  • Experience with relational and non-relational databases, time-series data management, historian integration, and industrial data modeling.
  • Familiarity with industrial communication technologies such as OPC UA and industrial standards such as ISA-95.
  • Awareness of industrial cybersecurity and compliance frameworks including IEC 62443 and ISO 27001, with experience applying them in enterprise or industrial environments.
  • Experience in working within agile teams, e.g., using SCRUM or SAFe

More about us:

ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Regulatory Compliance Coordinator
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

At Caterpillar, the work we do matters. For more than 100 years, we've delivered products and solutions that support mining, construction, and infrastructure worldwide. Our teams combine practical engineering expertise, manufacturing excellence, and disciplined execution to deliver equipment that performs in the toughest conditions.

As a global leader in mining equipment, we are committed to designing safe, reliable, and compliant products that meet the evolving needs of customers and regulators around the world.

What You’ll Be Doing

This is an exciting opportunity for a compliance, engineering, or product safety professional who enjoys working across technical, regulatory, and business functions to ensure products meet global safety and certification requirements.

You'll work closely with Engineering, Product Groups, Caterpillar Product Compliance & Safety, certification agencies, and regulatory authorities to:

  • Lead product regulatory compliance activities across our Underground Hard Rock product portfolio
  • Support new product development, market expansion, and continuous product improvement initiatives
  • Ensure products meet applicable global regulatory, safety, and certification requirements

Importantly, we're open to candidates from a range of backgrounds including product compliance, product safety, engineering, certification, or regulatory roles within mining, heavy equipment, construction, rail, defence, oil & gas, or other highly regulated industries.

Your mission is to ensure Caterpillar products can be delivered confidently into global markets while meeting the highest standards of safety, compliance, and product integrity. This role extends beyond documentation and certification activities. You will work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the product lifecycle, identifying compliance requirements, supporting risk assessments, and driving successful certification outcomes.

In addition, you will collaborate with internal specialists and external authorities to monitor emerging regulatory requirements and implement appropriate compliance strategies that support both business objectives and customer needs.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead and coordinate product compliance activities across the Underground Hard Rock product portfolio
  • Act as the primary point of contact for product regulatory compliance matters
  • Interpret and communicate global regulations, directives, standards, and legislative requirements
  • Prepare and maintain Technical Construction Files and related compliance documentation
  • Manage product certifications, approvals, and relationships with third-party certification agencies
  • Develop and maintain Declarations of Conformity and supporting compliance records
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI), Continuous Product Improvement (CPI), New Market Introduction (NMI), and New Source Introduction (NSI) programs
  • Determine market-specific compliance requirements and product certification needs
  • Coordinate compliance activities between engineering, legal, product management, certification agencies, and other stakeholders
  • Facilitate product safety risk assessments and support risk mitigation activities
  • Review and approve compliance validation reports and certification documentation
  • Monitor emerging regulatory changes and coordinate implementation plans with relevant teams
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of product compliance processes and governance frameworks

What You Will Bring

We're looking for a technically capable professional who can translate complex regulatory requirements into practical business outcomes. Ideally you will have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Safety Engineering, Product Compliance, or a related discipline
  • Experience in product compliance, product safety, engineering, certification, quality, or regulatory affairs
  • Knowledge of international product safety standards, machinery regulations, and certification requirements
  • Experience participating in product risk assessments and product safety reviews
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

In this role, The Quality Specialist is responsible for ensuring product and process quality across the assembly line, meeting customer quality standards, and driving continuous improvement through structured problem-solving, process audits, inspections, and compliance with ISO 9001:2015 requirements. You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Quality Assurance & Compliance: Ensure product and process quality as per customer requirements, ISO 9001:2015 standards, drawings, PCPs, and defined quality procedures; monitor and improve key quality KPIs.
  • Inspection & Non-Conformance Management: Conduct visual, dimensional, functional, and pre-dispatch inspections; identify non-conformities, perform RCA, manage UD clearance, customer complaints, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions.
  • Process Quality & Validation: Maintain and update PFMEA, Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and Work Instructions; conduct process validation, Cp/Cpk capability studies, LPA, poka-yoke audits, and support FPY improvement.
  • Calibration & Quality Documentation: Ensure timely calibration and upkeep of electrical/mechanical equipment and process instruments; maintain accurate daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual quality reports and records.
  • Continuous Improvement & Cost Reduction: Review FPY, Final Yield, Rework Yield, IFC, and Customer Complaint PPM; support Kaizen, OPEX/cost-saving initiatives, 5S, and structured problem-solving activities to raise quality and cut process losses.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Education & Experience: Diploma or bachelor’s degree in mechanical or electrical engineering with 4+ years of relevant experience in Process Quality within a manufacturing environment.
  • Industry Exposure: Prior experience in Switchgear, Automobile, Electrical, or similar manufacturing industries, with practical experience in production quality processes.
  • Quality Management Systems: Good knowledge of ISO 9001:2015, PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow Diagrams, Work Instructions, and quality documentation.
  • Statistical & Technical Skills: Proficiency in SPC, Cp/Cpk capability analysis, Minitab, calibration processes, and Poka-Yoke; basic knowledge of IEC 60898-1, IEC 60947-2, and IEC 61008-1 standards.
  • Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement: Practical skills in RCA, 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa/Fishbone, and DMAIC, with the ability to analyze quality trends, investigate failures, and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Systems & Reporting: Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SAP for documentation, reporting, UD clearance, lot tracking, and inventory management; Windchill knowledge.
  • Communication & Ownership: effective communication and cross-functional collaboration with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, EHS, Maintenance, and R&D teams; prepared to support shift work, handle several priorities, and support quality improvement initiatives with accountability

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications.   • Quality, Safety & Compliance Assess operational risks and safety hazards, implement corrective measures, ensure compliance with all quality, production, and equipment safety requirements.
  • Process Control & Validation Ensure torque verification, equipment calibration, and validation of production test systems while implementing effective control plans to mitigate process risks.
  • Continuous Improvement & Project Execution Identify opportunities for improvement, oversee process enhancement projects, and advance operational excellence initiatives to boost quality and efficiency.
  • Customer Support & Issue Resolution Support customer issue resolution, participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and act as an interface between the customer and internal teams during critical quality discussions.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Demonstrated knowledge of quality management systems and standards, including ISO 9001:2015, IEEE standards, UL requirements, IEC 60947, EN 62040-3, along with proficiency in SAP systems.
  • Practical experience with calibration and test equipment, non-conforming material disposition, layout testing parameters, wire continuity testing, HiPot (HV) testing, CT ratio testing, and power quality analysis.
  • Prior experience working with Low Voltage (LV) Switchgear products and a good understanding of manufacturing processes and industrial applications.
  • Detail-oriented professional with a solid background in structured problem solving and ongoing improvement, contributing to better quality and more efficient operations.

job.title: Finance Analyst-Intercompany
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Accounting & Reporting Manager - AR

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support account receivables and/or credit activities in line with defined strategies, policies, and procedures. Each day, you will be responsible for managing and analyzing accounts receivable data. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring accurate financial reporting and compliance with the relevant accounting standards.

The work model for the role is: onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Managing month end and year end closing activities, including posting intercompany journal entries, accruals and managing foreign exchange (FX) impacts.
  • Performing intercompany matching and reconciliation to resolve imbalances.
  • Ensuring accuracy in financial records and timely month-end closing.
  • Overseeing the intercompany payment settlements and clearing within group entities.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

  • Experience & Education: You hold a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in finance and have a demonstrated track record in financial management and comfortable working in English , Generally 1–4 years for analysts.
  • Functional Skills: Strong knowledge of Intercompany Reconciliation (ICR), General Ledger (GL), Accruals and Balance Sheet Reconciliation.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP FICO and MS Excel.
  • Process Expertise: End-to-end month-end closing includes accruals calculation, supporting group team in terms of financial reporting, and intercompany settlements (IC Matching) Soft Skills:- High attention to detail, analytical skills, ability to work under tight deadlines, and good communication
  • You hold a valid India work permit, and you are comfortable working in Bangalore as work Location.
  • Permanent shift timings 05:30 PM to 02:30 AM – Currently 3 weeks working from office and 1 week WFH.

job.title: Commissioning Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Commissioning&Warranty Suport Specialist

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for leading and executing commissioning activities for marine and port projects, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality project delivery in accordance with contractual, technical, and cybersecurity requirements. You will work closely with project teams, site personnel, contractors, and customers to support installation, testing, commissioning, and final acceptance activities. Your expertise will contribute to successful project execution and customer satisfaction while upholding ABB's commitment to safety, integrity, and operational excellence.

The work model for the role is: Onsite (Most of the time at site - fabrication yard or site office)

This role is contributing to the Offshore solution under AUEN – eHouse solution, supporting ASEAN region, majority will be in Batam, Singapore) Main stakeholders. (Engineering, Planner, Construction, MC, QA/QC, Factory, warranty, warehouse, field service engineers)

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Planning, coordinating, and executing commissioning activities for marine and port automation, electrification, and control system projects, ensuring delivery in accordance with project specifications, quality standards, and schedules.
  • Supporting and coordinating installation and commissioning activities with Site Managers, Project Managers, contractors, and customers to ensure safe and efficient project execution.
  • Conducting testing, troubleshooting, commissioning design updates, and documentation mark-ups, ensuring accurate as-built documentation and technical completion of projects.
  • Ensuring compliance with ABB safety, quality, cybersecurity, and contractual requirements while supporting customer acceptance testing, project close-out activities, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications for the role

  • You hold a Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Marine Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • You have experience in commissioning, field service, installation, testing, or project execution within marine, port, industrial automation, power, or electrification environments.
  • You possess a solid understanding of electrical distribution, automation, control systems, drives, or marine electrical systems, with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues on site.
  • You are experienced in coordinating site activities with project teams, contractors, and customers, ensuring projects are delivered safely and efficiently.
  • You have strong knowledge of HSE requirements and demonstrate commitment to safety, quality, compliance, and cybersecurity standards in project execution.
  • You are a proactive problem-solver with strong communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of working independently in a dynamic project environment.
  • You communicate effectively in English and are willing to travel domestically and internationally, including working onboard vessels and at customer sites when required.

More about us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

job.description:

HR Delivery Manager

Key Responsibilities:

• Manage end-to-end compensation and benefits administration, including support for annual compensation reviews, incentive cycles, and sales incentive processes.

• Ensure accurate maintenance and integrity of compensation data across local and global HR systems, including calculation and administration of production worker and sales incentives.

• Deliver high-quality service to internal stakeholders by ensuring timely, accurate processing and communication of compensation-related information.

• Execute Compensation & Benefits services in alignment with defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and organizational standards.

• Prepare and provide required documentation and data for audits and external regulatory authorities, ensuring compliance with applicable policies and regulations.

• Maintain and update compensation data in relevant systems, ensuring accuracy and completeness at all times.

• Address employee queries efficiently through HR case management tools (e.g., ServiceNow), ensuring a positive employee experience.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and support process optimization projects within the Compensation & Benefits function.

Must have experience in Payroll and Salary Calculation

• Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Minimum of 3 -5 years of experience in Payroll, Compensation & Benefits and incentive planning within an HR Shared Services environment, preferably in a global organization.

• Hands-on experience with Workday HR systems.

• Strong understanding of Workday Core Compensation; knowledge of Advanced Compensation modules is an added advantage.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders across all levels.

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting, and the use of advanced functions such as Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, complex formulas, and data validation

job.title: HR Operations Team Lead - Compensation and Benefits
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

HR Delivery Manager ###

Key Responsibilities

1. Compensation & Benefits Operations - Cluster Countries

Lead and manage end-to-end C&B operations for assigned cluster countries, ensuring timely and accurate execution of all rewards transactions.

Oversee salary benchmarking, pay review cycles, merit increase processing, and market data analysis for cluster geographies.

Ensure country-specific compensation structures and benefit programmes are maintained and aligned with global ABB policy.

Manage benefits enrolment, renewals, vendor coordination, and employee queries related to health, wellness, retirement, and other benefit plans.

Partner with local HRBPs and country HR teams to address C&B escalations, exceptions, and complex cases.

Maintain data integrity in HR systems (Workday / SAP) for all compensation and benefits records across cluster countries.

2. Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) Process Management

Own and drive the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) process end-to-end for Global: from target setting, mid-year review, year-end calculation to payout processing.

Coordinate with P&R, HRBPs, and Business Leaders to ensure accurate AIP eligibility lists, payout calculations, and exception management.

Manage AIP communication and employee-facing documentation in coordination with HR Front Office and COE.

Ensure all AIP activities comply with ABB global guidelines, local labour laws, and audit requirements.Perform quality checks and reconciliation of AIP data before final payroll submission.

Track AIP timelines, identify risks, and proactively escalate issues to the Hub Delivery Manager.

3. Team Leadership & Performance Management

Lead a team of C&B specialists; manage work allocation, capacity planning, and business continuity. Conduct regular performance reviews, one-on-ones, and development conversations. Coach and mentor team members to build technical C&B capability and process expertise.

Foster a high-performance, customer-centric, and collaborative team culture.

Handle escalations with composure and resolve complex issues in a timely manner.

4. Compliance & Regulatory Adherence

Ensure all C&B operations comply with local labour laws, statutory regulations, GDPR, and ABB internal controls across cluster countries.

Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and evidence.

Monitor regulatory changes impacting compensation and benefits in cluster geographies and implement required updates.

5. Stakeholder Engagement & Customer Experience

Build strong partnerships with HRBPs, COEs, Finance, and Payroll teams across cluster countries.

Proactively manage stakeholder communication on C&B matters, process timelines, and issue resolution.

Analyse customer satisfaction feedback and drive continuous improvement in C&B service delivery.

Serve as the primary point of contact for all C&B-related escalations from cluster country stakeholders.

6. Operational Optimization & Innovation

Continuously review C&B processes to identify inefficiencies and implement improvements. Leverage HR technology (Workday, SAP, ServiceNow) to automate and streamline C&B workflows.

Support global HR initiatives such as total rewards redesign, policy harmonisation, and M&A activities. Explore AI-enabled tools and analytics to enhance C&B reporting, benchmarking, and decision support.

Qualification for the role

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Administration, or other relevant fields
  • Must have 7 to 10 years of experience in the Compensation and Performance function

Should possess excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong analytical abilities and strategic thinking.

  • Excellent user knowledge of Microsoft Office and Excel skills and other analytic tools and techniques is a must
  • Must have team handling and delegation skills and the ability to create a learning atmosphere among team members
  • Strong Customer service orientation and collaborative and conflict-resolving skills is an added advantage

job.description:

job.description:

Your role and responsibilities

Working as Global Product Manager - Industrial Networks, you will be a key member of the Global Product Management team within Process Control Platform. You will shape the future of secure and resilient industrial networking across ABB’s process automation portfolio.

The role is fundamental to the realization of ABB’s Automation Vision. You will own the network strategy and define how network technologies and products enable open, modular, interoperable and cyber-secure automation architectures while ensuring the reliability and continuity expected in mission-critical industrial operations.

The position combines strategic product management with a strong understanding of industrial automation, networking and cybersecurity. You will work across control system product lines and functions to turn technology trends, customer requirements and regulatory developments into a coherent roadmap, network portfolio and partner strategy.

The work model for the role is: hybrid.

This role is contributing to the Automation Process Control Platform (PCP).

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Define and manage the global strategy, roadmap and lifecycle for ABB’s OT network technology
  • Translate ABBs Automation Vision into secure, resilient, standards-based and interoperable network solutions
  • Lead customer, market, competitor and technology analysis, translating insights into requirements, business cases and differentiated value propositions
  • Develop strategic supplier and technology partnerships, including roadmap alignment, technical qualification and lifecycle commitments

Each day, you will provide technical and commercial leadership to support both internal and external customers, ensuring the delivery of high-quality proposals and solutions.   • Defining key performance targets and ensuring their achievement by monitoring progress, driving corrective actions, and enhancing customer support and service delivery outcomes.
  • Establishing, maintaining, and continuously improving RFQ, pricing, governance, and bid management processes to ensure consistency, compliance, and operational efficiency.
  • Driving the development of competitive, commercially sound proposals by evaluating market conditions, customer requirements, and the most effective delivery models, including direct sales, partnerships, consortiums, and channel strategies.
  • Overseeing the review and validation of commercial, technical, legal, and pricing terms within customer offers, while supporting bid/no-bid assessments and strategic decision-making.
  • Participating in project risk reviews and providing technical and commercial guidance throughout the sales process, ensuring Sales teams are equipped to successfully engage customers through presentations, negotiations, and solution discussions.

Qualifications for the role

  • Proven leadership experience in sales operations, bids, proposals, or commercial teams within process industries such as mining, metals, minerals, energy, or heavy industry.
  • Strong background in sales, business development, or commercial management within automation, electrification, digitalisation, or process control environments.
  • Experience developing and optimising sales systems, governance processes, and performance metrics in high-volume, customer-focused organisations.
  • Sound technical knowledge of industrial automation and electrification solutions, including DCS, PLCs, drives, process control systems, and digital technologies.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to identify opportunities, negotiate contracts, manage profitability, and drive business growth.
  • Degree qualified in Engineering, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline, with excellent communication, stakeholder management, and people leadership skills.

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based incentives
  • Flexible working arrangements and international travel opportunities
  • Professional development, training, and career growth support
  • Employee assistance program and local-specific benefits in Australia

More about us

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems.

The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

Each day, you will act as the first point of contact in Research and Development for specific product-related issues and maintenance. You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Maintaining recognized expertise in a specific area by integrating the latest developments in technologies, tools, and methodologies into your work.
  • Finding new ways of solving problems by following your ideas, creating hypotheses, and defining ways to validate them.
  • Documenting work results (like findings, designs, or software), allowing others to maintain and improve them.
  • Understanding and initiating IP generation in your area of specialization and participating in the project IP strategy development.

Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering (should be full-time)
  • Minimum 8 to 12 years of experience in Design and Development of Mechanical Parts and Assemblies (Sheet-Metal components, Casted & Machined Metal parts and Molded Plastic parts)
  • Hands-on experience in prototyping, type testing, and interpreting technical drawings.
  • Proficiency in SolidWorks or Creo 3D CAD software.
  • Strong technical knowledge of Medium Voltage Switchgear (CSS / RMU / Transformers)

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

  • Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and explanations.

  • Allocate workloads and monitor team performance against KPIs and SLAs.

  • Collaborate with business units, real estate teams, procurement, legal, and controllers.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for lease accounting matters.
  • Support global finance and business stakeholders with accounting guidance.
  • Manage escalations and resolve complex accounting issues.

  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through standardization and automation.
  • Lead system enhancement projects and process transformation initiatives.
  • Support implementation and optimization of lease accounting tools (CoStar, Trintech Cadency).
  • Develop and maintain process documentation and SOPs.

Governance & Controls

  • Ensure adherence to financial controls and company policies.
  • Monitor aging items, reconciliation exceptions, and control failures.
  • Track and report operational metrics to management.

Required Qualifications

  • A master’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce (MBA/Mcom) is must.
  • Minimum 10to 12 years of experience in Lease Accounting and Record to Report GA.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting quality assurance activities to ensure products, processes, systems, software and services meet specified requirements and customer expectations in incoming material, manufacturing, factory test labs, and final inspection including internal testing routine and Customer / Factory Acceptance Testing (F.A.T.) as applicable.
  • Supporting quality control/assurance needs and activities for production quality, customer quality, supplier quality, testing and validation, and engineering, as applicable in the local organization and sister factories globally.

Qualifications for the role

  • You possess advanced knowledge of quality management systems, testing standards (ISO, IEC), and Factory Acceptance Testing (F.A.T.) procedures and are highly proficient in data recording, analysis and interpretation tools.
  • You are passionate about attention to detail, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement with a demonstrated ability to communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You demonstrate expertise in electrical systems, power electronics, or UPS/critical power applications or have a strong willingness to develop specialized knowledge in these areas.
  • You hold a qualification in electrical/electronic engineering, quality assurance or a related technical discipline, or have an equivalent combination of relevant experience and certifications (such as ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, Lean / Six Sigma Belts).
  • You are at ease communicating in English and have strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • You are flexible to work following extended production schedule, as necessary.

More about us

In ABB's Critical Power division, our customers require reliable and efficient power that supports their growing infrastructure, ensuring that data flows 24x7, while optimizing their footprint, energy costs and operations. They rely on us to provide the latest industry insights and technology to develop solutions needed to meet their evolving challenges. We are a customer-first provider of innovative critical power solutions that are designed for high reliability and performance. Our culture is one of quality and operational excellence which is fuelled and supported by our talented people, tools and processes, and our "know how."

ABB is a global leader in technology and engineering, dedicated to serving a wide range of industries through electrification, automation, and digitalization. Our commitment to innovation, sustainability, and excellence drives our mission to improve quality of life and support the energy transition globally.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Regulatory Compliance Coordinator
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

At Caterpillar, the work we do matters. For more than 100 years, we've delivered products and solutions that support mining, construction, and infrastructure worldwide. Our teams combine practical engineering expertise, manufacturing excellence, and disciplined execution to deliver equipment that performs in the toughest conditions.

As a global leader in mining equipment, we are committed to designing safe, reliable, and compliant products that meet the evolving needs of customers and regulators around the world.

What You’ll Be Doing

This is an exciting opportunity for a compliance, engineering, or product safety professional who enjoys working across technical, regulatory, and business functions to ensure products meet global safety and certification requirements.

You'll work closely with Engineering, Product Groups, Caterpillar Product Compliance & Safety, certification agencies, and regulatory authorities to:

  • Lead product regulatory compliance activities across our Underground Hard Rock product portfolio
  • Support new product development, market expansion, and continuous product improvement initiatives
  • Ensure products meet applicable global regulatory, safety, and certification requirements

Importantly, we're open to candidates from a range of backgrounds including product compliance, product safety, engineering, certification, or regulatory roles within mining, heavy equipment, construction, rail, defence, oil & gas, or other highly regulated industries.

Your mission is to ensure Caterpillar products can be delivered confidently into global markets while meeting the highest standards of safety, compliance, and product integrity. This role extends beyond documentation and certification activities. You will work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the product lifecycle, identifying compliance requirements, supporting risk assessments, and driving successful certification outcomes.

In addition, you will collaborate with internal specialists and external authorities to monitor emerging regulatory requirements and implement appropriate compliance strategies that support both business objectives and customer needs.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead and coordinate product compliance activities across the Underground Hard Rock product portfolio
  • Act as the primary point of contact for product regulatory compliance matters
  • Interpret and communicate global regulations, directives, standards, and legislative requirements
  • Prepare and maintain Technical Construction Files and related compliance documentation
  • Manage product certifications, approvals, and relationships with third-party certification agencies
  • Develop and maintain Declarations of Conformity and supporting compliance records
  • Support New Product Introduction (NPI), Continuous Product Improvement (CPI), New Market Introduction (NMI), and New Source Introduction (NSI) programs
  • Determine market-specific compliance requirements and product certification needs
  • Coordinate compliance activities between engineering, legal, product management, certification agencies, and other stakeholders
  • Facilitate product safety risk assessments and support risk mitigation activities
  • Review and approve compliance validation reports and certification documentation
  • Monitor emerging regulatory changes and coordinate implementation plans with relevant teams
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of product compliance processes and governance frameworks

What You Will Bring

We're looking for a technically capable professional who can translate complex regulatory requirements into practical business outcomes. Ideally you will have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Safety Engineering, Product Compliance, or a related discipline
  • Experience in product compliance, product safety, engineering, certification, quality, or regulatory affairs
  • Knowledge of international product safety standards, machinery regulations, and certification requirements
  • Experience participating in product risk assessments and product safety reviews
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively across engineering, manufacturing, legal, and commercial teams
  • Strong analytical, organisational, and project coordination capability
  • High attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving

Highly Regarded

  • Experience within mining, underground equipment, heavy mobile equipment, construction machinery, rail, defence, or oil & gas industries
  • Familiarity with global machinery legislation and certification frameworks
  • Experience working with regulatory authorities and third-party certification bodies
  • Knowledge of compliance management systems and technical document control processes
  • Exposure to global product certification and market-entry requirement

Why Join the Burnie Product Development Team

Burnie has a proud heritage in underground mining equipment design and development and remains a key location within Caterpillar's global Underground Hard Rock Mining business. The site supports the engineering, validation, and product development activities that help deliver safe, reliable, and productive mining solutions to customers worldwide.

In this role you'll:

  • Contribute to products used in some of the world's most demanding underground mining operations
  • Partner with engineering, product safety, legal, and certification specialists across the Caterpillar enterprise
  • Play a critical role in supporting market access and regulatory compliance for global product launches
  • Influence product safety and design decisions throughout the product lifecycle
  • Be part of a highly experienced team recognised for its underground mining expertise
  • This is a site-based position located in Burnie, Tasmania, requiring attendance in the office 5 days per week. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Employee Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration, including bonus and share options.
  • Generous parental leave with flexible payment options
  • Strong commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunity
  • Employee discounts across health, wellbeing, travel, and retail
  • Global career progression and development opportunities within Caterpillar

How to Apply

If you're ready to take on a challenging and rewarding role with a global industry leader, apply via:

www.caterpillar.com/careers

Your road to success begins with Caterpillar.

Join a global leader and build a career with real impact. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

About FG WILSON

For over 50 years, FG Wilson generator sets have been trusted to provide essential power to a wide range of applications globally. From 6.8 to 2,500 kVA, FG Wilson oﬀers one of the widest ranges of diesel-fuelled generator sets, built in modern facilities in Brazil, China and India.

Over our long history, FG Wilson generator sets have been installed in more than 150 countries worldwide. You’ll ﬁnd our generator sets installed in many of the world’s most iconic buildings, in hospitals, banks, airports, data centres, factories, construction sites, hotels, oﬃces and telecommunications networks, quietly guaranteeing that they are never without electric power.

Role Definition:

The FG Wilson team is seeking a Pricing Analyst to join our Aftermarket team as we seek to achieve our ambitious targets to double our aftermarket revenue by 2030.

In this role you will partner with product, financial and industry teams to guide the execution of dynamic and differentiated pricing strategies that align with product and enterprise goals for revenue and profitability.

Responsibilities

  • Analyzes, interprets and communicates a wide variety of data (economic and competitive environment, revenue and profitability, and historical forecasted sales, prices, discounts and price realization) to draw business insights and recommend actions to maximize sales and profitability
  • Develops advanced strategic pricing recommendations for new and existing products and services to drive value-based pricing
  • Provides thought leadership to key stakeholders in the development of pricing strategies for new and existing products and services
  • Executes strategic and tactical price action within a robust pricing governance framework to implement future price changes

Skill Descriptors

Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.

Data Gathering & Analysis: Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.

  • Evaluates best practices of data gathering and analysis within the industry.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Value Selling: Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product/service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer needs.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Uses 'value selling' techniques to successfully engage customers.
  • Researches the customer's industry and organization before attempting sales calls.
  • Discusses issues and considerations regarding current 'value selling' practices and recommends potential improvements.
  • Quantifies proposed costs, benefits and value in customer terms.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Negotiating: Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.

  • Utilizes techniques for establishing rapport and building trust.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

This role is accountable for driving construction industries technology utilization and adoption at scale across dealer and customer operations. The focus is not just selling technology but ensuring it is actively used to deliver measurable productivity, safety, and aftermarket outcomes.

You will work directly with dealers and customers to close the gap between technology installed and technology used, driving execution in the field.

Key Responsibilities

Drive Utilization & Execution

  • Lead actions to increase utilization of Cat technologies across installed fleets (Grade, Payload, VisionLink, Safety)
  • Identify underutilized machines and work with dealers/customers to lift usage
  • Drive execution discipline — ensuring technology delivers real outcomes, not just activation

Dealer Capability & Accountability

  • Build dealer capability to support technology adoption and ongoing use
  • Set clear expectations and review dealer performance against utilization targets
  • Drive corrective actions where execution gaps exist

Customer Engagement & Value Delivery

  • Work directly with customers to improve jobsite performance through technology
  • Run jobsite reviews and identify productivity, safety, and efficiency gains
  • Translate technology into clear, practical customer value (not features)

Training & Enablement

  • Deliver targeted training to dealer teams and customers to improve adoption and usage
  • Support onboarding of new technologies and features into dealer operations
  • Ensure consistency in how technology is positioned and supported in the field

Opportunity & Growth Focus

  • Identify aftermarket and incremental sales opportunities driven by technology usage
  • Support growth in key growth metrics
  • Use data and insights to prioritise actions

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Work with product, digital, and support teams to resolve issues impacting adoption
  • Provide field feedback on product gaps, training needs, and commercialization barriers
  • Support rollout of GTM programs and new technology releases

Skills & Experience Required

  • Strong combination of sales capability and technical/application expertise
  • Deep experience in machine control & guidance, telematics, machine technology systems, and civil construction applications
  • Experience in construction, mining, or heavy equipment environments
  • Proven ability to drive execution through dealers and customers
  • Ability to translate data into clear actions and outcomes
  • Strong influencing skills; able to challenge and drive accountability
  • Hands-on, field-oriented approach with a focus on results

Compensation & Benefits:

Competitive salary based on degree and professional industry working experience. The Total Rewards package includes:

  • Competitive remuneration package
  • Attractive Bonus and Share options
  • Career development with global prospects
  • A strong commitment to safety and your wellbeing
  • An inclusive workplace culture focused on quality, customer service and the environment
  • A commitment to diversity and inclusion, equal opportunity, and equal outcome
  • SMART spending APP
  • The opportunity to do truly meaningful work in a supportive, constructive culture that encourages you to make the most of your talents.

Additional Information

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

For more information, visit caterpillar.com. To connect with us on social media, visit caterpillar.com/social-media

This employer is not currently hiring foreign national applicants that require or will require sponsorship tied to a specific employer, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities which can be found through our employment website at [www.Caterpillar.com/Careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/Careers)

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

August 25, 2026 - September 12, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

We’re a collaborative team with a shared vision to make the world a better place for our customers, our investors, our people, and the communities we operate in. We value innovation, integrity, determination, and sustainability, and [our purpose](https://au.goodman.com/about-goodman/our-purpose) is simple: to make space for greatness in everything we do.

Goodman encourages innovation at every level. We seek individuals who are eager to challenge conventional thinking, drive change, and develop new ideas that contribute to a sustainable and successful business. Your creativity and forward-thinking approach can make a tangible difference today and long into the future.

job.title: Site Leader - Thermal & Electric - El Paso Tx
job.description:
Job Description

The Site Leader will provide world class jobsite leadership for large, long-duration, high-profile projects for Vertiv power and/or thermal equipment. The Site Leader is the primary Vertiv Service on-site technical representative for large jobs, from construction start, through start-up, site acceptance testing, and project completion. The Site Leader is required to establish, grow and maintain excellent rapport with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives and others as appropriate. The Site Lead is required to work in tandem with the assigned Project Manager to drive cost controls, schedule adherence, resource management, and ultimately a positive customer experience.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

ROLE SUMMARY

  • Provide jobsite construction and technical leadership for large projects
  • Working knowledge of critical infrastructure equipment in data centers, including Vertiv-manufactured equipment
  • Leads a multi-disciplinary on-site team consisting of Project Leaders, Installers, Technicians, Customer Engineers, and subcontractors
  • Represents Vertiv at daily customer meetings and can speak to technical requirements for the day’s schedule to coordinate activity with other parties on-site
  • Leads and supports start-up and site testing activities for assigned projects
  • Ensure sufficient manpower on-site each day to perform start-up and site testing work
  • Assist during start-up and site testing as necessary, depending upon man-power availability and site location
  • Provide daily status reports to Service Management, Project Management and sales rep

TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Keeps current on Vertiv equipment start-up and commissioning processes, procedures, and tools-of-the-trade
  • Keeps current on Safety Bulletins, Safety Field Change Notices, Field Change Notices, and Service Tips

SAFETY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Leads daily Vertiv toolbox talk, pre-job safety walk and inspection, and drives any necessary corrective/preventative actions required in a timely fashion
  • Responsible for the adherence and administration of all site and Vertiv Safety policies on job sites
  • Operates in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Adhere to work hours policy guidelines – “14 hours rule”
  • Report all work related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel
  • Must be a role model to fellow associates with regards to safety by setting a positive example
  • Lead by example with the use of STOP WORK Authority, Good Catch engagement, and timely closure of necessary corrective/preventative actions

ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensure adherence to Vertiv Warranty process in partnership with Project Manager
  • Provide accurate and timely reporting in accordance with published guidelines
  • Timecards, expense reports, mileage reports, SR/task closure, forms, et al.
  • Supports Project Manager with obtaining any necessary technical data so Project Manager can maintain project systems
  • Maintain company property according to company policies
  • Credit cards, PPE, test equipment, laptop, smartphone, et al.

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Ensure daily alignment of customer expectations and Vertiv activity, and drive clarification/re-alignment if there appears to be misalignment of expectations
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates according to company guidelines

PERSONAL PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

  • Make decisions based on the Fundamental 5 in order of importance: Safety, Quality, Timeliness, Cost, Productivity
  • Capable of making timely decisions, technical and commercial, under pressure
  • Maintain productive utilization rate according to company guidelines
  • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations
  • Understand and comply with company startup/escalation process and procedures
  • In all aspects of job requirements, must lead by example, and conduct themselves aligned to Vertiv Behaviors
  • Ability to communicate with all levels within the organization -Managers, co-workers, Support Services, sales, electronic communications, et al.
  • Ability to handle stressful situations and provide a calming effect to customer
  • High level of diplomacy when interacting with internal and external customers

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience (one or more of the following)
  • ASEET or ASMET preferred
  • Equivalent industry experience, specifically leading and actively participating in start-up and commissioning of power and/or hvac equipment preferred
  • Six years’ military experience in a related field
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Industrial construction management
  • Interpersonal Skills
  • Vertiv Behavior practitioner
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Independent operator
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Able to build and maintain trusting customer relationships
  • Collaborative and cooperative in high-stress environments
  • Able to communicate at all levels of an organization with a base level of executive presence
  • Able to quickly respond to changing customer priorities without disruption or resistance
  • Must be able to read and interpret electrical one-line diagrams and blueprints
  • In all aspects of the job, need to lead by example, and be held to a higher standard of conduct
  • Product certifications up to date
  • Meet all aspects of the job description
  • Performance evaluation rating of meets all aspects of job requirement or better
  • Consistent performance and customer relation skills
  • Technical skills
  • Ability to make an immediate site evaluation, skills to include environmental temperature, and general operating conditions without supervision
  • Ability to summarize and report all work related tasks performed
  • Independently evaluate, recognize and recommend acceptable customer solutions based upon site evaluation
  • Recommend and direct activities at a customer site by leading technical activities of other technicians
  • Provide on-site customer consultation with the assistance of Project Leader(s)
  • Capable of providing project leadership and on-site direction for assigned projects
  • Expert in COHE procedures
  • Expert in site acceptance testing procedures and equipment
  • Computer skills
  • Advanced word processing, report generation
  • Spreadsheet processing
  • Electronic mail
  • Testing equipment and data analysis programs
  • Familiarity with computer networks
  • Mechanical aptitude

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Job assignments will typically be long-term assignments ranging from 4 weeks to 12+ months duration based upon the scope and schedule of the project
  • If assigned a project not located in the vicinity of Site Leader residence, travel will consist of a field rotation that includes (3) consecutive weeks on the customer site followed by (1) week of a service break in their home office whereby the Site Leader is expected to work their minimum of 40 hours on billable tasks and any administrative duties (i.e. Safety training, cycle counts, etc.) as necessary
  • Jobsites consisting of industrial new construction (greens field) or retrofit construction (browns field)
  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Deployable in the event of emergencies

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell. The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.  Must be able to consistently lift up to 50 pounds and occasionally up to 75 pounds.

Notes: Vertiv will make reasonable accommodations whenever necessary for all qualified employees or candidates with disabilities (as defined by applicable law), provided that (1) the individual is otherwise qualified to safely perform the essential functions of the job and (2) such accommodations due not impose an undue hardship.

_The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities._

_OUR CORE PRINCIPALS: Safety. Integrity.  Respect.  Teamwork. Diversity & Inclusion._

_OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES_

  • _Customer Focus_
  • _Operational Excellence_
  • _High-Performance Culture_
  • _Innovation_
  • _Financial Strength_

_OUR BEHAVIORS_

  • _Own It_
  • _Act With Urgency_
  • _Foster a Customer-First Mindset_
  • _Think Big and Execute_
  • _Lead by Example_
  • _Drive Continuous Improvement_
  • _Learn and Seek Out Development_

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs. Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks, and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Work Authorization

No calls or agencies please. Vertiv will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Vertiv is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We promote equal opportunities for all with respect to hiring, terms of employment, mobility, training, compensation, and occupational health, without discrimination as to age, race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy status (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression (including transgender status or sexual stereotypes), genetic information, citizenship status, national origin, protected veteran status, political affiliation, or disability. If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, you can request help by sending an email to [help.join@vertiv.com](mailto:help.join@vertiv.com)
