job.description:
Job Description

The Customer Engineer (CE) is responsible for installation, commissioning, scheduled and emergency service on Small to Large UPS, Power Distribution Units and other Power Products, & Battery system products (2-120KVA) serviced by Vertiv, commensurate with appropriate classroom and on-the-job training.  The Customer Engineer is required to establish, promote and maintain excellent rapport and collaboration with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives and others as appropriate.

RESPONSIBILITIES

ROLE

  • Perform service tasks as assigned and as per company policies and procedures
  • Capable of working under direct supervision or independently based upon training completion
  • Render on-site and phone assistance to customers
  • Communicate with Technical Support on technical or procedural issues
  • Implement Field Change Notices per published guidelines
  • Keep current on Safety Bulletins, Safety Field Change Notices, Field Change Notices, and Service Tips\[CS1\]

SAFETY

  • Operate in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Maintain and operate company vehicle in accordance with local laws and company policy
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Adhere to work hours policy guidelines – “14 hours rule”
  • Complete required Vertiv safety training assignments on time.
  • Adhere to on-site Customer safety requirements when applicable.
  • Report all work-related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel.

ADMINISTRATION

  • Complete accurate and timely administrative tasks (i.e. Timecards, expense report, mileage reports, Service Request task closure, service reports) per company guidelines\[CS2\]
  • Maintain individual inventory and perform cycle counts in accordance with company policy
  • Maintain company property (company vehicle, credit cards, PPE, test equipment, laptop, etc.) per company policies

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Provide estimated time of arrival to the customer where applicable
  • Complete scheduled maintenance documentation properly and provide to the customer and local office upon completion of each assignment
  • Strive to provide all customers a “first time fix” for their equipment
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates per company guidelines
  • Attend Customer Meetings as required

PERFORMANCE

  • Maximize productivity by combining service opportunities
  • Complete all technical and administrative work in an efficient and timely manner
  • Capable of making technical and commercial decisions under pressure
  • Properly evaluate site and equipment for appropriate billing status

QUALIFICATIONS

  • ASEET or AMEET, or progress towards, is preferred

Interpersonal and Administrative Skills

Technical skills

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Due to the safety sensitive aspect of the role, candidates are required to successfully pass a drug test prior to employment. In addition, you will also be required to complete and pass a pre-employment background check and a motor vehicle records check.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell. The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Must be able to consistently lift up to 50 pounds and occasionally up to 75 pounds.

job.title: Paralegal, Compliance Legal Services
job.description:
Job Description

The Contractor Licensing Specialist will be responsible for managing contractor and engineering licensing activities for Vertiv and its affiliates, helping ensure compliance while enabling business growth across multiple jurisdictions. In this highly collaborative role, you will oversee the licensing process from application through renewal, prepare and submit regulatory filings, and partner with internal stakeholders to complete applications. This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented professional who enjoys navigating regulatory requirements, building cross-functional relationships, and making a direct impact on the success of a growing global organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES

for the Contractor Licensing Specialist:

  • Managing and maintaining all existing licenses for Vertiv's corporate entities and affiliates across all applicable jurisdictions.
  • Owning the end-to-end licensing application and renewal process, including completing all forms, gathering required documentation, and ensuring submissions are accurate and timely.
  • Driving applications and renewals to completion.
  • Proactively determining additional licenses and classifications necessary to support Vertiv's current and planned business activities.
  • Coordinating with licensing boards, state agencies, and regulatory bodies to resolve issues, respond to deficiency notices, and keep applications moving.
  • Assisting with the development and maintenance of the licensing database to ensure accurate, real-time tracking of all license statuses, deadlines, and requirements.
  • Assisting with maintaining corporate records for Vertiv's corporate entities as they relate to licensing.

QUALIFICATIONS

job.title: Engineer I (Mechanical Engineer)
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The _Mechanical Engineer_ supports new product development for the company’s Thermal global products.  The Mechanical Engineer is responsible for the physical design and/or thermal system design of new products.  This engineer must be a practical hands-on type of engineer who can start with an abstract concept and see it through to product launch.  This position will support lab testing on 2nd shift.  Normal working hours will be approximately 11am to 8pm.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Creates/modifies mechanical Parts/Assemblies/drawings in CAD systems, such as Creo and/or Solid Edge.
  • Create and maintain Bill of Materials and unit configurator logic to select the correct BOM’s based on options selected by the customer.
  • Works with Marketing, Manufacturing, Service, and Quality to understand their requirements to design a product that best meets all of their needs.
  • Assist with prototype builds by providing technical support and providing guidance when issues arise.
  • Gather feedback from prototype builds and field trials and implement appropriate improvements to the product.
  • Understands the products, suggest ideas and improvements.
  • Assists with troubleshooting of escalated or re-occurring field issues.
  • Coordinate testing in the lab.
  • Analyze test data, diagnose issues and determine changes to improve performance.
  • Thermal system modeling to determine performance and correct part selection.
  • Determine controls routines needed to make system operate optimally and to meet customer requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent.
  • Basic working knowledge of mechanical and electrical concepts, products, and safety.
  • Basic mechanical CAD tools experience- Solid Edge, Creo (preferred), Solid Works.
  • Experience with sheet metal, piping, and assemblies is a plus.
  • Data-entry systems familiarity - Oracle, Agile, etc.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to solve (and prevent) a wide range of problems quickly and methodically.
  • Detail oriented.
  • Excellent planning, organizing, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and operate in cross functional global development teams.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

Job Description

ServiceNow Business Analyst

Overview

We are seeking a skilled and experienced ServiceNow Business Analyst to join our team. In this role, you will act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to analyze business processes, gather requirements, and translate them into effective non-custom ServiceNow solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with business stakeholders to elicit, analyze, and document business requirements related to ServiceNow platform implementations and enhancements.

Qualifications:

job.title: Test Automation & Process Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

Vertiv is seeking a Test Automation & Process Engineer for our Test Engineering team in Delaware, Ohio.

This is not a typical test-automation job. You will not write software-QA frameworks, Selenium suites, or RPA bots. You will not spend your days running electrical tests. You will build the systems that collect the data, analyze the results, and make the work easy to follow.

The job has three parts. Automate data collection from laboratory meters and instruments — precision power analyzers, oscilloscopes, and related measurement equipment. Create analysis tools — often using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor — for the electrical tests our engineers perform. Turn the team’s knowledge into simple, standard workflows using knowledge-management and AI-assisted tools. Internally this role is also called a Process Engineer. The work is process, but the method is automation, tooling, and knowledge made usable.

We hire for Safety, Integrity, and Hard Work. You will work in a high-power electrical laboratory. You will be expected to tell the truth, finish what you start, and leave the team faster than you found it.

Responsibilities

  • Automate test data collection. Build and maintain automated capture from precision power analyzers, oscilloscopes, power meters, data loggers, and probes. Interface over Ethernet, USB, GPIB, or serial using SCPI and standard instrument libraries. Replace manual reads, screenshots, and USB file pulls with clean, time-stamped datasets tied to the unit and the test. Make long-duration logging reliable enough to run without someone standing by.
  • Build analysis tools. Turn raw captures into engineering answers — efficiency, power quality, harmonics, transients, thermal performance, pass/fail against limits. Use AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor to ship useful software quickly. Make the tools self-service: if only you can run it, it is not done. Version-control, document, and support what you build. Not one-off scripts.
  • Make the work easy to follow. Write clear standard work and simple workflows for setup, data collection, analysis, and reporting. Capture what experienced engineers and technicians know and put it in searchable, well-structured knowledge bases. Use AI-assisted knowledge tools so the team can find and apply that information without hunting down the one person who knows. Train people on what you ship. Bring them along.
  • Work safely, in the open. Follow PPE, lockout/tagout, and lab safety rules without exception. Surface problems early, including your own. Partner with test engineers and technicians; translate their friction into tools they will actually use.

Requirements

  • B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, with 3+ years of relevant experience; or A.S. with 5+ years; or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Proof you have built automation or data-acquisition software. We will ask you to walk us through something you made and what changed because of it.
  • Python (or comparable) for instrument control, data processing, and analysis.
  • Experience controlling laboratory instruments programmatically over LAN, USB, GPIB, or serial.
  • Enough electrical-test knowledge to read a schematic and work productively with test engineers.
  • Willingness and discipline to work safely in a high-power electrical laboratory.
  • Clear writing. Procedures you write have to be followed by other people.
  • Self-directed. Find the friction, prove the fix, roll it out.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on work with precision power analyzers, oscilloscopes, and power-quality meters. (Yokogawa and Fluke preferred)
  • SCPI, VISA/PyVISA, LabVIEW, or similar instrument-control frameworks.
  • Power electronics, UPS, switchgear, transformers, energy storage, or power-quality measurement.
  • Building engineering tools with AI-assisted development environments (for example Cursor).
  • Experience standing up or curating engineering knowledge bases, document repositories, or AI-assisted search/Q&A for technical teams.
  • Git, and the habit of documenting what you ship.
  • Lean or continuous improvement, used in practice — not just certified.

How we expect you to work

  • Safety first. Lab rules are not optional.
  • Integrity. Tell the truth. Raise issues early.
  • Hard work. Write the software and pull the cable. Stay until it works. Document it so someone else can run it tomorrow.
  • Build for the team. Your score is how much faster everyone else becomes, not how much only you can do.

Physical and work environment

Split between desk and an active high-power electrical test laboratory.

Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and to stand or walk for extended periods.

PPE and safety training provided.

Travel up to 5-10%.

job.title: Senior Manager Quality Data Analytics
job.description:
Job Description

Role Purpose

Serves as the analytics subject matter expert for Quality & Continuous Improvement across EMEA, owning the design, development, and evolution of the EMEA-wide performance analytics architecture. Translates complex operational data into strategic insights that drive decision-making at senior leadership level. Acts as the bridge between business stakeholders and data — defining what to measure, how to measure it, and what it means.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics Architecture & Strategy

  • Design and own the EMEA Quality & CI KPI architecture — defining metrics, hierarchies, calculation logic, and data lineage across all Business Units
  • Establish standardised KPI definitions (Customer Claims, FPY, COPQ, Warranty, VoC, Supplier Quality) to enable consistent EMEA-wide comparison
  • Define the analytics roadmap for the function, identifying where advanced analytics, process mining, and AI-enabled approaches can add value
  • Architect the data model underpinning EMEA Quality & CI reporting — ensuring scalability, accuracy, and maintainability

Insight Development & Stakeholder Advisory

  • Develop and present monthly operating review analytics to senior leadership — translating data into narrative, identifying root causes, and recommending actions
  • Partner with BU Quality leaders to define leading indicators and predictive analytics that shift the function from reactive to proactive
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses on quality trends, warranty patterns, and supplier performance to surface systemic issues
  • Provide data-driven recommendations to Senior Director and VP-level stakeholders on performance improvement priorities

Platform & Capability Development

  • Design and build Power BI dashboards and reports that serve as the single source of truth for EMEA Quality & CI performance
  • Define requirements for data pipelines and integrations (SAP, Snowflake, other source systems)
  • Evaluate and implement process mining tools (Celonis or equivalent) to identify inefficiencies in quality processes
  • Drive automation of manual reporting — target 50% reduction in manual effort within 12 months
  • Develop reusable templates, calculation logic, and self-service analytics capabilities for the broader Quality team

Governance & Data Quality

  • Own the data governance framework for Quality & CI analytics — defining data ownership, refresh cadences, validation rules, and exception handling
  • Establish and maintain data quality standards; monitor and resolve discrepancies across source systems
  • Lead 8D maturity tracking methodology — defining scoring criteria and reporting dashboards

Required Skills & Experience

Technical (Must-Have)

  • Expert-level Power BI development (complex DAX, data modelling, row-level security, deployment pipelines)
  • Advanced SQL (query optimisation, stored procedures, complex joins across large datasets)
  • Data modelling and warehouse concepts (star schema, fact/dimension design)
  • Experience with process mining platforms (Celonis preferred)

job.title: Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

Vertiv is seeking an Electrical Engineering student entering their second year of college to join the Large Power Converters Product Engineering team as an intern.

This position provides an opportunity for an early-career engineering student to gain hands-on experience with large Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) and power-conversion systems. The intern will work alongside experienced engineers and participate in engineering laboratory testing, data collection, troubleshooting, documentation, and product-support activities.

No previous experience with UPS systems or power electronics is required. The position is designed to provide practical engineering experience while introducing the student to large-scale electrical systems and real-world engineering problem solving.

Key Responsibilities

Under the guidance of experienced Product Engineers, the intern will:

  • Assist with engineering laboratory testing of UPS and power-conversion equipment.
  • Help set up tests and collect electrical measurements and test data.
  • Assist with reviewing and organizing test results.
  • Learn to use engineering test equipment such as digital multimeters, oscilloscopes, current probes, and power analyzers.
  • Assist engineers with troubleshooting and investigation of product issues.
  • Review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and system drawings with guidance from experienced engineers.
  • Assist with documenting test results and engineering observations.
  • Help prepare and update test procedures, technical reports, drawings, and other engineering documentation.
  • Assist with basic analysis of electrical waveforms, event logs, and operating data.
  • Participate in engineering design reviews, troubleshooting discussions, and product meetings.
  • Work with engineering, manufacturing, quality, service, and product development teams to gain an understanding of the complete product lifecycle.
  • Support other engineering projects based on current product and laboratory needs.
  • Follow all applicable electrical and laboratory safety procedures.

Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electrical and Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • Entering the second year of an undergraduate engineering program.
  • Successful completion of first-year engineering coursework.
  • Basic understanding of electrical concepts from introductory engineering, physics, or electrical-circuit coursework.
  • Basic computer and data-analysis skills.
  • Strong interest in electrical engineering and hands-on technical work.
  • Willingness to learn and ask questions.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of an engineering team.

Previous experience with power electronics, UPS systems, or industrial electrical equipment is not required.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in any of the following areas is helpful but not required:

  • Introductory electrical circuits
  • Engineering laboratory coursework
  • Digital multimeters or oscilloscopes
  • MATLAB, Python, C/C++, or other programming languages
  • Microsoft Excel or other data-analysis tools
  • Electronics or electrical projects completed through coursework, student organizations, hobbies, or personal projects

Learning Opportunities

The intern will receive exposure to engineering areas that may not yet have been covered in their university coursework, including:

  • Large Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems
  • AC and DC power systems
  • Power electronics
  • Rectifiers and inverters
  • Batteries and DC power systems
  • Electrical controls and sensing
  • Embedded control systems
  • Electrical schematics and system diagrams
  • Oscilloscope and waveform analysis
  • Engineering laboratory testing
  • Root-cause analysis and troubleshooting
  • Product reliability and corrective actions
  • Manufacturing and field-support engineering
  • Mission-critical data center power systems

Internship Experience

This internship is intended to provide a student early in their Electrical Engineering education with meaningful exposure to real engineering work.

The intern will work directly with experienced engineers on active projects and product investigations. Assignments will be selected based on the student's current knowledge and will become progressively more challenging as their skills develop.

The emphasis will be on learning by working alongside engineers in the laboratory and on real products, rather than expecting the student to already possess specialized knowledge of power electronics or UPS systems.

By the end of the internship, the student should have a better understanding of how fundamental electrical engineering concepts learned in the classroom are applied to complex, high-power electrical systems.

Physical & Environmental Demands

  • Participation in engineering and R&D laboratory activities.
  • Work around large electrical and power-conversion equipment.
  • Laboratory work will be performed under appropriate supervision and in accordance with established electrical safety procedures.
  • Some hands-on activities may involve test setup, instrumentation, wiring, and equipment inspection.
  • Occasional travel to other Vertiv facilities may be available depending on project needs.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a student who is curious about how electrical systems work and eager to gain hands-on engineering experience.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, is comfortable asking questions, wants to learn from experienced engineers, and is interested in seeing how electrical engineering principles are applied to real products.

Prior UPS or power-electronics knowledge is not expected. Curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn are more important than specialized technical experience.

job.title: Field Service Technician - AC Power - Richmond/Norfolk, VA
job.description:
Job Description

The Field Service Technician is primarily responsible for scheduled and remedial (break-fix) service on Small to Medium UPS, Power Distribution Units & Battery system products (2-120KVA) serviced by Vertiv, commensurate with appropriate classroom and on-the-job training.  The Field Service Technician is required to establish, promote and maintain excellent rapport with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives and others as appropriate.  The Field Service Technician is primarily responsible to support products and services sold to our “Edge” market segment, including retail, financial, and municipal customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

ROLE

  • Perform service tasks as assigned and as per company policies and procedures
  • Capable of working under direct supervision or independently based upon training completion
  • Render on-site and phone assistance to customers
  • Communicate with Technical Support on technical or procedural issues
  • Implement Field Change Notices per published guidelines
  • Keep current on Safety Bulletins, Safety Field Change Notices, Field Change Notices, and Service Tips

SAFETY

  • Operate in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Maintain and operate company vehicle in accordance with local laws and company policy
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Adhere to work hours policy guidelines – “14 hours rule”
  • Report all work related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel.

ADMINISTRATION

  • Complete accurate and timely administrative tasks (i.e. Time cards, expense report, mileage reports, Service Request task closure, service reports) per company guidelines
  • Maintain individual inventory and perform cycle counts in accordance with company policy
  • Maintain company property (company vehicle, credit cards, PPE, test equipment, laptop, etc.) per company policies

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Provide estimated time of arrival to the customer where applicable
  • Complete scheduled maintenance documentation properly and provide to the customer and local office upon completion of each assignment
  • Strive to provide all customers a “first time fix” for their equipment
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates per company guidelines
  • Attend Customer Meetings as required

PERFORMANCE

  • Maximize productivity by combining service opportunities
  • Complete all technical and administrative work in an efficient and timely manner
  • Capable of making technical and commercial decisions under pressure
  • Properly evaluate site and equipment for appropriate billing status
  • Maintain productive utilization rate per company guidelines
  • Perform inventory cycle counts per company guidelines
  • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations
  • Meet or exceed on-site response time requirements for each customer
  • Understand and comply with company startup/escalation processes and procedures
  • Maintain proper and adequate level of internal communications

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience (one or more of the following)

  • ASEET or AMEET, or progress towards, is preferred
  • High School or Vocational School Diploma
  • 2-4 years military experience in a related technical field
  • 0-2 years of relevant industry experience

Interpersonal and Administrative Skills

  • Communicate professionally and respectfully in both written and verbal forms
  • Manage time effectively by prioritizing and balancing technical tasks with administrative tasks
  • Collaborative with peers, customers, suppliers, and leadership
  • Complete administrative tasks (i.e. report writing, time entry, expense reporting, material debriefing, inventory counting, etc.) in a timely fashion

Technical skills

  • Make basic site evaluation skills to include: environmental temperature, and general operating conditions
  • Familiarity with electrical / electronic test equipment and fundamentals
  • Follow written technical documentation (i.e. procedures and product manuals) to perform service tasks
  • Employ elementary fix/repair techniques based on directed supervision
  • Complete service tasks and return unit to full operating conditions based upon directed supervision
  • Summarize and report all work related tasks performed in written and verbal form
  • Efficient with a personal computer and associated applications (Microsoft Office, Vertiv software, etc.)

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Travel is required
  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Due to the safety sensitive aspect of the role, candidates are required to successfully pass a drug test prior to employment. In addition, you will also be required to complete and pass a pre-employment background check and a motor vehicle records check.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell. The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Must be able to consistently lift up to 50 pounds and occasionally up to 75 pounds.

Notes: Vertiv will make reasonable accommodations whenever necessary for all qualified employees or candidates with disabilities (as defined by applicable law), provided that (1) the individual is otherwise qualified to safely perform the essential functions of the job and (2) such accommodations due not impose an undue hardship.

job.title: Materials Planning Manager
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The Materials Planning Manager is a centralized team role responsible for ensuring on-time supply of materials across multiple manufacturing facilities within the Thermal AMER Business Unit. This role focuses on reviewing material supply for critical materials in the 8-week to 24-month planning horizon, coordinating with factory Materials Management teams, Procurement, and suppliers to ensure timely delivery in support of on-time customer order fulfillment.

Additionally, this role collaborates with factory teams and Procurement to execute sourcing projects that secure external supply capacity to support long-term internal capacity growth plans aligned to SIOP. The Materials Planning Manager provides critical input on mid-term and long-term supply risks to the constrained supply plan and drives necessary actions to ensure material availability across the planning horizon. This position requires strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills, combined with the initiative to drive projects from idea through execution and completion.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review and monitor material supply for critical materials across the 8-week to 24-month planning horizon, identifying risks and gaps that could impact on-time delivery of customer orders
  • Coordinate with factory Materials Management teams, Procurement, and suppliers to resolve material supply issues and ensure timely delivery across multiple manufacturing facilities
  • Translate SIOP outputs into actionable material supply plans, driving necessary actions to ensure supply of material in the mid-term to long-term planning horizon
  • Provide input on mid-term and long-term supply risks that need to be accounted for in the constrained supply plan
  • Collaborate with factory teams and Procurement to identify, initiate, and execute sourcing projects that secure external supply capacity aligned to long-term internal capacity growth plans
  • Drive sourcing projects from idea through execution and completion, managing timelines, stakeholders, and deliverables to ensure successful outcomes
  • Develop and maintain visibility to critical material supply status across the Thermal AMER BU, escalating risks and constraints as appropriate
  • Build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships with factory Materials Management, Procurement, Engineering, and Operations teams
  • Engage directly with suppliers as needed to address supply constraints, capacity concerns, and delivery performance
  • Support the SIOP process by providing material supply intelligence, constraint analysis, and risk assessments
  • Identify opportunities to improve material supply reliability, reduce lead times, and mitigate supply chain risk across the BU
  • Monitor supplier capacity and performance to proactively identify risks to long-term growth plans

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or related field
  • 4-8 years of progressive experience in materials management, supply chain, procurement, or planning within a manufacturing environment
  • Strong familiarity with the SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) process and the ability to translate SIOP outputs into material supply actions
  • Demonstrated project management skills with a track record of driving projects from concept through execution and completion
  • Experience coordinating across multiple manufacturing sites and cross-functional teams
  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills with the ability to work effectively across organizational boundaries without direct authority
  • Self-starter with the initiative to identify issues, develop solutions, and drive action independently
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess supply risks, evaluate capacity constraints, and develop mitigation plans
  • Experience with ERP/MRP and SCM systems (Oracle, Cyberplan, Kinaxis, or equivalent)
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to present supply risks and recommendations to leadership
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • The role is primarily based in an office environment but may requiring site visits and interaction with production teams.
  • Required to wear personal protective equipment (PPE) and adhere to safety protocols.
  • The role involves extended periods of sitting in front of a computer.
  • Occasional standing or walking may be required during meetings, presentations, or site visits.
  • Work is primarily conducted in an office environment with controlled temperature and lighting.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • Occasional travel to different office locations, client sites, or conferences may be necessary.

job.title: Application Development & Support Senior Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Brief Job Description:

  • The CPQ Developer is responsible for collecting requirements, design, development, testing, implementing and support of Configure, Price and Quote (CPQ) solutions throughout the enterprise.
  • This role will require working with Product Offering managers, analysts to capture the configuration , commerce needs associated with different products and services.
  • The ideal candidate should have prior implementation experiences of Oracle CPQ (BigMachines) system, demonstrate strong technical skills, hands on experience and good understanding of business processes, a focus on user experience improvement, and a drive to improve sales effectiveness and efficiency through implementation and maintenance of Vertiv’s CPQ system along with other associated applications like Sales Cloud CRM, Oracle EBS, Oracle PD/PIM.
  • The CPQ Developer must have hands on experience with all functions of Oracle CPQ (BigMachines) application especially configurator development.
  • CPQ Developer will work to achieve streamlined processes, superior quality of service, and outstanding reliability and availability.
  • CPQ Developer must be a self-starter, able to work independently with minimal supervision, comes with can-do, jump-right-in attitude.

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

  • Collaborate with representative from analysts, Product Offering managers to obtain requirements for products and services.
  • Designs best-in-class CPQ solutions to accommodate configuration, commerce requirements.
  • Supports highly integrated CPQ solutions either by extending existing functionality or build from beginning.
  • Build new and support existing SOA based integrations to CRM, ERP systems.
  • Provide suggestions to optimize utilization of Oracle CPQ for optimal performance.
  • Create and maintain product configurator specification including item master, sales UI, rules, pricing, proposals, submittals.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues to support smooth business operations.
  • Develop test scripts, execute to support ongoing project work.
  • Assist in new product introduction by participating in design reviews and advising on product structure that would assist in the configuration of product.
  • Design complex product configuration models using CPQ platform to ensure that the resulting configured products can be manufactured.
  • Develop the code and master data required to set up the configuration model.
  • Unit test the model to validate configuration rules, BOM generation.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Engineering to ensure the testing and proofing of configuration models prior to release.
  • Participate in the engineering change processes to ensure all relevant changes are reflected in the configuration models.
  • Define and follow product configuration modelling standards to improve development efficiencies and reduces development cycles.
  • Setup, Item, Pricing, BOM structure in Oracle CPQ.
  • Assist in meeting, schedules, and deadlines for implementation of new products and engineering changes.
  • Acts as technical subject matter expert (SME) for Oracle CPQ platform.

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or IT or related.
  • Three years or more experience in implementations and support Oracle CPQ/BigMachines or other CPQ applications.
  • Strong experience with following Oracle CPQ areas:

o    Commerce – maintain existing (break fix, enhance), build new commerce configurations, preferably using JET UI.

o    Configurations – build new complex product configuration, maintain existing.

o    BOM based configurations.

o    System Configurations

o    Integrating CPQ application with CRM, ERP systems using SOA and flat files.

o    Document Engine

o    Experience with visual configurator like CDS, Atlatl (preferred)

o    Advanced Pricing Rules, Approval Routing, AJAX Configuration Rules.

o    Hands on experience using BML, BMQL, SOAP, REST, JavaScript, CSS.

o    Integration experience with commerce and configurations.

o    Data tables

o    Price Books

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications
  • Analytical Thinking and Problem Solving- effectively identify business issues and opportunities, assess proposed solutions, and meet stakeholder needs.

job.title: Firmware Validation Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for embedded firmware development using GitLab CI/CD or similar platforms.
  • Automate firmware build, test, packaging, artifact management, versioning, and release workflows.
  • Create reusable pipeline jobs, scripts, containers, and development environments across firmware projects.
  • Improve management and reproducibility of embedded compilers, SDKs, toolchains, dependencies, and build environments.
  • Establish and improve Git-based development practices, including branching, merge workflows, release processes, tagging, and configuration management.
  • Integrate engineering platforms and workflows such as requirements management, project tracking, documentation, source control, testing, and release systems.
  • Develop integrations and automation between tools using APIs, scripts, web services, or similar technologies.
  • Improve traceability between requirements, source code changes, builds, test results, defects, firmware versions, and releases.
  • Work with Firmware Test Engineers to integrate automated tests, regression testing, and HIL environments into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and automated workflows that provide visibility into build status, test results, release readiness, and engineering activities.
  • Identify manual or inconsistent development processes and implement scalable automation and standardised DevOps practices.

Cybersecurity & Compliance Responsibilities

  • Work with the Cybersecurity organisation to implement security requirements and development processes defined for Firmware projects.
  • Coordinate and track cybersecurity activities, action items, remediation tasks, and required engineering evidence across the Firmware team.
  • Integrate applicable security checks and controls into firmware development and CI/CD workflows.
  • Support vulnerability management, security findings, dependency tracking, software composition analysis, and remediation activities.
  • Help maintain traceability and evidence required to demonstrate implementation of cybersecurity requirements.
  • Support firmware teams with cybersecurity compliance activities related to applicable product security standards and regulations.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in firmware, embedded software, DevOps, build/release engineering, or a related embedded systems role.
  • Strong understanding of embedded software development workflows and firmware build environments.
  • Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with Git and Git-based development workflows.
  • Strong scripting or programming skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages.
  • Experience with containers such as Docker and reproducible development/build environments.
  • Experience automating software build, test, integration, or release processes.
  • Experience integrating engineering tools or systems using REST APIs, scripts, or automation services.
  • Familiarity with software configuration management, versioning, artifacts, and release management.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and cross-functional coordination skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GitLab and GitLab CI/CD.
  • Experience developing or supporting C/C++ embedded firmware projects.
  • Familiarity with embedded compilers, cross-compilation, SDKs, RTOS environments, and hardware-dependent build/test workflows.
  • Experience with engineering platforms such as Jama Connect, Smartsheet, Microsoft SharePoint, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience integrating automated firmware testing or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) systems into CI/CD environments.
  • Familiarity with Typhoon HIL or similar platforms.
  • Experience with embedded product cybersecurity practices such as vulnerability management, SBOM, static analysis, dependency scanning, or security automation.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity regulations or frameworks such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).
  • Familiarity with security assessment or vulnerability management platforms such as Mandiant or equivalent tools.
  • Experience with power electronics, UPS firmware, industrial control systems, energy systems, or other complex embedded products.

What Success Looks Like

  • Firmware builds and releases become reproducible, automated, and consistently managed.
  • CI/CD becomes a standard part of the firmware development workflow.
  • Engineering tools and development processes become increasingly integrated and automated.
  • Automated firmware testing and regression results are connected to development pipelines.
  • Firmware requirements, changes, builds, tests, and releases have improved end-to-end traceability.
  • Cybersecurity requirements and remediation activities are consistently tracked, implemented, and supported with appropriate evidence.
  • Manual engineering effort is reduced while development visibility and process consistency improve.

job.title: Technical Trainer
job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

Vertiv Structures is seeking a hands-on Technical Trainer to support the development, cross-training, and continued growth of team members throughout our metal fabrication and modular manufacturing operations.

The Technical Trainer will deliver classroom, hands-on, and production-floor training; develop and maintain OJT/SOJT materials; assess employee competency; and partner with Operations and technical subject matter experts to ensure training accurately reflects current processes, safety requirements, quality standards, and production expectations.

The ideal candidate will have broad manufacturing knowledge with experience in areas such as structural steel fabrication, welding, CNC or laser operations, assembly, quality, material handling, or similar industrial processes. Formal trainer experience is preferred but is not required for an individual with strong technical knowledge and a demonstrated ability to teach, coach, or mentor others.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver classroom, hands-on, OJT/SOJT, and production-floor training for new and existing team members.
  • Demonstrate manufacturing processes, tools, equipment, work instructions, and safe work methods.
  • Coach employees during skill development and evaluate competency through observation, practical demonstrations, assessments, and documented qualification activities.
  • Support onboarding, cross-training, refresher training, upskilling, and introduction of new processes or equipment.
  • Develop and maintain training materials, including presentations, work instructions, visual aids, assessments, checklists, OJT/SOJT documentation, and hands-on learning activities.
  • Work with supervisors and subject matter experts to identify skill gaps and establish training priorities.
  • Observe production processes to ensure training remains aligned with actual work practices, current documentation, engineering requirements, and quality expectations.
  • Maintain accurate training records, rosters, assessments, and completion information within our LMS - Vertiv Learning and other applicable systems.
  • Support training documentation, revision control, reporting, and audit readiness.
  • Reinforce Vertiv safety requirements, 5S, standardized work, quality expectations, and continuous improvement throughout training.
  • Spend significant time within production areas to maintain familiarity with processes and support employees as they transition from training to independent work.

Manufacturing & Technical Knowledge

The Technical Trainer should possess broad manufacturing knowledge and the ability to develop working knowledge of processes throughout Vertiv Structures, including:

  • Structural steel fabrication and modular or prefabricated manufacturing.
  • MIG/GMAW, FCAW, and SMAW welding processes and common welding terminology.
  • Joint preparation, fit-up, welding symbols, basic weld quality, common defects, and workmanship expectations.
  • General awareness of WPS/PQR documentation and AWS D1.1 requirements applicable to structural fabrication.
  • Blueprint, fabrication drawing, BOM, work order, specification, and work-instruction interpretation.
  • CNC laser, plasma, press brake, cutting, grinding, drilling, and other common fabrication processes.
  • Machine setup and operation concepts, material loading, basic troubleshooting, operator inspections, and routine equipment care.
  • Structural steel shapes, grades, dimensions, identification, staging, and material flow.
  • Measurement and inspection using tools such as tape measures, calipers, micrometers, squares, levels, and gauges.
  • Dimensional requirements, tolerances, visual inspection, defect identification, nonconformance escalation, and basic quality practices.
  • Structural and modular assembly, fasteners, torque requirements, component installation, fit, alignment, and production sequencing.
  • Receiving and material-control concepts, including material verification, labeling, staging, inventory transactions, and basic ERP/WMS use.
  • Safe material handling and general awareness of forklifts, cranes, hoists, rigging, and other equipment used within the facility.
  • Manufacturing safety requirements including PPE, machine and tool safety, hot work, Hazard Communication, Lockout/Tagout awareness, material handling, and workplace hazard identification.

The Technical Trainer is not expected to serve as the final technical authority for welding inspection, engineering requirements, equipment certification, safety regulation, quality acceptance, or other activities requiring specialized qualifications.

Subject Matter Expert Partnership

No single Technical Trainer is expected to possess expert-level certification in every manufacturing discipline represented within Vertiv Structures.

The Technical Trainer must instead demonstrate the ability to:

  • Learn unfamiliar technical processes quickly.
  • Identify and work effectively with qualified subject matter experts.
  • Observe and document technical work accurately.
  • Ask appropriate technical questions.
  • Validate training content with responsible departments.
  • Distinguish between training guidance and formal technical authority.
  • Escalate questions requiring Engineering, Quality, EHS, Maintenance, or regulatory interpretation.
  • Convert expert knowledge into standardized training that can be understood by employees with varying levels of experience.

Subject matter experts may include experienced welders, AWS Certified Welding Inspectors, Quality Inspectors, Engineers, CNC operators and programmers, Maintenance technicians, Logistics and Receiving personnel, Production supervisors, certified instructors, and experienced assemblers and fabricators.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Experience in manufacturing, metal fabrication, structural steel, welding, machining, industrial assembly, modular construction, or a related industrial environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, drawings, work instructions, and technical documentation.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing tools, processes, quality expectations, and safe work practices.
  • Ability to learn technical processes and explain them clearly to others.
  • Strong verbal, written, coaching, and presentation skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to documentation accuracy.
  • Advanced computer proficiency.
  • Ability to work effectively with employees, production leadership, and cross-functional departments.
  • Ability to work extensively within an active manufacturing environment and adapt to changing production and training priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience training, coaching, or mentoring employees in manufacturing.
  • Structural steel fabrication or welding experience.
  • Knowledge of MIG/GMAW, FCAW, and SMAW welding processes.
  • Familiarity with welding symbols, WPS/PQR documentation, or AWS D1.1.
  • CNC laser, plasma, press brake, or other fabrication-equipment experience.
  • Experience with modular or prefabricated construction.
  • Quality inspection or dimensional-measurement experience.
  • Receiving, logistics, material-control, ERP, or WMS experience.
  • Experience with Lean manufacturing, 5S, or standardized work.
  • Experience developing OJT/SOJT programs or technical training materials.
  • LMS experience and proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Knowledge of adult-learning principles.
  • Train-the-Trainer or other recognized instructor certification.

Formal welding, equipment, safety, or instructor certifications are considered a plus but are not required for this position unless specifically required for an assigned training activity.

Core Competencies

  • Technical and manufacturing aptitude
  • Ability to teach and coach others
  • Hands-on learning and demonstration skills
  • Ability to design and develop simple labs for training skills.
  • Clear communication
  • Safety and quality awareness
  • Attention to detail
  • Problem solving
  • Organization and documentation
  • Adaptability and technical curiosity
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Continuous improvement
  • Professional judgment and ability to recognize when specialized technical expertise is required

Position Purpose

The Technical Trainer serves as the connection between manufacturing knowledge and workforce development, helping ensure employees have the knowledge, skills, and practical experience necessary to perform their work safely, consistently, and to Vertiv quality standards.

The trainer is not expected to be the facility's expert in every technical discipline. Success in this role requires broad manufacturing knowledge, the ability to learn quickly, strong partnerships with subject matter experts, and the ability to transform technical knowledge into practical, standardized, and effective employee training.

About Vertiv

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs.  Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Business Unit Job Summary:

Developing mechanical design of modular enclosure/buildings (small/medium scale) in Autodesk Inventor and produces project drawings & documentation as mentioned in upper paragraph. The mechanical engineer in design engineering based on inputs works on CAD models for sheet metal parts, design concepts & detail models of parts and assemblies in Autodesk Inventor, participate on engineering meetings with equipment suppliers and develops new skills and knowledge through internal and external education. Mechanical Engineer will be part of team of engineers with a lot of knowledge in various disciplines.

Responsibilities

  • Developing of project conceptual and detailed design in CAD.
  • Based on input data (information, requirements, standards), development of mechanical project documentation: detailed sheet metal part & assembly design, Installation drawings, Customer Drawings, fabrication weldment drawings, detail drawings, descriptions, instructions, material submittals, BOM, presentations and marketing materials etc.
  • During design, follow and take into consideration international, national and company standards and good engineering practices
  • Use knowledge and experience to fulfill requirements given by project tasks
  • Participating in regular project team meetings, and on-site coordination meetings if any.
  • Reporting project status to Lead Engineer- Mechanical
  • Based on Project and priorities he needs to align with North America, India region, EMEA or ANZ region timeline.
  • Proactive cooperation with all team members during project execution
  • Initiating RFI („Request for Information “) in cases where additional clarification is needed
  • Development of defined documents according to Document list (DLIST)
  • Verification and approval of workshop supplier documentation developed by subcontractors.
  • Specifying Accurate Bill of Material & drawings required for project execution.
  • Specification of necessary certificates for materials needed to be ordered
  • Supporting suppliers with additional information during bidding phase of sourcing (offer submitting)
  • Providing technical approval for received supplier offers
  • Providing technical support to subcontractors and installers during production/assembly
  • Cooperation with the manufacturing and Site deployment engineering team
  • Cooperation with Site Manager during assembly, providing technical solutions to raised issues
  • Cooperation with Quality Control during quality control of components/systems and assembly on Site

job.title: Workflow Analyst I, CXQO
job.description:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Amazon Physical Stores is more start-up than big-company, a group of entrepreneurial, perceptive, and creative leaders with innovation at our core. We’re pushing the state of the art in helping customers shop in engaging, fast, and safe ways. To date we’ve created stores that let you use an app to enter, take what you want and exit the store. Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you’re done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we’ll charge your Amazon account and send you a receipt. Designed and custom-built by Amazonians, our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earths’ most customer centric company and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an innovative program that continues to push the state of the art in computer vision, machine learning, distributed systems and hardware design.

We are looking for a Workforce Capacity Planning (CP) Analyst who is passionate about customer experience, thinks and acts globally, a strong communicator and networker to build successful working relationships across CXQO network and has the edge to drive industry standard innovations. The ideal candidate will need to possess a strong schedule optimization background that enables them to manage quantitative planning to achieve productivity goals for the network, possess analytical background that enables them to manage network planning, experience a wide range of problem solving situations which are strategic to real-time to identify opportunities for improvement and is able to extensively use data collection for further analysis. The Workforce CP Analyst is responsible to share guidance on real-time staffing adjustments, work with sites on special events planning, build processes to manage contingency, real-time business domain blending to help business meet its service levels; they aid as a resource, advisor and is a close working partner with Operations and other functional, support teams. The successful candidate will also need to be an analytical problem solver who is comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasked, high-energy environment. This role requires candidates to be flexible to working in Night shifts and Rotational Week offs Please note: this team is not customer-facing.

Key job responsibilities

  • Generate forecast, plan capacity for multiple network sites, successfully manage short term staffing of the sites (4 to 6 weeks), work closely with long-term planning, program, Ops and multiple stakeholders and come up with right input and exception mechanisms on factors affecting forecast
  • Create and accurately maintain CXQO associate shift schedules ensuring that shifts are optimally planned to meet the short term forecast requirements and SLs (Service Levels)
  • Build short/long term operational plans for network sites to optimize variable costs associated with staffing
  • Creates intra-day, daily, weekly plan for business to meet the forecasted numbers and required productivity
  • Setup feedback mechanism to share overall capacity planning processes improvements and drive better planning accuracy for future
  • Performs dive deep on daily, weekly, and monthly site/network performance to provide feedback to Operations and other program management stakeholders to help sites meet its efficiency goals
  • Monitor actual staffing levels against plan and take corrective actions to flex-up or flex down as required like OT (Over Time) calls, cross skill support, shrinkage, shift changes to improve service levels
  • Effectively plan and monitor associate adherence to the assigned schedules & plan non-productive activities
  • Maintain CXQO associate matrix for each sites basis it’s hours of operation, seating and transportation plan
  • Participate in initiatives to cater to growing business needs
  • Connect and network with stake-holders, including but not limited to operations, program management, training, GREF teams
  • Supports Capacity Planning leadership by maintaining accurate records of planned and required headcount in each of business groups/marketplace on a weekly basis
  • Communicate and maintain vision, Leadership Principles and culture with the team
  • Written and verbal communication up to operations level

job.title: Network Infrastructure Deployment Manager, Infra Networking
job.description:
Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. The AWS Cloud infrastructure is built around Regions and Availability Zones (AZs). AWS Regions provide multiple, physically separated and isolated Availability Zones which are connected with low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant networking. These Availability Zones offer AWS customers an easier and more effective way to design and operate applications and databases, making them more highly available, fault tolerant, and scalable than traditional single data center infrastructures or multi-data center infrastructures. How would you like to come be part of the team that builds out that low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant network?

Amazon Web Services is looking for a highly motivated, technically savvy Network Infrastructure Deployment Manager to help develop and scale one of the world’s largest and most complex networks. The Deployment Manager (DM) is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced communication construction project schedules achievable. AWS Deployment Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient connectivity solutions in the world. As a Deployment Manager you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in fiber construction. AWS Deployment Managers are always at the forefront of the network construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers. Our networks are industry leading in terms of capacity and cost effectiveness. The DM is ultimately responsible for end to end network delivery and management of the contractors. The DM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, fiber splicing, OSP Design, ISP Construction or system installation/commissioning) and be responsible as a team member for delivering some of the most complex networks in the world.

Key job responsibilities As NW Infra Deployment Manager working within AWS Infrastructure you will:

  • Interface with key internal stakeholders to understand the technical requirements and ensure the completed project meets these requirements.
  • Project management of construction related activities and DWDM network rollout for new builds or general capital projects. This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budget;
  • Ensure that the construction, fiber and optical network adheres to the defined standards;
  • Perform quality audits and ensure issues are remediated;
  • Understand the metro fiber market segments, customer base, and industry verticals;
  • Drive scaling designs to meet the demand of our customers;
  • Interface with data center providers to drive equipment and circuit installations;
  • Create detailed network planning packs to build scalable and future proof infrastructure;
  • Program management, risk mitigation and reporting status reviews to management and internal customers.
  • Develop long-term strategic partnerships in support of our key markets;
  • Understand the mechanisms used to operate and maintain one of the world’s most complex networks;
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time;
  • Ability to work across multiple time zones;

  • Knowledge of electrical systems in critical Data Center operations that include but are not limited to utility substation feeds, transformers, switchgear, VFI Class UPS, DRUPS, PDUs, ATS, STS, SLA/VRLA batteries and associated systems, diesel/gas turbine generators and related fuel systems, Surge Suppression, Active Harmonic Filtering, battery monitoring systems, branch circuit monitoring systems or SCADA systems
  • Knowledge of mechanical systems in critical Data Center operations including but not limited to CRAC/CRAHs/AHUs, chillers, cooling towers, storage tanks, chemical systems, heat exchangers, piping systems, pumps, valves, duct systems, fans, or dampers

job.title: Program Manager - Procurement Process Improvement & Excellence, Data Center Procurement Governance (DCPG)
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

The Data Center Procurement Governance (DCPG) function is part of AIS. Do you want to be part of a global team that relentlessly pursues procurement excellence, improves operational processes and outcomes, and manages compliance and business risks? Do you have a solid procurement background, excel at program and stakeholder management, and thrive in a fast-paced environment?

We are hiring a Program Manager - Procurement Excellence to work closely with procurement stakeholders, operations, functions, systems and engineering to enable scalable, well-controlled business processes and decision-making.

This role sits within a broader team of program managers that operates as highly embedded business partners to procurement, focused on operational effectiveness and impact, scalable mechanisms, and risk-informed execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong business process thinking, stakeholder influence, operational rigor, and technical literacy to help teams move quickly while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

The ideal candidate require a high tolerance of ambiguity aligned to AWS Day 1 culture, ability to influence executive decisions, drive strategic initiatives and change management that deliver meaningful programmatic improvements.

This is not a traditional audit or policy-focused role. We designed this role for individuals who enjoy solving operational problems, driving influence and alignment across teams, and building scalable mechanisms in fast-paced environments. Over time, this role has opportunity to evolve toward broader technical program management style leadership responsibilities.

Your role

Business Partnership & Operational Enablement

  • Partner closely with Technical, Engineering, Operations, Procurement, and Risk stakeholders to shape scalable business processes and controls.
  • Engage early with teams to influence decisions, identify risks, and enable efficient execution.
  • Translate risk and controls requirements into practical, actionable operating mechanisms.

Risk & Controls Integration

  • Design and improve scalable controls, guardrails, and operational frameworks that support business velocity while managing risk appropriately.
  • Simplify and modernize existing processes to align with evolving business needs and risk appetite.
  • Ensure controls are operationally practical and embedded into day-to-day workflows.

Business Process & Mechanism Ownership

  • Identify process gaps, friction points, and operational inefficiencies across programs and workflows.
  • Build mechanisms, playbooks, decision frameworks, and scalable patterns that improve consistency and reduce ambiguity.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across governance, operational readiness, and execution processes.

Cross-Functional Coordination & Audit Readiness

  • Act as a business partner to Procurement teams and a key coordination point across Risk, Audit, Assurance, Legal, Technical and Engineering teams.
  • Streamline audit readiness and evidence gathering through scalable operational processes rather than manual coordination.
  • Ensure teams have clarity on ownership, expectations, and escalation paths.

Technical & Operational Collaboration

  • Engage effectively with technical teams by understanding system architecture, workflows, dependencies, and operational trade-offs.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure controls and operational requirements are designed into solutions early.
  • Use data and operational signals to identify risks, trends, and improvement opportunities.

What good looks like for this role:

  • Procurement teams and functional partners proactively engage you as a trusted partner early in planning and execution.
  • Decisions move faster because of your involvement, not slower.
  • Processes become simpler, clearer, and more scalable over time.
  • Risk Management and controls are embedded into operational workflows rather than managed as separate activities.
  • Stakeholders experience clear ownership, practical guidance, and streamlined engagement across governance functions.

What We Are Not Looking For

  • Purely policy or checklist-driven approaches.
  • Candidates who operate primarily through approvals or gatekeeping or arm's length approach
  • Candidates who identify problems without driving practical solutions.

High stakeholder engagement, influencing and cross-functional ownership is essential is for the role.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead various audit programs, risk remediation, policy and process improvement projects internally and with external stakeholders
  • Take lead in establishing necessary controls, mechanisms, and policies to improve DCSP compliance and assurance
  • Drive culture of innovation, simplification and continuous improvement through best practice sharing, advocacy and hands-on leadership and execution of projects
  • Identify new tools and business processes that simplify, standardize and enable operational excellence
  • Derive actionable insights and routinely present recommendations from analysis

A day in the life -This role has a global scope so there is no standard day - there is much variety in the day -You could be starting with a morning meeting speaking with US team members, a coffee with APAC and finish up with a call with EMEA -You will work on multiple projects with global teams, stakeholders and customers -Your biggest customers will be our Data Center Services Procurement teams and our AWS security assurance teams. Stakeholders also include legal, finance, H&S and other Data Center Communities colleagues

About the team Data Center Procurement Governance (DCPG) is a global function that includes:

-Program Management - a team of Program Managers who are strong business partners to procurement, intersect business process with technology and tooling across the procurement life cycle, to identify, architect and deliver impact projects for our DC procurement teams.

Procurement Systems, Tools & Analytics - Define, support and drive procurement technical roadmap in systems, tooling, automation, analytics and GenAI.

About AWS

Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of program or project management experience
  • 3+ years of purchasing experience
  • Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
  • Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
  • Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
