job.title: Network Engineering - Engineer
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

21 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Network Engineering - Engineer

Job Summary

The Network Engineer is an important contributor in ensuring that the Telstra network delivers a superior network experience for our consumer and business customers. You use your telecommunications network skills and experience to contribute to specialist analysis, design, development and deployment in specific network technology domains, including how this technology inter-operates with other technologies.

Job Description

We're an iconic Aussie brand with a global footprint. Our purpose is to build a connected future so everyone can thrive. We're all about providing the best experience and delivering the best tech on the best network.

This includes making Telstra the place you want to work.

For you, that means a having career that grows with you, and working with a team powered by human connection that prioritises well-being and choice.

Here’s what you can expect from us

  • Flexible working. Wherever you live, choose where, when, and how you work so you can be at your best.
  • There when life happens. From Gender Affirmation Leave to Telstra’s Additional Leave Day, we give you time to spend away from work when you need it most.
  • Pay for performance. We recognize outstanding contributions through our generous incentive programs.
  • Parental Leave. A gender-equal policy for parents so you can choose how and when you take your leave (16 weeks full pay or 32 weeks half pay). Receive superannuation contributions on paid and unpaid parental leave.
  • Unlimited learning. Level up your credentials with access to 17,000 learning programs. Learn ‘on the job’ and achieve university credits toward degrees and Master's programs.
  • Global presence. With a global presence across 22 countries, there are many opportunities to work where we do business.
  • Extra perks. Receive 25% off Telstra products and services, plus unlock exclusive discounts from over 240 brands and partners.

Make a Difference Networks Product and Technology - Fixed Engineering designs, builds, operates and improves all of Telstra’s fixed line network infrastructure – the physical and logical systems that deliver home broadband, enterprise connectivity and wholesale network services.

Key Responsibilities

This is how you’ll bring the purpose of your role to life.

  • Configure, deploy, and maintain jumphost platforms (e.g., MobBOSS, Shared Boss) that provide secure access and operational tooling for network environments
  • Support the implementation of security controls and remediations, ensuring alignment with enterprise cyber security standards (e.g., MFA, access control, hardening)
  • Execute platform lifecycle activities, including:

Build and onboarding of new environments

  • Patch management and upgrades
  • Decommissioning of legacy infrastructure

Assist in delivering key platform initiatives such as:

  • Jumphost rebuild and modernisation
  • Security uplift across shared and domain-specific environments

Ensure secure connectivity and access management for network devices:

  • SSH/telnet access control
  • Configuration backup and network tooling support

Monitor and troubleshoot network, platform, and access issues impacting management services environments

Support operational activities, including incident response, root cause analysis, and service restoration.

Collaborate with:

  • Cyber Security teams for compliance and risk mitigation
  • Identity and access teams for authentication and access models
  • Network and platform teams for integrated service delivery

Maintain and build expertise on Telstra’s networks and products, technologies, and operating systems.

Develop and maintain standard and best practice deployment documentation and reference material.

Work in a DevOps environment.

About you

To be successful in the role, you'll bring skills and experience in:

Essential

  • A degree in Network/Telecommunications/Systems Engineering and previous experience in network engineering roles with a minimum of 5 years' work experience.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (IP, routing, DNS, firewalls) and enterprise network environments (e.g., CMN, RDN, EDN concepts)
  • Strong knowledge of security standards and frameworks, with the ability to translate them into practical controls, drive best practices, and proactively identify and remediate gaps across enterprise environments.
  • Experienced in SNMP v2/v3 discovery, with the ability to capture and maintain accurate inventory data, ensuring data integrity and continuity across network environments.
  • Proven experience in:

Supporting jumphost / bastion host platforms

  • Network access and operational support systems
  • Integrating jumphost/ bastion host platforms with MFA.

System Administration:

  • Linux system administration (RHEL/CentOS preferred)
  • User access management, SSH configuration, and privilege control
  • Server patching, OS hardening, and security baseline enforcement
  • System performance monitoring and troubleshooting
  • Log management and analysis (syslog, system logs)
  • Backup and restore processes for system and configuration data

Experience working in a high-performing DevOps team.

Knowledge of:

  • Network security and access control (SSH, LDAP, MFA concepts)
  • Security compliance and remediation practices

Experience with:

  • Scripting (bash, Python)
  • Troubleshooting across network and infrastructure layers

Understanding of:

  • System and platform lifecycle management
  • High availability and operational resilience

Strong understanding and experience in Telstra Change Management practices.

Highly desirable

  • Exposure to:

Virtualised environments (e.g., VMware) and hosting platforms

  • Identity and Access Management (IAM) or privileged access systems
  • Operating Citrix CVAD environments and administering NetScaler/ADC for application delivery, traffic management, and performance troubleshooting

Familiarity with:

  • Network monitoring and observability tools
  • Automation tools (e.g., Ansible)

Experience in:

  • Telecom or large-scale enterprise network environments
  • Security uplift or infrastructure modernisation initiatives

API & Integration Capabilities for Network Automation

  • Experience designing and integrating APIs within Network as a Service (NaaS) platforms
  • Ability to develop and manage RESTful APIs for network automation and service integration
  • Experience integrating APIs across identity platforms, network/security services, and orchestration workflows
  • Understanding of API security principles, including authentication and authorization mechanisms
  • Ability to troubleshoot and support API driven integrations in enterprise environments.

If you are passionate to succeed as part of an agile and experienced team, we welcome you to apply! -------------------------------------

We encourage applications from people of all abilities and backgrounds - including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, the LGBQTI+ community, linguistically diverse, and people living with disability. When you apply, you can choose to note the pronouns you use and /or any reasonable adjustments needed to take part equitably during the interview process. Visit www.telstra.com.au/careers/diversity-and-inclusion or email us at DisabilityandAccessibility@team.telstra.com noting your preferred method of contact

job.title: Attendant, Housekeeping
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio spans across diversified real estate classes which include integrated developments, retail, office, lodging, residential, business parks, industrial, logistics and data centres. With a presence across more than 260 cities in over 40 countries, the Group focuses on Singapore, China and India as its core markets, while it continues to expand in markets such as Korea, Japan, Australia, Vietnam, Europe and the USA.

Job Description Summary

The Attendant, Housekeeping is responsible for the cleanliness and orderly presentation of rooms to create a positive impression for guests and/or customers. He/She performs cleaning, replenishes amenities and supplies as well as checks and reports items in need of maintenance or replacement. He updates room cleaning status, turns over any lost and found items and maintains the housekeeping cart before and after each shift.

As a service operations staff, he projects a professional image and provides assistance to address guests' concerns and special requests at the floor. He complies with organisational and regulatory requirements to ensure hygiene, security and workplace safety and health when carrying out his duties.

He is a service-oriented individual who is able to interact with guests in a professional and respectful manner. He has an eye for detail and is able to work independently and as a team on shifts, including weekends and public holidays. To meet the physical demands of the job, he has to be physically fit to lift heavy loads such as mattresses.

Job Description

Manage housekeeping operations

  • Perform activities for shift duty check-in and check-out
  • Perform cleaning activities in rooms and/or public areas
  • Replenish amenities and supplies in rooms and/or public areas
  • Inspect rooms and/or public areas to report defects and missing items
  • Update room status on completion of housekeeping work activities
  • Report and turn over lost and found items
  • Restock and maintain cleanliness of cleaning carts

Drive service and operational excellence

  • Adhere to personal grooming and hygiene standards to project a professional image
  • Respond to guests' requests, concerns and feedback on the floor
  • Identify areas for work performance improvement

Manage operational risks

  • Comply with organisational and regulatory requirements on hygiene, and workplace safety and health when carrying out work
  • Report safety hazards and security threats in accordance with organisational guidelines
  • Respond to emergency situations in accordance with organisational standard operating procedures

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Intern, Guest Service
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across more than 260 cities in over 40 countries.

Job Description

Manage front office operations

  • Supervise team's delivery of guest services to ensure adherence to organisational standards and procedures
  • Coordinate daily front office activities to ensure operational efficiency
  • Plan resources and allocate work assignments to team members
  • Maintain accurate room status information

Job Description

JD – lyf Guard (Guest Service Executive)

You will be a multifaceted Community Manager who revels in creating an inclusive and collaborative community at lyf. A day in the life of a lyf Guard starts with checking in a new guest, recommending the must-visit places in the area, replacing a light bulb at night, and ending with having a cup of coffee or sipping wine with the lyf guests in our social spaces after work. You will report to the Senior (GSAM) or Chief lyf Guard (GSM).

Responsibilities

Look after the well-being of all guests from arrival until departure by:

a. Assisting lyf residents with their check-in (via mobile app or kiosk)

b. Encouraging members to download the DiscoverASR app to explore and interact with the lyf community

c. Explore the various functions of the app with residents

i. Mobile key, how to message lyf Guards, make ancillary purchases (if available)

d. Handling guest queries

f. Facilitating communication and requests

Ensure operational efficiency by:

a. Monitoring record of room availability using the hotel's property management system (PMS)

b. Ensuring that processes carried out adhere to corporate guidelines

c. Performing book-keeping activities whenever necessary

d. Assisting the housekeeping department with regular rounds to ensure the cleanliness of the property – especially the social spaces

e. Handling walk-ins, emails, and phone inquiries

f. Executing light housekeeping/engineering duties and liaising with relevant outsourced contractors for cleaning and maintenance when required

Create an inclusive and collaborative community by:

a. Noticing guest preferences and managing their profiles

b. Assisting the Ambassador of Buzz (partnerships and events manager) in curating an event calendar for in-house guests and executing community initiatives

c. Proactively interacting with guests to obtain constructive recommendations that will enhance their stay experience

  • A passionate individual with a passion for entrepreneurial, tech, creative, and collaborative communities

job.description:
Job Description

Job Title – Senior Engineer

Location – Bangalore, India

Full time/Part Time - Full Time

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

Role Description

This position is for a lead Product and Technical Service technician coordinator who is under minimal supervision. Assists with planning, prioritizing, and managing technical service activities to ensure resources are used effectively and customer service agreements are fulfilled. Responds to complex customer inquiries and resolves technical problems related to installation, modification, upgrade, maintenance and repair of the company products or equipment purchased. May serve as a resource on varied tasks.

Responsibilities

  • Support & provide service via calls, emails and tickets
  • Work on provided offline activities
  • Follow given SOP’s and flag any unresolved issues, escalations to L2
  • Ability to diagnose and analyze technical problems
  • Analyse different systems and energy data to find potential for energy optimization.
  • Work on projects that requires data mining, analysis & presentation
  • Identify relevant trends, deviations, call drivers, perform follow up analysis and prepare visualizations
  • Provide training to L1 Engineers
  • Execution of bulk schedule/set point changes
  • Follows up and meets commitments to customer
  • Flexibility towards shifts and week offs as per requirement
  • Implementation of Controls programming changes
  • Troubleshooting and resolving platform based deviations
  • Ability to appreciate asset information dataset and modelling
  • Flair for root cause analysis and tracking issues to closure
  • Understand changes in the controls setup and initiate/recommend changes to the stakeholders
  • Propose new energy savings strategies and initiatives
  • Additional adhoc activities to support business goals
  • Guide team members

Basic Qualifications & Experience:

  • Requires theoretical to advanced knowledge obtained through a University degree, combined with experience
  • Practical knowledge of Carrier organization, programs or systems with the ability to make enhancements and leverage in daily work
  • University Degree – B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering
  • A minimum of 2 years prior relevant experience
  • Working hours’ flexibility to meet customer requirements
  • Should possess a good behavioral attitude

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.

  • Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
  • Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
  • Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

job.title: Manager, Commodity Management & Sourcing
job.description:
##

Note: It's a 6 days/week work from Office role at Gurgaon Plant

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

##

Role Summary

Responsible for strategic sourcing and supplier development of steel components, including fabricated, machined, stamped, welded, and sheet metal parts. The role focuses on cost optimization, tooling management, localization, and supplier performance while collaborating with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and suppliers to ensure timely development and supply. Ensures all components meet defined cost, quality, delivery, and technical requirements.

##

##

##

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Development

  • ## Identify, evaluate, and develop suppliers for steel fabricated and sheet metal components.
  • ## Execute RFQ activities, commercial negotiations, and supplier selection.
  • ## Drive dual sourcing and risk mitigation initiatives.
  • ## Support localization projects and supplier footprint expansion activities.
  • ## Monitor supplier performance on Quality, Cost, Delivery, and Responsiveness.

Tooling Management

  • ## Manage development of tooling, dies, molds, jigs, fixtures, gauges, and inspection tools.
  • ## Coordinate tooling feasibility reviews with suppliers and Engineering teams.
  • ## Track tooling investment, timelines, ownership, and life cycle management.
  • ## Ensure tooling readiness aligns with new product development milestones.
  • ## Support tooling transfers and capacity expansion projects.

New Product Development & Project Management

  • ## Lead sourcing activities for new product launches.
  • ## Coordinate with Engineering for drawings, BOM reviews, design changes, and technical clarifications.
  • ## Ensure timely completion of sample development, qualification, and PPAP submission.
  • ## Track project timelines and drive closure of critical path activities.

Cost Management

  • ## Conduct cost analysis and should-cost modeling.
  • ## Lead productivity, VA/VE, and cost reduction initiatives.
  • ## Manage commodity price impacts and negotiate cost-effective solutions.
  • ## Develop long-term sourcing strategies for steel categories.

Supplier Quality & Qualification

  • ## Coordinate supplier audits, capability assessments, and qualification activities.
  • ## Work with Quality teams for PPAP, APQP, CQS, and process approvals.
  • ## Resolve quality issues through cross-functional collaboration.
  • ## Drive continuous improvement at supplier locations.

Supply Chain & Operations Support

  • ## Monitor supplier capacity, inventory, and delivery performance.
  • ## Support S&OP and demand planning activities.
  • ## Ensure material availability for production requirements.
  • ## Work on inventory optimization and lead-time reduction initiatives

##

Minimum Requirements

##

  • ## A minimum of 10 years prior relevant experience
  • ## Experience on Steel commodity, vendor development, spend analysis, new development or product, should costing.
  • ## Requires theoretical to advanced knowledge obtained through a university degree, combined with experience
  • ## Practical knowledge of Carrier organization, programs or systems with the ability to make enhancements and leverage in daily work

job.title: Staff Engineer, Firmware & Embedded Software
job.description:
About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

About This Role

The Staff Engineer is a technical expert responsible for leading the embedded design, development, and optimization of embedded software for our next-generation air-conditioner products.

This role will drive architecture decisions, solve complex technical problems, and provide technical leadership across projects, working closely with hardware, system, and production teams. The lead is expected to act as a go-to person for critical technical topics, mentor other engineers, and help ensure our products meet global quality, reliability, and cybersecurity standards.

Each day, the engineering team meets some of the most unique and exciting global challenges. To maintain our role as a global leader, we continue to seek talented, ambitious individuals to join our engineering team. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are looking for an opportunity to apply your technical expertise, then we have a great opportunity for you. We are seeking innovative, data-driven, results-oriented team members to contribute to our continued legacy of innovation and success.

This position is based on-site at Carrier - Indianapolis, 30 South Meridian Street, Indianapolis, IN 46204.

Role Responsibilities

The candidate will have responsibility for the following in addition to ad hoc assignments as needed.

  • Design and implement embedded software solutions to address business needs.
  • Experience with Microcontrollers, RTOS and Embedded Protocols.
  • Develop firmware in C/C++, ensuring efficiency, reliability, and safety.
  • May have responsibility for the programming of assembly language, machine language and high-level languages, including but not limited to C and C++.
  • Involve in all aspects of the system software development process – concept, design, reviews, coding and validation.
  • Drive code quality initiatives through best practices including code reviews, unit tests, functional/integration testing, and CI/CD integration.
  • Provide software designs and documentation to the team.
  • Participate in product cybersecurity reviews.
  • Participate in Change Control Board (CCB) meetings to prioritize new features & defects.
  • Perform debugging, troubleshooting embedded systems using emulators, JTAG\BDM debuggers etc.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and apply relevant innovations as appropriate.
  • Work with embedded system development methodologies such as agile, and related project and repo management tools such as JIRA, Confluence, GitHub etc.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers, providing technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and review feedback.
  • Directs the activities related to the analysis, design, programming, debugging, troubleshooting and modification of software for firmware (IC embedded code) applications.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or Computer Science, or a technical field degree.
  • 7+ years of experience in the design and development of embedded firmware, and C/C++ programming skills for embedded systems
  • Willing and able to travel domestically up to 10% of the year.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming skills for embedded systems.
  • Hands-on experience in RTOS, multithreading and bare metal programming.
  • Solid understanding of microcontroller architecture, interrupts, timers, memory (Flash/RAM/EEPROM), and low-level drivers.
  • Knowledge of embedded development workflows, version control, and build systems (CMake, Make).
  • Experience with hardware debugging tools and test equipment.
  • Experience with common wired messaging architectures and protocols (UART, RS232/485, I2C, SPI, Modbus).
  • Demonstrated knowledge of firmware development best practices (AGILE design, code reviews, design documentation, unit testing).
  • Experience with IoT / Embedded systems’ standard design elements - bootloaders, OTA firmware downloads, and firmware updates.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity technologies and best practices (encryption, key management, certificates/exchanges, Secure Boot).
  • Experience with hardware/electrical with knowledge how to evaluate if your firmware is working as expected by probing the hardware (e.g., oscilloscope, logic analyzer, etc.).
  • Experience in the use of Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or other software development tools.
  • Experience with HVAC Controls Systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Organized with strong attention to detail, while managing multiple priorities.
  • Ability to lead a small team of software developers and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to implement continuous improvements and standardize processes.

Pay Range

The annual salary for this position is between $96,000.00 - $192,000.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate.

Other Compensation

This position is entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

Our solutions help reduce energy consumption, lower utility, operating and maintenance costs, and improve indoor air quality, occupant comfort, and productivity. Technology that supports the buildings and industry of today and tomorrow requires a wide range of talents and skill sets.

About This Role

The Building Automation Field Supervisor is a team leader of a selected number of Field Engineers (FE). Their primary responsibility is managing and training of their direct employees, and verification of their work. They will be responsible for the mentoring of new hires into new construction field operations, as well as current FE’s. They are responsible for working with the Project Management group in coordinating timely completion of all assigned projects. Ensure the field staff has the proper knowledge to perform that work and is executing their work at or under the project specific budget. Primarily responsible for coordinating all resources, internal and external, necessary for the execution of the new construction project their FE’s are assigned to in Cora PPM.

Key Responsibilities

COMMUNICATION AND DOCUMENTATION

  • Provide necessary documentation and communication to all customer levels, sub-contractors (when necessary), and ALC Department Management as well as ensure that the appropriate members of the field operations department do so.
  • Ensure proper time utilization from timesheet collection, site visits, and daily logs in Cora PPM.
  • Follow up on all daily log collection (Cora PPM) for the Field Engineers working for you and ensure timely delivery to New Construction Administration and Project Managers.
  • Be able to utilize Cora PPM to generate reports, spreadsheets, and schedules when necessary.
  • Professionally represent Automated Logic in meetings and always be proactive in defending the company’s best interest. Always be prepared for meetings, have the answers to questions that you know will be asked, and have the appropriate back-up personnel in attendance when necessary.
  • Lead, document, and participate in yearly and semi yearly performance reviews for all of your employees
  • Communicate with Engineering, Graphics developers and programmers to provide feedback on quality, accuracy and standards development.

BUDGET

  • Thoroughly understand project budgets for negotiated projects that are executed by the Field Supervisor’s team.
  • Continuously monitor work being performed by FE to ensure Quality Control. Provide continuous feedback to direct reports regarding performance, budgets and quality. Escalate any personnel concerns and proactively manage expectations of employees.
  • Attend and actively participate in turnover meetings, Pre bid meetings and other meetings deemed important to the job.

PROJECT PLANNING AND SCHEDULING

  • Collaborate with Project Manager in maximizing execution of projects by coordinating task assignment in Cora PPM
  • Participate in monthly meetings with Project Managers and the Branch Operations Managers to collaborate in assigning resources for all projects
  • Provide input to the Project Manager as to when resources will be needed on the project. This will include graphics, programming and technical checkout as required.
  • Coordinate project schedule with electrical subcontractors and other trades to maintain schedule. Maintain continuous communications with FE’s, Project Managers, Customers and other trades to ensure consistent understanding of the project schedule. .

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

  • Field Supervisor will be or become proficient on all necessary ALC programming and graphical work for their assigned projects
  • Field Supervisors will continue to provide technical assistance when needed. When workload dictates, they will be able to utilize other FE’s to meet the project schedule.

LEADERSHIP & TEAM PLAY

  • Help develop and improve company standards.
  • Develop Mentoring plans and continuously train new and current FE’s.
  • Participate in peer reviews, turnover meetings, post mortem meetings and close out meetings as required.
  • Assist in development of training and mentoring plans
  • Participate in and conduct interviews with potential candidates

PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT

  • Attends seminars, enrolls in self-study courses, and undertakes other self-improvement measures to maintain proficiency and improve job performance.

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • 3+ years of experience in the HVAC controls industry.
  • Possess and maintain valid and current Driver’s License and be insurable by the company’s insurance carrier.
  • Ability to travel in excess of 25% of typical workweek, including air travel, overnight hotel stays, and unexpected travel as well as participate in rotating on call schedule.
  • Capable of climbing ladders or using other lift equipment in excess of 8 feet above grade, and capable of lifting items up to 50lbs.

  • Experience interacting with a large and diverse number of simultaneous challenges, requiring knowledge of multiple disciplines.
  • Field experience and an understanding of the installation and operation of Automated Logic Controls and ability to understand/navigate third party control systems and integrations.
  • Experience with Automated Logic and Phoenix software to include: WebCtrl, SiteBuilder, ViewBuilder, LogicBuilder, InterOp 3.02, Alert, Draw, EDB, Eikon, Supervision, and Accel Works.

Carrier in Residential furnace factory in Indianapolis seeks a high energy, data driven, result-oriented Tooling Engineer to facilitate the transformation of our facility to a world class level. The focus will be to reduce equipment downtime and optimize tool’s reliability.

The Tooling Engineer will work first shift and longer hours when required. This is an onsite role.

Key Responsibilities

  • Improve fabrication process through tooling design, tooling PM, design changes, and process improvements
  • Design, develop and test tools, dies, jigs, fixtures, and gauges, using CAD
  • Recommend materials for tool production based on durability, cost, and function
  • Analyze and improve current tooling methods to increase efficiency and reduce cost
  • Generate frequency and standard work for tool/die preventative maintenance
  • Analyze quality of fabricated components and develop tool design/maintenance actions to improve
  • Work within the toolroom and in the operations department to ensure tools are operating at peak efficiency
  • Address problems and make / implement solution to improve efficiencies, process, product flow, safety, and quality
  • Report all necessary quality, production, and safety problems to Stakeholders
  • Document changes and revise detail prints and/or procedures to track the results of die repairs, modifications and improvements as they are made
  • Implement and drive a robust tooling preventive maintenance program
  • Prepare quotes and purchase replacement details, according to budget
  • Establish quarterly goals and objectives with Manager and Stakeholders
  • Review and update print GD&T (software application) based on product requirements and process capabilities
  • Support internal PPAP process for internally fabricated components
  • Drive continuous improvements efforts i.e., tooling cost reductions, improve usage or lower price without sacrificing quality
  • Troubleshoot any problems that are presented during production or on the bench

Basic Qualifications

OR

Preferred Qualifications

  • Stamping press and/or tooling troubleshooting experience
  • Energetic, hands-on; able to drive change and continuous improvement

  • Work with minimal guidance and direction
  • English written and verbal communication skills

job.title: Cyber Sec Archt/Engr II
job.description:
Job Description

As a Cyber Sec Archt/Engr II here at Honeywell, you will be responsible for leading the design and implementation of cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. You will be hands-on in fortifying defenses against emerging threats and acting as the subject matter expert for technical challenges. You will be responsible for collaborating with cross-functional teams, staying informed about emerging technologies, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

In this role, you will impact our cyber security initiatives by protecting critical assets and information across industries, ensuring the security and resilience of businesses worldwide. Your work will directly impact the safety and integrity of systems that power the modern world. Join us at Honeywell, where cybersecurity meets innovation, and together, we'll build a safer and more secure future.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement security policies and procedures to protect company assets
  • Conduct risk assessments and vulnerability scans to identify potential security vulnerabilities
  • Collaborate with crossfunctional teams to design and implement security solutions
  • Provide guidance on security best practices and ensure compliance with industry regulations
  • Stay uptodate with the latest security trends and technologies

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

  • 2+ years of experience in a cyber security leadership position
  • In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, frameworks, and best practices
  • Ability to lead direct and indirect reports by influence

WE VALUE

  • Bachelor’s or Advanced Degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or another related field
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or GIAC are highly desirable
  • Demonstrated leadership skills and experience managing cybersecurity teams

About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

job.title: Lead Field Service Fire Technician
job.description:
Job Description

As a Lead Field Service Fire Technician, you will be responsible for leading service, troubleshooting, maintenance, inspections, commissioning, and technical support activities for fire alarm systems across commercial, industrial, healthcare, education, and mission-critical customer sites throughout the Syracuse, NY region. You will serve as the technical leader for complex service activities, mentor junior technicians, coordinate field execution, and work directly with customers to ensure system reliability, code compliance, and operational excellence while delivering exceptional customer service.

In this role, you will lead inspections, repairs, commissioning, upgrades, and acceptance testing of fire alarm systems and related life safety equipment, ensuring all work is completed in accordance with Honeywell standards, NFPA codes, local AHJ requirements, and customer expectations.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead service, maintenance, inspections, troubleshooting, and repair activities
  • Diagnose complex fire alarm issues
  • Lead commissioning and acceptance testing
  • Mentor technicians
  • Complete reports
  • Coordinate with PMs, AHJs and customers
  • Ensure NFPA/OSHA compliance
  • Participate in on-call support

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

  • HS Diploma/GED
  • 3 or more years fire alarm field service
  • 3 or more years commercial/industrial systems
  • Valid driver's license
  • 3 or more years customer-facing experience
  • Knowledge of NFPA 72 and OSHA

WE VALUE

  • NICET I required; II or III preferred or willing to get certified within 90 days
  • Honeywell fire platform experience
  • NFPA 72 inspection experience
  • Special hazard systems
  • Advanced troubleshooting
  • Blueprint reading
  • AHJ coordination
  • OSHA 10/30
  • Mentoring experience

BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL

In addition to a competitive salary, leading-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. [Learn more](https://benefits.honeywell.com/)

The annual base salary range for this position is $69,700 - $87,350 mid. Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills as well as market and business considerations.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posted 08/11/2026

ABOUT HONEYWELL TECHNOLOGIES

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. [Learn more](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en)

THE BUSINESS UNIT

Meet fire threats with an integrated detect and response strategy. Fire protection begins with detection and response. We have experience equipping buildings of every size and complexity. We can scale solutions as needs evolve by connecting, enhancing and automating life safety systems. Real-time protection, full compliance, and unmatched scalability. That's what you get when you combine the power of Honeywell XLS4000, Honeywell Self-Test, and Honeywell Connected Life Safety Services (CLSS). This new product suite is a game-changing, all-in-one, end-to-end fire and life safety solution that provides you with the technology you need to seamlessly protect your people, your property, and your assets.

job.title: Lead HSE Coordinator
job.description:
Job Description

The Lead Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Coordinator will be the key point of contact for one of the HBA Airport service contract site & reporting to HBA HSE India north district leader, you will assist site Leadership in delivering the Honeywell and customer HSE requirements. Ensuring compliance and improving the safety culture within the portfolio. You will be responsible for effectively managing the day-to-day HSE activities at the site as a single point contact for all HSE matters of the site.

Responsibilities

As the Health, Safety and Environment engineer at siteyour key responsibilities will be to:

  • Ensure Compliance to Honeywell field HSE requirements and legislation for the site.
  • Establish relationships and processes with site team to influence employees to meet site HSE goals and objectives.
  • Support in the development & deployment of the district annual operating plan (AOP) for HSE performance. By ensuring the site HSE maturity requirements.
  • Conduct regular site contract HSE reviews to increase HSE performance to the scope of works.
  • Deploy a robust governance & auditing program for HSE at site.
  • Present HSE related trainings (induction, job specific or standard), ensure compliance to training need analysis and training plans., behavior observations, improving culture at site.
  • Work with the HSE leadership team to identify actions required to maintain or gain HSE Certifications to ISO 45001.
  • Complete injury / incident investigations as required
  • Assist in resolving potential non-compliance, enforcement actions or litigation regarding HSE matters.
  • Partner with site leaders and employees to continuously improve the HSE culture & awareness.
  • Maintains a close work relation with the site service leaders and Honeywell in regard with the Contract HSEMS management.
  • Monitor, record and present HSE performance parameters regularly, highlighting the lagging and leading indicators to site and district leadership.
  • Conduct HSE inspections, sharing the reports with site leadership and district HSE leaders.
  • Ensure 100% TBT implementation at site.
  • Ensure 100% adherence to customer HSE requirements and airfield operational procedures
  • Issue and monitor the effectiveness of permit to work system at site level.
  • Drive 5S & Kaizen initiatives at the site
  • Ensure risk assessments (Job level, Task level and last minute) are effectively implemented at site.

Key Deliverables

  • Achieve or exceed the site HSE objectives– Incident reduction & elimination
  • Sustain & improve the site HSE Maturity, observations, corrective action metrics & any other general KPI’s
  • Ensure compliance to all HSE standards from leadership, employees, contractors and sub-contractors.
  • Ensure an HSE continuous improvement culture is truly embedded in the site.

  • University Degree in Engineering (Electrical degree preferred)/Science with 2 years of experience or Diploma in engineering (Electrical preferred) with 4 years of experience

job.title: HVAC Apprentice- Union- Albuquerque, NM
job.description:
Job Description

As an HVAC Apprentice here at Honeywell, you will work under the direction of experienced HVAC Service Technicians to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair commercial HVAC and mechanical systems. Candidates will be required to join the applicable union apprenticeship program, which provides structured technical training and hands-on field experience to support skill development.

You will report directly to our Field Service Manager and work out of our Albuquerque, NM location on a Hybrid work schedule.

In this role, you will support the installation and service of commercial HVAC equipment while learning industry best practices, maintaining a safe work environment, and contributing to Honeywell's commitment to customer satisfaction and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Assist Journeyman HVAC Technicians with the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of commercial HVAC systems and mechanical equipment.
  • Learn to inspect, test, and diagnose HVAC equipment under the supervision of experienced technicians.
  • Assist with preventive maintenance activities on heating, ventilation, air conditioning, and refrigeration equipment.
  • Support the installation and service of chillers, boilers, rooftop units, air handlers, pumps, and related HVAC systems.
  • Learn to read and interpret blueprints, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.
  • Safely use hand tools, power tools, testing instruments, and trade-specific equipment.
  • Follow all Honeywell, customer, OSHA, and union safety requirements.
  • Maintain accurate service documentation and communicate job progress with the field service team.
  • Travel to customer locations throughout the Albuquerque, NM area and surrounding markets.
  • Complete apprenticeship training requirements and participate in classroom instruction as required by Local 412.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

  • High school diploma or GED.
  • Current membership in, or eligibility to join, Local 412.
  • 0-1 year of basic mechanical aptitude and a strong desire to learn the HVAC trade.
  • Ability to safely use hand and power tools.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to pass required background checks and drug screening for customer sites.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, climb ladders, work from lifts, and perform physically demanding work in various weather conditions.
  • Willingness to travel throughout the Albuquerque, NM area and surrounding markets.

WE VALUE

  • Enrollment in or completion of the Local 412 apprenticeship program.
  • Basic knowledge of commercial HVAC equipment, refrigeration systems, controls, or mechanical systems.
  • EPA Universal Section 608 Certification or willingness to obtain it.
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Commitment to safety, quality workmanship, and continuous learning.

BENEFITS OF WORKING FOR HONEYWELL

Benefits for this union-represented position are provided in accordance with the applicable Local 412 collective bargaining agreement. Benefits may include healthcare, retirement/pension, paid time off, holidays, and other applicable programs, subject to the terms of the collective bargaining agreement and applicable plan documents.

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posted 08/12/2026

ABOUT HONEYWELL TECHNOLOGIES

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. [Learn more](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

THE BUSINESS UNIT

Honeywell Building Technologies (HBT) and Honeywell Building Solutions (HBS) are leaders in providing innovative building automation, security, and energy management solutions. Together, they deliver advanced products, software, and services that ensure buildings are safe, efficient, and sustainable. The HVAC Apprentice role supports these business units by contributing to the installation, maintenance, and service of critical building HVAC and mechanical systems that enhance occupant comfort, energy efficiency, and operational performance.

_Honeywell is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, religion, or veteran status._ [_Learn more_](https://www.honeywell.com/us/en/company/inclusion-and-engagement?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

job.title: Advanced Cyber Sec Archt/Engr
job.description:
Job Description

The Advanced _Cyber Security Engineer_ reports to the Product Security Assurance Leader and will be responsible for assessing and evaluating the security posture of a variety of Honeywell IA Products and partner technologies.  This role will be responsible for security services delivery, which may include use of web/application/network/Mobile/Cloud/AI ML/protocol/hardware/firmware security toolsets, detection of security defects, and remediation consultation of those weaknesses.  Our services support the identification of potential attack techniques and serve as the foundation for continuously improving the product development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Individual Contributor with Product Security Assurance Team
  • Deliver Security Testing across all IA products.
  • Report observations using our standardized reporting structure
  • Work with cross functional teams to develop remediation suggestions
  • Develop methodologies, determine scoping requirements
  • Assist in the development of modular, repeatable, effective Security Testing processes
  • Proactively anticipate escalations
  • Oversee and ensure client deliverables are on time, requirements are met
  • Partner with Tools and Technology Team to select, implement, develop, and automate testing with appropriate tools.
  • Assist with onboarding internal team training
  • Champion strategic Product Security initiatives

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or software engineering, electrical engineering or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of Cyber Security or Information Technology experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of pentesting experience preferably in – Web, Mobile, Network, Thick Client, API, Web services, Cloud, Containers, AI ML, Embedded security ( Hardware and Firmware) , Protocol fuzzing
  • Has a Bachelor’s Engineering degree or equivalent, preferably in Computer Science
  • Perform penetration tests (Manual & Automated) for products spanning Web, Mobile (Android and iOS), Cloud, Dockers, Containers and Thick Clients
  • Familiarity with reverse engineering tools, debuggers, and dynamic analysis techniques
  • Analyze pen test results to identify the security vulnerabilities and suggest countermeasures for threat mitigation
  • Good understanding of Secure Development Lifecycle processes
  • Good knowledge of OWASP Top 10 and SANS Top 25 and how to effectively remediate vulnerabilities associated with each
  • Knowledge of attack frameworks like MITRE, VASTO, CIS Benchmarks, Virtualization Assessment Toolkit to exploit virtualization systems
  • Demonstrated manual product penetration testing experience; for example, simulate a SQL injection attack without using tools, simulate XSS attack, X-Path Injection, etc.
  • Good knowledge and hands-on experience using various penetration testing tools and frameworks like Nessus, Web Inspect, Nmap, Burp Suite, AppScan, ZAP, Kali Linux tools, IDA Pro, GHidra, OWASP, Metasploit, Nessus, Nmap, MObSF, Genymotion, Frida, APK Tool
  • Encryption tools and techniques for securing mobile and virtual machines
  • Understanding of application protocols, development, and common attack vectors.
  • Good cybersecurity capabilities and strong software engineering skills
  • Scripting experience in Python, Powershell and Bash preferred.
  • Experience working with other languages such as C, C++, Java, .NET or javascript.
  • Up to date knowledge of current and emerging security threats and techniques for exploiting security vulnerabilities
  • Effective oral and written communication and negotiation skills
  • Good interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work with geographically distributed, cross-functional teams

Good to Have Skills

  • Certification such as CEH, OSCP, OSWE, CCSP, CCSK, GPEN, CRTP, CRTO will be highly desirable
  • Strong Secure SDLC concepts
  • Experience in integrating pentest tools to CI/CD pipeline

job.title: Sr Systems Eng Supervisor
job.description:
Job Description

The role operates across the complete IMC value chain: opportunity identification and shaping, service creation, offering enablement, solution development, engineering execution, deployment support, and lifecycle services. The leader is simultaneously accountable for people leadership, engineering capability, AI adoption, revenue growth, billable hours, and alignment with IMC regions, R&D, P&E, Offering Management and Sales Management.

Strategic value to IMC and GPE

  • Translate product innovation into scalable, repeatable engineering services.
  • Accelerate adoption of new and existing IMC offerings through GPE capability readiness.
  • Connect product roadmaps, regional needs and engineering capability to create measurable business value.

Act as a trusted partner to IMC Offering Management, Product Management, R&D and Regional Leaders

Responsibilities

  • Lead initiatives to increase GPE revenue in dollars and expand billable engineering hours.
  • Expand regional engineering engagement and improve engineering productivity and utilization.
  • Create new engineering, consulting and lifecycle services aligned with IMC priorities.
  • Develop white-space opportunities and expand the service portfolio beyond established segments.
  • Measure success through revenue growth, billable-hour growth, white-space development and service portfolio expansion.
  • Opportunity development: identify growth opportunities, assess regional demand, evaluate GPE white spaces and define service concepts.
  • Service definition and offering enablement: develop deployment methodologies, engineering service packages, reusable assets and delivery standards.
  • Engineering execution enablement: build competencies, develop delivery frameworks, ensure organizational readiness and establish deployment support models.
  • Lifecycle services: define optimization services, develop modernization programs, establish recurring revenue streams and support portfolio expansion.
  • Offering Management: understand portfolio priorities, identify adoption opportunities, develop engineering growth plans and support commercialization initiatives.
  • Product Management: understand market requirements, shape engineering-service offerings, create deployment strategies and support portfolio growth objectives.
  • R&D Technical Leadership: understand technology roadmaps, align capability plans, prepare GPE for upcoming releases, and identify pilots and new service opportunities.
  • Regional IMC organizations: align GPE capacity and capability with the needs of META, Europe and the Americas.
  • Current offerings: Modular Systems, GTAC, SI Connect, Metering, Skids, TAS solutions, Process & Engineering Services, and Lifecycle Services.
  • Future offerings: emerging IMC technologies, AI-enabled solutions, digital engineering capabilities and new product introductions.
  • Identify how successful approaches from one IMC segment can be adapted and scaled into adjacent segments.
  • Engineering productivity: knowledge-management automation, engineering-process automation, design-productivity enhancement and documentation automation.
  • AI-enabled service development: create services using AI-assisted engineering, digital deployment methods, Engineering Copilot capabilities and intelligent lifecycle solutions.
  • Build a prioritized portfolio of AI use cases with clear engineering, quality and business-value measures.
  • Increase engineering output, quality and billable capacity without proportional headcount growth.
  • Define future skills and technical competencies across GPE.
  • Create competency roadmaps aligned with business-growth priorities.
  • Develop certification plans that strengthen technical depth, delivery consistency and confidence.
  • Build reusable engineering frameworks, tools and templates that improve quality and productivity.
  • Standardize delivery methodologies to enable repeatable execution across regions and offerings.
  • Talent development: individual development plans, career planning, technical mentoring and leadership coaching.
  • Performance management: goal setting, continuous feedback, performance reviews, recognition and development planning.
  • Workforce planning: resource planning, capability planning, succession planning and strategic hiring.
  • Culture: promote accountability, innovation, continuous improvement, collaboration, internal-customer focus and a growth mindset.
  • Create clarity on priorities, build an inclusive and high-performing team environment, and develop future technical and people leaders.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, Electronics, Automation or a related engineering discipline.

Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in industrial automation, engineering services or process solutions.
  • 10+ years in technical leadership roles, with experience leading global teams and developing engineering capability.
  • Hands-on experience with IMC control-system products and technologies, including PLC, DCS and SCADA.
  • Experience working with Honeywell IMC Product Management, Offering Management and R&D organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to create or scale engineering services, grow billable hours and influence revenue outcomes.
  • Experience connecting opportunity development, offering enablement, execution and lifecycle services.

Mandatory business and technical knowledge

  • Good understanding of IMC business models, revenue drivers, offering lifecycles, regional operating nuances and engineering value chains.
  • Strong knowledge of Modular Systems and working knowledge across GTAC, SI Connect, Metering, Skids, TAS, P&E and Lifecycle Services.

Responsible to drive Region-wise PA Sales, deliver AOP sales target, pre-sales activity, manage a team of 2-4 sales personnel and value selling to the customers.

The South Region Sales Manager will lead a team of Sales Personnel to deliver the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) of approximately 25M-30M of orders. The team will be comprised approximately 3-4 sales professionals.

Manage all aspects of engagements with existing and new customers for our Honeywell Process Automation Organization. Utilize your product knowledge to deliver the value proposition to the customers

Qualifications

MUST HAVE

job.title: Advanced Data Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

The Role: The Advanced Data Analyst will work across all PT lines of business and geographies to drive enterprise data quality, governance, and analytics initiatives supporting PT’s Digital Transformation, including S/4 HANA, digital customer experience, and enterprise analytics.

The role will focus on improving master and transactional data quality, enabling efficient business processes across Quote-to-Cash, Plan-to-Produce, Source-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report, while driving measurable business outcomes and operational excellence.

You will play a key role in defining data strategies, leading cross-functional data workstreams, and enabling analytics-driven decision-making across PT.

Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

  • Advocate and champion data-driven approaches in process improvement initiatives by leading data governance and analytics workstreams, presenting insights to leadership, and driving execution across cross-functional teams.
  • Partner closely with functional leadership (Commercial, Finance, ISC, Engineering, IT) to identify insights and drive strategies that improve transactional and master data quality, process efficiency, and business KPIs.
  • Design and implement data quality metrics, scorecards, and performance indicators, linking data health to business outcomes and monitoring them through structured operating cadence (MOS).
  • Collaborate with the Data Quality COE, Master Data teams, Engineering, and IT to expand availability of trusted data, automate recurring data processes, and improve system integration.
  • Drive data discovery, profiling, and root cause analysis to identify systemic data issues and define requirements for data cleansing, automation, and process improvements.
  • Perform advanced analysis across ERP systems (SAP ECC / S/4 HANA) to identify data inconsistencies, process gaps, and opportunities for optimization.
  • Communicate complex or sensitive data insights effectively to leadership and stakeholders, influencing decision-making and driving alignment across functions.
  • Define, document, and harmonize data quality standards, governance policies, business rules, approval workflows, and control frameworks to ensure sustained data quality.
  • Solve complex problems involving data architecture, process integration, and governance strategy, providing thought leadership and continuous improvement recommendations.
  • Develop scalable processes, templates, and tools for data cleansing, enrichment, governance, and monitoring across domains (Customer, Vendor, Material, Finance).
  • Engage in MOS and governance forums to drive accountability, ensure adherence to corporate data standards, and continuously improve data quality maturity.
  • Support enterprise transformation programs, including S/4 HANA data workstreams (data readiness, cleansing, migration, validation, and governance).
  • Enable integration across systems of record and downstream platforms including analytics, eCommerce, and digital customer experience solutions.
  • Work independently with a high degree of ownership while leading cross-functional initiatives and influencing stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.

Qualifications

Role Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 5+ Years of experience in Data Management, Data Governance, Analytics, or SAP/SFDC/Ecom/PIM Data domains
  • 3+ Years of Experience working with SAP ECC / S/4 HANA, Master Data Governance, Data Migration, Informatica, Collibra and Data Quality Management
  • Solid understanding of data governance concepts including metadata management, data architecture, data modeling, data integration, data Lineage and data lifecycle management.
  • Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools (Power BI, SQL, Python or equivalent) preferred

We Value

  • Excellent communication, presentation, problem solving, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Highly proficient in Microsoft office; Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint
  • Strong business acumen with data-mining mindset to drive value from investments.
  • Ability to collaborate with and influence across many interpersonal levels, up to executives.
  • Excellent communication skills combined with the ability to navigate a highly matrixed organization.
  • Self-starter with high ownership, able to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Adept in critical thinking and understanding of business processes, technology, systems, and tools.
  • Demonstrated initiative and resourcefulness; Self-starter with the ability to work independently.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, with high regard for quality and consistency of communication, and able to present concise plans and ideas to executive level in a diverse work environment.

About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

The Future Is What We Make It.

When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our Global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers and doers who make the things that make the future.

The position supports reliable and secure system performance throughout design, implementation, testing, commissioning, and customer handover.

External

  • Customer centricity: Avoid customer escalations related to the quality of system designs and applications.

  • Relevant networking and cybersecurity certifications are mandatory, such as CompTIA Network+ or Security+, Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals, or an equivalent industry-recognised qualification.

2.Work Experience Required

  • Five to seven years of relevant project experience.

3.Technical Skills & Specific Knowledge Required

Control Systems and Technical Documentation

  • Strong knowledge of distributed control systems (DCS), emergency shutdown systems (ESD), programmable logic controllers (PLC), and supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) platforms.
  • Ability to prepare functional design specifications (FDS), detailed design specifications (DDS), and system architecture drawings.

Industrial Experience and Site Delivery

  • More than five years of experience in industrial networking, industrial process-control environments, and cybersecurity audits and assessments.

Cybersecurity and Compliance

  • Experience conducting cybersecurity risk analyses and applying Linux and Windows security fundamentals.
  • Experience with antivirus, backup and recovery, network-management, and application-whitelisting solutions.
  • Knowledge of current cybersecurity standards and frameworks, including NIST, NCA, IEC 62443, and ISO 27001.

Networking and Systems

  • Experience with LAN/WAN architectures, the Purdue Model for industrial control systems, and the design and optimisation of complex LAN environments.
  • Experience selecting and configuring Cisco network switches and firewalls from vendors including Cisco, Juniper, Palo Alto Networks, and Fortinet.
  • Experience with Microsoft technologies, including Active Directory, DNS, WSUS, and Terminal Services, together with strong virtualisation expertise.
  • Ability to install and configure operator and engineering workstations, servers, domain controllers, and OPC servers and clients.
  • Ability to perform CPU-load and network-performance testing and configure server and I/O redundancy.
  • Experience integrating control systems and third-party interfaces using Modbus, OPC, and other suitable communication protocols, including IP-addressing design and industrial firewall configuration.

Process Control and Troubleshooting

  • Knowledge of process-control system design and implementation.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills, with the ability to resolve complex network, application, and system-integration issues.

Professional Certifications

  • Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional (GICSP) certification.
  • At least one Cisco professional-level certification in networking, design, or security.

4.Behavioural Competencies Required

Behaviours

Technical and functional excellence, effective communication, self-awareness and continuous learning, and championing change.

Soft Skills

Ability to manage technical scope, strong communication skills, and commitment to using standard builds.

5.Language Requirements

  • Additional language skills would be beneficial.

job.title: Tech Writer
job.description:
Job Description

Location: Pune, India

Work Schedule: Standard (Monday-Friday)

Job Description

We are seeking a skilled Technical Writer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing a variety of technical documentation, including user manuals, operating instructions, online help, release notes, product data sheets, and installation instructions.

This role provides opportunities to work with global cross-functional product teams and gain deep knowledge of enterprise software products and technologies. You will strengthen your expertise in technical communication, content strategy, and modern documentation tools while contributing to large-scale product releases.

The position offers exposure to global stakeholders, enabling you to enhance your collaboration, leadership, and project management skills.

This position is challenging and rewarding for writers who enjoy working with innovative and creative technology products.

Writers work in a comfortable, respectful environment and are treated as peers across departments. Technical documentation is required and valued as part of most products. Each writer’s role is important to the writing team’s contribution and the overall success of those products.

Responsibilities

Job Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including product data sheet, user guides, installation manuals, release notes for software and hardware products based on the Client’s Framework.
  • Learn and work with Client’s software and hardware products.

  • Write task-based topics with related concepts and reference topics as needed.

  • Communicate and arrange reviews/approvals from global stakeholders.
  • Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in related engineering discipline or science-related field
  • Bachelor’s Degree in technical writing, communications, engineering, journalism, English, technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Qualifications

Background

You must have:

  • 3+ years of experience in the technical writing domain.

  • Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly
  • Good time management & prioritization of assigned tasks & projects.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail.

Nice to have

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come.
