**

Location: Hyderabad, India

Carrier is a leading provider of heating, ventilating, air conditioning and refrigeration systems, building controls and automation, and fire and security systems leading to safer, smarter, sustainable, and high-performance buildings. Carrier is on a mission to make modern life possible by delivering groundbreaking systems and services that help homes, buildings and shipping become safer, smarter, and more sustainable. Our teams exceed the expectations of our customers by anticipating industry trends, working tirelessly to master and revolutionize them.

Among the many benefits, Carrier offers Retirement Savings Plan, Health Insurance, Time Off & Vacation Options, Parental Leave, Employee Scholar Program, Flexible Work Arrangements, Employee Assistance Program, Professional Development and Part-Time Benefits.

Description

The Carrier Air Conditioning is looking for a high-potential candidate to join our Digital ERP Architecture team. This role will be part of Carrier DA (Design Authority) team with key tasks include overall responsibility and authority to make decisions and provide guidance on design-related matters within SAP ERP system architecture. Propose most efficient business processes to meet or exceed business goals and objectives for business process. Responsible for benchmarking SAP processes with similar industries to propose scalable, lowest ownership and cost solutions that fit with existing SAP solution. Act as the integration layer between business and technology teams to deliver a seamless solution. Guide the development team in building solutions that are well designed, standards based, robust and easily maintained within SAP ERP Systems. Support the activities of architecture, design, application development, integration, and data/analytics within SAP ERP including SAP ECC & SAP S/4 HANA. Strong understanding of ERP systems from data perspective, including data structures, modules, and integration points. In addition, familiarize with the existing digital landscape to guide in the decisions regarding reuse, make or buy. Very good knowledge of SAP OTC domain business processes and ability to engage with architects in other domains for cross-functional solutions. other responsibilities include operational support of current applications, assisting IT management in the definition of IT strategic plans, and assessment and delivery of next generation business solutions. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing, deploying, and supporting software solutions within Carrier wide SAP based ERP solution suite.

**

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead Digital ERP -SAP architecture tasks in accordance with Carrier IT’s methodologies and governance model and collaborate with other IT teams to ensure solution designs are well coordinated and aligned to the overall ERP enterprise architecture.
  • As part of Carrier DA (Design Authority) team include overall responsibility and authority to make decisions and provide guidance on design-related matters within Order TO Cash process
  • Architect/Design system solutions to address business requirements, in alignment with the global solution template.
  • Architect and recommend solutions to achieve business goals, including integration points with other SAP modules or other applications, following SAP standard methodologies.
  • Guides development teams towards best practices in the design and development of enterprise solutions; validates that all requirements are met and gains approval from the Enterprise Architecture Review Board
  • Support & developing SAP S/4 HANA based Carrier wide global template and develop.
  • Develop Architecture specifications for systems, custom developments, integrations and collaborate with the development team to get those built and tested.
  • Analyze the existing business processes and business data and provide proactive & Constructure recommendations for improvement.
  • Seeks innovative solutions to problems through evaluation and proof of concepts with new and existing technology capabilities to determine compatibility with current and future architectural standards and business requirements. Continuously manages, monitors, and updates architectural models as business needs evolve. Interfaces with the business to discuss products and ideas and support Business Analysts as they drive functional requirements.
  • Controlling solution development to ensure standards are being observed.
  • Ability to establish relationships with business, IT leaders and technology subject matter experts with excellent verbal and written communication skills appropriate for both technical and non-technical audiences. Detail-oriented with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies as Carrier progresses through a digital transformation.
  • Performs requirements analysis for IT systems, effort and sizing estimations, including as-is and to-be cost assessments, and provides input to business case development and validate data requirements for applications. Supports efforts to achieve architectural compliance with Carrier standards and government regulations. Drives the creation of process models for the domains of business, application, data, and technology.
  • Creates and manages domain level architecture with all the Technology information and integration details. Should be able to build roadmap to keep systems up to date with technology versions/upgrades.

Experience

  • At least 16 year of experience
  • Experience in defining and maintaining global templates and play books for SAP OTC Modules.
  • Experience with ERP implementation projects, including data migration, integration, and customization.
  • Previous Order To Cash Architect experience.
  • Business process analysis and redesign experience: strong business analysis skills; process mapping; business process redesign and implementation
  • Experience in design, delivery, and clear understanding the SAP SD (Order To Cash) with integration MM/SD/LE/PP and FICO in SAP ECC and S/4 HANA environments
  • Hands-on experience in SD Master Data/Pricing/Sales BOM/VC/Sales Quote/Sales Order /ATP/Delivery/Billing/Rebates & Returns, CS module is a big plus.
  • Experience with Hybris and Other CPQ/Quote system is preferred,
  • Experience in end-to-end implementation for a global, manufacturing company.
  • Experience with Global Template development and governance
  • Knowledge of Application Interface Framework (AIF), Application Link Enabling (ALE), and Master Data Governance (MDG) Integration of Central Finance with SAP and other non-SAP solutions is preferred.
  • A conceptual thinker with the professional skills to create compelling solutions, considering business objectives as well as appropriate regulatory and technical requirements.
  • The ability to excel in a global team environment, effectively communicate and achieve results is critical.
  • Highly motivated, self-directed, and able to effectively work with limited oversight.

Benefits

  • We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.
  • Have peace of mind and body with our health insurance
  • Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules and leave Policy
  • Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Program.

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. job.title: Sr. Engineer, Firmware & Embedded Software
job.description:
About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

About This Role

We are seeking a Senior Firmware & Embedded Engineer to design, develop, and optimize embedded firmware for next-generation air conditioning products.

In this role, you will contribute to architecture decisions, solve complex technical challenges, and collaborate with hardware, systems, and production teams. You will support critical technical topics, provide guidance to other engineers, and help ensure our products meet global standards for quality, reliability, safety, and cybersecurity.

Our engineering teams take on some of the most unique and exciting global challenges in climate technology. To maintain our position as a global leader, we are looking for talented, ambitious, and results-oriented engineers who thrive in a fast-paced environment and want to contribute to Carrier’s continued legacy of innovation and success.

This is an onsite position located in Indianapolis, Indiana.

Role Responsibilities

As a Senior Firmware & Embedded Engineer, you will be responsible for the following, in addition to other assignments as needed:

  • Design, develop, and implement embedded firmware solutions that meet business needs and deliver reliable, scalable product functionality.
  • Apply hands-on experience with microcontrollers, RTOS platforms, and embedded communication protocols to develop robust embedded solutions.
  • Develop firmware in C/C++ with a focus on efficiency, reliability, safety, and maintainability.
  • Develop and maintain firmware using C/C++ and, where applicable, assembly or other low-level programming languages.
  • Contribute throughout the embedded software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, reviews, implementation, integration, validation, and release support.
  • Support software quality through engineering best practices, including design reviews, code reviews, unit testing, functional and integration testing, and CI/CD integration.
  • Create and maintain software designs, technical documentation, and implementation details for assigned firmware features and product functionality.
  • Participate in product cybersecurity reviews and support secure firmware development practices.
  • Participate in Change Control Board meetings to help prioritize features, defects, and product improvements.
  • Debug and troubleshoot embedded systems using tools such as emulators, JTAG/BDM debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related equipment.
  • Stay current with emerging embedded technologies and apply relevant innovations to improve product performance, quality, and maintainability.
  • Work within Agile development environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitHub, and related software development platforms.
  • Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and review feedback to junior and mid-level engineers as needed.
  • Analyze, design, program, debug, troubleshoot, and modify firmware for embedded applications.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience designing and developing embedded firmware.
  • Willing and able to travel up to 10% of the year (domestic).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming for embedded systems.
  • Hands-on experience with RTOS, multi-threading, and bare-metal programming.
  • Good understanding of microcontroller architecture, interrupts, timers, memory such as Flash, RAM, and EEPROM, and low-level drivers.
  • Experience with wired communication protocols and architectures such as UART, RS232/485, I2C, SPI, and Modbus.
  • Experience in the use of Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or other software development tools.
  • Knowledge of embedded development workflows, version control, and build systems such as CMake and Make.
  • Experience using hardware debugging tools and test equipment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of firmware development best practices, including Agile development, design documentation, code reviews, and unit testing.
  • Experience with IoT and embedded system design elements such as bootloader, over-the-air firmware downloads, and firmware updates.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity technologies and best practices, including encryption, key management, certificates, secure exchanges, and Secure Boot.
  • Experience working with hardware and electrical systems, including the ability to verify firmware behavior through hardware probing using tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.
  • Experience with HVAC control systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work independently on complex firmware assignments while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven ability to support continuous improvement and help standardize engineering processes.

Pay Range

The annual salary for this position is between $79,000.00 - $158,000.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate.

Other Compensation

This position may be entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

Benefits

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

  • Health Care Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
  • Retirement Benefits
  • Time off and Leave: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation
  • Disability: Short-term and long-term disability
  • Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment
  • Tax-Advantaged Accounts: Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account
  • Tuition Assistance

To learn more about our benefits offering, please click here [Work with us | Carrier Corporate](https://www.corporate.carrier.com/careers/work-with-us/). The specific benefits available to any employee may vary depending on state and local laws and eligibility factors, such as date of hire and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

We are a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Role Overview

We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded leader to help shape and strengthen our Datacenters business strategy across Asia Pacific and the Middle East (AME). In this role, you will combine market insight, business planning, financial analysis, and operational improvement to develop strategies and processes which enable growth, improve execution, and help the business scale effectively. You will work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to turn data and insight into clear prioritized actions, practical initiatives, and measurable results in a fast-changing market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Improve business performance: Review the end-to-end value chain and margins, identify bottlenecks, and lead improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, strengthen margins, and improve overall business performance.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives: Partner with teams across the business to deliver strategic programs that support growth, improve execution, and strengthen day-to-day operations.
  • Standardize and improve processes: Drive process improvement and standardization to create a more consistent, efficient, and customer-focused operating model across markets.
  • Provide market and competitive insight: Track datacenter market trends, customer needs, technology developments, and competitive activity to support business decisions and strategy development.
  • Support strategic projects: Turn analysis into action and help evaluate and deliver key business initiatives, including partnerships, transformation programs, and other priority projects.
  • Lead the planning cycle: Manage the annual and long-range planning process for the AME Datacenters business, including key planning and review milestones.
  • Shape long-term strategy: Partner with business leadership to develop three- to five-year plans that align market opportunities, customer needs, and business priorities.
  • Deliver insights for decision-making: Create clear analysis, recommendations, and presentations that help senior leaders make informed business decisions.
  • Strengthen reporting and visibility: Work with Finance, Sales Operations, and Digital teams to improve dashboards and reporting that support faster, better decisions.
  • Support bid management: Help build and improve the bid management approach for complex opportunities by introducing clear frameworks, coordination, and analysis.
  • Communicate business priorities: Develop clear communications that help teams understand the business direction, strategic priorities, and what success looks like.

job.title: Data Centre - Regional Account Manager - AME
job.description:
About Carrier

Carrier is a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, committed to creating healthier, safer, and more sustainable environments. With a legacy of innovation and a world-class, diverse workforce, we continue to lead by keeping customers at the center of everything we do. Our performance-driven culture fuels long-term value creation through strategic investments and bold growth initiatives.

The Role

As the Regional Key Account Manager (KAM) for the AME region, you will be relationship architect for our high-value datacenter customer accounts. You will bridge the gap between our cutting-edge cooling technologies (including liquid cooling, Chillers and advanced air handling) and the infrastructure roadmaps of the largest Datacenter builders in Asia Pacific & Middle East region. Your goal is to position Carrier as a strategic technology and business partner for the customer. To thrive in this role, you need a unique blend of relationship-building skills, financial acumen, strategic outlook and technical curiosity

Key Responsibilities

  • Comprehensive Account Mapping: Identify, map, and cultivate deep relationships with all key stakeholders across the customer ecosystem—ranging from C-suite executives, procurement heads to regional site operations managers and engineering leads.
  • Cross-functional Engagement: Establish multi-level touchpoints at both the customer’s Asia Pacific/Middle East Headquarters and their decentralized regional teams across all critical functions (Design, Sustainability, Procurement, and Construction).
  • Early-Stage Engagement: Intercept opportunities during the concept and design phases of datacenter planning, long before a formal RFP is issued.
  • Planning-to-action: Translate strategic discussions into tangible, multi-year, multi-country business plans. Act as the regional anchor, supporting country-specific sales teams with tactical intelligence and strategic alignment to close local deals.
  • Solution Co-Engineering: Synthesize trends to position our cooling portfolio proactively. Partner with customer engineering teams to tailor, optimize, and co-design cooling solutions that match their specific Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) targets.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Serve as the internal champion for your accounts. Work with Product Management, R&D, Marketing and Operations to ensure custom solution requests and supply chain timelines match customer deployments.
  • Commercial Excellence: Lead complex, multi-million-dollar regional contract negotiations, establishing Master Service Agreements (MSAs) that maximize profitability while protecting long-term partnership health.
  • Data-Driven Governance: Monitor rigorous sales metrics and KPIs, providing clear, forecast-accurate pipelines and progress reports to the executive leadership team.

Qualifications

  • 8–10+ years of enterprise/strategic sales experience in the Datacenter infrastructure industry (Cooling, Power, or EPC services preferred).
  • Proven track record of navigating the diverse business cultures and regulatory environments across APAC and the Middle East.
  • Understanding of datacenter cooling dynamics, sustainability metrics (PUE/WUE) and emerging technologies
  • Demonstrated success in negotiating complex, large-scale capital equipment contracts/complex bids and multi-year MSAs

job.description:
About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

About this role

The Indianapolis manufacturing plant has an opportunity to become a key contributor to the overall Operations team.  In this role as a Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll be responsible for troubleshooting, modifying, and acquiring equipment in a fast paced, high-volume manufacturing plant.

We are looking for candidates with 2+ years of technical experience, whether in manufacturing or other industries, who excel at fostering collaboration, achieving results, analyzing data, and decision making.  Your transferable skills and fresh perspectives are highly valued, as we recognize the strength of diverse backgrounds. This role offers significant opportunities to grow your career with Carrier and take on greater leadership responsibilities within a global organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Respond urgently to plant issues and emergencies, acting as the technical expert during unplanned events and drive implementation of effective corrective and preventative actions.
  • Troubleshoot equipment and tooling issues; providing technical support to maintenance, tool room and production, as requested.
  • Recommend, specify and implement preventive maintenance procedures.
  • Plan, coordinate and implement repairs, modifications and improvements to equipment and tooling.
  • Ensure equipment is properly released to production after preventative maintenance or repairs.
  • Lead Kaizen events resulting in higher line output and greater efficiency.
  • Utilize maintenance and tooling management system, purchase order system and various other planning systems.
  • Innovate and implement cost reduction, quality, safety, and ergonomic improvement ideas for the operations team.
  • Model and promote adherence to OSHA regulations and Carrier environmental, health and safety policies and initiatives.
  • Fostering a positive working relationship with union representatives by adhering to the terms of the Collective Bargaining Agreement.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 2+ years of experience in Operations or Engineering

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within a fast paced manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with A/B Control Logix 5000, Siemens S7 PLC’s, various VFD motor controls.
  • Experience with pneumatic and hydraulic controls.
  • Automation and/or tooling troubleshooting experience preferred.
  • Energetic, hands-on; able to drive change and continuous improvement.
  • Experience applying Six Sigma/Lean manufacturing principles.
  • Demonstrated ability to foster positive relationships with production employees, peers and manufacturing management.
  • Ability to work with minimal guidance and direction.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience in a union environment is preferred.
  • Strong computer and system skills, including AutoCAD and Microsoft Office.

Pay Range

The annual salary for this position is between $64,500.00 - $129,500.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate.

Other Compensation

This position may be entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

Benefits

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

  • Health Care Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
  • Retirement Benefits
  • Time off and Leave: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation
  • Disability: Short-term and long-term disability
  • Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment
  • Tax-Advantaged Accounts: Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account
  • Tuition Assistance

job.description:
About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. About the role

If you are looking for a role that combines your technical acumen and passion for marketing, then we have a great opportunity for you. We are seeking a high-energy, self-starter to work effectively across the organization with the goal of delivering innovative product solutions for our customers.

The Senior Ductless Product Manager is responsible for leading the strategic direction, roadmaps, new product development, portfolio lifecycle management and commercialization strategy for ductless HVAC products. The successful candidate must have the capacity to work in a fast-paced environment and demonstrate the ability to leverage leadership, decision-making abilities, and technical aptitude to ensure products meet customer needs. Foundational skills for this role include project management, public speaking, general technical aptitude and general business management skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Be an expert in Ductless heat pump systems, products, and markets.
  • Determine needs and strategies for market acceptance.
  • Communicate and gain support for product vision and strategy and drive organizational alignment to drive execution of product strategies and roadmaps.
  • Evaluate and propose product growth opportunities with strong strategic company value and viable success potential that will drive sales growth and market share.
  • Works closely with other product managers, regional sales managers, product engineers, factory, product launch and other internal departments to provide product and application support to distributors, dealers and/or customers to help increase sales, revenue, and margins.
  • Regularly conduct competitive comparisons, product gap analysis and voice of customer gathering to understand and drive robust product value through features & benefits
  • Create messaging and tools to assist sales, distributors and dealers gain market share of our products
  • Leverage input from multiple channels, both internal and external, to solidly define feature requirements.
  • Develop pre-sale technical materials that aid in the selection, application and sales of ductless products.
  • Clearly articulate product features and value in public speaking events such as distributor, dealer, sales, and recruitment meetings.
  • Research, propose and execute product modification projects from conception through launch.
  • Develop a thorough understanding of the residential HVAC industry, the company's products, and sales channels.
  • Establish positive working relationships with the field sales force and key leaders in the HVAC space and be viewed as an expert regarding the products and application opportunities.
  • Responsible for product launches and phase-in/out for projects with significant scope and complexity.
  • Juggle multiple issues, set expectations and prioritize accordingly.

  • 3+ years of HVAC industry experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in business or engineering preferred
  • Clear understanding of basic marketing principles
  • Understanding of residential HVAC applications and market dynamics preferred
  • Ability to work in self-directed manner across multiple business units to identify needs of the organization and/or customer, articulate necessary proposals and see projects through to completion
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, while also able to manage multiple priorities
  • Passion for customers. Ability to listen to customer needs and quickly act to solve their problems, go above and beyond to exceed their expectations
  • Demonstrates self-initiative, sense of ownership, quality, and customer satisfaction orientation
  • Proven ability to execute with speed and exhibit a bias for action mindset
  • Ability to think outside the box, innovate, take risks, and implement progressive, sustainable solutions
  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to pull data from assorted sources and synthesis in both graphic and verbal format, so that it is easily understood by the target audience
  • Strong ability to work in diverse, cross functional project teams to achieve high levels of performance in a dynamic, changing environment
  • Play to win by daring to disrupt

About the role: The Remote Commissioning Engineer will be responsible for remote commissioning, validation, integration, and troubleshooting of Building Management Systems (BMS) and HVAC control systems. The role requires deep technical understanding of Niagara Framework, control logic, field devices, and building equipment, with the ability to diagnose system-level issues and optimize performance remotely

Job Responsibilities:

  • Perform remote commissioning of BMS and HVAC control systems using Niagara N4, NexRev, and Novar platforms.
  • Validate controller configurations, control logic, point databases, graphics, alarms, schedules, and trends.
  • Commission and verify field devices such as sensors, actuators, VFDs, dampers, valves, meters, and controllers.
  • Monitor and analyze live system data, alarms, trends, and logs to identify functional and performance issues.
  • Troubleshoot control logic, network communication, and application-level issues across BMS subsystems.
  • Diagnose integration issues across BACnet, Modbus, LON, and IP-based protocols.
  • Provide technical support through calls, emails, and remote sessions for live customer issues.
  • Support testing of HVAC systems including AHU, RTU, Heat Pump, VAV and lighting systems.
  • Coordinate remotely with site teams, commissioning agents, and internal engineering teams.
  • Prepare detailed commissioning reports, as-built documentation, and technical advisory notes.
  • Track commissioning issues, punch points, and action items to closure using project trackers.
  • Provide post-commissioning support and assist during system handover and stabilization phases.
  • Support critical commissioning and troubleshooting activities outside normal business hours when required.

Requirements

  • 5 – 7 years’ experience in BMS Remote Commissioning
  • B.E/B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical or similar background.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Niagara Framework (N4) including station setup, backups, restores, and upgrades.
  • In-depth understanding of BMS architecture, controllers, and supervisory systems.
  • Strong expertise in HVAC control sequences and building equipment operation.
  • Ability to troubleshoot application, controller, and network-level issues.
  • Knowledge of electrical and mechanical fundamentals related to HVAC and building automation.
  • Experience in BMS integrations and third-party device communication.
  • Ability to interpret control drawings, wiring diagrams, and functional descriptions.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for technical discussions with Technicians and stakeholders.

job.title: Associate Director FP&A
job.description:
Role Summary

The Global Container FP&A Head will lead financial planning, forecasting, management reporting, business analytics and decision support for the Global Container business. The role partners closely with business, regional and functional leadership to provide clear financial insights, improve forecast quality, strengthen performance management, and support sustainable growth, margin expansion and cash generation across the global business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the Annual Operating Plan, Long Range Plan, profit assurance and rolling forecast processes for the Global Container business.
  • Coordinate planning calendars, assumptions, submissions, reviews and leadership presentations across regions and functions.
  • Develop robust financial models, scenario analysis and sensitivity analysis to support business decisions.
  • Improve forecast accuracy by strengthening assumptions, cadence, data quality and accountability across the organization.
  • Prepare and deliver monthly and quarterly performance analysis for business leadership reviews.
  • Explain business performance versus plan, forecast and prior year, with clear linkage to operational and commercial drivers.
  • Track and analyze key performance indicators including sales, orders, backlog, margin, EBIT, cash flow, working capital, pricing.
  • Highlight risks, opportunities, performance gaps and required management actions in a timely and structured manner.
  • Partner with business and functional leaders to support profitable business growth.
  • Support pricing, margin improvement, productivity, working capital and transformation initiatives with financial insights and analytics.
  • Prepare business cases, ROI analysis and financial evaluations for strategic projects, capital investments and operational initiatives.
  • Lead cash flow forecasting and working capital performance analysis in partnership with operational finance teams.
  • Analyze inventory, receivables, payables and operational drivers impacting cash conversion.
  • Support initiatives to improve cash generation and capital efficiency.
  • Standardize and simplify management reporting, forecast templates, review decks and FP&A processes.
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement to reduce manual reporting effort and improve insight quality.
  • Promote strong governance, data accuracy and consistency in financial reporting and analysis.
  • Lead, coach and develop FP&A COE team, building strong analytical, communication and business partnering capabilities.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and high-quality execution.

Requirement

  • CA, CPA, ACCA or MBA Finance
  • 10-15 years of progressive finance experience, including significant FP&A, business finance, management reporting and leadership exposure in a multinational environment
  • Experience in hands on FP&A scope to manufacturing, industrial, equipment, or global business environments preferred.
  • Advanced Excel, financial modeling, PowerPoint and executive presentation skills. Working knowledge of ERP, BI/reporting tools
  • Strong business partnering, stakeholder management, communication, influencing, problem solving and team leadership skills.
  • Commercially curious, analytical, hands-on, detail-oriented, improvement focused and comfortable operating in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Given the global/regional and cross-functional nature of the role, flexibility to work and engage with stakeholders and team members across different time zones (including US) is required

Key Competencies

  • Strategic financial planning and business performance management
  • Executive-level financial storytelling and presentation capability
  • Strong commercial, operational and manufacturing finance acumen
  • Ability to convert complex data into actionable insights
  • Cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder influence
  • Forecasting discipline, process governance and continuous improvement
  • People leadership, coaching and capability building
  • High integrity, ownership mindset and strong attention to detail

About this role / Job Summary

## Experienced Commodity / Account Management & Strategic Sourcing professional. Establishes sourcing goals and acceptable service levels. Responsible for negotiating and administering contracts and analyzing price proposals to enhance price, quality, timing and reliability of supply.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead global sourcing initiatives for the Electromechanical/ Proprietary electrical product category, driving cost reduction, supply base optimization, and risk mitigation. Category includes products such as wire harnesses, electrical control boxes, heaters, drives, ignitors, inverters, transformers, contactors, switches, sensors, and related electromechanical assemblies.
  • Build and validate a pipeline of cost reduction opportunities using spend analytics and design/commercial levers such as LPP (Linear Performance Pricing), Best Source to Buy, Cost vs. Index, Parametric Modelling, Contract Analysis, VAVE, SKU Rationalization, and Resourcing.
  • Perform detailed should-cost analysis and cost modeling to identify savings opportunities.
  • Lead supplier negotiations using structured negotiation strategies and fact-based negotiation packs to secure value for the enterprise while maintaining long-term supplier relationships.
  • Implement idea pipeline through close collaboration with CFT involving regional teams from procurement, engineering, quality, operations & suppliers.
  • Ensure timely realization and tracking of savings commitments and project deliverables.
  • Manage end-to-end RFQ/ RFP processes, including part selection, bidder identification/ selection, onboarding suppliers, launching RFQ using Ariba & other tools, managing quotes, quote analysis, supplier negotiations & sourcing recommendations considering holistic evaluation including Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and lifecycle cost considerations.
  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with business objectives and procurement goals.
  • Analyze market trends, commodity movements, and supplier cost structures to support strategic decision-making.
  • Leverage digital tools, automation, and analytics platforms to improve sourcing effectiveness and productivity.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • B.Tech from an accredited institution in Mechanical/ Electrical Engineering.
  • 7-9 years of total experience, with significant background in Sourcing/ Procurement.
  • Strong experience analyzing spend data, supplier performance, and procurement metrics to identify cost reduction ideas & drive them to implementation.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience in Should Costing / Cost Engineering, including cost breakdown analysis, manufacturing process assessment, and fact-based supplier negotiations.
  • Hands-on experience managing RFQs, supplier negotiations, and sourcing projects.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, BOM structures, and manufacturing process documentation.
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes, cost drivers, and supply chain dynamics related to electromechanical and proprietary electrical components.
  • Strong analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a matrixed global environment with stakeholders across Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and Operations.
  • Self-motivated, highly accountable, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced global environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech degree from a Tier-1 or Tier-2 engineering institution.
  • Experience with SAP, Ariba, and aPriori costing tools.
  • Exposure to global supplier markets and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Background in HVAC, industrial manufacturing, automotive, business consulting (cost reduction and procurement transformation projects), or other engineering-driven industries is preferred.
  • Experience in leading and managing teams, with the ability to drive performance and develop team capabilities.

KPIs & Success Metrics:

  • Annualized & In-year realized cost savings delivered against target
  • Spend reviewed for sourcing decision
  • Turnaround time (TAT) improvement on all the standard processes
  • Idea pipeline generation and realization %
  • Inflation mitigated through negotiations & other levers

  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps practices.
  • Experience supporting AI/ML workloads on top of data platforms.

We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on Model Maker to support HVAC engineering development through the fabrication, modification, and testing of prototype equipment. This position plays a critical role in bringing new product designs to life by building and refining prototype HVAC units in collaboration with engineering teams.

This role is 100% onsite in Indianapolis, IN

Key Responsibilities

  • Fabricate HVAC prototypes, tooling, and test fixtures to support engineering development projects
  • Read and interpret work orders, engineering drawings, and technical documentation
  • Perform fabrication processes including:
  • Brazing (copper and aluminum)
  • Welding
  • Bending and stamping
  • General sheet metal fabrication
  • Modify HVAC units based on engineering direction and specifications
  • Charge and discharge refrigerant from HVAC systems
  • Install instrumentation components such as thermocouples, pressure taps, and sensors
  • Program and operate automated equipment including:
  • 3D printers
  • Water jet cutters
  • Brake presses
  • Collaborate with engineers to clarify requirements, troubleshoot issues, and complete builds
  • Maintain a safe and organized work environment in compliance with EH&S policies

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in one of the following
  • HVAC Technology
  • Mechanical Engineering Technology
  • Industrial Maintenance
  • Building Automation / Controls
  • Electrical or Electromechanical Technology

Preferred Qualifications

  • EPA Certification
  • Working knowledge of residential HVAC systems (air conditioners, heat pumps, air handlers, gas furnaces)
  • Experience fabricating sheet metal components
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints and engineering drawings
  • Experience brazing similar and dissimilar materials (copper and aluminum)
  • Experience with machine shop and fabrication equipment (press brake, shear, punch, welder, band saw, etc.)
  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office and Outlook; comfortable with digital communication tools
  • Experience with or ability to learn CAD/CAM software
  • Electrical aptitude, including ability to read wiring diagrams and use testing tools (e.g., volt/ohm meter)
  • Experience with:
  • Industrial 3D printing
  • CNC or automated fabrication equipment (water jet, turret press, tube bending, etc.)
  • Conventional and/or CNC machining

Additional Requirements

  • Ability to lift and move up to 35 lbs without assistance
  • Ability to work first shift (Monday–Friday, 40 hours per week)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and matrixed environment
  • Self-motivated with the ability to learn quickly and take initiative
  • Ability to understand and follow EH&S and ethics policies

Must be Permanent US Resident, sponsorship not available

Pay Range

The annual salary for this position is between $53,000.00 - $106,000.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate.

Other Compensation

This position may be entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

Benefits

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

  • Health Care Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
  • Retirement Benefits
  • Time off and Leave: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation
  • Disability: Short-term and long-term disability
  • Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment
  • Tax-Advantaged Accounts: Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account
  • Tuition Assistance

To learn more about our benefits offering, please click here [Work with us | Carrier Corporate](https://www.corporate.carrier.com/careers/work-with-us/). job.description:

As a BMS Technician you will be responsible for commissioning, servicing, and engineering various installations to deliver and maintain high quality systems in compliance with site specified tasks, statutory requirements, and Automated Logic Australia standards, whilst ensuring tasks are completed on time and always ensuring customer satisfaction.

job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across more than 270 cities in over 45 countries.

Job Description

Job Description

Manage front office operations

  • Supervise team's delivery of guest services to ensure adherence to organisational standards and procedures
  • Coordinate daily front office activities to ensure operational efficiency
  • Plan resources and allocate work assignments to team members
  • Maintain accurate room status information
  • Handle irregularities related to the delivery of front office service
  • Supervise upselling procedures to maximise room revenue
  • Assist in the check-ins and check-outs of VIP guests and large groups
  • Supervise switchboard services and related call services

Drive service and operational excellence -Monitor and facilitate service responses to guests' requests to ensure timely and appropriate follow-up

  • Provide information and recommendations to guests on property's amenities, services and tourism-related activities
  • Resolve guests' concerns and feedback to ensure guest satisfaction
  • Build rapport with guests to enhance service experience
  • Monitor guest satisfaction levels and feedback for service improvement
  • Propose improvements to enhance operational efficiency and guest experience
  • Implement innovation, improvement and sustainability plans for continuous improvement
  • Act as a role model for service excellence to drive service culture

Manage operational risks

  • Monitor team's compliance with data protection regulation and organisational security procedures for guest registration and credit and cash transactions
  • Manage and scan crowd to identify and analyse signs of potential security threat for appropriate follow-up
  • Execute response and recovery actions during emergency situations
  • Implement loss and risk prevention policies and procedures

Manage human resources, finance and report management

  • Verify and analyse operations reports and guest statistics for management updates
  • Identify training needs and implement training plans to enhance team capabilities
  • Provide coaching and feedback to improve team performance
  • Monitor team performance and provide feedback for improvement

You will be part of the tenant relations team based at the assigned mall, responsible for building strong tenant relationships. By engaging tenants on regular performance discussions, you gain deep understanding of customer needs, business direction and future growth plans with regards to retail space requirements. This position calls for someone with strong analytical, interpersonal and communication skills.

You will report to the Mall Centre/General Manager.

  • Maintain good landlord-tenant relationships
  • Track and analyse the performance of tenants
  • Engage tenants on performance discussion and opportunities for expansion
  • Conduct regular meetings with tenants to understand their business needs and directions
  • Liaise with tenants on operational feedback and leasing matters
  • Support the Central Leasing team in terms of lease management and administration
  • Ensure tenants adhere to the lease terms
  • Ensure property tax levied is in line with committed rentals
  • Analyse tenants’ sales data for reporting
  • Provide management, malls and other departments with relevant leasing reports when required
  • Assist CM/GM on yearly budgeting, forecast with respect to income arising from Leasing activities

Requirements

  • Degree or Diploma in Estate Management, Building, Business Administration, Marketing or equivalent
  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, negotiation and presentation skills
  • Possess positive disposition, resourcefulness and is a team player
  • Sound understanding of the real estate and retail industries preferably in shopping complex
  • Self-motivated and able to work under pressure with tight deadlines

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across more than 260 cities in over 40 countries.

Job Description

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Identifies and handles sales leads effectively and efficiently, confirming every possible piece of business through focus selling and follow-up.
  • Delivers financial results by meeting or exceeding sales goals and objectives.
  • Effectively uses and promotes technology to support productivity and profitability.
  • Builds effective relationships with customers and business partners to maximize sales and customer satisfaction.
  • Participates in domestic and international sales activities, representing the hotel/chain to potential customers.
  • Fulfils Customer Relationship Management responsibilities and sales goals through planned customer interviews.
  • Monitors and reports on the market and competition within own market segment.
  • Prepares and updates customer management reports and ensures all necessary follow-up work is carried out on time.
  • Actively distributes product information and creates awareness in the markets and business segments of responsibility.
  • Carries out “cross-selling” and uses unique selling propositions (USPs) during sales calls to increase sales and revenue.
  • Participates in planning and realization of sales campaigns, promotions, and events in coordination with the Director of Sales.
  • Manages accounts and maintains up-to-date customer information manually and electronically.
  • Provides ongoing advice and support to staff under his/her supervision.
  • Performs most tasks in a team environment with minimal direct supervision, acting as a team leader.
  • Understands premium products, able to overcome objections, and confident in selling premium rates.
  • Maintains outstanding performance and results in related fields and markets.
  • Acts as an example for the team during daily job duties.

PEOPLE

  • Promote teamwork and quality service through daily communication/briefings and coordination with other departments. Key departmental contacts include all hotel departments.
  • Be the face of the hotel and act as the Brand Identity/Ambassador for The Crest Collection in Singapore.

GUEST EXPERIENCE

  • Should be well versant in defining experiential ‘Out of the Box’ experiences so that the guests can be introduced to customized experiences which, for example, do not involve standard menus but Tailored coffee break items after having a thorough discussion with the client on their expectations and preferences.
  • Set a positive example of guest relations.
  • Develop valuable relationships with clients and key accounts.
  • Interact with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.
  • Respond to and handle guest problems and complaints and strive to improve service performance.
  • Emphasize guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focus on continuous improvement.

RESPONSIBLE BUSINESS

  • Develop and maintain good relationships with officials and representatives of local community, groups and companies to promote new business and increase sales for the hotel.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

ACCOUNTABILITY

  • Responsible for nurturing relationships on behalf of the hotel with clients, partners and guests.
  • Act as a key liaison between the hotel and the client to ensure effective communication and co-ordination in all aspects of the guest journey.

QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Tourism/Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 or more years’ sales experience in hotels/travel companies or related industries.
  • Fluent in English and Mandarin is highly desirable, as Singapore is a multicultural and multilingual environment.
  • Extensive knowledge in Corporate (RFP/LNR), Catering sales, F&B knowledge, and event organization.
  • Extensive experience in sales and marketing, with a proven track record of delivering results.
  • Has extensive knowledge of the hotel industry, local market and market competitors.
  • Ability to identify and handle sales leads effectively and efficiently.
  • Possesses good computational abilities and a sense of business to make data-driven decisions.
  • Understanding the market and its competitors and ability to conduct market research and analysis to develop effective sales and marketing strategies.
  • Proficient in technology and software tools for sales and marketing, and ability to leverage technology to support productivity and profitability.
  • Excellent leadership skills and ability to manage a sales team effectively.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build effective relationships with customers and business partners.
  • Outstanding computational abilities and a strong sense of business acumen to make data-driven decisions.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills to handle multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal direct supervision, as well as in a team environment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work as a team.
  • Adaptable and outgoing with excellent interpersonal skill.
  • Ability to work under pressure and be flexible as part of the pre-opening team.
  • Passionate and enthusiastic with a positive ‘can-do’ attitude.

Benefits

job.title: Executive/Senior Executive, Sustainability
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across more than 260 cities in over 40 countries.

Job Description

Responsibilities

Decarbonisation & Sustainability Initiatives

  • Decarbonisation Pathways: Collaborate with product and technical services teams to help properties across the globe develop tailored decarbonisation pathways, aiming for measurable reductions in carbon emissions.
  • Ascott CarbonClear Initiative: Contribute to the development and execution of the Ascott CarbonClear Initiative, aligning properties with the organization’s sustainability and decarbonisation framework.
  • Sustainability Solutions Pilots: Source and conduct pilots for new sustainability solutions to optimize building performance and reduce carbon impact.
  • Global Sustainability Strategy: Support the global sustainability strategy by aligning operational teams and stakeholders with decarbonisation goals and sustainability best practices.

Data Analysis & Insights

  • Portfolio Analysis: Analyze sustainability data from the global portfolio, identifying trends and providing actionable insights regarding building performance, energy consumption, water use, waste management, and carbon emissions.
  • Building Performance Optimization: Use data-driven insights to optimize building performance across the portfolio, ensuring compliance with sustainability goals and identifying areas for improvement.
  • Trends & Reporting: Provide strategic insights based on global sustainability trends, highlighting opportunities for improvement and areas where performance can be enhanced to meet decarbonisation and sustainability targets.
  • Benchmarking: Benchmark sustainability performance across properties and advise on potential improvements to meet global and local sustainability goals.
  • GRESB Submissions Support: Support listed and private fund entities in the submission of sustainability data and performance information for the GRESB (Global Real Estate Sustainability Benchmark) assessment, ensuring accurate and timely submissions aligned with the organization’s sustainability standards.

Data Systems Management

  • Data Collection & Reporting: Ensure timely and accurate submission of sustainability data from global properties, tracking key performance indicators such as energy, water, waste, and carbon emissions.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Perform regular checks to ensure the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of the data submitted, addressing discrepancies and collaborating with property teams to resolve any issues.
  • System Maintenance: Support the maintenance and optimization of data systems, including UL360 and Greenview Portal, ensuring that data is correctly integrated and accessible for reporting and analysis.
  • Reporting Tools Development: Help develop and maintain data dashboards and reporting tools that provide real-time insights into sustainability performance and progress towards decarbonisation goals.
  • Onboarding & Training: Assist in onboarding new properties to the UL360 and Greenview Portal platforms, ensuring smooth integration and providing training to property teams on data collection and reporting processes.

Requirements

  • Experience: At least 3-5 years of experience in sustainability, decarbonisation strategies, or related fields, with a focus on sustainability data, building performance optimization, and environmental solutions.
  • Education: A degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Sustainability or a related field.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in sustainability data collection, analysis, and deriving actionable insights.
  • Data Management: Proficiency in data management and reporting tools (e.g., Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI, Tableau). Experience with sustainability data platforms (e.g., UL360, Greenview Portal) or the ability to learn new software tools quickly is highly desirable.
  • Decarbonisation Knowledge: Knowledge of decarbonisation frameworks and strategies, particularly in the context of the built environment, and experience supporting the development of decarbonisation pathways for properties.
  • Sustainability Solutions: Experience in piloting or implementing sustainability solutions aimed at optimizing building performance and reducing environmental impact.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and communicate complex sustainability data and insights clearly to internal stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: High attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy and consistency.
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities, with experience in driving sustainability initiatives across teams and properties.
  • Global Perspective: Ability to work effectively in a global context, collaborating with teams and properties across different regions to drive sustainability goals and data accuracy.
  • Passion for Sustainability: A strong passion for sustainability and environmental impact, with a commitment to advancing global decarbonisation and sustainability efforts.

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Director, Associate Director, Group Rewards
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

Reporting to the Head, Group Rewards, the incumbent will be a key member of the Group Rewards team, with primary responsibility for Group performance management and asset-management compensation, with particular emphasis on private-markets businesses.

The role will focus on:

  • Developing, implementing and operating a Group performance-management framework that enables a diverse portfolio of businesses to be assessed against a consistent performance standard, supported by modular criteria that reflect the objectives and characteristics of each business; and
  • Designing, implementing and managing compensation and incentive programmes that attract, retain and motivate employees, while aligning employee outcomes with business performance, the Group’s strategic objectives and relevant market practices.

Performance Management

  • Develop, implement and operate the organisation-wide performance-management policy, framework and processes to support objective performance assessment and effective pay-for-performance differentiation.
  • Establish a consistent Group performance standard while developing modular performance criteria that appropriately reflect the objectives, operating models and performance drivers of the Group’s different businesses.
  • Review and enhance performance-management policies, processes, rating methodologies and governance to ensure that they remain robust, objective and consistently applied.
  • Partner with senior management, HR business partners and business leaders to translate business objectives into relevant performance measures and assessment criteria.
  • Support performance calibration and moderation processes, including the development of management analytics, decision materials and recommendations.
  • Analyse performance outcomes across businesses, functions, employee segments and geographies to identify inconsistencies, risks and opportunities for improvement.

Asset-Management Compensation and Incentives

  • Develop and implement compensation strategies covering base pay, annual incentives, long-term incentives, equity-based awards and other financial rewards.
  • Conduct market analysis and compensation benchmarking using appropriate asset-management, private-markets, financial-services and corporate comparators.
  • Advise senior management and HR business partners on compensation structures, market positioning, retention arrangements and incentive-plan design.
  • Develop and refine carried-interest and employee co-investment programmes across different fund strategies, including real estate, credit, open-end funds and other private-markets strategies.
  • Develop, implement and review policies relating to carried interest, employee co-investment and other asset-management incentive arrangements.
  • Support the development and review of capital-raising incentives and other business-specific incentive programmes, ensuring alignment between individual contribution, commercial outcomes and the economics of the underlying business.
  • Undertake financial modelling and analysis to assess programme costs, potential employee outcomes, affordability, dilution, vesting and alignment with fund and Group performance.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Tax and relevant business teams to structure incentive programmes and related documentation in compliance with applicable legal, tax, accounting and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate with external advisers, service providers and system vendors on programme implementation, administration, system enhancements and the maintenance of accurate participant records.
  • Develop employee communications, programme materials and briefing presentations for fund teams, senior management and other stakeholders.

Broader Group Rewards and Transaction Support

  • Support the annual compensation cycle, including salary review, bonus-pool analysis, incentive allocation, retention assessment and management reporting.
  • Ensure compensation and incentive programmes within the role’s remit comply with applicable statutory, regulatory and governance requirements.
  • Support the review of benefits and non-monetary reward programmes where required, including relevant market benchmarking.
  • Participate in compensation and benefits due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures and other corporate transactions.

job.title: Senior Manager/Manager, Legal
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across 270 cities in 45 countries.

Job Description

As a member of the CapitaLand Development in-house legal team, you will be working on several complex transactions involving real estate acquisitions, development and divestments. This would involve structuring based on legal requirements and to achieve tax efficiency, M&A transactions, joint ventures, and general advisory work. Our in-house counsels provide legal expertise and a seamless integrated service across our offices in Singapore and other countries (e.g. China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, India). You will counsel and strategically collaborate with our business partners in Singapore and overseas to minimize risk, creatively solve problems, contribute to cost-saving initiatives and resolve disputes, while achieving the company’s business goals.

Responsibilities

Reporting to the General Counsel, your key responsibilities will include the following:

  • Provide legal support and advice to the various departments and business units of the company, including country operations, finance, sales, human resources, and the project design, development and construction teams, on all real estate, development and construction-related legal matters.
  • Negotiate, draft and review a wide range of real estate agreements, purchase and sale agreements, leases, employment contracts, financing and mortgage/security agreements, vendor agreements, service agreements, NDAs, and more.
  • Negotiate and minimize risk in joint venture agreements with partners.
  • Assist in the creation of processes for managing legal issues from all business areas and help provide training, create templates, and manage workflows to allow business units to move quickly while addressing key risks.
  • Work with external counsel as necessary on litigation, disputes, and other matters.
  • Manage external counsel on transactions to ensure high quality, commercially focused, and cost-effective legal advice.
  • Work with senior executives to design efficient and effective general controls.
  • Assist in the drafting of policies, guidelines, legal templates and other documents to ensure best practices.
  • Assist in corporate secretarial matters.

Qualifications

  • Minimally, you should hold a Bachelor’s degree in Law and have at least 6 years PQE in a law firm or as an in-house counsel with a corporate real estate focus.
  • Good academic history and proven legal skills, combined with a strong reputation for providing commercial solutions, excellent transactional and management skills.
  • Strong background in general corporate work, probably gained from practice in a law firm or as an in-house counsel.
  • Able to work confidently with our stakeholders, as well as create workable bespoke solutions to facilitate our stakeholders’ objectives.
