  • You’re a senior technical consultant who enjoys being close to the customer and influencing big-picture technology decisions.
  • You like working across sales, technical and executive teams to shape solutions that are commercially strong and technically sound.
  • You’re comfortable leading complex Azure and cloud transformation conversations, especially with enterprise, public-sector or highly regulated customers.
  • You enjoy mentoring others and helping sales teams build confidence in technical conversations.
  • You’re motivated by strategy, customer impact and the opportunity to help grow a high-performing cloud technology business.

About You.

  • Strong experience in a senior consulting, pre-sales, solution architecture or technical advisory role with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure and cloud services.
  • Deep hands-on understanding of Microsoft Azure, including Azure architecture, cloud migration, modernisation, managed services and customer solution design.
  • Experience working with complex enterprise customers, ideally across Azure, cloud managed services, hybrid cloud, public-sector customers or highly regulated environments.
  • Microsoft Security experience, including MDR, XDR, Defender or Sentinel, would be highly regarded and add strong value to the role.
  • Confidence presenting to senior stakeholders, including C-level, executive and senior public-sector audiences.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear commercial outcomes and customer value.
  • Strong commercial awareness, with the ability to contribute to go-to-market strategy, solution positioning and competitive differentiation.
  • Experience working with Federal or State Government customers, public-sector procurement, secure cloud environments or government bids and tenders would be highly regarded.

If this excites you, apply now, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: Engineering Documentation Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

Brief Job Description:

Technical Writer:

Responsible for researching, writing and editing customer-facing documentation such as user manuals, online help systems and quick installation guides. Able to work with and facilitate positive relationships with Global Business Units (GBUs), all Lines of Business (LOB), other departments and OEM customers with specific needs. job.title: Telstra Retail: Customer Service & Sales Consultant (Expression of Interest)
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

30 Dec 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Telstra Retail: Customer Service & Sales Consultant (Expression of Interest)

Job Summary

As a Retail Sales Consultant, you are passionate about delighting Telstra’s customers through outstanding customer service. You achieve this by providing an exceptional in-store customer journey, and through your collaborative approach you empower customers by identifying the products and services they need to transform their telecommunications experience.

Job Description

Ready to Make a Difference? Join Our Iconic Team at Telstra!

At Telstra, we’re more than just a leading telecommunications company—we’re where passion meets purpose. As a Retail Customer Service & Sales Consultant, you’ll have the opportunity to work for an iconic Aussie brand that’s been connecting Australians for generations. You won’t just be a friendly face in-store—you’ll be the trusted expert who helps customers find tech solutions that enhance their lives. This is your chance to make a meaningful impact by bringing our purpose to life: to build a connected future so everyone can thrive.

Opportunities available across these locations:

  • SOUTHLAND
  • CHADSTONE
  • MALVERN
  • WAVERLEY GARDENS
  • DANDENONG
  • PARKMORE

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Deliver Exceptional Customer Experiences: Help customers find the right products and services to suit their needs, ensuring their time at Telstra is a memorable one.
  • Be the Go-To Tech Expert: Stay up-to-date with the latest gadgets and services, offering informed guidance and solutions.
  • Achieve and Excel: Use your consultative selling skills to meet and exceed sales targets and KPIs, while keeping customers connected.
  • Collaborate and Contribute: Work closely with your team to create a welcoming environment where everyone is supported to achieve store goals.

Salary and Benefits:

  • Generous Discounts: Enjoy 30% off Telstra services and exclusive offers with over 240 brands and partners.
  • Leave Options: Take advantage of 16 weeks of paid parental leave, the Telstra Extra Day Off, gender affirmation leave, Cultural Leave, Blood Donor Leave, and the ability to purchase up to 4 weeks of additional leave.
  • Training & Career Growth Opportunities: Access over 17,000 learning programs with LinkedIn Learning, and take advantage of a range of development opportunities designed to build your skills and support your career growth, helping you prepare for your next step.
  • Flexibility: We offer flexible working hours and a supportive approach to parental leave—do it your way!
  • Recognition & Rewards: Benefit from monthly performance rewards and a range of recognition programs to celebrate your success.
  • Inclusive Culture: Join a diverse and inclusive team where everyone’s unique perspective is valued and respected.

Is it You We’re Looking For?

  • Great Communication Skills: You’re a natural at connecting with people and making their day better.
  • Solution-Oriented Approach: You enjoy thinking on your feet and tailoring solutions for each customer.
  • Sales Drive: You’re motivated to achieve (and exceed!) sales targets and KPIs.
  • Passion for Learning: You’re eager to grow and develop your skills in a dynamic environment.
  • Resilience and Positivity: You have a can-do attitude, even when things get busy.
  • Customer-Facing Experience: Previous experience is a plus but not required—bring your enthusiasm and we’ll teach you the rest!

How to Apply:

Ready to kickstart your journey with us? Click "Apply Now" to submit your application! After applying, keep an eye out for an email from our partner, HireVue, to complete the next step in our assessment process.

Join Us at Telstra Retail:

When you become part of the Telstra team, you’re joining a brand that celebrates diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone is respected, valued, and can thrive. We can’t wait to see what you’ll bring to our team!

job.title: Engineer I
job.description:
Job Description

Join our team as a test-focused Engineer or Senior Technician, where you'll validate electromechanical systems that integrate mechanical, electrical, and electronic components. If you're passionate about ensuring reliability, safety, and compliance through rigorous testing, this role is for you.

What will you do?

  • Design and execute functional, environmental, and safety tests for electromechanical and electrotechnology systems
  • Validate actuators, sensors, power systems, and control mechanisms to ensure seamless hardware-software integration
  • Use automated testing tools and diagnostic techniques to optimize system performance and reliability
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with safety and regulatory standards

What are the key skills we are looking for?

  • Electromechanical Engineering— developing level; integrating mechanical and electrical components in system testing
  • Electrotechnology— developing level; validating electronic control systems and power distribution
  • Test Method— developing level; designing and executing test protocols for system validation
  • Testbench Development— developing level; building test setups to evaluate component and system performance
  • Verification and Validation— foundational level; confirming systems meet design specifications and regulatory requirements
  • Problem Solving— developing level; diagnosing failures and implementing corrective actions during testing
  • Electrical Safety— developing level; ensuring test procedures comply with safety standards and protocols
  • Mechanical Design— developing level; understanding mechanical interfaces in electromechanical assemblies

What qualifications will make you successful?

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality standards in testing and documentation
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines
  • Analytical thinking to interpret test data and identify root causes of system issues
  • Willingness to learn and apply new testing methodologies and diagnostic tools

What's in it for me?

  • Hands-on experience with advanced electromechanical systems and testing technologies
  • Supportive team culture with mentorship and opportunities for technical growth
  • Direct contribution to product reliability and innovation

job.description:

_Requisition Title:Customer Major Issue Leader, LV Final Distribution Products_

Location: Bangalore, India

Role Type: Global Role

Department: Power Products – Customer Satisfaction & Quality

You are a passionate customer oriented person with a strong background and technical experience integrating low voltage applications and digital communication, willing to work in a fast pace, energizing and exposed environment. Your knowledge of Power Products is very appreciated, as well as your ability to manage demanding customer and large scale quality crisis, such as product recalls.

Your role will be articulated around 3 dimensions

  • Customer Major Issue resolution leader
  • Customer complex Issue/cases resolution
  • Main quality contact point for LV Final distribution products like – MCB, RCCB, RCBO, Distribution boards

You are required to be

  • Subject matter expert on MCB, RCCB, RCBO & distribution boards
  • Shall have good knowledge of IEC/IS standards related to the offer products like IEC 60898, IEC 61439.
  • Lead the Customer Major Issues linked to the scope of offers.
  • Eliminate dissatisfaction by ensuring customer issue are well managed and ultimately prevented
  • Ensure a reliable process is operating to solve customer complaints fast and effectively
  • Escalate customer issues to the right organization whenever needed and supports collaborative resolutions in the customer’s best interest
  • Ensure all customer issues are regularly analyzed in order to identify top issues and launch projects to prevent them
  • Collaborate with other organizations in order to contain, correct and prevent problems affecting customers.
  • Lead execution of containment actions for known problems.

As CMI leader, you will often interact with customers. Your role will be to demonstrate Schneider Electric's values and build trust over time, transforming difficult situations in opportunities.

  • Resolution of Critical Issues in CMI and BRE: Resolve at least 90% of critical issues related to CMI and BRE within a 30-day timeframe. Track and report the percentage of issues resolved on a monthly basis. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and address issues effectively. Achieve resolution rate consistently over the next quarter.

Gather feedback from at least 80% of participants to assess understanding and application of I2P concepts, utilize existing resources and knowledge to facilitate sessions. Complete all sessions by the end of the second quarter.
  • Effective Warm Loop to Cold Loop Transition: Develop a transition framework that successfully shifts 75% of warm loop processes to cold loop within six months. Monitor the transition process and report the percentage of successful shifts monthly.

Ranges in scope: Mainly Low voltage products like MCB, RCCB, RCBO, Distribution boards

Experience

  • 10–12 years of experience in:
  • Service Sales, Business Development, or Aftermarket Sales
  • LV/MV Switchgear industry
  • Electrical distribution and industrial automation solutions
  • Experience managing regional/business development teams
  • Exposure to Eastern Zone markets (West Bengal, Odisha, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, Bihar, Assam, Northeast) preferred

Strong knowledge of:

  • LV Switchgear (ACB, MCCB, MCB, Relays, Capacitor Banks, etc.)
  • MV Switchgear
  • PCC & MCC Panels
  • Protection systems and electrical safety
  • Industrial Automation products and solutions
  • Retrofitting and panel upgradation opportunities
  • Digital retrofit solutions and connected electrical assets

Commercial Skills

  • Service sales (Retrofitting & Modernization)
  • Channel Partner development
  • Customer relationship management
  • Enterprise account management
  • Bid management and commercial negotiations
  • Revenue generation and business expansion

  • Salesforce (SFDC)
  • SAP
  • MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)

  • Size and structure of team managed
  • Experience handling senior service sales engineers
  • Coaching and performance management capability

  • Achievement against service-sales targets
  • Retrofitting and modernization projects closed
  • Digitalization opportunities identified and converted

Switchgear

PCC & MCC

Digital Retrofitting

✅ Team leadership experience

job.title: Operations Safety Lead
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As Operations Safety Lead, you’ll provide visible, hands-on safety leadership across operational sites, supporting critical maintenance activities and strengthening operational resilience. You’ll partner closely with site teams, contractors, and service providers to drive a proactive safety culture, support incident response, and embed continuous improvement initiatives that enhance operational performance and critical risk management.

What You'll Do

  • Lead operational safety activities across live data centre campuses
  • Support critical operations, maintenance, and contractor management programs
  • Drive compliance with key risk controls including Permit to Work, electrical safety, confined space entry, and working at heights
  • Conduct incident investigations, operational assurance activities, and risk assessments
  • Partner with operational teams to strengthen emergency preparedness and response capability
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance safety outcomes and operational reliability

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years’ experience in operational safety within high-risk industries
  • Qualifications in Work Health & Safety or a related discipline
  • Strong investigation, assurance, and operational risk management capability
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience supporting critical environments, industrial operations, or data centres is highly regarded

At AirTrunk, we value diverse perspectives, inclusive leadership, and a culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to creating a workplace where you feel supported to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities.

Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

Working within technical delivery space you will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, within a live, operational environment, to ensure they meet CDC requirements and deliver high-quality results. This role supports project teams through the initiation, planning, and execution phases by tracking progress and reporting outcomes. Serving as the primary contact for customer requests and requirements on these projects, you will collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to achieve quality, assurance, and financial objectives.

Other responsibilities include:

  • Oversee the completion and handover of all plans, as-built documentation, test reports, certificates, and ongoing maintenance materials.
  • Manage stakeholder communication by delivering regular updates, facilitating meetings/workshops, and acting as the primary liaison.
  • Ensure all project activities adhere to regulatory, safety, and site policy requirements, promoting safe work practices at all times.

What's in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About you

The ideal candidate is a technically-driven project manager, experienced in delivering complex electrical, HVAC, and communications projects within a live, operational environment. With a strong background in electrical, HVAC, or related building services, you have exposure in coordinating key infrastructure projects from planning through to commissioning and handover. You work seamlessly with operations, engineering teams, contractors, and vendors, bringing clear communication and a solutions‑focused approach to every project. You ensure documentation, compliance, testing, and handover requirements are met efficiently, enabling smooth operational transitions and reliable long‑term performance.

  • Demonstrated experience in managing commercial-scale brownfield project works within a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Commercially focused in nature, with the ability to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
  • A natural problem solver, combining an innovative work style with strong prioritisation and time management.
  • Strong understanding of electrical, HVAC, and communications project management processes - trade qualifications preferred.
  • Ability to balance administrative elements of the role with the strategic project management elements.

Australian citizenship and ability to obtain and maintain NV1 Security Clearance.

job.title: Sr. Engineering Manager Thermal
job.description:
Job Description

Responsibilities & Role Requirements:

  • Lead and develop the local Thermal Management engineering team in Pune and/or Chakan, ensuring strong ownership, accountability and technical excellence.
  • Be responsible for the engineering execution of Chilled Water products, including chiller, CRAH and Thermal Wall product lines.
  • Support NPDI programs from concept to launch, ensuring timely delivery of engineering deliverables, design reviews, validation plans, cost targets and product documentation.
  • Coordinate sustaining engineering activities for existing CW platforms, including product improvements, cost reduction, localization, quality issues and component substitutions.
  • Ensure alignment between the regional engineering team and global Chilled Water engineering strategy, standards, design rules and product roadmaps.
  • Drive decisions on key technical issues to avoid project delays and to support business priorities, customer commitments and manufacturing readiness.
  • Provide technical leadership on thermodynamic design, air/water side performance, refrigeration circuits, controls integration, electrical interfaces and design for manufacturability.
  • Coordinate laboratory tests and product validation activities in cooperation with global engineering leaders, test laboratories, quality and operations teams.
  • Support regional engineering team and customer-specific requests by ensuring fast, technically robust and platform-consistent engineering responses.
  • Review and approve technical documentation including specifications, drawings, bills of material, user manuals, test reports, rating tools and engineering change documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable safety, quality, regulatory and engineering standards relevant to CW products and local manufacturing requirements.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing, Supply Chain and Quality to support product industrialization, localization, supplier development and resolution of production issues.
  • Develop team members through coaching, performance management, technical mentoring and structured capability growth.
  • Promote continuous improvement, standard work, engineering discipline, cross-functional collaboration and customer-focused execution.
  • Work in a multi-disciplinary and global engineering environment focused on high performance, cost-effective design, product reliability and market-leading innovation.

job.title: Data Center Strategic Negotiator, AWS Infrastructure - Data Center Supply Solutions (APAC)
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Do you have the business savvy and the technical background necessary to help establish Amazon as a key technology platform provider?

In this role you will be part of a team that drives AWS's data center contract negotiations, with a focus on colocation projects. You will play a crucial part in expanding our data center footprint while optimizing costs, keeping apace with evolving data center design, and ensuring operational excellence. The position encompasses comprehensive ownership of both new and existing colocation agreements, including pricing structures, terms, and service level agreements, while developing and implementing market expansion strategies across existing and new markets.

The role focuses on structuring deals and serves as the primary contact with colocation providers. The position requires strong market analysis capabilities to evaluate conditions, pricing trends, and competitive landscapes, along with the ability to create and present compelling business cases to senior leadership. Success demands excellence in relationship building, stakeholder management, and driving complex multi-million dollar negotiations while maintaining AWS's competitive advantage in the global cloud infrastructure market. You will work closely with Legal, Finance, Engineering, Operations, and Project Management teams. The role requires a self-starter who is a team player and is not afraid to keep learning.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as a key member of the team in driving data center deals and overall infrastructure strategy for target regions
  • Understand the supplier base (both Colocation providers and Real Estate developers), develop a strong understanding of market dynamics and activity, and develop long-term strategic partnerships in support of our key markets
  • Set business development plans in-line with the larger organization strategic direction
  • Negotiate and close multi-million dollar contracts to support capacity expansion
  • Understand the technical requirements of our engineering teams and negotiate solutions that meet technical requirements as well as the business objectives
  • Ownership of business case creation and presentation to leadership (including commercial, technical and risk profile)
  • Prepare and give project reviews to the senior management team regarding progress and deal execution roadblocks
  • Ability to work in a high-pressure environment and pivot on the fly to changing requirements to manage competing priorities simultaneously
  • Continue to build a culture of speed, flexibility and frugality with all business partners
  • Develop and implement new mechanisms to improve our customer experience
  • Business Travel: 10-20%

job.description:

The Infrastructure Operations (Data Center) Team is the backbone of AWS, supporting the rapidly growing AWS business and customers 24/7. We are committed to maintain the physical infrastructure of AWS, ensuring the standards for operational performance in the areas of safety, security, availability, productivity, capacity, efficiency, and cost.

We are looking for a Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Engineer with experience in critical facilities management, and a result-driven individual with strong technical understanding and the drive and vision to take our data center engineering operations to the next level. The DCEO Engineer is responsible for engineering operations including risk management and mitigation, planning, implementation of corrective and preventative maintenance for critical infrastructure and vendor management within our AWS Data Center environment. They are responsible for day-to-day operational excellence, maintenance of the critical infrastructure, supervising specialist vendors, acting as first responders to incidents, and becoming subject matter experts for the facility.

Key job responsibilities The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

  • Meet daily hours of operations, on call requirements and response during rotations.
  • Manage minor and major planned and unplanned site works for critical infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the works involved, risks, mitigation and seeking approvals within relevant SLA’s as required.
  • Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
  • Prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
  • Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
  • Coordinate with DCO managers (IT), Networking, Logistics, Safety, Security and other business leaders and operating partners to execute projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
  • Review and follow the documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
  • Implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
  • Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues

A day in the life

  • Support troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
  • Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
  • Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
  • Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
  • Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

job.title: Security Architecture - Senior Architect
job.description:
Employment Type

Permanent

Closing Date

16 Sept 2026 11:59pm

Job Title

Security Architecture - Senior Architect

Job Summary

Job Description

The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to play a lead security architecture role across complex enterprise and network environments, helping ensure solutions are secure, scalable and aligned to Telstra’s cyber security strategy. You will partner with business stakeholders, enterprise and domain architects, engineers, product vendors, delivery partners and operational teams to translate security requirements into practical architecture outcomes.

The role also contributes to the ongoing development of security standards, patterns, frameworks and guidelines, ensuring they remain actionable in a dynamic technology and systems environment. Success will be reflected through strong architectural governance, effective risk treatment, reusable security patterns and timely support for business-critical delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure solution architectures comply with Telstra’s security policies, standards, patterns and principles, with deviations appropriately managed through Telstra’s risk management frameworks and processes.
  • Actively collaborate with business stakeholders, enterprise and domain architects, engineers, constructor teams, product vendors and partners to define and operationalise security controls that protect Telstra and customer information, systems and network assets.
  • Perform security quality assurance activities and support operational readiness processes for initiatives and solution designs.
  • Define security solution architectures and document the corresponding business and security impacts, including requirements, solution impact assessments, high-level designs, solution briefs, solution architecture definitions and security risk assessments.
  • Identify and communicate security risks to business stakeholders in a timely and practical way, incorporating insights from privacy, legal, engineering and operational teams.
  • Drive assessments of emerging security capabilities to ensure architectural standards and capability roadmaps remain current and aligned to business objectives.
  • Define and document reusable assets such as standardised security requirements and solution patterns that reduce rework and improve consistency.
  • Contribute to the creation and governance of security strategy, standards and frameworks to support a coherent and optimised security architecture.
  • Foster strategic relationships across industry and technology vendors to anticipate emerging opportunities and threats and support innovation across business units, partners and customers.
  • Comply with Telstra Business Principles, Telstra Values, the Telstra Code of Conduct and Telstra policies and procedures.

About You

You are an experienced security architecture professional who can solve complex enterprise-scale security problems, work through ambiguity and translate customer and business security needs into deliverable technical and operational requirements. You bring strong judgement, stakeholder management and the ability to balance risk, business outcomes and delivery priorities.

Core expertise: You bring strong problem-solving capability, core security architecture competency, business acumen, decision quality, adaptability, continuous learning, customer focus, teamwork and accountability. You can assess, develop and operationalise security solutions using control and risk management frameworks, and you are comfortable documenting security architectures, requirements, models, frameworks, patterns and standards for complex IT and network systems. Your security domain knowledge spans areas such as access control, cryptography, security architecture, information security governance and risk management, operations security, legal and regulatory compliance, network security, environmental security, and generative and agentic AI security.

Essential experience and qualifications:

  • Extensive experience, ideally 5+ years, providing complex security solutions, including security requirement elaboration, security control definition and security threat/risk assessment.
  • Experience solving enterprise-scale security problems involving high levels of ambiguity.
  • Experience developing or contributing to architecture or technology strategy.
  • Tertiary qualifications in IT, Engineering or a complementary discipline.

Highly desirable:

  • Relevant industry certifications such as CRISC, CISSP, CISM, SABSA, CCNP, CCIP, CCIE, CCSP, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, MCSD, TOGAF, ITIL, COBIT 5, Agile or CGEIT.
  • Experience with Agile and DevOps environments.
  • Knowledge and experience in IT systems planning, design and technical architecture.
  • Experience designing service-oriented, RESTful and secure cloud-based architectures.

job.title: DC Contract Manager
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Procurement of Maintenance Contracts: Collaborate with Procurement, and DCO teams to identify maintenance needs and develop specifications for new contracts.
  • Vendor Selection: Conduct market research to identify potential vendors, evaluate their capabilities, and select the most suitable ones.
  • Contract Negotiation: Negotiate terms and conditions of maintenance contracts to ensure cost-effectiveness and alignment with company standards. Contract Management: Draft, review, and approval of new maintenance contracts, ensuring compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Vendor Management: Establish and maintain strong relationships with vendors to facilitate effective communication and collaboration.
  • Performance Monitoring: Continuously monitor vendor performance against contract terms and KPIs, ensuring timely and quality service delivery. Performance management: Define clear and measurable KPIs for vendor performance, focusing on key areas such as service quality, response times, and compliance.
  • Issue Resolution: Address and resolve any issues or disputes with vendors promptly to minimize impact on data centre operations.
  • Reviews: Chair monthly performance review meetings with vendors to discuss performance metrics, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective actions.
  • Reporting: Generate and present regular reports on vendor performance to senior management, providing insights and recommendations for improvement. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve procurement and vendor management processes, implementing best practices to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Market Trends: Stay informed about industry trends and developments in the Southeast Asia region to ensure the company remains competitive and innovative in its vendor management practices.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in vendor management and contract negotiation within the data centre or related industry.
  • Understanding of data centre operations, maintenance requirements, and industry standards.
  • Strong negotiation skills with a proven track record of securing favourable contract terms. Ability to analyse performance data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills for effective interaction with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills to handle multiple contracts and vendors simultaneously.
  • Ability to quickly resolve issues and disputes with vendors in a professional and effective manner.
  • Willingness to travel within the Southeast Asia region as needed to manage vendor relationships and contract negotiations.

Desired Attributes:

  • Relevant certifications in procurement, supply chain management, or contract management (e.g., CPM, CSCP, or similar).
  • Familiarity with the business environment and regulatory landscape in Southeast Asia.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Design Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering hyperscale data centres that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As a Site Design Manager, you will report to the Project Director and work closely with the Development, Design, Technology, Commissioning and Operations teams to ensure AirTrunk's design standards are successfully delivered during construction.

You will be the primary design representative on site, providing technical leadership throughout construction while ensuring the original design intent is maintained. Acting as the interface between the Design Team and Construction Team, you will proactively resolve technical issues, coordinate consultants, contractors and vendors, and ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to AirTrunk's world-class quality standards.

You will make your mark by:

  • Leading the implementation of AirTrunk's design during construction.
  • Acting as the technical authority for all design-related matters on site.
  • Working closely with General Contractors, consultants, vendors and Owner Supplied Equipment (OSE) suppliers to resolve design issues quickly.
  • Supporting Project Managers to ensure design decisions minimise programme and commercial impacts.
  • Driving design quality throughout construction, commissioning and handover.
  • Ensuring customer requirements are incorporated while maintaining AirTrunk design standards.
  • Collaborating with Development, Technology, Design and Operations teams to continuously improve design standards and construction methodologies.

Your Day to Day

Design Leadership

  • Lead design coordination throughout the construction phase.
  • Maintain ownership of the approved design throughout delivery.
  • Review contractor proposals and ensure compliance with AirTrunk standards.
  • Manage design changes and ensure appropriate governance and approvals.
  • Coordinate consultant responses to RFIs and technical queries.
  • Drive practical engineering solutions that balance programme, cost, quality and operational outcomes.
  • Technical Governance
  • Provide technical leadership across Mechanical, Electrical, Civil and Architectural disciplines.
  • Review contractor shop drawings, technical submissions and material approvals.
  • Ensure all engineering decisions align with AirTrunk design philosophy.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary design interfaces.
  • Support design standardisation and continuous improvement across projects.
  • Construction Support
  • Work alongside the Project Manager to provide technical support during construction.
  • Participate in design workshops, value engineering exercises and constructability reviews.
  • Assist in resolving site issues that may impact safety, quality or programme.
  • Support procurement activities relating to Owner Supplied Equipment and specialist systems.
  • Ensure consultant deliverables support construction sequencing.
  • Quality
  • Champion AirTrunk's quality-first culture.
  • Conduct design quality inspections throughout construction.
  • Ensure installations meet AirTrunk standards and approved documentation.
  • Support defect management and close-out activities.
  • Assist commissioning teams by ensuring systems are installed in accordance with design intent.
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Build collaborative relationships across Development, Design, Construction, Technology, Commissioning and Operations.
  • Coordinate with customers regarding design requirements and changes.
  • Manage external consultants and specialist designers.
  • Support General Contractors with technical guidance while maintaining appropriate governance.
  • Programme & Risk
  • Identify design-related risks early.
  • Develop mitigation strategies with contractors and consultants.
  • Support programme recovery where design issues threaten delivery.
  • Assist Project Managers in evaluating design impacts on cost and schedule.
  • Commissioning & Handover
  • Support testing and commissioning activities.
  • Ensure design documentation is complete and accurate.
  • Assist Operations during project handover.
  • Coordinate consultant support through practical completion and defects liability periods.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the site-based design authority throughout project delivery.
  • Manage consultant design deliverables during construction.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering interfaces.
  • Lead design issue resolution across contractors, consultants and vendors.
  • Review contractor design submissions for compliance.
  • Manage design changes through approved governance processes.
  • Support procurement and integration of Owner Supplied Equipment.
  • Participate in value engineering and constructability reviews.
  • Coordinate customer design requirements.
  • Ensure design quality throughout installation and commissioning.
  • Support Project Managers with technical decision making.
  • Maintain accurate design records and reporting.
  • Drive continuous improvement into future AirTrunk design standards.

Requirements

Essential

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil or Structural Engineering.
  • 10+ years' experience delivering major infrastructure, mission-critical or data centre projects.
  • Significant experience managing design during construction.
  • Strong understanding of multidisciplinary engineering systems.
  • Experience working for a developer, consultant, contractor or hyperscale data centre provider.
  • Proven ability to coordinate consultants, contractors and multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial awareness with the ability to balance programme, cost and quality.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience delivering hyperscale data centres.
  • Experience managing Owner Supplied Equipment (OSE).
  • Experience in commissioning and operational readiness.
  • Knowledge of BIM and digital engineering workflows.
  • Experience across APAC data centre projects.
  • Chartered Engineer or working towards chartership.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer (Controls) - Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
job.description:

  • Monitor site BMS, SCADA and Controls systems and carry out routine maintenance activities.

job.title: Principal Software Engineer - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

As a Principal Data Engineer at Equinix, you will be responsible for driving end-to-end delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions on Google Cloud Platform. This role combines hands-on technical expertise, requiring you to design sophisticated system architectures, lead cross-functional initiatives, and mentor data engineers. You will act as a trusted technical advisor for the team championing innovation across GCP, Data Engineering, AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP). The ideal candidate possesses unparalleled technical depth, exceptional strategic thinking, and a demonstrated history of delivering transformational data platform capabilities at a global scale.

Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture Leadership

  • Architect and evolve cloud-native, petabyte-scale data platforms and data products, with clearly defined and measurable SLOs for data freshness, availability, and reliability
  • Design data solutions balancing scalability, performance, cost, and operational excellence through clear architectural trade-offs
  • Establish reference architectures, architectural guardrails, and engineering standards adopted organization-wide
  • Lead architectural governance across all data engineering squads, ensuring consistency, scalability, and security
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies (including Agentic AI/LLM and real-time systems) to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes
  • Drive adoption of domain-oriented data architecture (e.g., data mesh principles) across business domains to enable ownership, consistency, and reuse

Technical Solutioning & Innovation

  • Design scalable data solutions using modern cloud-native technologies (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, dbt/Dataform, Pub/Sub), selecting the right tools based on problem context
  • Own end-to-end delivery of complex data engineering initiatives from design through production, and continuous evolution.
  • for real-time streaming, event-driven architectures, and unified batch-streaming pipelines at petabyte scale
  • Evaluate and adopt AI/LLM capabilities to improve engineering productivity and enable intelligent data consumption, using standard interfaces (e.g., Model Context Protocol) to integrate AI with data systems
  • Establish engineering excellence frameworks covering performance engineering, cost governance, reliability, and observability
  • Lead proof-of-concept and rapid prototyping of breakthrough technologies before scaling org-wide

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Serve as a technical role model and multiplier — elevating the capabilities of Senior Staff, Staff, and Data Engineers across the organization
  • Lead org-wide engineering communities of practice and knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Partner with engineering managers and HR to drive technical hiring strategy and raise the engineering talent bar
  • Drive culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and continuous learning
  • Establish mentorship programs that systematically grow the next generation of technical leaders

Data Governance & Compliance

  • Architect automated data quality platforms, end-to-end lineage tracking, and enterprise metadata management systems
  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, SOX, and emerging global data regulations through proactive architecture and policy design
  • Lead privacy-by-design initiatives, zero-trust data access models, and data anonymization at scale
  • Establish cross-cloud security standards and enforce them through automated policy guardrails
  • Design privacy-preserving techniques, data anonymization, and secure data sharing mechanisms

Strategic Influence & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with business stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into scalable technical solutions
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams and business units
  • Present technical concepts and architectural decisions to executive leadership
  • Represent Equinix externally — at industry conferences, in open-source communities, and in strategic vendor partnerships
  • Drive build-vs-buy decisions, vendor evaluation, and strategic technology partnerships at the enterprise level

Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • GCP Platform Mastery: 8+ years of hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, including deep expertise in BigQuery (advanced SQL, scripting, optimization, ML integration), Cloud Dataflow, Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, and Vertex AI
  • Programming Excellence: Expert-level Python/Java programming, proficiency in Python/Scala for Spark development
  • Advanced Data Technologies: Deep expertise in Apache Beam, Apache Spark, Airflow, Kafka, and distributed computing architectures
  • Infrastructure: Extensive experience with Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure management
  • Database & Data Modeling: Advanced knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL systems (BigTable, Firestore, MongoDB); expertise in data modeling, normalization, and performance optimization
  • System Design: Proven ability to architect and deliver distributed, fault-tolerant, globally distributed data systems with rigorous security and cost governance
  • AI/ML Integration: Deep experience with MLOps, feature engineering platforms, model serving infrastructure, and integrating LLM-powered capabilities into production data pipelines

Professional Experience & Leadership

  • Master's or bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field; Master's degree strongly preferred
  • 15+ years of Data engineering experience with 8+ years specifically on Google Cloud Platform
  • Proven track record of leading end-to-end delivery of complex, enterprise-scale data platform initiatives
  • Experience designing and implementing data governance, compliance, and security frameworks

job.title: Senior Accountant
job.description:
Job Description

Your Role

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented accounting professional to join our finance team supporting an SGX-listed Real Estate Investment Trust (“the REIT”) and its Special Purpose Vehicles (“SPVs”). Reporting into the finance leadership team, you will play a hands-on role across financial reporting, regulatory compliance, and the day-to-day accounting that underpins a listed trust and its cross-border property portfolio.

This is a broad, high-exposure role that offers direct interaction with Trustees, auditors, tax agents and overseas finance teams (U.S. / EMEA), and a clear runway to grow into budgeting, forecasting and committee-level reporting.

What You'll Do

  • Financial reporting: prepare the full set of accounts for the SGX-listed REIT and its non-listed SPV entities, and support periodic and ad hoc financial reporting.
  • Finance operations: manage day-to-day accounting — journal entries, payments, month-end close, and variance analysis — and assist with group consolidation.
  • Regulatory submissions: prepare and support corporate tax, GST and other statutory and regulatory filings to SGX, MAS and IRAS.
  • Stakeholder management: liaise with overseas finance teams (U.S. / EMEA) and external parties including the Trustee, auditors, tax agents and the unit registrar.
  • Controls & compliance: ensure compliance with SGX, MAS, corporate and statutory requirements, and maintain strong internal controls and adherence to group policies.
  • Transactions: assist with pre- and post-acquisition processes, including tax structuring, funds-flow coordination, and aligning acquired financials for consolidation.
  • Projects: participate in system implementation and other ad hoc finance initiatives.
  • Growth scope: depending on experience, the role may extend to budgeting and forecasting, and participation in Audit and Risk Committee reporting over time.

What You Will Bring

  • Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent. Minimum 3–5 years of relevant accounting experience, or Big Four candidates at the associate or senior level looking to join the commercial sector are welcomed to apply.
  • Technical strength: strong working knowledge of accounting principles and practical application of IFRS.
  • Delivery under pressure: proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities while delivering high-quality, accurate work.
  • Mindset: proactive, solutions-oriented and positive, with meticulous attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
  • Collaboration: a team player who also works well independently and across functions, levels and geographies.
  • Advantageous: experience with the Yardi system and prior accounting experience in REITs or real estate companies.

NOTES:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.

Digital Realty is an equal opportunity employer, EOE/AA/M/F/Vets/Disabled.  All applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or other status protected by law or Company policy.

Digital Realty is a publicly traded company (NYSE: DLR) with investment grade ratings from all three major ratings agencies.

Please do not forward unsolicited resumes to any employee of Digital Realty and its subsidiaries. Digital Realty is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited referrals. -

job.description:
Assistant General Manager Operations

The Assistant General Manager Operations will oversee day‑to‑day operational activities, ensuring efficient processes, high quality standards, and alignment with the company’s strategic objectives. This senior leadership role requires strategic thinking, strong analytical capabilities, and proven experience in managing large teams and complex operational environments.

Location

Mumbai, India

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute operational strategies that support the organization’s business goals.
  • Lead cross‑functional teams to improve process efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance service delivery.

  • Manage budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance of the operations function.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal policies.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership to align operational initiatives with corporate strategy.

  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving, and decision‑making skills.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen).
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools and ERP systems.

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient,electric, and digital.

We are now hiring i nterns for ourH 1 202 7 cohort!Internships will start inJanuary 202 7.Students who can commit full-time will be preferred.

Join us as a Data Analytics & Excel Internto make an impact!

Location:Kallang

Launch your career with a hands-on internship in industrial operations and supply chain management. We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Data Analytics & Excel Intern to support data collection, analysis, reporting, and dashboard creation. This internship offers hands-on experience in working with large datasets, developing reports, and generating insights that support business decisions.

What will you do:

  • Collect, organize, validate, and maintain data from multiple sources to ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
  • Create and maintain Excel dashboards, trackers, and reporting tools to support business performance monitoring and decision-making.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work independently, meet deadlines, and quickly learn and adapt to new tools, technologies, and business requirements.

job.description:
Join us as a Senior Associate, End to End Flow Controller, and take charge of optimizing supply chain operations from start to finish. You'll monitor performance, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with teams to ensure materials and information flow seamlessly across the entire supply chain.

  • Analyze supply chain performance metrics to identify inefficiencies and implement corrective strategies
  • Coordinate with suppliers and production teams to ensure timely material delivery and reduce lead times
  • Optimize inventory management processes to balance supply and demand while controlling costs
  • Facilitate cross-functional communication to align activities and resolve supply chain issues proactively

  • Supplier Portal Tool— intermediate level; coordinating with suppliers to ensure timely deliveries and resolve issues
  • Problem Solving— intermediate level; identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions to improve flow

job.title: Associate Client Success Specialist
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Associate Client Success Specialist is an entry level subject matter expert, required to learn the skills to effectively support in the building and maintenance of client relationships with the goal of driving value for the client and increased lifetime value for the organization.

This role is responsible for multiple small-to-medium scale or simple (single-service) contracts. As the primary post-sale point of contact for clients, this role is responsible for driving client-facing activity through NTT’s Client Success Management Charters of Adoption, Expansion and Renewal.

Acting as the clients’ trusted advisor, this role helps client realize value from their relationship with the company and ensure the client’s relationship experience is a positive one. This role works in partnership with sales and client/service delivery management teams to deliver in-contract growth and a successful on-time renewal.

This role takes guidance from a senior manager / leader within the team.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

Client Nurture / relationship -

  • Develops and maintains the relationship with client representatives to Management level, being recognized as the client’s ‘trusted advisor’.
  • Ensures the client is able to interact successfully with the organization and to optimize the engagement (measurable through improving CSAT).
  • Acts as an escalation point for client issues which are not being resolved though standard process, facilitating a satisfactory client outcome with relevant resolver groups within the company.

Adoption Charter - Ensures the client is aware of and is successfully adopting offer features and increasing their usage of services (as appropriate). Proactively helps the client to realize demonstrable value from the offers and meet their original business (procurement) objectives.

Expansion Charter - Drives up-sell of existing Offers/services and closes the deals to achieve revenue targets. Identifies cross-sell opportunities (to extend company's footprint with the client) and facilitates engagement with Sales/GTM functions to engage the client on these opportunities.

Renewal Charter - Demonstrates the value delivered by the organization throughout the lifetime of the contract and drives a successful and on-time renewal. Minimizes churn (client, revenue, service) at renewal and seeks opportunities to drive up-sell / cross-sell as part of the renewal process.

Client Success Practice -

  • Be an active member of the regional and Global CS Management practice (including adopting standard methodologies, platforms/tools, KPIs, best practice activity, sharing experiences with the community).
  • Responsible for DATA Quality Management within own client portfolio.
  • Builds and maintains Client Success Management skills and operating knowledge.
  • Builds and maintains an up-to-date knowledge of company offerings.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Good interpersonal skills with the ability to develop and maintain solid stakeholder relationships up to Management level.
  • Basic account planning and stakeholder mapping and management techniques.
  • Ability to interpret a client’s business strategy / plans and understand opportunities for company solutions/services.
  • Knowledge of company's offers and services, including the core functionality and features, linkage within NTT’s service portfolio, pricing structures, client benefits.
  • Ability to provide an external industry viewpoint (including industry insights, technology trends and competitor landscape) and to highlight the organization's expertise and differentiated offerings and position “partnership” offerings with the client.
  • Solid sales skills (consultative selling and negotiation) with the ability to identify up-sell opportunities and close resulting deals.
  • Ability to execute on-time renewals with minimum volume or price churn.
  • Good knowledge and understanding of IT service environment, service operations and ITIL practices.
  • Understanding of organization's high-level operating model and the ability to develop and maintain relationships across relevant cross-functional teams.
  • Understanding of billing processes and client invoicing linked to contracted services.
  • Understanding of financial statements and metrics, including revenue, expense control, and growth relative to market in order to hold strategic client conversations.
  • Understanding of contracts and contract management; with the ability to maintain the contract, to discuss with the client and understand how to position as a value exchange.
  • Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in information technology or sales or a related field.
  • Certification and working knowledge of ITIL practices.
  • Additional relevant vendor certifications is advantageous.
  • Required experience:
  • Entry level experience in a client-facing role in one or more of Sales, Service or Consultancy disciplines in a large scale (preferably multi-national) IT services environment.
  • Demonstrated subject matter and services product expertise within sales and operations.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer (Thermal) (NSW)
job.description:
Position Summary/Objectives of Incumbent:**

The purpose of this position is to provide post-sales engineering review, leadership and support for won projects in Australian and New Zealand. Provide guidance and expertise on critical infrastructure projects, including the application and installation of Vertiv products and services, including support with approved third-party vendors and internal teams, to facilitate smooth deployment of major projects undertaken by the business. They will also provide technical leadership amongst peers in the team with expertise to help drive decision making.

Key Responsibilities

Document Package Transfer In / Out:

•Attend the documentation hand-over process from Pre to Post-Sales teams once a project has been won or has a very high likelihood.

•Attend the document package and transfer process for projects going from Post-Sales to Project Management.

ICA Technical Reviews:

•On receipt of the Document Package, interrogate the documentation to ensure buildability and budget compliance.

•Review all aspects of the proposal, from Statement of Compliance through to Commissioning and Hand-over, including provision of Training and Documentation requirements to the customer.

•Act as technical authority for engineering decisions and design philosophies throughout the project lifecycle.

Engineering re-estimate:

•Once Technical Review is complete, engage with our partners, contractors, and vendors to assure the most cost-effective and technically sound solution has been selected by the Pre-Sales teams. Work with Product Managers, Service Teams, and our source factories (where necessary), to ensure the best possible and cost-effective solution has been selected for the project.

Technical Submittals post Purchase Order:

•During the Post-Sales phase, attend to all project meetings on scope of supply, technical qualifications and testing procedures and programs are understood by Vertiv associates, contractors, other vendors, and our customer.

•Assist with the ownership of the project through to delivery, commissioning and hand-over.

•Ensure a thorough hand-over process to Project Management when the units have arrived in country.

Site and As-Built Drawing Management:

•Operate a comprehensive documentation register for all project files and ensure the latest revisions are uploaded to the company server.

•Check new revisions for details affecting Vertiv’s scope of supply and quickly communicate any impacts to Vertiv’s technical, cost and schedule impacts, back to the customer and the Sales and Projects team for management of variations.

•Provide a completed set of project documentation to the Project Management Team on delivery of the project for hand-over to the client.

Technical Procurement Specification

•Where necessary, prepare a detailed Scope of Supply to Procurement, where Vertiv contractors and vendors are required to undertake works on our behalf. Documentation should be thorough enough to be used by procurement to gain the necessary number of quotations and enable tensioning of vendors to occur.

•Scopes of Supply should also ensure there are no areas of overlap or gaps in scop, reducing our risk of double-ups or variations from our vendors

Scope Changes:

•Liaise with Sales and Project Managers to capture all site, scope and testing departures from our original submission, are captured, and highlighted to the customer. Provide variation documentation as and when required to ensure Entry margins are not eroded through the span of the project.

Technical Submittals:

•Manage revisions and updates to site documentation post the Purchase Order. This will include incorporating documentation changes into revised Statements of Compliance and other affected documents.

Drawings:

•See Technical Submittal, above.

•Work with PSA team to have as-built drawings developed and updated as necessary, ready for site hand-over.

Continuous Improvement:

•Lead the identification of engineering lessons learned across project delivery and ensure they are translated into actionable design and process improvements.

•Identify recurring technical, design or delivery issues and drive corrective actions across future projects.

•Contribute to the development and refinement of engineering standards, templates and design tools.

•Share technical insights and best practices across engineering, sales and project delivery teams.

•Promote a culture of continuous improvement and engineering accountability across the business.

WHS, Environment & Quality:

•Comply with all Work, Health & Safety, Environment and Quality obligations.

•Actively promote safety in the workplace

•Product Managers

•Sales Engineers/Account Managers

•Project Managers

•Procurement

•Service Teams

Main contacts outside the Company

•Vertiv customers and clients

•Third party suppliers of products and services

•Project Management team members

Education/Qualification:

•Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering

•10+ years engineering experience

Specialist Knowledge:

•Market knowledge of mission critical cooling infrastructure, including application, installation, commissioning, testing and communications connectivity

•Tender processes and the application of products to fit their requirements.

•Good understanding and knowledge of HVAC industry and products

•Knowledge of the application of Australian and international standards framework and industry codes

Practical Experience:

•Market knowledge of Power products including application

•Tender processes and the application of products to fit their requirements

•Excellent technical understanding and knowledge of thermal management products and concepts.

•Excellent competency in reading technical drawings and design specifications.

•Proficient in technical writing.

•English writing and presentation skills

•ACAD drawing skills would be an advantage.

job.title: Sr. Workforce Manager, CXQO, Just Walk Out Technology
job.description:
As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

Just Walk Out (JWO) Technology is a team of entrepreneurial, analytical, and creative builders with innovation at our core. Designed and custom-built by Amazonians, JWO operates with the speed and agility of a start-up while leveraging the scale of Amazon. We use computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning to push the boundaries of what is possible in retail technology — enabling customers to shop in engaging, fast, and safe ways.

Our checkout-free shopping experience automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to shelves, maintaining a real-time virtual cart for each shopper. When a customer finishes shopping, they simply walk out. Shortly after, we charge their account and send a receipt — no lines, no checkout, no friction.

We are looking for a Sr. Workforce Manager- who is passionate about customer experience, thinks and acts globally, a strong communicator and networker to build successful working relationships across worldwide JWO network and has the edge to drive industry standard innovations.

The successful candidate will:

  • Lead the Workforce planning team for multiple regions.
  • Create best capacity plan for business by managing trade-offs between Customer Experience/Service Levels and Cost Effectiveness.
  • Develop, improve and optimize work assignment, prioritization logic to manage work from various regions with multiple constraints.
  • Mitigate capacity risks by managing dependencies across multiple operating units. Clearly communicate dependencies and manage/track exceptions.
  • Partner with Operations, Capacity Planning and Finance teams to analyze historical data and work trends and provide workforce inputs. Manage the analyses of daily, weekly, and monthly reporting of regional performance via Key Performance Indicators.
  • Support management to optimize staffing requirements. Manage Service Levels (SL) and provide recommended workflow options and directives to maintain acceptable SL.
  • Fully leverage existing technology, including global standardization of reporting.

You lead by example and are a role model when it comes to insisting on the highest standards and maintaining an atmosphere of respect for customers. No task is beneath you. You fully live the Amazon Leadership Principles and are passionate about helping your team do the same. You have a high bar for quality and hold your team to the same standards. This role requires candidates to be flexible to working in Night shifts and Rotational Week offs Please note: this team is not customer-facing.

Key job responsibilities Job Responsibilities:

  • Understand and communicates the department vision to team members, at the same time assess behaviors and coach direct reports in their role.
  • Lead Projects to improve planning and execution efficiency and support worldwide network of business units, and operational centers.
  • Identify/Implement workforce management tools and technology enablers that will improve operating accuracy and efficiency
  • Manage the development of global standards (Average Handle time, NPT, Shrinkage, Attrition) working with Capacity planning ensuring that all changes successfully inter-operate with existing operational processes.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Capacity Planning, Technology and internal workflow teams to maintain and update plans.
  • Communicate these plans and report on their execution to various stakeholders, and continuously improve the planning and execution cycle.
  • Monitor performance by analyzing performance statistics; evaluating staffing schedules to match volume demand; evaluating potential productivity & quality standards; identifying and resolving problems; determining system and process improvements.
  • Prepare management reporting by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends and developing recommendations.
  • Improve quality of reporting and work to streamline various data sources to drive consistent reporting.
  • Promote process improvement and standardization of processes across all sites.
  • Lead and participate in global projects and initiatives & own providing optimal solutions for upcoming initiatives.
  • Proactively identify service improvement opportunities and ensure continuous improvement within Workforce Management across advisor scheduling, metric reporting and real-time delivery.
  • Participate in global initiatives to cater to growing business needs
  • Communicate and maintain vision, Leadership Principles and culture with the team
  • Written and verbal communication up to senior leadership.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in management directly
  • 5+ years of data interpretation and analysis to influence stakeholders experience
  • 7+ years of with Excel experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MS Power Query, Python)
  • Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
  • Experience managing teams who deliver on defined goals and timelines
  • Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in a relevant industry working within technology teams
  • Experience in managing and troublshooting network, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
  • Experience being responsible/leading large and complex negotiations
  • Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
